title: Humanoid robots with artificial muscles
body: >\nDuring a recent event in Silicon Valley <a href=\

>(Souce), one that attracted attention, not because it was exaggerated, but because of the level of realism that it entails, the possibility of creating synthetic humans at scale, the company Clone Robotics is proposing a completely different approach from what the world has become accustomed to seeing in robots.


Instead of motors, gears and rigid structures, they are trying to replicate something much more complex, the human body itself, while much of the industry builds machines that imitate the human form, Clone tries to copy the internal functioning, the robot they developed does not use a traditional metal skeleton, it is based on a polymer structure that imitates the human anatomy and instead of electric motors they use artificial muscles called Miofiber.


It is a technology inspired by hydraulic systems that seeks to reproduce the way real muscles contract, relax and generate movement, this creates a level of fluidity and precision that traditional robos simply cannot achieve, but there is a high technical cost behind all this.


Controlling this type of system is extremely complex because each movement requires the simultaneous control of multiple variables, something much closer to biology than classical engineering, this is where artificial intelligence comes in; According to the company, the most advanced models manage to abstract this complexity, allowing the system to operate this synthetic body as if it were a conventional machine, but with much more natural movements.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2SYA8ELZmEs
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> And the company's plans show that this is not an isolated experiment. They have already defined a classic roadmap, in 2026 they will reach a level of precision sufficient to manipulate delicate tools. In 2027 achieve a completely natural walk, in 2028 launch the first commercial robberies focused on environments such as hotels and corporate services. The point that really changes everything is the cost, according to the founders themselves, it is already possible to produce these machines for less than $20,000. a value that places this technology dangerously close to mass access and that completely changes the equation because when a technology approaches that price level, it stops being experimental and begins to become inevitable. Perhaps the most uncomfortable part is yet to come, the company also revealed that it intends to evolve these models towards increasingly human versions, first with neutral faces, then with full facial expressions, replicating dozens of muscles responsible for micro-expressions, that is, machines that not only move like humans, but look like humans. And when that level is reached, the difference between natural and artificial might simply disappear. When you look at this idea of ​​synthetic humans, it seems far away, almost theoretical, but there is a technical detail that is making all of this possible now.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

links.title: Más Núcleo [Esp/Eng]
links.body:
>

Más Núcleo. Continuamos activando la región abdominal, con un trabajo conjunto entre piernas y brazos. La rutina de hoy está diseñada para que todo el abdomen, cadera y glúteos, realicen actividades potentes para desarrollar y fortalecer la región en cuestión. De verdad que, cuando uno realiza ejercicios diferentes y fuera del aburrimiento, el ejercicio se hace más dinámico y se sienten más ganas de entrenar. Como siempre digo; cada quien trabajando a su ritmo, para que no exista ningún problema con nuestro cuerpo. La idea es que exista ánimo para salir del sedentarismo e iniciar un cambio positivo en tu vida. No olvides que cada rutina está preparada, para que poco a poco te conviertas en un maestro del entrenamiento; mis conocimientos son tuyos. >More Core Work. We’ll continue engaging the abdominal region, coordinating the legs and arms. Today’s routine is designed to have your entire abdomen, hips, and glutes perform powerful movements to develop and strengthen these areas. Honestly, when you do different exercises that break the monotony, your workout becomes more dynamic, and you feel more motivated to train. As I always say, everyone should work at their own pace so there are no issues with our bodies. The idea is to find the motivation to break free from a sedentary lifestyle and start making positive changes in your life. Don’t forget that each routine is designed so that, little by little, you become a master of training; my knowledge is yours.

![1000444633.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKLsm75jpLLLLePaNSwRr5gN3pT2Chxkp6h6dte8dHS1FAQM323iS3fGNb7ruJr.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **GOLPES ALTERNOS HACIA ATRÁS CON GIRO DE CADERA**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera, con brazos en postura de combate. >[**Warm-up 1**, **ALTERNATING BACKWARD SWINGS WITH HIP ROTATION**]() >[Stance]() >Feet hip-width apart, arms in a fighting stance.
![1000444594.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKe6bpXKKdtyRBXWdKENCQAmE1GtDqHK9uAmjWN3Nof3mKYajW3xYzEjTCT1pN8.gif)
[Ejecución]() Activos en la postura indicada, giramos el cuerpo hacia atrás de forma alterna y de esta manera, propinamos golpes rectos. >[Execution]() >While maintaining the indicated stance, we alternate turning our bodies backward to deliver straight punches.
![1000444598.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKcfM4kde3XmbiW5X4cKZT9whFHFn1hrbspAHu9kRRyturfnp9L7ntHEkwUaatg.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **GIRO ABDOMINAL**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas más allá del ancho de hombros con rodillas flexionadas. Torso ligeramente flexionado hacia adelante; codos flexionados con brazos al frente. >[**Warm-up 2**, **ABDOMINAL TWIST**]() >[Posture]() >Legs spread wider than shoulder-width apart with knees bent. Upper body slightly bent forward; elbows bent with arms in front.
![1000444600.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKe6cYr5Ym6ZQwNfKDMEBvnsm8XuaqA2Vhh9SKZSbjJM7bgYsGCKxa5TBQ6yn9V.gif)
[Ejecución]() Durante 3 minutos de actividad; mientras hacemos leve pulso de piernas, vamos girando el torso de lado a lado. >[Execution]() >For 3 minutes, while doing light leg lifts, rotate your torso from side to side.
![1000444606.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKp9GkSn4qH5XXbqvKftNfubc1tBLDXjXW3w3bXfaUrVeNdHNuozrUJQj47NJnK.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **GIRO DE CADERA CON TOQUE DE PISO EN POSTURA DEL CANGREJO**]() [Postura]() Sentados en el piso, ubicamos las manos en el suelo detrás de la espalda. Rodillas flexionadas y elevamos la cadera quedando en postura del cangrejo. >[**Station 1**, **HIP ROTATION WITH A TOUCH OF THE FLOOR IN CRAB POSE**]() >[Pose]() >Sitting on the floor, place your hands on the floor behind your back. Bend your knees and lift your hips into crab pose.
![1000444608.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKHzyKajhuLg8xHqu57nvjePgdJGen4MhtKz8TdCZqVodEcaiTfxUvQGAoDahKU.gif)
[Ejecución]() Todo el cuerpo trabajando, brindando mayor énfasis en la región del núcleo; brazos y piernas en absoluta tensión. Ahora; para realizar el movimiento, giramos el torso de lado a lado, despegando una mano para tocar el piso del lado del giro. Nos vamos con 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >Engage your entire body, focusing particularly on your core; keep your arms and legs fully tensed. Now, to perform the movement, rotate your torso from side to side, lifting one hand to touch the floor on the side you’re turning toward. We’ll do a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000444612.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKHzxfcHqN2RakhCsNNztND5MGmGrRcoigUfJ1o1AHRNvqiqgKrfqava9MJc7yc.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **CRUCH ABDOMINAL CON TOQUE DE RODILLAS Y CODOS**]() [Postura]() Nos acostamos en el piso boca arriba; piernas extendidas y elevadas. Codos flexionados con brazos hacia atrás y manos tocando suelo a nivel de la cabeza. >[**Station 2**, **ABDOMINAL CRUNCH WITH KNEES AND ELBOWS TOUCHING**]() >[Position]() >Lie on your back on the floor with your legs extended and raised. Bend your elbows, bringing your arms back so your hands touch the floor at head level.
![1000444614.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKKSWf4wqLaH46Kyd4sz4AfpDY6gZQ7nftM9z8LUdiP2WPQcGiMLvryK2WmeW22.gif)
[Ejecución]() Sin lugar a dudas que el abdomen, cadera y glúteos se mantienen super activas. Brazos y piernas trabajando en segundo plano. Para llevar a acabo el ejercicio, ejecutamos el abdominal llevando el torso al frente; al mismo tiempo, se flexionan las rodillas llevándolas contra el abdomen para chocar las rodillas y codos. Realizamos 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >There’s no doubt that the abs, hips, and glutes are working hard. The arms and legs are working in the background. To perform the exercise, do a crunch by bringing your torso forward; at the same time, bend your knees and bring them toward your abdomen so that your knees and elbows touch. Do 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000444618.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKKSXNxfnemS5ZK3Vr41pxMYR3S53PXehP2r9jBmndzuMjzGuUm9tiLcWYP6GJc.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **PUENTE DE GLÚTEOS MÁS GIRO DE TORSO Y TOQUE DE PISO**]() [Postura]() Nuevamente nos acostamos en el piso boca arriba; rodillas flexionados y brazos en el suelo a los lados del cuerpo. >[**Station 3**, **GLUTE BRIDGE WITH TORSO TWIST AND FLOOR TOUCH**]() >[Position]() >Once again, lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your arms on the floor at your sides.
![1000444620.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKRB7PxAujaZH4yVkcsQDDrT7DHGQ3cxxADmdHQQMKbnLRz4UdGRcZhQ6yTnsJQ.gif)
[Ejecución]() Con este ejercicio trabajamos todo el núcleo y las piernas; brazos en segundo plano. Ahora; para ejecutarlo, elevamos cadera y torso quedando apoyados con la parte alta de la espalda. Estando en esa posición; giramos el torso de lado a lado, tocando el suelo con la mano. Para ello se despega el brazo del suelo, el cual se dirige hacia el lado del giro. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >This exercise works your entire core and legs; your arms take a back seat. To perform it, lift your hips and torso so that you’re supported by your upper back. From that position, rotate your torso from side to side, touching the floor with your hand. To do this, lift your arm off the floor and move it toward the side you’re turning toward. Do a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000444622.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKPjusz63dp83rX7t4uuaHaF98zsr4ktk2wp5EpmWpF5q7C8EftCNWxbvrGKTbz.gif)
[**Relajación**, **GIRO ALTERNO DE CADERA**]() [Postura]() De pie, con piernas separadas al ancho de la cadera y manos en la cintura. >[**Relaxation**, **ALTERNATING HIP ROTATION**]() >[Posture]() >Stand with your legs hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPo29Yr9UepeDtdCoBnxHiZXsvM8choVj3ub2Gvy9zMv/1776622584610.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, giramos la cadera de lado a lado de forma alterna; movimientos circulares. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; for 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, we rotate our hips from side to side in an alternating motion; circular movements.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVuA7VSbxdoNRcs7Qy4Kxip1iGuZND886ohxdUM1f1ESu/1776622584734.gif)

links.body:
Francis Bacon

Saludos a toda la comunidad de HIVE, con el fin de promocionar el contenido matemático dentro de nuestra querida red social, a continuación les presento la siguiente sección en la cual se estará publicando un problema matemático a ser resuelto, los problemas abordarán diversas áreas de la Matemática (Aritmética, Álgebra, Geometría, Análisis, entre otros).

Los invito a compartir sus soluciones, sin más preámbulo les presento el problema

Un atleta sigue un plan de entrenamiento en el que corre una distancia que aumenta cada día siguiendo una progresión aritmética. El primer día corre 3 km, y cada día aumenta 0.5 km respecto al día anterior. ¿Cuántos kilómetros corre el día 20? ¿Cuántos kilómetros habrá corrido en total después de 20 días?


La matemática es la ciencia de la abstracciones, que presenta cierta belleza austera para todo aquel que decide dedicarse a su estudio.

Me despido deseándoles feliz blogging.

links.title: Sombras nada más (microficción para Javier Solís)
links.body:
[Javier Solís](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Javier_Sol%C3%ADs), uno de los más grandes cantantes mexicanos de ranchera, y de otros géneros, falleció el 19 de abril de 1966, es decir, hace 60 años. Seguramente, muchos usuarios de #Hive no sabrán de este cantautor, pero trato por este modesto post de presentárselo. Lo hago por medio de una microficción.
![Javier Solís.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23zGj1B1AZU5xvaM6y51MrbnyT8CozJZQQuG5EQ3391hd5MWpAw9AtasxouQdjW3MBtkj.png)
Javier Solís - [Fuente](https://ehplustv.com/el-inolvidable-javier-solis/)

Soy estas propinas que me dieron aquellos solidarios compatriotas. Gracias a ellos pude sobrevivir en la Ciudad de México, pobre y hostil, para nosotros, que veníamos de la humilde familia sostenida por la panadería. ¡El pan del padre, el pan de Dios! Había que darle por donde fuera posible, y me tocó cantar en restaurantes, bares y plazas. Quería salir de ese limitado espacio, al que agradezco siendo hoy esta figura reconocida. No pude llegar a ser esto que soy si no hubiera existido esa tierra donde germinó mi canción y mi voz. En verdad, somos sombras; no sé si de algún espacio que no conocemos seamos luz. Aunque deseamos la luz, muchas veces solamente tenemos la oscuridad. Y también en o con ella vivimos.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UasiMOoMz1o

Hola amigos de Womentribe, deseo que estén pasando una bonita noche o día. Leí con atención [el post](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-traguese-ese-sapo) de nuestra amiga @syllem sobre el libro que está leyendo —el cual tiene un nombre bastante peculiar— y las reflexiones que ha obtenido durante su lectura. Cuando tenemos un libro o algo que cambia nuestra perspectiva de la vida, podemos llegar a ver con más claridad el camino, ya no como algo que es dificultoso, sino como un tránsito que se hace con la idea de querer siempre hacer lo que se ama y también lo que nuestro cuerpo y mente necesita. 

Desde hace mucho tiempo he tenido inseguridades sobre todo con temas de mi autoestima, pienso que más que todo comenzó por la idea errónea de una perfección que es falsa y que nunca se puede llegar a alcanzar. Me llenaba de muchos pensamientos pesimistas y me daba látigo con frases que hacían que me sintiera aún más incompleta o poco autosuficiente. Sobre todo porque en los veintes crees que la vida debe ir encaminada con un mapa donde en cada cierto tiempo ya hay que tener ciertas metas y objetivos cumplidos. Pero la vida no es así, mucho menos es un camino lineal. 

Cuando tenía ese tipo de pensamientos, me sentía muy mal al punto de no querer mostrar mi forma realmente de ser ni tampoco hacer las cosas que me gustaban por vergüenza 🫣. Fue una etapa complicada que solo con muchas sacudidas de la vida, pude llegar a entender y comprender pero no me quedé viviendo en ese mismo círculo vicioso y entendí que todos tenemos cosas que nos hacen diferentes y no por eso, somos menos o más que los demás. Me costó llegar a ese nivel de comprensión, incluso por medio de mi salud fue que pude entender que era muy afortunada en muchos sentidos. 

Por eso cuando leí el post de @syllem recordé algo que me pasa muy seguido porque soy una persona muy observadora pero precavida. Cuando salgo a la calle tengo la inseguridad de verme como una persona que tiene una condición en una pierna —por fortuna tengo mi pierna sana— pero que me hace andar de forma más lenta y diferente. Se que esto puede ser mínimo para alguien más, pero para mí al comienzo fue difícil de aceptar. Entonces cuando volví a retomar actividades que requerían salir de la casa me di cuenta de que hay muchas personas con problemas parecidos al mío o incluso mucho peores que el mío. 

Y esto no es que me hace sentir feliz o llena de satisfacción por ver al otro en un mal estado de salud o físicamente. Sino que más bien me abrió los ojos ante lo que siempre pensaba de mi misma, siempre esperando ser perfecta o queriendo encajar en un molde que prácticamente solo existía en mi mente. Cuando veo a las personas salir con sus condiciones o con sus peculiaridades, me doy cuenta de que todos llevamos una lucha interna diaria, que no es algo que solo me pasa a mi, y eso me hace pensar que siempre debemos ser más empáticos con los demás, no sabemos cuál sea su situación emocional así que es mejor siempre tener la mejor actitud y no buscat hacer más daño del que ya existe en el mundo. 

Día a día recuerdo a ciertas personas o incluso veo a algunas en muletas, en sillas de ruedas, sin piernas, con una mala situación de salud y pienso que realmente no soy la única que pasa o ha pasado por algo así. Siento que la vida me trata siempre de decir que hay más personas con situaciones que también les pueden generar inseguridad o malestar, que pueden incluso tener menos apoyo por parte de la familia, que pueden ser más solitarios y aún así siguen adelante. Y eso me impulsa a no quedarme sentada cruzada de brazos esperando que vengan los cambios, cuando soy yo la que tengo que hacer que las cosas sucedan, si están en mi poder hacerlas. 

Me gustaría invitar a @sacra97 y @irenenavarroart para que también se unan a esta maravillosa iniciativa, que nos lleva a reflexionar sobre aquello que tal vez nos detiene durante el día y nos hace valorar más lo que somos y lo que tenemos. Un abrazo para todos. 🤗


![1000172951.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23z7SXRnZDu7nFmAyx57R76zKhp3RxQKgfQnPbMFEcvjGXjophtd4Amitm4hH3ajKu369.png)


## Life depends on how you look at it. 

![1000172952.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23xKpQ7auGZUC7B5CJeMMaYt3qi9DwxRVsictsaugg3Jp5Y1vgXUycmdnquP6WCtJJQhL.png)

<center><sub>Image created with Gemini.</sub></center> 

Hello friends of **Womentribe**, I hope you are having a wonderful day or night. I carefully read [the post](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-traguese-ese-sapo) by our friend **@syllem** about the book she’s reading—which has quite a peculiar name—and the reflections she has gained from it. When we encounter a book or something that shifts our perspective on life, we can begin to see the path more clearly—not as something difficult, but as a journey taken with the intention of always doing what we love and what our body and mind truly need.

For a long time, I’ve struggled with **insecurities**, especially regarding my **self-esteem**. I think it mostly started with the false idea of a \

that is fake and impossible to achieve. I used to fill my head with pessimistic thoughts and beat myself up with phrases that made me feel even more incomplete or insufficient. This happens especially in your twenties, when you believe life should follow a map where certain goals and objectives must be met by a specific time. But life isn't like that, and it is certainly not a **linear path**.


When I had those kinds of thoughts, I felt so bad that I didn't want to show my true self or do the things I enjoyed out of shame 🫣. It was a complicated stage that I only came to understand after many of life's \

I chose not to stay trapped in 그hat vicious cycle and realized that **we all have things that make us different**, and that doesn't make us more or less than anyone else. It took me a long time to reach that level of understanding; it was actually through my health that I realized how fortunate I was in many ways.


That’s why, when I read @syllem's post, I remembered something that happens to me often because I am a very observant but cautious person. When I go out, I feel insecure about appearing as someone with a leg condition—fortunately, my leg is healthy—but it makes me walk slower and differently. I know this might seem minor to someone else, but for me, it was hard to accept at first. However, when I resumed activities that required leaving the house, I realized there are many people with similar problems, or even much worse than mine.

This doesn't make me feel happy or satisfied to see someone else in a poor state of health. Instead, **it opened my eyes** to how I viewed myself—always waiting to be perfect or wanting to fit into a mold that practically only existed in my mind. When I see people going about their lives with their own conditions or peculiarities, I realize that we all carry a **daily internal struggle**. It’s not just me, and that reminds me that we must always be more empathetic toward others. We don’t know their emotional situation, so it’s always better to have the best attitude and not seek to cause more pain than already exists in the world.


Every day, I remember certain people or see others on crutches, in wheelchairs, without legs, or in poor health, and I realize I’m truly not the only one going through something like this. I feel like life is always trying to tell me that there are others in situations that could also cause insecurity or discomfort—people who might have even less family support or be more lonely—and yet, **they keep going**.
That drives me to stop sitting idly by, waiting for changes to come. I am the one who has to make things happen if it is within my power to do so.

I would like to invite **@sacra97** and **@irenenavarroart** to join this wonderful initiative, which leads us to reflect on the things that might hold us back and helps us value who we are and what we have more deeply.

**A hug to everyone!** 🤗

links.body:
>

>[**Part 12 Recap: Divine or Daniela Intervention**](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@justclickindiva/6-january-2026-freewriters-community-cf9cc9d9d7b63)
>
>Sitting in the cell thinking, Lyle's pulse quickened. This past year hadn't gone according to his exit timeline. A hot breath spread across his neck as is last words with The Boss materialized. He lowered his gaze as though unconcerned, but anticipating the man's wrath from within. His vindictiveness knew no bounds, as he'd previously witnessed.
>
>*The stench from the crowded cell shot up his nostrils and drew his ire, reminding him of the filthy, overfilled spaces once confined to.*
>
>Besides, he wasn't safe behind these bars. Not from him. However, even at his upper level, The Boss was still labeled a middleman. Lyle gambled on securing excess of his future needs and lost. The ways to an end hadn't panned out. Only by surpassing The Boss could he extricate himself from that heartless monster. The only viable pathway to independence.
>
>*Using the cartel's funds to legitimize his own enterprise was a gamble. But the only way to finally put the past behind. Shadows from chains around his wrists while others enjoyed themselves at his expense nearly evoked suppressed tears. He held them at bay. they couldn't change his past.*
>
>One painful image he recalled was only of a tall, imposing figure who turned away from him. Whispering to another man, the person his mother called his father extended his hand to accept euros. Reaching for his father, the man immediately stuffed a rag in his mouth and bound his hands. He couldn't cry out, but tears flowed as he noticed a starling perched on the windowsill before taking flight. Don't leave me too, he cried silently.
>
>*The next moment, his parents were gone. It was a few days later he learned he'd been exchanged for traveling funds abroad.*
>
>Of no use was remorse or anger over matters he couldn't control at the age of ten. All he knew was that now he belonged to another not of kin. The fact that he survived from victim to controlling his own fate was a testament to his tenacity.
>
>*Once he pigeonholed the finality of his imprisonment, he studied and absorbed the logistics of the trafficking business, realizing the inefficiencies and loopholes of international borders with regards to moving any type of \

. Drugs and weapons were mindless. The faces of workers confined to a fate he knew well began to tear at his innards. Using others along the way in the manner he'd been used satisfied the urge for blind revenge. For a while. And he knew one day he'd have to disappear.*
>
>Slowly, out of the corner of his eye, the cell grew smaller as two inmates moved from behind, headed in his direction. He understood why their hands dug deep within their pockets. He wanted no trouble, but wasn't one to back down.
>
>*\

the tall uniformed guard whispered, then laughed and nudged his partner. They both turned their heads away from the cell Lyle occupied. One twirled his collapsible baton while the other whistled as they kept moving past the cell.*
>
>Defenseless, Lyle rose quickly, pushed the cot toward the approaching inmates, and retreated until his back touched the wall. Help wasn't expected from neither inside or out.
>
>*Lyle didn't ask how one of the inmates obtained the blade he flashed in his direction, nor why the other inmates moved to form a line and cover the front of their cell.*
>
>He only knew the end of his time had come.
>
>*His thoughts immediately flew to Daniela and the note he slipped into the pocket of her pants at the hospital. She wouldn't disappoint. She couldn't.*
>
>Inmates stood watching intently as though participating in a collective payday. Bars on the outside of the cell rattled amid the silence inside. Lyle breathed a long sigh. All he could do was raise his hands across his face in defense. The first cut to Lyle's wrist only slashed his shirt as he thrust his foot forward. It met the inmate's knee, immediately dislodging the knife and disabling him. But the second inmate joined in. He retrieved the knife and moved quickly toward Lyle to finish the job.
>
>*With one man down, Lyle was expert at one-on-one. Gaining control of the knife was his only thought. They exchanged jabs as other inmates standing against the bars cheered. Before the inmate attacking could gain momentum, Lyle pushed the cot against the man's body causing the knife to fall.*
>
>\

Lyle hissed as the bloodied second inmate rose to his feet before wobbling away.
>
>*Through the commotion, Lyle didn't see Olivia standing outside the cell with the two guards watching the scene play out.*
>
>\

Olivia ordered one of the guards.
>
>*At the same time Olivia arranged for Lyle to be removed from the cell and released into her custody, Daniela was waiting on her release orders from the doctor. While sitting patiently, she glanced at the wall clock. Her father would arrive soon to take her home. She rose to gather her clothes, then sat on the bed and dressed slowly. Pulling up her pants, she noticed a bulge, so reached inside. To her surprise, a piece of paper was lodged there.*
>
>Reading the note, she paused for a long moment at the end. Signed Lyle. You meant to write, \
, didn't you, she thought to herself, then tossed it near the edge of the bed. Shaking her head violently as if to unread his message, she whispering, *\
*\n>\n>*Instantly, a small quiver she couldn't determine its origin interrupted her thoughts. She shuddered. *\

* she mulled over.*
>
>As though an afterthought, she grabbed the note, then gasped! The nerve of him, she thought trembling. Still, she read it carefully a third time. Sensing a thaw of her resolve, thought gremlins intervened and hammered her brain attempting to loosen the emotional grip Lyle still held.
>
>*But they couldn't. She'd already decided her next move. And it wasn't by no means the **norm**.*

**Part 13 - A Glimmer of Hope**

![262866.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23swXV8TTdSfCAMefZgEG2MHmtqq9ibT4QeFL1viVbJRuMz1ESKLDzDm4NkSDENoFbtBM.png)

Decision made, Daniela walked slowly from the hospital, lead by her father. Silence fell between them as he drove her to the home she knew as as child.

Emerging from her inner thoughts, she pointed frantically, *\
he scolded.\n\nShe refused to tell him the reason for fear he'd think her insane allowing Lyle to continue to dictate her life until he demanded, \
Don't you care at all for your own life?\
I need to retrieve some valuable information that may help clear Lyle's name in all this mess. He left it in the attic that the police overlooked because it was hidden in a cup board he cut out.\

Haven't you had enough abuse and been duped by that man long enough. What if it's only another ploy to help him flee the country? Do you want to be an accomplish? to that. I know I taught you better than that. Think for once with your head and not your feelings. Although I don't understand what you ever saw in that man!\
I hope to God you didn't tell him.\
Of course not. I'm not completely stupid. I understand my and his predicament.\
is there anything else you've left out, such as where you're going to meet him to hand these over?\
Yes, he left me a note in the hospital where to meet him.\
You've made a wise decision to hand over the ledgers to us.\
I don't know what you mean?\
Evidently you don't know Daniela as well as you think. She's finally come to her senses.\
Do you both a favor and allow us to handle everything. You got a taste of what trying to go it along back there in the cell will be like. We can protect you and...,\
I'm merely a facilitator. But I'd rather die at the hands of The Boss' inner circle. You can't protect me and have no idea how far and deep the net that has entangled \

in high places. I know too many who would silence me without a thought to keep their names under the rocks. The waterways' octopus has many tentacles, at the end of which all are paid to look the other way while the trafficking wheels turn and lubricate their pockets. Finished with that tidbit, he sat back and turned his gaze toward the window as a worried scowl enveloped his face, fearful of where they were headed if indeed he'd misjudged his wife. *[to be continued]*
![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)
For my theme, I was inspired by and utilized the @daily.prompt's publishing of [6 January 2026, @mariannewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 2974: norm](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/6-january-2026-mariannewests-freewrite-writing-prompt-day-2974-norm); together with the prompts listed below: [14 March 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3042: can’t find the evidence](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/14-march-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3042-cant-find-the-evidence) [5 January 2026, @mariannewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 2973: has no heart](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/5-january-2026-mariannewests-freewrite-writing-prompt-day-2973-has-no-heart); [4 January 2026, @mariannewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 2972: reinforced](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/4-january-2026-mariannewests-freewrite-writing-prompt-day-2972-reinforced); [3 January 2026, @mariannewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 2971: can’t overlook that](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/3-january-2026-mariannewests-freewrite-writing-prompt-day-2971-cant-overlook-that); [1 January 2026, @mariannewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 2969: what an appearance!](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/1-january-2026-mariannewests-freewrite-writing-prompt-day-2969-what-an-appearance); [22 December 2025, @mariannewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 2959: the last date](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/22-december-2025-mariannewests-freewrite-writing-prompt-day-2959-the-last-date); **and** [21 December 2025, @mariannewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 2958: the secret in the attic](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/21-december-2025-mariannewests-freewrite-writing-prompt-day-2958-the-secret-in-the-attic)

> ****
![Pixabay-TAI-Design-man-in-coat-ai-generated-9017655_640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/EoAS6LaoocPgeYrrB9Y9HxspC6QF59aKeQqvjqPMHbW252NL3TGqkWjosDfhhCcRHFh.jpg) [Source...](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/ai-generated-man-hat-detective-spy-9017655/)
**Parte 13 - Un rayo de esperanza** Una vez tomada la decisión, Daniela salió lentamente del hospital, acompañada por su padre. El silencio se apoderó de ambos mientras él la llevaba en coche a la casa que ella conocía de niña. Saliendo de sus pensamientos, señaló con nerviosismo: *«¿Adónde vamos? Tienes que dar la vuelta. Es urgente que vaya a casa inmediatamente».* «¿Qué hay allí de tan importante? Lyle está en la cárcel, y ese lugar solo te trae malos recuerdos», la reprendió él. Ella se negó a decirle el motivo por miedo a que pensara que estaba loca, lo que permitiría a Lyle seguir dictando su vida hasta que él exigió: «No daré la vuelta a menos que me digas ahora mismo qué haces allí. ¿No te importa en absoluto tu propia vida?». *«¡Está bien!»,* gritó ella. *«Necesito recuperar información valiosa que pueda ayudar a limpiar el nombre de Lyle en todo este lío. La dejó en el ático, donde la policía no la vio porque estaba escondida en un armario que él mismo había recortado».* Su padre ladeó la cabeza hacia ella con una mirada de total sorpresa. «¿No has sufrido ya suficientes abusos y te ha engañado ese hombre durante demasiado tiempo? ¿Y si solo es otra estratagema para ayudarle a huir del país? ¿Quieres ser cómplice de eso? Sé que te he enseñado a ser mejor que eso. Piensa por una vez con la cabeza y no con los sentimientos. ¡Aunque no entiendo qué viste nunca en ese hombre!». Silencio de nuevo. Tras un largo rato, Daniela dejó escapar un profundo suspiro antes de confesarlo. *«Papá, estoy embarazada».* Lo único que se le ocurrió decir a su padre fue: «Espero por Dios que no se lo hayas dicho». Ella se apresuró a responder. *«Por supuesto que no. No soy tan tonta. Entiendo la situación en la que nos encontramos tanto él como yo».* «Lo dudo», fue la única respuesta de su padre. No quería hacerlo, pero se dio la vuelta y se dirigió a la casa de ella y Lyle. Una vez allí, subió al ático y recuperó la información que tenía en su poder. Daniela no se opuso a su decisión. Al salir, él le preguntó con dureza: «¿Hay algo más que te hayas dejado de contar, como dónde vas a encontrarte con él para entregarle esto?». Atónita, su padre dedujo la petición de Lyle, y ella simplemente respondió: *«Sí, me dejó una nota en el hospital indicando dónde encontrarme con él».* Estaba tan enfadado que no se atrevió a mirarla, limitándose a decir: «Entonces, no irás sola». Al instante, se puso al teléfono. Daniela no podía descifrar su conversación, así que se quedó sentada en silencio, esperando que todo se resolviera por sí solo.
![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)
Mientras tanto, Olivia había sacado a Lyle de la cárcel. Un sedán negro se acercó y aparcó cerca de allí. Al abrir la puerta, metió a Lyle dentro y lo dejó al cuidado de su compañera. Nada más entregarlo a la custodia de su compañera, sonó el teléfono. Miró fijamente a Lyle mientras asentía con la cabeza, luego sonrió y se subió con él al coche patrulla. Dio un golpecito en el asiento delantero y su compañero arrancó. —Has tomado una sabia decisión al entregarnos los libros de contabilidad. —Olivia miró por la ventanilla del coche y esperó su respuesta. —¿A qué te refieres? —preguntó Lyle, con el pulso acelerado. —Evidentemente, no conoces a Daniela tan bien como crees. Por fin ha entrado en razón. —Olivia volvió a esperar. Pero Lyle se limitó a mirar al frente. No se lo creía. Daniela no lo traicionaría. Entonces recordó la llamada de hacía unos momentos y su sonrisa decidida. Olivia siguió presionando para obtener una reacción. «Hazos un favor a los dos y dejad que nos encarguemos de todo. Ya has tenido una muestra de lo que será intentar salir adelante allí dentro, en la celda. Podemos protegerte y...», afirmó con naturalidad antes de hacer una pausa. No le correspondía a ella revelar la verdad sobre Daniela. Por fin respondió. Empezando despacio, explicó sin entrar en detalles las maquinaciones. «Yo solo soy un facilitador. Pero prefiero morir a manos del círculo íntimo del Jefe. Ustedes no pueden protegerme y no tienen ni idea de cuán amplia y profunda es la red que ha enredado a la “gente buena” en las altas esferas. Conozco a demasiados que me silenciarían sin pensarlo dos veces para mantener sus nombres ocultos bajo la piedra. El pulpo de las vías fluviales tiene muchos tentáculos, al final de los cuales todos son pagados para mirar hacia otro lado mientras las ruedas del tráfico giran y lubrican sus bolsillos. Una vez terminada esa revelación, se recostó y dirigió la mirada hacia la ventana mientras una mueca de preocupación envolvía su rostro, temeroso de hacia dónde se dirigían si, de hecho, había juzgado mal a su esposa. *[continuará]*
![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)

body.title: 3Speak Encoder Network Weekly Activity Report — Week 20
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eddie-3speak/Eo6DF1G75FXBGvGKkKoSBHKeXSKLQaW5riEfLNkqktVRVi4WR9kETH9Mqve3jg8PVpD.png)

This is the weekly activity report for the 3Speak decentralized encoding network. The report covers encoder node activity, aggregated output per Hive account, and reward distribution based on work completed during the week.

This week, **225 encoding jobs** were processed across 8 nodes operated by 7 Hive accounts. Most nodes held a 100% success rate, with one node at 97%.

---

## Encoder Activity

| Encoder Node | Hive Account | Jobs | Success |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3speak-snapie-encoder | @snapie | 37 | 100% |
| eddie-3speak-encoder | @eddie-3speak | 35 | 97% |
| 3speak-ph1102-node | @ph1102 | 31 | 100% |
| sagar-ubuntu-1 | @sagarkothari88 | 29 | 100% |
| Butter-Node | @joseamenac | 29 | 100% |
| 3speak-encoder-node | @rishi556.lambo | 26 | 100% |
| atexoras-3speak-encoder | @forkyishere | 25 | 100% |
| ph1102-mac-node | @ph1102 | 13 | 100% |

---

## Aggregated Jobs by Hive Account

| Hive Account | Total Jobs |
|---|---|
| @ph1102 | 44 |
| @snapie | 37 |
| @eddie-3speak | 35 |
| @sagarkothari88 | 29 |
| @joseamenac | 29 |
| @rishi556.lambo | 26 |
| @forkyishere | 25 |

**Total: 225 jobs**

---

## Reward Distribution (7 Beneficiaries)

Only 7 accounts were active this week, so all are included as beneficiaries.

| Hive Account | Jobs | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| @ph1102 | 44 | 20% |
| @snapie | 37 | 16% |
| @eddie-3speak | 35 | 16% |
| @sagarkothari88 | 29 | 13% |
| @joseamenac | 29 | 13% |
| @rishi556.lambo | 26 | 11% |
| @forkyishere | 25 | 11% |
| **Total** | **225** | **100%** |

---

## Notes

- **@ph1102** leads the week with 44 aggregated jobs across two nodes, both back in action after `ph1102-mac-node` was inactive last week.
- **@rishi556.lambo** is back with 26 jobs after being absent in Week 19.
- **@sagarkothari88** ran a single node this week (`sagar-ubuntu-1` only), down from the usual multi-node setup.
- Overall volume continues a gradual downward trend: 279 (Weeks 15/16) to 232/233 (Weeks 17/18) to 246 (Week 19) to 225 this week.

---

## Get Involved

Want to help power decentralized video encoding on 3Speak? Running an encoder node is a great way to contribute to the network and earn rewards for your work.

Reach out to **@eddiespino** on the 3Speak Discord for more info:
https://discord.gg/NSFS2VGj83

**Useful links:**
- [Gateway Monitor](https://gateway-monitor.3speak.tv)
- [Direct Encoding Monitor](https://gateway-monitor.3speak.tv/direct-encoding)
- [Analytics](https://monitor.3speak.tv/analytics)
- [Preview Frontend](https://preview.3speak.tv)

---

*Thank you to all encoder operators for keeping the 3Speak network decentralized and running strong.*

body.title: Building a small wall
body.body: >Hace unas dos semanas tuve un accidente horrible, gracias a un irresponsable que dejo inundar su apartamento, la cosa es que nuestro apartamento tambien se inundo y fue un desastre, estuvimos pensando mucho en que hacer para arreglar esa situación ya que es algo que puede volver a repetirse, ya sea tarde o temprano eso puede volver a pasar asi que tomamos la decisión de seguir el consejo de nuestra vecina y hacer un pequeño muro afuera de la casa y asi evitar una inundación igual. > About two weeks ago, I had a terrible accident, all because of some irresponsible person who let their apartment flood. The thing is, our apartment flooded too, and it was a disaster. We thought long and hard about what to do to fix the situation, since it’s something that could happen again—sooner or later, it might happen again—so we decided to follow our neighbor’s advice and build a small wall outside the house to prevent a similar flood. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)

>Pero nosotros no teníamos idea de como hacerlo asi que mi suegro se ofreció a ayudarnos, asi que ayer comenzó a construir el muro afuera de nuestra reja, como no sabíamos nada al respecto lo ayudamos en las cosas básicas, conseguirle algunos materiales, asistirlo en diferentes peticiones y no fue un trabajo demasiado largo pero si bastante agotador para el. > But we had no idea how to do it, so my father-in-law offered to help us. Yesterday he started building the wall outside our fence. Since we didn’t know anything about it, we helped him with the basics—getting him some materials and assisting him with various requests. It wasn’t a very long job, but it was quite exhausting for him. ![IMG_20260418_121838.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xeZ56Y7fWuhoWhUEo5WgKzTSwWM3LLYuVyLUMUD92H5j5jpJPqNRCyja2dzKx6HSWVr.jpg)

>Obviamente aun no esta listo, pero al menos ya está armado, aún sigue sin secar por completo, aunque mi suegro hoy iba a quitar las cosas que coloco para sostenerlo al final decidido que debemos esperar un poco mas para poder sacar todo y luego comenzar con la segunda fase que seria afinar los detalles que falten y colocarle cerámica para que se vea bonito. > Obviously, it’s not ready yet, but at least it’s already assembled. It still isn’t completely dry, though. My father-in-law was going to remove the supports today, but in the end he decided we should wait a little longer before taking everything out and then moving on to the second phase, which involves finishing up the remaining details and adding ceramic tiles to make it look nice. ![IMG_20260418_133926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xAR82GyimcRaf4rhk3wVgTbznAqqZSPT57VUE1MGrj8npEEY2oMfJsvUY68TVspWtBJ.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_121922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xeXDZta8mzSnRbzQ1HqidXUQjgChG6pRexFa7e22FTkSYm23oMnXFpQesqfEw29DRSm.jpg)

>Aunque parezca una tontería es algo que realmente ayuda cuando pasan estos accidentes y me di cuenta de eso porque justamente mi vecina tiene un murito asi y su casa no se inundó ese día y bueno, esperaremos a ver el resultado final en unos dias. > It might sound silly, but it really helps when accidents like this happen, and I realized that because my neighbor actually has a little wall like that, and her house didn't flood that day. Well, we'll wait and see the final result in a few days.. ![IMG_20260418_164613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EoAZoL4NeaUiCqDsnsiGDnpWMSbdDwCoauuzDQwAdadmBYREMwdTGuUc54p9pwNzunk.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_164610.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EoCgdfwMoDTHoYUs6drzhMHuZPj2m8T1VN6NgxLRpEhaqRiTgqDTddEb8ALpC3APK6y.jpg)

body.title: Alice's Stroy, For them, or for me
body.body:
Warm greetings to my dear friends at Buskeria! I'm happy to be with you all again today. I'm going to share the story I've written about Alice. She's a singer, but perhaps she strays a bit from her path in her quest for fame. You'll see what happens to her. I hope you enjoy it. With that said, let's begin.

> Saludos cordiales mis queridos amigos de Buskeria, me alegra estar un día más con todos ustedes por acá en estas tierras. En este día les voy a compartir la historia que he escrito sobre Alice. Ella es una chica que es cantante. Pero quizás se desvía un poco de su rumbo en la búsqueda de ser alguien reconocido. Ya verán lo que le pasa. Espero que les guste, dicho esto comenzamos.



<div class=\

> ![1776466162245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23zbPY6q9f8SvsBVd3AcHcAgDq52sy9EgWorD9A7Xc8vcZYU6CwqN5vjWSReSteqMLYDj.jpg) Image created by me in canva Alice always wanted to be a singer; that was her clear goal. She felt ready to take on the music world. When she started, she thoroughly enjoyed the process: creating songs, composing them, writing the lyrics. It was what she had always dreamed of. She didn't start off very strong because, being new to music, many people didn't know her. So it was normal that her initial songs didn't make a big splash in Buskeria; she almost went unnoticed. With each new song she released, she gained more experience and could correct her mistakes. She also learned what she liked, and what people liked too. She always tried to be balanced in that regard, giving people what they liked but without keeping anything for herself, what she liked. That formula worked very well for her, allowing her to enjoy the journey while rising like a star in her own right. In other words, fulfilling the dreams of everyone who lives in Buskeria. Her rise took up a large part of her youth, and she has now reached the top of the regional charts as a fully-fledged artist. Although everything had taken time, he didn't complain about anything. Every song he released, no matter how bad it was in the past, or if it wasn't widely listened to, served directly or indirectly to make him who he is today. > Quería llegar a ser una cantante, esa era la meta clara que siempre tuvo Alice. Sentía que ya estaba lista para comerse este mundo musical. Cuando comenzó disfrutó muchísimo del proceso. Crear canciones, componerlas, escribir la letra. Era lo que siempre había soñado. No empezó muy fuerte porque como era nueva en la música muchas personas no la conocían. Así que fue normal que sus canciones iníciales no la rompieran demasiado en Buskeria, Casi pasó desapercibida. Con cada tema nuevo que iba lanzando ganaba más experiencia que no tenía y podía corregir en lo que había fallado antes. Y ver que era lo que le gustaba a ella, y a la gente también. Siempre intentó ser equilibrada en ese punto, darle a la gente lo que le gusta pero sin dejar algo para ti, lo que te gusta a ti. > Esa formula funcionó muy bien para disfrutar del viaje mientras iba como una estrella en acento. Es decir cumpliendo el sueño de todos los que viven en Buskeria. El ascenso le tomó gran parte de su juventud y ya llegó como una señora echa y derecha a lo más alto de los rankings de la región. Aunque todo había tardado, no se quejaba de nada. Cada tema lanzado por muy malo que fuera en el pasado, o si no fue muy escuchado sirvió directamente o indirectamente para ser quien es hoy.

> ![kevin-britos-PHYgBreyeYc-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23uExMZvceFqkhW2L7xDdWDAyDBNnVRaSiMQYAyJJitkbvwP2gBX243jzpg1wXCiJRidU.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) She never expected problems to enter her life when she was feeling her best. But it was all her own fault. That was the most tragic part. It turns out that she gradually lost the balance that had always defined her: creating songs that she personally liked and that people liked. When she was at her peak, she saw that the music competition in Buskeria was more successful. So she started looking for ways to be more popular and to top the charts, as she had been until then. Because of this, she lost her balance. She increasingly focused on writing songs for other people rather than on herself or how she felt. This caused her to plummet in the charts. Because in that transformation, she lost part of her charm, what defined her. It wasn't her singing anymore. It was the people who had the voice. Her fans noticed and didn't forgive her; her quality as a singer was greatly affected. What happened was the opposite: her fall in the region's metrics accelerated, and that was her worst nightmare. > Nunca esperó que los problemas llegaran a su vida cuando se sentía mejor. Pero por culpa de ella misma. Eso fue lo más trágico. Resulta que ella poco a poco fue rompiendo el equilibrio que la había definido siempre. Es decir, hacer temas que le gusten a ella personalmente y a la gente. Cuando estaba en su mejor momento vio que a la competencia musical en Buskeria se iba mejor. Así que comenzó a ver que podía hacer para gustarle más a la gente y ser ella la líder de los rankings como había hecho hasta ahora. A causa de esto el equilibrio se fue perdiendo. > Cada vez fue haciendo más canciones pensando en la gente que en ella misma o como se sentía. Esto la hizo caer estrepitosamente en los rankings. Porque en esa transformación perdió parte de su encanto, lo que la definía. Ya no era ella misma la que cantaba. Era la gente la que tenía la voz. Sus fans lo notaron y no se lo personaron, su calidad como cantante se vio muy afectada, lo que pasó fue lo contrario se aceleró su caída en las métricas de la región, y esa era la peor pesadilla para ella.

> ![clayton-webb-tbNgtxU5uSM-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23yTgyuUHGaxqdeni1r2EitmxRuKKwE8v2mgh6efCEcKhcY3GPob6S9nyCoCRakQpMgFA.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) She fell so low that she regressed to her beginnings, when no one knew her. How could a singer of her caliber fall like that after reaching the top and enjoying the entire journey? In the midst of her anguish, Alice acknowledged everything; she was to blame for everything that had happened. Was there still a chance to change what she had done? Yes, there was, but it would take a long time to rebuild her career. She still has the talent, but she must regain the trust of her fans. It took her another five years to climb back to a point close to where she had been before. They were five long and agonizing years. But despite everything, she was regaining her balance and becoming herself again. She hopes that very soon she can be the person she once was, the one she should never have changed to be someone else or to stay ahead of the competition. Enjoy yourself; don't just do it for others. > Llegó a caer tan bajo que regresó a sus inicios, cuando nadie la conocía. Como era posible que una cantante de su nivel pudiera caer de esa forma luego de haber tocado lo más alto y luego de haber disfrutado todo el camino. En medio de la angustia Alice lo reconoció todo, ella había sido la misma culpable de todo lo que había pasado. ¿habría aún oportunidad para cambiar lo que había hecho? Si, si la había, pero le tomaría mucho de nuevo hacer crecer su carrera. Aún tiene el talento pero debe recuperar la confianza de sus fans. Le tomó otros 5 años poder subir hasta un punto cerca al que estaba antes. > Fueron 5 largos y agónicos años. Pero a pesar de todo estaba nuevamente recuperando el equilibrio y siendo ella misma. Espera que muy pronto pueda ser ella misma la de antes, la que nunca debió cambiar para ser otra o para mantenerse encima de la competencia. Disfruta tu, no solo lo hagas por los demás.

> ![Captura de pantalla (2596).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23uQxtuEjaEE5w86khDqhqYSWRRACdWbguLsoU3uXspP2K5tuCR82Zo1AG7VVCuw86fLP.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.

body.title: Fight against city gangsters
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776649725352-5d780a6b95352864.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=gamingnature/7a15768e)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=gamingnature/7a15768e)


---

In reality, there are many juvenile gangs in the cities of our country.Juvenile gangs are the name of terror in the city and due to their disorder, the prominent people and businessmen of the city cannot move around with proper dignity and respect.Many school and college students are subjected to street teasing by them.

Terrorists who have made big gangsters give shelter to any terrorist or juvenile gang.Starting from juvenile gangs to all the big gangsters of the country, they are the terror of a country.Various misdeeds and terrorist activities spread from gangsters.

Gangsters secretly deal in drugs or bombs.Various drug trafficking transactions and the creation of mountains of black money are all done by gangsters.In a real-life case in a country, teenagers get involved with big gangsters and terrorize the city.Only occasional attempts are made by law enforcement to control them, but with little success.

If only there were real Spiderman or Krrish like in the movies to control them.When we play fighter games or gangster games, we have to move forward to destroy the teenage gangs and gangsters and in the end we can destroy the gangs.If such consequences happened in real life like in games, the city would be free of terrorism.

I played such a game today thinking about destroying gangsters from the city.If in reality gangsters could be destroyed from such a city, it would be great, but is such a fight possible in reality? In reality this is possible, but without resorting to violence, government forces can deal with terrorism in this way.A terror-free city is everyone's dream.

The main point of today's game is to eliminate terrorism from the city or destroy gangsters.I can swing from one building to another with a rope and catch terrorists.This game shows some scenes like this.They are dealing drugs through gangsters and are also selling weapons like bombs, so I destroyed them.

After destroying the illegal terrorist activities in the city, I killed the gangsters and destroyed five more gangsters in this game.In reality, everyone dreams of a Spiderman or hero coming to free a city from terror.But is it possible in reality? I think it is possible in reality if the government has the will.I invite you to watch this interesting game today.

Stay healthy until we return.

Thank you...

---

body.title: : Why is this game still so relevant?
body.body:
<center>[Naavik](https://naavik.co/deep-dives/feb-2022-premium-blockchain-deconstruction-splinterlands/)</center>
Amidst the rise of numerous *pay-to-earn* games within the blockchain-based ecosystem, maintaining relevance within a sea of possibilities - *which, incidentally, only continues to grow* - is no easy task. Staying at the top of the choices is an arduous process, built through ups and downs with the help of the community itself, which is present with each new game improvement.
This is exactly what happens (as far as I know) with the game **Splinterlands**. Although I'm not a player (simply because it's not my style to delve into this type of game... which doesn't affect my judgment, because I've had my opportunities and didn't become a regular player due to other priorities), it's impossible to remain indifferent to the new developments that occur during its improvement process. Whether they are good or bad ideas, it's all part of the adventure.
**Splinterlands** is a famous blockchain-based **TCG** (trading card game) that uses **NFT** technology (which, despite being somewhat \

of the financial market for some time, remains a viable option for many players and investors worldwide) to ensure that players actually possess the assets they are entitled to. This solid foundation lends confidence to the game, and that is the first point of its success.
<center>[The Block](https://www.theblock.co/linked/112621/popular-nft-game-splinterlands-raises-3-6-million-from-animoca-brands-and-others)</center>
Security is one of the most relevant factors. Combined with other technical aspects of the game itself (such as its gameplay process that favors a very frenetic dynamic within each battle, the easy accessibility of the game, and the vibrant economy are other fundamental attractions for keeping players interested in it), this game is already established as a success within the blockchain landscape (albeit despite controversial episodes in its evolution).
Going beyond the boundaries of the game itself, **Splinterlands** also offers an open field for other possibilities, such as discovering other gateways to access other projects within the blockchain. The ecosystem is very broad and \

opportunities that need to be explored (and which become easier to see because there are parallel connections between the game and **Hive**, for example). Everything is connected, but it's necessary to explore the pathways. Lastly, but definitely not least, it's a game that values pure fun and interaction within the community itself, where players stay connected to each other by sharing their ideas and thoughts to improve what's already good. It's a community that has a constant commitment to the product, not just treating it as a product. That's quite an achievement for any kind of game. ---
**Splinterlands: ¿Por qué este juego sigue siendo tan relevante?**
En medio del auge de numerosos juegos *play-to-earn* dentro del ecosistema blockchain, mantenerse relevante en un mar de posibilidades - *que, por cierto, no deja de crecer* - no es tarea muy fácil. Mantenerse a la vanguardia es un proceso muy arduo, forjado a través de altibajos con la ayuda de la propia comunidad, que está presente con cada nueva mejora del juego. Esto es precisamente lo que ocurre (hasta donde sé) con el juego **Splinterlands**. Aunque no soy jugador (simplemente porque no me atrae este tipo de juegos... lo cual no afecta mi opinión, ya que he tenido mis oportunidades y no me he convertido en jugador habitual por otras prioridades), es imposible permanecer indiferente ante las novedades que surgen durante su desarrollo. Sean buenas o malas ideas, todo forma parte de la aventura. **Splinterlands** es un famoso juego de cartas coleccionables (**TCG**) basado en blockchain que utiliza la tecnología **NFT** (que, a pesar de haber estado algo fuera del radar del mercado financiero durante algún tiempo, sigue siendo una opción viable para muchos jugadores e inversores en todo el mundo) para garantizar que los jugadores posean realmente los activos a los que tienen derecho. Esta sólida base genera confianza en el juego, y ese es el primer punto de su éxito. La seguridad es uno de los factores más relevantes. Junto con otros aspectos técnicos del juego (como su dinámica de juego, que favorece un ritmo frenético en cada batalla, su fácil acceso y su vibrante economía, que son otros atractivos fundamentales para mantener el interés de los jugadores), este juego ya se ha consolidado como un éxito en el panorama de la cadena de bloques (a pesar de algunos episodios controvertidos en su evolución). Más allá de los límites del juego, **Splinterlands** ofrece un amplio abanico de posibilidades, como descubrir otras vías de acceso a otros proyectos dentro de la cadena de bloques. El ecosistema es muy extenso y “oculta” oportunidades que requieren exploración (y que se hacen más evidentes gracias a las conexiones entre el juego y **Hive**, por ejemplo). Todo está interconectado, pero es necesario explorar las diferentes vías. Por último, pero no por ello menos importante, es un juego que valora la diversión pura y la interacción dentro de la propia comunidad, donde los jugadores se mantienen conectados compartiendo ideas y opiniones para mejorar lo que ya funciona bien. Es una comunidad con un compromiso constante con el producto, que no lo trata simplemente como un producto. Eso es todo un logro para cualquier tipo de juego. ---
**Splinterlands: Por que esse jogo ainda é tão relevante?**
Em meio a ascensão dos inúmeros jogos *play-to-earn* dentro do ecossistema baseado na tecnologia blockchain, não se torna uma tarefa muito fácil para qualquer jogo manter a sua própria relevância dentro de um mar de possibilidades... Que aliás, só vem crescendo ao longo do tempo. Se manter no topo das escolhas é um processo árduo, que entre altos e baixos, vai sendo construído com a ajuda da própria comunidade que se faz presente a cada nova melhoria dos jogos. Isso é exatamente o que acontece (até onde eu sei) com o jogo **Splinterlands**. Embora eu não seja um jogador (apenas porque não faz o meu estilo mergulhar esse tipo de jogo... o que não afeta o meu julgamento, porque eu já tive minhas oportunidades e não me tornei jogador assíduo por ter outras prioridades), é impossível ficar alheio as novidades que vão acontecendo dentro do processo de aperfeiçoamento dele. Sejam ideias boas ou ruins, isso faz parte da aventura. **Splinterlands** é um famoso jogo de **TCG** (cartas colecionáveis digitais) baseado em blockchain e que utiliza a tecnologia **NFT** (que apesar de estar um tanto quanto “fora do radar” do mercado financeiro já faz um tempo, ainda segue sendo uma opção viável para muitos jogadores e investidores mundo à fora) para certificar que os jogadores, de fato, tenham consigo os ativos que lhe são devidos. Essa base sólida confere confiança ao jogo, e é esse o primeiro ponto do sucesso. Segurança é um dos fatores mais relevantes. Aliado outros aspectos técnicos do próprio jogo (como o seu processo de jogabilidade que favorece uma dinâmica muito frenética dentro de cada batalha, há uma fácil acessibilidade ao jogo e a economia pulsante são outros atrativos fundamentais para que os jogadores se mantenham interessados nele), esse jogo já está consolidade como um sucesso dentro de terras da blockchain (ainda que episódios polêmicos de evolução). Indo mais além das fronteiras do próprio jogo, **Splinterlands** ainda traz a oportunidade de um campo aberto para outras possibilidades, como a descoberta das outras portas para acessar outros projetos dentro da blockchain. O ecossistema é muito amplo, e “esconde” oportunidades que precisam ser exploradas (e que se tornam mais fáceis de serem vistas, porque há conexões paralelas entre o jogo e a **Hive**, por exemplo). Tudo está conectado, mas é preciso explorar as vias. Por último, mas definitivamente não menos importante, é um jogo que preza pela pura diversão e pela interação dentro da própria comunidade, onde os jogadores se mantêm conectados uns aos outros sempre que espalham seus conceitos baseados em ideias e pensamentos para aprimorar o que já está sendo bom. Se trata de uma comunidade de tem um compromisso constante com esse produto, não o tratando apenas como tal. Isso é um feito para qualquer tipo de jogo. body.title: 📚 Dune by Frank Herbert 🏜️🌌
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPospWV2sdAHFWjSsNhMavmGCizB773Z6J2Ds1XaHa8hL/Libro.png 


Frank Herbert’s *Dune* (1965) is one of the most influential science fiction novels ever written. More than just a story about a distant planet, it is a complex exploration of politics, religion, ecology, and power. It sets the foundation for an epic saga that feels as philosophical as it is grand.  

> *Dune* (1965) de Frank Herbert es una de las novelas de ciencia ficción más influyentes jamás escritas. Más que una historia sobre un planeta lejano, es una exploración compleja de la política, la religión, la ecología y el poder. Establece las bases de una saga épica que se siente tan filosófica como grandiosa.  

---

## 📖 Story Summary  
The story follows Paul Atreides, heir to House Atreides, whose family is assigned control of Arrakis—a desert planet that is the only source of the most valuable substance in the universe: spice. This resource grants enhanced mental abilities and is essential for space travel. But Arrakis is a dangerous world, and Paul’s family soon becomes the target of betrayal, forcing him into a journey of survival, transformation, and destiny.  

> La historia sigue a Paul Atreides, heredero de la Casa Atreides, cuya familia recibe el control de Arrakis—un planeta desértico que es la única fuente de la sustancia más valiosa del universo: la especia. Este recurso otorga habilidades mentales avanzadas y es esencial para el viaje espacial. Pero Arrakis es un mundo peligroso, y la familia de Paul pronto se convierte en víctima de una traición, obligándolo a emprender un camino de supervivencia, transformación y destino.  

---

## 🌌 Themes and Philosophical Depth  
What makes *Dune* extraordinary is its depth. Herbert doesn’t just tell a story—he builds a world where politics, religion, and ecology are deeply interconnected. The novel explores how power is constructed and maintained, and how belief can shape reality. Paul’s journey is not just heroic—it’s also a warning about the dangers of messianic figures.  

> Lo que hace extraordinario a *Dune* es su profundidad. Herbert no solo cuenta una historia: construye un mundo donde la política, la religión y la ecología están profundamente interconectadas. La novela explora cómo se construye y mantiene el poder, y cómo las creencias pueden moldear la realidad. El viaje de Paul no es solo heroico: también es una advertencia sobre los peligros de las figuras mesiánicas.  

---

The ecological aspect is also central. Arrakis is not just a setting—it’s a living system, harsh and fragile, where every action has consequences. Herbert was ahead of his time in presenting environmental awareness as a core element of the narrative.  

> El aspecto ecológico también es central. Arrakis no es solo un escenario: es un sistema vivo, duro y frágil, donde cada acción tiene consecuencias. Herbert se adelantó a su tiempo al presentar la conciencia ambiental como un elemento fundamental de la narrativa.  

---

## 🖤 Final Thoughts  
*Dune* is not a simple read, but it is a rewarding one. It challenges the reader to think, to question authority, and to understand complexity. As the first book of the saga, it lays the groundwork for a story that will only grow more intricate and philosophical.  

> *Dune* no es una lectura sencilla, pero sí profundamente gratificante. Desafía al lector a pensar, a cuestionar la autoridad y a comprender la complejidad. Como primer libro de la saga, establece las bases para una historia que se volverá cada vez más compleja y filosófica.  

---

*Is destiny something we follow—or something we create, even when it leads to destruction?*  

> *¿El destino es algo que seguimos o algo que creamos, incluso cuando nos lleva a la destrucción?*

body.title: Sten Slatehelm: Low Mana Legendary Range Tank
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf5FV2w85uSPsb5YWvRK4jcyqi7A8oLDRJorDBLfZtRJ9/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

There are few cards to fit in low mana battles in Going the Distance ruleset. It's a very limiting ruleset that allows only range units. The ruleset is not much of challenge if you're using the Death splinter with Razi Clanktrap as an archon but for other splinters the lack of decent units is an issue. For Water, the legendary reward card, Sten Slatehelm is one excellent choice. In today's post, we'll do a deep dive into this card. 

***

# Lore

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ11cvcbu6hP3arqL3g4tKWAfu5DfBRQUto2HS9aQF6rQ/image.png)

Sten Slatehelm is a short (even for dwarves) but fearless dwarf who fights with throwing daggers and a shield. His vision blocking oversized eyebrows gives him a reckless fighting style that even hurts allies as well as enemies. Despite his reckless style, he’s loyal and battle-hardened, following Fithe Bladestone after surviving brutal past conflicts together. In the harsh Great Lowlands, Sten pushes the frontlines forward through fire and ash, holding ground against overwhelming odds. Clumsy but effective, he keeps fighting, ensuring his allies survive even if they take a few hits from him along the way.

***

# Stats and Abilities

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUvpL6C6YTmEUVc8mtMJjQ4tBcTR39ejPW8CeAadfRct3/image.png)

Sten Slatehelm is a two mana, legendary, Water card. At maxed levels, he deals two range damage and has three speed. He has good defense of five armor and six health, making him a viable tank in Going the Distance ruleset. As for abilities, he has Close Range at level on. At level two, he gets Reckless, that according to his lore was caused by his overgrown eyebrows. At level three he uses his armor to damage his enemies with Armored Strike. His most powerful ability is at maxed level where he gets Resurgence.

For Silver and Gold players, level one is good enough in my opinion. Level two gets him a debilitation which hurts his allies but could be useful in some situations and with the right combo like units with Painforge. For overall use, it's better to keep him at level one in my opinion. 

Due to his stats and abilities, he's a good unit to take the tank role in Going the Distance rulesets especially when the mana cap is limited. He has decent defense to last for a few rounds while his allies do damage to the enemy.

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmapHfVsZgnCPzPjf5hmhRYaHqZnMVLMZ11PQbsEiftSwb/image.png)

The battle was in the high level Gold League with Going the Distance and Equalizer rulesets. Player Hepthorn had Sten as his tank and the rest of his team were composed of the following units.

Chaos Battlemage is a legendary reward card from the Rebellion set. She deals three range damage and has Piercing and Resurrect abilities. 

Mar Torren Seeker is common card with decent stats. The Poison ability from the archon adds to his offensive kit.

Chaos Lackey is a low mana card with low attack. It's good to fill your slots in Equalizer rulesets even with low attack cards since they provide additional defense. 

Drybone Rawdog is another low mana card but deals better damage. He also received the Poison ability from the archon.

Mar Torren Trader is one of the key cards in this battle. She has the Headwinds ability to reduce the enemy's range attacks.

His enemy had the legendary Eternal Tofu archon but came with only three units. This puts him at a disadvantage in Equalizer ruleset. Also, one of his units have eleven health. While it increased the health of his allies, it also does the same for his enemy. The better synergy and play against the ruleset favored Hepthorn and he got the win.

[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_baac41d35566a5e1415587f514debaf5?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

body.title: Fill Your Mind with Good Things!
body.body:
What an absolutely incredible stroke of fate!
--------------

I am currently reading *Sherlock Holmes* when I stumbled upon this quote:

*\

'A fool takes in all the lumber ... so that ***the knowledge which might be useful to him gets crowded out ... he has difficulty in laying his hands upon it.*** Now the skillful workman is ***very careful indeed as to what he takes into his brain-attic.*** He will have nothing but the tools ... ***for every addition of knowledge, you forget something that you knew before.*** 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd6yrxubzbxZGkWiYuP2vr3mA3ZpJwWP3wVnDxTEP18uq/1776648803953.jpg) **(All images created using an AI art generator on NightCafe)**

*\

*
------------------

*I find this especially telling, for not but a day before picking up this book, I was explaining this exact concept to my husband!*

I am the type of person who enjoys mentally stimulating content: politics, religion, true crime, human psychology, etc. However, sometimes these subjects are also mentally exhausting. Most of the time, all that is really registered is yelling and chaos -- people screaming back and forth, invalidation, name calling, misinformation, etc. 

The straw for me came a few nights ago while my husband was listening to some influencer drama. It was a woman, making up a false rape allegation, no less, and it truly solidified for me -- I don't want to be filling my head with anymore of this trife.

One has to figure, the human brain only has so much space readily available for valuable information, and filling it up with useless and destructive information means sifting through those tons of garbage in order to even locate the good stuff. 

Like, I SHOULD know how to stitch together my own clothing, but instead I know that *MrBeast* worked with a pedophile! 😩
--------------

So, naturally, whenever I have to deal with something greater than myself -- in this case, addiction -- I turned to God. Yes, I was addicted; addicted to my phone. I possessed the self-control necessary to stop smoking but not to get off my phone! 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZTH31pSrr3n3Pv3dSqQjuzJo8wokUvvR5iU2DR7kTcsh/1776648943356.jpg)

If anything, my phone has been infinitely harder to quit because I couldn't escape it. Everybody has a phone, everybody is using it, and what's worse, everybody expects you to be doing the same thing.
--------------------

I asked God for help! 🙏 I prayed to Him... *\

*

That was about two weeks ago, and I am noticing tremendous improvement. Honestly -- without exaggeration -- I no longer engage in discourse, and I only use my phone to watch some shorts for maybe an hour or so throughout the day. Very little triggering content, although I have seen a few news stories, particularly of the beautiful little Athena... May God be with her family 🙏💛

The limited social media has positively affected my mood as well! Anxiety, anger, doom, and grief have virtually all dissipated. It feels incredibly revitalizing to be cut off and free from all of that chaos! 

And, of course, all of the glory goes to God 🙏🙇‍♀️
---------------

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWJe75scjCCCZidbAA6t2KduS88Sk6ZrkzTfWpfrUqNM9/1776649017923.jpg)
