body.body:
Hoy voy a empezar pidiendo su apoyo 
A la fundación BBH de @bradleyarrow 
Que pueden con una buena historia su fundación darle una nueva vida a quien lo esté pasando mal en este momento o con su esposa @cathyarrow 
Que apoyen el blog de mi esposa @diazktty que recién empieza al igual que yo 

🎧 Hoy quiero hablar sobre mi convivencia con la música alemana como tal, música de grupos como 
Saltatio Mortis

![maxresdefault.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23w2ieCGQJisCFRWojdFu8toXc6syDfmWfj1u4oGhpUJd1EQnVSEnXtZ9z7T79HPzMcTe.jpg)

,Feuerschwanz 


![a4216965548_16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/AJpiCb5DNz4GE1goeK1dmCKh1uaFw93m2MaVhhxqjv9nTYJjn8wVXNALqk7d2Md.jpg)

, Powerwolf

![EMP_Autogrammstunde_Powerwolf_Leipzig_SMALL.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23tknMYKNFZWDMVJnAvFM1vGpuufxHAckF23FY2f2eWEDuh9SjpVrcuyVTvFnu91kwqUs.jpg)

 y dArtagnan.


![0x1900-000000-80-0-0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/AKe6JC5J18p6qNcJyc6sZsYRqCFCx9nUW9DoNuVUedWKcy7VfaCWLMFGkw73YAX.jpg)


La historia es muy sencilla.
En 2022 estaba buscando algo nuevo, algo distinto, algo que me motivara. La música que escuchaba en ese momento estaba buena, pero quería algo más intenso.
Y así, simple, revisando las redes, me encuentro una versión de “My Mother Told Me” versión de Saltatio Mortis . Y fue como: vamos a buscar más, a ver si hay más de este contenido.
Empiezo a encontrar más cosas de ese nuevo estilo medieval y, buscando y viendo videos, consigo de casualidad uno de Feuerschwanz. Ese video me encantó. La temática y también la canción, “Última noche”.
Ese grupo tiene algo que destaca muchísimo: el violín. Es súper fuerte, te llega directo. Lo recomiendo. Es más, es una buena elección para quien le guste la música y el rock. También con ellos encontrarán otro grupo que es dArtagnan muy similar El vocalista es el mismo 
Y de ahí seguí escuchando, me encanta, lo disfruto… hasta que veo un cover, “Amen & Attack” de Powerwolf . Ese cover me encantó, y ahí empecé también con ellos.
Después se fue conectando todo.
Y desde 2022 hasta la actualidad, no me ha decepcionado ninguna canción de esos grupos. Han pasado años y sigo escuchándolos. No es que sean las mismas canciones, es que cada una tiene una fórmula nueva, una emoción diferente.
Es algo que yo recomendaría para escuchar todos los días. Si te aburres, no importa: tienen muchísimas canciones y ninguna repite la misma fórmula. Tal vez en algunas colaboraciones entre ellos haya similitudes, pero sigue siendo súper recomendable.
Quiero que esta sea mi recomendación . No se van a defraudar.
Otro grupo sería Wind Rose

![a8ffc7891448a96afc695c40077d8d57_XL.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23tm9UGWNp7XBS69XfVzrnqsPMsGt2dXgaK7cEV9mFURmBRXQfUQmhKYMQFtXFpvwtFPy.jpg)
 , que ya ese me lo recomendaron. Si te gusta la temática de \

, te va a gustar mucho más, porque es su estilo.
Todo esto lo dejo como recomendación para que tengas algo nuevo que disfrutar.
Puede que no sea tu gusto, puede que no te interese escucharlo… pero pruébalo. No te vas a arrepentir 🔥
 Gracias por su tiempo ⏲️ 
 gracias por su apoyo 
Que nunca les falte el amor y que dios los bendiga 🙏

body.title: The Joy of Calling the Province Home
body.body:
![1_20260420_091252_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23w2oVj3Bf74qyssg1jNBhRo2snDuzBo6KjmHH7n3goe9MJPZ81Z4ya9tz7uMNMatEXfE.png)


Wow look at these photos. This place is honestly so beautiful and peaceful right. 



![4_20260420_091252_0003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/241Zhaxs4QYARV9nRWGGEx2KEqohT6e93EYHQpoA1nAcPAbtpgumRDko2qsNXg1HUURsR.png)

​
Everything is just so green and fresh you can almost feel the calm cool air just by looking at them.



![9_20260420_091252_0008.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23x16t4rWG8kM2AbEJ7R1cYD6gBgACiFaDxJ5mJbj8ebDShY5aY8219i9YF7oGsaYrRMJ.png)

​
Its like stepping into a little world where everything slows down far away from all the noise and rush of the city.



![2_20260420_091252_0001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23zkkH4EeMS3aWJucbsEQotwRiikuXY1rAmV6xE5EkLbqmni5T7vwpTS9A4p6Cu1g2Koi.png)

​
First off those rice fields are just stunning. Big stretches of bright green looking so neat and endless under the blue sky with soft white clouds.




![3_20260420_091252_0002.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23r1cnPhhMk2CMLzuS4TcMJitCFWoFACNSipP9ZwGYcrugKCdJzkiTEDfUd717qWhQ7ve.png)

​
The tall coconut trees standing tall everywhere make it feel so tropical and cozy like you are in the middle of natures own little spot.



![10_20260420_091252_0009.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23wgQHgosH3u4Qu2xSSSvkYgUp2L1xGFjN17PdWGGJnD5kWyReLF7oEGEjC355Nuwfnpg.png)

​
6. There is even that cute nipa hut peeking through the trees imagine sitting there just chilling no plans no hurry at all.




![11_20260420_091252_0010.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23yd3W2nxEGUaWCbv1JB51JSDjFvRuvDFunEznnbR8BA5kWrvSK4WuLn1czW4zcrb35na.png)

​
Perfect place to just sit and watch the day go by. And look at all the plants growing around! So lively and healthy all kinds of green leaves and little plants popping up everywhere.



![5_20260420_091252_0004.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/243Bc3vG5e8y8oHKUZZELyrzDx2eoioqV9Fwi6nSTciwDeK8isfuVqLsKDWZ5oGDWE7nG.png)

​
You can tell nature is just thriving here everything feels so alive and vibrant. Then there are those goats So cute just walking around free like they are having the best time. 



![6_20260420_091252_0005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23yd81eTmFsbCZvG61azedJGHscPZQmuDHEzEyYSfAwfwmW16pSd8JhHKiUkcgZ9FKydn.png)

​
They add such a sweet homey touch makes the place feel warm and lived in not just pretty but also full of simple happy vibes.



![8_20260420_091252_0007.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/2423swiJRU1Yb699o37B7W6x2Uze6yoKMoVnpC4hLPVe3h16y2CXTkBqSNzgyqFewcqzK.png)

​
The mountains in the distance too they make the whole view even more amazing. Its like the place is wrapped in all this natural beauty quiet and calm.




![7_20260420_091252_0006.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rodavlas/23tveE6gq9zMGaySnaMC3YAJqNh6DNpNuRt5mudTTkZ5K8UGqbzwmhi6wkPd2NDsTxqGP.png)


​
This is exactly the kind of spot where you can forget all your stress no honking cars no busy streets just the sound of wind through the trees and maybe birds singing. Time really does feel like it stops here and you can just breathe relax and enjoy every little thing around you. Its not fancy or anything but thats what makes it so perfect. Simple peaceful and full of good energy. Truly a little paradise where you can just slow down and appreciate the simple things in life. 


This photos are credit from my niece and have permission to share.

body.title: Ready to be hurt.
body.body: > I've been mugged at gun point. And at blade point. Nothing serious, I got used to walking around without anything of personal value. Without anything I'd fight for. The first time was in Peru, we were travelling and went to the wrong neighborhood. They got a few coins from us, and they took my friends Walkman. For those who remember the days - a Walkman is a device that plays cassettes. Like SD card with music, plugged into a cellphone and making music come out of headphones. With cables. Those that have foam around them, the kind of foam that makes you cringe touching it. Or at least me. ![IMG_20260419_181806218_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EoAZEUe1PSiXBcxr3wury7rjnLD5oBp1ED33KVEeE9c2KU51qe2RXyFNBH7Gs3mHALY.jpg) Anyway, that was in 2012. Nobody used Walkmans anymore back then. Even I had a cheap MP3-Player. So, the muggers, some quite young boys, were a bit flabbergasted and confused. My friend told them what it was and that it was of no value, and given the state and the cheap plastic, it really wasn't, so they returned it. But that wasn't any real danger at all. Neither that nor the other robbery afterwards. Material stuff. I did many things that were a danger to my bodily integrity, climbing mountains without gear, driving my bike so drunk I ended up in thorny bushes, having a truck fall on my leg, a pot of oil exploding in my hands, and so on. I still have the scars. *But I survived.* I've been taking more care of my body since I have people to live for, and that is honestly the most dangerous part of life. Love. I'll personally fade eventually, good or bad, and I've made my peace with that, to a point that I don't care much. If it wasn't for those around me. *Love.* That stuff is dangerous. It kills every instinct of survival, anything that preserves one's self. It makes you think of others instead of just yourself. Caring for your loved ones, caring for your community, basically caring for anything that does not serve your own interest in the first place. *That's some real danger.* Because you could make the wrong choice each step of the way, hurting someone or getting hurt, or both. In the ever valid dichotomy of every society when push comes to shove - me or we? *We.* That's my answer, most of the time. I was always lucky enough to experience the power of community. Many times over. The good power and the bad power. There's danger in that too. As is in everything, all the time, and that's fine. The solution is as most of the times, with most things in life - accept it as part of reality. ___ What are your thoughts about this topic? Please feel free to engage in any original way, including dropping links to your posts on similar topics. I'm happy to read (and curate) any quality content that is not created by LLM/AI. ___ Post written for the #weekend-engagement by @galenkp inviting us to answer selected questions in the [Weekend Experiences community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-168869/created) each week. This is my response to: Have you ever been in a dangerous situation? What was it, how did you deal with it and how has it changed what you do moving forward? ___ Thank you for reading!

body.title: Deliciosa sopa de pollo con apio, maíz y fideos // (Esp/Eng)
body.body:
---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![1000441883.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EoEtSqZtrsVCeTkiNMQE9uyDXHKXyhduCLCdZAEXBjVKm4qW1QPQ17oNdna1XKSk7wQ.jpg)

> Hola, amigos, quiero contarles que en mi familia tenemos la costumbre de comer sopa una vez a la semana y la sopa que más les gusta es la de pollo; por esta razón siempre busco formas de darle un sabor distinto. Este es otro modo en el que hago la sopa de pollo, y les garantizo que queda exquisita. Espero que lo pongan en práctica en su hogar y que les agrade. Aquí está el procedimiento paso a paso. > Hi, everyone! I wanted to tell you that in my family, we have a tradition of eating soup once a week, and the soup we like best is chicken soup. That’s why I’m always looking for ways to give it a different flavor. This is another way I make chicken soup, and I guarantee it turns out delicious. I hope you try it at home and enjoy it. Here are the step-by-step instructions.
![1000441870.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wCGJ9owMR351HZdrbRKizcqF1AJdauTKkQHY79dfmDZnnHzCfomq8BfyYpqmuVsbER2.jpg)
--- ![El texto del párrafo (32).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EouEzXFRam7Qu5Er4T5yaxbebYHDJJvGYKKJedtHFWxqE5sXNxmydEWFdjp6DLSkUTF.jpg)

> - 1 pollo fresco - 3 kilos de verduras (ocumo, apio, auyama, yuca y chaco) - 1 zanahoria - 2 jojotos - 1 taza de fideos - 2 cebollas - 1 pimentón rojo - 1 tallo de cebollín - 8 ajíes dulces - 1 pimentón rojo - 8 dientes de ajo - 1 cucharadita de curcuma - Sal al gusto.

> - 1 fresh chicken - 3 pounds of vegetables (ocumo, celery, squash, cassava, and chaco) - 1 carrot - 2 corn cobs - 1 cup of noodles - 2 onions - 1 red bell pepper - 1 scallion stalk - 8 sweet peppers - 1 red bell pepper - 8 garlic cloves - 1 teaspoon of turmeric - Salt to taste.

![1000441803.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsSPTArWD89w3gYWdZZgxgCuzyQnT9UXCS9megKBA8Vsnfgc4MYZHSVAT5Rtv8naeXV.jpg)
![El texto del párrafo (31).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EowNPiUud55yj2BkuDpKGUA8asqcUnP2g4hytTz9iUtwoeMREbopLjBeaQpT27KBKrK.jpg)
- Lo primero que haremos es colocar una olla en la cocina a fuego alto y dejar que hierva. > - First, we'll place a pot on the stove over high heat and bring it to a boil.
![1000441804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wC7dwVrzZeRE31QG2YzPXEjYNiz3WgnoNSztE3iQhpNSzNVgoXM5mxdZoJZcvPPokPX.jpg)
- Mientras el agua hierve, lavamos bien el pollo; luego lo colocamos en un bol y lo sazonamos con sal y cúrcuma. > - While the water is boiling, wash the chicken thoroughly; then place it in a bowl and season it with salt and turmeric.
|![1000441805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsQT8fWt59HQDumcjB8cGgmCrh6iFHPVyU7wFeTNVKf1z6PMHMmw4nqithSFL3Y2KDC.jpg)|![1000441806.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uFVhk632FSC58ni452hFPaEUMMZ2ZpiokZkFW9xT8H6561hjoumAivBh9v96e6XcZGN.jpg)| |-|-|
- Seguidamente le agregamos el ajo triturado, una cebolla, 1/2 pimentón y 3 ajíes dulces, todos previamente lavados, y reservamos. > - Next, add the minced garlic, one onion, 1/2 bell pepper, and 3 sweet peppers—all of which have been washed beforehand—and set aside.
|![1000441818.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tbtuWUaF4iuGd6dpr9iMJYZPppUbgfrZ7bSmh5dKevehHNK1TdzSQENFF7ZjBiau4iq.jpg)|![1000441819.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsNPE5ZVoB6nYT84svb7aMHKf3GvH6VJFohYRV8eNg6D1Ab5ryWr8gFWNkMkiAwybXX.jpg)| |-|-|
- Una vez el agua hervida, añadimos el pollo ya sazonado y dejamos cocinar. > - Once the water has come to a boil, add the seasoned chicken and let it cook.
![1000441822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uQrWdQGuvxgdTgoeTXBn5dxszyZ6a5dM5DS6HGiYVa95JhgZCq7t4uQYESWdEj69bQb.jpg)
- Luego le añadimos el cebollín, el tallo del celery, la zanahoria cortada en 4 pedazos y el apio todos previamente lavados. > - Next, add the green onions, the celery stalk, the carrot (cut into 4 pieces), and the celery, all of which have been washed beforehand.
|![1000441824.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vhwwcGbBYFJTCToXDEvQiTdJHyVeA54Ab7TqeacyE67h1wCPgQ57e3qNapuQG7vFM4t.jpg)|![1000441825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23x16rDNTK8wxVoHNkay5aW7qzJrGTCk3heuDqixVkpXDSeReSghfgdpNvPAuJk3DT43v.jpg)|![1000441831.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wWw2jNMX6EwWFm5bTBtij84h3LCcTmUdfyCkfvLqhgdgzFnKtXWoFiCvJWLb83Y9FmH.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Mientras se cocina el pollo, retiramos la piel a las verduras y los jojotos y los lavamos bien. > - While the chicken is cooking, peel the vegetables and corn on the cob and wash them thoroughly.
![1000441828.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tSYHb6s3khw4ppdkdoRP9fyjLzfhVCKpuFZuMkVXHt19tjRvePKqd6sQrYK7fadFS1a.jpg)
- Ahora colocamos los jojotos en una olla con agua y lo ponemos a cocinar a fuego alto hasta que ablande; a mí me gusta cocinarlo aparte. > - Now place the corn in a pot of water and bring it to a boil over high heat until tender; I like to cook it separately.
![1000441830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23u67FwMxzyGFTUYSy43gMJkLkBBBpTcCtzigu6iSGaohNmaXNJLteNL2Z6hkih3uJz3N.jpg)
- Mientras se cocina el pollo, lavamos la cebolla, el medio pimentón y los ajíes, y cortamos con el picatodo. Ahora colocamos una sartén, le colocamos un poco de aceite y añadimos la verdura para que se sofría. > - While the chicken is cooking, wash the onion, half a bell pepper, and the chili peppers, then chop them in a food processor. Next, heat a little oil in a skillet and add the vegetables to sauté them.
|![1000441832.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23x196HqCW4nGdgRBkNDas4PDCzB2wURwryr6FH9DGiEkq8bwtGM2Zq8c5QZdc1tD6ULw.jpg)|![1000441833.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wqiMNj5HSy16PpPhQ5hPMgQEgAUEEa6YfcTTSDm6oDhkohWthbt7YMRZ8fCw9LK8GF2.jpg)|![1000441834.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsLEQRaRsLQjTk47EvmQpm4TQ7WNwgWZnbfbzVbfpXgq64vx1ikxLA2ME2w3HnEU1zc.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Ahora retiramos la zanahoria, ya blanda, y el cebollín y lo licuamos hasta formar una crema. > - Now remove the carrot, which is now tender, and the scallion, and blend them until smooth.
|![1000441835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsQcM2mFBC4feeXvZaC3STnjhJXsuZ2V6cVEVpCC6CEamiUpHbjz4TbwLeuUTUXBkba.jpg)|![1000441836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vhyis9sv1BjjtAS8MYRP3YgNZZDgUYjs7DNPKZxduF3d1d7RQ8bgF32FEYkP6QkMaZH.jpg)|![1000441839.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uQthsBH9MjQhXkBUFdTHhgrMBCJa4mxdVoKQagQtneCeEzKkfoSEhRvdH5QFyZosGW7.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Una vez cocido el pollo, le añadimos la verdura, y dejamos cocinar hasta que se ablande. > - Once the chicken is cooked, add the vegetables and let them cook until tender.
|![1000441841.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23zGcMTBnXgcYb1Q1Tuz6r1BizyvjHLH5X7H2t3d2rbGcwAqMDyXtwCP7gxaqqSkFCPLK.jpg)|![1000441843.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsNTx6CxMWpTfrUsDR8soXj1sjNCZWbnd1fcgWx66sn3GVpkSra6pKaLaXC88yw5Z3r.jpg)| |-|-|
- Luego añadimos la verdura sofrita, la crema y los jojotos. > - Then add the sautéed vegetables, the cream, and the corn kernels.
|![1000441851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23u65793CnyNj3eGLybF3ZBQ36Bng9YgyruZuwGRzUaqHeR2jT1YbtjXDvkQQx2WAeX4S.jpg)|![1000441845.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xen33UrPXfbK3Kp7KTdYQhmvA1vYqtKbxp22NLBPfUJDpoGP4BqUZwRQ5mCUiW5nFTn.jpg)| |-|-| |![1000441852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xAbqMZv51Jzy5LNidd3AfvzkcuL1ephMEP6d8w9V4V3uZ2HHWLdHjbcXooqLNSWtrhN.jpg)|![1000441854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wCEHvHptiDnKLztUQAV53hAwsXXQj7Uz52MXv1jiUkfNN2RLdh7mcuCRd6gqxePtdkt.jpg)|
- Luego el fideo y, por último, las ramas; probamos si le falta sal y dejamos cocinar unos minutos. > - Then add the noodles, and finally the sprigs; taste to see if it needs more salt, and let it cook for a few minutes.
|![1000441855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vi61drgRzabVNz5sSaoEhgFDtUds6tvqFbmRQcF3w78whgBb1DmJVA6sdiFpzPbsRsJ.jpg)|![1000441857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMaBvZ9XK5c7ssVoQntNqasEnmLUS8T8YCE1x9ynWCfx45t6ZQPr1GtjNtf8e9xhwiG.jpg)|![1000441860.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vi3j8ejFnGQGeNZM3mSVhb36yjgUNZA5MYw2sHd8xNQPssppJyktqeY7rDT9KpJq4QY.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Ahora a disfrutar de esta deliciosa sopa de pollo con apio, maíz y fideo. Buen provecho. > - Now sit back and enjoy this delicious chicken soup with celery, corn, and noodles. Bon appétit.
![1000441861.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xpAuS3cENfRsWMpnuferkHfVrRH1ZvK8BziL6zs66ihNPP6uqpcdpV4eXBRbCmiAyUo.jpg) ![1000441865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xVPTSjXmjNDtJhLaRTHJ1iPj5zo5drouHotz1KhBzkj8ti4SefJ9QG2kXopxBhA5RtT.jpg) ![1000441863.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wX1RANHGwRFRDdwhbDr8odpvemKZJUrSgEHuYV2zR89XHr2qAU5KLLrawgW7EH5efaY.jpg) ![1000441868.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vi66zEtPXh13ZjitJ1cwJ7VZAQCJD4raUPMQ6dSCfJBQ8X5LEpfjHF3s7gRKhX41e5g.jpg) --- --- ![Diseño sin título (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23x1axniJV5q89au6oZkLKQn5zqKQL2UH9VQRMAhFxoQy7tTZc1CDCNKKeT7px9B83tMn.jpg)

---

**¡Feliz domingo, mi gente runner!**✨

El día de hoy fui por primera vez a hacer una ruta sin haber pagado la carrera jajaja, pero de verdad la pasé bien, me arrepiento de no haber pagado la inscripción porque la camisa estaba linda y me hizo falta la medalla, sin embargo, aquí les cuento que tal me fue.

---

<center>![1001986828.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/23xAcFwhveW9rxC8fk7rvUZCseM3Z81nvihRFJPrq6ttZX9V1opiT9gJHqevppJ4hBAwv.jpg)</center>

---

La carrera, llamada 5K SUMANDO SONRISAS, estuvo bastante concurrida y con una buena organización, además de que el clima favoreció bastante el desempeño de los corredores. Corrí con mi equipo, Bochinche Running Club, y durante la carrera, mi compañero fue Gabo, quien estaba más que todo acompañándome. Me dió un poco de culpa frenar su ritmo, pero me alegró bastante que se quedara conmigo, me motivó a mejorar mi ritmo y casi no caminar.

<center>![1001986711.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/23tRxJBSyAGL42ibLmFMRk9zGqNQbtEyZiAAHXTmZqr5Xkb5dRZexqo5DYRPdfYKFSr7p.jpg)</center>|<center>![1001986714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/23tkhh3jtQ33j85CwDuBZBsQjaoHS5mtVZ9jQCzN4E6jhx92WKvvvvAZnYhG4nV4s7Zhr.jpg)</center>
-|-

Corrí mis 5km en 28 minutos con 19 segundos, me alegra haberlo logrado bajo los 30min, aunque sé que puedo hacerlo mejor, quisiera mejorar mis hábitos para ver resultados más satisfactorios. 

Empezó la temporada de competencias acá en Maturín con esta carrera, así que probablemente me vean seguido por acá junto con mi equipo, así no esté inscrito, iré practicando para la tan esperada Farmatina 10K. Espero seguir mejorando y que correr acompañado me ayude y me motive para entrenar mejor.

Por ahora, eso es todo, pero de seguro estaré actualizando más durante la semana, les mando un abrazo, y a sumar sonrisas.😁✨

<center></center>|<center></center>
-|-

<center>![26uUsAjKTsXCDw7zixZR182JbFKvgzJ9YwsFpTVcRaGCmsqhA1unTgpqht45Ghm.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/241tSwUUYFF1bAsDFR7iE1THTrCdw2XsoVdbVv6zAycdNn2uLtG6u5McriCgv7B3oPURT.png)</center>

<center>[![1000501894.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/AJmn8QUFmqXpxCTvqjmhnVBTqrDWpBDDLFYd79KnE8oyB7xkzkiTd5Z5t7kr7tf.png)](t.me/artsyjose)</center>|<center>[![1000501888.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/AK3a2H9Mf1QfmogSNCWSKAs87SaUDs87XES9DkmW821ENiYi5kU1ZQvTqmMzpPa.png)](x.com/artsyjose)</center>|<center>[![1000501886.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/AJhU8uf9pMggZXHWrKeM3ZSCLzH8M3dWNnN5wFgZLyWk4NLmeChVqmaQykTgnWw.png)](https://www.instagram.com/artsyjosee?igsh=MTRpOHN5eWE5Z2w1dA==)</center>|<center>[![1000501890.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/AJmn94KtfAsqUcBHYEpbySyxup24mB3kgvg1tPBGFczog4RCK9WyiqdvqNgzzAt.png)](https://www.tiktok.com/@artsyjose?_t=8ph7Yxpnk8L&_r=1)</center>

---

<center><sub>*English <a id=\

>* --- **Happy Sunday, fellow runners!**✨ Today I went for a run for the first time without having paid for the race, haha, but I really had a good time. I regret not paying the entry fee because the shirt was cute and I missed out on the medal. Anyway, here’s how it went. ---
![1001986828.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/23xAcFwhveW9rxC8fk7rvUZCseM3Z81nvihRFJPrq6ttZX9V1opiT9gJHqevppJ4hBAwv.jpg)
--- The race, called 5K SUMANDO SONRISAS, was quite well-attended and well-organized, and the weather really helped the runners perform well. I ran with my team, Bochinche Running Club, and during the race, my partner was Gabo, who was mostly just keeping me company. I felt a little guilty for slowing him down, but I was really glad he stayed with me; it motivated me to pick up my pace and barely walk at all.
![1001986711.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/23tRxJBSyAGL42ibLmFMRk9zGqNQbtEyZiAAHXTmZqr5Xkb5dRZexqo5DYRPdfYKFSr7p.jpg)
|
![1001986714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/23tkhh3jtQ33j85CwDuBZBsQjaoHS5mtVZ9jQCzN4E6jhx92WKvvvvAZnYhG4nV4s7Zhr.jpg)
-|- I ran my 5K in 28 minutes and 19 seconds. I’m glad I managed to finish under 30 minutes, although I know I can do better. I’d like to improve my habits to see more satisfying results. The racing season has kicked off here in Maturín with this race, so you’ll probably see me around here often with my team. Even if I’m not registered, I’ll be training for the long-awaited Farmatina 10K. I hope to keep improving, and I hope running with others will help and motivate me to train better. That’s all for now, but I’ll definitely be posting more updates throughout the week. Sending you all a hug, and let’s keep spreading smiles.😁✨

body.title: I bought my first instrument steriliser. | Compré mi primer esterilizador de instrumentos.
body.body:
> **Gratos saludos tengan todos mis queridos amigos de esta comunidad de Lifestyle quiero compartir con ustedes un pequeño logro que he podido alcanzar y espero en la medida de lo posible seguir alcanazando.** **Warm greetings to all my dear friends in this Lifestyle community. I’d like to share with you a small achievement I’ve managed to make, and one I hope to continue achieving as much as possible.** Amigos, quiero compartir con ustedes un primer objetivo que pude lograr pese a que aún no tengo consultorio, tome la iniciativa de comprar un pequeño esterilizador para utilizar mis instrumentos y que estos estén en completa higiene es por eso que decidí comprarlo con un dinero que tenía ahorrado, así como también compré un escaler de mano, el cual funciona directamente con el sillón y a su vez un lubricante, simplemente he decidido soñar un poco a pesar de que todo en este país esté bastante difícil más allá de la queja, pude comprarme este aparato tan necesario que el día de mañana va a poder estar disponible en mi consultorio, pues como dice una canción, si aún no tienes jardín, compra la podadora, eso es lo que estoy haciendo en este momento. >Friends, I’d like to share with you the first goal I’ve managed to achieve, even though I don’t yet have a practice. I took the initiative to buy a small steriliser to ensure my instruments are completely hygienic, which is why I decided to buy it with some money I’d saved up. I also bought a hand-held scaler, which connects directly to the dental chair, and some lubricant. I’ve simply decided to dream a little, even though things in this country are pretty tough beyond just complaining I managed to buy this much-needed piece of equipment, which will be available in my surgery tomorrow. As the song goes, ‘if you don’t have a garden yet, buy the hedge trimmer’ that’s exactly what I’m doing right now. ![Collage de fotos horizontal Feliz San Valentín Sencillo Blanco y negro_20260419_204714_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVAmnVJWQoYvwrzQ3djdQYSsMrBVUnXMBDTYWvx9WFmB5/Collage%20de%20fotos%20horizontal%20Feliz%20San%20Valent%C3%ADn%20Sencillo%20Blanco%20y%20negro_20260419_204714_0000.png) --- Ahora bien, ese día que fuí a comprar el esterilizador decidí ir a comprar al otro lado de la ciudad en Maracaibo, ya que yo vivo en el extremo sur, me dirigí hasta el centro, luego pude tomar el bus del norte y este me dejó justamente en la tienda de insumo odontológicos, que lleva por nombre insumos, me bajé y decidí preguntar los precios para volver a rectificar de todas formas, yo sabía que el esterilizador costaba 70 dólares en efectivo, por lo que le pedí al empleado que me trajera uno cómo el estirilizador pequeño ya que lo iba a comprar, a su vez en el momento pensé solamente llevarme esto pero ya que estaba allí y el lugar queda muy lejano también opté por comprar mi escaler de mano. >Now, on the day I went to buy the steriliser, I decided to go to the other side of the city in Maracaibo, as I live in the far south. I made my way to the city centre, then took the bus heading north, which dropped me right outside the dental supplies shop, called ‘Insumos’. I got off and decided to ask about the prices just to double-check, I knew the steriliser cost $70 in cash, so I asked the shop assistant to bring me one of the small sterilisers as I was going to buy it. At the time, I’d only intended to buy that, but since I was already there and the shop is quite a long way away, I also decided to buy my hand-held scaler. ![20260331_110720.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTRxeR9TrzhNKmFzrJPLmHeLCj4rP3RLLK1w9qY2CgGQ3/20260331_110720.jpg) ![20260331_110631.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRVfR5UfVQx56GkmLoX28PuyViHzQ1wB8BNUbHJ1kidpQ/20260331_110631.jpg) ![20260331_110629.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmScXSY9JQC2twAe5duuZzaUJhdn3nYbNZqJtD1n8m113e/20260331_110629.jpg) En otras casas dentales había preguntado el precio de este mismo estarilizador, y el mismo se encontraba en 100 dólares, por lo que decidí sacrificar mis 70 dólares en efectivo, ya que consideré que aquí está mucho más económico que en otros sitios para comprar este esterilizador, estaba bastante, emocionada, entusiasmada y orgullosa de mí, por este pequeño logro, a pesar que son tantas las cosas que necesito y tanto dinero el que necesito para el día de mañana poder tener mi consultorio, esta pequeña iniciativa me lleva a que puedo tener instrumentos higienizados, y así poder realizar. Para realizar procedimiento de mínima intervención a domicilio y así podre ganar más porcentaje. >I’d asked about the price of this same steriliser at other dental practices, and it was $100, so I decided to spend my $70 in cash, as I felt it was much cheaper here than elsewhere to buy this steriliser, I was quite excited, enthusiastic and proud of myself for this small achievement. Although there are so many things I need and so much money I need to be able to set up my own practice one day, this small step means I can have sterilised instruments and thus be able to carry out minimally invasive procedures at home, which will allow me to earn a higher percentage. ![20260331_110633.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY4aBocfT89SZKsCdAYsAYVve2GABwymdZ64JrboQ8Tg5/20260331_110633.jpg) En total gaste 119$, entre en los dos equipos el lubricante si lo compre en bs y salió como en 8$, después de comprar todo esto estaba pensando cómo me iba a regresar a mi casa con todo esto, ya que me daba mucho miedo que me lo pudieran, robar, es por eso que le pedí a mi papá que se encontraba en la misma avenida un más poco retirado, que me viniera a buscar es por eso que estuve esperando a mi papá aproximadamente unos 15 minutos en que llegara, llegó y posteriormente me fui con él me dejó justamente enfrente de los carritos de Manzanillo y salí bastante rápido, pude llegar a mi casa muy feliz con mi nuevo esterilizador directamente, fui a probarlo. >In total, I spent $119, including the two sets of tools and the lubricant I bought that in Buenos Aires and it cost about $8, after buying all this, I was wondering how I was going to get all this stuff back home, as I was really worried someone might steal it, so I asked my dad, who was on the same street a little further down, to come and pick me up. That’s why I waited for my dad for about 15 minutes until he arrived. He arrived and then I went with him; he dropped me off right in front of the Manzanillo stalls and I left quite quickly. I was able to get home very happy with my new steriliser straight away, and I went to try it out. ![20260331_110301.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaS6sVEjxRaXTAztZPLk9BZJZsuTjurCgKHcdhvqFqsWo/20260331_110301.jpg) ![20260331_110638.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbPk8h7U1nXhWvBNDyKWrGjT57rVU8RnGgRfH7Ux3xeW4/20260331_110638.jpg) ![20260331_110616.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaM5K8SebAa5BKwmDwVMHzs4ccZjfyxxriSkgbZyZws9M/20260331_110616.jpg) --- Por último, amigos, simplemente cuando tengamos un sueño y este sea más allá de lo imposible que creamos, ya que no tenemos todas las condiciones económicas adecuadas, debemos soñar poco a poco e ir construyendo ese sueño que por más imposible que creamos, algún momento lo vamos a hacer realidad es por eso que yo decidí iniciar desde lo simple con un esterilizador para poder construir mi consultorio que, sin duda alguna dentro de algunos años lo tendré en nombre de Dios, me despido hasta una próxima oportunidad mis queridos amigos y espero que le haya gustado esta publicación, les envío un fuerte abrazo. >Finally, my friends, whenever we have a dream that seems beyond what we believe to be possible since we don’t have all the necessary financial resources we must dream little by little and gradually build that dream; for however impossible we may think it is, at some point we will make it a reality. That is why I decided to start small with a steriliser so that I can build my practice, which, without a doubt, in a few years’ time I will have, God willing. I bid you farewell until next time, my dear friends, and I hope you enjoyed this post. I send you a big hug. ![20260331_140742.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbnoB8YqbZVWnDEBW2YLcJExBE48GxF1QXEFSRPFANqEE/20260331_140742.jpg)

body.title: Shadowcomb Duskrose
body.body:
🔥 Card Introduction

Shadowcomb Duskrose is an Elf-type magic-based card with a mana cost 8. It can be seen from this that it is  high-level late-game card meaning it is most effective for use towards the end game. Its combination attack (Magic Attack) health and speed makes it both aggressive durable.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTz9XKL5eDJGE8Sm8npCbgZ2EhX5yWDfjS4bgdLNhGck5/1776648451448.jpg)

⚔️ Attack power (Magic Attack)

The biggest strength  this card is its magic attack. The specialty magic attack is that it directly ignores the opponent's armor and hits health.  This card very effective against opponents who have high defense but low health.

If the opponent has a lot shields, then normal melee ranged attacks are not very useful.

But Duskrose directly reduces health, so the enemy can be weakened quickly.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRo7SGCEAcXMwvZX2aTkpXnCpNg9tDf4fHh3Zsi8BXyCe/1776648451622.jpg)

 ❤️ Health (Durability)

This card has quite good health, especially as a magic unit. Usually magic cards are a bit fragile, but Duskrose is an exception in that regard. It can also act as a bit of a tank.

👉 This means:

It doesn't die easily

Can stay on the field for a long time

Can deal damage for a long time

⚡ Speed ​​(Speed)

The speed is average but not bad. As a result:

Gets the chance to attack a lot earlier

There is also the possibility of dodging (although dodge has less effect on magic attacks)

🧠 Special abilities (Abilities)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeW6FBwZizgFgpKAG8APDzU9SiK6kbHr4DGDPk4CLq1r2/1776648451545.jpg)

The real power of this card is hidden in its Abilities or special abilities. As you increase the level, new abilities are unlocked.

Some possible abilities may be (analyzed according to the icon in the picture):

1. Life Leech / Self Sustain type ability

If it has it:

Increases your health with each attack

Lives for a long time

2.  Support or Summon Ability

At some levels, it can help other units:

Boost the team

Can summon additional units

3. Debuff ability

May have the ability to weaken the opponent:

Reduce their speed

Reduce their attack power

👉 By combining these abilities, it not only attacks, but can control the course of the entire battle.

📈 Importance of leveling up

If you level up this card, its power will increase many times over.

As the level increases:

Attack increases

Health increases

New abilities are unlocked

👉 Especially at levels 7–10:

It can turn the match around alone

Can handle multiple enemies

🛡️ Where to use (Best Position)

The correct positioning of this card is very important.

 🔹 Mid or Backline (Best Choice)

It is safe to keep in the back line

Can deal continuous magic damage

🔹 Frontline (in some cases)

If there is no tank

Or a special ruleset requires it

⚔️ In what situations does it work best

✔️ High Armor Enemy

Because it is magic, it ignores armor—it is most effective here.

✔️ Long Battle

In long battles:

Abilities work

The enemy gradually weakens

✔️ If there is no Low Mana Restriction

Because its mana is 8—it is difficult to use in low mana matches.

❌ Weakness

Like all cards, it has some limitations:

It costs a lot of mana

It can be a bit weak against very fast enemies

If there is a Silence or Magic Debuff, the damage is reduced

🧩 Team Combination

This card is strong alone, but it is even stronger with the right team.

 ✔️ Tank + Healer

A strong tank in front

With a healer, Duskrose lasts longer

✔️ Magic Boost Team

When used with other magic units

The whole team is full of magic damage

🎯 Strategy Tips

1. Play at the right time instead of using it at the beginning

2. Make a decision based on the opponent's lineup

3. Invest in leveling up—this is the most important

4. Always try to keep it in the backline

💡 Personal feelings

If I say from my own experience, Shadowcomb Duskrose is a card that may seem ordinary at first, but once you can use it correctly, you will understand how terrible it can be. Especially when the match is long, this card gradually starts to show its true power.

It may not have much impact in the first few matches, but after increasing the level, it can turn the tide of the match alone. I myself have noticed that when the opponent has a strong tank, the magic attack of this card plays the biggest role. 

Shadowcomb Duskrose is a high-value, late-game dominant card. If you use it correctly and level it up slowly, it will become one  most powerful weapons in your deck.

Powerful magic attacks

Good health

Tremendous level-up boost

Game-changer when placed in the right position

body.body:

<center>
![bawy3ti9LY5cVw4E_mmexport1776644760791_edit_248747427672981.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/bawy3ti9LY5cVw4E_mmexport1776644760791_edit_248747427672981/bawy3ti9LY5cVw4E_mmexport1776644760791_edit_248747427672981.webp)
![gWJMg3MdrCdlHfkf_wx_camera_1776643667815.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/gWJMg3MdrCdlHfkf_wx_camera_1776643667815/gWJMg3MdrCdlHfkf_wx_camera_1776643667815.webp)

哈哈～最近好像减肥啊！不是跑步就是锻炼吃健康的减肥餐！之前我的主食还是比较粗的粗粮主食大米！感觉还是不错吧！多吃粗粮有益身心健康吧！唉～我家老头说我没苦硬吃，什么猪吃不了细糠，唉～都不知道吃粗粮是不是健康，都是他们制造的焦虑然后好卖产品吧！哈哈～吃什么都不一样吗？能吃饱就是幸福啦！所以他们在版卖焦虑！

其实人也就那么几十年，没啥说吃什么健康，但是总感觉按他们说的吃，感觉还是不错啊！能让自己舒心的事就是好事！我上称感觉都瘦了！也不是瘦了，感觉肌肉紧致了！没有以前那些激素鸡一样的肌肉拉！身体好就可以了！


今天我特意买了玉米当减肥早餐！哈哈～一个鸡蛋，一根玉米！一杯牛奶营养搭配起来健健康康，昨天买菜买的玉米，今天特意留着做早餐的！人也没必要特意去减肥瘦身的，身体健康才是重点，我现在身体体重还是标准的，就是没啥力气，一干活就容易累了！所以注意饮食和多运动，慢慢就会好起来啦！人生就这样，简简单单又一餐，本来想吃糯玉米的，但是糯玉米废牙，爵得累啊！甜玉米就是好吃！又是美好的一天开始啦！

---

body.title: Hyundai Motor's labor union goes a step further than the three-time union
body.body:
![image.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmbigdn3o76g3XmBhRt1KPcwxq58bb6GGerHiKo1jNEguX/image.png)
>Labor unions of large corporations are demanding massive incentives. SK Hynix (000660) union claimed 10 percent of its total operating profit, Samsung Electronics (005930) union claimed 15 percent of its operating profit, followed by Hyundai Motor (005380) union demanding 30 percent of its net profit.

>According to industry sources on Tuesday, Hyundai Motor's labor union recently confirmed its demand for wage negotiations. The plan includes a hike of 149,600 won (179 dollars) in monthly basic salary (excluding salary increase), a 30 percent bonus payment for last year's net profit, and guarantee of employment and working conditions related to artificial intelligence (AI). It will also demand a hike of 750 percent → 800 percent in bonuses, implementation of a full salary system and reduction of working hours without strengthening labor intensity.
In addition, the union said it would expand the scope of distribution of performance to its suppliers beyond its existing members. In fact, the union stipulated that 30 percent of the previous year's net profit should be paid as bonus, but the same should be applied to employees of its suppliers as well as regular employees.

>Hyundai Motor's annual net profit last year was KRW 10.3648 trillion, and based on this, the amount of incentives simply calculated will exceed KRW 3 trillion.
The labor union of Samsung Electronics is demanding an unlimited amount of incentives, funded by 15 percent of its operating profit. Based on the annual operating profit expected by the stock market, 44.7 trillion won should be paid.
SK Hynix agreed to pay 10 percent of its operating profit as \

through labor-management agreements in September last year. SK Hynix's operating profit is expected to be 50 trillion won this year, with about 25 trillion won expected to be paid as incentives. Divided into total executives and employees (about 35,000 people), SK Hynix will receive an average of 700 million won per person.
Han Soo-jin, reporter for Mae-kyung Digital News Room (han.sujin@mk.co.kr )

“Demanding performance bonuses in this way seems excessive.
Shouldn’t performance bonuses be based on evaluating individual achievements and then paid out differentially?

It feels like they are evolving into yet another entrenched interest group.
Another obstacle to our economic development is steadily growing.”

💿 Three Tune Tuesday Picks For Tuesday April 21st! Late Nineties Tunes That Went Under The Radar When Released! Pop-Punk,Ska & “Emo” Tunes! 🎶

It’s Monday but I finished my TTT post already so why not post a day early!  Enjoy! 🎸

This week I’m picking three bands who released these tunes on late nineties albums. One of them ended up having a huge hit a few years later in 2002, that’s Jimmy Eat World! They missed mainstream audience with there nineties records but did build a big following. Second is ska tune from 1998 from the band Spring Heeled Jack, I think this song is up there with ska hits like Impression that I get from Mighty Mighty Bosstones but sadly mainstream success was never in the cards. Third pick it’s the pop punk band MxPx, a band who never had a huge mainstream hit but actually has a huge following and just last weekend sold out a 3500 person venue in Denver, there are one hit wonders do can’t fill 20% of those spots and sell close to that many tickets. body.title: The Fated Magical Princess: Who Made Me a Princess | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
body.body: > Hello, anime fans. We’re back to talk about some of the hidden gems from last fall’s season. This time, I’ve got a South Korean animated series for you that—surprisingly, for me—I actually ended up really liking. A dramatic and fantastical story that managed to stand out from the majority of generic fantasy anime out there. Based on the web novel series of the same name written by Plutus and illustrated by Spoon, Who Made Me a Princess was produced by the Chinese studio Colored Pencil Animation. Discover the animated series that brought three Asian countries together.

>
Hola, fanáticos del anime. Volvemos a hablar de algunas de las joyas escondidas de la pasada temporada de otoño. En esta ocasión les tengo una serie animada surcoreana que -sorprendentemente para mí- me llegó a gustar bastante. Una historia dramática y fantástica que logró destacarse por sobre la mayoría de animes de fantasía genéricos que hay. Basada en la serie de novelas web homónima escrita por Plutus e ilustrada por Spoon, Who Made Me a Princess fue producida por el estudio chino Colored Pencil Animation. Conoce la serie animada que unió a tres países de oriente.

>

Plot

The animated series opens with a blonde woman who appears to be of royal blood giving birth to a baby girl. As soon as the baby is born and she holds her in her arms, she names her Athanasia and then passes away. The woman was none other than Empress Consort Diana, wife of Emperor Claude Obelia. Due to the death of his beloved wife, Emperor Claude rejects his newborn daughter, Athanasia, and confines her to a separate palace where she lives only with a group of maids. He also decides to burn everything related to his wife, such as paintings, dresses, photographs, and so on.

>

Trama

La serie animada empieza mostrándonos a una mujer rubia que parece ser de la realeza dando a luz a una pequeña bebé. Al nacer y tenerla en su regazo, le da el nombre de Athanasia y posteriormente fallece. La mujer era nada más ni nada menos que la Emperatriz Consorte Diana, esposa del Emperador Claude Obelia. Debido a la muerte de su querida esposa, el Emperador Claude rechaza a su hija recién nacida, Athanasia, y la confina en un palacio aparte donde solo vive con un grupo de sirvientas. También decide quemar todo lo relacionado a su esposa como lo son cuadros, vestidos, fotografías y demás.

/> Here is the trailer for the donghua: https://youtu.be/AOhuwqZptjk?si=rS4f8IdGaVtAZZkE

By:

>\n\nHonestly, I don't know how I've managed to watch so many anime series in a single season. And the craziest part isn't the quantity, but the variety of anime I've ended up watching. I've even watched the famous \

, which are like anime but made in China. That’s the case with the animated series I’m bringing you today—a Chinese animation that’s actually based on a South Korean web manga and also has a Japanese dub. That’s why I mentioned at the beginning that this series has brought together three Asian countries, a remarkable feat that, apparently, isn’t the first time this has happened. It’s also not the first time I’ve watched a donghua, since there was another much more popular fantasy-comedy one I watched back then that entertained me quite a bit. But when it comes to Who Made Me a Princess, things are different because, while it also has fantasy elements, it has a story that’s much more dramatic and romantic than it is comedic and absurd. In fact, it was precisely because of the story it tells at the beginning that it caught my attention (and I actually thought twice about watching it, since it’s not the kind of story I usually watch). This series tells the story of Athanasia, the daughter of Emperor Claude Obelia.

>
Honestamente no sé cómo he logrado ver tantos animes en una sola temporada. Y lo más loco de esto no es la cantidad, sino la variedad de animes que he llegado a ver. Incluso he visto los famosos “donghuas” que son como los animes, pero hechos en China. Ese es el caso de la serie animada que les traigo el día de hoy, una animación china, pero que a su vez está basada en un manga web surcoreano y que tiene también un doblaje al japonés. Es por esto que les mencioné al principio que esta serie ha unido a tres países asiáticos, una completa hazaña que, por lo visto, no es la primera vez que sucede. Tampoco es la primera vez que veo un donghua, ya que hubo otro mucho más popular de fantasía y comedia que vi en su momento y que me entretuvo bastante. Pero en cuanto a Who Made Me a Princess es diferente la cosa ya que, si bien posee fantasía también, tiene una historia mucho más dramática y romántica que cómica y absurda. Es más, es debido a dicha historia que nos cuenta al principio que me llamó la atención (y eso que lo pensé dos veces para verlo ya que no es el tipo de historias que acostumbro a ver). Esta serie nos cuenta la historia de Athanasia, la hija del Emperador Claude Obelia.

> Just a few days after her birth, she gains adult-level intelligence and later has a vision of her future in which she is imprisoned for allegedly attempting to assassinate her father, Emperor Claude, and ultimately commits suicide. All of this happens while she is gnawing on a book she sees in a void, completely chained up. Now, armed with the knowledge and the vision she had of her future, she will have to find a way to avoid that tragic fate. Obviously, you’ve already figured out why I decided to watch this series all the way through: the premise presented at the beginning struck me as incredibly intriguing. While there are many other anime with similar plots—where protagonists travel back in time to rewrite their history and the like—this time there was something that hooked me and was hard to let go of until the very end. Maybe it’s that mix of drama and fantasy that I love so much, which definitely delivers a story with shocking and quite thrilling moments. Everything I hoped to see in this anime series was fulfilled, to a certain extent. For example, everything related to Emperor Claude and Athanasia unfolds in a way that, honestly, I didn’t expect.

>
A los pocos días de haber nacido apenas obtiene inteligencia adulta y posteriormente tiene una visión de su futuro donde es encarcelada por supuestamente intentar asesinar a su padre, el Emperador Claude y finalmente se suicida. Todo esto sucede mientras muerde un libro que ve en un vacío que se encuentra completamente encadenado. Ahora, con el conocimiento y la visión que tuvo de su futuro, tendrá que buscar la manera de evitar ese trágico destino. Evidentemente, ya se dieron cuenta de la razón del por qué decidí verme esta serie hasta el final y es que dicha premisa que nos plantea al principio me pareció de lo más interesante. Si bien hay muchos otros animes con tramas similares de protagonistas que regresan al pasado a reconstruir su historia y cosas por el estilo, esta vez hubo algo que me enganchó y que fue difícil de soltar hasta el final. Tal vez sea esa mezcla de drama con fantasía que tanto me encanta ver y que definitivamente ofrecen una historia con momentos impactantes y bastante emocionantes. Todo lo que esperaba ver en esta serie animada la llegó a cumplir, hasta cierto punto. Por ejemplo, todo lo relacionado con el Emperador Claude y Athanasia lo vemos desarrollarse de una forma que, sinceramente, no me lo esperaba.

> Although it’s true that the ending was, in part, what we expected. But despite that, it managed to wrap up this season in a pretty exciting way. And that’s another thing I love about this series: it develops its main characters in a way that makes you grow attached to them, even if they seem like the worst people imaginable. That was certainly the case with Emperor Claude himself, who—as you read above—seems cold and ruthless at the start of the series, but then, as the episodes unfold, we see him change in a surprising way. Beyond being the typical story of the protagonist who travels back in time to change her tragic fate, this series has a much more tragic and melancholic underlying story of loss, pain, hatred, and overcoming adversity. The story of Claude and Diana is deeply moving, especially given everything we learn about them throughout the series. It is this aspect that gives the story its romantic touch, though in the end it becomes something far more tragic and dramatic. Despite this, the series doesn’t neglect its sense of humor—a humor that never feels heavy-handed, though it is somewhat innocent.

>
Aunque, sí es cierto que la parte final tuvo un desenlace que, en parte, se esperaba ver. Pero a pesar de eso, logró cerrar esta temporada de una forma bastante emocionante. Y es otra cosa cosa que me gusta de esta serie, que consigue desarrollar a sus personajes principales de una forma que consigues encariñarte con ellos, aún si aparentan ser lo peor que hay. Así fue con el caso del mismo Emperador Claude quien, con lo que leyeron arriba, notaron que tiene una personalidad fría y despiadada al principio de la serie, pero luego con el paso de los episodios vemos cómo cambia de una forma sorprendente. Más allá de ser la típica historia de la protagonista que regresa al pasado para así cambiar su trágica historia, esta serie posee de trasfondo una historia mucho más trágica y melancólica de pérdida, dolor, odio y superación. Lo de Claude y Diana es algo que genera mucha emoción y más con todo lo que llegamos a conocer a lo largo de la serie sobre ellos. Es por este lado que dicha historia posee su toque romántico, aunque al final termina siendo algo mucho más tráfico y dramático. A pesar de esto, la serie no deja de lado su toque de humor, un humor que no llega a ser del todo pesado, aunque sí un tanto inocente.

> I don’t entirely dislike the protagonist’s personality and development, especially compared to most generic protagonists in this type of story. She has her moments where she shines and really stands out, though she also has her cringeworthy moments—which, rather than being disappointing, I actually find funny, to be honest. We also meet Lucas, a powerful sorcerer who teaches Athanasia magic and is always by her side because he’s interested in how she “changes the fate” of things and the people around her. Among all the characters we get to know in this series, I think the one who stands out the most—aside from the protagonist—is the young Ijikiel, who, while he has a very innocent relationship with Athanasia in the end, had an introduction at the beginning that was one of the most awkward and humiliating I’ve ever seen. We also see that there’s a sort of villain in this story who doesn’t have much presence or development, as one would normally expect. But he does manage to cause some chaos and rather striking problems. Yes, he has his action scenes, though they’re quite scarce, to be honest.

>
La personalidad y desarrollo que tiene la protagonista como tal no me desagrada del todo, en comparación con la mayoría de protagonistas genéricas de este tipo de historias. Tiene sus momentos en los que se luce y logra destacarse bastante bien, aunque también tiene sus momentos bochornosos que, más que decepcionar considero que son graciosos, la verdad. También conocemos a Lucas, un poderoso hechicero que le enseña magia a Athanasia y que está siempre con ella debido a que está interesado en cómo “cambia el destino” de las cosas y de la gente a su alrededor. Entre todos los personajes que llegamos a conocer en esta serie, considero que de los que más destacan es -aparte de la protagonista- el joven Ijikiel quien, si bien tiene una relación muy inocente con Athanasia al final, al principio la introducción que le dan fue de lo más incómodo y humillante que he visto. También vemos que hay una especie de villano en esta historia que no tiene mucha presencia ni desarrollo como uno espera ver normalmente. Pero sí llega a causar ciertos estragos y problemas un tanto llamativos. Si, tiene sus escenas de acción, aunque bastante escasas, la verdad.

> Last but not least, another thing I really liked about this donghua is its audiovisual presentation. Usually, this type of animated series doesn’t have the same level of quality as a popular anime, but that doesn’t take away from the fact that it’s eye-catching. In this case, Who Made Me a Princess boasts excellent visual quality, particularly in its use of traditional (2D) animation. The character designs, art style, visual details, and warm, vibrant color palette are among its most striking features. The same goes for its fluidity. Another thing worth noting is the design of the backgrounds or environments we see throughout the series. Some appear to be created using traditional animation, while in other instances, the clear use of computer-generated animation is evident. While it doesn’t stand out enough to overshadow the rest, this mix of visual elements doesn’t seem to blend very well on a couple of occasions. Still, for a relatively obscure fantasy anime series, it’s actually not that badly made. The sound effects aren’t bad either, and the soundtrack often stands out quite well. Anyway, here’s a donghua for anyone interested in watching it.
Personally, I give it a rating of 8/10 in the fantasy and drama genres.

>
Finalmente, pero no menos importante, otra cosa que me gustó mucho de este donghua es su apartado audiovisual. Normalmente este tipo de series animadas no tiene el mismo nivel de calidad que tiene un anime popular, pero eso no resta al hecho de que llama la atención. En esta ocasión, Who Made Me a Princess tiene una muy buena calidad visual, sobre todo en lo que respecta al uso de la animación tradicional (2D). Los diseños de los personajes, el estilo de dibujo, los detalles visuales y la paleta de colores cálidos y brillantes son de lo más llamativo que posee. También sucede lo mismo con su fluidez. Otra cosa a destacar es el diseño de los fondos o entornos que vemos a lo largo de la serie. Algunos parecen estar hechos por animación tradicional mientras que en otras ocasiones se ve el claro uso de la animación hecha por computadora. Si bien no llega a destacarse tanto como para opacar lo demás, dicha mezcla de elementos visuales parecen no mezclarse muy bien en un par de ocasiones. Aún así, para ser una serie animada de fantasía poco popular, no está tan mal hecho, la verdad. Los efectos de sonido tampoco están mal, al igual que sucede con la banda sonora que logra destacarse bastante bien en muchas ocasiones. En fin, aquí les dejo un donghua para el que le interese verla.
Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 8/10 en lo que respecta al género de fantasía y drama.

>
Tell me, have you seen this donghua yet? What did you think of it? Feel free to leave your thoughts in the comments.

>
Dime, ¿ya has visto este donghua? ¿Qué te ha parecido? Puedes dejarme tu respuesta en los comentarios.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 20 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gbf841bfbdee5f47cec66a5fd3bb4fb8f3a88c1d5840b165c5050a459624ca036a564a1f8096533ebbd6ea1fe356c185692123a0b7d8426b46f0dd4a5684c8480_640.jpg)
Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente enriquecedora. Empecé mi recorrido en el parque central, donde noté a un grupo de niños jugando en los columpios. Sus risas eran contagiosas y me recordaron la importancia de disfrutar de los pequeños momentos. Más adelante, me encontré con una artista callejera pintando un hermoso mural; su dedicación y habilidad eran impresionantes. Me detuve a hablar con ella un rato y me contó que su objetivo era transmitir un mensaje de esperanza a través de su arte. En la cafetería de la esquina, conocí a un anciano que se sentaba a disfrutar de su café mientras leía un libro. Resultó ser un poeta local, y compartió algunas de sus inspiraciones. Fue sorprendente cómo una simple caminata me permitió conectar con personas tan diversas y ver la creatividad que pulula en nuestra ciudad. Sin duda, una experiencia que reafirma mi amor por explorar cada rincón. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZzGP1eniqfAnSd4MbiK4eKMP7huzyGoYr3z5HKgh7nQy/1776647792759.jpg)

Chelsea vs Man United ပွဲစဉ် အပြီး ကျန်ပွဲစဉ်တွေကလည်း အရှုံးအနိုင် အဖြေပေါ်ခဲ့၏။ သရေ ရလဒ် ထွက်ပေါ်ခြင်း မရှိခဲ့ပေ။ Aston Villa vs Sunderland ပွဲစဉ်ကတော့ ဒီတပတ်ရဲ့ ဂိုးအများဆုံး ပွဲစဉ် ဖြစ်ပေလိမ့်မည်။ အပြန်အလှန် သွင်းဂိုးတွေနှင့် နောက်ဆုံးမိနစ်အထိ ရင်ခုန် စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားဖွယ် အတိ ဖြစ်ခဲ့၏။ United ကို တောက်လျောက် ဖိအား ပေးနိုင်ဖို့ အနိုင် ၃ မှတ် ရယူထားခြင်သည့် Aston Villa အနေဖြင့် အိမ်ကွင်းမှာ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုးတွေ အရင် သွင်းယူခဲ့၏။ ၃-၁ ဖြင့် ပွဲပြီးတော့မယ်ဟု ထင်မှတ်ထားချိန် ၈၆ နှင့် ၈၇ မိနစ်မှာ ဧည့်သည် Sunderland အသင်းက ချေပဂိုးတွေ ဆက်တိုက်သွင်းယူပြီး ၃-၃ သရေ ဖြစ်သွား၏။ 

ဒီအတိုင်း ပွဲပြီးပြီလို့ ထင်မှတ်ထားမိ၏။ ၉၀+၃ မိနစ်မှာ Aston Villa အနေဖြင့် အနိုင်ဂိုး သွင်းယူပြီး ၄-၃ ဖြင့် ပွဲပြီးသွား၏။ United ကို အမှတ်တူ ဂိုးကွာခြားချက်ဖြင့် ဆက်လက်၍ ဖိအားပေးထားကာ UCL ဝင်ခွင့်ကို ရယူထားခဲ့၏။ မာဆေးဆိုက် ဒါဘီဟု ဆိုရမယ့် Everton vs Liverpool ပွဲစဉ်ကလည်း ပွဲကောင်း တပွဲ ဖြစ်ခဲ့၏။ ဧည့်သည် Liverpool က ၂၉ မိနစ်မှာ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး သွင်း၏။ Everton က ၅၄ မိနစ်မှာ ချေပဂိုး သွင်းယူ၏။ ၉၀+၁၀ မိနစ်မှာ ဧည့်သည် Liverpool တို့ အနိုင်ဂိုး သွင်းယူပြီး ၃ မှတ် ရယူကာ အမှတ်ပေး ဇယား အဆင့် ၅ မှာ ဆက်လက်၍ ရပ်တည်နေခဲ့၏။

တန်းဆင်းဇုန် ဖိအား ရှိနေသည့် Nottm Forest က အိမ်ကွင်းမှာ Burnley ကို ၄-၁ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရယူပြီး ဇုန်နှင့် ဝေးရာကို သွားနိုင်ဖို့ အားယူနေခဲ့၏။ ၃၆ မှတ်ဖြင့် အဆင့် ၁၆ နေရာမှာ ရပ်တည်နေ၏။ အဆင့် ၁၈ က Tottenham နဲ့ ၅ မှတ် ကွာ အနေအထားမို့ အနည်းငယ် စိတ်ချထားလို့ရသည် ဆိုပေမဲ့ လုံးလုံးကြီး စိတ်သေလက်ချ နေလိုက်လို့တော့ မရသေးပေ။ လက်ကျန် ၅ ပွဲမှာ ရယူသင့်သည့် အမှတ်တွေ အရယူထားနိုင်ဖို့ လိုမည် ဖြစ်၏။ သို့မှာသာ EPL မှာ တင်ကျန် နိုင်မည် မလား။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUH2E3q7SYdaHEA5Yj4SfV9JaFVuVyrfzjJvndt8vD3Fb/1776647792789.jpg)


နက်ဖြန် မနက် ၁ နာရီခွဲမှာတော့ အဆင့် ၁၇ နေရာက West Ham အသင်း၏ ပွဲစဉ် ရှိ၏။ Crystal Palace နှင့် အဝေးကွင်းမှာ ယှဉ်ပြိုင် ကစားရမည် ဖြစ်၏။ ဒီပွဲရလဒ်က အဆင့် ၁၈ က Tottenham အတွက် အရေးကြီးလှ၏။ West Ham ကသာ အနိုင်ရသွားရင် Tottenham အတွက် ဖိအားတွေ ပိုများ လာနိုင်၏။ လက်ကျန် ၅ ပွဲက West Ham နဲ့ Tottenham တို့ အတွက် ဘုရင့်နောင် ဖောင်ဖျက် ပွဲစဉ်တွေချည်း ဖြစ်နေခဲ့၏။

ဆင်ပျံကြီးကတော့ ဘယ်လို ဘယ်ပုံ ဖြစ်နေသည် မပြောတတ်တော့ပေ။ အမှန်တော့ ဆင်ပျံကြီးထက် City ကကို ကောင်းနေတာဟု ဆိုရမလား မသိပေ။ UCL Quarter-Finals အဆင့်မှာ Real Madrid ကို ရှုံးနိမ့်ကာ ထွက်ခွာခဲ့ရ၏။ သို့ပေမဲ့ အဆိုပါ ပွဲစဉ်ပြီး Big Match ၄ ပွဲလုံး အနိုင်ရထား၏။ EFL Cup Final မှာ Arsenal ကို ၀-၂၊ FA Cup Quarter-Finals မှာ Liverpool ကို ၄-၀ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရထား၏။ ထိုပွဲစဉ်တွေ အပြီး Chelsea နှင့် EPL ပွဲစဉ်မှာလည်း ၀-၃ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရထား၏။ မနေ့က Arsenal နှင့် ပွဲစဉ်မှာလည်း ၂-၁ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့လေ၏။

Arsenal ၏ EPL ချန်ပီယံ အိပ်မက်ကို City တို့ ဖိအားပေးနေခဲ့၏။ EFL Cup, FA Cup တို့ကနေ ထွက်ခွာခဲ့ရပြီး EPL မှာ ၂ ပွဲဆက် ရှုံးနိမ့်သွားသည့် Arsenal အနေဖြင့် အဆင့် ၁ နေရာက အနည်းငယ် မျက်ခုံးလှုပ်စရာ ဖြစ်လာခဲ့၏။ တပွဲလျော့နေသည့် City က ကြားရက် Burnley နဲ့ ပွဲစဉ်ကိုသာ အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့ရင် အဆင့် ၁ နေရာကို ဖယ်ပေးရဖို့ ရှိနေ၏။ လက်ကျန် ၅ ပွဲက Arsenal နှင့် City တို့အတွက် တကယ့်ကို ရေကုန် ရေခမ်း ကစားရမယ့် ပွဲစဉ်တွေ ဖြစ်လို့ လာခဲ့၏။

body.title: How Our Simple Chayote Garden Grows Fresh Food and Helps Our Family Every Day
body.body:
![1000195947.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vhsZduo7pwfNFfUuuvQyjx8VWDan2iVdp3rWz2tf8s1tWk7jm2ZxR2bmL9uY2Qsrhyi.jpg)

Hello Hive Garden friends!
Today I want to share our chayote garden here in the mountain and why we chose to plant this kind of vegetable at home.

![1000195954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2aNfXxHLaR3rRhTwejVf7cEV6PbzsATg2peKzXfrogbegAusopG9XMjkCHWXKvixGP.jpg)

Today the price of vegetables in the market is getting higher, including chayote. I still remember when I was still studying, sayote was very cheap and easy to buy anytime. It was one of the most affordable vegetables before. But now, things have changed. The price has gone up a lot. In some places, one sack of chayote can cost around 1,000 pesos or more, which is already a big amount for many families. 

![1000195958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wWTPxWghRoCBsQkX2iUXykN1arCqUJY1SDY4sKoVvqbVB7uSQZNk2qZMSS8NmsMVRVV.jpg)

![1000195955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wzdTKWkBu4WN6zC43e9ksBtvqen9Hst8K17EV8sAZczwqARP627RDP6qiof4EaMnjuF.jpg)

Because of that, we decided to plant chayote in our own garden since then, It is a big help for us, especially now that many daily needs are expensive. Instead of buying often from the market, we can harvest fresh vegetables from our backyard.

What I really like about chayote is that it is very easy to plant. We do not need to spend money on seeds. We simply use a mature sayote fruit that has started to sprout. Once it is ready, we place it in the soil and let it grow naturally.

![1000195956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xAMA4YsW2sKQoEn5ub7ELBxT4Wa2uoytBQuvbqj7FqJ7vHYoBv26MYBCjMUThFXSCzy.jpg)

![1000195951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tvAjuqHaXsBfWVS3RRgW65Qh3VEPQeV4zKsrKXHNkBgP3tWMAWNt4yUjJFHBMYsVf69.jpg)

We also do not use fertilizer. We just let it grow on its own. After planting, we wait for the vine to climb and spread. It does not need too much attention compared to other crops. That is why I can say it is one of the easiest plants to maintain.

After around three months, it starts to bear fruits. It feels good every time I see new chayote hanging from the vine because I know our small effort has become something useful for our family.

![1000195950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vrtfXRD3nHEJTqsosVXp5bgpDw8E7fUM1JXBqUt6HkaoD2yKXFa3NUG1DCtkYShYW53.jpg)

![1000195948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wfr4LRTLwRwFAKzzATqVFHPYtJYHvLUoF9wvFMh9PhXFgsNooxdFZ3cSCk6kYU3gzyg.jpg)

![1000195927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uEz8iT9STri3WyuHHyXAiAA2SaitYZRWnJ1EfiJQgFxfh5ckZ7uavPLsiqwhvpG99QG.jpg)

Aside from being easy to grow, chayote is also very useful in cooking. We use it in soups, stir fry dishes, and mixed vegetables. Even the young tops can be cooked partner with bagoong. Nothing is wasted.

![1000195922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wWyPxvgCmAHEq894cP4TK2zNW2ksZ7ShQ2Nrp4s126Rt88toYpsuEKPxGWTZVDRAi5X.jpg)

For me, planting chyote is practical and rewarding. It helps lessen expenses, provides fresh food, and gives satisfaction whenever we harvest.

![1000195923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23y8stYTr21DuFGGEw4vgPAk5bzRDp47ZoLAgbi95CPntF9wa4q91XqyhvYqrz2Km3qBV.jpg)

Thank you for reading my story, this is my own picture, edited in Canva.

body.title: Hilos de luz [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSMVxH4CGnF8tjffxVbRwj3oBiFh5LJbzYBnNLVN5N3LQ/1776625287736.jpg)

***
***
Hace unos días les contaba en esta comunidad que, entre apagones y noches interminables, había encontrado un refugio inesperado: tejer con la poca luz de una lámpara de cabecera. Es verdad que no era una solución mágica a los problemas enormes que vivimos los cubanos hoy, sino mi manera personal de decirle a la oscuridad que no iba a dejarme vencer. En un contexto donde las horas sin electricidad se alargan y parecen no tener fin, cualquier pequeña acción que nos devuelva una sensación de control se convierte en un acto casi sagrado. 

Hoy, con las manos todavía un poco entumecidas y los ojos acostumbrándose otra vez a la penumbra, quiero mostrarles el resultado de esas horas en vela con dos proyectos terminados. Ambos son tapetes de color salmón. No me pregunten por qué elegí ese tono, aunque pienso que quizás es porque es el color del atardecer cuando todavía hay luz, o porque mi lámpara de poca batería le daba a la lana un brillo cálido que me impedía sentirme sola. El caso es que el salmón se convirtió en mi pequeño acto de rebeldía contra el gris de los cortes eléctricos. 
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVuLHNq1RB47hKDhk2m3spWwNUgPT1EKx5om9rHw31t2v/1776625434612.jpg)

***
El primer tapete es alargado, a modo de camino de mesa. Lo empecé una madrugada en que el déficit eléctrico llegó antes de lo previsto y me quedé a oscuras con una vela moribunda y mi aguja. La luz temblaba, mis dedos dudaban, pero seguí y puntada tras puntada, al terminar cada hilera sentía que le ganaba un segundo a la desesperanza. Recuerdo que en la tercera noche, con la lámpara ya casi fundida, perdí la cuenta de los puntos y tuve que destejer media hora de trabajo. Me frustré, claro, pero respiré hondo y volví a empezar. Ahora ese tapete no es solo lana, sino que es también el registro de noches sin nevera, sin ventilador, sin ruido de la calle. Cuando lo extiendo sobre la mesa, todo parece menos triste y yo me siento menos derrotada. 
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuiWLMnf8n9MzLyC2cavPKRnx2XRernKigaCjQqH52QY/1776625434312.jpg)


***
El segundo tapete es redondo y ese lo tejí pensando en una amiga. Ella también pasa las mismas horas sin luz, las mismas colas para el pan, la misma incertidumbre sobre cuándo volverá el servicio eléctrico. En los días malos nos mandamos mensajes de voz con lo que nos queda de datos móviles, y nos decimos: “Esto también pasará”. Supe que este tapete era para ella. Un círculo completo como un abrazo de lana. No es un regalo caro, pero está hecho con la única luz que tenía, con el único tiempo que no me quitaba el cansancio. Al tejerlo, pensaba en su risa, en cómo nos sostenemos la una a la otra sin necesidad de grandes gestos. Ese tapete redondo es la prueba de que la amistad también se teje, puntada a puntada, en la oscuridad.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmasHFoTeGqrXgj9H7JgjfwppZagE4JLLUhKJeZQrATjjm/1776625603910.jpg)

***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNttALa8iGTzpbwuyUJJi6vecqg2ey7FnNajUMNV9f2Gf/1776625603692.jpg)



***
No les estoy dando un tutorial de manualidades y no voy a explicarles el punto ni la hebra porque eso no importa. Lo que importa es que, en medio de las carencias, la creatividad y la paciencia pueden tejer un pequeño escudo. La resiliencia no es un concepto abstracto, es esto: sentarse donde hay un poco de luz, aunque sea tenue, y construir algo con las manos, algo que antes no existía. Tejer en la oscuridad tiene algo de ritual íntimo. Cada puntada es un pequeño triunfo sobre el silencio que dejan los apagones. En Cuba, la falta de electricidad no es solo un inconveniente técnico; es una ausencia que se mete en los huesos, que detiene la vida, que nos obliga a inventar nuevas maneras de pasar las horas. Por eso, cuando tejo, no solo estoy creando un objeto útil o bonito, sino que estoy hilando mis propias esperanzas. La lana se vuelve un hilo conductor entre lo que soy y lo que quiero ser: alguien que no se resigna.

***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTWrVL5rvCXExKfjZjvjm3oZBNsWETUVjTkLjZgkF8Xeu/1776625782300.jpg)


***

El salmón de estos tapetes me recuerda que no todo tiene que ser gris y que se puede elegir un color vivo incluso cuando el mundo se apaga. Elegí el salmón también porque es el color de la piel cuando uno se sonroja, de la fruta madura, de algunos amaneceres que he visto desde mi ventana cuando finalmente vuelve la luz.

<center>🧶</center>


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSmczRZ7mh457ozsGyfJF93vxnsidtnD9LmCYpF1XK9K/1776476176416.jpg)

### <center>ENGLISH VERSION</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center>Threads of Light</center>




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwoqP2XRZqAT63jLnzzUUNH7DV4PCQhuM4EZUjCE2KmF/1776625287962.jpg)



***
***

A few days ago I told you in this community that, between blackouts and endless nights, I had found an unexpected refuge: knitting by the dim light of a bedside lamp. It is true that it was not a magical solution to the enormous problems we Cubans face today, but rather my personal way of telling the darkness that I was not going to let it defeat me. In a context where hours without electricity drag on and seem endless, any small action that gives us back a sense of control becomes almost sacred. 

Today, with my hands still a little numb and my eyes getting used to the half-light again, I want to show you the result of those sleepless hours with two finished projects. Both are salmon colored mats. Do not ask me why I chose that shade, although I think it is perhaps because it is the color of the sunset when there is still light, or because my low battery lamp gave the wool a warm glow that kept me from feeling alone. The point is that salmon became my small act of rebellion against the gray of power cuts. 
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVuLHNq1RB47hKDhk2m3spWwNUgPT1EKx5om9rHw31t2v/1776625434612.jpg)


***
The first mat is long, like a table runner. I started it one dawn when the electricity deficit arrived earlier than expected and I was left in the dark with a dying candle and my knitting needle. The light flickered, my fingers hesitated, but I continued and stitch by stitch, as I finished each row I felt that I was gaining a second on despair. I remember that on the third night, with the lamp almost burned out, I lost count of the stitches and had to undo half an hour of work. I got frustrated, of course, but I took a deep breath and started over. Now that mat is not just wool, it is also the record of nights without a refrigerator, without a fan, without the noise of the street. When I spread it on the table, everything seems less sad and I feel less defeated. 
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuiWLMnf8n9MzLyC2cavPKRnx2XRernKigaCjQqH52QY/1776625434312.jpg)


***
The second mat is round and I knitted it thinking of a friend. She also goes through the same hours without light, the same lines for bread, the same uncertainty about when the electricity will return. On bad days we send each other voice messages with what little mobile data we have left, and we say to each other: This too shall pass. I knew this mat was for her. A complete circle like a woolen hug. It is not an expensive gift, but it is made with the only light I had, with the only time that tiredness did not take from me. As I knitted it, I thought of her laugh, of how we hold each other up without big gestures. That round mat is proof that friendship is also knitted, stitch by stitch, in the dark.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmasHFoTeGqrXgj9H7JgjfwppZagE4JLLUhKJeZQrATjjm/1776625603910.jpg)
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNttALa8iGTzpbwuyUJJi6vecqg2ey7FnNajUMNV9f2Gf/1776625603692.jpg)


***
I am not giving you a crafts tutorial and I am not going to explain the stitch or the thread because that does not matter. What matters is that, in the midst of scarcity, creativity and patience can weave a small shield. Resilience is not an abstract concept, it is this: sitting where there is a little light, even if it is dim, and building something with your hands, something that did not exist before. Knitting in the dark has something of an intimate ritual. Each stitch is a small triumph over the silence that blackouts leave behind. In Cuba, the lack of electricity is not just a technical inconvenience; it is an absence that gets into your bones, that stops life, that forces us to invent new ways to pass the hours. That is why, when I knit, I am not just creating a useful or pretty object, I am spinning my own hopes. The wool becomes a thread between who I am and who I want to be: someone who does not give up. 
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTWrVL5rvCXExKfjZjvjm3oZBNsWETUVjTkLjZgkF8Xeu/1776625782300.jpg)

***
The salmon color of these mats reminds me that not everything has to be gray and that you can choose a living color even when the world goes dark. I chose salmon also because it is the color of skin when you blush, of ripe fruit, of some sunrises I have seen from my window when the light finally returns.

body.body: It's called aphantasia when you can't or struggle to visualise, I haven't looked into it beyond that.  Most people generally assume other people see things the same way as they see them, there was a Reddit thread that I was skimming through (I can't remember how I got there) where there was someone who replied \

to some people who were describing how they could visualise things as a full colour movie (apparently normally like an actual movie that you watch on a screen, but a few could either move around the \

or rotate it or some combination) as this person could only visualise in 2d.\n\nI can see my own body parts (sometimes I see my whole self as I'm outside of me like I'm watching a video) and reflections in dreams, it's times and screens I have trouble with (I can usually \
the dream screen or digital clock but can't read it because it's blurry or I forget immediately after looking at it), though having said that I can usually \

dream videos/movies just fine (up to the point where I end up in them which is normally what happens).\n\nIt's interesting reading about the different ways people imagine/visualise/dream about things!

body.title: 只有週末才快樂 !
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUK1Yc7EQHaujMDweZ7WyhionCXfSuKUgZiLnNwxB9XRi/img_1169.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3MHuJd7oar3RYiRCjAbvVrRpo7GWoVUQze3CxhbtQgb/img_1170.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNXMPrT2yWeBYKTBpRNi4D6h1yYXM7MZpJX5FeFSGv2Z/img_1173.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPayUH5dkB1WEDxh3Sgm4yc8KG7V3Vdppou51mKfLcW9E/img_1174.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQzghqcenTkPxxZj9yKqFk1NyJPRpdVW4cEYkcBd4F5r/img_1171.jpg)


現在在這裡上班, 基本上都是週一到週五都沒了靈魂似的, 每天回到公司都是行屍走肉. 然後就是被屌一輪狠的, 的確, 我早已被屌到沒感覺了. 但沒感覺, 不代表我覺得一輩子過這種生活是有意思的. 所以, 最近都是消極面對工作, 覺得, 就這樣吧. 誰不都這樣上個破班,為那三棗兩毛的工資唯唯諾諾.

所以嘛, 最近變到連帖都沒有日更了, weekday 的時候, 真的做甚麼都提不起勁來, 不過, 一旦到了週末, 我可會回歸初衷, 變回一個很有活力的人, 我已正式踏入41歲是真的, 但不代表我的內心真的要像網上那些人所說的中年老登一樣, 失去了活力, 放假都只想呆家裡. 抱歉, 我不是那種人. 

再說了, 過了35就是人到中年, 只是大陸網絡世界的說話, 在香港或者其他地方, 45都是打拼的好時機. 所以我有時不禁懷疑, 甚麼過了35是中年人, 都是資本有心在網絡上宣染的, 目的就是剝削一眾基層的手段, 大陸最不缺的就是勞動力. 近十年, 大家都那麼清醒了, 以往那套PUA行不通了, 就建立一套新的來收割? 這都是個人猜測, 是真是假, 大家不必太在意哈.

3月28日的週末, 第一天星期六, 的確我沒像以往一樣, 一大早就開車出去浪, 其實不是人累了, 只是一下子想不到要去裡, 所以不想為了出去而出去. 我還有星期天, 可以在當天好好想想去那裡逛就是. 

當時我家三三還在打點搬新家的事, 但基本上我的沙發已經到位了, 雖然中間有一些小問題, 就是運送途中有一點破損, 但後面她找了客服去安排修補, 所以最後不必我操心的. 但我也想再上去看看他們新家搞的咋樣, 所以就約了當晚吃飯囉.

在那邊基本上都是吃大排檔燒烤之類的, 這些年來, 帶過她吃無數家好吃的, 新奇的餐廳了, 我們早就沒辦法在探店上找到新鮮感啦, 滿足感倒還能找到, 因為出去吃, 不用花時間自己煮, 也不用洗碗, 省心. 但不省錢, 我懂的, 現在都不是一天三餐出去吃了, 偶然吃一下也無妨. 

最後還給我猜中了, 真的去了吃燒烤, 要吃甚麼自己在攤外邊的冰箱自己挑, 然後老闆會在外邊慢慢烤. 你問我這種街邊攤是不是特別衛生? 可以跟你說不是, 但至少看的出不算很髒, 偶然吃一下也無妨, 不用怕吃完會拉肚子那種. 加上十多二十年都是一天三餐在外邊吃, 身體各個器官早就習慣了這種相對不乾淨的環境了. 所以問題不大, 吃完飯再上去看看, 果然暫時就只有我那張沙發到位了, 其他家電一件都沒有. 所以, 坐一下, 抽根煙, 吹吹水就先回去了.

到家之後, 基本上都想好了第二天去那裡逛, 現在油價漲了, 加上不知出遠門的話要去那裡, 所以決定找一些在深圳沒逛過的商場, 等我的車動一下就好.
