body.title: Las reuniones familiares lo más hermoso de la vida.
body.body:
>Espero que se encuentren muy bien. En esta oportunidad estoy aquí, para compartir con ustedes una pequeña reflexión. Espero que les guste mucho; abrazos. #
![Union familiar ante todo. La luz no enseñanza eso._20260419_205919_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXZq1DxY4CCk7zqQNMVgR38uoQt75Er43Gxmre9gcX6Nc/Union%20familiar%20ante%20todo.%20La%20luz%20no%20ense%C3%B1anza%20eso._20260419_205919_0000.png)
Imagen diseñada en CANVA
#

>En Venezuela, la situación de la luz es terrible; todos los días se va por grandes horas, y la verdad que molesta. El calor es intenso, así que nos obliga a salir de nuestros hogares, no para la playa, sino para el frente de tu casa; te sientas con tu familia, y ahí empiezas a hablar con ella. Empiezas a contar anécdotas de la familia; es hermoso porque sacas sonrisas, te ríes hasta más no poder, y se perdonan algunas cosas que hicieron mal en la familia; es sin duda muy hermoso, une a la familia e incluso hasta a los vecinos, los cuales también siempre tienen algo que contar. Ahí es donde te das cuenta de una cosa: al principio peleas porque la luz se fue y ya no puedes ver tus redes sociales. Pero después de todas esas peleas, que te reúnes con tu familia y ves lo que realmente importa, todo cambia; te vas a empezar a arrepentir por todos esos insultos a la luz, yo le digo, porque me enojó mucho cuando se va la luz, pero no la insulto, eso sí no, jeje. Aun así, me doy cuenta de que no va a valer la pena gritar y enojarse; más bien me debo poner contento, pues me voy a reunir con mi familia, y vamos a empezar a contar cosas de terror, etc. # Y eso es todos los días. Aquí donde vivo, es una urbanización, y cuando se va la luz, que miras afuera, ves a todas esas familias reunidas, vecinos contando chismes y niños corriendo de aquí y de allá. En la vida no todo se trata de estar en un celular o en una computadora. Debemos también compartir un poco con el mundo exterior, con nuestras amistades, mascotas. Pero no debemos esperar hasta que se vaya la luz, porque no va a ser todo el tiempo. Esos momentos de reflexión en familia sin duda no los cambio por nada en el mundo. En mi familia nada más somos 3, pero disfruto cada momento que hablo con mi mamá y mi hermanito. Mi mamá es una mujer que trabaja todo el tiempo y comparte muy poco con nosotros, así que aprovechamos ese tiempo al máximo. La unión familiar es hermosa, lo más fuerte que puede haber en la vida. Está bien que peleemos porque, si los entiendo, da rabia que se vaya todos los días, pero en vez en cuando también está la familia, las amistades y los recuerdos; el trabajo es muy importante, pero también debemos descansar la mente. ¿Cómo? Con esas anécdotas, cuentos de terror y de todo con la familia, jeje. Sin duda, nunca voy a parar de amarlo. #
![Union familiar ante todo. La luz no enseñanza eso._20260419_210008_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbxA8HkhZWXT9cY3HnE5WJpGXzzHr4d8pSkeWRmGPGKdY/Union%20familiar%20ante%20todo.%20La%20luz%20no%20ense%C3%B1anza%20eso._20260419_210008_0000.png)
Imagen diseñada en CANVA
#

>Así que ya saben, mis queridos amigos. La familia es primero. Si la luz se va, aprovecha ese momento; además, así la luz llega más rápido, pero, obviamente, el tiempo para la familia. También las amistades recuerdan su infancia,, cuándo jugaban; les digo porque yo lo hago, jeje, de verdad que me río de más, aunque soy una persona de risa fácil también. Pero ya saben, la familia ante todo. # Y bueno amigos, hasta aquí dejo yo mi publicación. Espero que les haya gustado mucho, y que les sirva de gran reflexión. Un fuerte abrazo. # #
Greetings, friends!
# I hope you're all doing well. I'm here today to share a short reflection with you. I hope you enjoy it; hugs. #
![Union familiar ante todo. La luz no enseñanza eso._20260419_205919_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXZq1DxY4CCk7zqQNMVgR38uoQt75Er43Gxmre9gcX6Nc/Union%20familiar%20ante%20todo.%20La%20luz%20no%20ense%C3%B1anza%20eso._20260419_205919_0000.png)
Imagen diseñada en CANVA
#

>In Venezuela, the electricity situation is terrible; it goes out for hours every day, and it's really annoying. The heat is intense, so it forces us to leave our homes, not to go to the beach, but to the front of our houses; you sit with your family, and that's where you start talking. You start sharing family stories; it's beautiful because you bring smiles, you laugh until you can't breathe, and you forgive some of the things the family did wrong; it's undoubtedly very beautiful, it unites the family and even the neighbors, who also always have something to share. That's when you realize something: at first, you argue because the power went out and you can't check your social media. But after all those arguments, when you get together with your family and see what really matters, everything changes; you start to regret all those insults you hurled at the electricity. I tell it, because I get really angry when the power goes out, but I don't insult it, no way, haha. Even so, I realize that it won't be worth yelling and getting angry; rather, I should be happy, because I'm going to meet up with my family, and we're going to start telling scary stories, etc. # And that's every single day. Here where I live, it's a gated community, and when the power goes out, you look outside and see all those families gathered together, neighbors gossiping, and kids running around. Life isn't all about being on a phone or a computer. We also need to connect with the outside world, with our friends and pets. But we shouldn't wait until the power goes out, because it's not going to happen all the time. I wouldn't trade those moments of reflection with my family for anything in the world. There are only three of us in my family, but I cherish every moment I spend talking with my mom and my little brother. My mom works all the time and doesn't spend much time with us, so we make the most of that time. Family bonding is beautiful, the strongest thing there is in life. It's okay to argue because, I understand, it's frustrating when the power goes out every day, but we also have family, friends, and memories; work is very important, but we also need to rest our minds. How? With those anecdotes, scary stories, and everything else with the family, hehe. Without a doubt, I'll never stop loving him. #
![Union familiar ante todo. La luz no enseñanza eso._20260419_210008_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbxA8HkhZWXT9cY3HnE5WJpGXzzHr4d8pSkeWRmGPGKdY/Union%20familiar%20ante%20todo.%20La%20luz%20no%20ense%C3%B1anza%20eso._20260419_210008_0000.png)
Imagen diseñada en CANVA
#

>So, you know, my dear friends. Family comes first. If the power goes out, make the most of it; it'll come back on faster that way, but obviously, that's for family. Friendships also bring back memories of childhood, of playing together; I know because I do, haha, I really laugh a lot, even though I'm a person who laughs easily. But you know, family comes first. # And well, friends, that's all for my post. I hope you enjoyed it and that it gives you food for thought. A big hug.

body.title: Paseo en el puente Gonzalo de Ocampo por el perímetro de la ciudad [Esp-Eng]
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Bendiciones abundantes y eternas para todos los miembros de esta fabulosa comunidad @Worldmappin. Encantado en saludarles y desearles feliz y Bendito inicio de semana. Deseo que la bendición de Dios abunde en sus vidas y tengan un excelente día. Hoy les comparto una nueva y relajante aventura por el puente Gonzalo de Ocampo, el cual se encuentra ubicado muy cerca del mercado municipal y el terminal de pasajeros en el sector conocido como la boca, el nombre obedece a que en este punto se unen el mar y el río, el puente es de color amarillo y está formado por barandas laterales, un muro central y la amplia avenida que conduce a la carretera nacional hacia Puerto la cruz y Carúpano, cerca del puente se localiza también una parada de transporte, muy concurrida dada la cercanía que tiene con el mercado municipal, en horas de la mañana es un área activa, ya que la población se moviliza a hacer sus compras en el mercado y esta es la vía más usada para desplazarse. El puente está sobre el un tramo del río manzanares, como lo indiqué anteriormente desciende hasta el mar en el sector que se le conoce como la boca del Río,un puerto pesquero donde distribuyen pescado fresco a los pequeños y grandes comerciantes; por su cercanía al mercado muchas personas transitan esta área en busca de pescado fresco y otros productos del mar, el puente lleva el nombre de uno de los fundadores de la ciudad de Cumaná.

> **
ENGLISH
** Abundant and eternal blessings to all members of this fabulous @Worldmappin community. It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed start to the week. I pray that God's blessings abound in your lives and that you have an excellent day. Today I'm sharing a new and relaxing adventure across the Gonzalo de Ocampo Bridge, which is located very close to the municipal market and the passenger terminal in the area known as La Boca (The Mouth). The name comes from the fact that the sea and the river meet at this point. The bridge is yellow and consists of side railings, a central wall, and the wide avenue that leads to the national highway towards Puerto La Cruz and Carúpano. Near the bridge, there is also a bustling bus stop, given its proximity to the municipal market. In the mornings, it's a busy area, as people travel to do their shopping at the market, and this is the most frequently used route for transportation. The bridge is over a section of the Manzanares River, as I mentioned before, which descends to the sea in the area known as the mouth of the river, a fishing port where fresh fish is distributed to small and large merchants; due to its proximity to the market, many people pass through this area in search of fresh fish and other seafood products. The bridge is named after one of the founders of the city of Cumaná. ![PGO (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqBci3HsxxGGS6rGGvyWvYEnRPpXu58PsVGtiA6LQ4PpYpikiXpeFJfJ14PuSNJn2DE.jpeg) ![PGO (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eq5Ex3Rz4pUFhJRdABEG5tysEEQDoM1BxXAtGkZ13DGrub2ZJ8ZjXytuhQQqqVYWh3d.jpeg) ![PGO (24).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EprU9QPMcRn7VJDEUVoTCp5vLx4s6itiNgp6FuT4sEUd7cTcrRKazGUs8fFYs8FPcMN.jpeg) ![PGO (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpxrJuXq5gbuwvrz48dxkqEzGU3AMgsTKM6D66ynUh78JbAcoqq36joTGmVzsStAtkM.jpeg) ![PGO (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpzyjBZqGphMhbXAJSNRSksL7Wb6uZZpRjtm9GMnvB2pRMwqx72BG7cHwPZVy1wzCdu.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> During my walk across the bridge, I observed several boats traveling from the river mouth to the adjacent areas of the municipal market, transporting fish and other products. In the mornings, it's common to see several boats crossing this section of the river. The boat passes under the bridge and then heads towards the aforementioned area. I enjoyed the view of the river, the vegetation along its banks, and the calm, relaxing water. Later, I walked towards the railings and could see the river with its layer of vegetation on either side, as well as some buildings, most of which belong to fishing companies or seafood processing plants. In the distance, other boats can be seen following the same course as the previous one, crossing the river and distributing the fish to these companies. On the right side of the river, there is also a large layer of vegetation covering part of the bank, rocks, posts, and a blue building that belongs to a seafood processing company.

> Durante mi recorrido por el puente pude observar varios botes que se trasladan desde el sector la boca hasta las áreas adyacentes del mercado municipal transportando pescado y otros productos, en el horario de la mañana, es común ver varios botes atravesar este tramo del río, el bote pasa por debajo del puente y luego se dirige hacia la zona mencionada, me gustó la vista del río, la vegetación a los lados y el agua tranquila y relajante del río, luego avancé hacia las barandas y se observa el río con su capa vegetal por los lados, también algunos edificios que en su mayoría corresponden a empresas pesqueras y procesadoras de productos del mar. A lo lejos se observan otros botes que siguen el mismo curso del anterior, cruzar el río y distribuir los pescados en estas empresas, al lado derecho del río hay también una gran capa vegetal que cubre parte de la orilla, rocas postes y se observa una edificación de color azul que corresponde a una empresa procesadora de productos del mar. ![PGO (19).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep1WueW5yMfnAiW5PkN5ooP1uFG2oJngcvsN6fvvEeTuNEfHda52Mh4cDY64uBFyXbN.jpeg) ![PGO (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqWknst8nKptgePaig5viT1Hx2MPKNddVzorCbkRB5aUPfMrBeJpxPnE9xovF1VkFc7.jpeg) ![PGO (17).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqhQKrudPkasYJMxiAT6CX8iuWGptd2v8wXLkMStXWQ7ukgCinuAVTrNykB9XqjsSpY.jpeg) ![PGO (20).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqSW29MCY11xr1xSpxUWNveaKvUHKMnfXQXDaR95oQsvjkjpiR3rgJTF9gYBapnkpMN.jpeg) ![PGO (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpvhzXfvMvaF3kamAJtigioyzFPksfBP4jcLVy9HRndzzbWuagAHssARSsyvdYTnWu2.jpeg)

> **Portugués** ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

body.title: Un posa lentes de felpa ✂️📐 [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
> ##
Hola amigos, ¡bienvenidos a mi mundo!
  Cómo están todos? Yo bien con mucha flojera de ir para clases mañana pero por lo menos tuve toda la semana pasada libre porque estaban haciendo los recuperativos y la discusión de notas del segundo lapso que me fue bien gracias a Dios. Bueno amigos hoy yo les vine a enseñar otra cosa que hice para mi cuarto para poner en la mesita de noche y es para poner mis lentes cuando voy a dormir. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP1GQZn6KzZM3MDVpBFQaJtCwUunToK2tVQcJCEd1XAEA/1776647307327.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Es como una mini bandeja de felpa donde poner los lentes que yo vi en una de las fotos que me enseñó mi mamá y que se veía bonita, pero la que yo vi era de cerámica, pero no me gusta así porque si se cae se rompe y yo soy un poquito desastrosa y como le dije a mi mamá que quería eso, ella me dijo que podía hacerlo con cartón y forrarlo entonces le dije que sí y buscamos por ahí una tela y encontramos esa que era una cobijita rosada de cuando yo era una bebé y quedó bien bonita. ## Yo utilicé 💗 Cartón de caja 💗 Pistola de silicón 💗 Lápiz 💗 Regla 💗 Transportador 💗 Tela de felpa rosada 💗 Tijera ## Ahora el paso a paso Lo primero fue hacer los moldes y esos me los marcó mi mamá en el cartón y mide 10 cm de ancho y 19.5 cm de largo y en las puntas es curvo y eso lo hacen con el transportador o con cualquier cosa que sea así curvita. Mi mamá me marcó dos porque el cartón era delgado y después yo los recorté. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQHqTNtnvbdDPhXm58iRkTp7KxsizJ8mAomt592RXNzkL/1776646414596.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Después lo que yo hice fue pegar esos dos cartones con el silicón para que quedara más gordito y más duro. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZm5LFUjk47mmxmRjA8Hdc8AuSUMahmLUtdmjtpsCJJz1/1776646414877.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Ahora viene lo que va alrededor de eso que es una tira de cartón que mide 3 cm de ancho y hay que cortarla del tamaño del otro cartón porque hay que pegarlo por todo alrededor y como el cartón es duro y eso es curvo mi mamá me enseñó un truco que es enrollar esa tira de cartón y se pone suave y agarra bien la curva. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUzQTqECyvf9XokYRr4p4uJGUVpkC537froFWVMKq4qkc/1776646414698.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ2ttPjVUSmLb71rc69wzN5SsYzgYkEN5G6esL5GRLc2y/1776646414784.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Después pegué esa tira con el silicón caliente y listo. Ahora hay que pegar la tela. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLVuiv6JNGi5D3iwfWwwf159bdiXN5WVZvPoSpzoRbm9/1776646414978.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Lo que yo hice fue cortar una tira un poquito más ancha que la tira de cartón y de todo el largo de la cajita o de alrededor y lo fui pegando con la pistola de silicón y quedó tapada toda la orilla y después lo doblé para adentro y también lo pegué y también hice lo mismo por debajo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5pVdWjCN81MKrjJ3CNmxA5k4bWnJn5vAVXcuR3zMdfA/1776646560899.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNn7e4ZgJ4aqDXMhtnTZi2rXSTR3iQgVpzb9a3xXtBk8Y/1776646560991.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Después para tapar lo de adentro y lo del lado de abajo que le faltó tela mi mamá me marcó dos rectángulos de curva más pequeños y corté la tela y se la pegué a los cartones y después metí uno adentro, que ese no lo pegué y el otro se lo puse abajo y listo, quedó bien bonita y es fino que sea de tela y acolchada porque ya mis lentes tienen unas marcas que se le hicieron con la repisa porque a veces no me doy cuenta cuando los pongo, pero ahora no se van a rayar más. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZcV89HxKHaTee9PH58SJ1SV715LUaoDaCb3ztSJNNr1L/1776646561072.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZvuYiGN18QzcPZFwkEBk13gUXZBapJSp2oTxdMQFYXuR/1776646561157.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTv1anhcnkTxEW1PsC21UKenchD4j2na2dxn7Me2kDBjv/1776646561243.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaWamHVXyUf4CLVWhEY1k9P9ptcmAzyhLFP4JxDbQC656/1776646686449.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXvReQqxatSS8WJEKdQZHDBh7nRKc8Vz18qRWbJBLi6jZ/1776646686535.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Eso es para ponerlo en la mesita de noche de mi cuarto nuevo, pero mientras tanto la voy a poner en la repisa que tiene mi cama. Bueno amigos ojalá que les guste esta idea para poner los lentes, pero también pueden poner otras cosas. Gracias por leer mi post. Chaoooo ❤❤💕💕
![PicsArt_11-23-08.48.18.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/EpJZ9gWSo3WTMQUHBrJxzUKwRzwVXPPH5zrUqDQBD4QcbxmNnPVJQbY8oPJSqWS8oeN.png)
##
Hello friends, welcome to my world!
How’s everyone doing? I’m fine, though I’m really not in the mood to go to class tomorrow. At least I had the whole of last week off because they were holding the resits and the second-term results discussion, which went well for me, thank goodness. Well, friends, today I’ve come to show you something else I made for my bedroom to put on my bedside table – it’s for putting my glasses on when I go to sleep. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) It’s like a mini felt tray for my glasses that I saw in one of the photos my mum showed me, and it looked lovely. The one I saw was made of ceramic, but I don’t like that because if it falls, it breaks, and I’m a bit of a klutz. So, when I told my mum I wanted one, she said I could make it out of cardboard and cover it, so I said yes, and we looked around for some fabric and found this little pink blanket from when I was a baby, and it turned out really pretty. ## I used 💗 Cardboard 💗 Hot glue gun 💗 Pencil 💗 Ruler 💗 Protractor 💗 Pink plush fabric 💗 Scissors ## Now for the step-by-step guide First, I made the templates; my mum marked them out for me on the cardboard. They’re 10 cm wide and 19.5 cm long, and the ends are curved – you can do this with a protractor or anything else that’s slightly curved. My mum marked out two for me because the cardboard was thin, and then I cut them out. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQHqTNtnvbdDPhXm58iRkTp7KxsizJ8mAomt592RXNzkL/1776646414596.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Then what I did was stick those two pieces of cardboard together with silicone so it would be thicker and sturdier. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZm5LFUjk47mmxmRjA8Hdc8AuSUMahmLUtdmjtpsCJJz1/1776646414877.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Now comes the part that goes around it, which is a strip of cardboard 3 cm wide. You have to cut it to the size of the other piece of cardboard because you have to stick it all the way round, and as the cardboard is stiff and it’s curved, my mum taught me a trick: roll up that strip of cardboard and it becomes soft and follows the curve nicely. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUzQTqECyvf9XokYRr4p4uJGUVpkC537froFWVMKq4qkc/1776646414698.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ2ttPjVUSmLb71rc69wzN5SsYzgYkEN5G6esL5GRLc2y/1776646414784.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Then I stuck that strip down with hot glue and that was it. Now it’s time to stick the fabric on. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLVuiv6JNGi5D3iwfWwwf159bdiXN5WVZvPoSpzoRbm9/1776646414978.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) What I did was cut a strip a little wider than the cardboard strip and the full length of the box or around it, and I stuck it down with the hot glue gun, covering the entire edge. Then I folded it inwards and stuck that down too, and I did the same underneath. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5pVdWjCN81MKrjJ3CNmxA5k4bWnJn5vAVXcuR3zMdfA/1776646560899.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNn7e4ZgJ4aqDXMhtnTZi2rXSTR3iQgVpzb9a3xXtBk8Y/1776646560991.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) Then, to cover the inside and the bottom where there wasn’t enough fabric, my mum marked out two smaller curved rectangles for me, and I cut the fabric and stuck it to the cardboard. I then put one inside – I didn’t stick that one down – and placed the other one at the bottom, and that was it. It turned out really nice, and it’s great that it’s made of fabric and padded because my glasses already have some marks from the shelf – I sometimes don’t realise when I put them down – but now they won’t get scratched anymore. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZcV89HxKHaTee9PH58SJ1SV715LUaoDaCb3ztSJNNr1L/1776646561072.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZvuYiGN18QzcPZFwkEBk13gUXZBapJSp2oTxdMQFYXuR/1776646561157.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaWamHVXyUf4CLVWhEY1k9P9ptcmAzyhLFP4JxDbQC656/1776646686449.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXvReQqxatSS8WJEKdQZHDBh7nRKc8Vz18qRWbJBLi6jZ/1776646686535.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTv1anhcnkTxEW1PsC21UKenchD4j2na2dxn7Me2kDBjv/1776646561243.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYpfirfR4gQKNRz8BC3CFdtAxXSiqPsXkphRvvzLcKNr/1751323701197.png) I’m going to put that on the bedside table in my new bedroom, but in the meantime I’ll put it on the shelf by my bed. Well, friends, I hope you like this idea for storing your glasses, but you can also use it for other things. Thanks for reading my post. Bye for now ❤❤💕💕
![PicsArt_11-23-08.37.42.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/23zkpiQrPG4B2ZfFRgwU1v1td2GybzN5DFW2NVYSaDaUXJ5hwJKdnGAiYyGGw82s144rx.png)

body.title: De retorno al running
body.body:
![1000288586.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gchacin25/EqDk9S5RNMFQdttq2M5aa9Y7x4FtFp6T3cjtqeLLxRAV6Trh7o2cP5duW8ijGBdiyjf.jpg)

![1000288587.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gchacin25/Ensb3ZDQmDBCfsa2YiXDWR8cqpoC1cnZGsQAMCLTr4otBXNqVaot1EDcMNTezmJZkgu.jpg)

![1000288584.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gchacin25/EqfGKq5AZ4AUi3zfn4qXNBqzfZyTAqe5NRb5iGfCexUtCPd1suk9fmKnV9KaNUWDdDU.jpg)


---


Hola, querida comunidad running.

Después de un buen tiempo sin poder entrenar por motivos laborales, hoy decidí retomar la rutina de una manera especial. Fui al estadio acompañado de mi esposa y mi hija. Ha sido un regreso que me llenó de energía y emociones bonitas.

Al llegar, sentí esa mezcla de ganas y expectativa que todo runner conoce bien. Comencé a trotar recorriendo 5 kilómetros en forma progresiva, buscando encontrar el ritmo y la respiración que había extrañado. Lo más lindo de esta experiencia fue que mi hija me acompañó durante el primer kilómetro. Trotar con ella fue algo realmente hermoso; verla correr a mi lado, con esa sonrisa inocente y ese ánimo contagioso, me recordó por qué amo este deporte y cómo puede unirnos como familia.

Después de ese primer kilómetro juntos, continué con mi entrenamiento, enfocándome en mantener un buen ritmo y cuidar cada paso. Fue un momento en el que también pude reencontrarme conmigo mismo, con mis ganas y con la pasión que siempre he sentido por correr.

Terminada la carrera, la diversión no acabó ahí. Me puse a jugar voleibol con mi hija, y esa simple actividad llena de risas y saltos hizo que el día fuera aún más especial. Son esos pequeños instantes los que realmente importan: compartir tiempo de calidad, reír juntos y disfrutar del movimiento y la naturaleza.

Hoy me siento agradecido por poder combinar mi pasión por el running con la compañía de mi familia. Estas experiencias me recuerdan que más allá del esfuerzo físico, están los momentos humanos que nos motivan a seguir adelante, día tras día.


---

![1000288695.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gchacin25/Ep7v3is2ueVJmBrWikXWrbKdFe1PFSuXCRSAcQJMnYf63sA54ZPsMvGUmxGnsD8ZSc2.jpg)

![1000288576.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gchacin25/EnaZFcSDfQbR5cruQLxiMMDq86GeiUuC5AfwBBVmFrZLtHHsRbty5pPsYB4gvssvjbo.jpg)

![1000288585.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gchacin25/EnmBMte3AufwLh9HYJVCRkNLayBw2noyf5dCUtvwacDgJiEUTueMovy4Y8LeAwdMViS.jpg)

![1000288581.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gchacin25/Eq5EYswaqTaxVVJvdbn42avWmywCpCdV341W4pGrk6dLimfu3Mz7VgskFWNcqsztZBf.jpg)



---
 
Hello, dear running community.

After quite some time unable to train due to work commitments, today I decided to get back into my routine in a special way. I went to the stadium with my wife and daughter. It was a return that filled me with energy and wonderful emotions.

When I arrived, I felt that mix of eagerness and anticipation that every runner knows so well. I started jogging, gradually covering 5 kilometers, trying to find the rhythm and breathing I’d missed. The best part of this experience was that my daughter joined me for the first kilometer. Jogging with her was truly beautiful; seeing her run by my side, with that innocent smile and infectious enthusiasm, reminded me why I love this sport and how it can bring us together as a family.

After that first kilometer together, I continued my workout, focusing on maintaining a good pace and paying attention to every step. It was a moment when I was also able to reconnect with myself, with my enthusiasm, and with the passion I’ve always felt for running.

Once the run was over, the fun didn’t end there. I started playing volleyball with my daughter, and that simple activity filled with laughter and jumping made the day even more special. It’s those little moments that really matter: spending quality time together, laughing together, and enjoying movement and nature.

Today I feel grateful to be able to combine my passion for running with time spent with my family. These experiences remind me that beyond the physical effort

body.title: ‎The Sweet Lie of Revenge
body.body:
‎
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎While I was watching a movie, a line slipped through the noise and settled quietly in my chest: “Revenge is the purest form of justice.Thar line sounded powerful and almost poetic. The kind of sentence that makes pain feel justified and anger feel noble. But the more I sat with it, the more uneasy I became.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ2ts8XXmYY7HEMiHo9rpruWrgg3cg4XPbEm6nAgeoJZg/thedetonator-man-5694441_1920.jpg 

‎[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/man-model-portrait-fashion-style-5694441/)
‎
‎Because revenge has never felt pure if I’m being truthful with myself.
‎
‎There was a time I was deeply hurt and betrayed in a way that left me questioning my worth, my judgment and even my kindness. And revenge felt like the only language my pain could speak in that time. I have imagined scenarios where I would “balance the scale,” where the person who hurt me would feel went through exactly what I felt. It gave me a strange sense of control, like I was reclaiming something that had been taken away from me.
‎
‎But here is the truth I had to confront that  revenge didn’t heal me but it kept me tied to the very pain I wanted to let go of.
‎
‎Revenge can be seductive because it promises closure and it tells you that once you get even, your heart will finally be free from worries. But on the other hand, revenge sometimes does the opposite. It keeps the wound fresh and makes you relive the hurt, over and over again, until you started becoming someone you couldn't even recognize again.
‎
‎On the other hand, Justice feels total different. It’s not fueled by anger, but by fairness. Justice doesn’t need you to lose yourself before proving a point. And neither doesn’t ask you to carry bitterness like a badge of honor. True justice doesn’t destroy  but instead restores.
‎
‎And maybe that’s where the confusion is.
‎
‎Revenge feels so personal, it’s emotional, raw, and immediate. Justice is often slower, quieter, and less satisfying in the moment. But it’s also cleaner. It doesn’t leave dirts on your conscience and it doesn’t turn you into the very thing that hurt you.
‎
‎I have realised that sometimes the hardest thing to do is to walk away without retaliating. To choose silence when your heart is screaming and to let go when everything in you wants to hold on and fight back. But painful as it is in that space, there’s growth. There’s dignity. There’s peace.
‎
‎So, is revenge the purest form of justice?
‎
‎I don’t think so.
‎
‎Revenge is human. It’s emotional. It’s understandable. But it’s not pure at all. Because it’s messy, complicated, and sometimes self-destructive. Justice, even when it feels incomplete, is still the higher ground.
‎
‎And sometimes, the greatest form of justice isn’t getting even but it’s let's go, moving forward, healing, and refusing to let your pain define who you become.
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

body.title: Me mordio un perro primera vez que me pasa......Esp-Eng
body.body:
> Para todo como dicen hay una primera vez, pero si es bueno maravilloso, pero si no es asi, entonces no, como la que me paso a mi, que me mordio un perro, ya les cuento. Luego de la Semana Santa, que todo vuelve a la normalidad: estudios, trabajos, las rutinas de cada quien en lo que hace, la mia tambien como era la de ir al taller mecanico. Me reintegre el lunes, todo bien, pero cuando fui el martes, despues del desayuno, mi mama quedo en la casa, se sorprendio que regrese tan rapido, ella estaba desayunando. Se soprende de verme. Le cuento lo que me paso, fuimos al patio a lavarme a ver que tanto era la herida, pero al ver que si era mas o menos algo de cuidado, ella se cambio de ropa y nos fuimos al modulo de asistencia que gracias a Dios queda uno cerca y nos fuimos, yo asi mismo con mi ropa de mecanico.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSC8iXe6jb2M7pgYnoPLzH6HeJqSkKvrwynktJEPhaimh/image.png)

> Llegamos a la emergencia del modulo, estaba una vecina que es enfermera, nos dijo de ir a ponerme primero la vacuna antitetanica o toxoide, que es la que aplica en este tipo de casos. Listo la vacuna, regresamos a emergencia, para que me viera la medico de guardia, espere un momento porque ya estaban otras personas esperando, cuando pasamos, mi mama le conto lo que paso, me vio la herida, me indico unas pastillas y el tratamiento. No me pudieron hacer el primer lavado y cura ahi, porque aunque suene insolito, no tenian pero ni una gasa.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVagz93LzDFzcZxcFNzMxi9UvNZPuRQij6UBUDq6Nbn75/image.png)

> El perro en cuestion no se si es un perro de la calle que anda ambulante o si es un perro que tenga dueños y andaba por las calles. Que de verdad me sorprendio, ya habia pasado la avenida hacia el taller. Ya en la casa, mi mama llamo a una tia que trabaja en una farmacia para que nos diera precios de los mismos uno era un antibiotico que es para evitar algun tipo de infeccion: Cefadroxilo y un protector gastrico por el antibiotico: Esomeprazol, pero de este habia en la casa Omeprazol y tambien era bueno. Primero me lavo bien con cuidado como le dijeron con agua y jabon azul, varias veces, luego me secaba con una gasa, me ponia betadine, me limpiaba y luego me ponia una venda, para asi protegerme unos dias, evitar que me rozara con el pantalon o en la cama al dormir.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmctLhN9dtHUqXQsbPg1EkcZagSEgSvNjj7h4WZeGF2FiF/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPxZhXN7QXep42EdWVYm4JJ66y2sfHZ1kxgoKnPD21cQe/image.png)

> Pense que me iban a agarrar puntos, pero dijeron que mordedura de perros no se suturan por alguna infeccion, como tampoco era tan profunda, que luego poco a poco se ira cerrando. Tuve una semana de reposo, en esos dias llego mi hermana de su viaje, luego ella como futura enfermera hacia la cura, y me ponia una cremita que tambien ayudaba a cicatrizar ademas de ser antibiotico, ya luego no me ponian mas la venda, porque ya estaba secando, no estaba tan rojo. Ya me reintegre al taller, esta semana no tenia dolor, pero si tenia algo de temor de poder encontrar el perro de nuevo, que le dije a mi mama que me acompañara estos dias, que creen si lo vimos, pero estaba en la calle. Es decir no sabemos si tiene dueño, porque de tenerlo, ellos deben poner cuidado con su perro de no dejarlo tanto tiempo afuera, como de ayudar con el costo de las medicinas.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXcJWzKLh8WNo6TSWEFQPiHgaEzdgK3jLrLXx72VmZUhZ/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmby7rizSNEH396Hmvs6KJumrxSetCXCaFy5XnysgXdj9C/image.png)

> Las fotos tomadas con el celular de mi mama Samsung Galaxy A16. Portada editada en Canva. Trtaductor usado DeepL
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX4Smc1t6jhAdYiPsPeGPmX2JMqve8kSqgD4JhuaqwXre/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYX3W7Uq21v2vjmtcFY6Sp8pqs76t4r4bER7KRj2ivdXZ/image.png)

> As they say, there’s a first time for everything. If it’s good, it’s wonderful, but if not, then not so much—like what happened to me when I got bitten by a dog. I’ll tell you about it. After Holy Week, everything goes back to normal: school, work, everyone’s daily routines—mine included going to the auto shop. I went back on Monday, and everything was fine, but when I went on Tuesday after breakfast, my mom was still at home. She was surprised I came back so soon; she was having breakfast. She was surprised to see me. I told her what happened. We went out to the patio so I could wash up and see how bad the wound was, but when she saw that it was something that needed attention, she changed her clothes and we went to the first-aid station—thank God there’s one nearby—and we left, me still in my mechanic’s clothes.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSC8iXe6jb2M7pgYnoPLzH6HeJqSkKvrwynktJEPhaimh/image.png)

> We arrived at the clinic’s emergency room. A neighbor who is a nurse was there; she told us to go get the tetanus shot or toxoid first, which is what they administer in these kinds of cases. Once the shot was done, we went back to the ER so the on-call doctor could see me. I waited a moment because there were already other people waiting. When it was our turn, my mom told her what happened. She looked at my wound, prescribed some pills, and outlined the treatment. They couldn’t clean and dress the wound right there because, as strange as it sounds, they didn’t have a single piece of gauze.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVagz93LzDFzcZxcFNzMxi9UvNZPuRQij6UBUDq6Nbn75/image.png)

> I don’t know if the dog in question is a stray roaming the streets or if it’s a dog with owners that was just out walking. What really surprised me was that it had already crossed the avenue toward the workshop. Once home, my mom called an aunt who works at a pharmacy to get prices for the medications. One was an antibiotic to prevent infection: Cefadroxil, and a stomach protector to go with the antibiotic: Esomeprazole, but we already had Omeprazole at home, and that worked just as well. First, I washed it thoroughly and carefully, as they told me, with water and blue soap, several times. Then I dried it with gauze, applied Betadine, cleaned it again, and put on a bandage to protect it for a few days and prevent it from rubbing against my pants or the bed while I slept.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmctLhN9dtHUqXQsbPg1EkcZagSEgSvNjj7h4WZeGF2FiF/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPxZhXN7QXep42EdWVYm4JJ66y2sfHZ1kxgoKnPD21cQe/image.png)

> I thought they were going to give me stitches, but they said dog bites aren’t stitched up because of the risk of infection, and since it wasn’t that deep, it would gradually close on its own. I had a week of rest. During those days, my sister came back from her trip. Since she’s a nursing student, she took care of the wound and applied a cream that helped with healing and also had antibiotics. Later, they stopped putting the bandage on because it was drying up and wasn’t so red anymore. I’ve gone back to the workshop. This week I haven’t had any pain, but I was a little afraid of running into that dog again, so I asked my mom to come with me these days. Guess what? We saw it, but it was on the street. I mean, we don’t know if it has an owner, because if it does, they should keep a closer eye on their dog and not leave it outside for so long, and they should help cover the cost of the medicine.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXcJWzKLh8WNo6TSWEFQPiHgaEzdgK3jLrLXx72VmZUhZ/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmby7rizSNEH396Hmvs6KJumrxSetCXCaFy5XnysgXdj9C/image.png)

> Photos taken with my mom’s Samsung Galaxy A16 cell phone. Cover edited in Canva. Translated used DeepL.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ7KoeA5Bjw5zAFS5KR5GmE1XnkJu3iQbezNiXbAXhwd8/image.png)

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Nueva sesión de DIBUJO URBANO en un edificio muy peculiar/ New URBAN SKETCHING session at a very unique building.
body.body:
¡Hola, Comunidad de Hive! Hoy les comparto los resultados de una nueva sesión de dibujo urbano que tuve con mi grupo habitual de compañeros. El encuentro fue hoy, domingo 19 de abril, con la finalidad de dibujar el Edificio La Florida, uno de los más llamativos de la ciudad de Mérida. El primer ejercicio fue un dibujo de una hora y media de duración, para el cual usé un lápiz de grafito 2HB. 
.
Hello, Hive Community! Today I’m sharing the results of a new urban sketching session I had with my usual group of friends. The session took place today, Sunday, April 19, with the goal of sketching the La Florida Building, one of the most striking structures in the city of Mérida. The first exercise was a one-and-a-half-hour sketch, for which I used a 2HB graphite pencil. 
![P1120711.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcMmbmW9GNTnKiUEa7Zw11ztFcyWxqmsxHCaDsiqXbHpi/P1120711.JPG)

![IMG_20260419_141533_086.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYHNCf5sUdtBSAFAV5VcATH4NKoxUFac6eFKQRi2c7aT3/IMG_20260419_141533_086.jpg)
Después, pasamos adentro del edificio y dibujamos diferentes espacio del interior como pasillos o escaleras. A mí me llamó la atención una fuente en el centro de la planta baja, que a su vez conducía a varias escaleras y permitía una composición interesante. El dibujo me tomó unos 40 minutos. 
.
After that, we went inside the building and sketched various interior spaces, such as hallways and staircases. I was particularly struck by a fountain in the center of the ground floor, which led to several staircases and created an interesting composition. The sketch took me about 40 minutes. 
![P1120716.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWia1aoj8Y186u9pSSbEvVVMw1JL2duKSviV5wjqU7xw9/P1120716.JPG)

![IMG_20260419_141603_241.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf7jXNbKBLCNfPb2eUyRmXPVEz6JPGNkQRSk6mxwKAfnD/IMG_20260419_141603_241.jpg)
Eso fue todo por hoy. Pronto les compartiré más resultados de nuevas sesiones de dibujo urbano. Muchas gracias por leer.
.
That's all for today. I'll share more results from my latest urban sketching sessions soon. Thank you so much for reading.

body.body:

Сегодняшняя прогулка была просто замечательной! Я отправился в горы рано утром, когда воздух еще был свежим и прохладным. Встречая первые лучи солнца, я заметил, как природа просыпается: птицы пели свои утренние песни, а вокруг распускались цветы. По пути я встретил группу туристов, с которыми завязал разговор. Это были опытные любители горных походов, они рассказали мне о своих самых запоминающихся маршрутах и поделились советами по безопасному передвижению по трудным рельефам. Мы обсудили техники маскировки от дождя — они предложили несколько интересных лайфхаков. Также я оказался рядом с маленьким водопадом, который спускался по камням, издавая приятный звук, как будто сама природа мелодично играла. Я присел на камень, насладился этой красотой и поймал себя на мысли, как важно иногда просто остановиться и прислушаться к окружающему миру. Это была прекрасная прогулка, полная новых встреч и впечатлений! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.body:

## English 🇬🇧

One of the moments that moved me the most in Paris was visiting Père-Lachaise Cemetery, a place where history, art, memory, and human emotion seem to coexist in the same space. Seeing Jim Morrison’s grave in person was something special, not only because of the cultural weight it carries, but because of the atmosphere around it. Flowers, portraits, messages, and small offerings transform the grave into something more than a burial site. It feels like a living point of connection between generations, where admiration is preserved almost like a system that resists the natural tendency of time to erase details. In that sense, memory behaves almost like a conserved quantity: it changes form, but it does not disappear.  

As a Doctor in Chemical Engineering, I cannot help but look at places like this through a slightly different lens. Stone, metal, moisture, biological growth, and atmospheric exposure all leave visible marks on these structures, and yet what remains standing is not only the material, but also the symbolic value. The tombs, inscriptions, and sculptures are constantly undergoing physical transformation through weathering and aging, but their meaning is reinforced by the people who continue visiting them. That contrast fascinates me: matter deteriorates, but significance can become even stronger with time. It is a beautiful reminder that not every important process is measured only by what is lost; sometimes the most interesting phenomenon is what persists.  

The surroundings of the cemetery also left a strong impression on me. The old monument, the trees, the muted colors of the day, and the quiet pathways created an atmosphere that invited reflection rather than haste. There was a kind of calm that made me slow down and pay attention. In science, we often talk about observation before interpretation, and that is exactly how this place felt to me. Before trying to explain anything, I simply stood there and absorbed the textures, the silence, and the emotional weight of what I was seeing. Paris once again reminded me that travel is not only about moving across geography, but also about entering spaces where history and personal thought begin to interact.  

## Español 🇪🇸

Uno de los momentos que más me impactó en París fue visitar el **cementerio Père-Lachaise**, un lugar donde la historia, el arte, la memoria y la emoción humana parecen convivir en un mismo espacio. Ver en persona la tumba de **Jim Morrison** fue algo especial, no solo por el peso cultural que tiene, sino por la atmósfera que la rodea. Las flores, los retratos, los mensajes y las pequeñas ofrendas convierten ese sitio en algo más que una sepultura. Se siente como un punto vivo de conexión entre generaciones, donde la admiración se conserva casi como si fuera un sistema que se resiste a la tendencia natural del tiempo a borrar los detalles. En ese sentido, la memoria se comporta casi como una magnitud conservada: cambia de forma, pero no desaparece.  

Como Doctor en Ingeniería Química, no puedo evitar mirar lugares así desde una perspectiva un poco distinta. La piedra, el metal, la humedad, el crecimiento biológico y la exposición atmosférica dejan huellas visibles sobre estas estructuras, y aun así lo que permanece en pie no es solamente el material, sino también el valor simbólico. Las tumbas, las inscripciones y las esculturas están en transformación física constante por el desgaste y el envejecimiento, pero su significado se refuerza con las personas que siguen visitándolas. Ese contraste me parece fascinante: la materia se deteriora, pero el significado puede hacerse incluso más fuerte con el tiempo. Es un recordatorio muy bello de que no todo proceso importante se mide únicamente por lo que se pierde; a veces, el fenómeno más interesante es lo que logra permanecer.  

El entorno del cementerio también me dejó una impresión muy fuerte. El monumento antiguo, los árboles, los colores apagados del día y los senderos silenciosos creaban una atmósfera que invitaba más a la reflexión que a la prisa. Había una calma especial que me hizo detenerme y observar con atención. En ciencia muchas veces hablamos de observar antes de interpretar, y así se sintió este lugar para mí. Antes de intentar explicar algo, simplemente estuve ahí, absorbiendo las texturas, el silencio y el peso emocional de lo que estaba viendo. París me recordó una vez más que viajar no consiste solo en desplazarse por la geografía, sino también en entrar en espacios donde la historia y el pensamiento personal comienzan a dialogar.

body.title: Ccc art contest week 297|| Fast food mural
body.body: > Happy Sunday to the talented members of the great **Streetart** community. I wish all users the very best. It’s wonderful to be participating in week 296 of the [CCC Street Mural Contest]( https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@digi-me/ccc-s-street-art-contest-4acfedb32c962 ) This week I’m sharing a beautiful mural located on Cancamure Avenue in the city of Cumaná, Sucre. I was just heading into the sports center to work out with my friends when I spotted this mural that catches your eye from a distance. There are many fast-food kiosks there, and this one is called Area 51, featuring 3D designs of astronauts, spaceships, and UFOs. I take it that this food reaches beyond space. I took the last photo the other day when I found the restaurant open; someday I'll try their burgers. **Until the next adventure, friends.**

> >! [Spanish,Here]> Feliz Domingo a los talentosos miembros de la gran comunidad **Streetart**. Les deseo lo mejor a todos los usuarios. Es maravilloso participar en la semana 296 del [Concurso de murales callejeros del CCC]( https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@digi-me/ccc-s-street-art-contest-4acfedb32c962 ) Esta semana muestro un mural de un Está ubicado en la avenida Cancamure de la cuidad de Cumaná, Sucre. Justamente estaba entrando al polideportivo para entrenar con mis amigas, y vi este mural que de lejos llama la atención, allí hay muchos kiokos de ventas de comida rápida, y este se llama Area 51 con motivos de astronautas, nave espaciales y ovnis en 3 D , interpreto que esta comida llega hasta más allá del espacio. La foto final encontré al otro día el restaurante abierto, algún día probaré las hamburguesas. **Hasta la próxima aventura amigos.**

body.title: Torta de calabacín paso a paso 🥧
body.body:
![1000260109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/23wqiMVBoWfTZP4P92HK5LkAjoUeK4Szswx1avS7G2atHkbBjJYDATw36gDA2DcCze5av.jpg)

# Hola amigos! 

Estoy emocionada por contarles cómo me fue haciendo esta torta de calabacín la verdad es que fue interesante para mí porque no estoy acostumbrada a utilizar el horno Así que estoy como niña chiquita con juguete nuevo desde que comencé a utilizar el horno así que me puse a hacer esta torta Además de que tenía tiempo que no probaba esta receta y pues Por supuesto que busqué algunos videos en internet para recordar cómo era les voy contando aquí cómo me fue. 

![1000259265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/Eoc8VwjaZn6HgBSxy3A2Q3ceP2n36s7kkBfWM5UYWugdnCoz1AhyajeK7dswsrENP5o.jpg)

# Ingredientes

• 3 huevos
• 1 1/2 de azúcar 
• 1 taza de aceite (aprox)
• 3 tazas de azúcar
• 1/2 calabacín rallado
• 2 citas de levadura
• Polvo de canela al gusto
• 1 cdta. De sal
• Rarradura de la concha de un limón.

![1000259266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/Eos4eXB8bRXwLXFfovRDtpdu1ck3tZai4KTuy5mUJYZ6hAoarm3mAHbhXmPcsF8wrMh.jpg)

1. Lo primero que vamos a hacer es batir tres huevos en una taza más o menos grande yo lo batico un batidor de mano, si ustedes tienen un batidor eléctrico muchísimo mejor porque va a salir más espuma Luego de eso agregué el azúcar y después incorporé el aceite si tienen aceite de oliva mucho mejor porque es más saludable.

![1000259267.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/EpNsHWXimw3D9bc2dQnviobih4HjGRtKvHVTygFhaEN6MuJyEvjYGzAkwxan8Je5g56.jpg)

2. Una vez que los ingredientes húmedos ya están batidos es hora de ir agregando poco a poco los ingredientes secos que es la harina de trigo el polvo de canela el polvo de hornear y la ralladura del limón. A mí se me olvidó colocarle la ralladura de limón por lo que no quedó con el punto que quería así que no sé No se les olvide 🫣😅


![1000260043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/EouCzQFVsVASrQuLAZoSu17BtXjJHHCK9h6Frt6L1QHzX3379BXoGaSJksUyoA6FSw7.jpg)

3. Ahora bien pasamos a agregar el calabacín que rallamos previamente del lado grande del Rayo.

Incorporamos todo totalmente a mano súper fácil y ahora sí preparamos un molde juntándole aceite o margarina y luego un poco de harina de trigo. Mientras hacemos esto es importante Ya ir colocando el horno a calentar.

![1000260044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/Ep5r5JqJew2v9opxJtZQwW7AiExBUUxFdPHaFrijUzvRXp9nsunSaRJspNr5d3UD4uv.jpg)

Yo metí la torta a cocinar por unos 40 minutos aproximadamente como ya saben una manera simple para saber que la torta ya está lista es pinchándola con palito de espagueti o si no lo tienen pueden utilizar un cuchillo pequeño de cortar pan y si sale limpio entonces quiere decir que está listo.

![1000260070.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/EoeJL4JCxCcQCjLrUdwTY2qYh57GchxtL8VxbZj4DJU9vGCrhqebREDUczAcxbcuaue.jpg)

Deben tener paciencia al desenmoldar  su torta para que no se les rompa okay.Ahora cuéntenme aquí qué les pareció esta receta y si ya han probado antes una torta de calabacín nos vemos en el próximo post.

![1000260107.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/EokcDWyhKnmHW5jYmr1y7M5PjZYFfDegQ57fdrT8yawZMTjyN56Hxgc6tseezvVGE7C.jpg)

body.title: Freewrite || Shadow in the Mud
body.body:
![PSX_20260419_211531.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSLCAFxb53Ycq4AZfBw6ZzoG4fwBmxvmAKVHLAQt1p7pT/PSX_20260419_211531.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
That afternoon, the sun stood high overhead, reflecting harsh light onto the wet surface of the rice paddy. The stagnant water was no longer clear, but murky, mixed with soil and the remains of cut rice stalks. In the middle of the puddle, a shadow stood still, as if bearing witness to the long journey of the past planting season.

That shadow was me. There was no face, no color, just a dark silhouette that blended with the soil. But therein lay an unspoken story. Every step I had taken before, every bit of mud that clung to my feet, was all represented in that simple shadow.

This rice paddy isn't just a place to plant rice. It's a place to learn about patience, about waiting, and about accepting the results as they come. From the initial plowing, to planting, to protecting the plants from pests, everything takes time and perseverance. Nothing is instant here; everything is a process.

Seeing my own shadow in the mud made me think that life is like this too. Sometimes we feel dirty, tired, and insignificant. But in reality, we are undergoing an important process, even if the results aren't immediately visible.

The wind moved gently, making the water ripple slightly. The shadow swayed with it, as if alive and breathing. I smiled slightly, realizing that beneath this simplicity, there was a serenity that couldn't be bought.

The day might pass, the mud would dry, and the seasons would change. But the memory of this shadow in the middle of the rice field will remain, reminding me that every effort, no matter how small, always has meaning.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

body.title: Siendo precavido
body.body:
>

<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/23xedoKLUBnM6s2UWpV7sqSdxza5AUF2He6t4eRhn5MCG3kz7N3Rp1XbtAwLhB4kRs1eJ.png
<sub>Imagen propiedad de @lanzjoseg</sub>
</center>

Cuando pienso en automóviles de una pienso en mi papá, pues nunca he tenido un carro y a pesar de han pasado muchos años desde que mi padre no nos acompaña físicamente en este plano, siempre recuerdo lo delicado que era con su Malibú, no le tenía accesorios  lujos ni un color llamativo, pero siempre trataba de mantenerlo completamente funcional, con todos sus repuestos originales y por su puesto con buenos cauchos, además era un hombre muy precavido al conducir, fiel seguidor de las normas de tránsito por lo cual ni un rasguño tenía, pero como siempre nunca se está exento a sufrir algún imprevisto nunca podían faltar el su maletero sus herramientas y su caucho de repuesto.


<center>
https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png
</center>

Mi papá aun poco maniático con eso de los cauchos, siempre los revisaba y procuraba que estuviera en buen estado, en las muy pocas veces que llegó a tener un problema con algún caucho, obligándolo a colocar el caucho de repuesto en la calle se notaba muchísimo su incomodidad, el tener un caucho que no iba a la par con el resto parecía algo que no podía soportar por mucho tiempo, en este sentido pasado el tiempo de uso provisional para salir de la emergencia de una se ponía a planear comprar cauchos nuevos, no solo para reponer el averiado sino loa 4 cauchos, aunque los demás no presentaran ningún problema, él decía que lo hacía por precaución, sin embargo, para mí era más como una manía de no tener uno nuevo mientras que los otros no, con los años me he dado cuenta que me parezco mucho a mi papá y este tipo de “manías” las entiendo perfectamente 😊

<center>
https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png
</center>

body.title: Claude Opus 4.7: A Anthropic Entregou Seu Modelo Mais Capaz ao Público
body.body:
## O que mudou de verdade

Vamos começar pelo número que mais impressiona. Em um benchmark interno com 93 tarefas de engenharia de software, o Opus 4.7 resolveu 13% mais problemas do que o seu antecessor, o Opus 4.6. Isso não parece muito até você entender o que isso significa na prática: quatro tarefas que nenhum modelo anterior da Anthropic — nem o Opus 4.6, nem o Sonnet 4.6 — conseguia resolver, agora são resolvidas pelo 4.7.

É como um mecânico que antes resolvia 87 de cada 100 problemas no carro e agora resolve 100. Os 13 que faltavam não eram os fáceis.

## Enxergando em alta resolução

A segunda novidade é menos óbvia, mas igualmente importante. O Opus 4.7 processa imagens com até 2.576 pixels no lado longo. Isso é mais de três vezes a resolução que os modelos anteriores da Anthropic conseguiam trabalhar.

Por que isso importa? Porque muitas tarefas do mundo real envolvem imagens com detalhes finos: diagramas técnicos, prints de interfaces, planilhas fotografadas, capturas de tela de código. Quando o modelo não enxerga bem, ele adivinha. Quando enxerga em alta resolução, ele trabalha com o que está realmente ali.

## Mais controle sobre o esforço de raciocínio

Um detalhe técnico que vai interessar a quem usa a API: a Anthropic introduziu um novo nível de esforço chamado **xhigh**. Ele fica entre os níveis \

já existentes.

Na prática, é como um controle de velocidade mais fino. Antes você tinha marcha 3 e marcha 5. Agora tem a marcha 4. Dependendo da tarefa, você pode pedir mais raciocínio sem pagar pelo custo máximo. Para projetos que rodam centenas de chamadas por dia, essa granularidade representa economia real.

## Tarefas longas e autônomas

O terceiro pilar da atualização é comportamental: o Opus 4.7 foi treinado para manter consistência e rigor em tarefas que levam muito tempo para serem concluídas. Não estamos falando de uma pergunta e uma resposta. Estamos falando de sessões onde o modelo precisa planejar, executar, verificar seus próprios resultados e reportar — sem perder o fio da meada no meio do caminho.

Isso é especialmente relevante para fluxos de trabalho agentic, onde o modelo age como um agente autônomo que usa ferramentas, acessa arquivos, faz chamadas a APIs externas e toma decisões encadeadas. A Anthropic afirma que o 4.7 é mais cuidadoso em verificar seus próprios outputs antes de considerar uma tarefa concluída.

## Segurança e disponibilidade

Vale mencionar que o Opus 4.7 vem com proteções automáticas contra usos de alto risco em segurança cibernética. Qualquer solicitação que sinalize intenção de uso malicioso é bloqueada antes de ser processada.

O modelo está disponível na plataforma Claude, na API da Anthropic, no Amazon Bedrock, no Google Cloud Vertex AI e no Microsoft Foundry. O preço não mudou em relação ao Opus 4.6: US$ 5 por milhão de tokens de entrada e US$ 25 por milhão de tokens de saída.

## O que isso diz sobre a Anthropic

A empresa continua apostando em segurança e confiabilidade como diferenciais. O Opus 4.7 não é o modelo mais secreto ou mais poderoso que a Anthropic tem — internamente, existe o Claude Mythos, ainda em acesso restrito. Mas o que foi entregue ao público desta vez é substancial: mais resolução visual, mais precisão em código, mais controle para desenvolvedores, e um comportamento mais confiável em tarefas complexas.

Para quem trabalha com automação, desenvolvimento de software ou análise de documentos, o Opus 4.7 representa uma atualização que vale testar.

body.title: Los Antaños del Stadium [Esp-Eng]
body.body: > Presentamos la trayectoria de **Los Antaños del Estadium**, la agrupación que rescató la esencia de la Caracas festiva y la convirtió en un sello de identidad nacional.

> We present the trajectory of **Los Antaños del Estadium**, the group that rescued the essence of festive Caracas and turned it into a seal of national identity. -----
[English version below!](#english-version)
----- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AKWw2fkQPgNFpx3B3k8tpFij5xyghhgUPdjyGQfYyDbPoPBvEr8HcE9FpbZ5kSG.png) # Los Antaños del Estadium: Cronistas sonoros de la capital

> La agrupación **Los Antaños del Estadium** constituye la fuente directa de inspiración y enseñanza para todos los ensambles dedicados a la música cañonera en Venezuela. Fundada en 1946 por el maestro Jacobo Espinoza, el conjunto nació con la misión específica de animar los encuentros de béisbol en el desaparecido estadio de San Agustín, conocido como el **Cervecería Caracas**. En aquel recinto, la música se entrelazó con la pasión deportiva, creando un ambiente único donde los ritmos tradicionales de la ciudad servían de banda sonora para las hazañas del diamante y las celebraciones en las tribunas. El estilo y la instrumentación de **Los Antaños del Estadium** han consolidado un sello indiscutible que forma parte integral de la historia de Caracas. En la construcción de esta sonoridad, fue determinante la labor de **Aníbal Escobar**, quien como saxofonista de la agrupación durante más de 50 años, fue el responsable de crear el fraseo y el sonido característico que define al género cañonero. Su ejecución permitió rescatar géneros fundamentales como el merengue rucaneao, el pasodoble, la polca y el vals, otorgándoles una vigencia que ha recorrido toda la geografía nacional a través de décadas de presentaciones en radio, televisión y cine. Como justo reconocimiento a su labor de preservación y difusión de la música típica caraqueña, la agrupación fue declarada Patrimonio Cultural de Caracas. Tras el fallecimiento del fundador, sus hijos asumieron con rigor la continuidad del proyecto. **Enrique Espinoza** destacó como cantante y director general de la agrupación hasta su reciente fallecimiento, siendo el motor que mantuvo viva la estructura del conjunto. Por su parte, **Nicol Espinoza** ha sido la voz femenina de la orquesta desde sus primeros tiempos, aportando la elegancia y el matiz vocal característico que define el sonido de **Los Antaños del Estadium**. Hoy en día, la labor de la familia Espinoza y la influencia técnica de **Aníbal Escobar** permiten que la música cañonera siga resonando con la misma mística que en el estadio **Cervecería Caracas**. La agrupación sigue siendo la referencia obligatoria para entender la evolución de los ritmos populares urbanos, demostrando que la tradición posee una vigencia eterna cuando se cultiva con respeto. **Los Antaños del Estadium** representan el alma festiva de una ciudad que, a través de sus notas, se niega a olvidar sus raíces más alegres y auténticas. -----

>

### Los Antaños del Estadium: Sonic Chroniclers of the Capital

The group **Los Antaños del Estadium** constitutes the direct source of inspiration and teaching for all ensembles dedicated to \

music in Venezuela. Founded in 1946 by maestro Jacobo Espinoza, the ensemble was born with the specific mission of entertaining baseball games at the late San Agustín stadium, known as the **Cervecería Caracas**. In that venue, music intertwined with sporting passion, creating a unique atmosphere where the city's traditional rhythms served as the soundtrack for the diamond's feats and the celebrations in the stands.\n\nThe style and instrumentation of **Los Antaños del Estadium** have consolidated an indisputable seal that is an integral part of the history of Caracas. In the construction of this sound, the work of **Aníbal Escobar** was decisive; as the group's saxophonist for over 50 years, he was responsible for creating the phrasing and characteristic sound that defines the \
genre. His execution allowed for the rescue of fundamental genres such as \

pasodoble, polka, and waltz, granting them a relevance that has traveled across the national geography through decades of performances in radio, television, and cinema.

In fair recognition of their work in preserving and spreading typical Caracas music, the group was declared a Cultural Heritage of Caracas. After the founder's death, his children strictly assumed the project's continuity. **Enrique Espinoza** stood out as a singer and general director of the group until his recent passing, being the motor that kept the ensemble's structure alive. For her part, **Nicol Espinoza** has been the female voice of the orchestra since its early days, providing the elegance and characteristic vocal nuance that defines the sound of **Los Antaños del Estadium**.

Today, the work of the Espinoza family and the technical influence of **Aníbal Escobar** allow \

music to continue resonating with the same mystique as in the **Cervecería Caracas** stadium. The group remains the mandatory reference for understanding the evolution of urban popular rhythms, proving that tradition has eternal relevance when cultivated with respect. **Los Antaños del Estadium** represent the festive soul of a city that, through its notes, refuses to forget its most joyful and authentic roots. #

Hello everyone, I hope you’re all doing well. I’m delighted to be able to show you this new design I’ve created for a pair of medical trousers for my lovely mum. The pocket design is the part I’d like to show you.

Hola amigos, espero que se encuentren muy bien. Estoy feliz de poder mostrarles este nuevo diseño que hice de un pantalón medico para mi hermosa madre. El diseño de los bolsillos es la parte que quiero mostrarles.

Hice primero el corte de las piezas delanteras y de la zona trasera y luego marque y diseñé la forma de los bolsillos laterales superiores y la del bolsillo que va en la zona media del pantalon. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVGNcM9mn2RPXM35MbDaXy6DtBqvUzjaA9bFPvM1woc1E/image.png)

body.title: Pump Up the Volume Is One of the Most Underrated Films of the Nineties. A Bold, Honest, and Rebellious Classic. (1990)
body.body:
Released in 1990, Pump Up the Volume feels like a movie that was ahead of its time. It captures the frustration, isolation, and desire to be heard that defined a generation, and honestly still feels relevant today. It is not a flashy film, but it hits hard where it matters.

![IMG_0494.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVdbAg3vHx6BoPaGhi7vakuL4kcoM2cu527oS2CjWTEEK/IMG_0494.webp)

The film was written and directed by Allan Moyle, who brings a very raw and personal tone to the story. Moyle does not try to over polish anything. The movie feels honest, sometimes messy, but always real.

Christian Slater stars as Mark Hunter, a quiet high school student who struggles to connect with the people around him. Slater is perfect in the role. He brings a mix of sarcasm, intelligence, and vulnerability that makes Mark feel authentic.

At night, Mark becomes “Hard Harry,” an anonymous pirate radio host who broadcasts his thoughts and frustrations to anyone willing to listen. Through this alter ego, he says everything he cannot say during the day.

The plot follows how Hard Harry’s broadcasts begin to gain attention. Students start listening, relating to what he is saying, and slowly building a connection around his voice. At the same time, the school administration and local authorities begin trying to track him down.

Samantha Mathis plays Nora, a fellow student who begins to figure out Mark’s secret. Mathis brings a strong presence to the film and helps ground the story emotionally. Her connection with Mark adds another layer to the movie.

What makes Pump Up the Volume stand out is its message. It is about finding your voice and not being afraid to speak out, even when it feels like no one is listening. That message still hits just as hard today.

The film also deals with serious topics like depression, pressure, and the struggles of being young and misunderstood. It does not always offer easy answers, but it does not shy away from those issues either.

Christian Slater carries the movie with his performance. His voice as Hard Harry is confident and fearless, but when you see him as Mark, you understand how much he is holding inside.

The soundtrack is another major part of the film. The music helps set the tone and gives the movie even more personality. It perfectly fits the rebellious energy of the story.

Allan Moyle’s direction keeps everything focused on the characters and their emotions. The film never feels overly complicated. It is a simple story told in a very direct way.

There are several moments in the movie that stand out, especially the broadcasts where Hard Harry speaks openly about how he feels. Those scenes are what give the film its impact.

Pump Up the Volume may not have been a huge mainstream hit, but it has become a cult classic for a reason. People connect with it because it feels real.

It is one of those films that stays with you after it ends. It makes you think about your own voice and whether you are really being heard.

![IMG_0498.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbhpNTriGbeYYLfPF4k2MpZHLiWngHMjne3VGqMAuH9kt/IMG_0498.webp)

Pump Up the Volume remains an excellent film because it is honest, emotional, and fearless. It is a true classic that deserves more recognition.

body.title: Pushing myself to go!
body.body:
I haven't blogged for a couple of days.
I was visiting my McLean family.

Friday morning my client's husband called and told me to take the day off, again.
So that my friend was another long weekend for me!
I am happy to have a 3 day weekend.

I wasn't doing much, puttering around my house still in my robe.
My cousin asked earlier the week if I was coming out.
I was planning to but by the time Friday came, I wanted to stay home. 

My anxiety was creeping in.
I didn't feel like doing anything.
I just wanted to crawl back in bed, put the covers over my head and hide, from who or what, I don't know.
I didn't even tell @bradleyarrow that I was off.
I never ever did that before.
We don't hide anything from each other.
I was having a hard day.

My cousin called, she knew right away that I wasn't myself.
She asked what was wrong, I told her, sometimes I hide it but I told her.
Well now, she didn't take it with a grain of salt.
She gave me orders to pack my bag, get in my car and friggin' haul my ass out there.
She was serious, I didn't get a word in, No changing her mind.

So a quick shower, packed a bag, away I went.
When I got on the highway I called my supportive husband, I apologized for not calling him.
As always, it was no big deal. 
I love him so much.
I am not used to that kind of support.

I met 2 of my cousins and a friend in Stephenville at a local Inn.
It was wing night.
What a feed we had.
We ordered extra so we could take some home.
YUMMY!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23uFVuqZCudeM8WWVojubZSvdBE6FGBTq3F2cMDjBoPWmRfXuxozMtzepuGK5pfM6RrgU.png)


My friend and 1 cousin went on their way, my other cousin and I went to her house.
It was craft time {cricut}.
She had orders for 14 t-shirts.
Who did the designing? Me of course!
It took a lot of time and patience, but I love doing it!
I customized an apron for her boyfriend.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23x17JeUpVmR4uCuei7uTRxjzHGSa8n6BncssKKjY2tvPogwepKDeEkvw5dCosSxH8ryQ.png)

He loved it! 
He is on his weight lose journey.
So far he has 150 pounds gone!
You read it correctly, 150 pounds!

Later on we went to another cousins house and played darts till 3am!
My goodness, way pass my bedtime!
I don't remember the last time I stayed up that late! LOL

Saturday I went to my cousin's sons birthday 4th party!
It was fun!
Watching all of the little ones  play is so cute!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23y8oi4i5sa524MP86MAEwmxW2LSAf4GPpZQzS2G5Suob9hC2QWZjnhNNVohCpTSReYkw.png)

Opening up his gifts after the party, he is the one with the white shirt, turned back on!

After all it was all said and done, I was happy that I choose to move forward and go out there.
It isn't always easy to do so but I did it.
I am feeling refreshed, back home, at my happy place!

Good night and God bless🙏
Life is good!💗

body.title: 19 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3078: not so hot now
body.body:
/>

That moment when you realize your political strategy is not so hot now … Supervisor Bruce Franklin realized this moment as he and his fellow county supervisors watched Mayor Donald Lee Garner Jr. of Big Loft, VA – the county seat of Lofton County – calmly, confidently walk in.

This glorified bean counter was never supposed to be mayor, nursing a bad but politcally perfect marriage for the county bigwigs', depressed, drinking, but still high-functional in his work – very much so, because he still had the ability to control his drinking to get stuff done. Most people didn't even know he had a problem – so it was easy to put him into the succession for mayor, third in line. He would just be a functionary – no big deal, right?

But, lightning struck, politically – the mayor and vice mayor were caught on tape backing up the police corruption that would have led to mass murder if Ironwood Hamilton in Tinyville, VA hadn't figured it out and organized to stop it. That left Donald Lee Garner Jr. suddenly mayor, just as his marriage was dissolving. Kind of a bad time to be doing more than clocking in and clocking out.

But it was that Lee part … he moved back home with the Lees-of-the-mountain and found his strength again … and beside all that, Donald Lee Garner Sr. was also in city government, and perfectly incorruptible. Put those two core elements together in one man and end his alcohol use, and he might just get much stronger than expected.

Supervisor Franklin had watched it happen but stayed with the line of the more complacent of his fellows: they figured the mayor would revert to glorified bean counter and treated him as such. The first sign this was a mistake was how easily he had shaken his wife and her entire family loose – gotten his wife arrested and charged for the assault she made on him, had the rest of the family caught up on the various corrupt things they were doing.

Side note: the mayor's Lee cousin was “The Angel of Death,” Col. H.F. Lee, who had gone from captain of cold case to captain of Special Investigations and the Blue Ridge Precinct, and had been acting chief – though unofficially – since the aftermath of Hurricane Justicia. So, Mayor Garner had some backup in terms of finding old corruption. He was not using it as much as he could, but his wife's family had found out that, in the end, you need to have Grant somewhere in your name to be swatting at any Lee in Virginia and go unscathed!

The board of supervisors had no Grants either – in fact, no one had named their son Grant in Lofton County since 1865! Not that it really made a difference: Donald Lee Garner Jr. simply was no glorified bean counter, and the complacent supervisors had simply been wrong. He had emerged as the single most powerful politician in Lofton County after two hurricanes had shown the rest of county government up. Previous to this, the county board of supervisors had considered the mayor's office as secondary to the county seat that they held. That was over.

“Gentlemen, I do insist that we start on time – even with preparation for the previous hurricane, the affairs of this city require that I not divide my attention for too long.”

Nine men flinched – the complacent set – but made no retort as the head of the country board flushed with rage, but looked at the clock and picked up his gavel to call the meeting to order. In the chamber, Col. Henry “Light-Horse” Lee of Revolutionary War fame looked down in silent encouragement … but in profile, he also seemed to sit in the chamber itself, back in his power … from the side view, one at last knew the strength of the man one was dealing with in Donald Lee Garner Jr., the man who started as a glorified bean counter and got to the top of Lofton County, VA. The world had again turned upside down.
