body.title: Fundación vs Carlos Fuentes en El Torneo Apertura de 2da División
body.body:
> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @fulldeportes, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes la participación del equipo de Fundación en El Torneo Apertura de 2da División de Futsal, que se está desarrollando en la comunidad en la comunidad de Villa de Cura, municipio Zamora, estado Aragua. >Greetings to our friends at Hive and @fulldeportes. Today I’m going to share with you the Foundation team’s participation in the Second Division Futsal Opening Tournament, which is currently taking place in the community of Villa de Cura, in the municipality of Zamora, Aragua state. Fundación vs Carlos Fuentes en El Torneo Apertura de 2da División
![GridArt_20260419_193753498.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wCFixzeFRqDZ9g1bBSF7r5UGWdDN65dTpuu9HToJN59uUtswwx8bDfdLjGLmCDK6FB1.jpg) Cabe destacar que este torneo se está desarrollando desde el día viernes, sábado y domingo, en la cual Fundación participó los días viernes y también el sábado en las categorías Sub 14A, Sub 12A y Sub 10. El primer partido se inició a las 9:00 AM en donde se enfrentó la categoría Sub 14A de Fundación vs Carlos Fuentes, en la cancha del sector de Las Mercedes, en el primer tiempo Fundación estuvo atacando constantemente muy cerca de la portería, donde tuvo muchas oportunidades de concretar el pero estos fallaron. >It is worth noting that this tournament has been taking place over Friday, Saturday and Sunday, with Fundación competing on Friday and Saturday in the Under-14A, Under-12A and Under-10 categories. The first match kicked off at 9:00 am, featuring the Under-14A teams of Fundación and Carlos Fuentes at the Las Mercedes ground. In the first half, Fundación constantly attacked close to the goal, creating numerous chances to score, but failed to convert them. ![IMG_20260418_090955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23ycyGcUGC8dK1v3T9J6MSWQ2GbgjceZfPZiQjb7LrfwbRLS5wRWsGTALe5XykDDqGZZa.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_093037.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wC9VsmqPLDeAWqhR9HntUkofiY5sZcuFcCZBqhuuEPcAfsDYBqZA9udySnFjyCE2BgY.jpg) Asimismo, Fundación descuida la defensa el cual aprovechó el equipo rival para concretar el primer gol, luego Fundación empata 1 X 1, quedando el primer tiempo con este marcador. En el segundo tiempo el técnico Fundación, realizó algunos cambios de los titulares pero estos no jugaron con la misma intensidad y disminuyó la defensa y los ataques a la portería, donde el equipo de Carlos Fuentes aumentó el marcador a tres goles más, para perder Fundación 4 X 1. >Furthermore, Fundación were caught out in defence, which the opposition capitalised on to score the opening goal; Fundación then equalised to make it 1–1, and the first half ended with the score at 1–1. In the second half, the Fundación manager made some changes to the starting line-up, but the substitutes did not play with the same intensity, and both the defence and the attacks on goal weakened, allowing Carlos Fuentes’s team to add three more goals, resulting in a 4–1 defeat for Fundación. ![IMG_20260418_093052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23vsLXdhfvwzBTfNHe8ESEcHEdYN5TgTVqm1PxXakXGfqQvPKqhDzuKHi8umvp5NgjFWy.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_125008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xKzijzagffhEUx8QxfL9fLHtxHFHbNNxBDAqzrNWg6KZFfXThQotcsnTE66b264vWQF.jpg) Después pasaron a jugar la categoría Sub 12 de Fundación vs Orión, en el primer tiempo este partido estuvo muy cerrado, las dos delegaciones atacaban a la portería, pero la defensa no los dejaba avanzar, marcando el equipo rival un gol, pero luego Fundación logra empatar. Faltando pocos segundos para finalizar, Orión concreta su segundo gol, quedando el primer tiempo 2 X 1. En el segundo tiempo, Fundación mejoró la defensa y el equipo de Orión aumentar el marcador, pero Fundación pierde 2 X 1. >Next up was the Under-12 match between Fundación and Orión. The first half was a very tight affair, with both teams attacking the goal, but the defences preventing them from making headway. The opposition scored a goal, but Fundación then managed to equalise. With just a few seconds remaining, Orión scored their second goal, leaving the first half at 2–1. In the second half, Fundación improved their defence and Orión extended their lead, but Fundación lost 2–1. ![IMG_20260418_130840.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23ywqCNjAVNyxDEnbwm8n7cCaQdwMq4yij3ubtGCCQS2Ua823hxXcdQ629i6SagUuriwm.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_131230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23yJEKF5o4Lyc67mdhttWeEsv1be2gExpwP1LVXjZxNYMuDUF1U3EAXR2EFz3SYVUc3TV.jpg) Una vez se presentaron las categorías Sub 10 de Fundación vs Lideres de la parroquia de San Francisco de Asis, en el primer tiempo Fundación mantuvo el dominio de la pelota dentro de la cancha, para obtener cinco goles y ganar este tiempo. En el segundo tiempo el técnico hizo algunos cambios de los jugadores titulares para que participen y estos tuvieron una buena defensa pero no lograron aumentar el marcador, ganando Fundación con una amplia ventaja de 5 X 0. >In the Under-10s match between Fundación and Lideres from the parish of San Francisco de Asís, Fundación dominated possession in the first half, scoring five goals to win the half. In the second half, the manager made some changes to the starting line-up to give other players a chance to feature; they put up a good defensive display but were unable to add to the score, with Fundación winning by a comfortable margin of 5–0. ![IMG_20260418_124420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23zGgaoubTuPEEW78jFdTLJJ9kkpRoKenUf2R8CdUjvPVNWopFB5rqaVqHrFw1jcyDFp4.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_111248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xp8kyp5gtdhKHtfPjTSEnGp7vtKTzhmc5Sw3KTAn3q99kf2zUUwAJr1EZwhSVZrygG5.jpg) ![GridArt_20260419_194223619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23vYwzAUYcfQUVvuougiAiXFYmeBuUbzuBcTep3miuXb9Abgdw3Mirzn37wurszU72sS8.jpg) Para finalizar, en esta segunda jornada de juegos , Fundación de tres partidos solo ganó uno, que fue la categoría Sub 10, la cual ya lleva dos juegos ganados. >Finally, on this second day of games, Fundación only won one of three matches, which was the Under 10 category, which already has two wins. Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. body.title: Value Beyond What You Receive
body.body: There was a day I sat quietly and observed a conversation between two young people. It wasn’t loud, but the message was clear. Every moment, it was “give me data,” “send me airtime,” “I need this, I need that.”\n\n

> **It made me reflect deeply.** I began to ask myself when did relationships become all about receiving? When did we forget that we are also meant to give, to build, and to support? I’m not saying it’s wrong for someone to provide for you. In fact, it can be an expression of care. But when it becomes the only language in a relationship, something important is missing. Real connection goes beyond material things. It’s in encouragement, in thoughtful actions, in helping each other grow. Sometimes, value can be as simple as recommending a good book, speaking life into someone’s dreams, or standing by them when things are tough. I’ve come to understand that being a person of value is not about what you collect from others, but what you contribute. Are you building the person beside you, or just drawing from them?

>

In *friendships* and relationships, none of us should become a burden when we have the ability to be a blessing.

This is something I’m also learning daily to be intentional, to give more than I take, and to grow into someone who adds value wherever I go.
Because at the end of the day, the strongest bonds are not built on constant demands, but on mutual growth, respect, and purpose.

*Thanks for coming to my blog!*

body.body:
#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  
 
 
# <center> ✦ ***𝔓𝔒𝔑𝔗ℑ𝔄𝔑𝔄𝔎 ✦ 𝔅𝔢𝔰𝔱𝔦𝔞𝔯𝔦𝔬*** ✦</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmapyX9FCmAUSbzV3ebMAuewLTb4Xj7FXLPD4wLcWw6ruN/image_67ayufngofgtvne_1nufo.webp)


📸https://raphael.app/es 


Una bella mujer y su deseo de ser madre, Pontianak. Es un espíritu uno triste y lleno de terror, era una mujer, mortal y simple, que murió durante su embarazo, algunos dicen que justo antes de dar a luz. Un ritual para que su criatura no muriera la ató a este mundo, la dejó sin un lugar a donde ir.

Aun así quizás ese mismo ritual fue el causante de que a pesar, de no ser un demonio puro, sea tan poderoso, o quizás es simplemente el dolor emocional que supera el físico de la muerte, el dolor emocional de vivir en la pena del peregrinaje entre el mundo de los vivos y muertos, sin ver a su hijo.

Algunos datan su registro de hace más de 100 años en Malasia, ahí es muy temida, tanto que a muchos cadáveres se les clava en la nuca un clavo para evitar que se conviertan en un ser parecido.

De su piel sale un aroma peculiar como al de los jazmines de muerto, otros dicen que huele como a vinagre de manzanas descompuesto. A veces se anuncia a través del llanto de un bebé pequeño, un llanto que cambia de dirección repentinamente, un llanto que altera a los perros haciéndolos aullar de una forma poco común, primero tres aullidos cortos seguidos de un silencio largo y otra vez los tres aullidos cortos.

Algunos hablan sobre su belleza, como su mejor rasgo, una belleza que solo atrae a los hombres infieles y a los padres ausentes, sus uñas son largas, sus ojos son rojos, pero su sonrisa es cálida y plácida. Algunos dice que solo siente envidia de las mujeres que han quedado embarazadas.

Este espíritu tiene varias debilidades registradas, una de ellas es  que no puede entrar a una casa sin ser invitada, pero aun así, tiene la habilidad de cambiar su voz por la de cualquier ser querido, para provocar el engaño.

# <center> ✦ ***𝚃𝚞 𝙰𝚛𝚘𝚖𝚊 𝙽𝚘 𝙼𝚒𝚎𝚗𝚝𝚎*** ✦</center> 



Marcus olió algo en el aire aquella noche un aroma como de flores mustias, era martes y eran las 3 y 17 de la madrugada, no había árbol o jardín en aquella desolada calle. Marcus había bajado a fumar un cigarillo, mientras su esposa Sofía dormía plácidamente, mientras en el vientre cargaba a su hijo de ocho meses. El vientre de Sofía era grande y cálido, una futura madre llena de vida y llena de salud.

Junto a la llama del cigarrillo de Marcus se quemaba también un secreto, hacía 5 meses que le era infiel a su esposa, había conocido a aquella joven una tarde de domingo, mientras paseaba a sus perros. Comenzó como encuentros casuales, de amigos, un beso robada, la pasión furtiva. El romance embriagaba los deseos de Marcus, pero a la vez lo atormentaba con constante miedo a ser descubierto.

Hasta aquí, hasta hoy- le escribió Marcus a su joven amante en un mensaje y presionó el enviar, entonces sacó otro cigarillo, y lo encendió esperando la respuesta en su teléfono. El humo del cigarrillo y el aroma en el aire a pétalos mustios hizo que Marcus sintiera revoltura en su estómago y se mareara, a punto de perder la conciencia por un instante.

-Necesito hablar contigo, o le contaré todo a tu mujer -una voz familiar hizo que Marcus recobrara la compostura.

Ante él estaba en las sombras su amante, con el rostro apenas visible por la oscuridad de la noche.
-No hay nada que hablar, te lo dejé claro en el mensaje.
-Si no hablamos gritaré, despertaré a todo el vecindario, despertaré a tu mujer
-Está bien pero pasa a dentro de la casa

Marcus vio como su amante lo atravesaba, Marcus vio como el olor lo envolvía todo, hasta que despertó a la mañana siguiente en la mirilla de un policía, frente a su casa, una cinta amarilla cruzaba la puerta.

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

# <center> ✦ ***𝔓𝔒𝔑𝔗ℑ𝔄𝔑𝔄𝔎 ✦ 𝔅𝔢𝔰𝔱𝔦𝔞𝔯𝔶*** ✦</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmapyX9FCmAUSbzV3ebMAuewLTb4Xj7FXLPD4wLcWw6ruN/image_67ayufngofgtvne_1nufo.webp)


📸https://raphael.app/es 


A beautiful woman and her longing to be a mother: Pontianak. She is a sad and terrifying spirit, a mortal and simple woman who died during her pregnancy, some say just before giving birth. A ritual to prevent her child from dying bound her to this world, leaving her with nowhere to go.

Even so, perhaps that same ritual is what makes her so powerful, despite not being a pure demon. Or perhaps it is simply the emotional pain that surpasses the physical pain of death, the emotional anguish of living in the sorrow of wandering between the world of the living and the dead, without seeing her child.

Some trace her origins back more than 100 years in Malaysia, where she is greatly feared. So much so that many corpses have a nail driven into the back of their necks to prevent them from transforming into a being similar to her.

Her skin emits a peculiar scent, like that of jasmine blossoms; others say it smells like spoiled apple cider vinegar. Sometimes it announces itself through the cry of a small baby, a cry that suddenly changes direction, a cry that disturbs dogs, making them howl in an unusual way: first three short howls followed by a long silence, and then the three short howls again.

Some speak of its beauty as its best feature, a beauty that only attracts unfaithful men and absent fathers. Its nails are long, its eyes are red, but its smile is warm and serene. Some say it only envies women who have become pregnant.

This spirit has several recorded weaknesses. One is that it cannot enter a house uninvited, but even so, it has the ability to change its voice to that of any loved one, to cause deception.

# <center> ✦ ***𝚈𝚘𝚞𝚛 𝚜𝚌𝚎𝚗𝚝 𝚍𝚘𝚎𝚜𝚗'𝚝 𝚕𝚒𝚎*** ✦</center> 



Marcus smelled something in the air that night, a scent like withered flowers. It was Tuesday, 3:17 a.m., and there wasn't a tree or a garden on that desolate street. Marcus had gone downstairs to smoke a cigarette while his wife, Sofia, slept peacefully, carrying their eight-month-old son. Sofia's belly was large and warm, a mother-to-be full of life and health.

Along with the flame of Marcus's cigarette, a secret was also burning. He had been unfaithful to his wife for five months. He had met this young woman one Sunday afternoon while walking his dogs. It began as casual encounters, like friends, a stolen kiss, furtive passion. The romance intoxicated Marcus's desires, but at the same time tormented him with the constant fear of being discovered.

\

Marcus wrote to his young lover in a message and pressed send. Then he took out another cigarette and lit it, waiting for a reply on his phone. The cigarette smoke and the scent of withered petals in the air made Marcus feel nauseous and dizzy, almost fainting for a moment.\n\n\

a familiar voice said, bringing Marcus back to his senses.

Before him stood his lover in the shadows, his face barely visible in the darkness of the night.

\

Marcus watched as his lover walked through the door. Marcus felt the scent envelop him, until he woke up the next morning looking into a police officer's peephole, across from his house. Yellow tape stretched across the door.

body.title: Buying My First Packs in Splinterlands and Explaining the Packs in Rising Star Game
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbKxGqa2PA5Dk7vKuTNTRRCrnpr2fnbQ9w2A1QzYbfE4X/pack.png</center>

## Splinterlands

In my other posts I mentioned that I started my journey in Splinterlands and I'm currently playing the Frontier Format because, in my opinion, it's a great way for a newcomer to learn about battles.

Another interesting advantage of the Frontier Format is that you can start earning money in the game without spending money buying or renting cards, but you still need to buy the Spellbook.

If you're curious about the Frontier Format, then I recommend you read my two posts below.

-

-

Since my focus is the Frontier Format, I need Foundation Cards, and for that reason, today I decided to open my first pack in Splinterlands.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcoULM9bQY8RX19qTT84SvfdTqGpQR6bM6cJRbX1yuMex/d.png</center>

To find the available packs in Splinterlands, you need to go to the Card Packs option on the Splinterlands website.

There are several Card Pack options, but what I'm looking for are Foundation Cards, and for that reason, I'm going to buy Foundation packs.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYykqryjpgMuYP7ryvzTxxJ3yAkxrsNoA3s7QEJ2f9VMF/dd.png</center>

In Splinterlands, you can buy packs with Credits or with DEC. This is good news because I can start spending the 3000 Credits I received after buying the Spellbook.

I'm going to buy 3 packs, and each pack costs 39 Credits, so in total that will cost me 117 Credits. I still have a lot of Credits left, but I don't want to spend them all quickly because I'm still discovering various things about Splinterlands.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeam9trNYJq817tJh3VUkP7VwqyB3TmvAAd7gYH3D3R3H/ddd.png</center>

Each pack in Splinterlands has 5 cards, so I'll receive 15 cards opening the 3 Foundation packs.

I don't usually have luck opening packs in other games, but let's see if I'll have luck in Splinterlands.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSWMrvGeG3a7eEDykbBVQrRbN39LuWQQjhaiEbB4cWLJp/dddd.png</center>

I still don't know much about Splinterlands to know if these cards are good, so only time will tell because I'll be testing them in battles.

When I reach the Gold league in the Frontier format, I'll start earning Foundation packs, and that will be great for making money in the game or evolving my current Foundation Cards.

Rising Star Game

I haven't reached level 10 in Rising Star Game yet, but it won't be long before that happens. After reaching level 10, I'll be able to buy packs and then I'll try my luck in Rising Star Game as well.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmShFzxNZGZvTr1sSYKVfEriwqCH58MjpXVVuWiTcdSafc/ddddd.png</center>

The first 100 packs cost 10,000 STARBITS, and after that, they start costing 20,000 STARBITS. Considering the prices of cards in Rising Star Game, this isn't a bad price, and packs will probably be my main way of getting Fans in Rising Star Game, but I'll still continue buying cards on the market when they're at a good price.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@arkartus/buying-my-first-packs-in-splinterlands-and-explaining-the-packs-in-rising-star-game-jhj)

body.title: 說走就走的魚丸夢，嚇出一身冷汗的兄弟情
body.body:
人生如夢，這句話聽起來老掉牙，但對拉叔而言，昨晚那場夢境卻真實得連那股新車的皮革味都還鑽在鼻尖。

故事要從三個老男人說起。我、阿倫、阿傑，咱們三人的交情若要細算，那是橫跨了三十幾載的漫長歲月。回想起升中那會兒，咱們就是形影不離的鐵三角，一起熬夜應付那枯燥的補習班，一起在情竇初開的年紀去泡妞，結果當然是排隊「吃檸檬」，被拒絕後的酸爽滋味，至今想起還能相視大笑。高中畢業後，大家奔向不同的象牙塔，學習領域南轅北轍，見面的機會確實像某些政客的承諾一樣，越來越稀缺。

踏入社會這口大染缸，大家各自打拼，但拉叔慶幸這份兄弟情還沒被生活磨得面目全非。逢年過節的信息從不缺席，偶爾抽個空喝杯茶、吹吹牛，在這人情薄如紙的年代，這份三十年的情分，算是不錯了。

這一年，拉叔換了新坐騎。雖然不是什麼百萬超跑，但那輛國二藍的 Perodua Bezza 閃閃發亮，看著就順眼。趁著興致，我們三人決定搞一次「男人浪漫之旅」，目標鎖定玲瓏（Lenggong）。聽說香港影星阿燦在那裡開了家飯店，那裡的西刀魚丸名震江湖，說什麼也得去朝聖一番。

難得家裡的「母老虎」不在身邊盯梢，我們這幾個中年大男孩擠在 Bezza 裡，一路上有說有笑。車窗外的風景疾馳而過，車廂內卻彷彿時光倒流，回到了那個無憂無慮、不必為了五斗米折腰的少年時代。幾百公里的路途，聊天也會有詞窮的時候，於是拉叔順手扭開音響，讓動感的節奏填充空氣，載著這份情誼繼續奔向魚丸的懷抱。

就在前方即將跨過那條通往玲瓏市區的大橋時，後座的阿倫正刷著手機，突然神色大變，失聲喊道：「小心！新聞說昨天的暴風雨導致橋塌……」

話音未落，拉叔的瞳孔猛地收縮。視線盡頭，那座橋竟然真的憑空「消失」了！情況危急得讓人心跳漏了半拍。這輛 Bezza 雖然配有 ABS 防鎖死煞車系統，但以此刻的車速，拉叔心裡有數，即便把煞車踩到底，恐怕最後的結局也是在橋底下跟西刀魚打招呼。

關鍵時刻，我那隱藏已久的「前業餘賽車手」靈魂瞬間覺醒。這種生死關頭，唯有「J-Turn」能救命。拉叔猛地一打方向盤，手臂肌肉緊繃，另一隻手狠拉手煞車。車子發出一聲刺耳的輪胎慘叫，整個車身在斷橋邊緣劃出一道驚險的弧線，猛地甩尾掉頭。

然而，慣性是殘酷的。車速實在太快，雖然車頭轉了過來，但後輪卻因為收不住勢，硬生生地陷進了斷橋的懸崖邊緣。

「阿倫！」拉叔回頭大喊，心涼了半截。

只見左後方的車門赫然敞開，門外就是波濤洶湧的河流。剛才那記劇烈的甩尾，竟然直接把阿倫甩出了車外！我跟阿傑目眥欲裂，瘋狂地哭喊著阿倫的名字，淚水差點模糊了視線。但我們不敢動，因為車子後半部懸空在斷崖，稍微一點大幅度的晃動，前輪就會失去最後的抓地力，咱們倆連同這輛新車都得去給阿倫陪葬。

「阿傑，冷靜點！聽我說！」我咬著牙，強迫自己鎮定下來。

我們倆迅速商量出對策。我掛好擋位，含著離合器，我們兩人的身體開始有節奏地往前晃動，藉此將重量轉移到車頭，同時半離合加大油門，利用輪胎瞬間的下壓力尋找轉機。

「一、二、三，晃！」

每一次身體的前傾，輪胎就抓地多一分。在引擎的咆哮和我們倆的努力下，車子一點一點地往「岸」上蹭。最後一腳重油，Bezza 終於發出一聲解脫般的低吼，徹底駛離了那個鬼門關般的斷橋邊緣。

我跟阿傑癱坐在座位上，大口喘著粗氣，驚魂未定。

「辛苦了兩位。」一聲熟悉的、慢條斯理的聲音從車窗外傳來。

拉叔猛地轉頭，阿倫正拍著衣服上的灰塵，好端端地站在車旁。

「咦？！阿倫！你沒死！」我們倆激動得差點跳起來，又是哭又是笑，手舞足蹈得像兩個瘋子。

阿倫翻了個白眼，沒好氣地說：「死你們的頭啦！這斷橋離河岸也才兩尺高。剛才甩尾的時候，我是看準時機開門跳下車的……」

拉叔愣住了，隨即一陣狂笑響徹玲瓏的郊外。這場驚心動魄的魚丸之旅，雖然沒見著阿燦，但這份在生死邊緣走一遭的兄弟情，值了。

夢醒時分，拉叔摸了摸後腦勺，笑了。人生嘛，有時候就像這斷橋，看似絕路，只要兄弟還在，總能晃著晃著就上岸了。

<center>
![farmer-1367104_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23tmFnjR3rSCvbaUHYtR2K2cqce6mEsmUujiVmZ9zVnywocscJcCP9EotvreckCforZd9.jpg)
 [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/farmer-plantation-manual-work-1367104/)</center>

<hr>

For some reason, the sun beat down mercilessly on the small village of San Cristóbal. For months, an endless drought had turned the green fields into lifeless wastelands. 

The farmers worked with tired, sunburned faces under the scorching sun, gazing at the clear sky in search of storm clouds, a miracle that would extinguish the intense heat suffocating their crops.

Fed up with this agony, the farmers decided to gather in the town square. They built a rustic altar out of dry branches and called upon the ancient rain god for help. 

They raised their voices in desperate prayers, begging for a torrential downpour to save the crops on their land. The echo of their chants reverberated through the parched valley, fading into the horizon.

Suddenly, the sky clouded over until it turned gray. A cool breeze swept away the stifling heat, bringing with it the unmistakable scent of wet earth. 

Thunder rumbled like a drum, and immediately, the sky broke open. A torrential downpour fell upon the village, soaking the farmers who wept with joy; the oppressive heat vanished, and everyone gave thanks to the rain god.

**“Atrás” está bien elegido**, y tu nota sobre **“volver” + “atrás”** también da en el clavo: *volver* ya implica regreso, pero **“atrás” añade énfasis o dirección más explícita**. En uso real, **“vuelve”** y **“vuelve atrás”** pueden funcionar, pero la segunda suena más marcada, más visual, casi como “go back/backwards”. La diferencia entre **posición** y **movimiento** también es clave: *atrás* suele ir muy bien con idea de retroceso, mientras *detrás* suele pedir complemento: “detrás de la casa” ([ThoughtCo](https://www.thoughtco.com/atras-or-detras-3079142)).

La imagen además ayuda bastante porque aterriza el sentido de inmediato: **back / go back / ¡vuelve atrás!**. Ese formato trilingüe sigue siendo una buena jugada para aprendizaje comparado; le da al lector una entrada visual y otra contextual, no solo una definición seca.

Tu serie sigue muy consistente. También conecta bien con la anterior sobre **“patio”** en [A Daily Word in Spanish #377](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-spanish-377-mo4yraqkd8347227), así que ya se nota el ritmo diario del proyecto.

En tu línea de publicaciones, este tipo de palabra funciona porque es **corta, útil y engañosamente simple**: parece fácil, pero abre matices reales de uso. Eso siempre da buen material para aprender de verdad, no solo memorizar vocabulario.

La alarma sonó a las 5:00 am y mi cerebro ya programado y emocionado por volver a correr, una semana sin correr se me hizo eterna y hasta incómodo dormir ya que creo que mi cuerpo esta adaptado a ese cansancio extra de la semana, pero estuve de reposo esta semana ya que me resfríé el domingo pasado y me moje con lluvia el martes asi que era inevitable ya estaba envuelta en una gripe. 

Fui a correr con @lpgrunners donde tenian programadas rutas de 11 kilómetros, 16 kilómetros y 19 kilómetros, yo estaba un poco indecisa sin embargo salimos a correr y decidiría la distancia en la ruta de acuerdo a mi estado físico, aunque ya 19 kilómetros estaba descartado porque no podía saltar de hacer el domingo pasado solo 6 kilómetros en montaña a realizar 19 kilómetros esta semana sin haber entrenado nada en la semana, un perfecto ejemplo de lo que no se debe hacer. 

Para el kilómetro 6 me sentía super bien, así que allí el retorno de la ruta de 11 kilómetros había quedado atrás, ya estaba rumbo a los 16 kilómetros, al llegar a los 8 kilómetros que fue en ascenso, venía el retorno y me sentí genial, la ruta hacía Plaza Las Americas es una ruta exigente y la hice excelente. 

Sentí cansancio en el kilómetro 14 porque el sol me pegaba de frente en la Avenida Francisco de Miranda, pero finalmente llegué a la Plaza Los Palos Grandes feliz de haber realizado 16 kilómetros. 

### Seguimos sumando kilómetros de salud y bienestar 

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@erilej/retomando-un-domingo)

body.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260417_101528038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhuMDYnktyqkdU1pNx8UjukyCHH2PwvDLD1iUnHe43gVNHKJVWyxdX8oZfg9H6Y6Cgh.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 23.73% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.061 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 1.006 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.02958884 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.07398606 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00126256 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.125303 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.125303 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 74,734.4 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.125303 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 54.625 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,831.00 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 80.83 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #131 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#103 (among active witnesses only)/449.6k HP in votes/46 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 My recent techie adventures in converting/migrating the first of my three separate Arch Linux installations to Artix Linux has taken me down several technological rabbit holes, first into figuring out how to get user services that had previously worked under systemd to function again using the dinit init system, and then deeper into exploring how to run user services at a simpler and more basic level using BASH code and .xinitrc, which (*along with a very interesting conversation with my jungle neighbor Jyoti about locally-run AI agents, which he's been using*) led me into exploring and finding ways to use locally-installed FOSS (*Free and Open-Source Software*) AI agents for issue troubleshooting and resolution, and maintaince and optimization, on my laptop. As of last night, I've been jumping into exploring docker and then podman, which are one of the simplest ways to install, test, switch, and run, various AI models, via pods and containers. Needless to say, my brain is smoking again. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_145333457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xehxE7csvFRETHbEQCrnA91oiiuHF2j4S7nusHgUiitjTFnqHBnsEnuWiqRUauvu7xz.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_145452327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvitvjJo7ZK5fw5DWN44SDPSBqZ1txR6qq7ybmqntFLG1vxZwtdXbx8BYc4tW8v7A3Y.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Containers are totally isolated and self-contained containerized applications that have all necessary dependencies included, which means that they can run in the same way on any system, using any OS. Pods are inspired by Kubernetes, and they are meta-containers which hold groups of containers that work together, and share communication and resources, as part of a greater functional system. So containers are the basic building blocks, and pods the higher-level systems that can be built with them. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_145638303.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2m8odM5nmwbYRFVaBgnuFqL2raraMyiCSjqNXtrvcDcU4qM7Q6AknUj49e3vRdJ7hi.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_145847651.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2h3FkuhDEy13B9QHKWyprJsU3WDxp9a4Wmz52ykWcT39wEzzcVPko92ajM6KJox2gZ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I still have issues with user services to resolve with dinit, but that's momentarily on hold to explore and understand these new tech layers and domains, because I'm sensing a huge potential here to be able to create and set up some pretty incredible things on my computer, especially with the assistance of onboard locally-installed and run AI Agents. This potential exists not only with what I'll be able to integrate into a larger functional system using assorted useful components, but also with what new implementations that I will be able to create and build myself. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_150026944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWy7BrLNF6PqzCCzfChk2NJ6wVnpZgAy7bokwDYEGpA1anYFh5hJSmMTwqVrTDYGyxU.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_150140883.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tbyMNP3P9HbUMt9nKhi21GfVN9EHbYTXnygEB34TGH7e5PUFaMxATvBMJUGYJCSdvmg.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I won't be using any commercial cloud-based AI models with paid subscription plans, opting instead to set up those that are free and open source, that I control, and that I can configure, myself, without any of my data being sent to a corporation. The possibility of being able optimize and maintain my Arch/Artix Linux installations, and to create new software and software infrastructure and frameworks for them, is quite exciting I must say. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_150447524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tbrpVtG7FLDcW2LYX9qrZQWJVyMcjd2eQd6f9HjTWBMsUFHMRH8XY47abPuFQtgprAG.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_150521409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFU9hmKFiyrGMboh4F68GWvxjEGzcNVR9QaeUTwp4Z55mTBKTXLuE926tQNoGYhbYcg.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Since I'm planning to port and implement this pod-and-container-based AI framework, once I've successfully set it up on my first system, into my other two Arch Linux installations, it's essential to keep things as simple, easy, and modular as possible, which is exactly why pods and containers are so useful, because they make this an easeful process. Yep, my brain is fried, but I'm learning a whole lot, and even though I haven't gotten everything up and running successfully just yet, I have no doubt that I will soon. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_150620672.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u69Y3YbidmRXNfifhRrE3VoELobXoaetPFLEovL8iWen6Di6Tpowty629nnWb5bJmqE.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_150644798.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2m3Wqf7p4d1MUyYNPqs58nDYtoSUgZRD4C8BvEcbgGRaebjnJgQmMS2iYXnVwVyDSU.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Saturday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by around 2:30PM, giving my attention first to some photography for my posts, and then to a few small jungle-community tasks, including scouring the property for harvestable bananas (*I found 3 racks*). With that completed, I turned on the generator, made myself some food on Wabisabi, and with that and my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee in hands, I headed back to the Flow House, to begin my evening Hive tasks. I got everything done my around 10:30PM, and after some asset management, and researching locally-installed AI agents/docker/podman, I went to bed so very late, by about 1:30AM. I woke up just after 7AM, still feeling that I needed more sleep, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to write this post. It's now just after 1:45PM, so it's an excellent time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my numerous Sunday Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on a few small jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's expression of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_150918034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWs6cZD2QkYdDnM4CZqWvaxe26qyFyk3eoRxcKufArzpSK514P8H169TxG1oB4u1p5G.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_151005413.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23yTdGVwuRVs3s5yHj45bZGKwo1FUHoFiSBi7u3APNZcXmi5QKrHoaHUH2EGjJjhRhZYU.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Do regular integral practices again, alone or with others. 2.) Prepare regular batches of my medicinal teas collected from the land again. 3.) Make my plant nursery, and the gardens, beautiful again. 4.) Begin learning relevant coding/programming languages to more fully contribute to the sovereignty-driven technologies where I am active, like Arch Linux, Hive, Qortal, DeSo, and Bastyon. ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) *All photos were taken with my **Motorola G Play 2024 Android Phone**.* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) Thank you all so much who have helped me get to where I am today, and allowing me to share more of the beauty and magic from my life and my world with you, and for your continuous appreciation and support! body.title: Getting back to my tennis and swimming routine😜[ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![5ig4gi1brjE1B1BH_1000537770.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/5ig4gi1brjE1B1BH_1000537770/5ig4gi1brjE1B1BH_1000537770.webp) ![dhLTmJ5klvbWyNEQ_1000537115.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/dhLTmJ5klvbWyNEQ_1000537115/dhLTmJ5klvbWyNEQ_1000537115.webp) ![rok4BKmvBYMN52KA_1000537114.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/rok4BKmvBYMN52KA_1000537114/rok4BKmvBYMN52KA_1000537114.webp) ![8yn7czvOn7pa6Mb7_1000537116.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/8yn7czvOn7pa6Mb7_1000537116/8yn7czvOn7pa6Mb7_1000537116.webp) ![TXZax26FEbXkzbtO_1000537104.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/TXZax26FEbXkzbtO_1000537104/TXZax26FEbXkzbtO_1000537104.webp) ![u4sU7NqKIrc2cQ6O_1000537757.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/u4sU7NqKIrc2cQ6O_1000537757/u4sU7NqKIrc2cQ6O_1000537757.webp) ![4q9eBnir0KrVN37M_1000537018.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/4q9eBnir0KrVN37M_1000537018/4q9eBnir0KrVN37M_1000537018.webp) ![oVWmYQ3DXnmJUkmE_1000537059.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/oVWmYQ3DXnmJUkmE_1000537059/oVWmYQ3DXnmJUkmE_1000537059.webp)
¡Hola, amigos! Quizá no lo sepan, pero hace algunos años practiqué tenis, aunque solo durante unos meses. De todas formas, tenía muchas ganas de aprender a jugar. Todo comenzó porque quería poder acompañar a mi esposo a sus partidos, ya que es su deporte favorito y lo practica desde la universidad; así podría compartir su afición por este juego. Lamentablemente, como muchas cosas en mi vida, me aburrí rápidamente y lo abandoné por completo, pero ahora he decidido retomarlo y esta vez él se tomará el tiempo de enseñarme.

Para nuestra primera sesión fuimos al hotel Tibisay, ya que allí puedes alquilar la cancha por horas y cuesta $10. Además, queríamos nadar un rato, así que podríamos «matar dos pájaros de un tiro», como se dice por allí. No voy a negar que estoy bastante oxidada, pero, a pesar de todo, siento que conservo algo de lo aprendido y más o menos me pude defender. Aún queda un largo recorrido por delante, pero creo que me adaptaré fácilmente.

Después del entrenamiento, nos dimos un buen baño en la piscina, a pesar de que lloviznó varias veces y el cielo se mantuvo nublado. Fue un día diferente, en el que nos escapamos de la rutina, nos divertimos y, de cierta forma, seguimos estrechando nuestro vínculo como pareja. En futuras prácticas iremos al polideportivo de la ciudad, ya que podemos utilizar la cancha de forma gratuita. Ya saben: mientras podamos ahorrar, mucho mejor 😜. ----- Hello, friends! You might not know this, but a few years ago I played tennis, though only for a few months. In any case, I was really eager to learn how to play. It all started because I wanted to be able to accompany my husband to his matches—since it’s his favorite sport and he’s been playing it since college—so I could share his passion for the game. Unfortunately, like many things in my life, I got bored quickly and gave it up completely, but now I’ve decided to pick it up again, and this time he’ll take the time to teach me.

For our first session, we went to the Tibisay Hotel, since you can rent the court by the hour there for $10. Plus, we wanted to swim for a while, so we could “kill two birds with one stone,” as they say. I won’t deny that I’m pretty rusty, but despite everything, I feel like I’ve retained some of what I learned and was able to hold my own, more or less. We still have a long way to go, but I think I’ll adapt easily.

After practice, we took a nice swim in the pool, even though it drizzled a few times and the sky stayed cloudy. It was a different kind of day—we escaped the routine, had fun, and, in a way, continued to strengthen our bond as a couple. For future practices, we’ll go to the city sports center, since we can use the court for free. You know how it is: the more we can save, the better 😜. ----
¡Nos vemos pronto!
See you soon!

body.title: Parable of the lost sheep: Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost. Luke 15:6
body.body:
The divine master, on his journey to the holy city of Jerusalem, taught an important parable that describes how the Kingdom of God, the dominion or empire of God's perfections, works in men, and that is the Parable of the Lost and Found Sheep. This parable is known as one of the parables of mercy in the Gospel of Saint Luke.
On the level of ideas, this parable has a great resemblance to the parable of the Prodigal Son and the Parable of the Lost and Found Coin. Understanding one parable means understanding all three together. The parables seek to convey the idea of ​​a God full of wisdom and mercy (compassion, kindness, gentleness), who observes how men use their freedom, and how, through this freedom, some choose a destructive and unjust path while others choose a progressive and benevolent one. In other words, the Lord in his understanding does not want evil and suffering, but man's freedom is at stake, thence the spiritual paths, righteousness, and sin.
And God, in His unconditional love for those who choose the path of error and suffering, gives them the option of repentance. God constantly offers His mercy to humankind, but it is up to each person to allow themselves to be embraced by this wonderful gift.
And when Jesus spoke in his parable about the lost sheep that was found, he was referring to sinners who, repentant of their way of destruction, decide to change their path toward righteousness. Just as good and evil are possible, so too are repentance and forgiveness. Unconditional love does not take into account the evil received.
And so Jesus began his parable by saying that if a person has a hundred sheep and loses one, when he finds it, full of joy, the first thing he does is call his friends and tell them: \

Luke 15:6. Jesus ended his story by explaining that this is the joy and mercy in heaven for every sinner who repents.\n![Parable of the lost sheep. Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost. Luke 15,6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTB7vqU1QxGx8DMEy74TYL4VvxLFMZ63ZtmBo7kUPFBjM/Parable%20of%20the%20lost%20sheep.%20Rejoice%20with%20me,%20for%20I%20have%20found%20my%20sheep%20which%20was%20lost.%20Luke%2015,6.jpg)\nFor more information, check out my profile, follow the link, and download my ebook.

body.title: Chasing City Lights: Our Starbucks Night Hike Adventure
body.body: > ![1776606988556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/23u5ZWzJs5p9ipjWjDKDjp5weX1DntzYNMVRFs5MZt6853B9bi1KxQS5nRq2t4Aj4r5Hj.jpg) Welcome to Starbucks — a place where people hike, even those in their 40s, showing great determination just to experience it and, as they say, to strengthen their knees. Of course, this place is also famous online, where many people go to experience how challenging it is to climb the mountain. The trail is not in good condition, so you really need to be careful to avoid slipping. Since we went there at night, we had to be extra cautious. ![received_2017220502507064.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/23uFHJa3BWoFSQU3FFdPGZtV3sGkx72r8x7DKEXfSPLAq7K9VbKr6m1q3SDaAQXR5mFhG.jpeg) Look at one of my friends—he even brought a stick to use as support because he knew how difficult the trail would be, especially at night. But even though it was already dark, many people were still hiking just to experience the Starbucks hike. ![1776606956624.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/23tbkWcd8tB7TbXaW141CemaxGu2uQz2RpuqNR3EhehvjSyFY9tD24wQvKBnYwjjbuEZa.jpg) These are my friends during the hike—they were already very tired, but they were still thinking about our next hiking destination. We arrived at the top very late at night, and the trail became even harder because it was rocky and unfamiliar to us. Some of us really struggled, but we were all eager to reach the top. ![1776607869716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/EoEjHyjNBWHQvfS1zLvPjLxfDSbDM8XH9B6mwm7K3hndTwiURjiFmfc2T3UuGPHjjKf.jpg) Because of our eagerness, we successfully made it. What made it even more special was the view—the city lights looked like we could see the whole of Cebu City from above. ![1776607888107.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/Eo6CfuKJYGDhLscqM6wp82ktuUjPhZvFQ9EhvXF2cbbg8yBBmhSH82tQ3Fzk3NyRYGK.jpg) If you have any places in mind, feel free to comment some nice hiking spots so we can visit them too 🫶🫶 (Cebu City Only)

body.title: When Cars Meet Fashion: My Jetour Experience
body.body: > **English** A car fashion show? Yes! Yes! I’m game!! Any day, any time! I attended a car fashion show today and I haven’t been this excited in a while. I enjoyed the entire experience and didn’t want it to end.
> Jetour organized a four-day event in my city and I was privileged to attend. Today was the car fashion show and I was blown away.
> Every Jetour car displayed today was screaming luxury! They are all designed to be comfortable and stylish.

> Out of excitement, I arrived at the venue earlier than the stipulated time, while I waited for them to start, I moved around to see all the luxurious cars that were up for display, but sadly I couldn’t buy any 😃
> Since I couldn’t buy any, I didn’t hesitate to take pictures of the different models and go on a short ride, honestly this was my favourite part!
> The interiors of the cars are lit, and the entire user experience? Fantastic!
> There was so much to see and do, and each activity made you want more.
> The models were amazing. They carried the show and left us speechless. Every design, every look, and every walk was spot on!
> In a nutshell, this was an amazing event, just the kind of event I like to attend and I’d love to do this over and over again.
> I look forward to the next Jetour experience in 2027.
> Have you attended a car fashion show before? Did you enjoy it? Would you love to attend one? I’d love to read your thoughts in the comments!

> **Spanish** ¿Un desfile de moda de coches? ¡Sí! ¡Sí! ¡Me apunto! ¡Cualquier día, a cualquier hora! Hoy he asistido a un desfile de moda de coches y hacía tiempo que no me emocionaba tanto. He disfrutado de toda la experiencia y no quería que terminara.
> Jetour ha organizado un evento de cuatro días en mi ciudad y he tenido el privilegio de asistir. Hoy era el desfile de moda de coches y me ha dejado boquiabierta.
> ¡Todos los coches de Jetour que se han exhibido hoy rezumaban lujo! Todos están diseñados para ser cómodos y elegantes.

> Lleno de emoción, llegué al recinto antes de la hora estipulada y, mientras esperaba a que empezara, me moví por allí para ver todos los coches de lujo que se exponían, pero, por desgracia, no pude comprar ninguno 😃
> Como no podía comprar ninguno, no dudé en hacer fotos de los diferentes modelos y dar una vuelta corta; sinceramente, ¡esta fue mi parte favorita!
> Los interiores de los coches son espectaculares, ¿y la experiencia de usuario en su conjunto? ¡Fantástica!
> Había tanto que ver y hacer, y cada actividad te dejaba con ganas de más.
> Las modelos eran increíbles. Llevaron el peso del desfile y nos dejaron sin palabras. ¡Cada diseño, cada look y cada paso eran perfectos!
> En resumen, fue un evento increíble, justo el tipo de evento al que me gusta asistir y me encantaría repetir una y otra vez.
> Estoy deseando que llegue la próxima experiencia Jetour en 2027.

body.body:

</liketuimages>

天气变化的太快啦，周六天气晴朗太阳很大，学校安排到学生们去学校进行运动会开幕式预演，不得不说天气很配合。周天早上起来8点左右天气还是挺不错的，只过了不到2个小时天气就突变。变得阴沉沉，到了中午天气变得黄黄的，这是沙尘暴来临的预兆。孩子上午去上周六调班的补习班，10点多下课回家后原本孩子妈计划让写作业，可孩子说想下楼玩。于是就让孩子下楼玩一会，到12点回来吃饭，然后写作业。

到了12点孩子果然回来了，并且把邻居家朋友也带回来了。两个人在家里吃完饭，又说下楼去玩会儿，孩子妈答应玩到下午3点回来写作业。到了下午3点孩子并没有准时回来，我只好下楼去找。小区里转了一圈没有找到，门口商铺也没有找到。因为孩子没有带电话手表，我来到邻居家，对方父母给孩子朋友的电话手表打电话让赶紧回来。等了一会还没有回来，我又下楼去找，这次在小区门口商铺找到了。虽然我催促孩子赶紧回家写作业，可孩子还是不紧不慢，回去路上还玩了一会。

好不容易到家后，写完英语作业错了一大堆，孩子妈生气的教训了一顿，我把英语作业打印一遍让重新做。接下来还有语文卷子，生词听写，数学错题等等。孩子很生气，不仅仅是因为没有按照规定睡觉回来，更因为玩回来后写作业太敷衍。有了这次经验，以后不管什么原因都必须在家写完作业才能出去玩。

body.title: Werden wir dieses Jahr in den Geschichtsbüchern wieder sehen?
body.body:
Hallo Freunde,

ich weiß nicht warum, aber in letzter Zeit habe ich viel zu oft darüber nachgedacht, dass der Kalender 2026 die gleiche Struktur wie 1914 hat. Und irgendwie passt das ganz gut in unsere heutige Zeit. Wir sind nicht in einer Welt die man mit dem Beginn des Jahres 1939 vergleichen kann, kurz vor dem Ausbruch des zweiten Weltkriegs. Wir sind eher im Frühjahr 1914. Die Welt ist kurz davor in einen Abwärtssturm zu stürtzen. 1914 hat man auch nicht erwartet, was passieren sollte. Die Welt war vor dem großen Krieg, wie es in einigen Ländern genannt wird, sehr stark vernetzt. So Stark vernetzt wie man es danach erst wieder in den neunziger Jahren erreicht hatte, also nach dem Zusammenbruch der UdSSR und der Öffnung Chinas für den Westen. Und wir haben gerade einige Baustellen, die Gefährlich werden könnten, wenn sie weiter eskalieren. Schaut euch einfach einmal die beiden Blockaden der Straße von Hormus an oder was auch immer gerade zwischen China und Taiwan los ist. Die Chinesen werden immer stärker, im Osten baut Russland seine mechanisierten Kräfte an der Nato Ostgrenze aus und die Energeiversorgung der Welt stockt, genau wie die Versorgung mit Lebensmitteln in absehbarer Zeit. 

Es sind tausende kleine Probleme und ein paar größere Probleme und dann kann es passieren, dass es explodiert. Ich meine wer hätte 1914 daran denken können, dass ein einzelner Attentäter einen Weltkrieg auslösen kann, der die Weltgeschichte für immer verändern wird. Und heute haben wir viele dieser Baustellen und die internationale Ordnung wird immer schwächer, da die Akteure die sie garantiert haben, sie nicht mehr bereit sind zu schützen. Ich fand an dieser Stelle immer spannend, dass die Europäer die Amerikaner mit fehlender Krankenversicherung aufgezogen haben, während sie selbst darauf gesetzt haben, dass die Amerikaner sie schützen werden. Aber das war eben nur eine Frage der Zeit, bis sich diese Welt ändern wird. Und genau da stehen wir jetzt. 

Also in dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl und was denkt ihr? Wie wird diese Welt weiter eskalieren.

body.title: Every click, a lesson -  B&W PHOTOGRAPHY - from São Paulo - Brasil II ENG - PT_BR II ( 09 Shots )
body.body:
![TEMPLATE ART ALIEN HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/48ZbHpUo72Qm2pHPtVFYxMQkMRgZLNMNDG81uRAJQrnb6hiWRyLK2s3FmLxfP89bvi.jpg)










Photographing the streets is always a learning experience with every click, as if each step were a silent lesson the city offers to those who truly slow down their gaze. There's no script, no direction, no second chance prepared. It's you, the camera, and whatever is happening at that exact second. And that changes everything.





> fotografar as ruas é sempre uma sensação de aprendizado em cada clique, como se cada passo fosse uma aula silenciosa que a cidade entrega pra quem realmente desacelera o olhar. não tem roteiro, não tem direção, não tem segunda chance preparada. é você, a câmera e o que estiver acontecendo naquele exato segundo. e isso muda tudo.
------------------------













![_MG_2741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23w2kgqhVwj4AJ3oY96rK7cNCgvFCv367ZnzFL3eK1LR6f7X7qW6xmMZ1pJSx6AtqmHf7.jpg)










📷 **01.** / Canon EOS 60D



















![_MG_2826.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23xyTNiP595a9Mt7WXZWYca5GVCccmSPCTiDGSD4xejyg6hCmXm3AnmzBtoNiXocTh89e.jpg)





📷 **02.**  / Canon EOS 60D




------------------------

It is in improvisation that the street reveals itself. In the detail that goes unnoticed by most, but which, for those who are attentive, becomes history. A shadow crossing the ground, a lost gaze in the middle of the crowd, the texture of a wall tired of existing, the distorted reflection of a shop window telling two realities at the same time. Everything converses, everything adds up, everything becomes language.



> é no improviso que a rua se revela. no detalhe que passa batido pra maioria, mas que pra quem tá atento vira história. uma sombra atravessando o chão, um olhar perdido no meio da multidão, a textura de um muro cansado de existir, o reflexo torto de uma vitrine contando duas realidades ao mesmo tempo. tudo conversa, tudo soma, tudo vira linguagem.
------------------------
















![_MG_2849.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23zbY8UMXZ4K1DZmy6TfMRyN9Zb9hTqD3JtKKkifZUdYxbDfDX4KrfN9k68BSn4HcEoFV.jpg)






📷 **03.**  / Canon EOS 60D






















![_MG_2858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23xejg8PctBKTVbKpinzHYT6p3yX6nwSbehzZ4bbc43v1EgxNukXTBxttHFAnjDTb7675.jpg)





📷 **04.**  / Canon EOS 60D



















![_MG_3287.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23u67LHtGaigQVhvFhSmUrRH9kVpSjWTvUpko7JSAbAaBh5z5y41VneqJoMYrnNoEk9Kf.JPG)




📷 **05.**  / Canon EOS 60D




------------------------

Each click is trial, error, success, and discovery. Because the street doesn't forgive distraction, but it also rewards those who persevere. There are days when nothing fits, when the light isn't right, when the moment slips away in milliseconds. But there are days when everything flows, when it seems like the city conspires with you. And it's in this contrast that learning grows, in the frustration that teaches and in the success that confirms.



> cada clique é tentativa, erro, acerto e descoberta. porque a rua não perdoa distração, mas também recompensa quem insiste. tem dia que nada encaixa, que a luz não ajuda, que o momento escapa por milésimos. mas tem dia que tudo flui, que parece que a cidade conspira junto contigo. e é nesse contraste que o aprendizado cresce, na frustração que ensina e no acerto que confirma.
------------------------













![_MG_3300.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23xp6GPSDy2b7X2k2huzwQ9bhJgLeNwuW55AAjpsJb2hKdS3MjyBxJe8wCr251zLTnFVR.JPG)



📷 **06.**  / Canon EOS 60D





Time here is different. It's not clock time, it's the time of the event. Learning to wait, to anticipate, to sense when something is going to happen even before it happens. It's almost instinct. And when you make a mistake, you learn. When you get it right, you learn too. There's no loss, only process.


> o tempo aqui é outro. não é o tempo do relógio, é o tempo do acontecimento. aprender a esperar, a antecipar, a sentir quando algo vai acontecer antes mesmo de acontecer. é quase instinto. e quando você erra, aprende. quando acerta, aprende também. não tem perda, só processo.











![_MG_3313.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/241tdLxkaLVnQ5dpgeHvmWHyeQrLAt7KNYHbALfuxFQi3FJ9dzGNdWVJWL7JB3MEKTV1e.JPG)



📷 **07.**  / Canon EOS 60D





















![_MG_3318.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23x17EKJErYE2fPMxHSWPjYHapdxmCdvFPEbLRvdyY9BF433DGDVt49Qb4qrdMnfqgUi3.JPG)








📷 **08.**  / Canon EOS 60D





------------------------
The sun beating down on your head, the heat weighing on your body, fatigue arriving unannounced. A water bottle always nearby, sharing space with the camera as an essential tool. And yet, your eyes don't close. Because the street doesn't pause. It continues, pulsates, changes rhythm all the time. And you go along, adapting, molding yourself, getting lost and finding yourself in the midst of it all.



> o sol batendo na cabeça, o calor pesando no corpo, o cansaço chegando sem avisar. a garrafinha d’água sempre por perto, dividindo espaço com a câmera como ferramenta essencial. e mesmo assim, o olho não desliga. porque a rua não pausa. ela continua, pulsa, muda de ritmo o tempo todo. e você vai junto, se adaptando, se moldando, se perdendo e se encontrando no meio disso tudo.

------------------------

















![paisag 4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/244xz4G4GVieTygp9U535xnPdrdnqMVytU1iyzLpWd4acXgKBFWuanTLaQ4UszVZr8D9J.jpg)






📷 **09.** / Canon EOS 60D


------------------------


Photographing the street is also about dealing with the unexpected human experience. People who are surprised, people who stare, people who ask questions, people who ignore you. Each interaction becomes part of the experience, part of building this more conscious, more respectful, sharper perspective. You learn not only to photograph, but to position yourself in the world.

> fotografar rua também é lidar com o inesperado humano. gente que estranha, gente que encara, gente que pergunta, gente que ignora. cada interação vira parte da experiência, parte da construção desse olhar mais consciente, mais respeitoso, mais afiado. você aprende não só a fotografar, mas a se posicionar no mundo.










------------------------



And in the midst of this organized chaos, you begin to understand that you're not just capturing images. You're documenting time, behavior, culture, silence, and noise all at once. You're creating memories of things that perhaps no one else has noticed. And that gives a different weight to each click.



> e no meio desse caos organizado, você começa a entender que não tá só registrando imagem. tá documentando tempo, comportamento, cultura, silêncio e barulho ao mesmo tempo. tá criando memória de coisas que talvez ninguém mais tenha reparado. e isso dá um peso diferente pra cada clique.
------------------------








------------------------

body.title: Sunday Discipline, Always Showing Up 💪✨ / Domingo de Disciplina, Siempre Constantes 💪✨
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTcdg78hiibEwVC4cRucc9TDkxeWqJdhPZ1bt2dEtJkuK/IMG_4527.jpg 

Today I came to the gym again, even though it’s Sunday. For many, it’s a rest day, but for me it’s also a reminder that consistency doesn’t take days off. It’s not about being perfect, it’s about showing up, even when it would be easier to stay home. Little by little, these decisions are what build real change.

I don’t just come here for how I look, but for how I feel. Stronger, more confident, more focused. Of course, feeling beautiful and taking care of myself is part of it, but it goes deeper than that. It’s about discipline, self-love, and proving to myself that I can stay committed no matter the day.

So yes, even on a Sunday, I choose not to give up. I choose to keep going, to keep improving, and to keep building the best version of me — inside and out. 💖✨

>Hoy me vine de nuevo al gym, aunque sea domingo. Para muchos es día de descanso, pero para mí también es un recordatorio de que la constancia no descansa. No se trata de ser perfecta, sino de presentarte, incluso cuando sería más fácil quedarte en casa. Poco a poco, esas decisiones son las que construyen el cambio real.

>No solo vengo por cómo me veo, sino por cómo me siento. Más fuerte, más segura, más enfocada. Claro que también es bonito sentirse bella y cuidarse, pero va más allá. Se trata de disciplina, amor propio y demostrarme que puedo mantenerme firme sin importar el día.

>Así que sí, incluso en domingo, elijo no rendirme. Elijo seguir, mejorar y construir mi mejor versión por dentro y por fuera. 💖✨

body.body: > Happy Sunday everyone! I'm grateful to share a new post here in the #gems community where I show you an activity I do very often: giving preventative maintenance to the fan I have in my room to prevent dust and other particles from damaging it, and also to apply a little grease to its parts, especially the motor. >Feliz Domingo para todos agradecida por compartir una nueva publicación aquí en la comunidad #gems dónde les muestro una actividad la cuál hago muy seguido y es la da darle el mantenimiento preventivo al ventilador qué tengo en el cuarto para así evitar qué el polvo y otras partículas lo puedan dañar además de necesitar un poco de grasa a sus partes sobre todo del motor. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS87TpjQpTDT1hgUiacXUPrYeubRxaBKzeYahkUgrFWxT/1776640835877.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDxbvH8A2WQJnfhnvoRRfxJmtsY5fX3FzM62U2H3bQyq/1776640836005.png) I like to completely disassemble it to leave it thoroughly clean. I also have the necessary tools here at home to remove all the screws. I would have liked to take more photos, but I was alone and it was a bit difficult to find the best angles with the phone while still showing the work I was doing. I needed both hands to hold the screwdriver in one and apply a little force with the other to finish everything properly. >Me gusta desarmarlo en su totalidad para dejarlo completamente limpio además aquí en casa tengo las herramientas necesarias para retirar todos los tornillos, sin duda me hubiera gustado tomar más fotos pero estaba sola y se me complicó un poco al momento de con el teléfono buscar los mejores ángulos y al mismo tiempo qué se vea el trabajo qué estaba haciendo pero cómo necesitaba ambas manos para sostener en una el destornillador y con la otra aplicar un poco de fuerza para terminar todo muy bien. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS4v6MebocK4TC813zwkfRNg4LqAoyn74j36QNqfRafhU/1776640859439.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWSJuTDHFFc7HQ8rSMwUQywnvaVDR29YKjVwMUP9M2TvP/1776640859524.png) After cleaning it thoroughly, as you can see in the photo, it was just a matter of putting all the pieces back together and getting back to work, which would allow me to be cooler because the heat has been extremely intense in recent days after some rain. >Ya después de dejarlo bien limpio cómo se ve en la foto era cuestión de volver a colocarle todas sus piezas y volver al trabajo de darme la posibilidad de estar más fresca debido a qué el calor ha estado extremadamente fuerte en los últimos días luego de unos lluviosos. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf4AcTBfZzeJDcT7wb9iqwp8roD64xYiV3DKqUBw1WvQK/1776640923925.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQV7kZRxekP5AJLqPCf89uqSBvrmC3nq1iURvNnGtWBsT/1776640924008.png)

body.body: /> * * * Llevo parte de este año, con una estrategia diferente con respecto a mis recompensas. Desde que ya los post no se pagan con HBD, opté por cambiar el HIVE líquido a bitcoin. Incluso algunos HBD también los he cambiado a bitcoin cuando lo veo bastante bajo. Esta es una estrategia con poco dinero. Cuando pruebo algo siempre lo hago desde muy poquito, para que el riesgo sea menor. Así si crezco lo hago de forma más orgánica. Es posible que me pierda muchas oportunidades de hacer rico en cripto, usando esta metodología, pero también me pierdo más oportunidades de quebrar. El hecho de que estemos en un mercado bajista y ver a bitcoin en mínimos de ciclo, me animó a comprar. Esto incluso sabiendo que tiene menos posibilidades de crecer que HIVE. En este momento con una mínima entrada de capital a Hive, ya se puede disparar a un x5, o incluso un x10; en cambio BTC no hará eso. Como mucho podría esperar un x3 en los próximos cinco años. Sin embargo es más seguro en estos momentos para mantener el capital, ya que en Hive hemos visto como no ha parado de bajar. * * * Este es el gráfico de velas mensuales HIVE/BTC y vemos como ha perdido terreno a lo largo del tiempo. Es posible que estemos en los mínimos y que desde aquí comencemos a recuperar ese terreno.

/> * * * Este es el gráfico de velas de una hora, igual contra bitcoin. Vemos como ayer subió bastante, llego a más de 5% a favor de HIVE. No estoy seguro, pero quizás se relacione con le lanzamiento de [MAGI - Altera](https://peakd.com/hive/@magi.network/native-bitcoin-liquidity-pools-have-launched-on-magi-network-hive-crosschain-future-starts-today) porque coincidió en el momento. Debido a estas fluctuaciones, estoy haciendo trading con los dos pares. Lo bueno es que no me importa cual baja o sube. Puedo acumular más HIVE o más BTC. La idea es siempre comprar entre ellas, obteniendo más que la última transacción. Igual lo hago con HBD/BTC aunque en menor medida.

/> * * * Para esto uso [https://v4v.app/](https://v4v.app/) que con un click cambio de una a otra y las comisiones son pequeñas. Me gusta por lo rápido, porque así se mueve el mercado. Todavía no uso Altera, porque el cambio no favorece con respecto a v4v. ### Este video también lo hice con la intención de llamar la atención en Youtube. Decir que puedes ganar bitcoins con tu blog, puede generar un nuevo interés. De hecho a mí me ha generado interés publicar ahora para poner en práctica la estrategia. Quizás es porque es algo nuevo y eso motiva, o quizás porque así crece más rápido la billetera. body.title: [EN/ES] Drawing Cherrim Overcast Form
body.body:
### Drawing Cherrim Overcast Form > ### Dibujando a Cherrim Encapotado ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR8CFtZkxL7CwwSJfVB3ktQEUwy7MbHAFkkJ6fdN7rj2e/271_sin_t_tulo_20260416193258_2_.jpg) Hello, today I wanted to draw a Pokémon. It's Pokémon number 421 and it's called Cherrim; its type is Grass, as you can see. What's curious about this Pokémon is not its size or its species. What's curious is that it has several forms: an Overcast Form, which is the one I drew that looks like a closed bud. Another form is the Sunshine Form, which activates when there is intense sunlight, then its petals open. When the sun shines strongly, this Pokémon blooms, if the light goes away, it returns to its previous form. I wanted to draw it in its bud form, a form in which it barely moves and is very docile, so I drew it sleeping. > Hola, hoy quise dibujar un Pokémon. Es el Pokémon número 421 y se llama Cherrim, su tipo es planta, como pueden ver. Lo curioso de este Pokémon no es su tamaño ni su especie. Lo curioso es que tiene varias formas: una forma Nublado, que es esta que dibujé y que parece un capullo cerrado. Otra forma es la forma soleada, que se activa cuando hay sol intenso; ahí sus pétalos se abren. Cuando el sol brilla con fuerza, este Pokémon florece, si la luz se oculta, vuelve a su forma anterior. Yo lo quise dibujar en su forma capullo, una forma en la que apenas se mueve y es muy dócil, por eso lo dibujé durmiendo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWiGMD31dgRmeHyiWgact4wBn1JhQtS1mDAzz7qZy8Zuw/271_sin_t_tulo_20260416190549.jpg) This was my lineart which I drew directly since it is a very simple Pokémon where loose lines and organic movements predominate. > Este fue mi lineart el cual dibujé directamente ya que es un pokémon muy simple donde predominan las líneas sueltas y con movimientos orgánicos. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZRJnamBf1sArGsV3pJ2UizR7CZex6pJjVDJeSARN5b83/271_sin_t_tulo_20260416190555.jpg) First I added color to the petals using the same color as its normal form. I really like the color of this Pokémon. > Primero agregué color a los pétalos usando el mismo color que tiene su forma normal. Me gusta mucho el color de este Pokémon. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXfrfRtV2eqtj28zwCftbQAEjiLH4ZaacpeZyw4WnN242/271_sin_t_tulo_20260416190609.jpg) I did the same with the other parts of the Pokémon, from its green leaves to its rounded body hidden beneath the petals. > Hice lo mismo con las demás partes del Pokémon, desde sus hojas verdes hasta su cuerpo redondeado oculto debajo de los pétalos. I like Cherrim because even though it is hidden under the petals in its overcast form, it shows a great deal of emotion simply through the position of its parts. Moreover, despite looking like a weak flower, its petals are very hard and resistant. Its petals behave exactly like a shield would so that the bird Pokémon, its main predator in nature, do not harm it. There is a phrase in the Pokédex that says this Pokémon tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud. It makes me laugh every time I read that description. Well, to be like Cherrim. Sometimes we look delicate but we protect ourselves with the best of shields. > Me gusta Cherrim porque a pesar de estar oculto bajo los pétalos en su forma encapotada, muestra gran cantidad de emociones simplemente por la posición de sus partes. Además, a pesar de parecer una débil flor, sus pétalos son muy duros y resistentes. Sus pétalos se comportan exactamente como se comportaría un escudo para que los pokemones pájaro, su principal depredador en la naturaleza, no le hagan daño. Hay una frase en la Pokédex que dice que este pokemon intenta compensar todo lo que soportó de capullo. Me da mucha risa siempre que leo esa descripción. Bueno, ser como Cherrim. A veces nos vemos delicados pero nos protegemos a nosotros mismos con el mejor de los escudos. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhLXF3Rh2aUmLATiFqqN1nckqr24qLsXV44RuEoYg3Bm/271_sin_t_tulo_20260416190917.jpg) I began to add some shadows and lights as well as some textures to Cherrim, starting first with the green leaves. > Comencé a dar un poco de sombras y luces así como algunas texturas a Cherrim empezando primeramente por las hojas verdes. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUL6w5Xu47GowRij7tUjuCsos4pDzqETpaQJFVp8Bhd8w/271_sin_t_tulo_20260416192051.jpg) https://youtu.be/NwJrqEykJCc?si=iYnU7PkruxOJ70Tk [Video Link](https://youtu.be/NwJrqEykJCc?si=iYnU7PkruxOJ70Tk) | | | |:---|:---| | **Cherrim**
