body.title: Elaborando y degustando  delicioso menú de : Sardinas en salsa de tomate, arroz con frijoles, plátano hervido, y aperitivos de pequeñas galletas saladas.
body.body:
# Español
# Saludos amigos amantes del rico y variado sazón 💁🌈 
¡Feliz día para todos !
Mi familia, amigos, es amante del pescado, y del arroz con frijoles, por lo que hoy domingo, quise sorprenderlos para el almuerzo con un delicioso aperitivo y un menú compuesto por : Sardinas  en salsa de tomate, arroz con frijoles colorados, plátanos hervidos.Los invito amigos a que me acompañen a conocer las recetas que empleé para lograr tan divina combinación.¡Comencemos!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_112811955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCLbs9ZNgWaXhzhdY3vD1TZQaabGbjsDHacWsEPTJCuj2AqwVn9FxaHVvN2CkoibXAP.jpg)
</center>
#
Amigos, el aperitivo que brindé a mi familia fue el de pequeñas galletas saladas industriales , para aminorar el tiempo de espera del almuerzo. Tiempo, que fue transcurrido entre risas y pláticas  agradables, al lograr estás galletas con su deliciosa  y suave  textura, su propósito deleitativo exitosamente.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_111810499.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsX3PeG2dFn7LHwgkzFNozpLjcDs3TPcFeHApjJ4KNPwAtZTaVgEdaaPEQpKqvFrnBd.jpg)
</center>
#
Habiéndolas degustado, proseguí sirviendo el  saludable y nutritivo menú compuesto, que elaboré con los procederes siguientes: 

# ✨Ingredientes generales del menú, para cuatro comensales.✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_111553039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCG6BgGHD16TAzNNaS4iuGZZBoZuufWKvyWgbjfFFJoA1vYtr9UXBkBzBUfcTpE9qgp.jpg)
</center>
#
.Sardinas crudas, 12  unidades limpias
.Especias : 10 dientes de ajo, 6 cebollínes con sus hojas, 1/2 de cucharada de comino.
.Pasta de tomate:  2 cucharadas.
.Frijoles colorados: 1 taza mediana 
.Arroz: 3 tazas 
.Aceite de Soja: 6 cucharadas 
.Plátanos verdes : 5 unidades 
.Agua: suficiente para cada proceder.
.Sal : 1 cucharada distribuida en los alimentos.
.Zumo de limón: 3 cucharadas 

#
# ✨Modo de confección✨
Las sardinas fue el primer alimento que elaboré. 
# ✨Sardinas en salsa de tomate 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_124326681.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23u6BQRgVA3ymf2GVqcGEGsby5QzsJLRoPotxyDp5ocqbBVr1DzAHkrFYpvhpG4ZvXFTN.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié el proceder preparando con el método  tradicional de lavado, pelado, troceado, las especias a emplear , en este caso 6 dientes de ajo, y 3 cebollínes con sus hojas. Seguidamente, adobé las sardinas, que se encontraban totalmente limpias, sin escamas con : las especias preparadas, 3 cucharadas de zumo de limón y 1/4 de cucharada de sal. Dejé reposar las sardinas por 2 horas , para que se impregnaran del sabor de las especias y continué procediendo de la siguiente forma: En una olla incorporé 3 cucharadas de aceite de Soja, 1/4 de cucharada de comino y comencé a darle un leve salteado por unos segundos, este proceder me lo sugirió un familiar, pues es el que utiliza para darle el gusto a sus  salsas. Seguidamente, ingresé a la olla las sardinas adobadas con 3 cucharadas de pasta de tomate, continué salteándolo por unos segundos más, y le incorporé 1 taza de agua. Tapé la olla, y la puse a presión por 45 minutos. Impresionante el sabor de  las  sardinas cubiertas de salsa de tomate que se obtienen con este método, método, qué considero eficaz amigos, pues permite el total ablandamiento de sus espinas.

El arroz con frijoles, fue el segundo alimento que elaboré.
# ✨Arroz con frijoles✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_124851289.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23xAiDakukxbFBmzVrVVkFdLMKReTaXfm8Nu5HsQ2b3W1tmjNTnn3CVbGEjHqAYgAYG6Z.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié midiendo, revisando y lavando, 1 taza de frijoles colorados. Seguidamente, los incorporé en una olla con 3 tazas de agua, y 2 cucharadas de aceite. Puse la olla a presión por 20 minutos, y transcurrido el tiempo, ya poseía los frijoles blanditos con el agua colorida , que emplearía para el arroz con frijoles. Continué el proceder midiendo , revisando y lavando 3 tazas de arroz , que seguidamente, comencé a saltearlas con un pequeño sofrito previamente realizado de: ajo, cebollín, comino, y aceite. Despues de 1 minuto de encontrarme salteando el arroz con el sofrito, agregué al compuesto los frijoles reservados con su agua y 1/2 cucharada de sal. Removí, con ayuda de una paleta, y puse a cocinar el arroz con frijoles por 6 minutos.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_125544788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23zS7FqH7SA8Ub3YBJgfvJvbk6jL9Jdct11MCALh1V88urKN4uMXe1EL1ge27RwbYfzVu.jpg)
</center>
#
Exquisito, con un sabor predominante a comino, quedó  este arroz con frijoles que combinó  perfectamente con las sardinas en salsa de tomate, y el tercer alimento elaborado : plátanos hervidos.

# ✨Plátanos hervidos✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_125230393.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsUQEW25cm7TYBCDgkpr5uCqGd8t6jsGYSkNrZD67ciVW2Sjm647HCKF3Lmf72Gntr4.jpg)
</center>
#
Para realizar los plátanos, tomé 5 plátanos verdes, los lavé, despojé de su cáscara con ayuda de un cuchillo, y los puse a hervir  por 15 minutos, en un recipiente con: agua que los cubriera, 1/3 de cucharada de sal, 1 cucharada de zumo de limón. El limón, siempre es recomendable utilizarlo para evitar la coloración oscura.Transcurrido el tiempo los saqué para un recipiente, dónde los corté en rodajas de aproximadamente de 1 centímetro, y los impregné de 1 cucharada de aceite de Soja, y un toque de ajo en polvo.¡Sabrosos!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_125704110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23zS5hocHbAmXw14c8qW1uJ9fVQAPCtYKqVMubYqmkcSkzc6ePg8rgGnQ5NRjTCe9bNWq.jpg)
</center>
#
Amigos, adoré este domingo  lleno de deleites culinarios en familia. Espero, que a ustedes también  les haya gustado mi experiencia, y que se anímen a elaborar estas  recetas de sardinas, arroz y plátanos, para eventos  colectivos, les aseguro que les encantará. Me despido, deseándoles a todos  la culminación de un feliz domingo.¡Abrazos!💁☀️
Fotografías propias.
*** 
*** 
# English
# Preparing and tasting delicious menu of : Sardines in tomato sauce, rice with beans, boiled banana, and snacks of small crackers.
# Greetings friends lovers of the rich and varied seasoning 💁🌈 
Happy day to everyone!
My family, friends, is a lover of fish, and rice with beans, so today Sunday, I wanted to surprise you for lunch with a delicious appetizer and a menu consisting of : Sardines in tomato sauce, rice with red beans, boiled bananas.I invite you friends to join me to know the recipes that I used to achieve such a divine combination.Let's get started!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_112811955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCLbs9ZNgWaXhzhdY3vD1TZQaabGbjsDHacWsEPTJCuj2AqwVn9FxaHVvN2CkoibXAP.jpg)
</center>
#
Friends, the snack I gave to my family was small industrial crackers, to reduce the waiting time for lunch. Time, which was spent between laughter and pleasant conversations, by achieving these cookies with their delicious and soft texture, their delectable purpose successfully.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_111810499.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsX3PeG2dFn7LHwgkzFNozpLjcDs3TPcFeHApjJ4KNPwAtZTaVgEdaaPEQpKqvFrnBd.jpg)
</center>
#
Having tasted them, I continued serving the healthy and nutritious composite menu, which I prepared with the following procedures: 

# ✨General ingredients of the menu, for four diners.✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_111553039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCG6BgGHD16TAzNNaS4iuGZZBoZuufWKvyWgbjfFFJoA1vYtr9UXBkBzBUfcTpE9qgp.jpg)
</center>
#
.Raw sardines, 12 units clean
.Spices: 10 cloves of garlic, 6 chives with their leaves, 1/2 tablespoon of cumin.
.Tomato paste: 2 tablespoons.
.Red beans: 1 medium cup 
.Rice: 3 cups 
.Soy oil: 6 tablespoons 
.Green bananas: 5 units 
.Water: Enough for each procedure.
.Salt: 1 tablespoon distributed in food.
.Lemon juice: 3 tablespoons 

#
# ✨Mode of preparation✨
Sardines were the first food I made 
# ✨Sardines in tomato sauce 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_124326681.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23u6BQRgVA3ymf2GVqcGEGsby5QzsJLRoPotxyDp5ocqbBVr1DzAHkrFYpvhpG4ZvXFTN.jpg)
</center>
#
I started the procedure by preparing with the traditional method of washing, peeling, chopping, the spices to be used, in this case 6 cloves of garlic, and 3 chives with their leaves.Next, I marinated the sardines, which were completely clean, without scales with: the prepared spices, 3 tablespoons of lemon juice and 1/4 tablespoon of salt.I let the sardines rest for 2 hours, so that they were impregnated with the flavor of the spices and I continued proceeding as follows: In a pot I incorporated 3 tablespoons of soy oil, 1/4 tablespoon of cumin and I started to give it a slight stir-fry for a few seconds, this procedure was suggested to me by a relative, because it is the one he uses to give the taste to his sauces. Next, I added the sardines marinated with 3 tablespoons of tomato paste to the pot, continued sautéing for a few more seconds, and added 1 cup of water.I covered the pot, and put it on pressure for 45 minutes.The flavor of the sardines covered with tomato sauce that are obtained with this method is impressive, method, what I consider effective friends, because it allows the total softening of their spines.

Rice and beans was the second food I made.
# ✨ Rice with beans✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_124851289.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23xAiDakukxbFBmzVrVVkFdLMKReTaXfm8Nu5HsQ2b3W1tmjNTnn3CVbGEjHqAYgAYG6Z.jpg)
</center>
#
I started by measuring, checking and washing, 1 cup of red beans.Then, I incorporated them in a pot with 3 cups of water, and 2 tablespoons of oil.I put the pressure cooker on for 20 minutes, and after the time, I already had the soft beans with the colorful water, which I would use for the rice with beans.I continued the procedure by measuring, checking and washing 3 cups of rice, which then I started to sauté them with a small stir-fry previously made of : garlic, chives, cumin, and oil.After 1 minute of finding myself sauteing the rice with the sofrito, I added the reserved beans to the compound with their water and 1/2 tablespoon of salt.I stirred, with the help of a paddle, and put the rice and beans to cook for 6 minutes.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_125544788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23zS7FqH7SA8Ub3YBJgfvJvbk6jL9Jdct11MCALh1V88urKN4uMXe1EL1ge27RwbYfzVu.jpg)
</center>
#
Exquisite, with a predominant cumin flavor, was this rice with beans that combined perfectly with sardines in tomato sauce, and the third food prepared : boiled plantains.

# ✨Boiled bananas✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_125230393.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsUQEW25cm7TYBCDgkpr5uCqGd8t6jsGYSkNrZD67ciVW2Sjm647HCKF3Lmf72Gntr4.jpg)
</center>
#
To make the plantains, I took 5 green plantains, washed them, stripped their peel with the help of a knife, and put them to boil for 15 minutes, in a container with: water to cover them, 1/3 tablespoon of salt, 1 tablespoon of lemon juice.Lemon, it is always advisable to use it to avoid the dark coloration.After a while I took them out for a container, where I cut them into slices of about 1 centimeter, and impregnated them with 1 tablespoon of soybean oil, and a touch of garlic powder.Tasty!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260419_125704110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23zS5hocHbAmXw14c8qW1uJ9fVQAPCtYKqVMubYqmkcSkzc6ePg8rgGnQ5NRjTCe9bNWq.jpg)
</center>
#
Friends, I loved this Sunday full of culinary delights as a family.I hope that you have also liked my experience, and that you are encouraged to prepare these recipes of sardines, rice and bananas, for collective events, I assure you that you encantará.Me farewell, wishing you all the culmination of a happy Sunday.Hugs!💁☀️

body.title: Mythos AI: A Cybersecurity Nightmare or the Next Frontier of Defense?
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQiZY1PykRzhGFpxwAQCo3b4rKcJhD6oEHTUAM1U5KRr8/Mythos.png 


The landscape of cybersecurity within the cryptocurrency sector is facing a transformative shift with the emergence of Anthropic’s \

model. Major entities like Coinbase and Binance are rapidly escalating their defensive protocols as this ultra-powerful AI demonstrates an unprecedented capability to identify and exploit software vulnerabilities. Phillip Martin, Chief Security Officer at Coinbase, emphasized that Mythos represents a new class of \

AI that can conduct deep-scale testing of systems, accelerating both defensive capabilities and the evolution of digital threats.

While Anthropic has granted early access to Mythos for high-level institutions such as the White House, Goldman Sachs, and major tech giants like Apple and Google, the cryptocurrency industry has largely been excluded from the initial rollout. This gap has led firms like Binance and Fireblocks to rely on internal models and previous versions, such as Claude Opus 4.6, to simulate attacks and patch vulnerabilities. Michael Shaulov, CEO of Fireblocks, noted that even older AI generations have uncovered significant flaws previously missed by traditional security audits.

The urgency is underscored by recent breaches, such as the $285 million exploit of the decentralized platform Drift, which involved sophisticated social engineering. Experts argue that advanced AI models like Mythos pose a far more immediate threat to the blockchain ecosystem than theoretical risks like quantum computing. While quantum threats remain speculative due to the lack of functional hardware, AI-driven exploits can reduce the time needed to find and execute attacks from weeks to mere minutes.

As the industry awaits broader access to Mythos, the focus has shifted toward \

Companies are no longer just looking for bugs; they are trying to predict the pattern of AI-led aggression. The ability of Mythos to analyze open-source code at scale means that vulnerabilities in DeFi protocols could be discovered and drained almost instantly. Consequently, the crypto sector is now in a high-stakes race to integrate similar AI-driven defenses before the \
threats become accessible to bad actors.\n\nPosted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@pichat/mythos-ai-a-cybersecurity-nightmare-or-the-next-frontier-of-defense-g6w)

body.title: Las aventuras de Aramis / The Adventures of Aramis
body.body:
<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2yp7cnzjqeVaxGGWf9rmgpzAka7a2J9QgKKgqAR6oHS/_d_nde_est_mi_gatita.png</center>

En los próximos días, mi gatita Aramis cumplirá ya 3 años de vida, y aunque a esa edad creo que debería estar más asentada en cuanto a su comportamiento, se mantiene súper activa, pidiendo casi siempre salir a explorar los alrededores del edificio donde vivimos.

De hecho, casi todos los días tengo una conversación \

con ella, pues solo quiere estar en casa para comer y tomar agua, y luego volver a salir a jugar con sus amigos callejeros, a quienes parece invitar de vez en cuando a casa, pues me llegan a pedir comida casi todo el tiempo.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaxhdCs3g6LWRBApcRYwmsPu5xk3tHcQQh4Eh4hzMo7cH/_d_nde_est_mi_gatita_1_.png)</center>

Apenas abro la puerta, ella corre y se pierde escaleras abajo, pero este día logré captarla en sus travesuras, que la mantienen activa, a veces sola y otras veces se reúne con sus amigos gatos que son del vecindario.

Lo que me sorprendió fue su capacidad de moverse tan rápido, y en un abrir y cerrar de ojos ya está sobre el techo de un depósito que queda contiguo al edificio, que es donde la capturé de primero.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaHjUZHpjSFDK3WkfCy7DffdZT2NUY1feLjh2gMHYg8Nk/_d_nde_est_mi_gatita_3_.png)</center>

Pero no solo se queda ahí, sino que se pasa a los demás techos, explorando un poco, lo que me gusta porque me da cierta tranquilidad de que no se va a perder.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP9MH9dMfdS4CCFAdKqWiocNuYBRCpthHw2GPNyMzr4ik/_d_nde_est_mi_gatita_4_.png)</center>

Por ahora, ella aprovecha el buen clima para pasar más tiempo fuera de casa, y cuando vuelve está tan cansada que come y se acuesta a descansar. Lo mejor es que se acostumbró a hacer sus necesidades en el espacio de tierra que hay en la zona inferior, con lo cual me ahorro el tener que comprar piedritas sanitarias y limpiar a cada tanto.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4wkaDbHEKQzxaoasvdY8KvmKfWodXkXfgpbNjuXWJa8/_d_nde_est_mi_gatita_5_.png)</center>

Y así se van los días de mi gatita, mientras el clima resulta favorable para estar fuera de casa, y se mantiene en forma, pues come a cada ratico, como si no hubiera un mañana.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

In the next few days, my kitten Aramis will turn 3 years old, and although I think she should be a bit more settled in her behavior at this age, she remains super active, almost always asking to go out and explore the area around the building where we live.

In fact, almost every day I have a “mother-daughter” conversation with her, since she only wants to be home to eat and drink water, and then go back out to play with her stray friends, whom she seems to invite over from time to time, since they come to ask me for food almost all the time.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaxhdCs3g6LWRBApcRYwmsPu5xk3tHcQQh4Eh4hzMo7cH/_d_nde_est_mi_gatita_1_.png)</center>

As soon as I open the door, she runs off and disappears down the stairs, but today I managed to catch her in the middle of her antics, which keep her active—sometimes alone, and other times she meets up with her cat friends from the neighborhood.

What surprised me was her ability to move so fast; in the blink of an eye, she’s already on the roof of a storage shed next to the building—which is where I first spotted her.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaHjUZHpjSFDK3WkfCy7DffdZT2NUY1feLjh2gMHYg8Nk/_d_nde_est_mi_gatita_3_.png)</center>

But she doesn’t just stay there; she moves on to the other roofs, exploring a bit, which I like because it gives me some peace of mind that she won’t get lost.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP9MH9dMfdS4CCFAdKqWiocNuYBRCpthHw2GPNyMzr4ik/_d_nde_est_mi_gatita_4_.png)</center>

For now, she’s taking advantage of the nice weather to spend more time outside, and when she comes back, she’s so tired that she eats and lies down to rest. The best part is that she’s gotten used to doing her business in the patch of dirt at the bottom, which saves me from having to buy litter and clean up every so often.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4wkaDbHEKQzxaoasvdY8KvmKfWodXkXfgpbNjuXWJa8/_d_nde_est_mi_gatita_5_.png)</center>

And that’s how my little cat spends her days—as long as the weather’s nice enough to be outside—and she stays in shape, since she eats every few minutes, as if there were no tomorrow.

***

body.title: THINKING ABOUT MARCH... (PHOTOGRAPHY SERIES)
body.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AK3duyBCzFAjaucHUR8aYEkDvxxV1Z6oSqW2vPD1UwUpDc5Ejbm1E762fbVrsWc.jpg)

-----

**T**oday I reviewed my recent files. More precisely, my files from last March. And among the many things I thought about while searching for and finding unpublished photographs, I couldn't help but notice how distant these images seemed. In fact, looking at them, I felt as if they belonged to a very distant past, not to a month that only ended 20 days ago. But that's often the case for me. Or perhaps it's common for many people here, since \

is a frequent topic among neighbors and family members in any casual, everyday conversation. And it's true, in these small towns, I think, that time tends to compress or expand depending on the mood of the person thinking about it. And I know it sounds strange, because, as I read somewhere—I can't remember where—time itself is nothing more than a measure invented by ourselves. But I'm not here to talk about relativity and related things. The truth is, I just wanted to point out that, at least today, it seemed to me that the days here have lengthened. And it seems to me, by the way, that the ones that drag on are those from the past, because as far as the present and the future are concerned, those seem short and pass quickly...\n\n**A**nd I suppose you yourselves have recently noticed how much abstraction there is in what I write. And well, the truth is that even I've noticed it. But I don't hold back, because I think it's simply that I'm having \
and therefore, I end up writing it down. And I think that's also part of, and a cause of, the existence of this blog of mine here on #Hive. I'm referring to \

to writing as I'm thinking, because after all, I tend to fluctuate frequently. And certainly, it's good to use this space to put it all down in writing...\n\n>**H**oy revisé mis archivos recientes. Más precisamente, mis archivos de Marzo pasado. Y entre tantas cosas que pensé mientras buscaba y encontraba fotografías inéditas, no pude evitar en cuan lejanas me parecían estas imágenes. De hecho, al mirarlas sentí la sensación de que correspondían a un pasado muy lejano y no a un mes que recién ha terminado 20 días atrás. Pero así suele sucederme. O quizás le suele suceder a mucha gente aquí, pues \

es un tema común entre vecinos y familiares en cualquier conversación casual y cotidiana. Y es que, en estos pueblos pequeños, pienso yo, el tiempo tiende a comprimirse o a expandirse según el humor de quien lo piensa. Y sé que suena extraño, porque según leí no recuerdo donde, el tiempo en si mismo no es más que una medida inventada por nosotros mismos. Pero no estoy aquí para hablar de relatividad y cosas afines. La verdad, solo quería señalar que, cuando menos hoy, a mi me pareció que aquí los días se han alargado. Y me parece, por cierto,  que los que se alargan son los del pasado, porque en lo que se refiere al presente y el futuro; esos parecen cortos y pasar rápido... \n\n>**Y** supongo que ustedes mismos últimamente se han percatado de cuanta abstracción se aprecia en lo que escribo. Y bueno, la verdad es que incluso yo me he percatado de eso mismo. Pero no me privo, pues creo que ocurre que simplemente estoy en \
y por ende, termino escribiéndolo. Y creo que eso eso es también parte y causa de la existencia de este mi blog aquí en #Hive. Me refiero a la \

, a eso de escribir como estoy pensando, porque después de todo, tiendo a oscilar con frecuencia. Y ciertamente, es bueno usar este espacio para dejarlo plasmado...   

-----

![T01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23uFRTsmRF2tRdFPGUo8jNaMK1cdE1Dkw8HUHMM2wGQcQWA1bYw22qSs8ZorJrPYCMo7m.jpg)

Sí, exactamente eso... </sub>**

----

![T03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23yJA1YjZkhKv6Vp1s9tiSoEgecX7XTzhVyKvsN1T1tYP8FcUajR9UP7YdvewzhyPMpaU.jpg)

body.title: Mi entrada al concurso TopFiveFamily Observa Piensa Escribe: Caucho pinchado, es un golpe al bolsillo.
body.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS4jatqWJFP5vScAneogt5f81CNpnkDcQj3trarTnmspE/image.png)
</center>
# <center>***Caucho pinchado, es un golpe al bolsillo.***</center>
<div class=\

>Desde muy temprano me dispongo a viajar a la ciudad de Barquisimeto en una buseta, hasta el momento todo se desarrollaba con normalidad, cuando de repente el tráfico se hace más lento y comienza a formarse una cola, tanto en el canal de ida como en el de venida, disminución de velocidad, luces intermitentes en los carros, señal de alerta en la vía, en efecto, había un accidente.

Prácticamente por la magnitud del accidente la vía estaba cerrada, mientras las autoridades hacían el levantamiento del accidente. Al no poder avanzar, nos tocó esperar y el chofer nos dice que eso va a tardar, pueden bajar y están atentos a la hora de retomar el viaje. En estos casos la curiosidad es saber qué pasó, los que lograron llegar un poco más cerca del accidente y algunos testigos comentaban que la falla se había originado porque el caucho se pinchó con una especie de clavo, lo hizo perder el control y chocar con otro carro. Los expertos en tránsito y el resultado del levantamiento del accidente lograron dar con la causa, en efecto, un caucho pinchado, motivo por el cual el conductor al ser sorprendido trató de dominar la máquina pero al venir a una velocidad considerable, se estrelló con otro carro. El resultado son solo daños materiales que pudieron evitarse. Por lo general, hay unas bandas de delincuentes que operan en ciertos lugares críticos que usan unos clavos también llamados miguelitos que al pinchar el caucho, el conductor busca estacionarse y es justamente el momento cuando los delincuentes caen para atracar. Todo este inconveniente trae un desaguste en el presupuesto, tal como están las cosas, ya sea comprar o arreglar repuestos para autos, es un verdadero golpe al bolsillo.

body.title: Hechizos para olvidar - Adrienne Young ///  Spells to Forget - Adrienne Young
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdQC5t4zYA29SJZAX2aW2k7U5q2WwEn5VpjM4aCqiiwfA/1776624357842.jpg)</center>
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUu68NUW4c7pt8BYs5pjdsvzs3WYomovydGCdGtraegVG/img_0.6108203491677975.jpg)</center>

Hola a todos, espero que estén bien y que hayan tenido un lindo día. Hoy les quiero compartir sobre una lectura que me ha encantado y que he terminado de leer hace muy poco. Se trata de una historia cuya trama me atrapó por completo; pertenece al género de romance y tiene una literatura fluida y encantadora que te envuelve desde la primera página. Hechizos para olvidar es un libro que nos transporta a un rincón del mundo donde la magia no es solamente un cuentos de hadas, sino una presencia constante, silenciosa y profunda, arraigada en la misma tierra y en la sangre de sus habitantes. Esta historia se desarrolla en la fascinante y misteriosa isla de Saoirse, un lugar rodeado de niebla perpetua y leyendas antiguas, donde el tiempo parece avanzar a su propio ritmo y los recuerdos se niegan a marchitarse.
#
La protagonista es Emery Blackwood, una mujer cuya vida quedó fracturada hace una década por una tragedia que cambió el destino de toda su comunidad, la muerte de su mejor amiga Lily. Emery es la heredera de una larga tradición de mujeres con conocimientos sobre las propiedades de la naturaleza; ahora, como dueña de la tienda de té de la isla, pasa sus días entre hierbas, infusiones y los ecos de una herencia que no todos en el pueblo ven con buenos ojos. Sin embargo, su frágil estabilidad se tambalea cuando, después de diez años de un exilio forzado por la sospecha, August Salt regresa a casa. August no es un visitante cualquiera, fue el joven que Emery amó, pero también el principal acusado de la muerte de Lily y del incendio que devastó parte de la isla aquella fatídica noche de graduación. Su regreso es como una herida que se abre de nuevo; los isleños, que han enterrado sus dolores bajo capas de resentimiento, miedo y silencio, no están dispuestos a perdonar ni a olvidar. Pero para Emery, la vuelta de August no solo despierta sentimientos que creía haber sepultado, sino que trae consigo la certeza de que la verdad que todos aceptaron hace años está llena de grietas, por esto mismo Emery y August comienzan a desenterrar los secretos que la isla de Saoirse ha guardado celosamente. No se trata solo de un crimen sin resolver, sino de una red de traiciones y pactos oscuros que involucran a casi todos los habitantes.
#
Esta historia nos deja lecciones profundas como que la verdad es la única herramienta capaz de romper el ciclo del dolor. En Saoirse, muchos prefieren recurrir a “hechizos” para enterrar traumas. Sin embargo, el pasado no desaparece por no mirarlo; lo que se oculta termina envenenando el presente. Perdonar no significa olvidar, sino tener la valentía de enfrentar la realidad para poder sanar. Al mismo tiempo, la historia es un testimonio de que el amor verdadero no muere, solo espera. A pesar de los diez años de separación y las sospechas, la conexión entre Emery y August demuestra que, cuando existe un vínculo real, el tiempo y la distancia son solo pruebas. Las conexiones auténticas dejan una huella imborrable que ni la presión social ni los errores del pasado pueden borrar. El amor, cuando es genuino, siempre encuentra el camino de regreso a casa.

*<center>Espero les haya gustado 
Que Dios los Bendiga 🙏
 Feliz Noche</center>*

# ***<center>Créditos </center>***

-	Imágenes tomadas como captures de pantalla con celular Infinix Hot 40i
-	Contenido de mi autoría 
-	Traductor usado: DeepL app

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdU2jaVDoyaen8XU5v7aDi6p7UqyGet29whZXQwDQX9gW/img_0.8432625036666158.jpg)</center>


<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdQC5t4zYA29SJZAX2aW2k7U5q2WwEn5VpjM4aCqiiwfA/1776624357842.jpg)</center>

Hello everyone, I hope you’re all doing well and had a nice day. Today I want to tell you about a book I absolutely loved and just finished reading. It’s a story whose plot completely captivated me; it belongs to the romance genre and has a fluid, enchanting writing style that draws you in from the very first page. *Spells to Forget* is a book that transports us to a corner of the world where magic isn’t just a fairy tale, but a constant, silent, and profound presence, rooted in the very earth and in the blood of its inhabitants. This story takes place on the fascinating and mysterious island of Saoirse, a place shrouded in perpetual fog and ancient legends, where time seems to move at its own pace and memories refuse to fade.
#
The protagonist is Emery Blackwood, a woman whose life was shattered a decade ago by a tragedy that changed the fate of her entire community: the death of her best friend, Lily. Emery is the heir to a long tradition of women with knowledge of nature’s properties; now, as the owner of the island’s tea shop, she spends her days among herbs, infusions, and the echoes of a legacy that not everyone in town views favorably. However, her fragile stability is shaken when, after ten years of exile forced by suspicion, August Salt returns home. August is no ordinary visitor; he was the young man Emery loved, but also the prime suspect in Lily’s death and the fire that devastated part of the island on that fateful graduation night. His return is like a wound that reopens; the islanders, who have buried their pain beneath layers of resentment, fear, and silence, are unwilling to forgive or forget. But for Emery, August’s return not only stirs up feelings she thought she had buried, but also brings with it the certainty that the truth everyone accepted years ago is riddled with cracks. For this very reason, Emery and August begin to unearth the secrets that the island of Saoirse has jealously guarded. This is not just an unsolved crime, but a web of betrayals and dark pacts involving nearly all the inhabitants.
#
This story offers profound lessons, such as the fact that truth is the only tool capable of breaking the cycle of pain. In Saoirse, many prefer to resort to “spells” to bury their traumas. However, the past doesn’t disappear just because we don’t look at it; what is hidden ends up poisoning the present. Forgiving doesn’t mean forgetting, but having the courage to face reality in order to heal. At the same time, the story is a testament to the fact that true love doesn’t die—it just waits. Despite ten years of separation and suspicion, the connection between Emery and August proves that, when there is a real bond, time and distance are merely tests. Authentic connections leave an indelible mark that neither social pressure nor past mistakes can erase. Love, when it is genuine, always finds its way back home.

*<center>I hope you enjoyed it 
God bless you 🙏
 Good night</center>*

body.title: Rainy day….
body.body:
Afternoon everyone….

So today it is pouring out here. Not only that but it got much much colder. Going from the nineties to the low fifties and down into the low forties tonight. Such a huge change in just two days.

Today I am going to share a piece with you, yet again from the Intaglio Mint. Every time that I get an order from them, I am always fascinated by the immense detail they are able to capture on such a small silver round.

This round is part of their “Molon Labe” series. Which over the years now has become quite immense.

Four years ago our lovely government required all businesses regardless of the state they were in to collect the sales taxes for each and every state they sold merchandise to.

**_Well…._**

With the Intaglio Mint being such a small privately owned mint. This was a huge undertaking. At that time they didn’t not have the man power or the means to accomplish this requirement by the government and decided to only sell to dealers or businesses with a tax ID number.

**_So their items became way over priced by the monopolizing bullion dealers._**

For over two years now they are back to running as normal and I’m so glad they are.

**_The piece shown today is a Molon Labe round with a Spartan riding a horse while in combat._**

The detail is quite amazing.

And for you that would like a little information about the meaning and origin of Molon Labe. Below is a snipit from Wikipedia.

Molon labe (Ancient Greek: μολὼν λαβέ, romanized: molṑn labé), meaning 'come and take \[them\]', is a classical expression of defiance. It is among the Laconic phrases reported by Plutarch, attributed to King Leonidas I in reply to the demand by Xerxes I that the Spartans surrender their weapons. The exchange between Leonidas and Xerxes occurs in writing, on the eve of the Battle of Thermopylae (480 BC).

As for its origin:

Plutarch cites the phrase in his Apophthegmata Laconica (\

). The exchange between Leonidas and Xerxes occurs in writing, on the eve of the Battle of Thermopylae (480 BC): πάλιν δὲ τοῦ Ξέρξου γράψαντος 'πέμψον τὰ ὅπλα,' ἀντέγραψε 'μολὼν λαβέ.' When Xerxes wrote again, 'Hand over your arms,' he wrote in reply, 'Come and take them.' (trans. Frank Cole Babbitt, 1931) The exchange is cited in a collection of sayings by Leonidas before the Battle of Thermopylae (51.2–15). The main source for the events of the battle is Herodotus. According to his account, the Spartans held Thermopylae for three days, and although ultimately defeated, they inflicted serious damage on the Persian army. Most importantly, this delayed the Persians' progress to Athens, providing sufficient time for the city's evacuation to the island of Salamis. Though a tactical defeat, Thermopylae served as a strategic and moral victory, inspiring the Greek forces to defeat the Persians at the Battle of Salamis later the same year and the Battle of Plataea one year later. **_Now for the round….._**

body.body:
Happy Sunday Fellas,

It’s the start of a new week and I’m hopeful that this is gonna be a better week than the previous one. So what are you guys up to? I’ve been working all day today didn’t even have time to rest but that usually happens some weekends. Man gotta work when he’s younger so he can benefit from his grind when he grows older. I actually planned to win 15 battles today on the FRONTIER league but work didn’t not permit me to. Being that I’m a Splinterlands addict, man still managed to win 5 battles before the end of the day. Got to claim a set of daily prizes in the FRONTIER league. 2 foundation cards were in the set of prizes alongside an entry into the weekly FORTUNE Draw. One of the cards happened to be a RARE card which made my day actually. The name of the cards that I got for today were the MOROS MALIK which was the RARE card and the SPINETAIL FIEND which is a Regular card. Buenas noches comunidad, estaba desaparecido, pero ya regresé. Es que estaba corriendo en ROMA.

De repente Apazita me dice “ y si hacemos el maratón de Roma” y yo dije OK, terminamos corriendo en el viejo continente. 

Demasiadas historias y anécdotas, desde el viaje de ida hasta el regreso, comida, entrenamiento, alojamiento, competencia, clima, zapatos, uniforme, personas, corredores, son demasiadas cosas y no se como comenzar.  

Creo que empezaré con la entrega del dorsal, entramos a una especie de feria, recorrimos muchísimos stands, y conocimos muchísimas marcas europeas de geles y materiales deportivos, Incluso me compre una chaqueta del evento. 

No diré mentiras, llegamos a Roma un Jueves, corrimos el Domingo y comimos pasta, pizza, canelones, tiramisú, zepolas, pasticho, y demás. La carga calórica y el glucógeno estuvieron bien recargados además de un corazón feliz porque la comida estaba deliciosa.   

El día de la competencia si estuvo rudo, estábamos a tres estaciones del evento, llegar era fácil pero el clima estaba muy muy frio, temperaturas de 6° a 7° grados, con sensación térmica de 3°C, realmente estaba temblando del frio.


A las 7:00 a.m. salía el primer corral, y cada media hora liberaban un corral. En mi caso pude comenzar la competencia a las 8:30 a.m. y por eso tuve que esperar una hora y media dentro del corral con frio.  

Durante toda la carrera tuve los pies y las manos entumecidos, incluso llovió y cada gota se sentía como un cubo de hielo, sin embargo, el objetivo se logró, realicé un PR para el maratón extranjero, en condiciones extremas y sentimientos volcánicos. 

Gracias Apazita por invitarme a excelente viaje, si pudiera viajar en el tiempo, volvería al día 1 del viaje solo para estar contigo en tan hermoso lugar, y comer pasta sentado en la plaza del Popolo.

body.title: A DAILY WORD IN FRENCH (#31)
body.body:
https://media.tenor.com/ktY5NsZvX1IAAAAC/reading-education.gif 

Hello my fellow learners, it’s been a little while again and I hope we are still keeping up with our French journey! I wish you anll an happy Sunday as well! It’s the start of a new week and I hope we are all hapoy and excited to dive the new week. 
Even if you feel like you’ve forgotten some things I have been teaching don’t worry learning a language is all about repetition and consistency and with time you will be there! Just go back and read the lessons you forgot. 

 https://media.tenor.com/By_HEtMVyu8AAAAC/learn-how-to.gif 


Today’s word is APPRENDRE, and I want us to take our time to truly understand it not just cram it because it is a very important French word related to learning. 

What does today’s word mean?  
Apprendre means “to learn.” 📘 haha 😛  i must have got you there!  
We learn every single day whether consciously or unconsciously and sometimes we do learn without even realizing it. We learn fom conversations, experiences, mistakes and even silence that is why learning is always happening. 
It is a continuous process. 
For example, you might watch someone do something and pick up a new idea without sitting down to study it formally.


 https://media.tenor.com/22VtvWVtPmoAAAAC/education-learning.gif 

As a teacher (and even as a writer) learning never really stops. In fact, the more you teach the more you realize how much there is still to learn and I personally believe that learning is one of the most powerful habits anyone can build. 
It keeps you growing, improving and adapting to life which is the only way to survive and succeed. 

 https://media.tenor.com/Tr839isB9MIAAAAC/lots-to-learn-benjamin.gif 


There was a time I thought learning only happened in school, but life proved me wrong because every challenge I faced taught me something new. 
Maybe I don’t learn how to make money like we love to hear but sometimes I learn patience, sometimes discipline and sometimes how to simply try again! 
That’s the beauty of apprendre, over time it shapes who we become.

Pronunciation is like: ah-prahn-druh  

Read these few lines below to give you an idea on how to quickly conjugate the word to be used in sentences properly.  

If you memorize this, it will be helpful for your daily French vocabulary.

J’apprends — I learn  
Tu apprends — You learn  
Nous apprenons — We learn  

These are examples:

J’apprends le français = I learn French  
Nous apprenons ensemble = We learn together  

Ensemble means “together.”

It’s a simple word but very powerful in everyday life because as long as you keep learning, you keep growing.

 https://media.tenor.com/-D9WYi8GmP0AAAAC/read.gif 

Thank you for reading 
SAINT HEROD

body.title: 😲 Christopher Lee… Singing metal? Yes, and it sounds brutal 👍 [Eng+Spa] Christopher Lee… ¿Cantando metal? Sí, y suena brutal.
body.body: * * * * * * (Versión en español más abajo). ------------------------------- * * * * * * I recently got one of those surprises that brighten your day (and leave you thinking for a while). It turns out that **Christopher Lee**, yes, _that same_ actor that many of us remember from _The Lord of the Rings_ or _Star Wars_, also sang... rock metal! 🤘 And not only that: according to what I read, he once held the record of being the **oldest metal singer in the world** because he sang precisely the song that I was listening to when he had already turned 90 years old. Honestly, I didn't see it coming. 🎧 The discovery ---------------- While browsing a little, I came across a song called _“Massacre Of The Saxons”_, from the album _Charlemagne: The Omens of Death_ (2013). And well… I gave it play without many expectations. But what a surprise.

>Image source.

The song has a quite particular approach: it is as if Charlemagne was narrating the massacre of the Saxons in Verdun, all accompanied by quite powerful metal music. That is, history + metal + Christopher Lee… Unexpected combo! And the best: **sounds good**. Pretty good, in fact. 🏰 An actor… with many lives ---------------------------- For me, Christopher Lee had always been that towering actor in many films over several decades, although in recent times he may be best remembered for two particular roles: * Saruman in _The Lord of the Rings_ * Count Dooku in _Star Wars_ But of course, the man had a much more intense life than one imagines. That famous anecdote always comes to mind during the filming of _The Two Towers_, in the _Lord of the Rings_ trilogy. The director was not convinced of what his scream sounded like when he was stabbed and asked him to repeat the scene several times. Until Lee, already a little tired, said something like: \

😶 That phrase… ugh. He has that air of someone who **has experienced real things**, possibly related to his military past (of which there is a lot of mystery). And yes, you feel that mix of experience, character, and an intimidating touch. All within the field of experience of a military veteran who has set foot in the field of war. 🤘 Bloody story 🩸… but good metal 🤘🎶 --------------------------------------- Back to the song: yes, the historical theme is quite raw. It's not exactly a light story. But even so, the way it is told, with that energy and theatricality, makes it very interesting. I didn't expect to hear a **British Sir** singing epic metal about medieval massacres... but here we are 😅. And the best: I enjoyed it quite a bit. ▶️ Listen to it yourself: ------------------------- Here I leave the video for you to see (and understand me better): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XFbPiUEA62A Video source: [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XFbPiUEA62A) * * * In the end, these types of discoveries are what make it fun to get lost on the Internet for a while. You never know what you're going to find 😄. * * * * * *

> (English version above). ------------------------ * * * * * * 😲 Christopher Lee… ¿Cantando metal? Sí, y suena brutal. ======================================================== Hace poco me llevé una de esas sorpresas que te alegran el día (y te dejan pensando un rato). Resulta que **Christopher Lee**, sí, _ese mismo_ actor que muchos recordamos por _El Señor de los Anillos_ o _Star Wars_, también cantaba… ¡Rock metal! 🤘 Y no solo eso: según leí, llegó a tener el récord de ser el **cantante de metal más longevo del mundo**, porque cantó justamente la canción que yo estaba escuchando cuando ya había cumplido sus 90 años de vida. Honestamente, no lo vi venir. 🎧 El descubrimiento -------------------- Curioseando un poco, me topé con una canción llamada _“Massacre Of The Saxons”_, del disco _Charlemagne: The Omens of Death_ (2013). Y bueno… le di play sin muchas expectativas. Pero vaya sorpresa.

> [Fuente de la imagen.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlemagne:_The_Omens_of_Death) La canción tiene un enfoque bastante particular: es como si **Carlomagno estuviera narrando la masacre de los sajones en Verdún**, todo acompañado de una base de metal bastante potente. O sea, historia + metal + Christopher Lee… ¡Combo inesperado! Y lo mejor: **suena bien**. Bastante bien, de hecho. 🏰 Un actor… con muchas vidas ----------------------------- Para mí, Christopher Lee siempre había sido ese actor imponente de muchas películas durante varias décadas, aunque puede que en tiempos recientes se le recuerde más por dos papeles particulares: * Saruman en _El Señor de los Anillos_ * Conde Dooku en _Star Wars_ Pero claro, el señor tenía una vida mucho más intensa de lo que uno imagina. Siempre me viene a la mente esa famosa anécdota durante el rodaje de _Las Dos Torres_, en la trilogía de _El Señor de los Anillos_. El director no estaba convencido de cómo sonaba su grito al ser apuñalado, y le pidió repetir la escena varias veces. Hasta que Lee, ya un poco cansado, le soltó algo como: “¿Sabes cómo suena un hombre cuando lo apuñalan? Porque yo sí.” 😶 Esa frase… uff. Tiene ese aire de alguien que **ha vivido cosas reales**, posiblemente relacionadas con su pasado militar (del cual hay bastante misterio). Y sí, se siente esa mezcla de experiencia, carácter y un toque intimidante. Todo dentro del campo de experiencia de un veterano militar que ha pisado campo de guerra. 🤘 Historia sangrienta… pero buen metal. 🤘 ------------------------------------------- Volviendo a la canción: sí, el tema histórico es bastante crudo. No es precisamente una historia ligera. Pero aun así, la forma en que está contada, con esa energía y teatralidad, la hace muy interesante. No esperaba escuchar a un **Sir británico** cantando metal épico sobre masacres medievales… pero aquí estamos 😅. Y lo mejor: lo disfruté bastante. ▶️ Escúchala tú mismo: ---------------------- Aquí te dejo el video para que lo veas (y me entiendas mejor): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XFbPiUEA62A Fuente del video: [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XFbPiUEA62A) * * * Al final, este tipo de descubrimientos son los que hacen divertido perderse un rato en internet. Nunca sabes con qué te vas a encontrar 😄.

body.title: Agility Training and the Krudum Ascent * Agility tréninky a výstup na Krudum
body.body:
Hi everyone!
The dogs and I have been busy training over the past week. We hit the training grounds three times and even squeezed in a run through the nearby woods with the whole pack.
Here’s a quick recap of each session!

**

*Ahoj!
V uplynulém týdnu jsem toho se psy natrénoval opravdu hodně. Třikrát jsme vyrazili na cvičák a jednou jsem si byl se smečkou zaběhat v okolních lesích.
O každém z těchto tréninků se zde nyní stručně zmíním.*

![1000093780.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/EpEJFJjAHyhRw8tbvh97uJoBrc3SjeMLE99oaGjiZ49pyuoUQLLHFYPNstJqtDA3qsr.jpg)

Lately, I’ve been focusing mostly on Oggy’s weave pole training.

**

*V poslední době se s Oggym nejvíce soustředíme na trénink slalomu.*

***

<center> **Wednesday** * ***Středa*** </center>

On Wednesday, in addition to weave pole training, we also worked on the stay, which is very important. Oggy is starting to get it.
For a change, I brought out two jumps so the dogs could run around and review the basics.

**

*Ve středu jsme se kromě tréninku slalomu věnovali také odložení, které je velmi důležité. Oggymu to začíná jít.
Pro změnu jsem vytáhl dvě skokové překážky, aby se psi proběhli a zopakovali si základy.*

<center> 
![1000093698.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23wqgD5syDS5AwVaydd9nqeqxjyrtDDRjWwjcmLymstcFr7x3gNFdLLapgwb6u2gWz6Pm.gif)
 </center>

![1000093696.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23t7h5FcVyuKgtXsCpKQEt378JvWjiVzB8TixbpU11PF2q4VAjbLodKhtseEYHhzQhhnM.jpg)

<center> ⬇️**Basics** * ***Základy***⬇️ </center>

<center>
![1000093695.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/2458L4wiuXWgUuVhthQ6nqDd31Ff9WLvVryVrbn8UxwJnaNBASujyyLoavZi6QvfJvEGf.gif)
</center>

![1000041964.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23xyvixEw5woHh1AvkKbovLzJ7KhixNWj1PsQVRHnycYuYmGEx73Yvo3rpHfHz65q668L.jpg)

<center> **Friday** * ***Pátek*** </center>

On Friday, we focused more on weave pole training. Cesmína practiced these basics about six years ago, but she kept demanding to join in, so she got to run as well.

**

*V pátek jsme se zaměřili více na slalomový trénink. Cesmína tyto základy trénovala asi před šesti lety, ale tak moc se dožadovala pozornosti, že si nakonec zaběhala také.*

***

<center> **I’m teaching the weave poles using the 2x2 method.** </center>
I’ve tailored the method a bit, and I hope Oggy catches on soon.

<center> ** </center>

<center> ***Slalom učím metodou 2x2.*** </center>
*Tuto metodu jsem si trochu upravil a doufám, že si ji Oggy brzy osvojí.*

***

Here you can see us training the first six poles. A full weave channel consists of twelve poles in total. In this photo, we are currently working on setup number four.

**

*Tady je vidět, jak trénujeme prvních šest tyček. Celý slalom jich má celkem dvanáct. Na této fotce jsme zrovna u nákresu číslo čtyři.*

![1000093770.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/Eo28Qz8bc4en4LXd864BJow8UDHu7pe7uT6eJT68dXuwg6VNng9aKRqCdEeuUGcYTsE.jpg)

***

<center> **Oggy** </center>

<center> 
![1000093777.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23yJCYctSS1v4WhS28dVtR2QcC1zCzBmuBbwPEM8h7T6XCEtxzPQZatJNgueDpUMDrJao.gif)
 </center>

![1000093699.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/EogMNRDqerGJLg7Qu3ioAifggQ3afXLJ9wPDbxxB7z5iiTznWJDPRpE8oTNjc9aS5Pb.jpg)

<center> Here’s one run that didn’t quite go as planned. </center>

<center> ** </center>

<center> *Tady je jedno nepovedené proběhnutí.* </center>

![1000093700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23wWu6L9wnFAcRTnDsTC6uUr1tNo2K64zKE65b5DF8kjAjexeKxq4828hNWhbRigqAvT7.jpg)

***

<center> **Cesmína** </center>

You can see that Cesmína is still able to find her entry to the weave poles, even from a greater distance.

**

*Na Cesmíně je vidět, že si náběh do slalomu najde i z větší vzdálenosti.*

<center> 
![1000093778.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/2423qKvaK8TdVZQUzEtmuHZ2ESKW4U6kDhTR2VSkzzXq5TvoPwkNjT2QM1MeYTDbALAcw.gif)
</center>

![1000093692.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/Ep1Vx4rGTNsMM9EahaNTa7RzgFiJtPATBBujAjQcFfeBmGEHo7LTqbBRuSS1924d1Xh.jpg)

To break up the routine, I set up a tunnel and two jumps.

**

*Pro rozptýlení jsem pak připravil tunel a dvě skokové překážky.*

![1000093694.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23yJDwxsiMsFpd1Nk2kryEjxq5nKRYSMZcaci6UEANHS4cTDTiuiAp2mEgBcxg6QUdCVJ.gif)

![1000041964.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23xyvixEw5woHh1AvkKbovLzJ7KhixNWj1PsQVRHnycYuYmGEx73Yvo3rpHfHz65q668L.jpg)

<center> **Saturday** * ***Sobota*** </center>

On Saturday, we went to an official agility practice. Oggy ran his longest sequence of obstacles yet, and Cesmína finally got back into the swing of things with a proper workout.

**

*V sobotu jsme vyrazili na oficiální agility trénink. Oggy tam zdolal svou dosud nejdelší sekvenci překážek a Cesmína si konečně zase pořádně zatrénovala.*

<center> **Cesmína** </center>

![1000093679.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23tbsGU1o6Vs2sAVPxNRjcjymVB5WAdvfeoHexbfwYEothZbmVUsZdfJY2XhqmrBaRQar.jpg)

![1000093673.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23uQp4tHXNaUZrp7E6SoWQJC14Y3ATFdDpSkhB6GA4R2UAiMVjVVASenPtzCEVkGuC3Sg.jpg)

![1000093674.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23uFPqPU5WKCQQptNP34BKsWAiy9xJD4f1VZSAvYEZrgtkxb7At6wGG3FNxg5DqYTdc4g.jpg)

<center> 
![1000093689.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23vhwaVpuE9mS2cXC3xhdRCUDKPAVdiEhJxi6NMjwG5ZTzt7fFrciAzQkUiiYNHBGvtqo.gif)
 </center>

<center> **Oggy** </center>

![1000093680.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/EoGxUE2TRi7HD3z3DmomJGRGzWGbFwJpWNdBKgUH27DZN7tnionv7hx2txEAebrgEFE.jpg)

![1000093675.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/Eo6JyJXzmtwhZ8Efw1D5AuqZ8DY3tiXG9zu7MYj6poz6VWE8FCUpa25XAoH6pzUntQz.jpg)

![1000093688.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23tbryfK7M8aaxSfFYAypDDadZA6aVNqdT51Zfht8HFPdXbJ8mB7nipx5akQmeG8CkjLd.gif)

To avoid distracting others, we moved a bit further away and used the breaks between obstacle training to practice the weave poles again.

**

*O kus dál, abychom nerozptylovali ostatní, jsme pauzy mezi trénováním překážek využili k dalšímu procvičování slalomu.*

<center> **Oggy** </center>

![1000093677.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/Ep5kge4WFGqcvnfMUesSWRpQtzAUBL8B6pXJooPc1xXM56Z7VJhsXrhe1noXKgZmzWG.jpg)

![1000093678.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23uFMcHiET5GjNGTYUdPF3uceFbokFjercf4ko1o6xhWDuEPZ9wFBE5U4PGCQvwTwFJ5P.jpg)

![1000093686.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23wWnnwc6jWkF74zkbWjyATfigauGmvvU3QVi7rcwZZJNaRHtXGQXb2jffudfpyfCy9Fu.gif)

![1000041964.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23xyvixEw5woHh1AvkKbovLzJ7KhixNWj1PsQVRHnycYuYmGEx73Yvo3rpHfHz65q668L.jpg)

<center> **Wednesday's Run** * ***Středeční běh*** </center>

On Wednesday, I went for a run in the Slavkov Forest. I wanted to get some elevation gain, so I set the Krudum lookout tower as my goal.
I took Cesmína and my son’s dog, Dante, with me. I had them attached to me on a four-meter leash the entire time.

**

*Ve středu jsem si šel zaběhat do Slavkovského lesa. Chtěl jsem nasbírat nějaké výškové metry, a tak jsem si za cíl zvolil výstup na rozhlednu Krudum.
Vzal jsem s sebou Cesmínu a synova psa Danteho. Po celou dobu jsem je měl připojené k sobě na čtyřmetrovém vodítku.*

![1000093701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23y8jMW28j3s5jEsPdSYStss3rdJB54USYZ4HD5h9z4JfJeLT9Nnb9eoLNQvMhSsu6q9U.jpg)

The final ascent to the lookout tower, as well as the descent, was very demanding.

**

*Finální výstup (ale i sestup) k rozhledně byl hodně náročný.*

![1000093705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/EpVACQVb4zNjhx4n4Hgf1d827CSEDmTNt4xRmv4dDhNtj5t9RkmqaJNvKjzjatkjYx8.jpg)

![1000093709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/242D9rCRg46Q1jpoXcJnmRFtztwXnWne8uSzysM9pmt3zSN9QWiFZvhbk3oHjx9MBdLa1.jpg)

body.title: To silence noise.
body.body:
<Sub>[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/walk-of-silence-forest-silence-4576411/)<sub>





![neurok-walk-of-silence-4576411_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oyebolu/23x9wfswgUC5yVMYiBb4fSmN83MUS8T3fwFFYZGqAbnB6Vp8Qr6reBqwzaAjH2xtQ5y1a.jpg)







The noise still echoed in her head, just as the hammering of the earth's surface does in demagnetization.  The alarm rang continuously as if there was an emergency that must be followed as Mary tried to put it on while snoozing, stretching her hand to pick up her phone.  She grumbled and folded her blanket then unlocked her phone. She scrolled through her phone and looked at the picture she had screenshotted last night.

Dimming her eyes, the picture showcases a man standing with his colleagues, smiling like life had been kind to him. Still effortlessly handsome and composed. Everyone else in the picture looked like part of the movement but the man looked like the reason for it.

“He is a tease !!” rang in her head as she stood up by the window gently pulling open the blinds as soft light began to fill the room.

“ Why is it that the uptown ladies always have something to say when it comes to him” she continued talking about her friend group before going back to her phone which rang immediately as if it wanted her to pick it.

“ Hello babe, how was your night?
“ What sup Bisi, I am fine” she answered the familiar voice on the phone.
“ Go check your guy’s update today, I don't want you to miss today's info. That man has not got over you” her friend replied before the call dropped with good-bye.

Mary quickly went through her social media to search for Benson Amadi, the man she followed in his life online. Every post feels personal to her and she builds a story in her head to feed her fantasy world. He has posted about peace and she thought that he was missing her.

“ Knock, knock !! A sound called her back to reality and an elderly woman came in, she moved through the house with a quiet, practiced rhythm as if every step had been learned long ago and never forgotten. Her back was slightly bent not just from age but from years of work that had shaped her posture into something permanent. She dressed in simple, neat but faded clothes. There was a dignity in the way she carried herself, with no complaints, no rush, just a steady presence that filled the spaces others overlooked.

“ Hi Miss Mary” she said calmly and her voice was soft but clear carrying a quiet authority born not from position but from years of understanding more than she ever said.

“ Can I have a chat with you and hope it will not trigger you” she continued as her eyes spoke something deep and aware, she had seen too much of life to be surprised by anything yet still chose gentleness.

“ Come sit here old lady, you know you are the only one I have after the death of my parents “ Mary said, stretching her hands to help the woman sit on the bed beside her.

“ I have noticed you moved through life guided by echoes rather than instinct.

 Your decisions rarely begin within but by the loudest voice that speaks around you.

 You don't sit with your own thoughts and silence feels unfamiliar and almost uncomfortable for you so you fill it quickly with opinions, trends, and advice from others.

In the world full of noise, you are never truly lost but you are never truly found either”  she gulped saliva and continued.

“I noticed you are living in the shadow of a past relationship you never truly understood.

Can you switch your phone off and stay to yourself today to think it through?” she concluded with a smile.


This never once came to Mary's mind and she nodded her head like an Agama lizard in agreement before the old woman left. Mary brought out her phone and stared at the picture a little longer than she should have, wondering, “Was Benson’s smile ever hers or did she just imagine it?” She reckoned before switching off her phone.

Her journey in the room that whispers nothing was at first an inconvenience as she was a restless type and followed anywhere sound was heard. After some hours in silence, something prompted her mind.

“ Why did you listen to everyone except yourself?” 

She quickly opened her eyes to see if someone was talking to her.

“ Do you know what year it is?” the same inner voice asked and she replied.

“ I never thought of that” she brought out her phone then revisited Benson's post with no emotion, no panic, and just stillness then read the same post again and for the first time, she saw none of it was about her and it never was.

 She sat in a rare moment of quiet reflection as she finally saw the truth and in that silence is where clarity comes.
She understands her mistakes.

 She didn't lose Benson to another woman but lost him to noise, fear, doubt, and lack of self-trust.

She realized that he didn't leave because he stopped loving her but he left because she never believed she was worth loving and she sat in silence, not empty but aware.

And that silence becomes her first step towards growth even though Benson is gone for good.

body.title: Jose Suarez won ERC Rally Sierra Morena 2026
body.body:
Hi, friends! 

Please join our #Rally community which can be found here:
https://hive.blog/trending/hive-109272

European Rally Championship showed once again that fast locals with plenty of experience of the special stages of events where they compete can win against the regular oposition from the series. 

Jose Suarez showed once again his class. I remember his days in the Citroen Rally2 machinery, but these days in Škoda RS Rally2 car, he was really man to beat. Another Spaniard, Ivan Ares (Toyota) also shone bright and finished 2nd overall. 

Apart from these two Spaniards, the best was experienced Italian Giandomenico Basso who already has two ERC titles on his name. Ex-works M-Sport Ford driver Teemu Suninen finished 3rd in another Škoda.  Spaniard Sueiras Cagiao finished 5th with Citroen C3 Rally2 car. 

This was great tarmac event which showed us that European Rally Championship can give a lot to local drivers. 

https://youtu.be/J6V38wBATCU?is=gR48GJLPwpO8U93Z

Credit for photos and videos to WRC and Youtube. 

Vote for @pfunk and @guiltyparties as Hive witnesses.

Give some support to @tenkminnows :)

Grab a beer and enjoy!

Cheers!

_Everything felt urgent; success appeared easy; possibilities abounded; recognition was strong. Then it is rather simple to think that the pace would never ever slow down. Still changing, life is also going through stages. Once hot, what is now silent._

_A young businessman once rose quickly. His name was all over and his work was much sought after. Concentration then abruptly changed._

_Everything began to decreased and the focus suddenly changed. This man began to worry what might have changed in the process._

_A step, not a judgment, is not so hot now. This is a time that calls into doubt identification beyond knowledge. discipline, character, and the will to improve without authorization are all left after the noise stops._

_Every genuine success is born in the quiet after the attention, not in it. It is developed during unpaid work, when nobody is watching._

_Generally, those who stay steady when it's not so blazing come back stronger—wiser, grounded, and ready for long-lasting influence._ **Shalom**

body.body:
In the world of cryptocurrency, attention often gravitates toward large-cap assets like Bitcoin or Ethereum. Yet, history has shown that some of the most explosive gains don’t come from established giants — they come from small, overlooked tokens in their earliest stages.
One such token is RPEPE (RealPepe) — a meme coin on the Solana blockchain that, at first glance, may look insignificant. But beneath its simplicity lies something far more interesting: the structure of early growth.
1. The Reality of Small Beginnings
Every major crypto success story once started small.
Before becoming widely known:
Shiba Inu had almost no value
Dogecoin was dismissed as a joke
Many early projects were ignored due to low liquidity
RPEPE today reflects that same early-stage condition:
Micro market capitalization
Limited holders
Low transaction volume
Minimal exposure
To most investors, this signals risk.
To experienced observers, this signals phase one: accumulation and formation.
2. RPEPE as a Growth Organism
Instead of viewing RPEPE as just another meme coin, it’s more useful to think of it as a living digital organism.
At its current stage, it is not fully developed — it is growing.

Indicates activity and life
Right now, RPEPE is in its infancy stage — fragile but full of potential.

You risk a small amount…

The Appeal

The Reality

This creates a clear truth:
RPEPE is not a safe investment — it is a strategic one.
4. Long-Term Thinking in a Short-Term Market

But real growth — especially for small tokens — takes time.

RPEPE has a simple but powerful identity:

Because in crypto:

It is not backed by massive funding.

But that’s exactly what makes it interesting.
It represents:

body.title: Late to Church, Saved by Preparation: A Sunday of Tests, Teamwork, and Grace
body.body:
Me waking up today by 5.45 and having one great thought in mind that I must be in church by 7:10AM latest is a mission that must be accomplished and must be accomplished very well. 

So Sundays are usually structured for me. I go to church in the morning, I come back home, and I rest.


But today came with one little test. After getting ready, I stepped out and realised that I had to walk to the junction before I could even get a taxi that would take me to church. At a normal time, I immediately boxed out of my house. 

<center>
![Copilot_20260419_160420.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/timscreative/2432LHeREUHGBdFGevx4m4mZPEEtje4feG6KAq5t3pdiCuYCWgmxYfXyJMhSD8A2fuucL.png)
</center>


The taxi is always there, and I'm so lucky that sometimes I'll get to church early. But this time around, no taxi came to my junction. So I have to walk out of the entire estate where I live to take a taxi and then get to church. 

Another issue that happened was that I didn't have money, I meant cash with me. So I have to rely on using a POS person to convert to cash and give it to the taxi driver because many of these taxi drivers don't take transfers of money. They like taking cash. 

So that also delayed me a little before I could make plans and get to church. That short walk plus the wait for a taxi slowly began to eat into my time. By the time I finally got a ride and arrived, I had already spent more than 20 to 30 minutes on the road, and honestly, I was very late by the time I got to church. 

Even though I was late, I was grateful for one thing. Preparation. You see, yesterday I had already had all the choir sing down with the seed of destiny, and everything is done. 

The song that the choir was going to sing today was one I've already checked on yesterday, and everything was going fine. I have gone through it and structured it so that by the time I get to church, I'll have removed the extra time I'm going to use to work on something. So I was not confused or disorganised, and the song was already in my mind and spirit,t and that made everything smoother. 

Sometimes, it's the work you do the day before that quietly saves you from the chaos of the next day and that always worked for me. So we're connected to the headquarters for the service,e but their ownnetworko over there was crappy, and it was not good. For more than 30 minutes while the service was at the headquarters, our home here was not because they could not transmit it perfectly,y, and they were not fully online. 

By the time they came online, the audio was not the re and had to switch to havthe iname prayer section here in church led from the beginning to the end. It went smoothly, and the atmosphere was great. By the time the network was stable, we were already in tune, and the rest of the first service actually flowed even to the second service. 

It came with no issu,e and my entire media team cooperated perfectly well. Pictures and videos, everything was record,ed and every part of our media service went w,ell and I have to give God all the glory for that. Despite the yearly delays and netwproblemsblem, I was ,happy and there was no major challenge, no confliclast-minuteminute crisis. 

Just the grace of God at work, teamwork and a Sunday that is well spent. The next thing I'm going to do today, I thin,k is to watch a movie.

<center></center>

body.body: >Abigail was a pretty girl with so many aspirations on how to change the world. She studied really hard, and it eventually paid off when she was admitted to the university of her choice. She applied to a four-year business management course. Her first year was very decent as she made all her papers, and she was even considered to be the best amongst the first-year students in her level. Due to the fee recognitions she was feeling, she started to let it get into her head. At first, it was subtle, like refusing to attend some lectures, being rude to her fellow course mates, and so on. She eventually started feeling among with the elites in her class, and as a result of this, her grades started dropping as she spent more time going out than actually studying. She would post beautiful pictures online as all these kept increasing her fame, but drastically dropping her grade. She started getting so much attention from guys that everyone started calling her the hottest girl in school. One evening, she decided to skip a lecture to attend a party she was invited to, and on her way to the party, she was involved in an accident. The accident was so bad that she disfigured her face, and her leg was broken. Luckily, the doctor was able to save her life, but the scars of the accident remained. The people whom she had thought were her closest friends started to leave her gradually as they saw her as a liability because they got tired of pushing her around in a wheelchair, and she was not so hot now. Abigail was so depressed when she realized her reality and wept a lot. A few of her coursemates empathized with her and stood by her during this hard time. As the days went by, she was able to complete her physiotherapy and make good use of her legs, while for her face, she had to save up some funds, and some people even assisted her, as the face reconstruction surgery was quite expensive. body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptosimplify/23tGTgfknQuvnvDJPshuCMUbgJwCkBmKANAYWuUq1nw8gnrwZbKTaHpBLwqBYPBvqr4RK.png)


# Matchday 30: Rafa did it again, Porto are laughing, and Braga nearly bottled it

Look, I'm still processing what happened this weekend. If you watched all of the Matchday 30 action in Liga Portugal and you're not emotionally drained, I genuinely don't know what to tell you. This round had everything. Genuinely everything.

Let me start with Friday because that's when things kicked off, even though — let's be real — nobody cared about Friday. Rio Ave drew 2-2 with AVS in one of those mid-table games that exists purely to fill the schedule. Nacional beat Alverca 1-0, which matters way more than it sounds because Nacional need every single point right now. Casa Pia and Santa Clara drew 0-0 and I refuse to write more than one sentence about that game. Vitória went to Barcelos and nicked a 1-0 win against Gil Vicente, decent result for them, nothing spectacular.

Right. Now the real stuff.

---

I need to talk about the derby. I need to talk about Sporting 1-2 Benfica because I still can't believe how that ended.

So Sporting came out absolutely flying. Trincão was on one from the first whistle, cutting inside, driving at defenders, looking like the best player on the pitch. Geny Catamo was doing his usual thing of running at full speed and scaring everyone. And within the first few minutes, Aursnes goes and stamps on Trincão inside the box. Penalty. Alvalade is going mental, 51,000 people on their feet, and Luis Suárez — the guy with 24 league goals this season — steps up.

And misses.

Trubin went the right way and saved it. Not even a great penalty to be honest, Suárez basically telegraphed where he was going. And you could feel the mood shift inside the stadium. That was the moment. That was when you knew this game was going to be chaos.

Because what happens next? Morita, who'd been playing fine up to that point, jumps with his back turned in his own box and handles the ball. Didn't mean to, clearly didn't see it, but that doesn't matter. Penalty to Benfica. Schjelderup steps up, cool as anything, sends Rui Silva the wrong way. 0-1.

Half-time comes and Sporting are frustrated. They'd been the better team, they'd had the first penalty, they'd created chances, and somehow they're behind. Football is cruel like that sometimes.

Second half though. Morita — the same guy who gave away the penalty — goes and heads in the equalizer from a brilliant Debast cross. The noise in Alvalade was something else. Proper goosebumps stuff. 1-1 and suddenly the whole dynamic shifts.

Then Mourinho starts making subs. Brings on Lukebakio, Rafa, Pavlidis, António Silva. Classic Mourinho, waiting for the right moment and then throwing everything at it. Lukebakio does this incredible run down the right, puts in a perfect cross, and Barreiro — completely unmarked at the back post — somehow puts it wide. Wide! With the goal empty! I actually shouted at my screen. That's the kind of miss that changes seasons.

And then the last five minutes happened and honestly I still don't fully understand how Sporting lost this game.

Rafael Nel comes on in the 88th minute. Deep into stoppage time, he gets past Trubin and scores. Alvalade explodes. People are hugging strangers. The whole stadium is shaking. Title race back on.

Except VAR says no. Offside. By the thinnest of margins. Goal chalked off.

And here's the part that will haunt Sporting fans for years — literally seconds after that, SECONDS, Benfica go up the other end and Rafa Silva finishes them off. 1-2. Game over. Alvalade goes from the loudest place on earth to complete silence in about ten seconds flat.

Rafa. Again. At Alvalade. Again. He did the exact same thing back in 2020, came off the bench and scored twice to win the derby. Six years later, one goal was enough. The man has some kind of personal vendetta against that stadium, I swear.

For Sporting this is devastating. Not just the result but the WAY it happened. You score what you think is the winner, you celebrate, the whole stadium celebrates, and then VAR takes it away and you concede immediately after. That's the kind of thing that breaks teams mentally. Suárez apologized to the fans afterwards and apparently he's the first Sporting player to miss a penalty in a derby since 1983. That's a stat nobody wants attached to their name.

Benfica's unbeaten record stays alive though. 21 wins and 9 draws in 30 games, zero losses all season. The nine draws are the reason they're not top of the table, but still — going an entire league season without losing is remarkable regardless.

---

Meanwhile up in Porto, the Dragão was having the time of its life.

Nearly 47,000 people in the stadium, half of them watching the derby on their phones while supposedly watching Porto play Tondela. When Rafa's goal went in down in Lisbon and Nel's goal got disallowed, the Dragão erupted like Porto themselves had scored. You could hear it from outside the stadium apparently.

The actual game was... fine. First half was frustrating. Porto dominated but Bernardo Fontes in the Tondela goal was having one of those nights. Alan Varela had a penalty and Fontes saved it beautifully. So at half-time it's still 0-0 and Farioli is like right, something needs to change.

He brings on Gabri Veiga. Three minutes later, Veiga scores. Obviously. The guy comes on, combines with Deniz Gül, and finishes. 1-0. Then Froholdt makes it 2-0 on 65 minutes after a deflection fell kindly for him. Could've been more — Bednarek headed one just wide, Veiga almost scored a second on a solo run — but 2-0 was enough.

Porto now sit on 79 points. They need seven more from four games to win the league. The party could happen on May 10th against AVS if results go their way. At this point they'd have to actively try to lose the title, which obviously isn't going to happen. Farioli's done a proper job this season. Best defense in the league with only 14 goals conceded in 30 games is genuinely absurd.

---

Oh and Braga-Famalicão happened too, and honestly it deserves way more attention than it's going to get because the derby stole all the headlines.

Braga had just come off that insane Europa League night where they knocked out Betis in Seville. You'd think they'd be flying. And they were — Fran Navarro scored after TWO minutes. Lovely ball from Vítor Carvalho, Navarro finishes, 1-0, Pedreira going wild.

But Famalicão didn't read the script. Gil Dias equalized before half-time, then Rafa Soares scored in the second half to make it 1-2 Famalicão. The Pedreira went quiet. You could feel the tension. There were scuffles between players, a Braga staff member got sent off, yellow cards everywhere. Proper ugly stuff.

And then, because this weekend wasn't dramatic enough already, Braga get a penalty deep in stoppage time. De Haas elbows Víctor Gómez in the box. Ricardo Horta — who else — steps up and buries it. 2-2.

Neither team is happy with that result but for a neutral it was brilliant entertainment.

---

Quick word on the bottom of the table. Arouca beat Estrela da Amadora 1-0 thanks to a Tiago Esgaio goal right after half-time. Doesn't sound like much but it's massive for both teams going in opposite directions. Arouca climb to 10th and should be safe. Estrela are 15th and sinking — three losses in a row and the relegation zone is RIGHT there. The next few weeks are going to be brutal for them.

AFS are already dead at the bottom with 12 points. That's not a relegation battle anymore, that's just waiting for the math to confirm what everyone already knows.

---

So where does this leave us? Four matchdays to go. Porto are cruising toward the title and would need a historic collapse to throw it away. Benfica are second now — yes, the unbeaten team is seven points behind the leader, because nine draws will do that to you — but they've got the Champions League spot pretty much locked up. Sporting are third with 71 points and a game in hand against Tondela, but after what happened today at Alvalade, the title feels further away than the seven or eight point gap suggests. The psychological damage from that ending is going to be hard to shake off.

Moreirense vs Estoril on Monday wraps up the round. But honestly? The story has already been written. Rafa wrote it. Again.
