title.title: My Reason , My Drive.  LOH #285
title.body: > Right now in my life, if I am being very honest, my main reason for living is my kids, Like, everything I do now somehow links back to them, the way I think, the way I plan, even the way I push myself when I am tired, it is no longer just about me, there is this constant reminder in my head that I need to be better, not just for myself, but for them too. I want more for my kids, I want them to have a good life and better opportunities,see I do not want them to struggle like some of us did when we were growing up, this thought alone motivates me to keep going on days when I really do not feel like it. My kids are my motivation, i want a good life for my kids really ,I believe that my life has a purpose that I have not fully understood yet but I feel like I am alive for a reason, yes, I am alive to do something great,I am meant to achieve something good ,I just have to figure out what that is. My kids and my purpose in life keep me going, I believe in my kids and I believe in myself and I believe that I can give my kids a better life, I want my kids to have everything they do need, My kids are my reason, for living. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVawdx4hVm5YagqcYxWJw5Jud4B6DzFe25GTsW7s2nvZn/1776635200086.jpg) Because sometimes life can be confusing, things do not always go as planned, and you might start questioning yourself, but holding on to the fact that there is a purpose behind your life, even if you have not fully discovered it, gives you a kind of strength that is hard to explain, and honestly, what keeps me moving forward every day is the mindset that I just need to make a change, maybe not a big, loud change immediately, but something meaningful, something that will affect not just me, but the people connected to me, i don’t want to just live and leave things the same way I met them. i want my story to count for something, I want to look back someday and know that I tried, that I made effort, that I didn’t just sit back and let life pass me by, even when things are slow, even when progress is not obvious, I remind myself that every small step still counts, there are days I feel tired, days I feel like I am not doing enough, or that things are not moving as fast as I want, but then I think about my kids, I think about the future I am trying to build, and I just tell myself to keep going. Because giving up is not even an option at this point, and another thing is this… I want my generation to do better, I want to be part of that change, even if it starts from my own small circle, the decisions I make now, the effort I put in, the mindset I build, all of that can reflect in the lives of the people that come after me , so right now, my purpose might not be fully clear in detail, but I know the direction, to grow, to do better, to create something meaningful, and to raise my kids in a way that gives them a strong foundation, and honestly, that alone is enough reason for me to wake up every day and keep pushing. title.title: Worldbuilding Weekend Prompt #156 - Prophets
title.body:
Welcome to the next in an ongoing series of writing prompts in the Worldbuilding community ! 

I'm aiming to post one of these each Sunday. They aren't a replacement for the excellent daily prompts from @worldbuilding they're just an extra opportunity if you have a writing itch you want to scratch. 😀

![Potionsa.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/23tH5eLPaqvcPDdq9FKF6CjccpPyvVFqJoiULatXRyUqxSDkFDgaM1SSaR9yTRi5wLn9h.jpg)
*Image generated by AI in Wombo.art*</center>

The prompt this week is - **Prophets**

*In biblical and ancient times, prophets were seen as holy men and women (but usually men.... it was a patriarchal time, that's just how these things work) with a direct line to whichever god they worshipped. They conveyed their god's will to the people, who might or might not listen with varying degrees of belief and attentiveness. Over time, they became less like someone issuing orders, and more like messengers to keep people in line. Finally, a prophet nowadays is anyone who is thought to have a reasonable chance of guessing what the future will look like.*

*Tell me a story of a prophet from your setting ! Is it an old man with a white beard bringing a message of fire and brimstone, or the lowest of the low living a humble life and exhorting people to follow his unselfish example ? What is the message - is the prophet warning of imminent doom, or just trying to bring people back to their faith ? How do people react - fervent belief, or dismissive mockery ? How do the authorities react - make the prophet a wise advisor in the palace, to subject them to persecution, exile, imprisonment or even execution ? How does the story end - with an execution (and possible ascension), or maybe a great disaster or a crusade ?*

title.title: Bag It Up
title.body: >\n\nDriving home last night after the concert, Smallsteps noticed a shop called \

which is a *Funeral Home,* but the direct translation from Finnish would be *Burial Office.* And since the name didn't mean much to her, Smallsteps asked what it was. And well, her father being a bit of a clown told her it was because in Finland so many people visit the cemeteries that the dead people need assistants to schedule bookings. 

> She only bought it for a fraction of a second until logic stepped in.  


---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23wqu9YeuG4gfKdpVTag64Xb2udedsyE5bqiLCcBtHResFhxbk2pBimFtdwGAeT5VoqcT.png)


---

But my wife explained what they do and how they organise grave stones and caskets and the like and this led to a fun tidbit of information for Smallsteps from my wife about my own burial, which is a little less traditional. She told our daughter that I want to be thrown into the forest so the animals can eat me. But this is not entirely true, because I want a bit of ceremony. The process of throwing has to have one person grabbing my hands, the other my feet and then swinging me, *\

,* and leaving me as I lay.

> I have been told this is probably illegal.

So last night I came up with another idea, just in case I am forced into a normal kind of deal. If I can't be thrown into the forest, I want to be buried in a large, clear, zip-lock bag, like used for storing leftover food. Perhaps even with a message for attendees written on the note-taking surface. Smallsteps was asking more about this today and I said that I would of course also be naked and she said, \

And of course the answer was simple, because I will be dead, but they will have to be there with the guests.

> Dark humour is still humour.

Death doesn't scare me and I think that I might think differently to most people about it, because I don't believe that we *must survive* for some reason. From where I started far in the distance, I have come to the conclusion over the years that we aren't made to struggle endlessly. Yeah, life can be hard and I am not saying we should give up at the slightest hurdle, but I don't begrudge those who get to a point and say, \

. > That second bit is key. Getting out of life is selfish, so is wanting to put in value, but it is at least helping others too. I don't get the point of merely surviving this life and I don't get the personal value of those who are doing all they can just to stay alive, with no real chance of ever getting out of that cycle. It seems like a cruel and unusual punishment, a glass ceiling on wellbeing, with a person continually smashing against it, but it isn't going to break. More likely though, it is like trained fleas instead, where the ceiling is the lid of the jar and after bumping the head a few times, the lid can come off and the flea will never jump out of the jar again. > Have we been trained to survive? Of course, we have a survival mechanism, but I get the sense that this natural trigger has been leveraged to make some people wealthier, because we will keep on trying to survive even though we are made to do so with less and less. Eventually, just getting up in the morning is a burden, and as we can see with so many depressed people, it is getting quite heavy for many to keep lifting, without that sense of progression. And while many people are depressed over what is pretty meaningless, I think that is another part of the problem. > Survival isn't a purpose to live. It isn't enough for a human to have survival alone. But for a lot of people today and to some degree myself too, life purpose is no longer part of daily life when it comes to adding value *to society.* Yes, there can be the meaning of providing for family, but even that many people are choosing to opt out of. But beyond that, we as a species tend to need to be part of something larger than ourselves, something that adds value to the future environment of our children also, not just to get them through childhood. > But that future is looking worse. Most jobs do not add value to this world. You can argue that yours is amazing because you help sick people, but most of the illnesses are caused by the environment we have created, making it a problem we needn't have, but do. So many of the jobs we have a re similar, where the entire supply chain is ultimately doing nothing good for society, even if it is turning a massive profit. Profit doesn't provide purpose, though many rich people will argue that - until the bombs drop and we are living and dying in a post-apocalyptic world. >All the money in the world, *forced to live in a bunker.* Sometimes I think how great the world would be if it wasn't filled with so many people believing profit was the answer, even if it comes from what is useless business activity that we should have surpassed long ago. Sure, that is a fantasy land, but the vast majority of problems facing society today would just disappear. We'd have new problems of course and plenty of old ones to still solve, but solving *meaningful problems* gives purpose. And when the entire supply chain is in service to solving meaningful problems, there is no busywork, just *important work to be done.* > And play of course. But play wouldn't be done to escape the drudgery of meaningless work, it would be done because the brain and body needs it to some degree to function well. It would be true self-care at a societal level, so that people are able to *be their best* when tackling the real problems we face. >But what do I know. *My problem is finding a large enough zip-lock bag.* Taraz [ Gen1: Hive ] --- **Be part of the Hive discussion.** - Comment on the topics of the article, and add your perspectives and experiences. - Read and discuss with others who comment and build your personal network - Engage well with me and others and put in effort **And you may be rewarded.** ---

title.title: La Importancia de tener un Cliente Fiel, un Lector fiel, un Amigo Fiel -El Emprendimiento de Crear Contenido Valioso- (ES/EN)
title.body:
<center>![español stanislavkondrashov-man-6208470_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23ynhSLbb4FwX6LtZxz3hWQFgUmuhQ3Y9km2g7KujYJKS3tAAQVwJKUXftCZVxaqyE6Qs.jpg)</center>

> *<center>[Pixabay-StanislavKondrashov; editada en Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-computadora-port%c3%a1til-trabajo-6208470/)</center>*

###### <center>*Vemos que para nadie es un secreto que tener lectores que interaccionen constantemente contigo en tus creaciones de contenido no tiene precio; y esto revela que tu marca personal es importante, que lo que planteas soluciona y que estás produciendo en otro ser humano **una experiencia de valor.***</center>

###### <center>*Pero no es solo eso, también que existe un vínculo emocional y, por lo tanto, que este cliente, amigo o lector que te sigue, será capaz de perdonarte ciertos errores como la distancia y hasta salirte un poco de tus temáticas, que son situaciones que como humanos vivimos, como también cuando emitimos opiniones o concepciones diferentes sobre algo que los demás no tienen; por eso es importante tener un **cliente fiel***.</center>


<center>![stocksnap-man-2562325_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23ynZ31k5XExi1vzmrd5NGotXPpGpjGPZqY7VHjXMpE5EyEftxykZhuuxTsMdWqxZRz4G.jpg)</center>
> *<center>[Pixabay-StockSnap](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-escribiendo-2562325/)</center>*

<div class=\

> ###
¿A qué me refiero con un lector con fidelidad?
*En @hive un lector fiel es un **[cliente fiel](https://www.sociment.com/diferencia-fidelidad-lealtad-clientes/)**.* Ellos siempre eligen tu publicación, tu producto o tu marca ante otra alternativa, incluso ante aquellas que pueden ser muy parecidas. Es aquel que confía en ti, que sabe que el producto que le estás entregando para su evaluación y disfrute es bueno, de calidad y que está investigado. *También es un cliente que, cuando tú cometes errores, como cuando estás muy ocupado y te alejas un tiempo publicando en forma distanciada a como venías publicando, él te lo va a aceptar y va a priorizar las experiencias que ha vivido contigo antes que percibir como negativos los cambios.* Es que un cliente fiel mantiene una relación a largo plazo contigo, pero tú debes mantener una relación a largo plazo con él; y siempre, aunque te tardes, debes publicar, porque el cliente siempre espera. Y espera que le ofrezcas una alternativa, una noticia, una solución o una iniciativa en la que él pueda participar, así como expandir y compartir sus propias experiencias.
![stanislavkondrashov-man-6208469_1920 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/Eq5FwgUU5FV1UuWtV7QeUkY2GsZiJpcLuU7LEfdxeHAFmesrt6zMAb2xgsrn7pDqZht.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-StanislavKondrashov](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-libro-pensando-leyendo-6208469/)
* ###
¿Cómo hago para que mis lectores sean fieles?
*Ante todo, me gustaría que leyéramos el **[artículo de Daniela Giannini: Descubre cuatro estrategias para fidelizar a los clientes, del blog de Wifire, que escribió el 20 de noviembre de 2023](https://blog.wifire.me/descubre-4-estrategias-para-fidelizar-a-los-clientes/)**, porque comienza explicando que, si hemos entendido que quien nos lee o nuestro cliente es importante, debemos fidelizarlos.* Y existen cuatro estrategias que pudiéramos poner en práctica en nuestras empresas, además, según la autora. De todas maneras, como escritores o creadores de contenido, los clientes son los que nos leen y, de ellos, los lectores leales son los más valiosos para nuestra marca personal en nuestro blog. Y la forma más importante de fidelizarlos es haciéndonos cercanos, amigos y dándoles a entender lo valiosos que son para nosotros, de allí que sea importante que nos aproximemos a ellos con contenido veraz y efectivo, con investigaciones que soporten lo que informamos. *Debemos elevar la confianza, por lo que siempre hay que estar en contacto y atraer a los lectores que de vez en cuando visitan el blog, centrándonos un poco más en ellos para que nos visiten de nuevo.* Por último, dar algo que nos identifique en esa relación creador-lector, para acceder a nosotros y para que encuentren un nicho donde puedan obtener información personalizada en el momento en el que la pidan.
![stanislavkondrashov-man-6208475_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/243MLMNimxb5onMqc9RDqVNJ9bCsgESgnT7fnDuvXPB6EFrcmdYCduEk1KGszB3Q1GC3m.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-StanislavKondrashov](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-computadora-port%c3%a1til-laboral-6208475/)
* ###
Mantener la motivación
*Mantener la motivación en quienes nos leen es **[fomentar la fidelidad en ellos.](https://emprendedores.es/gestion/como-conseguir-y-retener-a-un-cliente-fiel-estrategias-que-si-funcionan/)*** Personalmente, aconsejo que tengas tu marca personal bien identificada, que seas tú mismo fiel a lo que creas, mejorando el contenido, pero siempre dentro de la línea en la que estás acostumbrado a exponer cualquiera de las temáticas que trabajes. *De alguna forma debes potenciar la participación, porque un blog frío, inerte y unilateral, generalmente se olvida; mientras que aquel en el cual yo puedo aportar ideas propias, identifica a los lectores fieles y les da la oportunidad de ser apreciados y reconocidos también.* Referencia conceptos que tú manejes, esos que piensas que los otros deberían manejar también o conocer, porque el lector es tan inteligente y preparado como tú. Eso es fomentar el desarrollo de la idea tomando en cuenta las habilidades de los otros, lo que expondrá otras perspectivas diferentes a las que puedas estar ofreciendo en tu contenido. ***[Incentiva a tu audiencia de alguna manera](https://eltinteroeditorial.com/imaginacion-lector)***. Nosotros tenemos la capacidad de obsequiar criptomonedas, pero también puedes hacer relevantes las ideas que ellos hayan compartido y hasta desarrollarlas, para que se sientan tomados en cuenta. Por último, apadrina comunidades de alguna manera, sé parte importante de esas organizaciones que concentran lectores específicos, y ofrece contenido valioso y que sepan que cuando tú escribes es para dar una temática interesante en la que todos puedan aportar.
*Nunca olvidemos que #Hive es una plataforma de creación de contenido, que es un emprendimiento y una oportunidad maravillosa para crecer.*
***
Y que en @beentrepreneur siempre habrá una herramienta que nos proyecte hacia adelante como comunidad y como plataforma.
***

#
The Importance of Having a Loyal Customer, a Loyal Reader, a Loyal Friend -The Enterprise of Creating Valuable Content-
![stanislavkondrashov-man-6208470_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23ydJmx556HhAnGP7dSuFpJfpvnEARvJ3k53ApmPoMF3KJqqZQhrB4jGsWLKrY599xEyR.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-StanislavKondrashov; edited in Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-computadora-port%c3%a1til-trabajo-6208470/)
* ######
*It’s no secret that having readers who constantly engage with your content is priceless; this shows that your personal brand matters, that what you offer solves problems, and that you’re providing another person with **a valuable experience.***
######
*But it’s not just that—there’s also an emotional bond, and therefore, this client, friend, or reader who follows you will be able to forgive you for certain mistakes, such as being distant or even straying a bit from your usual topics—situations we all experience as humans—as well as when we express opinions or perspectives on something that others don’t share; that’s why it’s important to have **a loyal client***.
![stocksnap-man-2562325_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23ynZ31k5XExi1vzmrd5NGotXPpGpjGPZqY7VHjXMpE5EyEftxykZhuuxTsMdWqxZRz4G.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-StockSnap](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-escribiendo-2562325/)
*

> ###
What do I mean by a loyal reader?
*At @hive, a loyal reader is a **[loyal customer](https://www.sociment.com/diferencia-fidelidad-lealtad-clientes/).*** They always choose your post, your product, or your brand over other options, even those that may be very similar. They are the ones who trust you, who know that the product you’re providing for their review and enjoyment is good, high-quality, and well-researched. *They’re also a customer who, when you make mistakes—like when you’re very busy and take a break from posting as frequently as you used to—will accept it and prioritize the experiences they’ve had with you rather than viewing the changes as negative.* A loyal customer maintains a long-term relationship with you, but you must also maintain a long-term relationship with them; and always, even if it takes you a while, you must post, because the customer is always waiting. And they expect you to offer them an alternative, news, a solution, or an initiative in which they can participate, as well as expand upon and share their own experiences.
![stanislavkondrashov-man-6208469_1920 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/Eq5FwgUU5FV1UuWtV7QeUkY2GsZiJpcLuU7LEfdxeHAFmesrt6zMAb2xgsrn7pDqZht.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-StanislavKondrashov](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-libro-pensando-leyendo-6208469/)
* ###
How can I build reader loyalty?
*First and foremost, I’d like you to read **[Daniela Giannini’s article, “Discover Four Strategies for Building Customer Loyalty,” from the Wifire blog, published on November 20, 2023](https://blog.wifire.me/descubre-4-estrategias-para-fidelizar-a-los-clientes/)**, because she begins by explaining that if we understand that our readers or customers are important, we must build their loyalty.* And there are four strategies we could put into practice in our businesses, according to the author. In any case, as writers or content creators, our clients are the ones who read us, and among them, loyal readers are the most valuable for our personal brand on our blog. And the most important way to build their loyalty is by being approachable, friendly, and letting them know how valuable they are to us; that’s why it’s important to engage them with truthful and effective content, backed by research that supports what we report. *We must build trust, so we should always stay in touch and engage readers who visit the blog from time to time, focusing a little more on them so they’ll come back.* Finally, we should offer something that defines us in that creator-reader relationship—something that makes us accessible and helps them find a niche where they can get personalized information whenever they need it.
![stanislavkondrashov-man-6208475_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/243MLMNimxb5onMqc9RDqVNJ9bCsgESgnT7fnDuvXPB6EFrcmdYCduEk1KGszB3Q1GC3m.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-StanislavKondrashov](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-computadora-port%c3%a1til-laboral-6208475/)
* ###
Staying Motivated
*Keeping your readers motivated is key **[to fostering their loyalty](https://emprendedores.es/gestion/como-conseguir-y-retener-a-un-cliente-fiel-estrategias-que-si-funcionan/)***. Personally, I recommend that you clearly define your personal brand, stay true to your beliefs, and improve your content—but always within the framework you’re accustomed to when addressing whatever topics you cover. *You must encourage participation in some way, because a cold, lifeless, and one-sided blog is usually forgotten; whereas one where I can contribute my own ideas identifies loyal readers and gives them the opportunity to be appreciated and recognized as well.* Refer to concepts you’re familiar with—those you think others should also understand or know—because the reader is just as intelligent and knowledgeable as you are. That is fostering the development of the idea by taking others’ skills into account, which will bring out perspectives different from those you might be offering in your content. ***[Incentivize your audience in some way.](https://eltinteroeditorial.com/imaginacion-lector)*** We have the ability to give away cryptocurrency, but you can also highlight the ideas they’ve shared and even build on them, so they feel valued. Finally, sponsor communities in some way; be an important part of those organizations that bring together specific readers, and offer valuable content so they know that when you write, it’s to provide an interesting topic to which everyone can contribute.
*Let’s never forget that #Hive is a content creation platform—a startup and a wonderful opportunity for growth.*
***And that @beentrepreneur will always provide a tool to propel us forward as a community and as a platform.***

Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - Not so hot now.  Hope you enjoy the story.

![labubu_popmart_outfit_sun_wuko_1729561172_d4882dda_progressive.jpg](https://media.karousell.com/media/photos/products/2024/10/22/labubu_popmart_outfit_sun_wuko_1729561172_d4882dda_progressive.jpg)

An interesting prompt to discuss today, when we think or discuss about hot, there can be multiple context that can be looked at. Firstly, it's the temperature, like the weather, With the hot sun blazing through and the effects of global warming worsen day by day. Yes, we are constantly on the lookout for way to cool down, escape the heat. Thus, we do have a good tendency to be saying \

Another scenario when hot is a commonly used word is when we are talking about trend of stuff. Whether if the particular item is still the popular item today or what is the trending item today in a certain category. People might be asking what's the hot item today for plush toys? Now, this has got nothing to do with temperature like our earlier context, the item can have no temperature at all but we can still use the word hot. It might not be hot item today, but any changes of event can turn it into a hot item tomorrow. 

Let me quote an example to illustrate, Labubu plushy was something I am unaware of till Black Pink members were reported to be carrying it and soon everyone around me were talking about it and memes were all Labubu. I am not sure if it's not so hot today compared to it's peak.

What do you think?

title.title: The New Wave of Tech Layoffs
title.body:
![Screenshot 2026-04-19 at 5.35.35 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/23wMU56DJy5LtwGj3YVCWzUwk8b2cCApitYLqDcNidtpWBZaUjuMmiXGpP9jKX3hXBmZ2.png)

The latest round of layoffs at Meta Platforms signals more than just another cost cutting cycle in Silicon Valley it reflects a deeper transformation underway across corporate America. As companies pivot aggressively toward AI, thousands of workers are being displaced in what is shaping up to be one of the defining labor shifts of the decade.

According to news outlets, Meta is preparing to cut roughly 8,000 jobs or about 10% of its global workforce starting May 20, 2026, with additional rounds of layoffs expected later in the year. This marks the company’s largest workforce reduction since its 2022–2023 “year of efficiency,” when around 21,000 employees were laid off. Despite generating over $200 billion in revenue, Meta is restructuring to become leaner, flatten management layers, and integrate AI more deeply into its operations. The company has reorganized divisions like Reality Labs and created new AI-focused teams to accelerate development.


![Screenshot 2026-04-19 at 5.36.23 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/23tcM1wdaQwfQ3n1f9cXiGdvJcpLHecPswCKZknVRSM94EehvfTq3MRehtGFmKrZHSp8C.png)


Meta’s layoffs are not happening in isolation. Across the tech industry, executives are increasingly framing job cuts as necessary steps toward an AI-first future. Companies like Snap, Atlassian, and Block have all announced significant layoffs with some cutting double digit percentages of their workforce as they restructure around smaller, more efficient teams. 

One of the most striking aspects of the current layoffs is that many companies, including Meta, are financially strong. Profits are high, revenues are growing, and stock prices have often risen following layoff announcements. Unlike previous downturns, this is not just about economic cycles it’s about technological displacement and organizational redesign to increase profits. 

My major concern is the erosion of middle class and white collar stability. Historically, jobs in tech, marketing, and corporate operations were seen as relatively secure with upwardly mobile. AI threatens to automate not just routine work, but also analytical and creative tasks, putting a broader range of careers at risk. If these roles shrink without adequate replacements, it could hollow out a key segment of the economy. As layoffs spread and frustration grows, a trend has begun to surface were acts of arson and sabotage targeting corporate infrastructure, particularly warehouses and logistics hubs. Facilities tied to major companies like Amazon and other large retailers have increasingly become symbols of what many workers see as an unfair system where profits rise while jobs disappear. 

It sure feels like we are on the cusp of a labor movement not see before. 

Remember we didn't start the fire
It was always burning
Since the world's been turning
We didn't start the fire
No, we didn't light it
But will fight it

![RxbsSMGS1INR5azi_P_20251226_114751.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/RxbsSMGS1INR5azi_P_20251226_114751/RxbsSMGS1INR5azi_P_20251226_114751.webp) ![PSD2rKsYBT2917DN_P_20251226_111211.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/PSD2rKsYBT2917DN_P_20251226_111211/PSD2rKsYBT2917DN_P_20251226_111211.webp) ![HilF0Zr8UuK7i2h6_P_20251226_114800.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/HilF0Zr8UuK7i2h6_P_20251226_114800/HilF0Zr8UuK7i2h6_P_20251226_114800.webp) ![vakhbJmW1vAQ8kLb_P_20251226_114815.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/vakhbJmW1vAQ8kLb_P_20251226_114815/vakhbJmW1vAQ8kLb_P_20251226_114815.webp) ![ZRRT8gUYQLkYrYlV_P_20251226_115222.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/ZRRT8gUYQLkYrYlV_P_20251226_115222/ZRRT8gUYQLkYrYlV_P_20251226_115222.webp) ![SjZHIThl3Xj8eNYn_P_20251226_114425.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/SjZHIThl3Xj8eNYn_P_20251226_114425/SjZHIThl3Xj8eNYn_P_20251226_114425.webp) ![3dzLeRipVceerGut_P_20251226_142105.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/3dzLeRipVceerGut_P_20251226_142105/3dzLeRipVceerGut_P_20251226_142105.webp) ![8WrMV5uu21nqtrcv_P_20251226_111234.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/8WrMV5uu21nqtrcv_P_20251226_111234/8WrMV5uu21nqtrcv_P_20251226_111234.webp)
人們常說，民以食為天，對很多人來說，吃得飽是非常重要的，不過，現今社會上，除了吃飽之外，更吃巧，就拿火鍋來說，火鍋不但簡單，卻又可以豐盛，只需準備各式食材與湯底，就可以享用一頓豐盛的盛宴了，食材從薄切肉片、海鮮，到蔬菜，還有豆腐與各式火鍋料可供選擇，湯底可以是清爽的昆布鍋、濃郁的麻辣鍋，或是帶著藥膳香氣的養生鍋，真是豐富又多樣啊！ 狂一鍋是一家台式火鍋店，為甚麼它叫自己為台式火鍋店呢？因為店家將經典台菜轉化為特色湯底，在結合熱鬧的桌邊服務，讓一場美食饗宴，成為一次喧囂的聚會，而店內的裝潢也給人們一種走進台式熱炒店的感覺，例如，桌面上放的一瓶瓶的台式啤酒，裝的並不是酒，其實裡面裝的是水，是讓人們在火鍋煮到太濃稠時，可以加點水用來平衡火鍋風味之用的，店內較昏暗的光照，也是仿效夜晚熱鬧的快炒店氛圍。 我就是為了它的功夫排骨酥鍋，再次上門的，說實話，它的排骨酥，外皮酥脆，肉質扎實不失軟嫩，不過，吃到一半，湯底就開始感到濃稠了，我還覺得奇怪，我沒放芋頭或地瓜內進入鍋內，怎麼湯頭就變濃稠了，後來才知道是因為鍋內放入了排骨酥，這就是每桌都有水瓶的原因吧，畢竟功夫排骨酥鍋是該家店的招牌鍋。 朋友點的生炒花枝鍋，熱炒帶出的鍋氣與酒香，讓口感更增添層次，他說很夠味，不管是涮肉片或者其它火鍋料，都很好吃，而火鍋料自助吧有將近30種食材，有當季蔬菜、甜不辣、丸子、豆腐、木耳等，其中的虱目魚漿是我的最愛，這種吃到飽的自助吧已經變成火鍋店的標配了，我想，人們愛吃火鍋，不只是因為它的美味，更因為它可以簡單，也可以豐盛，還有層出不窮的新花樣。
---
People often say, “Food is the first necessity of the people”. For many, just being able to eat enough is already very important. Anyway in today’s world, it’s not just about eating your fill—it’s also about eating well and creatively. Take hot pot as an example. It’s simple, yet it can be incredibly rich and satisfying. All you need is a variety of ingredients and a soup base, and you’ve got yourself a full-on feast. You can choose from thinly sliced meat, seafood, vegetables, tofu, and all kinds of hot pot add-ons. As for the broth, it could be a light kombu base, a rich spicy mala broth, or a herbal, nourishing soup. It’s honestly so diverse and fun! 狂一鍋 is a Taiwanese-style hot pot restaurant. So why do they call themselves “Taiwanese-style”? It’s because they take classic Taiwanese dishes and turn them into unique soup bases. On top of that, they combine it with lively table-side service, turning a meal into a noisy, energetic gathering. The interior design also makes you feel like you’ve stepped into a traditional Taiwanese stir-fry restaurant. For example, those bottles of Taiwanese beer on the table aren’t actually beer—they’re filled with water! They’re there so you can add some water if your soup gets too thick and needs balancing. Even the dim lighting is meant to recreate the vibe of a bustling night-time stir-fry spot. I actually went back there just for their signature pork rib crispy soup. Honestly, the ribs are great—the outside is crispy, and the meat is firm yet still tender. But halfway through the meal, the soup started getting really thick. I was confused at first—I hadn’t even added taro or sweet potato, so why was the broth thickening? Later I found out it was because of the fried pork ribs in the soup. That’s probably why every table comes with a bottle of water—since this is one of their signature dishes. My friend ordered the stir-fried squid hot pot. The wok aroma and slight hint of cooking wine really added layers to the flavor. He said it was super tasty, and whether dipping meat slices or other ingredients, everything worked well with the broth. There’s also a self-serve bar with nearly 30 different items, including seasonal vegetables, fish cakes, meatballs, tofu, and wood ear mushrooms. My personal favorite is the milkfish paste. This kind of all-you-can-eat ingredient bar has pretty much become standard in hot pot restaurants nowadays. I think people love hot pot not just because it tastes good, but because it can be both simple and extravagant at the same time—and there are always new twists and variations to discover. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@diochen/another-visit-to-taiwanese-style-hot-pot-restaurant)

title.title: Roots You Cannot See
title.body:
https://shorturl.at/FTJ0z

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWTXKkahE1DkkveSQrr83k6LPFB3AcTohxGd6ZrMeQEuj/1776634889687.jpg)


A few days ago I was walking through a small field near my village. In the middle of that field there was a tall tree. It looked strong and beautiful. Its branches were wide, its leaves were fresh, and birds were sitting on it peacefully.
For a moment I stopped and looked at it carefully.
Then a simple thought came to my mind: the strongest part of that tree was not the branches, not the leaves, and not even the trunk.
The strongest part was something nobody could see — its roots.
Those roots were hidden deep in the soil. They were silent, invisible, and unnoticed. But without them, the tree would fall in the first strong wind.
And suddenly I realized that human relationships are very similar to that tree.
In life, we often focus on what people show on the outside. We see smiles, laughter, pictures together, and friendly conversations. Everything looks perfect on the surface.
But the real strength of any relationship is not what people show in public.
The real strength is hidden, just like the roots of a tree.
It is loyalty.
It is sincerity.
It is the quiet support someone gives when nobody else is watching.
I remember a small experience from my own life.
A few years ago, I was going through a difficult time. Things were not going the way I had planned. During that time, I noticed something interesting about the people around me.
Some people who used to talk to me every day slowly disappeared. They became busy. Messages stopped coming. Conversations became shorter.
At first, I felt a little disappointed.
But then I noticed something else.
There were two friends who stayed exactly the same. They did not make big speeches. They did not give long advice. But they stayed.
Sometimes they simply asked, “How are you today?”
Sometimes they just listened.
At that moment I understood something very important: in life, it is not the number of people around you that matters. What really matters is the quality of the people who stand with you.
Many people can walk beside you when the road is smooth. But only a few will stay when the road becomes difficult.
Those people are like the roots of a tree.
They may not always be visible in public moments. They may not always be loud. But their presence keeps everything standing.
In today’s world, especially on social media, it is very easy to look surrounded by people. We can have hundreds of contacts, followers, and conversations.
But deep inside, every person knows who truly stands with them.
And honestly, we do not need many people.
Sometimes just one or two sincere people are enough to make life feel stable and meaningful.
So if you have someone in your life who stays loyal, who listens to you, and who does not disappear when things become difficult — appreciate them.
Because just like the roots of a tree, those people are the ones who quietly hold your world together.

title.title: Care and Concern for Oneself
title.body: > When it comes to discussions like what we have in this prompt, there needs to be carefulness in the things being said or implied. This is because one can be easily misinterpreted. It could not even be a case of misinterpretation. Rather, individuals cherry-picking what suits their desires and amplifying such to convey their narratives while leaving out the other important, vital and intrinsic things mentioned, thereby leaving an unbalanced notion of what the person was saying holistically. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRCsfcRB8fWD3YHzaT3vV9J9nEGT4DRoxfKWoF1s35LMi/photo-1590337199203-111d94c51a80.jpeg [Image Source.](https://unsplash.com/photos/text-LcS81I9uoJI) This is one of such discourses or topics. Positive selfishness it says. Is this good or totally bad? Like from the prompt, you can't mention selfishness and expect any sort of acceptance. It's something that's known as bad. Many of us were raised and meant to understand that living life should be selfless, void of self-centeredness or selfishness－good training. And maybe more of a balance was needed because many were not taught to care for themselves as much as they should for others. Positive selfishness? Well, I won't be going with that flow. The fact that by values and morals－not to even go into religious connotations－selfishness has been rejected, says a lot. While I understand and agree that we need to care for ourselves, selfishness still maintains the same meaning. I don't suppose positivity can be added to negativity. However, I'll opt for something like self-care and self-concern. I believe it still emphasises the point that looking after oneself as much as for others isn't bad. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSgrn3p1sPMxijbxUGTF8ZT2xG3RMuXEW6pWWYYocXue6/photo-1667517258985-2df0d3264d74.jpeg [Image Source.](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-sign-on-a-wall-JZt5OucOU1o) The balance we need is to bring clarity that love, care and concern for oneself is a good thing. One of the best ways we can reward our loved ones and humanity on a large scale starts with how we value and treat ourselves. It's important to have others deeply at heart which says a lot about the humanity and conscience in us. But we also need to have ourselves at heart. When we don't learn to do so, we can lose our self-esteem, productivity, growth, joy, happiness and more. Nevertheless, it's worthy of note that there's a thin line between being really selfish and self-centered to being really concerned and caring about oneself. Many tend to hide selfishness in the guise of putting themselves first. When all is about you and there's never room for others, it's selfishness and that should never be encouraged nor absorbed in society. As much as we try to put ourselves in the picture, let it not be only us in the picture, but others as well. --- ###### Thank you for reading! ----- ##### 🔗 Apps which I recommend built by Español:

El día en casa comienza temprano y parece no terminar nunca. Entre organizar el hogar, estar pendiente de las cosas de mis hijos y apoyar a mi hija con sus tareas del liceo, mi mente rara vez descansa. Es fácil olvidarse de una misma cuando siempre estás cuidando de los demás.

Por eso, he aprendido a valorar mis \

. No necesito mucho: solo diez minutos de silencio absoluto. Es el rato en el que dejo de lado el rol de esposa y mamá para simplemente respirar y estar conmigo. Esos breves respiros son mi verdadera catarsis; me devuelven la calma, recargan mis energías y me ayudan a soltar el estrés de la rutina diaria.\n\nPor eso, he aprendido a valorar mis \

. No necesito mucho: solo diez minutos de silencio absoluto. Es el rato en el que dejo de lado el rol de esposa y mamá para simplemente respirar y estar conmigo. Esos breves respiros son mi verdadera catarsis; me devuelven la calma, recargan mis energías y me ayudan a soltar el estrés de la rutina diaria.\n\nLlegar a este lugar fue como abrir una ventana y dejar entrar aire fresco directamente al alma. Después de días intensos de rutinas domésticas y responsabilidades familiares, mi primer pensamiento al ver esta vista fue: \

.

Ver el agua azul, tan quieta y acogedora, me transmitió una paz inmediata. El verde intenso de las palmeras y la vegetación parecía abrazar el lugar, creando un refugio perfecto. Fue una experiencia increíblemente relajante. Pasé un tiempo simplemente contemplando la escena, respirando profundo y dejando que el silencio y la belleza natural barrieran todo el estrés acumulado.

En ese momento, el mundo y sus pendientes desaparecieron. No había apuros, solo yo y este paisaje maravilloso. Fue un regalo directo a mis sentidos y un recordatorio poderoso de que la belleza y la calma existen, y que merecemos detenernos a disfrutarlas.

He descubierto que para que mi hogar esté en armonía, yo también necesito estar en paz. Tomarse un descanso no es egoísmo, es bienestar.

Muchas gracias a todos por dedicar un momento de su tiempo para leerme y acompañarme en esta reflexión. Valorar estos instantes nos ayuda a seguir adelante con más fuerza.

​🍃 ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 🌊 ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 🍃

English 

The day at home starts early and seems to never end. Between organizing the house, keeping up with my children's needs, and helping my daughter with her high school work, my mind rarely rests. It's easy to forget about yourself when you're always taking care of everyone else.

That's why I've learned to value my \

I don't need much: just ten minutes of absolute silence. It’s the time when I set aside the roles of wife and mother to simply breathe and be with myself. Those brief breathers are my true catharsis; they restore my calm, recharge my energy, and help me let go of the stress of the daily routine.\n\nArriving at this place was like opening a window and letting fresh air directly into my soul. After intense days of household routines and family responsibilities, my first thought upon seeing this view was: \

Seeing the blue water, so still and inviting, conveyed an immediate sense of peace. The vibrant green of the palm trees and vegetation seemed to embrace the spot, creating a perfect refuge. It was an incredibly relaxing experience. I spent some time just contemplating the scene, breathing deeply, and letting the silence and natural beauty sweep away all the accumulated stress.

In that moment, the world and its tasks disappeared. There were no rushes, just me and this marvelous landscape. It was a direct gift to my senses and a powerful reminder that beauty and calm exist, and that we deserve to stop and enjoy them.

I’ve discovered that for my home to be in harmony, I need to be at peace too. Taking a break isn't selfish; it's wellness.

Thank you very much to all of you for taking a moment of your time to read my thoughts and join me in this reflection. Valuing these moments helps us move forward with more strength.

title.title: If Aliens Really Exist, Are We Sure We Actually Want To Meet Them ?
title.body: You can tell it's silly season, because the news has had a few articles pop up claiming senior US politicians are going to release proof that aliens exist and they've met them. Of course, my first reaction was \

But whether it's real or not, I think it's likely aliens do exist. We're gradually filling in the numbers in the Drake Equation which shows statistically whether there really are aliens out there. But if they do exist, I'm not quite sure why they'd want to visit a primitive backwater planet like ours.

Then I started to wonder what would happen if aliens actually did reveal themselves in public.....


![danielarealpeg-spaceship-4828098.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/23tkdgEFCSo3HDbGuBs2w7PtJWQpVw9hntZbCwKNY8SDXUTEPqKoNmXah9TZ1i5ADUNs6.jpg)

*Image by <a href=\

>Pixabay* ### How Would The Authorities React ? ### I reckon whichever country the aliens landed in, the government would try to hide it. They would claim it was to prevent panic, of course, but in reality it would be in the hopes of keeping it to themselves. They'd be hoping to negotiate with the aliens for some technological advantage. Meanwhile, the legacy media would publish exactly what they were told to. Boring stories of unrelated scandals, a bit of jingoism, and some drama around a Z-list celebrity. Anything but aliens. I suspect word would get out soon enough anyway, through citizen journalists and social media. Unless the aliens were lucky enough to land in North Korea, of course.... ![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4arJr6HtnfHGJpnth33F4sSek1XxEQS3vHpdjcuokqyKGz3jFHfMZf.jpg) ### How Would The Public React ? ### The public reaction to aliens would inevitably border on the hysterical. In both directions. You'd have people panicking and declaring that it was the end of the world, and others saying the aliens were coming to save us from ourselves and bring a new golden age as part of some galactic federation. Probably the biggest crisis would be in the major world religions, particularly the monotheistic ones. Unless aliens were completely humanoid (unlikely !), there'd be instant schisms of all kinds. Some would come to the conclusion that if the god they believed in made humans in his image, the aliens must be devils because they aren't 100% like us. Or have their own god who looked like them. Or the same god as ours but who adopts different forms. All the possible permutations would, I suspect, lead most religions to fracture into factions happily blowing each other up, while many worshippers would give the whole thing up as a bad idea and just walk away from it all. There would inevitably be large numbers of people who wanted to try to talk to the aliens in person, despite inevitable efforts by governments to prevent it. Some would just be curious, others would think they could make some kind of deal, or would want to take a ride back to the aliens' homeworld. Some, of course, would just be the insane or fanatical (and those whose minds broke when the aliens arrived); these could easily cause an interstellar diplomatic incident. Their actions could be violent, culturally insensitive, or just downright weird and unpredictable ! In a global population of several billion, even a tiny percentage of crackpots could be a significant threat, and we all know how crazy humans can be ! ![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4arJr6HtnfHGJpnth33F4sSek1XxEQS3vHpdjcuokqyKGz3jFHfMZf.jpg) ### How Would Aliens View Us ? ### This could be the biggest problem. If the aliens have the technology to get from wherever they live to here (either with a faster-than-light drive, some kind of stasis, or because they are machines that don't have to worry about lifespan), it is very likely they'll have technologies way ahead of ours, and probably incomprehensible to us. Governments wanting to steal or bargain for that technology might find they literally have nothing to offer in return that the aliens might want. The aliens in turn might look down on us as completely inferior, or if we're lucky, just quaint and curious. We'd have to find out why the aliens were here. It might be hard to find out, especially if they were anything more than a bunch of tourists. It's certain that they wouldn't have the equivalent of Star Trek's \

, because that would mean they shouldn't have introduced themselves in the first place.

But it is quite possible that their reasons would be incomprehensible to primitives like us. Science fiction and Hollywood have given us all kinds of possibilities, from stealing our resources or colonising our world (if we Terraform planets, what would they do to Earth - Exoform or Xenoform it ?), to wanting to trade for what to them would be exotic primitive artworks, or just absorbing us into their empire.


![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4arJr6HtnfHGJpnth33F4sSek1XxEQS3vHpdjcuokqyKGz3jFHfMZf.jpg)

### What Would The End Result Be ? ###

I think the end result would almost inevitably be disastrous for humanity.

Assuming the aliens were here with positive motives such as research or tourism, and weren't just planning to bulldoze Earth to make way for a hyperspace bypass, we would still be confronted with a massive blow to our collective confidence.

How could we ever catch up with a civilisation so far above us ? What would be the point of going to the stars when someone else got there before us ? We wouldn't be pioneers, just the latest yokels to arrive in town.

If we look back at human history, the example of what happens when an outward-looking society meets an insular one is almost always the same, especially when the new arrivals appear technologically superior. European empires colonised the world, often using more advanced technology, but sometime just relying on the cultural difference of much higher levels of ruthlessness and aggression. 

Disease is unlikely to be a factor with aliens (unless they do it deliberately), but even without that, it always ends badly for the locals.

The best we can probably hope for is to be seen as so dangerous but also interesting for research that after a first visit the aliens treat us as we treat the Sentinalese islanders. Quarantined, left alone, and studied from afar. Oh wait, they may already be doing that....

![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4arJr6HtnfHGJpnth33F4sSek1XxEQS3vHpdjcuokqyKGz3jFHfMZf.jpg)

title.title: Do You Want To Make God Laugh? Tell Him About Your Plans
title.body:
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUKjxQrTnxxX6mL4sEFyhmhXjThReNcMjBf11QQHxsQZ2/20260419_034824805_ios_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUKjxQrTnxxX6mL4sEFyhmhXjThReNcMjBf11QQHxsQZ2/20260419_034824805_ios_2.jpg) ***Greetings, friends.*** Do any of my readers remember my post about my morning walk last Sunday? [I can remind you](https://ecency.com/hive-139358/@apnigrich/easter-walk). And this morning, when I looked out the window, I already assumed that the Snow Queen had returned to us. Apparently, she forgot something in our region. But I can say that this is not a surprise to me. Let Winter show its temper in April rather than in May.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP7UXYmwp9RNeHPvghbn1VNJPBE3wyd3sgbvzkAngvhGP/20260419_033325263_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP7UXYmwp9RNeHPvghbn1VNJPBE3wyd3sgbvzkAngvhGP/20260419_033325263_ios.jpg) Let's go back, friends, 2 days ago. Around noon on Friday, I noticed it was starting to rain outside the window and was saddened that I had not brought an umbrella. By evening, the rain had picked up, and on Saturday morning, it became clear that all work in the garden would have to be postponed due to the incessant rain. In the evening, when it was dark outside, I looked out the window and saw snow. So, Sunday morning, there was a snow cover more than 20 centimeters high on the street, and there was no electricity in the house, as in the whole village. So I decided to go for a walk with the dog.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNy922nr89CQKmjYsZv3ufKMzDviQz2qNjdjdHTrhR9Rs/20260419_033928908_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNy922nr89CQKmjYsZv3ufKMzDviQz2qNjdjdHTrhR9Rs/20260419_033928908_ios.jpg) I hadn't planned a long walk because snow was still falling from the sky, which was trying to get in my face. After looking around, I decided to head to the stadium, but when I reached the cemetery, I saw trees covered with wet snow, and I headed down the road through the cemetery towards the river.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTgtfFtZBdryVSfjndLM988cj43TGoEVKCZ9zXVvUQpG/20260419_034715093_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTgtfFtZBdryVSfjndLM988cj43TGoEVKCZ9zXVvUQpG/20260419_034715093_ios.jpg)
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGnoZHkQyqSW42JPiSY4zQmtfvtHcvAmahBExwPZGUDk/20260419_034748667_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGnoZHkQyqSW42JPiSY4zQmtfvtHcvAmahBExwPZGUDk/20260419_034748667_ios.jpg) A white snowy plain, half flooded with water. This new snow and yesterday's rain will add more water to the rivers. By the way, the weather forecast promises 2 more snowy days. In this snow story, the only thing that bothered me at the time was that I had installed summer wheels on my car last week. But I can say that the snow left the road in the afternoon, and in the evening I got safely to my apartment in Kirov.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQmxnFCxtmUWKUnNvtGSnDdWhMMQZdaYnPNnfnSowamd/20260419_034844658_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQmxnFCxtmUWKUnNvtGSnDdWhMMQZdaYnPNnfnSowamd/20260419_034844658_ios.jpg)
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbsZNZCVTv5PF3GkgURdtvdjiVnYpe7xMNa6SczzVHsj/20260419_035041670_ios_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbsZNZCVTv5PF3GkgURdtvdjiVnYpe7xMNa6SczzVHsj/20260419_035041670_ios_2.jpg) The dog was very happy about this renewal in nature. She kept sniffing around in the snow. I didn't let her off the leash because I was planning a short walk. And, by the way, five meters in front of us, at one point, a little weasel ran and hid in the bushes by the water. She couldn't run fast because she was literally drowning in the deep snow. My Nora did not expect to see this; she jerked after the rodent, but the leash did not allow her to catch up with this little animal.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfMTEXqwUNPP685fEm2eB2YbZaQqiVxLJp28LhmYxCmM5/20260419_035056144_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfMTEXqwUNPP685fEm2eB2YbZaQqiVxLJp28LhmYxCmM5/20260419_035056144_ios.jpg)
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT8LJfBfDEubGgS23NnhEAjrwt9ktWLKJxxdvYq6mcsnc/20260419_035157397_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT8LJfBfDEubGgS23NnhEAjrwt9ktWLKJxxdvYq6mcsnc/20260419_035157397_ios.jpg) Last week I photographed two butterflies in this place. Where are they now?
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRBe1PqkbF1wcDgUiBzfFgKjsHPfMpFQik5Sy71SSdnAT/20260419_035213234_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRBe1PqkbF1wcDgUiBzfFgKjsHPfMpFQik5Sy71SSdnAT/20260419_035213234_ios.jpg) You can compare this place with what [I saw last week](https://images.ecency.com/p/qjrE4yyfw5pJD9LKQ1BG3BAmr5TYaANmrJEBZ9YLQqcQMFHDZP9iHjyzarr1nUnD8tegaTHN19BFbDHdYuzH7mW9yguqyzNAZWQzcUfX3f6nsjMpsBRaGUMk?format=match&mode=fit&width=1280).
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7dEtrJ5q7LuM3kwtuDYAnEi7PTK2t6dZu23WAp1KKku/20260419_035255181_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7dEtrJ5q7LuM3kwtuDYAnEi7PTK2t6dZu23WAp1KKku/20260419_035255181_ios.jpg) She's already run away; you don't have to smell her tracks anymore.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeQ8hvZHVnTzjGvqwUF82QXgSiHaeQ5B7vWb1m6RdhtyU/20260419_035926036_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeQ8hvZHVnTzjGvqwUF82QXgSiHaeQ5B7vWb1m6RdhtyU/20260419_035926036_ios.jpg) When I came up from under the mountain to the road, I saw a strange car. Why is he standing here? Wow, there's another car. Why are they here? It's too early to look for mushrooms. This is a joke.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmakCBvgg1yomNn2tLQkkeomDhrtnJEPFoPEYvXoF48obf/20260419_040103378_ios_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmakCBvgg1yomNn2tLQkkeomDhrtnJEPFoPEYvXoF48obf/20260419_040103378_ios_2.jpg) That's the answer. Another tree fell on the road and blocked the passage. This has already happened several times this winter.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvWJXH5FcgcDT89iCKxwwgJrBh57dzs1AAiVzMuaYUoh/20260419_040143883_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvWJXH5FcgcDT89iCKxwwgJrBh57dzs1AAiVzMuaYUoh/20260419_040143883_ios.jpg)
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYp4FXdjXZRLmVkBHVUmht84Ygn5cevGZiAK6ipgdUZUk/20260419_040633930_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYp4FXdjXZRLmVkBHVUmht84Ygn5cevGZiAK6ipgdUZUk/20260419_040633930_ios.jpg)
In the afternoon, I took another walk and discovered that after my first walk, 2 more trees had fallen on the road. But people successfully sawed them down and cleared the road.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQhr4AAv4xR4ZCC4HfpP8UobpsY8HofKstsJmepSu4w8X/20260419_061243349_ios.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQhr4AAv4xR4ZCC4HfpP8UobpsY8HofKstsJmepSu4w8X/20260419_061243349_ios.jpg) At the end of March, when the warm weather came and the snow began to melt, the birds stopped coming to the feeder, but today they decided to eat the seeds in my dining room again. To do this, I filled them with fresh food.
Yes, this weekend went completely wrong as planned. I was going to plant blueberries and prepare a planting site for apple trees. I hope that I can do it on the next day off. They say that Nature does not have bad weather. So that's how it was supposed to be today and yesterday
![imagehive1.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbD5H7vX4jU6TiFbUKDRt1VvurE3tmJNBgpmF4jxEYkW/imagehive1.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdnr6CyN4mtmwyYLY8pARGkVVgkXFcvLZv62JTVLhKesF/image.png)
***Don’t Worry, Be Happy*** (C) Bobby McFerrin
Text & Photography by @apnigrich
With love @apnigrich
Good luck and have fun
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTaptAjVsgabYkFsYE2HhYkehE8Xyx6T7Ud2En1ELgm4g/image.png) [//]:# (!worldmappin 58.66454 lat 50.12708 long Do You Want To Make God Laugh? Tell Him About Your Plans d3scr) [//]:# (!pinmapple 58.66235 lat 50.12247 long d3scr)

Today I caught myself looking in the mirror a little longer than usual… not in a bad way, just noticing how much I’ve changed lately.

It’s not even about how I look, it’s more about how I feel. Stronger, more aware, a little more sure of who I am and what I want. I still have a long way to go, but I’m finally starting to enjoy the process instead of rushing it.

I’ve been thinking a lot about my future and the life I want to build for myself… something stable, something that gives me peace. I know I’m working toward it, even on the days that don’t feel productive.

For now, I’ll take these small wins… like feeling good in my own skin 🤍

body.title: Memories of my childhood and carefree days
body.body: > Greetings to all good people who sometimes like to knock on the door of the past of their childhood, where some inseparable parts of it remain in their hearts. That's how I found an album with interesting pictures this weekend after lunch, and the memories started to come out on their own and be transferred to paper, that is, the screen. My childhood was marked by a series of turbulences in the country of Serbia, which have always been there. I was born in 1983 in the city of Vršac, where I still live and work today and where my children are now growing up. It sounds ideal, doesn't it? But it was never ideal, especially in Serbia where there are always some problems, wars, diseases or disagreements, the entire Balkans is unfortunately known for that. In 1991, after the collapse of the SFRY of Yugoslavia, which consisted of 6 republics, a new Balkan war broke out in which, unfortunately, Serbia, Bosnia and Croatia and NATO were participants, which of course also affected inflation and the standard of living of all of us who, until noon that day, could buy half a loaf of bread for our full salary, and had to convert dinars into German marks of the time and sell gasoline on the streets in order to survive. But let's move on to brighter topics. Both before and after that period in the old Yugoslavia, in my opinion, it was the best ever to live here, so I first singled out some favorite pictures from my childhood from that period

> By the way, these two 40-year-old picture albums are the handiwork of my father, who at that time worked in a city printing house Somehow, those were carefree days, my father, mother and kindergarten took care of me while I was growing up, and sometimes my grandmother and grandfather's aunt intervened, unfortunately I didn't have it.

> Those 10 years of living near the Vrsac lake flew by quickly, yet close to school and town as a tenant, but I still had everything and a roof over my head. this picture with a basket and eggs for Easter in my favorite garden is a unique moment that I saved to show my son now.
> Also, the old picture of the street with my late aunt and uncle and the dogs is especially dear because they were inimitable people in their kindness and perhaps misunderstood nowadays

> Back then, we went to the sea every year, and I had a good time and enjoyed myself, again with balls and horseback riding and fighting the waves, despite the fact that we were building a house on the hill at the other end of town for a record 10 years.
> My new home where I carelessly played on the foundations and hung with my friend on the cherry tree.

> Elementary school passed quickly, and at the beginning of high school, a new chapter of life begins. This is how we used to hang out with school friends and go out into nature, I think that in this period of our lives we were too burdened with Tolkien and Lord of the Rings.

> In 1998, we finally moved from a rented apartment to an unfinished house, and then there was a bombardment with uranium missiles from the air, but God wanted my house to remain intact. Come on, let's talk about beautiful things again. We knew how to enjoy simplicity - in a beautiful garden full of flowers, fruits and vegetables and a dining set, and that without a facade on the house, but there was never a lack of a table and dear people.

> It came quickly, it's time for studies in the new school, from where I have many, many beautiful memories in the space of 10 years, which I can't fit in this blog. and then I managed to go to the sea with my aunt only once. It was perfect, the picture says it all.

> The studies were expensive and we worked on construction only my father and I to pay back the loan to the bank. This is still a dear picture of the neighbor's free concreting of 2 lanes of the road of our small narrow street on the hill before the asphalt came.

> After my studies, I started working in a secondary chemical school and then in a special school with children with special needs for almost 8 years. And that's when I met my current wife while shopping one day in the Chinese boutique where she worked. And those pictures are not in these albums, but they are in digital form, and right now they are the most in my heart, and we will talk about that at another time. I came to the conclusion of one thing: If you carefully read the blog and looked at the pictures, you will notice that there are always some balls around me. Coincidence? wherever and whenever I was, somehow they kept finding me, probably fate decided that they would become part of my life calling. And now I sit in front of my finished house and look at the two of them and think about it. Then and now.

> I hope you found this little piece of the biographical timeline interesting. Until the next opportunity, turn your time machines too, open the dusty boxes with pictures and take some time for yourself where you will be left to beautiful events from the past, because a person sometimes needs to look behind himself in order to know where to go next in life...

body.title: Chromotherapy: Purple color, childhood memories and lavender scent (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** Greetings and blessings, friends of the @holos-lotus community. It’s a pleasure to share my thoughts on @emiliorios’s post, [Cromoterapia o la Importancia del Color -Elige una Imagen y Comparte tus Ideas- Conociendo al Usuario](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/cromoterapia-o-la-importancia-del-color-elige-una-imagen-y-comparte-tus-ideas-conociendo-al-usuario-esen), regarding colors. Years ago, I took a course on making flowers out of foam, and I was struck by the fact that one of the girls made a very pretty red rose and blended the edges with black. Personally, I thought it was a technique to combine other colors and create an effect with them. When we handed in our work to be evaluated by the instructor, she—like many of the participants, including myself—was surprised to see such a beautiful rose with black edges. Of course, this color combination is beautiful and elegant, but it’s not common to see a rose with black edges. I don’t know if such a thing actually exists; nature always surprises us, and maybe there is a rose like that. After reviewing the students’ work, the teacher offered suggestions for improving techniques such as petal folding and cutting, among others, and focused on explaining the importance of combining colors and their meanings. Red is generally associated with passion and desire, while black, as the teacher explained, reflects sadness, pain that remains hidden and, to some extent, dominates the person, preventing them from valuing themselves as they are and often making them feel inferior to others. She also explained that black acts as a mask a person wears to protect themselves and hide something they don’t want to come to light. This explanation left me reflecting for several minutes, and later I looked up the psychology of color in books, where the meaning of each color is explained. and there I realized that even a small detail like choosing a color can reveal a great deal about our personality, as well as the situations or events we are experiencing.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Saludos y bendiciones amigos de la comunidad @holos-lotus, es un placer aportar mis ideas sobre la publicación del amigo @emiliorios, [Cromoterapia o la Importancia del Color -Elige una Imagen y Comparte tus Ideas- Conociendo al Usuario](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/cromoterapia-o-la-importancia-del-color-elige-una-imagen-y-comparte-tus-ideas-conociendo-al-usuario-esen), relacionada con los colores, hace años realicé un curso para hacer flores con foami y me llamó la atención que una de las chicas hizo una rosa muy bonita de color rojo y difuminó los bordes con el color negro, en lo personal pensé que se trataba de una técnica para combinar otros colores y crear un efecto con los mismos, al momento de entregar nuestro trabajo y ser evaluados por la instructora, ella al igual que muchos de los participantes incluyéndome, nos sorprendimos al ver una rosa tan bonita con los bordes de color negro, claro que esta combinación de colores es hermosa y elegante, pero no es común ver una rosa con los bordes negros, desconozco si realmente existe , la naturaleza siempre nos sorprende y tal vez hay una rosa así. Terminadas las revisiones de los trabajos, la profesora hizo las sugerencias para mejorar las técnicas como el doblado de los pétalos, cortes, entre otros y se centró en explicar la importancia de combinar los colores y su significado, el rojo generalmente está vinculado con la pasión y el deseo, el negro, refleja según lo que la profesora explicaba, tristeza , dolor que permanece oculto y en cierta medida dominan a la persona y le impiden valorarse como es y generalmente se sienten inferior a los demás, también explicó que el negro constituye una máscara que usa la persona para protegerse y ocultar algo que no queiere que salga a la luz, esta explicación me dejó reflexionando por varios minutos y posteriormente busqué en los libros la psicología del color, donde se explica el significado de cada uno de ellos, allí comprendí que con un pequeño detalle como lo es seleccionar un color es mucho lo que podemos reflejar de nuestra personalidad, situaciones o eventos que estamos viviendo. ![lotus (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xAcR3ykCyGZH3ZKfmotx9VW4LvLUpMkv1x9mc6aJ5q7Rj4ycdzKWLXt3DaT33yhiqQ9.jpeg)

> After seeing @emiliorios’s post and the three photos he shared, my absolute favorite is the one of the lavender field with the sky and its beautiful colors. I love watching the sunset—in fact, it’s my favorite part of visiting the countryside, the beach, and the mountains; Watching the colors in the sky blend together and then give way to night is truly a beautiful experience. I enjoy watching as the sun gradually sets, the clouds coloring the sky with different hues until night finally falls. This lavender field—and especially the sky—reminds me of the many sunsets I’ve seen, but especially of my childhood. Looking at the picture—the view of the night sky, the stars, and the lavender flowers in a beautiful, peaceful field—reminds me of a cleaning product we used a lot at home, whose most recognizable scent was lavender. the flowers make me smell the scent of this disinfectant and recall the beautiful moments of my childhood with my sisters and parents; there was no better cleaning product with a scent as pleasant as this one—it was more popular than other scents like strawberry, tutti frutti, and lemon. Its scent is pleasant, and needless to say, just this image brought back so many memories: my mother cleaning, the music we usually listened to while cleaning, my sisters or I cleaning the house—I particularly like cleaning with music 🎵. After sweeping, she would mop the floor and add this disinfectant; its scent would fill the house and linger for hours. It’s amazing how an image that seems so simple can bring back such beautiful memories. I think the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words” really applies here, and I’m convinced that’s true. There’s so much I could write about this image and the many memories, scents, and moments that come to mind, but I’ll focus on my childhood and part of my adolescence when I cleaned the house and used this well-known product. It also reminds me of rainy afternoons when we had to come inside and wipe our feet on the rug because my mom had already cleaned and it was forbidden to walk in with wet feet, so as not to dirty the floor.

>

Al ver la publicación de @emiliorios y las tres imágenes que comparte, definitivamente mi favorita es la del campo de lavanda con el cielo y sus hermosos colores,  me encanta observar el atardecer,  de hecho es mi parte favorita cuando visito el campo, la playa y la montaña; ver los colores en el cielo mezclarse para luego dar paso a la noche, es realmente una linda experiencia,  disfruto mirar como progresivamente el sol se va ocultando,  las nubes van tiñendo el firmamento, con diferentes colores hasta que finalmente llega la noche, este campo de lavanda y en especial el cielo, me recuerda los muchos atardeceres que he visto, pero en especial mi infancia.

Observar la imagen, la vista del cielo nocturno,  las estrellas y las flores de lavanda en un hermoso y agradable campo,  me recuerda un producto muy usado en casa,  para la limpieza, cuyo aroma más conocido era el de lavanda,  las flores me llevan a percibir el aroma de este desinfectante y los hermosos momentos de mi infancia con mis hermanas y mis padres,  no había un mejor producto para limpiar y con aroma tan agradable como este, superaba en demanda a  otros aromas como fresa,  tutti frutti y limón,   su aroma es agradable y está demás decir que solo con esta imagen vinieron a mi mente muchísimos recuerdos, mi madre limpiando,  la música que generalmente se escuchaba para limpiar,  mis hermanas o yo haciendo la limpieza en la casa,  particularmente me gusta limpiar con música 🎵.


 Luego de barrer pasaba la mopa y agregaba este desinfectante,  su aroma impregnaba la casa y permanecía por muchas horas,  es increíble como una imagen que parece sencilla,  traiga tan bonitos recuerdos , creo que en este punto es válida la frase: \

y estoy convencida que es así, es mucho lo que podría escribir sobre esta imagen y los tantos recuerdos, aromas y momentos que vienen a mi mente, pero me centraré en mi infancia y parte la adolescencia cuando limpiaba la casa y usaba este conocido producto, también me recuerda las tardes de lluvia cuándo debíamos pasar a la casa y limpiarnos los pies en la alfombra porque ya mi mamá había limpiado y estaba prohibido pasar con los pies mojados, para no ensuciar el piso. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23tbKPKtoMLUyqPRQTEe6UFTkcmqcRdDo1ZtsnT16Tt1NcnJaLNBV89aEhvVE167YTTbB.png) [Pixabay-JohnNaturePhotos](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/v%c3%ada-l%c3%a1ctea-cielo-estrellas-cosmos-4526277/)

> Generally speaking, when it comes to choosing colors, I tend to go for green, turquoise, pink, and blue, but this image definitely takes me back to my childhood, and I can almost smell the scent of the disinfectant and a gift I received in a gift exchange, which included a lavender-scented body lotion. It was the first time I’d ever used a body fragrance with this scent, I liked it so much that I used it sparingly so it would last longer. I liked it so much that I looked for it in several stores, but I couldn't find it anywhere. I asked the friend who gave it to me, but his mom had bought it in another state, so I gave up looking. Over the years, without even trying, I found a cream similar to this one and bought it without hesitation. The scent is pleasant and long-lasting, and the cream is very gentle and ideal for skin care and protection.

> Por lo general en cuanto a la elección de colores generalmente mi tendencia es escoger el color verde, turquesa, rosado y azul, pero definitivamente esta imagen me traslada a mi infancia y puedo percibir el perfume del desinfectante y un obsequio que recibí en un intercambio de regalo, el cual incluía una crema corporal con aroma a lavanda, fue la primera vez que usé un perfume para el cuerpo con este aroma, me gustaba tanto que lo usaba en pequeñas porciones para que durara por más tiempo. Me gustó tanto que lo estuve buscando en varias tiendas pero fue imposible conseguirlo, le pregunté al amigo que me lo obsequió, pero su mamá la había comprado en otro estado del país, desistí en la búsqueda y con el paso de los años sin proponérmelo, encontré una crema similar a esta y sin dudarlo la compré, el aroma es agradable y duradero la crema muy suave e ideal para el cuidado y protección de la piel. ![lotus (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eos1PunfaoVnCG6GvNBzyWbvwBojm41BTxF7UVbdKXQP7Bf3PwKhmErp5t9rcT1RLx5.jpeg)

> ![dese.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xpa97s1nEmxvZDqAMx4ZzmjvkUmxhHxiCA1BRqEKxTZWwMi7qP93b8ZBqN27bMBVLD2.png) ¡Bendiciones! ![298840ed-dc99-44dd-88ae-e5dd98c6a2fd-e077c470-b3b4-41b7-8298-8b73f49e1a25-v1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/AKCBArsVymhAtxSEXuQEXVtGFqs179BAJqxscwbiHjeUjfHW4BXK94BrzTQoN88.png)

Las constancia rinde frutos. Esta semana de entrenamiento ha sido una verdadera prueba de fuego y superación personal. El pasado jueves alcancé un hito que me llena de orgullo: me enfrenté a una ruta cuya mayor parte es pura subida y, por primera vez, logré completarla corriendo de principio a fin, sin detenerme ni un solo segundo. La sensación de conquistar esa cima fue increíble; aunque terminé exhausta, la felicidad de cumplir ese objetivo y bajar mis tiempos previos hizo que cada gota de sudor valiera la pena.
​Hoy domingo cerramos con broche de oro tras un largo tiempo sin hacer distancias mayores. Completé un fondo de 19 kilómetros que puso a prueba mi resistencia física y mental. No fue fácil; el intenso calor provocó que me acalambrara, obligándome a caminar en un pequeño tramo para recuperarme. Sin embargo, no perdí el enfoque: el objetivo era mantener el ritmo y reducir el tiempo en esa distancia, ¡y lo logré! Lo más desafiante fue el trayecto hacia El Cafetal, ese falso plano que parece no terminar nunca y que agota las piernas. A pesar de los obstáculos y el cansancio acumulado, se cumplió la meta con éxito. ¡Seguimos sumando kilómetros con el corazón! Vamos por mas
