Today, with over thirty years in the business, Cristian Castro remains a fascinating anomaly. While reggaeton artists measure their success by Spotify streams, he continues to sell tickets to see him belt out songs live, with those gestures that seem straight out of an eighties telenovela. His influence on Latin culture isn't measured by innovation, but by enduring appeal.

He proved that one can be both ridiculous and sublime at the same time, that a prodigious voice can coexist with an outsized ego, and that sentimentality, when performed with absolute dedication, transforms into popular art. For better or for worse, Cristian Castro is the mirror in which all the Latin balladeers who came after him see themselves. A distorting mirror, yes, but a mirror nonetheless. And as long as there are broken hearts searching for an anthem, his voice will continue to float in the air, as uncomfortable and necessary as a sigh at three in the morning.

In a culture where romantic love is experienced as a possession—where I love you, then I suffer for you, then I hate you, then I write you a bolero—Castro became its ultimate exponent. His voice, with those high notes that sound like a suppressed scream, lends a strange dignity to amorous submission.

Critics called him histrionic; fans, on the other hand, called him \

with nothing to envy and even surpassing Luis Miguel. And therein lies the key to his longevity: while other artists evolved toward more urban or electronic sounds, Cristian deliberately remained in the territory of the melodramatic ballad. It wasn't a lack of talent; it was pure strategy. He knew his audience didn't want experimentation. He wanted trademark tears

In recent years, his tribute albums to José José and Juan Gabriel have been notable, as well as his \

albums where he reinterprets his most emblematic songs with modern arrangements. These continue to keep his career alive, his hits are still going strong, and we hope to continue writing about him in the near future. Until next time. God bless you...
Hoy, con más de treinta años de carrera, Cristian Castro sigue siendo una anomalía fascinante. Mientras los reguetoneros miden su éxito por reproducciones en Spotify, él sigue vendiendo boletos para verlo desgañitarse en vivo, con esos gestos que parecen sacados de una telenovela de los ochenta. Su influencia en la cultura latina no se mide en innovación, sino en permanencia.

Él demostró que se puede ser ridículo y sublime al mismo tiempo, que una voz prodigiosa puede convivir con un ego desmedido, y que la cursilería, cuando se ejecuta con absoluta entrega, se transforma en arte popular. Para bien o para mal, Cristian Castro es el espejo donde se miran todos los baladistas latinos que vinieron después. Un espejo deformante, sí, pero un espejo al fin. Y mientras haya corazones rotos buscando un himno, su voz seguirá flotando en el aire, tan incómoda y necesaria como un suspiro a las tres de la mañana.

En una cultura donde el amor romántico se vive como una posesión en donde te quiero, luego te sufro, luego te odio, luego te escribo un bolero, Castro se erigió en su máximo exponente. Su voz, con esos agudos que parecen un alarido contenido, le dan a la sumisión amorosa una dignidad extraña.

Los críticos lo llamaron histriónico; las fans, en cambio, lo llamaron “el Soberano” sin nada que envidiar e incluso superar a Luis Miguel. Y ahí está la clave de su longevidad, mientras otros artistas evolucionaron hacia sonidos más urbanos o electrónicos, Cristian se estancó deliberadamente en el territorio de la balada melodramática. No fue falta de talento, fue estrategia pura. Sabía que su público no quería experimentación; quería lágrimas de marca registrada

En los últimos años, han sido notorios sus producciones en homenaje a José José y Juan Gabriel, además que sus discos de “Primera Fila” donde reversiona con arreglos actuales sus temas más emblemáticos. Continúan dando vigencia a su carrera, siguen todavía sus éxitos y esperamos en un futuro cercano seguir escribiendo sobre él. Hasta la próxima. Dios les bendiga...

body.body:
### Hi Guys!
***

**Yesterday I was on a short hike into forests by the Łyna river near my hometown Olsztyn in Poland. The weather was very nice so I took my family with me - of course I took my camera as well :).**

*The atmosphere - sounds of birds, the smell of trees and different flowers, nice low light among the trees... magical time to be in the field. It is not so dark and rusty like in the very early spirng but still it is not so green like in the summertime.*

This is probably my favorite time - ok, second one after autumn, to explore the forest.

Below I would like to share few selected shots I took.

body.title: The Silver Bloggers Chronicles #42 - My Childhood Area & its changes today
body.body:
***Your Childhood Area & its changes today
Tell us what you remember of the area/ neighborhood you grew up in and the changes that stand out most***?

If ever a wish was granted, I would rather opt for my childhood area where I lived and my lovely neighborhood, who always held a lending hand when in need, even without a second thought.

Greetings dear Hiveans and members of the #Silverbloggers  community.  The immediate [prompt](https://ecency.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-silver-bloggers-chronicles-42-your-childhood-area-and-its-changes-today?referral=shamis) brings  in loads of lost memories. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSzPbudUqH8WzUtGrqoDSHSSuzohRvPGkvTTEYbarWGPS/1776627459187.jpg)
A visit after nearly 30 years

The house behind me, is the one I spent the best of my 25 years, from birth until my marriage, with my parents and siblings, surrounded by so called affectionate and empathetic neighbourhood.  Then,  these quarters were painted in just yellow colour. Now its a combination of cream amd red. But the building remains the same.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeee1WPJ9yQhb6NgP622Z7twHnr6e2sgo7XBCokwqSeYD/1776627494500.jpg)
During water crisis, this borewell came as a great relief

This one is a borewell installed when I was in my 8th grade. Still remains the same in the same place, but painted with a different colour.  My visit to this place is after 30 years.  Somewhere I felt everything is the same except for the greenery around.  More new quarters have  taken over.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZZN4p4vLGRZQs3EUWQGY9sQjsfpgqVLJu65A2gFDM9u/1776627588532.jpg)
Once busy with kids, remains empty now with grass all over.


The big playground right in front of my home,  was the biggest blessing where kids united and was always occupied by children of all ages, remains silent now.  It was a cricket ground, a football ground, a space taken to conduct  any programmes is now a silent area, because children are now more engaged in mobile rather than the open games which keeps us mentally happy and physically fit.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPeZHs5iMHoeB8Qg9foDacQsokHK8sa7aubj45myxgSKt/1776627747034.jpg)
A school with a vision, with lot of intellects 


My school, just a kilometer away from home has changed a lot. But this was a recent change with new buildings around.   I was told the old building had its own irreparable reasons whereby, with the help of Alumini a new one was built.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmavmt3urZLvzEniMUP5RNAjmQAag8Cot1adeqFgHKZTSa/1776627824767.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcs1ksTpLDUGDx4uu9f4azvhL6eHX3S3QPBh9EzjsL2VG/1776627824800.jpg)


These are the beautiful lanes where I walked through to reach the bus stand, while in college.  Due to limited bus service, we never had a direct bus.  We had to take nearly three different buses,  plying our college area. It was a tough time, but the best moment ever. Because all these buses carried students to different colleges and it was such a fun, as we were young and full of energy.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXiYCoXNbi8jKa9q96y4dn9S4f3ZiTDwrPjtugXQfvYQf/1776627859562.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWdYnKVgmVGNeFJn3KvpQpnJLf4ftbjw1nnWt94qi7E4M/1776627859624.jpg)


Writing this article reminds me of the nook add corner of my residential area, and I would definitely give this credit to #silverbloggers community.

Thankyou friends for your time... Good day to all.

body.title: BlackBerry... The Movie for Entrepreneurs
body.body:
It's been a while since I had this movie sitting on my phone—probably since February or so. 
A friday afternoon where I decided to simply download 5 or 6 of the movies in my playlist to watch in my free time. 
That's how I got my hands into this gem of a movie, one that really hit close to home..
***
## <center>BlackBerry.</center>
***
### Plot
> Two scientists and best friends, Mike Lazaridis and Douglas Fregrin had an idea that would change the world of business communication forever. Yet they realize that for them to survive in the business world, they need the help of a business shark.
Success and fame came, yet it seems these two scientists have bitten off more than they can chew.

https://youtu.be/cXL_HDzBQsM?si=iT7mIkxE7TvduNis
***
This movie hit close to me because the first phone I remember my father having was the BlackBerry. At that time, it was a fun phone, a definite switch from the smaller button phones (Nokia C310) that I knew about which could only call and play minimal games and couldn't go online.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/pRsE3hMG4lAAAAAC/mad-tv-iphone.gif)
That's the switch that Mike and Doug wanted. A device that could do everything a computer can do and still fit in your hands and as we all know, it was a bit, because if it reached me all the way in Nigeria... Then surely, it was a phenomenon.
Yet this movie, is talking all about how it rose and fell, and what caused it. It's a wholesome film and I'm sure for those who love drama and overemphasized theatrics, you'd love it.

Yet, what I want to talk about is what I learned from the movie. Because what was shown in this film isn't like all other financial rise to fame movies.
What genuinely interested me in this movie was the drive of this one character **Jim Balsillie**


![1003422493.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23u5UkudFUxG5b6kkECyVweSsRqonC7AjngH4VgzhBUFsUD38HymP4iMkDwhBJxvUBzbA.jpg)

Now this guy Jim, can be grossly regarded as the antagonist and the major reason behind the fall of BlackBerry is because of his shading deals and infringement on the law.
Yet, I believe that the real antagonist was the greed and the shift of values between the two CEOs. Jim was introduced as the guy that had the drive to survive in the business world, and he did just that.


![1003422539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tkfd337XX5AFmj27ckpaQu2gfQnMob4reJejdhnSFN1nbb67RK62GfDoVBaXr6h7FLU.jpg)

As a fellow entrepreneur, I can say that from this movie I've learned quite a lot on how to push products in sales and just how harsh you have to be to manage people.
He went even farther, knowing when to be persuasive, when to back down and when to bite hard. It was straight up inspirational...
Although he did have some anger issues, it's clear his heart was in the right place 😂😂

|![1003422540.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tRoz5WC5vSNUVGdQ2ME3LNWbmaoNM8B7Z4Fs7KWNbUz76E8QQdbFXDeykzwc6339HCR.jpg)|![1003422541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tbHAjuotF3t7owccAGR4qqFQRmfaAtuMeBYJkpLJn4VrBjVKqfDs6fJ3sBVtpR4xtKV.jpg)|
|-|-|


The Co CEO; Mike and the other characters to me really pale in comparison to the amount of activity Jim brings to the scene.

Despite that, they did still play their parts well. The movie was a joy to watch and very informative to me.
It's a great story to watch for those in the business sector. It might seem a bit slow or boring for normal viewers though, yet I still encourage all to watch it!

It's a stunning 9 out of 10 stars.
 
![1003422614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23wggyb9DEc387FPocjuo6VwYNimQ5YadrxKVB7ZDpQBevvUoZazai18Xfiv34YCS7R1z.jpg)

It turns out that one of the members of the group is an actor in the Cuban soap opera <a href=\

>Ojo de Agua, which is currently being broadcast. His name is Hamlet Paredes in real life. I found out while talking with them, because I don’t watch TV, let alone soap operas. When my sister saw the photos I sent her, she immediately said: “Anaray, that’s the actor!” Hahaha… Well, this is just a colourful note and to mention that he is the author of these two photos.
> I had to split the route into three parts, otherwise connectivity issues might have caused me to lose the overall progress. That way I made sure to have all the data I’m sharing with you here.

> I asked Copilot to share its opinion about this ride in which I had to make a great effort to keep up with the group. This is what it told me: ✅ Positive • Great anaerobic stimulus: those 44 minutes in the high zone give you power, lactate tolerance, and the ability to sustain strong paces. • Good balance with aerobic: 37 minutes in the aerobic zone ensure it wasn’t all “flat out”, which protects your endurance base. • Variety of speeds: moving between 17 and 32 km/h shows your body responds well both in sustained and explosive sections. ⚠️ To consider • Heavy load: so much time in anaerobic can be very demanding on the cardiovascular and muscular systems. If repeated too often, it may cause accumulated fatigue. • Little active recovery: only 2 minutes in the light zone indicate you hardly gave your body space to loosen up and regenerate during the ride.

> In this second stretch, much the same — the figures echo the first. Yet the return was different: the ride back to Vedado, where those who arrived met at El Lolo Café, after pedalling by the sea along the Malecón.

> This was the return home. The road‑rider you can see in the video lives in my municipality. He accompanied me back, so I stayed within those ranges to keep a good pace with him. For me it was demanding, for him it was a relaxed and fun Saturday ride. The wrap‑up Got home knackered, had a nice bath, grabbed some food, and replied to a few Hive comments. Then straight to bed — slept like a baby! Not tired today, but I know I’ve got to let my body soak up all that effort. Maybe I’ll try these tough rides once a week, and hey, maybe the stats will get better over time. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23swsB5Ru5B7QMYCEvVjM1egJDhfEQMKeULT5DaX68BtYLbgdHwdp7u4429NnB85P1Sw6.png

>
Mi primera Escapada Exprés con Citykleta

Lo mencioné

>ayer en mi post, que me iba al workout que los sábados este proyecto planifica para algunos grupos, según el nivel de dificultad de la ruta, hacia diferentes puntos de la ciudad. Yo escogí Cojímar. Tuve que dividir el recorrido en tres partes para evitar que por problemas de conectividad perdiera el progreso de la ruta de manera general. Así me aseguré de tener todos los datos que aquí te comparto. Primera parte del recorrido Le pregunté a Copilot para que diera su opinión acerca de esta salida en la que tuve que esforzarme mucho para seguir el ritmo del grupo. Esto fue lo que me dijo: ✅ Positivo • Gran estímulo anaeróbico: esos 44 minutos en zona alta te dan potencia, tolerancia al lactato y capacidad de sostener ritmos fuertes. • Buen equilibrio con aeróbico: 37 minutos en zona aeróbica aseguran que no todo fue “a fuego”, lo cual protege tu base de resistencia. • Variedad de velocidades: moverte entre 17 y 32 km/h muestra que tu cuerpo responde bien tanto en tramos sostenidos como en explosivos. ⚠️ A considerar • Carga elevada: tanto tiempo en anaeróbico puede ser muy exigente para el sistema cardiovascular y muscular. Si se repite demasiado seguido, puede provocar fatiga acumulada. • Poca recuperación activa: apenas 2 minutos en zona ligera indican que casi no diste espacio al cuerpo para soltar y regenerar durante la salida. Segunda parte del recorrido Lo mismo. Los datos son similares. Diferente fue ruta de regreso hasta el Vedado donde nos reunimos todos (los que llegaron) en la Cafetería El Lolo pues pedaleamos por Malecón. Final del recorrido Este fue el regreso a casa. El chico rutero que puedes ver en el video vive en mi municipio. Él me acompañó, así que volví a estar en esos rangos para ir a buen ritmo con él. Para mí fue exigente, para él fue un paseo sabatino de mucho relax y diversión. El Resumen Llegué a casa cansada, tomé un buen baño, comí y estuve respondiendo algunos comentarios aquí en Hive. Luego me fui a la cama y dormí como una bebé. Hoy no estoy cansada, pero sé que debo darle tiempo a mi cuerpo para asimilar todo ese esfuerzo. Una vez a la semana podría intentar estas escapadas exigentes y, quién sabe, quizá con el tiempo todos estos datos mejoren. La nota de color 😁 Resulta que uno de los integrantes del grupo es actor en la telenovela cubana

>Ojo de Agua, que se está transmitiendo actualmente. Se llama Hamlet. Me enteré conversando con ellos porque yo no veo televisión, y menos aún novelas. Mi hermana, cuando vio las fotos que le mandé, enseguida me dijo: “¡Anaray, ese es el actor!” Jajaja… Bueno, esto es una nota de color y para decir que él es el autor de estas dos fotos.

body.title: Daredevil Born Again: The Scales & The Sword – S02E03 - RECAP
body.body:
https://i.postimg.cc/nrq3QHC4/Dare-Devil-Born-Again-(2025)-S02E03-RECAP-000.gif
[Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-85e7a914-c8e6-41db-95df-c740dc2cf1b7)

https://i.imgur.com/PGNq5Ek.png

Its been three episodes already of Daredevil Born Again season 2 and the show is finally starting to remember what it used to be, first two episodes were kinda draggy specially the premier, because the older Netflix run had this particular quality and this episode gets closer to that feeling with all the fights and specially with potentially a new White Tiger been born, which makes me both relieved and a little frustrated that it took this long to get here, I was expecting this kind of action right from the start but it is what it is. Matt Murdock is still carrying around all that blinded by justice guilt, still moving between justice, range and anger like a man who cannot decide which version of himself he wants to be, and Karen and the remaining allies on his side are trying to hold things together while Fisk get closer and closer to them, but you already knew all that if you have been watching because the show has been building this particular pressure cooker for weeks now. What this episode does differently is that it actually releases some of that pressure and puts Matt in situations where he stops talking about what he should do and just starts doing it, and I forgot how much I missed watching this guy work because the courtroom version of this character is fine but the version who uses every sense he has to tear through a room full of AVTF guys while bleeding all over the place is the reason any other DareDevil fan wants to watch this series. The vibe throughout this one feels heavier than the last couple of weeks, like the show took a step back and said okay enough setup, pedal to the metal, and the result is the closest thing to the old show this season has delivered, which for me personally after being on the fence about this whole revival is exactly what I needed to see.

- IMDB: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt18923754/
- Platform: [DISNEY+](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-85e7a914-c8e6-41db-95df-c740dc2cf1b7)

https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSKZQe.png
<div style=\

> https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSKwzs.png [Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-85e7a914-c8e6-41db-95df-c740dc2cf1b7) https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSK6i7.png [Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-85e7a914-c8e6-41db-95df-c740dc2cf1b7) The episode builds the story of Matt getting back into his badass mode during a really good damn fight sequence inside Fisk Red Hook prison, where he teams up with Jack Duquesne and helps free the prisoners while Karen is working the escape from the outside, and the whole sequence is the kind of tight fast choreography that reminds you why this character works so much better in motion than in a courtroom. Although its not just the action itself but the way they use the environment to show how Matt operates differently from everyone else in that space, because the bad guys are spraying bullets and hoping for the best while Matt is using every sound and surface and air current to know exactly where each person is before he even gets close to them, and it is a detail that a lot of superhero productions skip entirely but this show has always understood it. Jack Duquesne as swords man, getting some actual shine here felt right because bringing more muscle to the good guy side makes the fight feel more real when Fisk sends people to clean things up, and the cast carried every moment even when they were just two people moving through darkness trying to find an exit before the whole situation turned into a graveyard, there were a lot of prisoner and the AVTF was instructed to shoot them down to stop escaping, this were mostly non vigilante just regular people, innocent people. It is the kind of sequence that wipes your memory of the slow parts because you are watching a human being work through a crowd of thugs with nothing but his fists and about forty years worth of anger, and it is dope to see, it is the show operating at the level it is supposed to operate at. https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSKIq6.png [Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-85e7a914-c8e6-41db-95df-c740dc2cf1b7) https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSKixT.png [Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-85e7a914-c8e6-41db-95df-c740dc2cf1b7) Everything about the introduction of Angela Del Toro as the new White Tiger felt rushed to me but exciting too, you can see it coming a mile away, she is still early in her story as a hero so her tough talk came across flat and the whole thing felt too compress, because she is standing there trying to talk big to seasoned criminals and it just sounds like someone who has watched too many movies and not enough actual street level violence, the girl weights 100 pounds at most, any guy from the AVTF slaps her and put her to sleep. The character is not trash but they need to give her a real situation to react to instead of just having her stand in the corner looking intense while the people who actually know what they are doing handle the hard stuff. The whole story is simple but it gets cold when Fisk moves to destroy the wrecked Northern Star and control the aftermath in a way that keeps his hands clean on paper, and you could see he felt like garbage during his conversation with Vanessa about it, but he went ahead anyway because that is who Wilson Fisk is, he is not just a power hungry businessman but a monster who will bury any evidence that threatens his grip on the city and feel bad about it for exactly thirty seconds before moving on. The ship related scene is probably the most disturbing part of the episode because it shows how deeply that control goes, and the way everyone around Fisk just executes without asking questions shows you how completely he owns the people in his orbit right now. https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSKetM.png [Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-85e7a914-c8e6-41db-95df-c740dc2cf1b7) https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSKl5t.png [Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-85e7a914-c8e6-41db-95df-c740dc2cf1b7) The psychiatrist situation is the one thread that really has me looking sideways at the screen, because she is keeping Muse mask in her desk drawer and acting like she is hearing things in between sessions creating this spark that she might turn into Muse soon or latter, btch be crazy. The whole psychological aspect of her scenes reminds me of how Hannibal used to play with its supporting characters before they became something dangerous. Her scenes are quiet and unsettling creating this massive contrast to the explosions, shooting and bone cracking fights happening everywhere else in the episode its like the perfect silence before the storm and one of the biggest problem I find is that she might have inside info on Fisk and Matt when she turns into the new Muse, and that contrast is doing a lot of work because we already know roughly how the physical battles are going to end but the mental games are where things get unpredictable for Matt and the people around him. She is sitting there looking like a completely put together professional while hiding the face of a serial killer in her drawer, which is some next level unhinged behavior, and it makes you feel discomfort at every other potential stable adult on this show creating this suspicion of who will turn next because you have no idea who is secretly working for which side, living in a city where the Kingpin basically runs the law. https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png

> https://i.imgur.com/r0yj9oi.png After watching this episode Im 50/50 with it, I feel disappointed that the middle section drags in places with people going in circles over paperwork and corrupt justice theater because the scenes at the courtroom during Swordsman hearing was nothing special, but the ending was fkn nuts and it saved the whole hour from being just another bridge episode that you have to sit through to get somewhere interesting. The episode also  gave us a real look into how the criminal side of this city operates, this series have many seasons in it ngl at least five season imo but I bet Disney going to cut its wings, the show is giving us a city where everyone is positioning to be smarter or faster or just breathing long enough to collect their cut and it is exactly the kind of moment the show needs more of because it reminds you that Fisk is not just a threat to Matt personally but a machine that runs on loyalty and fear and keeps grinding forward regardless of what the only hero standing could be doing, seen all those prisoners walking away was like nothing because he controls the media and who is going to believe them?. I give this episode a 7/10 because the Red Hook prison sequence and the action are dope enough to carry the weight of the weaker scenes, but the show still needs to find a way to trim the corrupt justice and vigilante trial elements down so there is more room for real confrontation, and the new heroes being introduced are going to need real moments to earn their place in this story before they stop looking like just decoration, as long as Matt Murdock keeps giving us bloody battles I will be watching week after week. https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png

body.title: Trees that are slow to grow bear the best fruit! (weekly crypto updates)
body.body:
​

https://images.hive.blog/DQmX5iMfNxUo3z129s1B4PBkHUxDcvzyDnAQ99N5uK1tV5e/thumb%20mgc.jpg

What happened in crypto in the past week? This week we had Nigel Farage discovering Bitcoin, and while stocks are down, and gold is down, BTC is up 12%. Altcoins are also on the rise, but not as much. I found a way to expose myself to BTC via BlackRock, using [Freetrade. ](https://magic.freetrade.io/join/george/a08af1d8 \

). Feel free to check them. What else? Read below:

- Bitcoin: Some said that the Bitcoin 50% drop form its all-time high already reflects the quantum risk. Apparently  there is a window of three to five years to agree on a post-quantum upgrade. Saylor is close to overtake BlackRock, reaching 780K BTC, as the second are sitting at 790K BTC. Goldman Sacks filed for a Bitcoin ETF, but they will not hold Bitcoin directly, just buy into other Bitcoin ETFs and sell options on the top to generate income. Seems a bit dodgy, just saying give me you money to pretend to invest into BTC. Why would you want that? Bitcoin rose 5.38% this week. 
​

- Ethereum: Bitmine reported a $3.82B quaterly loss, and then bought more ETH anyway. They mentioned tokenization and AI as ETH's next catalysts. ETH outperformed BTC slightly, with a 7.26% increase this week. Ethereum L2 Scroll is planning to dissolve their Security Council in a favor of a Scroll Admin multisig, and some see this as increasing centralization.

body.title: One time bulk investment or SIP which one is better?
body.body:
I was taking to someone about PPF and they asked me a question if it would be beneficial to invest 1.5 L which is the limit for the year in just one shot or would it be good to invest monthly in an SIP format. This question can be applicable not just for PPF but also for other type of investment but the answer is very simple. IT DEPENDS. 

So for an investment like PPF where the percentage returns is mostly fixed, investment during the start of the year in bulk will be beneficial. But for other type of investments the timing really matters. When market is very low, investing in bulk can yield a high returns in terms of the value of our investment than the return the investment would be giving us in return. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT5pDFPjDWpu8FHvhRFZG58QkBoeoUJCGbxjTg98DQsM1/1776626911022.webp)


Source - Sora

Hive can be taken as a good example for comparison. For example if we are at the right timing and make a huge investment when the value of Hive is down, we will still get the 4% staking APR but apart from that if the timing is correct and the value of Hive increases, we should be able to get a good return on investment as the price of Hive has also increased. The same cannot happen if we had done an SIP investment on Hive. In this case a bulk investment when the market is low makes a lot more sense than monthly example. 


Now we have two examples in place where we are able to understand that the timing is very important and it also depends on where we are investing. Just blindly investing in something may not end up very well if we don't understand what we are doing. So there is no one answer for this question. When we expect the money to have maximum compounding from Day 1, lump sum investment is good. But when the market parameter is added, there is just an additional luck included but otherwise even the SIP that we are doing can also have the magic of compounding.

body.title: Was passiert mit meinen Bitcoin im Scheidungsfall?/ What happens to my Bitcoin in case of divorce?
body.body:
![29515.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ3JtWQJrUzbW1HvzK57wJeGpNFNuguVwwUtRnBdeSrBZ/29515.jpg)

Krypto-Assets tauchen immer häufiger in Scheidungsverfahren auf. Anwälte berichten, dass vermögende Ehepartner Bitcoin und andere Token gezielt verschweigen.

Vermögende Ehepartner verschweigen in Scheidungsverfahren zunehmend ihre Bestände an Bitcoin und anderen Kryptowährungen. Das berichten mehrere auf Familienrecht spezialisierte Anwälte. Die digitale Natur der Token erschwert die Aufdeckung und verzögert Einigungen vor Gericht.

In einem Fall, über den ein nicht namentlich genannter Anwalt berichtet, schöpfte eine Ehefrau Verdacht, nachdem sie handschriftliche Notizen mit langen Zahlenfolgen entdeckt hatte. Sie erwirkte gerichtliche Offenlegungs- und Einfrierungsanordnungen gegen ihren Ehemann und eine Krypto-Börse. Daraufhin musste der Mann einräumen, tatsächlich Krypto-Assets zu halten.

“Er sagte, er habe sie nicht angegeben, weil sie alt gewesen seien und es keine wirklichen Transaktionen mehr gegeben habe”, so der Anwalt. Der Wert der Bestände sei gering gewesen, dennoch gelte: “Man muss alle Vermögenswerte offenlegen.”

. “Früher parkten Menschen ihr Geld in Offshore-Treuhandstrukturen, Unternehmen und ähnlichem; das passiert natürlich immer noch, aber zunehmend sehen wir, dass es in Krypto geschieht.” In den kommenden zehn Jahren werde die Zahl solcher Fälle deutlich steigen, auch wegen der Popularität von Kryptowährungen bei jüngeren Generationen.

**Auch bei Eheverträgen spielen digitale Vermögenswerte inzwischen eine Rolle. Werden erhebliche Bestände, darunter Krypto-Assets, nicht offengelegt, kann dies zur Unwirksamkeit eines Ehevertrags führen.**

In Deutschland werden Bitcoin im Scheidungsfall wie andere Vermögenswerte behandelt. Leben Ehepartner im gesetzlichen Güterstand der Zugewinngemeinschaft, wird auf Antrag berechnet, wie viel Vermögen beide zwischen Eheschließung und Zustellung des Scheidungsantrags hinzugewonnen haben. “Derjenige, der in dieser Zeit mehr hinzugewonnen hat, muss dann dem anderen die Hälfte dieses Zugewinns abgeben”, erklärt Rechtsanwalt Christian Solmecke im Gespräch mit BTC-ECHO. Durch die teils starken Kursschwankungen könne es passieren, dass Bitcoin am Stichtag sehr hoch bewertet werden, bis zum Verfahrensende jedoch deutlich an Wert verlieren. Das könne für den vermeintlich vermögenderen Partner “teures Pech” sein.

**BTC-ECHO: Worauf sollte man unbedingt achten, wenn man Bitcoin und Co. vererben möchte?**

Grundsätzlich erben die Erben das gesamte Vermögen – dazu zählen auch digitale Güter wie Bitcoin beziehungsweise ganz konkret die Zugangsmöglichkeit mittels Private Key zur Wallet. Dass auch digitale Güter, Konten & Co. vererbbar sind, lässt sich aus dem BGH-Urteil zum “digitalen Erbe” ableiten.

Hat der Erblasser den Private Key physisch zum Beispiel auf einem USB-Stick gespeichert, geht er sofort auf die Erben über. Ist der Private Key in einer Online-Wallet gespeichert, tritt der Erbe in den Vertrag zwischen Erblasser und Anbieter ein und hat daher nur einen Anspruch gegen den Anbieter auf Zutritt zur Wallet.

Wichtig ist, dass der Erblasser seinen Erben zum Beispiel im Testament mitteilt, welche Kryptowährungen in seinem Besitz sind und wie die Erben an diese kommen können. Sonst kann es passieren, dass dieser Vermögensteil unentdeckt bleibt.

**Worauf sollte man bei der Schenkung von Bitcoin achten?**

Hier muss im Zweifel Schenkungssteuer gezahlt werden. Maßgeblich ist der Tag der Schenkung. Wenn der Wert da sehr hoch war, schlägt das auch auf die Steuer durch. Man sollte also versuchen, die Bitcoin an einem Tag zu übertragen, an dem der Wert niedrig liegt. Aller­dings sind manche Schenkungen von dieser Steuer befreit – zum Beispiel ein Geschenk an den Ehepartner unter 500.000 Euro, an ein Kind unter 400.000 Euro innerhalb von zehn Jahren.

---

English 

![29515.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ3JtWQJrUzbW1HvzK57wJeGpNFNuguVwwUtRnBdeSrBZ/29515.jpg)

Crypto assets are increasingly appearing in divorce proceedings. Lawyers report that wealthy spouses are deliberately concealing their Bitcoin and other tokens.

Wealthy spouses are increasingly concealing their holdings of Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies in divorce proceedings, according to several lawyers specializing in family law. The digital nature of the tokens makes them difficult to detect and delays settlements in court.

In one case, reported by an unnamed lawyer, a wife became suspicious after discovering handwritten notes containing long sequences of numbers. She obtained court-ordered disclosure and freezing orders against her husband and a cryptocurrency exchange. As a result, the husband was forced to admit that he did indeed hold crypto assets.

 “He said he hadn’t declared them because they were old and there hadn’t been any real transactions,” the lawyer stated. The value of the holdings was low, but the principle remains: “You have to disclose all assets.”

“People used to park their money in offshore trusts, companies, and the like; that still happens, of course, but we’re increasingly seeing it done in crypto.” The number of such cases will rise significantly in the next ten years, partly due to the popularity of cryptocurrencies among younger generations.

**Digital assets are now also playing a role in prenuptial agreements. Failure to disclose substantial holdings, including crypto assets, can render a prenuptial agreement invalid.**

In Germany, Bitcoin is treated like other assets in divorce proceedings. If spouses are subject to the statutory property regime of community of accrued gains, a calculation is made, upon request, of how much wealth each spouse has accumulated between the marriage and the service of the divorce petition.  “The one who has gained more during this period must then give half of that gain to the other,” explains lawyer Christian Solmecke in an interview with BTC-ECHO. Due to the sometimes significant price fluctuations, it can happen that Bitcoin is valued very highly on the valuation date, but then loses considerable value by the end of the proceedings. This could be “expensive bad luck” for the supposedly wealthier partner.

**BTC-ECHO: What should you absolutely consider when bequeathing Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies?**

In principle, the heirs inherit the entire estate – this also includes digital assets such as Bitcoin, or more specifically, access to the wallet via the private key. The fact that digital assets, accounts, and the like are also inheritable can be derived from the German Federal Court of Justice (BGH) ruling on “digital inheritance.”

If the deceased has physically stored the private key, for example on a USB stick, it passes directly to the heirs.  If the private key is stored in an online wallet, the heir assumes the contract between the deceased and the provider and therefore only has a claim against the provider for access to the wallet.

It is important that the deceased informs their heirs, for example in their will, which cryptocurrencies they own and how the heirs can access them. Otherwise, this asset may remain undiscovered.

**What should you consider when gifting Bitcoin?**

Gift tax may be payable. The decisive factor is the date of the gift. If the value was very high on that date, this will also affect the tax. Therefore, you should try to transfer the Bitcoin on a day when its value is low. However, some gifts are exempt from this tax – for example, a gift to a spouse under €500,000, or to a child under €400,000 within ten years.

body.title: The 4th Seed Starting - April 18, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
![Purple finch and goldfinch on feeder crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EoprWfToxzgceX5BG4HRTKKiKEwjcxttQHYmHX7B2LYPhUez8Q4jmpGetC6uEG5wHfx.jpg)

*Purple finch and goldfinch*

Saturday I woke at 5AM but didn’t get up until 5:30AM. I check the e-mail then went out and got the kitchen cleaned up and started setting up for the seed starting.

I sat down to do the seeds, markers, and notes and discovered because I’d taken so many trays to the cold frame, the plan for this starting’s trays was no good. So I had to re-do that. Next I got out the notes sheets and put away the previous startings’ notes as I went. 

Then I got out the seeds I’d need and couldn’t find the Kapija pepper seeds. Inventory showed I had some. So I checked to see if I had ordered any, but no. I had some, apparently. So I sat down and started going through each bag in case they had gotten stuck to another packet. Turns out they were a tiny ziplock bag and blended in with the bottom of the bag they belonged in.

![4th seed starting April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23tmjgGNFjcrxypfg1bJz4ttEVtoedrscwU8axPdop5Bcdzhq8fkDQ9A2RC6iFunwnRKx.jpg)

My #2 intern arrived around 9AM and set to work counting out pots and then filling trays and pots. I worked up a different system because there were so many different plants, 29 to be exact.

I’d group seeds and notes together for each tray and then group all the notes and seeds together for an area, like that Back Porch. The interns said it made the job so much easier!

So mostly I was writing notes and markers or looking for missing seeds. My #2 intern worked until 1PM and her sister, #1 intern, arrived about noon and took over. Shortly after that, I finished the notes, and started filling pots and soaking them. 

My #1 intern did the seeds. Once all the pots were ready, I started doing seeds and washing covers for the trays. We finished about 2PM and then had to clean up the mess.

![Seed starting collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23wgUJNzHdg67PzosUpmVaAz9CprBbhnbkEENh2MWRCE2B2awGKzNJQewmnXX1vdSFXVi.jpg)

All the cabinets, the stool, the chair, the counters, and the floor had to be wiped down. That soil has dried out so much it makes a ton of dust. I finished about 4 PM and went to lie down to watch ‘Leave It to Beaver’ until supper time.

I pulled the shades around 8PM but didn’t light a fire as it was to be 50F and no one had brought in wood. I was in bed by 8:30PM.

![Seed starting - shelves full again collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23wgUJQ5uFKfh9eEJNoEiZA1JfVBZM2nSy8FoYMoPRnLZ8LGxsoWxdamEa2Wh4b8uc3yZ.jpg)

On Sunday I have 3 posts to write to catch up and I must find my big piece of plastic to put on the cold frame as the temps are to fall through the day, with the rain, into the low 30’s during the night. I’ll have to keep fires going all day and for the night. Nothing else planned.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

body.title: Visitamos Sabay Bar en Ko Chang y nos encantó [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
>

Hola a todos! otro lugar que visitabamos a diario mientras estuvimos en la isla Ko Chang, fue el restaurante [Sabay Bar]([//]:# (!worldmappin 12.10792 lat 102.27079 long  d3scr)), no solo porque estaba ubicado cerca de nuestro hospedaje, es decir en White Sand Beach, sino también porque como ven en las fotos de este post, es un sitio muy bonito donde se pasa genial y además se come delicioso, y no solo eso, debo resaltar que la atención allí es espectacular y se toman en serio los pedidos, además la playa en frente hace que de verdad vayas allí a relajarte por lo que a nosotros nos encantó. 

>Hi everyone! Another place we visited every day while we were on Ko Chang Island was the restaurant [Sabay Bar]([//]:# (!worldmappin 12.10792 lat 102.27079 long  d3scr)), not only because it was located near our accommodation—that is, on White Sand Beach—but also because, as you can see in the photos in this post, it’s a very beautiful spot where you can have a great time and enjoy delicious food. And not only that, I must emphasize that the service there is spectacular and they take your orders seriously. Plus, the beach right in front of it makes it the perfect place to go and truly relax, which is why we loved it so much. 


![photo_2026-04-19_20-16-04.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSsGC4ANuVZqTwhq8u2k3LFY6WMFHkqGWWJQ95JLUFLPu/photo_2026-04-19_20-16-04.jpg)


La primera vez que fuímos allí fue porque nos llamó la atención su decoración y es que como ven son unas medusas coloridas e iluminadas colgando de un árbol, además la buena música en vivo también nos llevó allí, pero como ya habíamos cenado ese día solo fuímos a relajarnos mientras nos tomabamos un par de cervezas y le echamos un vistazo al menú para volver la noche siguiente, el cual les cuento es variado, pues tienen comida Tailandesa, pasta, pizzas y algunas cosas para niños, además diferentes bebidas como batidos, cervezas y cócteles deliciosos. 

>The first time we went there was because the decor caught our eye—as you can see, there are colorful, glowing jellyfish hanging from a tree—and the great live music also drew us in, but since we’d already had dinner that day, we just went to relax while having a couple of beers and took a look at the menu to come back the following night. I’ll tell you, the menu is varied—they have Thai food, pasta, pizza, and some kids’ options, plus different drinks like milkshakes, beers, and delicious cocktails. 

![photo_2026-04-19_20-14-25.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXnoURoaWeSknaENt56cqsFgDX9xVTL8SVN1Wfvp2WCPv/photo_2026-04-19_20-14-25.jpg)

<div class=\

> ![photo_2026-04-19_20-14-35.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaG7aCRMvhXR9fUZrF5kXzK3ZarjZJkRjeTnMWLmNtbTL/photo_2026-04-19_20-14-35.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-19_20-16-29.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPUp7R9gNd14gxKz4876RaaYUNjLM5AR379mFPEqPnseZ/photo_2026-04-19_20-16-29.jpg) La noche siguiente si volvimos pero más temprano ya que nos enteramos que tienen espectáculo de fuegos que nos perdimos el primer día por ir tarde, así que también este día aprovechamos de probar la comida allí y les cuento que comimos una pasta a la boloñesa muy deliciosa, a Olivia le pedimos una porción de arroz y huevo cocido (y debo resaltar que el chico que nos atendió todas esas noches siguientes se tomaba muy en serio mi pedido ya que como saben Olivia tiene sensibilidad al huevo por lo que solo puede comerlo bien cocido y si lo come de otra manera o poco cocido le da un fuerte de dolor de barriga, esto se lo expliqué al chico y él me entendió lo cual en otro restaurante que visitabamos no fue así). >The next night we did go back, but earlier, since we found out they have a fireworks show that we missed the first day because we arrived late. So that day we also took the opportunity to try the food there, and I’ll tell you, we had a very delicious pasta Bolognese. For Olivia, we ordered a serving of rice and a hard-boiled egg (and I should point out that the guy who served us all those following nights took my request very seriously, since, as you know, Olivia is sensitive to eggs, so she can only eat them well-cooked; if she eats them any other way or undercooked, she gets a severe stomachache. I explained this to him, and he understood—which wasn’t the case at another restaurant we visited).

> ![photo_2026-04-19_20-42-56.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdkwhuLBz25wTHzLRmn36gdBoMcdXK7hpB15NfEumEGkC/photo_2026-04-19_20-42-56.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-19_20-14-31.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXFTtQVoHVGoHkkRbiP7BLqcWcwDESyFuMwfAkGh3SntA/photo_2026-04-19_20-14-31.jpg) Después de comer nos quedabamos allí tomando cerveza y disfrutando de la música, además de otros espectáculos que daban y que eran muy interesantes, Olivia se divertía jugando con sus juguetes en la arena o mojando sus pies con el agua del mar y no tuvimos ningún problema por estar allí mucho tiempo, así que si me preguntan, este es uno de los lugares que más extraño de la isla, porque la pasabamos muy bien allí, nos relajabamos y todos los chicos que atendían eran muy amables (a ellos también los extraño), así que sin duda alguna si van a Ko Chang en Tailandia yo les recomiendo visitar este bar y restaurante, pues estoy segura que les va a encantar tanto como a nosotros. >After lunch, we’d stay there drinking beer and enjoying the music, as well as other shows they put on that were really interesting. Olivia had fun playing with her toys in the sand or dipping her feet in the ocean water, and we had no problem staying there for a long time, so if you ask me, this is one of the places I miss most about the island, because we had such a great time there—we relaxed, and all the staff were very friendly (I miss them too). So without a doubt, if you’re going to Ko Chang in Thailand, I recommend visiting this bar and restaurant, because I’m sure you’ll love it just as much as we did.

> ![photo_2026-04-19_20-34-25.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXAHAEEvs9PvQ5EJn7W6W1XvcpH6uAoWnn15PbidknwmK/photo_2026-04-19_20-34-25.jpg) -------

body.title: Lake Effect Fog
body.body:
My family and I took a walk to Pier 4 park in Hamilton Ont. With a plan of letting the kids see and feed the swans. But when we reached the parking lot, I noticed fog rolling in from the water. Thankfully I had my drone with me and put it up!

What looked like a fairly light fog from the ground, turned out being a very thick fog and it looked stunning as it made it to the buildings.
![DJI_0095.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcM1gNFozAhG7ijuBudJ6LnAYQCrNg325F4xaayJwd1zm/DJI_0095.JPG)

![DJI_0090.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeMURceTKyHEiF6G1tUnfxXvPm8zRq5rdavAGJaeHL4cP/DJI_0090.JPG)

![DJI_0087.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVsCHHUXGYnTUq9Pq9Uef9VnP2BQFKUQ3Ts3Vq7UrdjH8/DJI_0087.JPG)

Then when I turned the drone to the west, it was a cool scene of the neighborhoods being covered.

![DJI_0086.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPBm2nqLjbSq6AJ6bPQbvyBvW2grhurMhfiGPzXcckZEq/DJI_0086.JPG)

![DJI_0094.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXQcbf2Fufnf87S4gWiMAxPVtofDyBR3PNpJX6qKR16aK/DJI_0094.JPG)

Then I realized that the whole bay and lake Ontario had become a sea of cloud.

![DJI_0092.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNLnSAKcSkANn64WVJGrNTLKGMnT4rK66k8KdfYEX4DqM/DJI_0092.JPG)

![DJI_0093.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ2sb4LzLGw4CHMDk37yjjeZxc7zyUQLsTp3m9jEFcP2G/DJI_0093.JPG)

Despite all of the water being completely covered, the fog actually started to recede back away from the city and stayed over the water only. It was a really cool lake effect that I had never seen before!

After looking at the shots, I think this will make a great post for the  #monomad challenge

body.title: He who sows in his own land, reaps.(Ing/Esp.)-Creative Nonfiction-The Ink Well-Prompt #28
body.body:
>

In the city of Cumaná, Venezuela, in 1971, I married Efraín Rodríguez, and in 1973 I gave birth to my first daughter, whom we named Leocarmen. In 1976, Ernesto José was born; then, in 1977, I had  Engels Efraín, and in 1978, I had Simón Ilich. During that last cesarean section, my fallopian tubes were cauterized, as it was impossible to have any more children.

From that moment on, my husband and I dedicated ourselves to raising them and teaching them family values: love, respect, honesty, responsibility, generosity, and patience.

Since we got married, we've lived in a house in the Bolívar neighborhood, across from the José Silverio González High School. They experienced all stages of their development in this house: childhood, adolescence, and part of adulthood.

Several years later:

Leocarmen has a degree in Business Administration, works at the University of Oriente, is married to José, and has two daughters: Alexa,  Rut, and a grandson.

Engels, a Senior Technician in Business Administration, works at the José Silverio González High School; he also writes stories for Hive and sometimes creates cartoons for other websites. He lives independently with his wife, Nairuvis, and their son, Lenin Vladimir Ilich. Engels also plays the bass guitar.

Simón Ilich has a degree in Education with a specialization in Pure Physics; he works at the José Antonio Ramos Sucre High School. He wrote for Hive for several years. He is the lead singer and plays the bass guitar in the band The Stokers. He lives at his wife Corina's parents' house with his two daughters: Irianny and Estefany.

From a young age, Ernesto José used to sit with a notebook and pencil under the shade of a sea grape tree in our backyard, lost in thought. I would watch him from a distance; then I would pick up the pencil and write in my notebook.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT39BPVR14pP6rHXyismUTVBrmey3Tu7SFFqdKkqXc82n/image.png)

<center>Source from [pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/fondo-de-a%c3%b1o-nuevo-adulto-diario-1850177/)</center>


A week later, I saw my son Ernesto under that tree, meditating with his eyes closed. A little while later, I saw him writing. I approached him and asked:

“Son, what’s wrong? I’ve been watching you for several weeks.” I took a deep breath and then continued:

“After you finish your chores, you come and sit under this tree,” he replied very subtly:

“Sometimes I feel worried, and in this space I feel relaxed, and I also let my imagination run wild and write some drafts of stories,” I smiled and asked him:

“What’s worrying you?” His face was as pale as marble, and his lips were as white as snow. Then he answered:

“I’m turning 18 soon, I’ll be graduating soon; besides studying, I want to learn an art form so I can earn money and buy my own things,” I replied sweetly.

“I’ll talk to your father, but when will you show me those story sketches?” With a smile on his face, he replied:

“Someday.”

That night, my husband and I went to our bedroom; as soon as we lay down, I explained our son Ernesto’s situation to him. He replied:

“At the end of the month, I’ll give him a gift that will allow him to learn an art form.” Overjoyed, I hugged him and said:

“I trust you.”

At the end of the month, Efraín showed up with a box, handed it to my son, and said,

“Here you go. With these tools, you’ll be able to meet many of your personal needs.”

In a short time, Ernesto learned to weld and make furniture, doors, and all sorts of wrought iron items. He built his blacksmith shop on a small plot of land at the house.

Soon after, he married Darggys, and they moved into our house and had their first child, whom they named Ernesto. A year later, my son Ernesto graduated with a degree in Business Administration.

Five years later, he began working at FUNDACOMUNAL as a social promoter, training community members in Community Councils. After lunch and a rest, he would open his workshop and do various blacksmithing jobs.

Six months later, the couple divorced. Shortly after, Ernesto married Yusmary; their daughter, Ysabella, was born. He and his wife worked at the same institution and lived in a house they had bought. Two years later, they divorced.

A month later, Ernesto was transferred from FUNDACOMUNAL in Cumaná to the Santa Fe branch. There he met a beautiful young woman named Elizabeth, tall, dark-haired, with jet-black eyes that captivated him. He soon proposed, and they were married in a civil ceremony and later in the town's church.

Soon after, they had a son, whom they named Efraín Ramón; two years later, Makharianny was born. The economic situation in Venezuela led Ernesto and his family to emigrate to Brazil. There, he found work at a bus factory called Marco Polo, where he worked as a skilled blacksmith.

A year later, he bought a townhouse with a mortgage from a bank. They have been living in Brazil for several years now, and we keep in touch via video calls.

A week ago, he called me and told me that he now works nights and gets home in the early hours of the morning after sleeping. When he wakes up, he spends time with his wife and children. Then he has lunch with them. Afterward, he takes the children to school.

Upon returning home, he sits down at his computer, and in the tranquility of his house, he relaxes and begins to transcribe the sketches of stories from his childhood and adolescence that he keeps stored in his memory. He is inspired by the motivation, love, and understanding of his wife, who supports him with these ideas.

To my surprise, yesterday my son Ernesto emailed me a book he wrote, titled \

based on stories of experiences he shared with his siblings, cousins, and friends. I delighted in reading these stories and smiled throughout.

I also enjoyed the stories of community members who, in their youth and old age, were involved in folklore, and of other people from our city who, for some reason, lost their memories. Ernesto kept these memories in his heart, dedicating a space in this book to tell their stories.

I immediately called him and, after congratulating him, asked:

\

I heard the boy interrupt him; then he continued:

“You asked me, ‘When will you show them to me?’ and I answered, ‘Someday.’ Well, that day arrived with this book I sent you,” I replied, very excited:

“I’ve already read the whole book! You excelled with the poem dedicated to your wife on your wedding anniversary, ‘For Elizabeth, on our 10th anniversary,’ and in the story, ‘The Box That Changed My Destiny.’” I heard his laughter, then I continued:

“Efraín, my husband from the paths of eternity, and I from the face of the earth, are so proud of you! Our children! Because from a very young age we instilled in you family values ​​that have allowed you to achieve your dreams!” Ernesto, deeply moved, replied:

“Thank you, Mom, I love you very much.”

Quien siembra en su propia tierra, cosecha.

En la ciudad de Cumaná, Venezuela, en 1971, me casé con Efraín Rodríguez, y en 1973 di a luz a mi primera hija, a quien llamamos Leocarmen. En 1976 nació Ernesto José; luego, en 1977, tuve a Engels, Efraín, y en 1978, a Simón Ilich. Durante esa última cesárea, me cauterizaron las trompas de Falopio, ya que era imposible tener más hijos.

Desde ese momento, mi esposo y yo nos dedicamos a criarlos y a inculcarles valores familiares: amor, respeto, honestidad, responsabilidad, generosidad y paciencia.

Desde que nos casamos, vivimos en una casa en el barrio Bolívar, frente al Liceo José Silverio González. En esta casa vivieron todas las etapas de su desarrollo: infancia, adolescencia y parte de la adultez.

Varios años después:

Leocarmen es licenciada en Administración de Empresas, trabaja en la Universidad de Oriente, está casada con José y tiene dos hijas: Alexa,  Rut, y un nieto.

Engels, técnico superior en Administración de Empresas, trabaja en el Instituto José Silverio González; también escribe historias para Hive y ocasionalmente crea caricaturas para otros sitios web. Vive de forma independiente con su esposa, Nairuvis, y su hijo, Lenin Vladimir Ilich. Engels también toca el instrumento musical  \

.

Simón Ilich es licenciado en Educación con especialización en Física Pura; trabaja en el Instituto José Antonio Ramos Sucre. Escribió para Hive durante varios años. Es el vocalista y bajista de la banda The Stokers. Vive en casa de los padres de su esposa Corina con sus dos hijas: Irianny y Estefany.

Desde pequeño, Ernesto José solía sentarse con un cuaderno y un lápiz a la sombra de un árbol de uva de mar en nuestro patio trasero, absorto en sus pensamientos. Yo lo observaba desde lejos; luego tomaba el lápiz y escribía en su cuaderno.

Una semana después, vi a mi hijo Ernesto bajo ese árbol, meditando con los ojos cerrados. Poco después, lo vi escribiendo. Me acerqué y le pregunté:

“Hijo, ¿qué te pasa? Llevo semanas observándote”, respire hondo y continué:

—Después de terminar tus tareas, vienes y te sientas bajo este árbol —respondió con voz muy sutil—.

—A veces me siento preocupado, y aquí me relajo; también dejo volar mi imaginación y escribo borradores de historias —sonreí y le pregunté—.

—¿Qué te preocupa? Su rostro estaba pálido como el mármol y sus labios blancos como la nieve. Entonces respondió:

—Pronto cumpliré 18 años, pronto me graduaré; además de estudiar, quiero aprender un arte para ganar dinero y comprarme mis propias cosas —le respondí con dulzura:

—Hablaré con tu padre, pero ¿cuándo me enseñarás esos bocetos? —Con una sonrisa, respondió:

—Algún día.

Esa noche, mi esposo y yo fuimos a nuestra habitación; en cuanto nos acostamos, le expliqué la situación de nuestro hijo Ernesto. Él respondió:

—A fin de mes le daré un regalo que le permitirá aprender un arte. Llena de alegría, lo abracé y le dije:

—Confío en ti.

A finales de mes, Efraín apareció con una caja, se la entregó a mi hijo y le dijo:

“Aquí tienes. Con estas herramientas podrás cubrir muchas de tus necesidades personales”.

En poco tiempo, Ernesto aprendió a soldar y a fabricar muebles, puertas y todo tipo de objetos de hierro forjado. Construyó su herrería en un pequeño terreno junto a la casa.

Poco después, se casó con Darggys, se mudaron a nuestra casa y tuvieron su primer hijo, a quien llamaron Ernesto. Un año más tarde, mi hijo Ernesto se graduó en Administración de Empresas.

Cinco años después comenzó a trabajar en FUNDACOMUNAL, como promotor social instruyendo a los habitantes de las comunidades en Consejos Comunales. Al llegar de su trabajo después de almorzar y reposar, abría su taller y realizaba diverso trabajo de herrería.

Seis meses después, la pareja se divorció. Poco después, Ernesto se casó con Yusmary; nació su hija, Ysabella. Él y su esposa trabajaban en la misma institución y vivían en una casa que habían comprado. Dos años después, se divorciaron.

Un mes después, Ernesto fue trasladado de FUNDACOMUNAL en Cumaná a la sucursal de Santa Fe. Allí conoció a una hermosa joven llamada Elizabeth, alta, morena, con unos ojos negros como el azabache que lo cautivaron. Pronto le propuso matrimonio y se casaron por lo civil y posteriormente por la iglesia  en ese pueblo.

Poco después, tuvieron un hijo, a quien llamaron Efraín Ramón; dos años más tarde nació Makharianny. La situación económica en Venezuela llevó a Ernesto y su familia a emigrar a Brasil. Allí, encontró trabajo en una fábrica de autobuses llamada Marco Polo, donde se desempeñó como herrero experto.

Un año después, compró una casa tipo Twonhouse con una hipoteca bancaria. Llevan varios años viviendo en Brasil y nos mantenemos en contacto por videollamadas.

Hace una semana, me llamó y me contó que ahora trabaja de noche y llega a casa de madrugada después de dormir. Al despertar, pasa tiempo con su esposa e hijos. Luego almuerza con ellos. Después, lleva a los niños al colegio.

Al regresar a casa, se sienta frente a su computadora y, en la tranquilidad de su hogar, se relaja y comienza a transcribir los fragmentos de historias de su infancia y adolescencia que guarda en su memoria. Se inspira en la motivación, el amor y la comprensión de su esposa, quien lo apoya en estas ideas.

Para mi sorpresa, ayer mi hijo Ernesto me envió por correo electrónico un libro que escribió, titulado \

, basado en historias de experiencias que compartió con sus hermanos, primos y amigos. Disfruté mucho leyendo estas historias y sonreí de principio a fin. También disfruté de las historias de miembros de la comunidad que, en su juventud y vejez, se involucraron en el folclore, y de otras personas de nuestra ciudad que, por alguna razón, perdieron la memoria. Ernesto guardó estos recuerdos en su corazón, dedicando un espacio en este libro para contar sus historias. Lo llamé de inmediato y, después de felicitarlo, le pregunté: «Hijo, ¿cómo lograste armar este libro?» Él respondió con alegría: «¿Recuerdas cuando me sentaba en tu casa bajo aquel árbol, en aquel lugar donde reinaba la tranquilidad; solo soplaba el viento y las hojas danzaban armoniosamente como bailarinas?» Hizo una pausa y luego continuó: «¡En esos momentos, escribía borradores de historias de no ficción!» Oí al niño interrumpirlo; luego continuó: Me preguntaste: «¿Cuándo me los vas a enseñar?», y te respondí: «Algún día». Pues bien, ese día llegó con este libro que te envié —respondí, muy emocionada—. «¡Ya lo leí todo! ¡Te luciste con el poema que le dedicaste a tu esposa en su aniversario de bodas, “Para Elizabeth, en nuestro décimo aniversario”, y en el cuento “La caja que cambió mi destino”!». Oí su risa y continué: «¡Efraín, mi esposo desde la eternidad, y yo desde la faz de la tierra, estamos tan orgullosos de ustedes ¡Nuestros hijos!, porque desde muy pequeño les inculcamos valores familiares que les han permitido alcanzar sus sueños». Ernesto, muy conmovido, respondió: «Gracias, mamá, te quiero mucho».

de color verde: Una historia de portal en Hive Pets 💚 /  My Little Green \
: A Porch Story in Hive Pets 💚
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVUcZqGKbsfHPcN2Jfxmyimv5MoJKNCsNVHDDMaXuaafe/1776625477769.jpg)


​¡Hola, comunidad! Hoy quiero presentarles a una visitante muy especial que se ha tomado la atribución de supervisar mis mañanas.

​El escenario: Mi puesto de venta

​No trabajo en una oficina cerrada; mi día a día transcurre en el portal de una casa de vendedora. Es un lugar con mucha vida, donde entran y salen personas, se organizan pedidos y se sacan cuentas constantemente. Pero entre tanto movimiento, esta pequeña Lagartija Verde (Anolis porcatus) ha decidido que mi mesa de trabajo es su lugar favorito para tomar el sol.

​Una colega muy curiosa

​Como pueden ver en las fotos, no le teme ni a las libretas ni a los lapiceros. Se pasea por los bordes del muro del portal y, de repente, ¡zas!, aterriza justo encima de mis notas. Me causa mucha gracia verla ahí, tan estática y elegante, como si estuviera revisando que los números cuadren correctamente.

​Es fascinante observar su color verde neón tan intenso. En una de las fotos se aprecia el detalle de su piel y esa línea clara que recorre su lomo; es una verdadera joya de nuestra fauna cubana.

​La paz en el trabajo

​Aunque el trabajo de vendedora puede ser agitado, estos encuentros me regalan un momento de paz. Ella se queda ahí, disfrutando del calor del sol que entra al portal, y yo sigo con mis tareas, respetando su espacio.

 Es una convivencia silenciosa pero muy bonita.
​Me siento afortunada de tener una \

que no se queja de los precios y que siempre me recibe con el mejor color posible.

​¿Y tú? ¿Tienes algún animalito silvestre que te acompañe en tu jornada laboral?

/


​Hello, community! Today I want to introduce you to a very special visitor who has taken it upon herself to supervise my mornings.

​The Setting: My Sales Post

I don’t work in a closed office; my day-to-day life takes place on the porch of a vendor's house. It’s a place full of life, where people come and go, orders are organized, and accounts are constantly being calculated. But amidst all this movement, this little Green Lizard (Anolis porcatus) has decided that my workspace is her favorite spot for sunbathing.

​A Very Curious Colleague

As you can see in the photos, she isn't afraid of notebooks or pens. She wanders along the edges of the porch wall and suddenly—zap!—she lands right on top of my notes. It makes me laugh to see her there, so still and elegant, as if she were checking that the numbers add up correctly.

​It’s fascinating to observe her intense neon green color. In one of the photos, you can appreciate the detail of her skin and that light line running down her back; she is a true gem of our Cuban fauna.

​Peace at Work

Although being a vendor can be hectic, these encounters give me a moment of peace. She stays there, enjoying the warmth of the sun coming onto the porch, while I continue with my tasks, respecting her space. It’s a silent but beautiful coexistence.

​I feel lucky to have a \
who doesn’t complain about prices and who always greets me with the best possible color.\n\n​And you? Do you have any wild little animals that accompany you during your workday?

When you start looking ahead of yourself then the chances are things will unravel and this is what has happened with Arsenal.

/></center>

[source](https://x.com/CarolRadull/status/2045917416387965136/photo/1)


Today they lost to Manchester City who can now draw level on points when they play relegation bound Burnley. The Premier League title is no longer in their hands to control and Manchester City are in the driving seat.

From a neutrals perspective this is great news because a close finish in a title race is what everyone likes to see. There are bound to be some twists and turns so this by no means is all over and we all know pressure can create mistakes. I am always one for the under dog to fight through and upset the odds yet the under dog in this case was Manchester City even though they are a serial winning team who have won the League more than any other side over the last 15 years being 8 times champions.

Over the last month Arsenal have lost the Carabao Cup to Manchester City and lost to Southampton in the FA Cup. The stats will say they had a 36.4% and 63% chance of winning those trophies and they were knocked out. Games are not played on paper and why these stats are totally worthless as any result is possible.

In sport you may say that luck eluded you, but over the course of a season this tends to even out so one cannot feel hard done by and have an attitude of  doing better. A team that was 10 points clear 4 weeks ago has only themselves to blame if they let the title slip. When you are at the top with such a lead the pressure is on others to catch you which is basically what has happened here. 

The Premier League is definitely not over because if both Arsenal and Manchester City win all their remaining games they will be level on points and this could go down to goal difference. 4 weeks ago Arsenal had a 10 point lead and this has been whittled away and come Wednesday they should be knocked off the top spot for the first time this season with only 5 games to play. If Arsenal had drawn todays game then things would be very different and everyone would be calling the title in Arsenals favor.

Looking at the latest form of both teams Arsenal are the team under pressure and could implode at any time. The manager Mikkel Arteta is so desperate because this could have been a career defining season and he could end up trophyless. This would be very damaging because of the position his team was in not that long ago and shows how cruel sport can be. Losing 4 of their last 6 games at this time of the season is not ideal and why it raises questions with the team needing to find answers.

Success is gauged by what a team accomplishes and what they win and the pressure is mounting up as the trophies they had in their sights evaporate. The pressure is on Arsenal and has been on them all season because they have been leading the Premier League and the pressure is increasing. This is a test of character more than anything else and is a proper test. The pressure of being runners up for for the last two seasons will be weighing heavy on Arsenal which it would for any team having come close.

body.title: My Mom's New Musical Group
body.body: >\n\nHappy start to the week, everyone! A few days ago, I had a very special musical experience: I finally got to see the new group my mom formed to sing at our church in Maracay. In the video I'm sharing above, you can hear the song \

(Today I Wish I Could Cry), a communion song, which I recorded so they can use it as a keepsake and share it with their friends. It was rewarding for me to help them with the cameras and guitar on some songs, and I didn't have to sing at all, since it's an all-female project.
![IMG_20260331_175415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23zGaMs7VBLy6uF2S1EL8kv43BMyWqxTK4asvEdkYmyoDi32saE2iT972VxmfSKcadKL1.jpg)

What I loved most is that my mom has been planning to return to singing at church for many months, a service she put aside after my dad passed away. He was the musical leader of our family singing, and well, you know I live in another city, and I've always felt like I left my mom alone during such a difficult time as mourning. Of course, my brother lives with her, but their relationship with music is also different. He found this pair of ladies with beautiful voices and finally started a new group that sounds great.
![IMG_20260331_173737.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/242NjUPRENag95danPFExXWamqdALSzoUqFakSkY4YacnR5KzPYwaZYRHexTcefn6Ejpt.jpg)

They haven't performed much, but their years of experience making music in the church make everything flow smoothly. That day I didn't have much to do, just adjust the audio, the camera, and a couple of chords I could play on the guitar, and that was only because I had a few days off. But the three of them easily manage their musical project; I only helped out of courtesy. The three of them were happy singing and accompanying the Mass, and they're actually located in the best spot for singing, at the back and above the Cathedral of Our Lady of the Assumption, located in San Jacinto, Aragua State, Venezuela.
![IMG_20260331_171951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/242sA4ytc7qgs26LNEw9f98eqPhwhGJuEFgWF6QN6X7knBqhJCye6oSHjo22FAkbPVpQd.jpg)

In this place, we've had some of our best family performances, not only singing for Mass, but also private concerts, Christmas carols, weddings, baptisms, and even choral singing, since our service to the church has always been musical. Once Dad passed away, everything changed without us even realizing it. We've been rebuilding our lives and learning to live without him, and as we always say, God's timing is perfect, and little by little, everything is falling into place. I've always been proud of my parents, and I feel that artistically I don't even come close to them, since they are such great teachers.
![IMG_20260331_174829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EpnFH2nbZaW37BnQZh6PGpP38rQbjzZ3LkaoaKUrmVUeKxv9EPmvPCgKMDWbjjRMGq7.jpg)
I hope you all enjoyed the video, and that it serves as a reminder that after the storm, the calm always comes. The death of such an important family member shakes our world completely; for us, it's only been three years, but we're finally reaching some stability in our lives, even though the painful events of the past will always be there. Family is vital for our support, as are other practices and activities that help us distance ourselves from negative feelings. In our case, we have the joy of being musicians and using it to our advantage while also giving back to God, who gave us music.
![IMG_20260331_175423_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EnWLtXtMPTxPJqU65bwxiM4e2c2msMtCio2qNnmLZq5nX9EaPhbLfp4tFuDvPXXDuCL.jpg)
