body.title: Spring in Hvide Sande (Dk): A Week of Quiet, Wind, and Real Relaxation
body.body:
There are places that impress you with landmarks, noise, and endless things to do. And then there are places like Hvide Sande, which do the exact opposite and somehow leave a much deeper mark. My week there this spring was not about ticking off attractions or chasing experiences. It was about slowing down, breathing in the salty air, and rediscovering what real relaxation actually feels like.

##### Arrival: Leaving Everything Behind

The journey itself already felt like a transition. About 350 kilometers by car, door to door, from everyday life into something entirely different. As you move further north and west into Denmark, the landscape begins to change. It becomes flatter, more open, almost minimalistic. There is a certain honesty to it. No mountains, no dramatic forests. Just wind, sky, and space.

![IMG_2554.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EpnAt2xTkqixVpzZcuyVLrs7pE4J2nqcSAv7vAKRg72mfbLBnahqd6eVRcRs3a53hgD.jpeg)

![IMG_2556.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23qr7kGKhv7cFqvvTUKgDLvCfLmMU8rbETysVyB4Vc5MZSPxsMM6RvjZa5Pp2KhvMdwfs.jpeg)

![IMG_2553.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EqL8kQ4RZBz2qKgR137qCrZuKUY1BoKcvCusQxvJcvMkg61MGYDxfmKxc4wog3M4gcL.jpeg)

![IMG_2552.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EqNDjMzphfrFkSh4xaV5CgCT1jjytHPCjz2B5gRxz5E5yFrxuA9kKueEpczFGPS6Kbe.jpeg)

When we finally arrived in Hvide Sande, together with my mother, it immediately felt familiar. Not in a boring way, but in the comforting sense of returning to a place that does not demand anything from you. A place that simply exists and lets you exist with it.

##### Our Home by the Marina

We stayed in a holiday house close to the marina, booked through Esmark, which I can genuinely recommend. In this region, about eighty percent of the houses are holiday homes, and they are designed for one purpose: comfort.

Our house had everything you could wish for. A cozy living room, a fireplace, and that unmistakable Danish feeling of “hygge” that is hard to translate but easy to feel. Many houses here even come with saunas and jacuzzis, making them perfect retreats regardless of the season.

![IMG_2664.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23s9JxAcCLeGk2zMz8ZshL1Lr5PxfiHAr1UZTEpa5gmSH6dZkfShja5axBQQsAkk7rvjM.jpeg)

![IMG_2666.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EqDkdqjh2ALfiMmnUQYSwvTwPni6rAprUTYb6RyXfh7aHzoKnDezeDKwVrVoWGA69AH.jpeg)

![IMG_2671.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/Epzyj6Ati7AVQ4SNozzPmEGAiFQ93tdHnu9TKiH6BAfjKaHvzafyJAsPSELv1nPuk5e.jpeg)

![IMG_2651.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/Ep3fDUiCv1vjD96yJYMzCqyRk7hm8xadub8QEstRCGzaXmcGYt95MByycTNfTsohHPU.jpeg)

![IMG_2670.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EoiUgEwTTboeL8NvG1hta6Ea3iUEcWB5ViknSpxFyFQcpLVn2x1mSyHAFdceqUUDezf.jpeg)

![IMG_2555.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23vi2AZDBSMVfJpxvBxg97CDRwn8XgzzLUBPdjHaLFZN9Ne345qdZdTxsfxWwamRUwHQb.jpeg)


What stood out most was the silence. Not the awkward kind, but a deep, natural quietness. No city noise, no traffic, no crowds. Just the distant sound of seagulls and the wind moving through the dunes.

##### The Unique Character of Hvide Sande

Hvide Sande sits on a narrow strip of land between the North Sea and the Ringkøbing Fjord. This alone gives it a special character. On one side, you have the endless, wild ocean. On the other, calm waters where kite surfers glide across the surface.

The town itself is small. There is one supermarket, a few fish shops, and a handful of small stores selling typical Danish decoration, outdoor gear, and fishing equipment. That is it. No shopping malls, no party streets, no overwhelming tourist infrastructure.

And that is exactly what makes it so special.

The atmosphere reminded me a bit of small towns on the American East Coast. Simple houses, salty air, the constant presence of the sea. It feels authentic, not curated.

![IMG_2619.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/Ep7uAwAhh3BdUuqNBATPtxYyG4mLYp9pJZC9FmiryTv9292nHhScV62EChunk7YoNYY.jpeg)

![IMG_2615.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EpvhWFM7mWu3KKe9XFW8mgHVV1fk2kJyi7NyG6S1NpAvSimBMosQ6MrVBtaLGy8wKCB.jpeg)

![IMG_2616.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23xVHHjuFSyfGqkrG3hqKYWt1GcwM4FDbtTVJtsBXgkjvKgt6GtiATNAmWSmjDRsu7Chn.jpeg)

![IMG_2625.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EqSVWDdWqCYzzP5EoHUYHvc5w8fn3qScsVmb4KXPpcdfkT667RK17DgNGyjbvmEf6EJ.jpeg)

Interestingly, most of the people you meet are not even Danish. A large number of visitors come from northern Germany, and from Germany in general. You hear German almost everywhere, while actual Danish locals seem to be in the minority, at least from a visitor’s perspective.

##### Our Daily Rhythm: The Art of Doing Nothing

If I had to describe a typical day in one word, it would be: slow.

We would wake up late, without any pressure. Breakfast was long and relaxed. No rushing, no schedule. Just sitting together, enjoying simple food, and planning nothing in particular.

The rest of the day often revolved around long walks. And when I say long, I mean really long. The kind where you lose track of time and distance.

Evenings were usually spent with friends who, just like every year, had also come to Hvide Sande. There is something special about sharing such a quiet place with people you know well. Conversations feel deeper, laughter feels more genuine, and time somehow stretches.

##### The Beach: Wide, Wild, and Worth Every Step

The beach on the west side of the peninsula is one of the most impressive I have ever seen.

It is incredibly wide, covered in fine white sand, and stretches endlessly in both directions. There are no crowded sections, no loud music, no beach bars. Just space.

![741f951f-eb6d-4cbd-8fed-d1c1d2baf5fc.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23xAVKLrTnYcd5mcymB8QPpJcLxY4EUJPx5TxMUGZNkVSvCgMS8PFTp842GuRd4tdENdp.jpeg)

![db649e25-9a7c-4b4a-92cf-c54b4c79db34.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EpzyFyaxwdHyHph3cAWexuJtqPk5PUgASwKnFAYVNtiUo67N8wcdpcWM2GuRbmpEsPx.jpeg)

![IMG_2630.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EpQwJKMeybLtkCfMQLYYea49f2go33B84ADyQBV8sj2wgYFYYkNnoMHpDfgRVbkCeQZ.jpeg)

![IMG_2628.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/245caaGGFeW7cpVCEWBUSU2BCaEDcw36GvpodNsWNR1UkR3oU9JUBvVim99zhMtVFSi7E.jpeg)

![IMG_2575.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EoyP7BLqwZoMRqgxFk6L8fw76iEshnjuM2q5Hb2mbKc1GqjTemFZ65Y7XQpM3gfe4z9.jpeg)

![IMG_2597.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23z79FmASfqgnkp3KoFt4LBCpTMQYQWHBQoWBD27ZPGX7Q8wSowDHnUwo7hyzJhA7Fn6J.jpeg)

![IMG_2606.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EqL8Jp3mWV4861Tu2KnkcD5capY7TXctQvqg8wXHzNBhTvVGBxaqgXB5EryhjEkVuAg.jpeg)

![IMG_2570.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23yd1r68TRrMJFQQziKX39F8HW2NZ6euAhCnBmVH9vwM55nDP5tH5dzbdtNuySRfHSXyg.jpeg)

![IMG_2577.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23ynSX97Z1KM6sCERjAg3Ub31LovVTReUwZt6tnc6k1PCSBqEcjGUNV49GP6ca1gtWX2o.jpeg)

![IMG_2580.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EpVCbfjwPitR14g52AUWi2wLSjGR8AcQoDNu15k4Rbnr4wQQRECoH15EVugSJGTS7pJ.jpeg)


Getting there, however, requires effort. No matter where you are, you first have to cross a massive dune. Climbing it can be surprisingly exhausting, especially in the wind. But once you reach the top and see the ocean opening up in front of you, and the housing areas behind, it is completely worth it.

![b022e362-4b7e-49be-9f6b-246dc69b710f.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/2432BTobqbaefVQyeqV7xDeGk6v19hNkWSmMbofZAjLZB67CF7fMfjp6wQQ1oK4PMcz5G.jpeg)

![IMG_2642.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23rB9yBfUr2KrX3aRH2UWK9PxYvprsw7UXFgg4EkJV2ojjX8NHvqckAiN92iCsPQYUpRV.jpeg)

![IMG_2643.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/241tdRnkGfiP5o7BY42zeDrsiS87XFFr7TB5LNEPENP4CmGdsuw23eo6VEd8KPRm7vRxy.jpeg)

![IMG_2581.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23uQxj8ySF8MyWLPRecR3SuyeCshV4N2ejKj5KXk3eA8peVXqa7WjUbR3LGu17Nz33rPr.jpeg)

![IMG_2582.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/Eq9UqgBw1JtTXUy15WV9hzELeLjD6UiXY1pBKxtbp1CCFxnECRJ2pZq4mwNcy8Ea4En.jpeg)


There is only one accessible path that allows wheelchair users to reach the beach without climbing. Everywhere else, it is a bit of a challenge. But that challenge is part of the experience.

##### Walking with Ella

Of course, I was not alone on these walks. Ella was with me the entire time.

In Denmark, dogs are required to be on a leash at all times. I will admit that I found a small workaround by using a long training leash. Ella is incredibly well behaved and always stays close, so it felt like a fair compromise.

She quickly became a bit of a local attraction (doubled by the attendance of my friends Conny with another Leonberger and @kerstin42 with. her Great Dane. People constantly approached us, asking about them. Tourists from all over were impressed by their presence. It led to many small conversations with strangers, which added an unexpected social element to an otherwise quiet environment.

![a3f576a2-591c-450b-858f-45794de00588.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/244e81NNccTreg8TbgC9HxdRn1JrXZC31hXJkUwhocNg6GirbK2MTx4taNtqr7ntm6r3w.jpeg)

![IMG_2610.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EoGzqpBY2MPwLv5aBJpyzrmn63HjsodFJdsuATVh4NkMkr38CYx4k1jX6vsH3Hc9Kk2.jpeg)

![IMG_2599.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23z7BuXPXEEEuT6rpcUBZyRELjV2SeSXpCsxXJU1RHUcmxJf4ZSe8kn7m6quh9cPAHYKq.jpeg)

![IMG_2604.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/243BkvoZ3whdbymiXquLunawM1TNcbnZwBzLE2kVFh4zJr2pf1AAtqSaErzPAzstxuhiD.jpeg)

![IMG_2592.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23yThUs7W56XxpU7uCqF2uaxddbPSjkTBVy2k6Rx97qHQaVCzMpgadwHBAVJHARxbcA39.jpeg)

![IMG_2589.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23uQyBnjWNnNXCr2RsZXtq7dqYjgasdyowW2CYeiSdL2JPzCUh5WE1anku6U1fL2MXvo2.jpeg)


Walking along the beach with her, feeling the wind, hearing the waves, and seeing nothing but sand and sea for kilometers, is something I will not forget anytime soon.


##### The Other Side: Calm Waters and Kite Surfers

While the west side offers the raw power of the North Sea, the east side of the peninsula is completely different.

There, the landscape is softer. More like meadows by the water. The Ringkøbing Fjord provides calm conditions, making it a popular spot for kite surfers. Watching them glide across the water, sometimes performing jumps and tricks, adds a dynamic contrast to the otherwise peaceful surroundings.

##### Small Adventures: Fishing and Fresh Herring

One of the most fascinating spots in Hvide Sande is the lock near the marina. It is a well known place for herring fishing.

At times, you can see thirty or more anglers standing side by side, casting their lines into the water. And the incredible part is that they are often successful. One herring after another is pulled out of the water.

![IMG_2602.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23uQjvULSpe49mYvv1z436omaVpvSabjXpQw9NfuKTBWHkZG5X9nTyAczgBccaEq6ZddT.jpeg)


Whenever we were there, it meant one thing: fresh fish for dinner. There is something very satisfying about eating fish that was caught just hours before.

##### A Short Trip to Ringkøbing

For a bit of variety, we also visited Ringkøbing, the nearest larger town.

It offers more shopping options, restaurants, and some sightseeing. The harbor area is particularly charming, with colorful houses and a relaxed maritime atmosphere.

![IMG_2588.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/242NexhdZHeveyZU9svS9jMrEcuifod6XCAMpadkuYRXnBzJqq1RnuGegL13Bf4HNUjXx.jpeg)

![IMG_2590.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23wCDrTRqYPktUaMYGuVDX4wxi4kbGLHdFis5cxyoJFyjyGxycB8MDvsvuDEycw4ucbv3.jpeg)

That being said, it is not a place you need to visit multiple times. Once you have seen it, you have essentially experienced what it has to offer. And that is perfectly fine, because the real highlight of the trip remains Hvide Sande itself.

##### Food: Simple, Local, and Surprisingly Memorable

We mostly cooked ourselves, which fits perfectly with the overall vibe of the trip. Simple meals, eaten together, without any rush. And a very nice opportunity to have the largest oysters ever - use it!

![IMG_2681.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/24244KMzVizS1EKtRgNEYQ5t1dkopCw4JSm6ZmzcEcHxiDxeBHWUKEnmvcjDwFYHp4sXz.jpeg)


But there was one place that absolutely deserves a mention: Cafe Marina.

I am not exaggerating when I say besides a great Club Sandwich they serve the best fries I have ever had. Perfectly crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and somehow just better than anywhere else. Sometimes it is the simplest things that leave the strongest impression.

![IMG_2557.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23vi6VAyWBLd56hnLCKyztqMYtSfu7bDWUWMx8Upz2yeqr6JKwec8qCeNC31Jgnvv9JFx.jpeg)


##### The Weather: A Perfect Week

Spring weather can be unpredictable, especially on the North Sea coast. But we were lucky.

Sunny days, the bluest, clearest skies, and just enough wind to remind you where you are. The sunlight made the dunes glow, the sea sparkle, and the entire landscape feel alive.

![IMG_2596.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/23wqnLJ3S5Ed3WJopRituSxKpSH7ipYxoRTicMQffNCcbqzJPteEKwmaRXVBCV6iPrQnH.jpeg)

![IMG_2574.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dandegrischdine/EpEExJkpNBrJfaw5s2CgCtdAAfybMjbaEawsSCvctsVFqwxTuzyKyZ4xrL1hfumRrm7.jpeg)


##### Why Hvide Sande Feels Different

What makes Hvide Sande stand out is not what it offers, but what it does not.

No party tourism. No crowded attractions. No pressure to constantly do something.

Instead, it offers space. Silence. Simplicity.

It is a place where boredom transforms into relaxation. Where doing nothing becomes something valuable. Where you can actually hear your own thoughts again.

##### A Few Facts About the Region

Hvide Sande is located on the Holmsland Dunes, a narrow barrier spit separating the North Sea from the Ringkøbing Fjord. The town itself was only established in the 20th century, primarily as a fishing port after the construction of the lock that connects the fjord to the sea.

Denmark, as a country, is known for its high quality of life, strong focus on sustainability, and a deep cultural appreciation for coziness and well being. The concept of hygge is not just a trend here, it is a way of life.

##### The Feeling That Stayed

Looking back, what stands out most is not a specific event or attraction. It is a feeling.

A week without stress. Without noise. Without unnecessary distractions.

Just time with my mother, time with friends, long walks with Ella, and the constant presence of the sea.

I enjoyed every single minute of it.

And that is exactly why I will keep coming back to Hvide Sande.

body.title: Ich habe meine geliebte Katze verloren. 😭
body.body:
Heute teile ich diesen Beitrag mit großem Bedauern. Tatsächlich laufen mir beim Schreiben die Tränen über die Wangen. Denn ich habe eine sehr traurige Nachricht: Meine Katze ist gestorben.

Ich hatte eine geliebte Hauskatze. Ich habe sie sehr geliebt und mich liebevoll um sie gekümmert.


 Besonders wichtig war mir, dass ich jeden Tag nach ihrem Befinden sah und sie fütterte. Immer wenn ich mich zum Essen hinsetzte, kam sie zu mir und miaute. Sobald ich ihr Miauen hörte, fütterte ich sie.



![PSX_20260420_005242.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23uR3KN7AAW1yTVqCCzwZNCuk1TYuhGAmcuE83RNwEvcefBKrxi27LPb1oL5gc7oE5Yjc.jpg)



Manchmal nahm ich meine Katze mit ins Badezimmer, um sie zu baden. Wenn ich badete, badete ich auch meine Katze, da sie sich manchmal schmutzig machte.

Ich lebe in einem Dorf. Hier muss man mit Ästen kochen, und es gibt viel Kohle und Asche. Wenn ich mit dem Kochen fertig bin, geht die Katze in den Ofen, um sich aufzuwärmen. Im Ofen sammelt sich viel Ruß an. Wenn meine Katze hineingeht, um sich zu wärmen, wird sie stark mit Ruß bedeckt. Deshalb badete ich sie regelmäßig, um den Ruß zu entfernen.


![PSX_20260420_005358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23tScUZnga4xtx3T7pfuow5tMVRZX9qirquUNvwJtNkB4B8QMfQvM4axR8h86ekDJAAfU.jpg)





Plötzlich gab es ein Familienproblem. Ich bin nach Gazipur gefahren, um einen Familienstreit zu schlichten. Als ich zurückkam, suchte ich verzweifelt nach meiner geliebten Katze Rahim. Ich rief sie sofort, aber sie reagierte nicht, und ich war sehr enttäuscht.

Ich suchte in der ganzen Gegend, konnte sie aber nirgends finden. Mir kamen die Tränen, als ich sie verlor. Rahim war meine Lieblingskatze, und ich liebte sie über alles.

Ich habe sehr gelitten, als ich meine Katze verlor. Es war ein wirklich trauriger Moment. Hätte ich vorher gewusst, dass sie verloren gehen würde, hätte ich sie niemals allein zu Hause gelassen und wäre verreist. Jetzt weine ich bitterlich um sie 😭😭 Wie kann ich meine geliebte Katze nur wiederfinden?

body.body: > Domingo de trabajo en equipo. Bien temprano activa para el entrenamiento largo de la semana. La cita fue a las 5:40 am, yo inicie a las 5:30 am, ya que debia desocuparme temprano para asistir a la misa, benedecida porque el lugar de reunion en cerca de mi casa, por lo que pude entrenar unos pocos kilometros mientras todo el equipo llegaba. Al estar todos completos iniciamos la ruta, salimos todos juntos a ritmo suave, de charla jejeje. A pesar de ser tan temprano ya las temperaturas estaban elevadas, Gracias a Dios corria mucha brisa. La ruta de hoy, la ruta clasica de los Domingos, una ruta comoda, y fresca, bien comico que mientras trotabamos, pasamos por una casa y estaban unas personas amanecidas en el porche de la casa, estaban tomando, y nos saludaron muy alegres tenian musica alegres, y nosostros por su puesto los saludamos, y uno salio a correr con nosotros jejeje, asi estaria a penas aguanto unos metros. Seguimos nuestro trote de forma suave con ritmos promedio de 7:30-6:30 min/Km. Yo manteniendo mi frecuencia cardiaca por debajo de 140 ppm, bueno casi lo logre. --- Yo me devolvi antes que mis compañeros ya que necesitaba estar temprano en casa, alcance trotar una hora 28 minutos, la meta era una hora treinta segundos, pero me faltaron dos minutos. Por su puesto para el entrenamiento largo mantuve mi hidratacion, y me lleve mis bocadillos de guayaba, lo que me hace terminar muy bien los entrenamientos, nada de agotamiento, esto es producto del entrenamiento, y de no llevar al cuerpo al colpaso, ni a trabajar sin combustible. Agradecida por el entrenamiento en equipo siempre hace falta compartir con los amigos que amamos esta pasion. . >Greetings and blessings.! >

>Teamwork Sunday. Up bright and early for the week’s long training run. We were set to meet at 5:40 a.m., but I started at 5:30 a.m. since I had to leave early to attend Mass—which was a blessing because the meeting spot was near my house, so I was able to run a few kilometers while the rest of the team arrived. Once everyone was there, we started the route, setting off together at a gentle pace, chatting away, hehehe. Even though it was so early, the temperatures were already high, but thank God there was a nice breeze. Today’s route was the classic Sunday route—a comfortable, cool route. It was pretty funny that as we were jogging, we passed a house where some people were already up on the porch; they were drinking, and they greeted us very cheerfully with upbeat music playing. We, of course, greeted them back, and one of them even came out to run with us, hehehe, but he only lasted a few meters. We continued our jog at a steady pace with an average pace of 7:30–6:30 min/km. I kept my heart rate below 140 bpm—well, I almost made it. --- I headed back before my teammates because I needed to be home early; I managed to jog for an hour and 28 minutes. My goal was an hour and 30 seconds, but I fell short by two minutes. Of course, for the long run, I stayed hydrated and brought my guava snacks, which help me finish my runs feeling great—no exhaustion at all. This is the result of proper training and not pushing my body to the breaking point or working out without fuel. I’m grateful for the team training; it’s always important to share this experience with friends who love this passion. --- Todo el contenido es de mi autoría y las imágenes son de mi propiedad Fotos fueron tomadas con mi HONOR X6a Plus Separador editado en Canva Traducido con [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > All content is my own and the images are my property. > Photos were taken with my HONOR X6a Plus > Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > Publisher edited in the application Canva [Puedes chequear mi actividad en Strava](https://strava.app.link/ebxO7mAit2b) --- [ You can check my activity at Strava](https://strava.app.link/ebxO7mAit2b) ![SRL-image-14.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTN93piGhVsStGYqyRaiGAqHLC4oXUyMuBepEzJJrRW59/SRL-image-14.png) --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@mcookies/entrenamiento-del-dia-domingo-con-el-team)

body.title: Adieu Roos, vitraille, molière
body.body:
![FE76CEF0-AB39-45B1-8225-E3146D7DFD31_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23uQrDKLokNiaDP77nRa6CUyfH35uXpn8RM4ebwFQkPQNPUf67BV8BZG3KvAHmfAhGQJj.jpg)
Maandag brachten we Roos naar Montpellier, nadat we natuurlijk nog een statieportet op de trap hebben genomen. Blij meisje :-)
Zoals we meestal doen als we naar MPL gaan, parkeerden we aan de rand van de stad in Occitanie en gingen met de tram richting het station. In de buurt van het station Saint Roch zat de hostel van Roos: [JOST Montpellier](https://www.jost-hotel-montpellier.com/). Een spiksplinternieuwe jeugdherberg in nieuwe stijl. Op de begane grond cosy zit-, hang-, werk- en eetplekken. In het midden een grote bar en aan de andere kant een podium voor optredens. De verdiepingen erboven waren de slaapverdiepingen, waar je een bed in een zespersoons zaal kan boeken maar ook twee- of vierpersoonskamers. Ook is er een 'rooftop' met zwembad en bar, maar die ging helaas voor Roos pas op 25 april open. Volgens mij een superleuke hippe plek zo midden in de stad.

![6330992D-873F-451C-9DFA-E90F4FAD1186_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/EoiXDUnSDmC5KeCjY6i2Gpuwvh7GLz6VHbNv79r33VVXMzLKfBoadMpRzuxaT7JkgLM.jpeg)
We sloten af met een diner bij -hoe toepasselijk- [Rosemarie](https://rosemarie-restaurant.fr/), een erg leuk restaurant op een gezellig pleintje. In april is het nog net te fris om buiten te eten, dus we hebben van het leuke interieur genoten. Daarna was het tijd om gedag te zeggen, Roos zou nog drie volle dagen in MPL doorbrengen en wij gingen weer 'gewoon' aan het werk.

#### Uitbreiding van Galerie Bleu et Vert
![CFE71F84-DB6F-4AA1-B72D-9E5CCECE4CD2_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/Eq9WAKmo2HRZZAFAyQRENWzk6mSj9q6Xby7HhgPejGgHaxgzPPSkTHkWNjm2fgS5Wtp.jpg)
Onze Bleu et Vert galerie is ook weer aangevuld. Naast een Job, een Wouter, een Mook, twee Irma's, twee Gerrit's en wat Bart's hebben we nu ook maar liefst drie werken van Roos in de keuken hangen. Een mooi cadeau van haar als dank voor de logeerpartij! Van een schilderij gemaakt in (waarschijnlijk) Saint Julien le Vetre, heeft ze een linosnede gemaakt en daar deze afdrukken van gemaakt. Ze kleuren toch wel fantastisch bij onze flessencollectie, nietwaar?

#### Aquarelletjes

![5BA67CB7-E20A-477D-B335-85F23A9EC8DF_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/EoGzqjeoDtCmfA84ucbGJmkK8u91qvxshC3qtD5rvXnV3RuQawhj9SgA7hc6uTjpzeP.jpeg)
Roos is super creatief, dat wisten we al. Nu hebben we ook even mee mogen genieten. Tijdens haar vakanties houdt ze in een schetsboekje dagelijks bij wat ze zoal gedaan heeft. Heel herkenbaar! Linksboven de heenreis met werken in de trein en met ons busje naar Sintipo rijden, Ernaast de markt op vrijdag en (volgens mij) de gitarist die we 's avonds in de Pradet zagen spelen.

![209C141C-2F31-40C9-AC2D-BF7B7A6DAE7B_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/EoyRU9kapeVutTcS2wjAeqh1jmtmPF9DX998HX8AuCabH81kGjoyFXS8H43ze38Q5aZ.jpeg)
Zaterdag de kronkelige autorit rond het Cirque de Navacelles (en oja, ansichtkaarten of toegangskaartjes mogen ook in het vakantieboekje geplakt worden).

![A756E125-C62E-4BEC-9F7F-7131234E0417_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/EowJ2DtfvEBduppgYEvjwic7AK8a2jNsWeEtWDNTZRo81ftbkJ4L5XfXcBEChgVj2Nb.jpeg)
En zondag het ritje met de stoomtrein van Anduze naar Saint Jean du Gard. Super leuk en herkenbaar, toch? De dagen erna heb ik ook nog een paar aquarelletjes toegestuurd gekregen, om te raden waar ze die dag in MPL was geweest. Ik had ze allemaal goed!

#### Hidden Disabilities Sunflower
![Sunflower image - 06112025.png.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23uFMQH9Yy1JAnd7A6NXytzFfoRhSYTuJX8MTFgq9BrWAjkaoWnCHy74JHiUuSeeQMoi2.webp)

Roos liet me een sleutelkoord zien, vrolijk groen met zonnebloemen erop, die ze aan haar rugzak had hangen. Ze vroeg of ik de betekenis van dat koord kende. Nee, dat kende ik niet. Het blijkt een hulpmiddel te zijn waarmee je kan delen dat je een 'niet zichtbare handicap' hebt, en dat je misschien een helpende hand, begrip, of meer tijd in winkels, op het werk, in het vervoer of openbare ruimte nodig hebt. Het heet het Hidden Disabilities Sunflower-sleutelkoord.

![HDScord.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/AJmu1AQi5LwMbc55sEWQ4hMTm4mziVasB8JjaMX6qFjhMUCG52iFeWS8npZcMED.jpg)

Als je de Sunflower draagt, hoef je dus niet iedere keer uit te leggen dat je af en toe hulp nodig hebt, of dat je langs een rij wachtenden mag lopen om voorrang te krijgen. 

Ik vind het een mooi initiatief, dus zegt het voort! Als je er meer over wil lezen, dit is de pagina van [HDsunflower](https://hdsunflower.com/nl/?_gl=1*dojcz7*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTU4NzA0MDA2MC4xNzc2NDQ0MzQz*_ga_9NBHMF5E90*czE3NzY0NDQzNDIkbzEkZzAkdDE3NzY0NDQzNDIkajYwJGwwJGgw*_ga_QH2Q9GE934*czE3NzY0NDQzNDIkbzEkZzAkdDE3NzY0NDQzNDIkajYwJGwwJGgw)

#### Vitraille
![1C94B18F-5EE7-4BE3-92E7-FB3E9BF1C8FA_4_5005_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/Eos3EvXJdHGJaPL3rszT7nBFFdo2NGqNy5Duu6nSv1j348HEioBBrVPAT8Q14UuTayZ.jpeg)
Bart is na het vertrek van Roos met Régis naar een glas-in-lood-winkel in Nîmes geweest om inkopen te doen voor hun glas-in-lood projecten. Helemaal opgetogen kwamen ze terug met allerlei gekleurde glasplaten, tangen, koperband, snijmat, soldeerbout en -tin, hechtvloeistoffen en een 'meuleuse': een slijpschijf om de randen van de gesneden stukjes glas glad de slijpen. 

Bart heeft meteen twee gereedschapsrekjes -die we al een tijdje geleden hadden gekocht- opgehangen, waardoor nu alle attributen mooi boven de werkbank hangen. Que ça commence !

#### Obturation d'une molaire
![molaires.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23xLLDdvAUoU9k36tVDaeoa5YzeVDUm84v561JJiKNsKDNQR4HdzsKmcxCJH53epsdDKH.jpg)

Ondertussen was ik deze week een vulling uit een kies verloren. Geen idee wanneer, maar ineens voelde ik een flinke holte in een kies acherin. Dus weer een nieuw hoofdstuk aanbreken in FR: de tandarts. We hadden al een naam gekregen van een goede tandarts in Sintipo, alleen hadden we nog geen contact opgenomen. Dit leek nu een mooie aanleiding. Toen ik de assistente aan de telefoon uitlegde dat ik een vulling was verloren (een 'obturation d'une molaire') en ook maar meteen een controleafspraak wilde maken, kreeg ik als reactie dat ze op 16 november een plekje hadden. Ahum, 16 november ?? Ik probeerde uit te leggen dat het missen van die vulling toch wel onhandig was met kauwen.  Vervolgens vroeg ze of ik pijn aan de kies had, aan te geven op een schaal van één tot tien... tja en dan ben ik zo eerlijk om te zeggen: nou een viertje ofzo, het is onhandig maar doet niet echt pijn. Un instant madame... nou ze hadden ook wel op 6 september een plekje. Ok, twee maanden eerder, maar nog steeds best ver weg... Nóg een keer gevraagd of het echt niet eerder kan bij spoedgevallen: désolé madame... Geduld dus hebben en hopen dat de kies niet verder aftakelt! Wel ga ik nog er en der een beetje rondvragen of dit gebruikelijk is in FR, of dat er misschien een andere tandarts eerder tijd heeft.

#### Le Seigneur des anneaux
![59F4D45D-16E3-4BF9-8D56-49CD0FC6DAFA_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23u5vMwmSjG8McCAJ57qBjCd8wrevU1KnfMZwU9N7EwffN9JM5MWXqHQxe5e3bTMzFQYt.jpg)
Voor vanmiddag hadden we kaartjes gekocht voor een klassiek concert met de muziek van de Lord of the Rings en de Hobbit. We wilden al een tijdje een keer een concert in Montpellier bijwonen en dit thema vonden we wel toepasselijk. Helaas niet in de Comédie/Opéra, de mooie oude concertzaal van MPL, maar in het Corum, het grote congrescentrum. Ik hoopte op een groot philarmonisch orkest, maar het was 'slechts' een man of dertig schat ik. Er was een flink spektakel van gemaakt, met veel lichteffecten, rookmachines (bah), een beelden die zogenaamd uit de film zouden moeten komen. We herkenden er geen beeld van, waarschijnlijk hadden ze de rechten niet. Ook kwam er een acteur uit de film tussendoor verhaaltjes vertellen in een soort Franglais... niet te verstaan en veel te Amerikaans/populair. Bij vlagen was de muziek mooi en herkenbaar, net zo vaak herkenden we het helemaal niet. De beelden, het licht en de rook leidden erg af van het orkest, wat ik graag beter had willen zien. Al met al gaven we het een mager zesje. Nou ja, het kan niet altijd tóp zijn. 
Moe en voldaan sluiten we hierbij weer een week af, op naar de volgende!
body.author: marjoleinsch

body.title: What I need to do to stay healthy || Qué tengo que hacer para mantenerme sano
body.body: Hello, everyone! There are so many things I can do to stay healthy, look good, and live longer for myself and my generation to be blessed by me, this is the most important part of it.

/> The first thing to do to stay healthy is to be mindful of the food I eat, especially junk food. This type of food doesn't add anything to the body, but it affects your internal and external systems to some extent. However, the internal effects of it are that junk foods are high in calories but low in nutrients, so they store excess fat in the body, which is why you see some people with a pot belly. Consuming sugary food is the cause of diabetes, which affects your blood sugar level, some people cease breathing because of the issue. Let me share my story of consuming sugary biscuits. It actually left me in the toilet for days; it was too sugary, and I took it in the morning, evening, and night, and it landed me in the toilet. For days, I wasn't myself. I became so weak and tired that I couldn't move myself. So I had to take drugs. Since then, I learned my lessons. Same thing with eating peppery food and salty food, it lands me in the room, so I'm always careful of the food I take, and I make sure it's properly prepared for my health's sake. Digestive issues can be affected internally, such as constipation, bloating, and many other things. Moreso, what you consume will affect your internal and external systems. Your skin texture or nourished skin would tell the food you take and how you take care of yourself. Being intentional about yourself means a lot, not only for your physical body but also for your spiritual mind. Fasting is one of the things you can do to stay healthy too. Some people eat from January to December without spiritual exercise, which the Bible says brings a lot of genuine profit to the body. Fasting is important, as it burns calories, reduces weight, and helps you stay fit physically and spiritually. In all, I did all these things, I control my food intake, I don't take sugary drinks or food, I exercise my physical body, and I go on fasts too, not to starve but to pray as well. Eat veggies, fruit, drink a lot of water, bathe when necessary, and get enough rest. **_Stay fit, vibrant, and strong_** **_This is my response to this initiative_** Spanish ======= ¡Hola a todos! Hay muchas cosas que puedo hacer para mantenerme sano, tener buen aspecto y vivir más tiempo, para que tanto yo como mi generación podamos disfrutar de ello; esta es la parte más importante.

/>

Lo primero que hay que hacer para mantenerse sano es prestar atención a lo que como, sobre todo a la comida basura. Este tipo de comida no aporta nada al organismo, pero afecta en cierta medida a los sistemas internos y externos.

Sin embargo, las consecuencias internas son que la comida basura tiene muchas calorías pero pocos nutrientes, por lo que el cuerpo acumula un exceso de grasa; de ahí que algunas personas tengan barriga. El consumo de alimentos azucarados provoca diabetes, lo que afecta al nivel de azúcar en sangre; algunas personas llegan incluso a dejar de respirar a causa de este problema.

Voy a contaros mi experiencia con unas galletas muy dulces. La verdad es que me tuvieron en el baño durante días; tenían demasiado azúcar, y como las tomaba por la mañana, por la tarde y por la noche, acabé en el baño. Durante días no era yo misma. Me sentía tan débil y cansada que no podía moverme. Así que tuve que tomar medicamentos. Desde entonces, he aprendido la lección.

Lo mismo me pasa con la comida picante y salada: me hace acabar en la cama, así que siempre tengo cuidado con lo que como y me aseguro de que esté bien preparada, por el bien de mi salud.

Los problemas digestivos pueden tener un origen interno, como el estreñimiento, la hinchazón y muchas otras cosas.

Es más, lo que consumes afectará a tus sistemas internos y externos. La textura de tu piel o el estado de nutrición de esta reflejan la alimentación que sigues y cómo te cuidas. Cuidarte de forma consciente es muy importante, no solo para tu cuerpo físico, sino también para tu mente espiritual. El ayuno es una de las cosas que puedes hacer para mantenerte sano. Hay personas que comen de enero a diciembre sin practicar ningún ejercicio espiritual, algo que, según la Biblia, aporta muchos beneficios reales al cuerpo. El ayuno es importante, ya que quema calorías, reduce el peso y te ayuda a mantenerte en forma física y espiritualmente.

En resumen, he hecho todo esto: controlo lo que como, evito las bebidas y los alimentos azucarados, hago ejercicio físico y también ayuno, no para pasar hambre, sino también para rezar.  
Come verduras y fruta, bebe mucha agua, báñate cuando sea necesario y descansa lo suficiente.

**_Mantente en forma, lleno de energía y fuerte_**

**_Esta es mi respuesta a esta iniciativa_**

body.title: The Unseen Threat.
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776624129960-36d73dfa30ae6036.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=lazybug/f39c96e4)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=lazybug/f39c96e4)


---

<center><sup>The thumbnail was created in Canva.</sup></center>

<div class=\

>

Leaving the rangers, I entered the processing unit and discovered the remains of a brutalized guard. I encountered a strange, vanishing monster near a blocked Hiss door, which I defeated before finding intel on the Black Rock Quarry. Using my security clearance, I called the elevator to head deeper into the facility.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY6KH1H2G68rgF7RY744SfQVHrgJeH65rddCFmrjn7Cvg/screenshot_1_.png)

I still had to get to the Black Rock processing to move forward with the mission. So, leaving the rangers behind at the safe point, I walked through that door alone. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeBLcRRYypdcS4RvneN497KyB58E9yepZvgL8nbssTXD3/screenshot_2_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNyEBjrc4jPiGX1zKA5Bv4SGkUs7kgYBcg961EJhg8Ahj/screenshot_3_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPvMEF8vNytKEXDmo6MwPBVnuvEesb2pPSzVBVJJDdasz/screenshot_4_.png)

On my way, I found this dead body lying in the middle of the hallway. I saved that scene properly using the photo mode to get a closer look at the details. This ranger had suffered a very brutal death at the hands of the enemies lurking in the building.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcHyzKBb1cqp5XHHEmDsHocaew5dnYa9JZ8cKWGtctyQR/screenshot_5_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRyHQS7gsy4QDn8QpBT9JnNuCKmCJpQjTjuHL546JyQX6/screenshot_6_.png)

What should I say about this specific ranger who lost the lower part of his mouth? It was really a terrible sight to witness, and I tried to capture the horror of the moment through the lens. It was a grim reminder of how dangerous the Hiss can be to anyone caught in their path.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyU5zLvkwtjZsh4MksFRPKqsCR2tBq7JGbW7r4Nje5Gf/screenshot_7_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT33qnVWPQiJCbHfENQA9g658cVPZ9M3Zw3cVRDWdX5XA/screenshot_8_.png)

Here was this big hall room where a door was blocked by a large Hiss entity. This was the path that would lead me directly to Black Rock processing if I could clear it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbBtB2gzVLS5r5uskA6ixsPqySY4jyoNGHWBd3XQtNugq/screenshot_9_.png)

 I interacted with a storage part that should have had some black rock prisms inside, but unfortunately, it was empty.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVZ9LiHYphqLFfx6WTcnchWrLVik6ojpEsNVMZHzgjZSK/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSNDooCuYkazMVfKsyS5wYmsKg4xSACPdKRkP8KgAjTY8/screenshot_11_.png)

Right about that time, something appeared in the room that looked like a completely new kind of monster. I guess it was the same monster that Arish talked about during our last conversation. It moved with a strange, jittery energy that made it very hard to focus on its physical form.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbuWVSbMsJ5hd4fy8Wq13Fxzqq7N9UDZLwbp7g2FanBvV/screenshot_12_.png)

The monster disappeared into thin air just as I was about to launch my first attack. It came back suddenly when I was looking around the room, trying to surprise me from behind.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsQ9rvzTaYapNSSEUzLu7d5tFqpGb3YGeUPyMZzZvVKV/screenshot_13_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHrUzx61LDZvPPJcCd68vowpyubVGo8NCh2PZebd8Ycf/screenshot_14_.png)

 I was too fast in fighting it, using my powers to strike before it could vanish again. After a short while, it looked like I defeated the monster, though it seemed a bit too easy for such a scary creature.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbZSR7oKyAVf7UNyumJ2DEMrraUpShk1R3rzA4k36h8vK/screenshot_15_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVt5PheJo72YzqtcVynW8gQXLHHyCXuYqyafDjYCYTKfy/screenshot_16_.png)

Once the monster was gone, the door of the lab finally got free from the Hiss entity that was holding it shut. After getting inside the office, I found some very important information about the Black Rock Quarry. The documents mentioned that the quarry actually had the Black Rock prisms I was looking for.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWQZXvZwQQkjNvSsgFWAJrGRGgrycNGcwZZMKrnsq6WLp/screenshot_17_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTBgY3SHTc6k71Y1YxbmRBkBT2NYEgbhsYmcopCNnFsjm/screenshot_18_.png)

I was able to open the restricted door at the back of the lab. I walked toward the shaft and called for an elevator to get me down to the Black Rock Quarry.

**To be Continued...**

---

body.title: 50/50 HP is the best strategy
body.body:
>

Hive is the best Web 3.0 platform, and I fully agree with it. I feel that decentralization is the beauty of this platform. I have freedom of speech, and there is no one to restrict my voice. My account truly belongs to me, and Hive Power, also known as HP, is what really matters here. The more power we have, the more influence we can create. So, we need HP, and having more HP allows us to raise our voice louder. We receive rewards for our posts and engagement. We can cash out to use them for various purposes, and again, we can use them to power up and boost growth. What is the best strategy to manage the rewards? I am going to share my thoughts related to it. ![Inline Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNckcdeJnBWoKgN88MdUsaCFAddrY3EE2JuUoTatXZeHP/ai-image-1776624009396.jpeg) I think that Hive users should have a long-term vision, as I feel that Hive is not for short-sighted people. One should have patience and an understanding of the Hive platform. In the long run, having a huge amount of HP means having huge influence, and in many cases, their words matter a lot. If we hold HP, we can get 4.31% APR on HP. It’s not bad, and in the long run, it will make a huge difference. It’s not the end. More HP means more curation rewards, and more curation rewards means getting more HP. It also means the curation reward will boost the HP, and HP will boost the curation reward, and it will help grow an account faster. Having more HP means we are allowed to delegate some HP and earn more rewards using HP. So, in the long term, using rewards to power up and grow an account faster seems to be the best choice. Why do we earn money? It’s because we need it in our life. For every purpose, we need money, and that’s why we are making efforts. Saving money is a good thing, but what is the meaning of earning money if we don’t use it? So, I think there should be no hesitation in using the money we earn. So, if one Hive user cashes out all the rewards to use in real life, I think it’s also a good thing, and I feel that it’s worthy, as we earn for life and using the reward to treat ourselves is something we deserve. Just imagine I don’t need the reward asset in my real life. Should I power up all of it to boost my growth? In the past, I have done this kind of thing. I powered up all that I earned from here. I can remember once I also powered up 1,000 HP in a single day. I really regret powering up recklessly. I just think it would be better if I had saved it for HBD. It’s because HIVE’s price dropped so much, and it was beyond my imagination. I think if I had the same amount of HBD, I would buy at least 7/8x more HIVE and power up all of it. I don’t want to think more about the price, and I don’t dare to power up so much like in the earlier days. I feel that a 50/50 strategy is the best solution. 50% should be used for power up, and the remaining 50% of rewards should be used for stable funding. In fact, I think 50% should be invested in other crypto because we should not be obsessed with a single crypto. Diversifying is the best thing we can do, and I think that it will be the best strategy for us, and I recommend it.

body.title: Memory
body.body:
![PXL_20250625_141233085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/23vhU8rCBNVAVkfegtJtyZuHofQxjpvVJz8Mg7h7zcT8Y5dHwcia4vAgzFcHJC8YY1vn1.jpg)


Hi friends, how are you all? I hope you are well. Friends, as time goes by, I feel like I am leaning towards some unknown place. Looking at the present, it seems that I am completely alone or that I am sitting alone and thinking about thousands of people around me. But among thousands of people, I am the only one awake, and everyone else is sleeping. It seems a little unreal, especially in this case, as it happens to everyone. For example, I can say that when you suddenly get into deep thought about something, no matter how many people are around you or how many friends you have, you will see that you do not pay attention to anything; you are just immersed in what you are thinking. That is why I said such things. Maybe it sounds a little strange, but it is absolutely true.

This kind of thing has happened to me several times. Today it happened like this, so I thought if it happens to you too, I'll share it with you, so maybe I can understand. Today, when I finished work and left for my destination, I suddenly felt like having some tea to lighten myself as I felt very heavy, so as I thought about it, I sat at a tea shop instead of going home to have some tea.

![PXL_20250224_132614614.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/EoeDSreBGSuf76e19PYeHoD6ReG5bMQAMhKXbSGMCbtu9wxa98TTj2UJoM7srbaWCW2.jpg)

While sitting in the tea shop, I looked around and saw several college students sitting together chatting and drinking tea. At first, I was very happy to see them, but then I remembered my own memories. At that age, we used to sit there and chat together in a very famous tea shop in our area. It was a sweet time. I didn't realize how morning turned into night or how time passed. But it was an incredibly beautiful time.


![PXL_20250121_062454530~3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/23xVTbRpJDTPFNmoLTJg74MDyC7mjXwLdJ3y5AZPmebRixPeWPbe9MQhTEgcobswBDAUG.jpg)

But today I feel very helpless looking at myself. My friends from that time are all running in different directions for their careers. Sometimes we talk to each other or maybe sit together once or twice a year. But the chats that were given during college are no longer there. It is very difficult to say, but this is the real, cruel truth of life. However, friends, each of us should take some time for ourselves and entertain ourselves. Because if you are good, you will be able to keep your family and everyone around you good. But if you are not good, you will not be able to keep others good, be sure of this. So I request you to give some time to yourself. You will be much better than,

body.body: ![dcrops portada.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danideuder/242Nocwmnrgw2nczz6P9JhjyCj8pv8mVKNosWT7vkp2K9XZa1WZEpCw2A1rf9KoGhX76h.png) Hola queridos amigos granjeros. Acaba de terminar la primavera en lo que ha sido esta temporada 121 y llega el momento de prepararse para el verano y de hacer resumen de lo que hemos conseguido en esta nueva temporada primaveral que ha sido corta pero intensa. Esta temporada una de las recompensas diarias ha sido un cofre por lo que se podría decir que ha sido una buena temporada en el aspecto de recompensas. Vamos a ver, también, qué tal ha ido la parte de siembra y recolección. Vamos al lío pues. ![cooltext505302647582680.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danideuder/23tvVvwgqTPN8yxGhH6Fs6Q8aBmEQBzfw9ixESZv4EiBjoJQ7cyDxFVxmKYUrw9qY8ug6.png) No ha habido cambios en cuanto a las tierras de cultivo disponibles por lo que los números son los mismos que el invierno del anterior reporte siendo estos: 5 terrenos épicos, 3 raros y 3 comunes que me otorgan un total de 24 espacios cultivables. Y las semillas con las que he contado esta temporada han sido: |Semilla|Cantidad| |-|-| |Broccoli|5| |Kale|6| |Cauliflower|3| |Potato|7| |Strawberry|1| |Dill|23| |Rosemary|15| |Tulip|8| |French Bean|2| |Ginger|2| |Egg Plant|1| ![cooltext505302671040369.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danideuder/23t7cyGr97mQQ6K1vujvpC3E2EFeYy8GmkPvNHVva4YFs5cCCGPNdyQVPfwmsLHiqJfAx.png) Los resultados de la siembra y recogida me proporcionaron un total de 2.336 shares que, con la tasa de reparto de esta temporada que has sido de 0.400, me han proporcionado un total de 935,07 crop. Mi balance actual de crop \

queda ahora en 15.687,73 ![cooltext505302671040369.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danideuder/23tvZrP4DveCs7XTRBKEEdkEWzDRsMHo1txY9ZLyhjiKcvgGtxoJHnSd6LGgvonCgGtPZ.png) Una parte importante del juego son los quests. Uno de mis objetivos principales es conseguirlos y vender en el mercado secundario los minerales que obtenga y reinvertir en crop los beneficios obtenidos. Mi Quest de esta temporada ha sido este. Sencillo y que logré completar a falta de cuatro días para el final de la temporada: ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-15 174843.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danideuder/Eos6gYvSyZoU4r7jAeYitSxsSbCZPVz7ETSgEsyNyBpEVhcmwYjhBenmnZT8jG77Z9s.png) Y las recompensas han sido: ![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-19 193708.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danideuder/23uFrsyd7Co1zrZXCZqb87oWBqQfa4VehvJkUvaR171xrSFXKqXCbuFQ8rxp9pbpLDzgQ.png) La venta del cobre, la madera y el hierro me proporcionan la cantidad de 0.40 Hive aproximadamente que utilizo para comprar 129 crop. Este ha sido el resumen de esta temporada de primavera número 121. No ha ido nada mal. Ahora toca trabajar el verano para seguir sumando recompensas y poder dentro del juego. Seguimos. # 🖖 Prime Directive Spread — Week Ahead Reading

## The Cards & Their Positions

Your seven-card spread reveals a week of significant reckoning balanced by wisdom and strategic patience. Here's the full transmission:

---

### 🔴 Position 1 — THE MISSION: **Judgment (XX)**
*Top left — What you're called to address*

The week opens with a cosmic summons — a moment of reckoning that demands you evaluate where you've been and where you're headed. Like standing before a Starfleet tribunal, this card asks: *are your actions aligned with your highest values?* In business, expect a situation that requires a definitive verdict or conclusion. Something that's been pending or unresolved arrives at a tipping point. Don't avoid it — this is your call to action.

---

### 💛 Position 2 — THE ALLY: **Queen of Latinum**

*Top right — What supports you*

The suit of Latinum governs material resources and practical affairs. The Queen here is sharp, resourceful, and commercially astute. In personal matters, a capable woman in your life may offer grounding wisdom. In business, *your best asset this week is resourcefulness* — financial savvy and practical thinking will serve you far better than bold gestures. Watch for opportunities involving commerce, negotiation, or value exchange.

---

### ⚔️ Position 3 — THE CHALLENGE: **Seven of Bat'leths**
*Middle left — Obstacles on the bridge*

The Klingon suit mirrors the Swords suit — strategy, conflict, and mental tension. The Seven signals a temptation to go it alone or use cunning rather than direct confrontation. Someone (possibly yourself) may be operating with a hidden agenda or withholding information. *The challenge this week is resisting the urge to deceive or be deceived.* Stay vigilant but don't become paranoid — not every cloak hides an enemy.

---

### 🔵 Position 4 — THE HIDDEN TRUTH: **The Hermit (IX)**
*Center — Inner guidance only you can access*

Sitting at the heart of your spread, The Hermit is the most important message of the week: **slow down and look inward.** The answers you're seeking are not in the noise around you — they're in quiet reflection. This is a week to spend time in contemplation before making moves. A mentor figure or elder wisdom (past or present) may illuminate something you've been overlooking. Don't rush decisions. Consult your inner compass first.

---

### ✨ Position 5 — THE PATH: **Temperance (XIV)**
*Middle right — How to move forward*

Spock himself anchors this card — logic, balance, the blending of opposites into something greater. Temperance says: *don't overreact, don't overcorrect.* Whether in a relationship, a business negotiation, or a personal dilemma, the winning approach this week is measured, patient, and moderate. Extremes will backfire. Find the middle path between action and restraint, between heart and mind.

---

### 🚀 Position 6 — THE FOUNDATION: **Six of Federation Ships**
*Bottom left — What grounds and sustains you*

The Federation suit reflects harmony, collective strength, and shared purpose. The Six suggests community, goodwill, and the support of those who've traveled with you before. *Your foundation this week is your network and your relationships.* Past connections may resurface helpfully. In business, collaborative energy is strong — lean on your crew rather than soloing through challenges. There is real goodwill available to you right now.

---

### 🟢 Position 7 — THE OUTCOME: **King of Cloaks**
*Bottom right — Where the week leads*

The King of Cloaks (Swords/Romulan suit) is a figure of sharp intellect, command, and strategic authority. Reaching him as your outcome is a strong signal: *by week's end, you can arrive at a position of clarity and decisive authority* — provided you've heeded the Hermit's call for reflection and Temperance's call for balance. This king does not act rashly; he observes, calculates, and moves with precision. This is who you can become this week if you play your hand wisely.

---

## 📡 Overall Transmission

> This week carries the energy of a **turning point** — not dramatic upheaval, but a quiet, significant shift in how clearly you see your situation and your own power within it. The Hermit at center commands you to pause before acting. The bookends of **Judgment** and the **King of Cloaks** form a powerful arc: *from being called to account → to becoming the one in command.*

**In personal matters:** Relationships benefit from honest conversation and measured responses. Someone may test your patience — Temperance is your guide.

**In business matters:** A financial or strategic decision needs sober, solitary reflection before action. Use your network's goodwill, watch for hidden agendas around you, and trust practical resourcefulness over impulse.

*Live long and prosper.* 🖖

body.title: LOH 285: LIVE A HEALTHY LIFE
body.body:
![pexels-photo-12950261.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/241ZvAJD32uhY1PJPCgQTi8chZcSxNybLH6EE9RDJmfSRebt13ct4CV7saSfDE15Ro7Mc.jpeg)
[source](https://www.pexels.com/search/purpose%20of%20life/) 


Everyone has a reason for living we all have a purpose as human being to fulfill in this world of ours. Human beings, our purposes in life is not fixed to one particular thing rather it depends on the activity is going on on in our life at that particular time. Hence we can describe this as a shift for our reasons to live. 

Based on my experience, the purpose for living can change from something that is immediate and something that is big. My point is that there are different points in our lives that we get to and we think that we have a Clear Vision of what we want our life purpose to be but reverse is the case where we get another Level we like and we discovered that the formal purpose we wanted to achieve was a limitation because we have not gotten to our destination yet. 

For instance, when we were in primary school we had dreams of becoming doctors teachers nurses engineers pilots and so on then with good say it was a Clear Vision but not one that we were experienced about because we were kids. When we got to secondary school as well the division of students into art commercial and science class gives us a vision that this is where we are going to end up with our life in the future. 

Again, on getting to the university and attaining that degree we were so sure that our purpose in life would be clear and definite which would include a career path our family responsibilities and others. However getting into the real world we discover that there is a paradigm shift in what our purposes in life should be. 

As I speak to you, my purpose in life is to live healthy and to build myself to the extent that I would feel loved and be responsible for everyone around me and not failed them. I do not hope for too much but i am grateful for life and intend to live the best out of it. 


This is my participation in the @ladiesofhive community weekly contest, to join in check through this [link](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-201) 
>Right now in your life, what feels like your main reason for living?
How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day?

Thanks for stopping by my blog... 

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@henrietta27/loh-285-love-a-healthy-life-jy6)

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 19 2026
body.body: <center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g081eaf7f2deb0390c86e24182f5e318424dd07b32383df71d2715df3165df96099a6998b8e9f840a372c424ee24a5ed8_640.jpg)</center>My last walk was along the Cotswold Way, a stunning long-distance trail that runs for about 102 miles across the Cotswolds in England. I started my journey near the picturesque village of Broadway, often referred to as the \

As I made my way through the rolling hills and lush green landscapes, I was greeted by the beautiful sight of honey-colored stone houses typical of the Cotswold architecture. The countryside was dotted with sheep grazing peacefully, creating a quintessential English scene. The views from the higher points were breathtaking, particularly when I reached Broadway Tower, a stunning folly designed in the 18th century. The tower offers panoramic views over the countryside, and on a clear day, you can see as far as Wales! Along the trail, I stumbled upon a few other walkers, one of whom was an elderly gentleman named Mr. Collins, who was quite the character. He shared stories of his youth exploring the same paths, reminiscing about how the area has changed over the decades. His anecdotes brought the landscape to life, adding layers of history to the scenery I was enjoying. I also encountered a small local market in Chipping Campden, where I stopped to indulge in some homemade scones and local cheese. The market had a warm, friendly atmosphere, and I struck up a conversation with a local artisan who crafted wooden toys. He spoke passionately about the importance of preserving traditional crafts and shared insights into the history of the region. The walk was not only a lovely physical journey but also a delightful exploration of the rich history and culture of the Cotswolds. It reminded me how much stories are intertwined with the places we visit, and how every walk can reveal new tales waiting to be discovered. The combination of natural beauty, historical landmarks, and the warmth of local people made this outing truly memorable. I’m already looking forward to my next adventure! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: 🇵🇱 Siłownia pod chmurką 💪 / 🇬🇧\nOutdoor gym 💪: April 18 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5082ebc4-0ece-41d1-a50a-34bb62b7e117.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/97c17f59-fa79-4a74-995f-58fb239bf294.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ea88ea21-e0da-4718-b0e9-5b39e1d4b1b6.jpg)
🇵🇱 Dziś bez biegania. Zamiast kilometrów – drewno, ręce i robota do zrobienia. Siłownia pod chmurką. Bez planu, bez tempa, bez Garmina. Ale ciało i tak pracuje – inaczej, ciężej, bardziej „życiowo”. Dobra odskocznia od schematów. Bo forma to nie tylko odcinki i tętno – to też takie dni, gdzie robisz swoje, i budujesz siłę trochę poza trasą. Jutro wracam na ścieżkę. Dziś – działka. — 🇬🇧 Today, no running. Instead of kilometers – wood, hands, and work to be done. Outdoor gym. No plan, no pace, no Garmin. But the body still works – differently, harder, more real. A good break from structure. Because fitness isn’t just intervals and heart rate – it’s also days like this, building strength off the track. Back to running tomorrow. Today – gardening.

Forgive and forget. That is forgive the offense done unto you and then forget about the offense. The heart of love should not remember offenses always. People say they can't forget the bad things that someone had done unto them. But we are queried why is it possible that we can remember that thing which is bad but we can't remember the good things that are done to us. There are people who have helped you when you where in the college but you can't recall their good works and appreciate them. This is not a good spirit. It is lack of love that makes people always remember bad things and forget good things.

I have come to realize that God Himself forget offenses. He said in His words that our iniquities will he remember no more. If God who is greater than all of us and whose memory is wider and bigger than that of any creation can still forget the iniquities of people when he forgives their sins, how come that we find it difficult to forget about the wrong things which people did to us. The reason why we can't forget the wrong things is because we are not living in love.

As christians, forgiveness is a virtue which we must exhibit. We must always forgive those who sin against us. We should not keep the scores of wrong. The Lord Jesus Christ told us that we must forgive if we want God to forgive us. Sometimes, it is not very easy to forgive but let us always try to keep a clean mind with others.

body.title: Parents Should be Loving: Toxic Parenting Ruins the Joys of Childhood.
body.body:
Hi everyone!  If I ask you what is the sweetest word in the world I think almost 99.99% will reply that Mother/ Mom/ maa is that word. There is no mother who doesn’t love her child most. Only mom can feel the pain of her child properly. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQ4QNbAihcoRnAyvVZvFN9ZTuXk4mnHAdpwsCcFAca71/1776622513422.jpg)

From giving birth to taking care after birth a mother bears a lot of sufferings for her child. After that when the baby grows up he learns many things from her mother. Naturally a baby copies his mother. He always observes his mother. Even his emotions also affected by his mother's emotions. But there is a dark side of few mothers which ruins childhood of a baby. It is hard to believe  but it is a  sad reality. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRLd1UuvFohSM2anEW1thvkVzNpBDtQmDjWoAuHg28Gke/1776622914691.jpg)

There are some mothers and some fathers who are always concerned about her child's educational development more than his mental happiness. Mothers are more curious than fathers for their child's future. They want that their child might stand first position in their class always. If the child failed to keep his position a brutal torture awaits him. They expect 100% marks in all exams within class tests.  If their child does any silly mistake in exam paper they can't tolerate at all. Even they can't take their child in relatives' house because it may hamper his study. 

They never let their child do any household work. They feed their child on reading table by own hand. Even they never let them mix with other friends lest it causes hamper on their study. This type of child grows up with an introverted mind. They never feel to show minimum courtesy with the guest of their house. They are always busy with their own world. Even if anyone is about to  die in front of them they will not go for help. And their mother also feel proud for this. 

But these children have some good quality also. They generally very honest in their workplace. They never keep their work for later. They are always punctual and very much dutiful to their family. They can reach the top of the success but they lost the golden moments of their childhood ever which they lost forever to fulfil their parent's dream. 

But it is possible to grow up with keeping social relationships from childhood and there are a lot of examples around us who never got any care or financial support from their parents but ultimately some of them can shine in life with full mental peace.

body.title: LA TELENOVELA EN VENEZUELA: MIS TRES HERMANAS (2000).
body.body:
***Hola mi gente bella, espero esten todos super bien, un gran abrazo para todos, hoy les traigo la ediciòn sobre una de las mejores novelas que han producido en el pais, una historia increible que trata sobre 3 hermanas, un drama familiar expectacular.***

---

![192..jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23wMj8bZqGjWjZQadqZ2V7WW82gLTYsA5wbU1AfDtvWTx5gtmgnPEm2R7damEw7dRSsyJ.jpg)

<center>***Portada realizada por mi.***</center>

---

<center>INTRODUCCIÒN.***</center>
-

***​Mis 3 hermanas es una de las telenovelas más exitosas y queridas en la historia de RCTV, estrenada en el año 2000. Escrita por la reconocida autora Perla Farías, la historia se alejó de los grandes villanos melodramáticos para centrarse en un drama familiar profundamente humano y cotidiano. Fue un fenómeno de audiencia que logró paralizar al país en su capítulo final y se convirtió en un éxito de exportación masivo.***

---

<center>![httpswww.instagram.compB7Exzm_luU6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/Eoc7a8jmgXeqKA3ULokzdspbrRmkYitgTSUUQgTgpB7ouAob1BkgqbZ2MUejpBggbmX.jpg)</center>

<center>[Actrices Protagonistas de la novela](httpswww.instagram.compB7Exzm_luU6)</center>

---

<center>***FICHA TECNICA.***</center>
-

***-Titulo Original: Mis Tres Hermanas.
-Productora: Radio Caracas Televisión (RCTV).
​-Año: 2000 (150 episodios).
​-Guion: Perla Farías.
​-Dirección: Tony Rodríguez.
​-Protagonistas: Scarlett Ortiz, Ricardo Álamo, Roxana Díaz y Carlos Cruz.
​-Elenco Estelar: Dad Dáger, Chantal Baudaux, Jonathan Montenegro, Marlene De Andrade y Yul Bürkle.
​-Tema musical: \

, interpretado por Son by four.***

---

<center>![httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads201909Mis-3-Hermanas-Miniatura-900x900-2a-1-1024x1024.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/AK6XnJ5y3PhCetunMcC5QsqxsEMRDAaSGXgoJVPeDvohh2hDxD77auGE5zDQWWT.jpg)</center>

<center>[Elenco familiar de la novela](httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads201909Mis-3-Hermanas-Miniatura-900x900-2a-1-1024x1024.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***SINOPSIS.***</center>
-

***La historia gira en torno a los hermanos Estrada. Tras la muerte de sus padres, el hermano mayor, Augusto (Carlos Cruz), ha dedicado su vida entera a trabajar y sacrificar sus propios sueños para criar a sus tres hermanas menores: Silvia (Dad Dáger), la mayor de las tres y pilar del hogar; Lisa (Scarlett Ortiz), una estudiante de medicina noble y decidida; y Beatriz, mejor conocida como Beba (Chantal Baudaux), la más joven y rebelde.***

***​El conflicto central se desata cuando el amor toca a la puerta de los hermanos, poniendo a prueba la unión familiar. Lisa se enamora de Santiago (Ricardo Álamo), un ingeniero que trabaja con Augusto, pero su relación se ve obstaculizada por la ambiciosa Bárbara Solórzano (Roxana Díaz). Por su parte, Augusto debe aprender a soltar a sus hermanas y permitirse amar, enfrentando la dura realidad de que la familia que tanto protegió está creciendo y tomando rumbos inesperados.***

---

<center>![httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads201909Mis-3-Hermanas-Miniatura-900x900-1-1-1024x1024.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/AK9PsAuoFFF4NJpQfMETZCwGLKmZwRsVGQTcoPUdS1VEDehUsAEqDDQRAanFgqf.jpg)</center>

<center>[Mis tres hermanas](httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads201909Mis-3-Hermanas-Miniatura-900x900-1-1-1024x1024.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***BREVE RESEÑA.***</center>
-

***Mis 3 hermanas rompió récords de sintonía gracias a su guion realista y personajes tridimensionales. Fue la novela que consolidó a Scarlett Ortiz y Ricardo Álamo como la pareja de oro de la televisión venezolana de principios del milenio. Sin embargo, muchos críticos señalan que el \

de la novela fue la actuación de Carlos Cruz como Augusto, representando el arquetipo del hombre sacrificado por su familia.***

***​La actuación de Roxana Díaz como la antagonista Bárbara fue icónica, creando una villana humana, sufrida y compleja que el público amaba odiar. También se resalta el impacto de las tramas juveniles con Jonathan Montenegro y Chantal Baudaux, y la participación de Marlene De Andrade, quien se convirtió en una revelación actoral. La banda sonora, encabezada por el éxito de la banda argentina Los Enanitos Verdes, acompañó perfectamente el tono nostálgico y esperanzador de la obra.***

---

<center>![httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads201905Mistres-hermanas-900x900-2.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/AJivKDeGaGQpipGEBX3zgmNpFNYiSsFciWjxE7CpyjKHp1QDftCCBsJnRzcQJ9R.jpg)</center>

<center>[Portada de la novela](httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads201905Mistres-hermanas-900x900-2.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***CONCLUSIÒN.***</center>
-

***Mis 3 hermanas es recordada como una de las últimas grandes producciones de la era de oro de RCTV. Su éxito radicó en la sencillez de su premisa: el amor fraternal y los desafíos de la vida diaria. Logró que el público se viera reflejado en los conflictos de los Estrada, dejando un legado de valores familiares y una factura técnica impecable que la mantiene como un referente indispensable del género en Latinoamérica.***

---

body.title: Przyrodnicza wycieczka po Koloniach
body.body:
Tym razem to nie ja byłem przewodnikiem. To była wycieczka na którą zaprosił nas kolega ze studiów a prowadził ją nauczyciel biologii - zacny rocznik wojenny (nie chodzi o stan wojenny).

Do wycieczki przygotowałem się w ten sposób, że analizowałem Gdańskie kolonie na mapie. Kolonie to budżetowe osiedla mieszkaniowe z pierwszej połowy XX wieku. Dzisiaj w większość przypominają działki.

Cieszy się, że podczas wycieczki przechodziliśmy przez Kolonię Wyżyny bo tam mnie jeszcze nie było.

Tak skupiłem się na tych koloniach, że przyrodę zostawiłem przyrodzie.

Teraz od dwóch dni uzupełniam i porządkuję wiedzę wklejając dane do bazy, która tworzy miastonamapie.racibo.pl. 

Doszła ulica Ojcowska z 1930 roku, której zabudowa z lotu ptaka przypomina dwie literki S. To jednak przypadek, choć wiadomo jakie upodobania mieli przedwojenni Gdańszczanie.

Doszli architekci zabudowy ulicy Wyczółkowskiego, doszedł dom gdzie mieszkał dziadek Donalda Tuska. Ten którego los nie oszczędzał i w trakcie wojny służył tam gdzie musiał.

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | Are we financially responsible to other people
body.body: > https://youtu.be/1thyLJnGsqA?si=t_mgADuJByfGi1qT Most of the time, I have heard and seen people talked about whether we are financially responsible for people or not and even as a Christian, whenever I think about it, the only answer I can come up with it is the fact that it is yes but I am going to balance it. We are financial responsible for other people but in wisdom and love and I will explain why I said in wisdom and love. First of all, the bible always reach us that we should not live only for ourselves but we should try to care for others most especially people that is in need. In Galatians 6:2, the Bible says, “Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ. I personally always believe it just showing love and generally helping people is not just about a good act. For me, I see it as a duty as a believer that we must fulfill. Whenever I actually see someone or generally a believer that is struggling, I always want to help. Even though I don't really have that much with me, I know giving little always can help someone else so I don't always hesitate to help. Now let me create the balance before I round up. In 1 Timothy 5:8, it says, “But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith. I have always come to understand that my first responsibility is actually my family. I must not neglect those that are very close to me even though I am trying to help others. Not even only that, one of the things that will really made my giving to be blessed is the fact that if I give from a willing heart.

body.title: [ENG-ESP] ¿Qué hacer un domingo? | What to do on a Sunday? ☀️ Sublime Sunday
body.body:
​🌼[ENG]  What to do on a Sunday?
I mentioned that it would be a cloudy weekend here in Bilbao, but midday today turned out to be radiant.

​🏵️[ESP] *¿Qué hacer un domingo?
Les comenté que en Bilbao sería un fin de semana nublado, pero hoy el mediodía estuvo radiante.*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZh8AYYokoxmr6L8dWcWJGfwTGpNtSGyWeEivagKW5Rm8/1776621437475.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNzVVwwjBArhmACS882h8st4oyEV356yristo6pYuUrjV/1776621437838.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeqTnFCNatosTfYi5wEDiDRRx41MCV4VjnqYjvcBd6NEv/1776621437935.jpg)


​🌼On Sundays, most shops are closed, but today I went for a walk through the Casco Viejo (Old Town), where it seems independent businesses decided to open up to take advantage of the fact that people were out and about in high spirits.

​🏵️ *Los domingos la mayoría de los comercios cierran, pero hoy me fui a caminar por el casco viejo, donde al parecer los negocios independientes decidieron abrir para aprovechar que la gente salió animada a las calles.* 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZTgyA3siQN9sEGLrbNgfQn3R2LmP3YYFpBiRUfvFHo99/1776621560383.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTxmMW3rBXmWzBtKh6eUZe86XHjeBAAEwiJxFjV7HWFyD/1776621560544.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTM6bhNdhW3Y1YUYi4USXehiXubjgUgDdsJBHtZBsWkh9/1776621560667.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSewgpNdycLfrPEeMRBYrqHMwx46FctZnAB6X7R9ju9i2/1776621560768.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNSNEr7vr8TpPKhV5jhgNWdzd9phhZYLyykWyuNMhRnwS/1776621560872.jpg)


​🌼 Finding myself with an empty fridge and pantry by the time the weekend rolls around is something that happens to me quite often. Even though the big supermarkets are closed, there are always some small \

and local markets around; in this area, I spotted a few, along with several open fruit stands and butcher shops.

​🏵️*Lo de que llegue el fin de semana y me falten muchas cosas en la nevera y la despensa es algo que me pasa seguido. Los supermercados cierran, pero quedan algunos mercaditos y tiendas domingueras, y en esta zona vi unos cuantos, al igual que varias fruterías y carnicerías abiertas.*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSBubCBxPKuypTR2pi8i1gojVxykWZUNVBKbZo22EhH3/1776621995329.jpg)


​🌼 I woke up today with that unpleasant pressure in my eyes—a sure sign that a tough migraine was on its way. I took my medication early, and once it kicked in after I finished my shopping, I actually felt like going for a walk.

​🏵️ *Hoy amanecí con una presión desagradable en los ojos, señal segura de que viene una migraña de las duras. Así que tomé mi medicamento temprano y, cuando me hizo efecto después de hacer las compras, sentí ganas de ir a caminar.*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVPgwxCPwAUeSoVHXo4LNKv5Bhe7pud8n4hu7MEotN9Sz/1776622178625.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTaYi2u2mM1bk5jTtEPfTUHkHf9KygfT5EBiN67gsWCvM/1776622027642.jpg)

​🌼 The sun was quite strong, and it was hot out. I worked up a sweat, partly because of the heat and partly from the exercise of the walk. It gave me that feeling you get when you have a fever and you sweat it out through your pores. It felt as if I were \

the migraine. Realistically, I know it was the medication numbing the pain, but getting outside still did me a world of good. I’m proud of myself for managing to do it, since these migraines usually leave me quite incapacitated.\n\n​🏵️ *El sol calentó bastante y hacía calor. Sudé, en parte por eso y en parte por el ejercicio de la caminata. Tuve esa sensación de cuando tienes fiebre y sudas, y sientes que la fiebre se va por los poros de la piel. Tuve la sensación de \

la migraña. En realidad, sé que fue el medicamento el que alivió el dolor, pero aún así sé que salir me hizo bien, y me siento orgullosa de mí misma por haber podido hacerlo, ya que la mayoría del tiempo estas migrañas me incapacitan bastante.*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRxwfqubvQgVgSUwdcYNGbCbWcwbRe2TeDnjjEjbMPXpv/1776622097581.jpg)


​🌼 Now, after lunch, it's time to rest with my kitten. My brain feels a bit dizzy and fuzzy, but I can still make the most of what’s left of the day and enjoy it despite the rough start.

​🏵️ *Ahora, después de la comida, es hora de descansar con mi gatita. Mi cerebro está algo mareado y adormecido, pero aún puedo aprovechar lo que queda de este día y disfrutarlo a pesar de lo malo.*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmb6VRWfkA1NLQLDuWipWD2aaZji5VcuzyxPNrhtzQVY/1776622113388.jpg)


​🌼I hope you also manage to do at least one activity today that your body needs, something that brings you satisfaction or joy—whether it's going for a walk or taking a good nap. Happy Sunday and a great start to the week for everyone tomorrow! ✨🍃

​🏵️ *Espero que ustedes también hagan hoy al menos una actividad que su cuerpo necesite, que les cause satisfacción o alegría, sea salir a caminar o echar una buena siesta. Feliz domingo y buen inicio de semana para todos mañana.*✨🍃


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTrGAi8sbsu8GmQRhprYzko2MdY1eoxutCJGp5mXAMy4A/1776622160115.jpg)
