body.title: Putting Out Fires Right and Left - April 17, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
[//]: # (CCC LINKS PLACEHOLDER, DON'T DELETE THIS TAG)
![Post writing supervisor crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EonkURk7YX2vCXy6k8i3xLojzoe9EHjQHzS4oUqEkEBaUvhEbWXU3yj6pvvYKa8bJRp.jpg)

*Post writing supervisor*

On Friday morning, I was awakened at 4AM by a furball on my bed. Mind you, I had just put up the screen door, and it still had the cookie sheet. Because of the weight of the cookie sheet, the door would not stay shut, swinging open the instant it was released. So when I went to bed at 9PM, I KNOW I hooked it on the inside.

With the cookie sheet still on it, there’s no way he banged on it to open it without me being woken up. So how did the door open? Well, I tend to chalk it up with the other unexplainable events over the last 6 years.

So I tossed him out and hooked the door and tried to go back to sleep. I gave up around 5:30AM. I got up and got my post up. Next I tightened the hook on the screen door. Then I did the milk order. I found a message that the service for my husband’s cell phone hadn’t been paid even though I had put the new credit card number on. So I had to go through the rigmarole of getting that sorted. One fire out. 

The plant lights on the back porch were on when I was awoken at 4AM. (I had just checked them the day before…) So I went around and made sure they were all set correctly. Second fire out.

I went out to get started on the gardens and discovered I’d managed to bend the blade on my new anvil cutters so I had to fix that. I spent about ½ hr on it. Third fire out.

I try to remember to take before photos and I got side tracked because so many things had burst due to the high heat on Thursday.  I ended up taking about 90 photos…

![MacIntosh - comfrey before crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EoEqRmd4UqPGuham2TYGWZqcXKJFz8dDQ2JkcCVeLXZWcGvnQmA8VUTB5bY1cPpykXi.jpg)

*MacIntosh comfrey, before*

I finally got started on the comfrey at 9AM and got it cleaned out and put FlowerTone on it. It has buds from the heat. I forgot the after photo.

![East lilacs - before-after collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eqd9zgUTiWjefe2czem9p8F24GGgiYBbSDomjjWLKWgg3HWgnJEj2qNkhXAF14hvrkQ.jpg)

I started East lilacs at 10AM. They hadn’t been pruned last year so it kept me busy. I got the wood chip mulch raked back around them and cleaned up. It had started to drizzle so I quickly got my photos and notes and went inside around 11:30AM.

![Lemon verbena plants crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EonkVPzUuBHrsyNfhG8SF3TtgLuh213nWJ9jS7FUAvZf2GuBajwJnipmMupMxWiTiAL.jpg)

Last year I had gotten a catalog from a new-to-me company and ordered 2 plants: lemon verbena and ‘Attar of Rose’ geranium. They arrived and I got 2 lemon verbena. I didn’t mind having 2, but I really wanted the geranium as mine of nearly 20 years had died last year. So I had to deal with that. Fourth fire contained.

With the windows open I kept hearing what I thought was birds in the gutters. When I went outside, I discovered starlings had managed to get under the soffit and were building a nest.

So I called the contractor and asked if he could come fix the soffit sooner than later. He called around noon and said he’d come but it would be in the evening. Fifth fire contained.

![Seedlings - moving out collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23y94V7t2eLGAkKVdEr6kSXMVGQKzydyLXLPVenTyJxgT5ZvoGH1rjUpBe4iouSvbz3ef.jpg)

My #3 helper arrived at 12:30PM and we went to the cellar to fill the quart jars for the foliar feeding. We were moving 20 or so trays to the cold frame, and they all needed fed.

Then we took a tray out and I showed her how to level the trays so when they are watered from the bottom, the food stays in the tray. I’ve quite a collection of sticks and stones for this purpose. She did a really good job.

So next we had to get the hot water hose out and turn on the hot water to the outside. I temper the water temperature for the seedlings as they’ve had enough of a shock going outside.

Once the hose was hooked up and the hot water made it to the end of the hose, I showed her how to mix up 5 gallon pails of food and how to administer it to the trays.

When she had finished feeding them, I was heading to the house so I said I’d shut off the hot water. Neither of us had touched it since turning it on. She’d filled 3 – 5 of the 5 gallon buckets. But when I got there, it was off… I double checked, but yup, it WAS off…

Well, that was the 2nd unexplained thing of the day. I think someone was messing with me, as he does periodically…

![Mesclun haircuts collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyVMPN3GHo5DFShq5yR586z4VmEc16Tm1wMPUb9VHnn1Yzf8d9NLhPTXf9EXFgB3Wry.jpg)

While she had been moving seedlings and so forth, I had been giving both mesclun trays a hair cut before they went out to the cold frame.

![Free kindling collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23zbUC4HNQkGjXaFbSznMTLtioAYYYQhDAhnmLFLvQ3VPH8u7YEmnmgMqikdrea8H34wV.jpg)

About this time, my son left to walk to work and went passed the new house on our road. He sent me the photo of the scrap pile. It was perfect for kindling, which I am in dire need of. So I messaged my #1 intern to ask if she could get the wood with me in the truck. She said she could. Sixth fire contained.

![South - daffs going by crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EnYSMgEvRtCvR7esCkxhxvsxNmRSc89FHuifMdpd3utTvDdGGeDc5jZLiQReWXDoxUT.jpg)

My brother came home and I was talking with him about 6:45PM and my #1 intern hadn’t come home. I mentioned I was waiting for her to get the wood. He said he’d go with me to get it. So he went up to get the truck, and I spent the time I was waiting to deadhead the daffodils. Both south gardens had the early ones that had gone by in the heat.

As I was tossing the deadheads in the bushes, I looked up to see why my brother hadn’t come yet. The truck hood was up and his car was butted up to it. So I walked up because he probably needed me to start the truck while he revved up his little car. So we did that and got it started. Seventh fire out.

The pile didn’t look that big but it filled the bed of the full sized truck and was heaped high. We brought it around by the bulkhead behind the house and managed to get my raggedy tarp on it so it would blow off. Eighth fire out.

![Removing the bird's nest collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpvkHkZkf3ftezSRe8s7XP2XkSyKxjBn5UQxY5kaWoSHAf2NkYHqtgoTTavDciwbdvH.jpg)

While we were messing around with the tarp and baling twine, my contractor arrived and pulled the nest out. I didn’t get a photo. Then he managed to get the corner firmly in place, but right next to it the soffit could easily be lifted up 4” – 5”. He tried to use wire to make it stay down, but it didn’t hold. He asked for duct tape and I still had a roll of white from fixing the window shades, so he taped it down as far up as he could reach. Ninth fire out.

![What was left collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23wquFPjnSxovLvm1zNGuQiQQukNhzqziHd5xPxiyfKYTrNgoy5eSG34dWJzfMRMksXqV.jpg)

By the time he left it was 8PM. (Remember my day had started at 4AM…) I made some supper and sat down for a while. But my left hip starting really hurting. I took some meds, but it didn’t help. I got the dishwasher loaded so I’d not have to do it in the morning. I took a heavy duty muscle relaxer and it finally kicked in around 11PM.

One heck of a long day and I had 20 trays of seedlings to start on Saturday.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

body.title: LOH185 // They Are My Purpose
body.body:
Right now, if I think about what truly keeps me going, it’s my family especially my kids. Honestly, they are the main reason I get out of bed every day and keep moving forward. I mean, there are days when life feels overwhelming, and I wonder how I’ll make it through. But when I look at my kids, it’s like everything just clicks. I don’t have a choice but to keep going, because they depend on me, and that alone gives me purpose.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQfwMVMLJ8CHcvAQarPLwGksr8BFDJw4LeeHZ8rPZ4CgF/1776621731174.png)


[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/nutshell-security-insecurity-2122598/)

Being a mother is one of the most exhausting, beautiful, and humbling experiences I’ve ever had. Some days, I feel like I’m failing at everything, from work to household stuff to even finding time for myself. But the moment my kids call me, laugh at me or give me a hug, it reminds me that I’m doing something right. They’re my constant reminder of what’s important and what truly matters. Everything else work stress, personal doubts, it all fades into the background when I see their faces because it gives me the purpose.

And when I think about my purpose right now, I’d say it’s all about them. It’s about being the best mother I can be, even on the days when I feel like I’m barely holding it together. I want to teach them how to be kind, how to face challenges with a positive mindset, and how to never give up, no matter what life throws at them. Of course, there are days when I wonder if I’m doing enough, or if I’m messing them up in some way. But I think that’s just part of the motherhood journey, trying, failing, learning, and trying again.

Sometimes, it’s the little things that make me feel like my purpose is clear. The way my youngest pronouns the new words she just learn or the way her brother wants to talk to me about their day. Those moments make everything else feel insignificant. It’s like the weight of the world can be heavy, but in those simple, precious moments with my family, life feels light.

What keeps me moving forward each day isn’t some big dream or some grand goal, it’s them. It’s knowing that my kids need me. And when I get tired or frustrated, I remind myself that I’m shaping their world, even when I feel like I’m just barely hanging on to mine. I know that the effort I put in now will make a difference later. Even if it’s hard to see in the moment, I trust that everything I’m doing for them will matter in the long run.

There’s also something about being there for them that pushes me to do better for myself, too. I don’t want to just be a good mother, I want to be a person they can look up to. It’s not always easy, and sometimes I wish I could hit pause on the chaos and just breathe. But in the midst of the madness, my family is my anchor. They are the reason I keep going, even when it feels impossible.

So, for now, my purpose is all wrapped up in them. It is about showing up for my family, even when I feel drained. It is about being the best version of myself for them. And that’s enough to keep me moving forward, day after day.





**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

body.title: El susurro de la paz: Un encuentro inolvidable en San Jaime // The whisper of peace: An unforgettable encounter in San Jaime
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNggqVkf8gDMA3E8WKBhkMv9R4MKa9ojLQxzwBZsRjbEm/1776620900016.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfCnfzcgaRYZ5GmRUhEcGmYSrCqZyaRQmefPZy5z5TFR5/1776621085304.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbz7vuoRfoyVvNE55tcpW7CnfpZo3uBXCJ1te8xfmLJXe/1776621120159.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmceTgE3aeL2MagAsW8raSXBJhTJWwZmfLXXiFnTfBStWd/1776621571501.jpg)


─── ·🍃· ───  🍀  ─── ·🍃· ───

Español

A veces, la vida nos lleva por caminos inesperados para permitirnos abrazar la calma y reencontrarnos con nosotros mismos en el silencio. Recientemente, tuve la dicha de visitar la Vía de San Jaime, en Maturín, Estado Monagas. Al llegar, sentí de inmediato cómo el ruido del mundo exterior se desvanecía para dar paso a una tranquilidad vibrante y llena de vida.

Al contemplar este paisaje, me invadió una profunda gratitud. Más que un jardín bien cuidado, era la armonía del entorno lo que me cautivó: la textura del camino de piedra bajo mis pies, el suave susurro de las palmeras con la brisa y esa luz natural que baña cada rincón con una calidez esperanzadora. Este lugar de ensueño me recordó que la verdadera felicidad reside en nuestra capacidad de admirar la perfección que la naturaleza nos obsequia generosamente.

\

Fue un momento de conexión pura; un respiro necesario para el alma que quise inmortalizar a través de mi lente. Comparto esta fotografía con ustedes esperando que esa misma serenidad que sentí al capturarla pueda llegar a sus corazones.


─── ·🍃· ───  🍀  ─── ·🍃· ───

English

Sometimes, life takes us through unexpected paths to allow us to embrace the calm and rediscover ourselves in the silence. Recently, I had the joy of visiting Vía de San Jaime in Maturín, Monagas State. Upon arrival, I immediately felt the noise of the outside world fade away, making room for a vibrant tranquility full of life.

While gazing at this landscape, I was overcome with deep gratitude. More than just a well-kept garden, it was the harmony of the surroundings that captivated me: the texture of the stone path beneath my feet, the gentle whisper of the palm trees in the breeze, and that natural light bathing every corner with a hopeful warmth. This dreamlike place reminded me that true happiness lies in our ability to admire the perfection that nature generously bestows upon us.

\

It was a moment of pure connection—a necessary breath of fresh air for the soul that I wanted to immortalize through my lens. I share this photograph with you, hoping that the same serenity I felt while capturing it can reach your hearts.



─── ·🍃· ───  🍀  ─── ·🍃· ───

Ubicación / Location: Vía de San Jaime, Maturín, Venezuela.

***

火山是自然界中最为壮观和神秘的现象之一。它们代表着地球内部强大的力量，喷发时能释放出巨大的能量和熔岩，改变周围的地形和生态。每当我想起火山，便会感受到一丝敬畏与惊叹，同时也意识到自然的不可预知与人类渺小。火山的美与毁灭交织，提醒我们珍惜生命与保护环境。

body.body:

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kawa-i-kredki/23wC3FrbkHoYEukyp3xAXN46cg3hYiuhF1SUMNMaW2SjuXEHWhJd7PtpK8L9esHso1nkp.png)

 
 ## 🏆 **And the winners are...!** 🏆

Without further ado, here are the results for this week’s **Hive Art Gallery** contest! It was a spectacular round, but one artist truly stole the show.

Huge congratulations to **Bonanzell**, who took 1st and 2nd place! It was a well-deserved victory, and your talent continues to blow us away. 🎨✨

Thank you to everyone who participated. We can’t wait to see what you create next! Keep the inspiration flowing and join us for the next round of artistic fun.
 


# The winners

 🥇 **1st place**:

 **@bananzell** -  [Day 1: Rainboots](https://hive.blog/hive-158694/@bananzell/day-1-rainboots) - 6 pts - prize:  **20% of the post's earnings** + **300 Ecency Points**  

![](https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmbAx3hrHcmatgQp2pdmRrUyLGv1yW4oWcb9NzSwEbudkr/messenger_creation_c392371b_fc53_4b91_a350_d27a96b963bd.jpeg)
 
 
This charming mixed-media piece successfully captures a cozy, whimsical atmosphere through its \

aesthetic and clever use of layering. Despite the initial struggle with brush sizes and watercolor blending, the transition to colored pencils was a brilliant pivot, providing the rich texture and necessary definition to make the yellow boots pop against the more fluid, blotchy background. The organic, improvisational approach to the greenery feels natural rather than cluttered, and the highlights from the white acrylic marker add a vital touch of \

shine that ties the rainboot theme together beautifully. Overall, it’s a vibrant and technically resourceful execution of the prompt that balances detail with a lovely, painterly spontaneity.

 
  🥈 **2nd places**:
  
 **@bananzell** -  [Day 6: Bubblesds](https://hive.blog/hive-158694/@bananzell/day-6-bubbles) - 2 pts - prize:  **15% of the post's earnings** + **150 Ecency Points**  
 
![](https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmS8PW12FqYHSZj2VZfSWJKo9VzbaBCKeMsozdtYDAvTpw/messenger_creation_48f2ef06_04fa_44a7_a924_4c35088987d5.jpeg) 

 This piece is a vibrant testament to artistic perseverance, showcasing a stunning depth of color achieved through the careful layering of watercolor and colored pencils. The contrast between the fiery, luminous orange of the goldfish and the deep, textured blues of the water creates a powerful focal point that immediately draws the eye. While the artist expressed some frustration with the initial watercolor opacity, the transition to pencils allowed for a beautiful, tactile grain that enhances the underwater atmosphere. The white acrylic marker highlights are particularly effective, giving the fins a delicate, translucent quality and making the bubbles shimmer with life. It is a technically impressive work that successfully balances rich saturation with a sense of fluid movement.



 
 **@promzy23** -  [The Reader's Refuge](https://hive.blog/hive-174301/@promzy23/the-reader-s-refuge) -  2 pts - prize:  **15% of the post's earnings** + **150 Ecency Points**    

![](https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmeBujnxsu5eGVWLhWY55TgK7CdiVhYUtcDnuZccPmQuav/1775834555922.jpg)

This striking pencil sketch masterfully uses contrast and texture to convey a profound sense of \

and peaceful isolation. By utilizing a 12B pencil, the artist achieves a rich, deep tonality in the shadows of the tree and the figure’s back, which anchors the composition and provides a sense of physical weight. The varied mark-making—ranging from the sharp, vertical lines in the background to the aggressive, expressive scribbles of the foliage—creates a dynamic environment that feels alive yet secondary to the stillness of the reader. It is a powerful exploration of solitude, where the guardian-like tree and the fading world of lines beautifully frame the intimate act of discovery within a book. --- ## **Congratulations to the winners!** 🎉 Remember, the contest is ongoing! Tomorrow, we’ll publish a post showcasing this week’s submissions. Join the **YAF - Young Art Fair Community** and support our project! body.title: Coastal Encounters: Living Alongside the Cuban Curly-Tailed Lizard [EN/ES]
body.body:
## Coastal Encounters: Living Alongside the Cuban Curly-Tailed Lizard
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ3w6rhCZhcp9caB7VkBoyHzmGmA2GV2SuGmzfNcbvEfX/screenshot_20260419_134758_01.jpg)

---

Working in a hotel near the coast in Cuba means you don’t just see the sea — you also share the space with wildlife in unexpected ways.

One of the most common visitors are these small reptiles, locally known as *caguayos* or “perritas de costa”, scientifically identified as **Leiocephalus carinatus**.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVFCtvEschYEWpLnmpbUnYNLKwEfr87q71ZomAZ6gdw45/screenshot_20260419_130238_01.jpg)

---

They are fast, alert, and naturally cautious. Getting close enough for a photo isn’t always easy. In this case, I had to move slowly and patiently, avoiding sudden movements until it felt safe enough to stay.

What surprised me is how much they tolerate human presence.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUdVuXW9Xj18H5VDjpP6Sk7nUyUyDtfPVrBAsPVzsz1ad/screenshot_20260419_134832_01.jpg)

---

There is a small park area near my workplace where employees usually take short breaks. The benches are simple, improvised with hollow concrete blocks and wooden planks. It’s a quiet place to drink coffee and rest for a moment.

And yet, it’s not only ours.

These lizards move freely around the area, climbing, stopping, observing. In this shot, it remained still for a few seconds, almost blending with the texture of the wood.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeigm6M9MKHAyeKP1tQ5hwnBeAkFLBnUmaNgMHG9wdNTs/screenshot_20260419_134743_01.jpg)

---

Over time, it becomes clear that they have adapted to us. Not completely, not domesticated — but aware. They keep their distance, but not as much as you would expect from a wild animal.

It feels like a silent coexistence.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY27wmhdcz1hh88FF1jwZTEN5S1LjdPRTJkZ3zYkby6Lh/screenshot_20260419_134707_01.jpg)

---

Moments like this remind me that even in spaces shaped by humans, nature doesn’t disappear — it simply adjusts, observes, and continues.

---

>Photos taken by me  
Cuba
Google Translate

---
## En Español
---

## Encuentros en la costa: conviviendo con el caguayo cubano
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ3w6rhCZhcp9caB7VkBoyHzmGmA2GV2SuGmzfNcbvEfX/screenshot_20260419_134758_01.jpg)

---

Trabajar en un hotel cerca de la costa en Cuba significa que no solo ves el mar — también compartes el espacio con la vida silvestre de formas inesperadas.

Uno de los visitantes más comunes son estos pequeños reptiles, conocidos localmente como *caguayos* o “perritas de costa”, identificados científicamente como **Leiocephalus carinatus**.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVFCtvEschYEWpLnmpbUnYNLKwEfr87q71ZomAZ6gdw45/screenshot_20260419_130238_01.jpg)

---

Son rápidos, atentos y naturalmente cautelosos. Acercarse lo suficiente para tomar una foto no siempre es fácil. En este caso, tuve que moverme despacio y con paciencia, evitando movimientos bruscos hasta que se sintiera lo suficientemente seguro como para quedarse.

Lo que más me sorprendió es cuánto toleran la presencia humana.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUdVuXW9Xj18H5VDjpP6Sk7nUyUyDtfPVrBAsPVzsz1ad/screenshot_20260419_134832_01.jpg)

---


Cerca de mi área de trabajo hay un pequeño parque donde los empleados suelen tomar breves descansos. Los bancos son simples, improvisados con bloques de hormigón huecos y tablas de madera. Es un lugar tranquilo para tomar un café y desconectar unos minutos.

Y, sin embargo, no es un espacio solo nuestro.

Estos lagartos se mueven libremente por el área, suben, se detienen, observan. En esta toma, permaneció quieto por unos segundos, casi mimetizándose con la textura de la madera.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeigm6M9MKHAyeKP1tQ5hwnBeAkFLBnUmaNgMHG9wdNTs/screenshot_20260419_134743_01.jpg)

---

Con el tiempo, se hace evidente que se han adaptado a nosotros. No completamente, no domesticados — pero sí conscientes. Mantienen su distancia, aunque no tanta como cabría esperar de un animal salvaje.

Se siente como una convivencia silenciosa.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY27wmhdcz1hh88FF1jwZTEN5S1LjdPRTJkZ3zYkby6Lh/screenshot_20260419_134707_01.jpg)

---


Momentos como este me recuerdan que incluso en espacios moldeados por el ser humano, la naturaleza no desaparece — simplemente se ajusta, observa y continúa.

---

>Fotos tomadas por mí  
Cuba

body.title: Telegram Tap-to-Earn is Dead… So What’s Next?
body.body: />Hey everyone! 👋 Last years we all witnessed the insane Telegram crypto boom — remember those tap-to-earn games? From Notcoin to Hamster Kombat and dozens of others. Everyone was frantically tapping their screens hoping to turn a few minutes a day into hundreds of dollars. Some projects exploded overnight… and most disappeared just as fast. Notcoin actually delivered — many people made anywhere from dozens to hundreds of dollars by doing almost nothing. But the vast majority of the copycats turned out to be pure scams. They hyped up the game, drained attention and sometimes money, dumped their worthless token, and vanished into the sunset. After that whole circus ended, I thought the space would finally calm down and we’d start seeing more serious, actually interesting Telegram crypto projects. But so far… my search has come up pretty empty. I’ll be honest — I didn’t dig super deep, just did some casual scrolling. That’s why I’m turning to you, the smart Hive/Ecency community! What promising Telegram-based crypto projects are you watching right now? I’m genuinely curious from a “research” point of view — I’m not looking to invest money, just exploring how this mini-economy inside Telegram is evolving. If you want to share: >

>Drop the project name
Tell us why you like it (or why you’re skeptical)
What are your expectations from it?

Links are probably not allowed here, so just the name + your thoughts will be perfect. Looking forward to your recommendations! 🔥 P.S. Salute to all the tap-to-earn survivors out there 😄

> We will start our trip in Prague with a truly genre photo, because many trips start at the train station :-).

Although @actifit-godfish liked or bought tickets for another adventure, he offered us a rarely available view of the Main Station from the Deloitte terrace. The photo won a prize for participating in the competition.
[ ![actifit-godfish49-6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bucipuci/EqUdsxU4eshfPbiycYQZuvuoKzLYdHCmiWexepDg5sYzYcpagRgU9wCwRK3ci4hZpCk.jpeg) ](https://peakd.com/hive-193552/@actifit-godfish/actifit-actifit-godfish-20260415t203919130z)
---

>\nDruhou zastávku si uděláme na místě, které už málem neexistovalo. @wahaceggy nás pozval do zahrady zámku Jezeří. Zámek unikl zániku jen o vlásek. Stojí nad bývalým velkodolem na hnědé uhlí a velkorypadla se zastavila 500 m od zámku. Fotografie získala druhou cenu.\n

> We will make our second stop at a place that almost no longer existed. @wahaceggy invited us to the garden of Jezeří Castle. The castle narrowly escaped extinction. It stands above a former large brown coal mine and large excavators stopped 500 m from the castle. The photo won second prize.
[ ![wahaceggy49-6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bucipuci/EpxpJFUrJKrWpSehkg4rKYCDGeVG9sozw54nVMhowwri6s5wMYpq4m1hvdGL2Fb3Zk7.jpeg) ](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@wahaceggy/the-chateau-of-jezeri-encz)
---
>\nZnovu se podíváme do indického města Varanasi. @ansoe nás tentokrát pozval do přístavu Namo Ghat na řece Ganga. Moderní pojetí posvátného místa na posvátné řece. Fotografie získal třetí cenu.\n

> We'll take a look at the city of Varanasi (India) again. This time @ansoe invited us to the Namo Ghat port on the Ganges River. A modern take on a sacred place on a sacred river. The photograph won third prize.
[ ![ansoe49-6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bucipuci/EpzzDTa9upHw8q7sga3jBjkR741vLHxgH1HgkU77txx8e4WTRqg6n64H2gz7C76Nbdh.jpg) ](https://peakd.com/hive-125125/@ansoe/my-entry-for-around-the-6a41fe931549a)
---

>\nPokud pravidelně sledujete naši soutěž, možná se vám vybaví v paměti denní fotografie Bazyliky Mariacke v polském Krakově. @cezary-io tentokrát fotil v nočním osvětlení. Velmi působivé. Vypadá to, jakoby z věže baziliky shlížela dolů samotná Madona. Fotografie získala první cenu.\n

> If you regularly follow our competition, you might remember the daytime photos of St. Mary's Basilica in Krakow, Poland. This time @cezary-io took photos in nighttime lighting. Very impressive. It looks as if the Madonna herself is looking down from the tower of the basilica. The photograph won first prize.
[ ![cezary-io49-6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bucipuci/23u5vrwHA94gJqr4b3jQuC8SzEiqggCs7bL7JyfNddjERqzGLhQV4rJ7iomRr8MQ62xwP.jpeg) ](https://peakd.com/hive-193552/@cezary-io/actifit-cezary-io-20260412t201510895z)
---

>\nTo si takhle jedete na kole z výletu, snažíte se dostat přes frekventovanou silnici po lávce a najednou zůstanete stát v obdivu nad prostým západem slunce :-). Přesně to se stalo @lukee66f v Brně – Maloměřicích (jižní Morava). Z obyčejné lávky pro pěší se tak stalo atraktivní místo pro sledování :-). Fotografie získala speciální cenu s právem účasti na doplňkové soutěži o nejlepší fotografii měsíce dubna.\n

> This is how you ride your bike from a trip, try to cross a busy road on a footbridge and suddenly stop in admiration of a simple sunset :-). That's exactly what happened to @lukee66f in Brno - Maloměřice (South Moravia). An ordinary pedestrian footbridge has become an attractive place to watch :-). The photograph won a special prize with the right to participate in the additional competition for the best photo of the month of April.
[ ![lukee66f49-6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bucipuci/EpQtqv9ik9b2G94QoVx7DSKvhPwK8vcneBE1MCAX2qF3xgzSYqDcCgi9RyfzT3qeeTP.jpg) ](https://peakd.com/hive-125125/@lukee66f/cestou-necestou-lom-hady-on)
---

>\nNa poslední zastávku zůstaneme ještě v Brně. @hairyfairy využil zajímavé slevy na návštěvu Moravského muzea na hradě Špilberk. Nabídl nám pohled na jeden z exponátů, fragment gotického ostění okna. Fotografie získala třetí cenu.\n

> We will stay in Brno for the last stop. @hairyfairy took advantage of an interesting discount on a visit to the Moravian Museum at Špilberk Castle. He offered us a look at one of the exhibits, a fragment of a Gothic window frame. The photo won third prize.
[ ![hairyfairy49-6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bucipuci/23uQkSDRQTiFJ6rZHBfu4TED3EaXS3UZ777KtPFEfkrTUz9payjUQE7r87KzKwfZHDqPV.jpeg) ](https://peakd.com/hive-184437/@hairyfairy/tip-for-tourists-the-card-brnopas)

<div class=\
><div class=\

> Greetings, Hive Gaming community! I hope you're all having a great day. Today we continue with the second chapter of our adventure in *The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past*. After successfully rescuing Princess Zelda from the castle dungeons, our mission was to get her to a safe place. To be honest, navigating the secret passages of the castle with the princess following close behind felt much more intense than I remembered. Our immediate goal was to reach the Sanctuary, a place where the dark influence of the wizard Agahnim couldn't easily reach us. # The escape through the secret tunnels was quite interesting. We had to push heavy ornamental blocks to reveal hidden stairs and move through sewers filled with rats and bats. Using the lamp was crucial here, as many areas were completely shrouded in shadow. After a bit of puzzle-solving and lever-pulling, we finally emerged inside the Sanctuary. The Monk greeted us with relief and promised to keep Zelda safe while we began our quest to stop the evil growing in Hyrule. This was a pivotal moment in the story, as it set the stage for everything to come. # Once Zelda was safe, the Monk explained that to defeat Agahnim, we would first need a legendary weapon: the Master Sword. However, to prove ourselves worthy of wielding it, we must first obtain the three Pendants of Virtue. My first destination was Kakariko Village to seek out the elder, Sahasrahla. Exploring the village was a nice change of pace from the damp castle basements. I spent some time talking to the locals and exploring the houses. It was during this exploration that I made a couple of vital discoveries. First, I found a Bug-Catching Net, and shortly after, I got my hands on a Glass Bottle, which will be incredibly useful for storing potions or fairies in the future. # After gathering information in the village, the path led me towards the Eastern Palace. On the way, I finally met Sahasrahla near the entrance of the temple. He gave me some valuable advice and, more importantly, handed over the Pegasus Boots. This item is a total game-changer, allowing Link to dash at high speeds and break through certain obstacles. With the boots in my possession and the elder's blessing, I am now ready to face the challenges inside the first palace and claim the Pendant of Courage. Thank you very much for reading my publication! I'll see you in the next chapter as we dive into the first dungeon.
><div class=\

> ¡Saludos, comunidad de Hive Gaming! Espero que todos estén teniendo un excelente día. Hoy continuamos con el segundo capítulo de nuestra aventura en *The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past*. Después de rescatar con éxito a la princesa Zelda de las mazmorras del castillo, nuestra misión era llevarla a un lugar seguro. Para ser honesto, navegar por los pasajes secretos del castillo con la princesa siguiéndome de cerca se sintió mucho más intenso de lo que recordaba. Nuestro objetivo inmediato era llegar al Santuario, un lugar donde la oscura influencia del mago Agahnim no pudiera alcanzarnos fácilmente. # El escape a través de los túneles secretos fue bastante interesante. Tuvimos que empujar pesados bloques ornamentales para revelar escaleras ocultas y movernos por alcantarillas llenas de ratas y murciélagos. El uso de la lámpara fue crucial aquí, ya que muchas zonas estaban completamente envueltas en sombras. Tras un poco de resolución de acertijos y mover algunas palancas, finalmente emergimos dentro del Santuario. El Monje nos recibió con alivio y prometió mantener a Zelda a salvo mientras comenzábamos nuestra búsqueda para detener el mal que crece en Hyrule. Este fue un momento crucial en la historia, ya que preparó el escenario para todo lo que vendrá. # Una vez que Zelda estuvo a salvo, el Monje explicó que para derrotar a Agahnim, primero necesitaríamos un arma legendaria: la Espada Maestra. Sin embargo, para demostrar que somos dignos de empuñarla, primero debemos obtener los tres Colgantes de la Virtud. Mi primer destino fue la Aldea Kakariko para buscar al anciano, Sahasrahla. Explorar la aldea fue un buen cambio de ritmo tras los húmedos sótanos del castillo. Pasé un tiempo hablando con los lugareños y explorando las casas. Fue durante esta exploración cuando hice un par de descubrimientos vitales. Primero, encontré un Cazamariposas y, poco después, puse mis manos en una Botella de Vidrio, que será increíblemente útil para guardar pociones o hadas en el futuro. # Después de reunir información en la aldea, el camino me llevó hacia el Palacio del Este. En el trayecto, finalmente me encontré con Sahasrahla cerca de la entrada del templo. Me dio algunos consejos valiosos y, lo más importante, me entregó las Botas de Pegaso. Este objeto cambia totalmente el juego, permitiendo a Link correr a altas velocidades y atravesar ciertos obstáculos. Con las botas en mi poder y la bendición del anciano, ahora estoy listo para enfrentar los desafíos dentro del primer palacio y reclamar el Colgante del Valor. ¡Muchas gracias por leer mi publicación! Nos vemos en el próximo capítulo mientras nos adentramos en la primera mazmorra. ------ ---- |

description.title: When my mother-in-law and stepdaughter cook together they always make masterpieces!/ Cuando mi suegra y mi hijastra cocinan juntas, ¡siempre preparan auténticas obras maestras!
description.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXCCfZE8wbXtMhCGoe33aLCuNAVED6UViNF7uby23tNwF/1776619165454.jpg)

Happy Sunday, blog friends, how are you? Today we spent a family Sunday with my stepdaughter and my mother-in-law. With everyone's busy schedule, it's hard to get together except during the holidays, but today we managed it. It was a beautiful day, so we went to visit my mother-in-law. She cooks beautifully, but I can tell you, my stepdaughter is also very good in the kitchen. In fact, today my husband and I were guests because my stepdaughter and my mother-in-law cooked together. My mother-in-law cooked the pasta (pasta is now a must on Sundays, at least here in Italy), and my stepdaughter took care of the sauce.

Using my mother-in-law's tomato sauce (she makes it at home and is very good at it, she always has large supplies), she prepared a pasta dish with cream, mozzarella, and grated parmesan cheese. She crushed an egg to make the crust and baked it with our help. She was very good at it, and the result was a delicious, stringy baked pasta dish, even though, as always, the portions were really generous.


> Feliz domingo, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? Hoy pasamos un domingo en familia con mi hijastra y mi suegra. Con la agenda tan apretada de todos, es difícil reunirse excepto en días festivos, pero hoy lo logramos. Hacía un día precioso, así que fuimos a visitar a mi suegra. Ella cocina de maravilla, pero les aseguro que mi hijastra también se desenvuelve muy bien en la cocina. De hecho, hoy mi esposo y yo fuimos invitados porque mi hijastra y mi suegra cocinaron juntas. Mi suegra preparó la pasta (la pasta es imprescindible los domingos, al menos aquí en Italia), y mi hijastra se encargó de la salsa.

> Con la salsa de tomate de mi suegra (que prepara en casa y le sale de maravilla, siempre tiene mucha), preparó un plato de pasta con crema, mozzarella y queso parmesano rallado. Batió un huevo para hacer la masa y la horneó con nuestra ayuda. Le salió de maravilla, y el resultado fue una pasta al horno deliciosa y con una textura elástica, aunque, como siempre, las raciones eran muy generosas.

title.title: Happy with my new progress in the game Splinterlands
title.body: > Well well, I’ve been advancing in the game at a fast pace since I bought some level 2 cards. That made me move super quick in the Bronze league, which got me to the next medal fast. Here I noticed more challenge with Archons at level 5 in some cases, though most were still level 1. In the new leagues I found more rules. I’d say it’s almost impossible to repeat the same rules in another fight—each one is unique. Learning names and states will take me some time to memorize.
> I also bought some cards for my Death Archon, which was level 1. Since I didn’t have much capital, I could only buy a few.

> I also started getting some Frontier collection chests to keep earning more cards. That way I can have better ones, though for now I haven’t gotten any from my favorite elements—only from ones I never use.

> I’m also taking advantage of every victory to stack rewards. In the card lottery I haven’t won yet, but every card gets stored in my account for when I decide to use another element. Even though I used some potion items I got for advancing in leagues, I didn’t get any gold or better cards. I guess luck is something I still don’t have 😀

> Last season I finished in the SILVER league, which was super exciting. Even with everything I bought, I still have a long way to go to compete in higher leagues against players with really strong cards. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSsa3aEiMgiTU2tZHKAvk9LVAAcXg3a8eebP1SrxhtgDU/screenshot_10.png) Also I discovered you can delegate the cards thanks to @bhattg with his card I won a battle

> So I think I’ll stick to the strategy of looking in the market for the cards I want to level up. It’s the best and fastest way to grow. I could buy chests, but since rewards are random, it’s slower to build up the power of my deck. --- ### 🎨 Gallery Banner

title.title: You have seen many red Ixora flowers, have you seen this white flower?
title.body: I hope everyone is well! Red Ixora flowers are often seen around us. They bloom in bunches at the gate of someone's house or on the roadside. But these white Ixora flowers are not usually seen that much. One afternoon on 17/04/2026, while passing in front of the tree, I was completely overwhelmed by the softness of white. I immediately took out my phone from my pocket and took picture.
/> Introduction to this flower: Bengali name: White Rangan/ শ্বেত রঙ্গন English name: White Ixora Scientific name: Ixora finlaysoniana

/> When the white petals peek out from the crowd of green leaves, it looks very magical. While taking the picture, I saw that there was also a red rose flower in the background, but the dim light made the white flowers in the front look even more dazzling.
/> The young buds along with the flowers also look wonderful. I was smelling a very sweet smell while taking the picture. In fact, these simple things in nature bring peace to our minds.

/>

After taking the picture up close, it seemed as if each petal was perfectly crafted by an artist. Let me know how you like this hobby of mine!

All the pictures are taken by me. The pictures were taken on 17/04/2026. The size of the picture has been reduced through compression. And it has been lightly cropped.

All content owner 100% @mshbd Natore-Bangladesh🇧🇩

title.title: Concurso. Observa Piensa Escribe.  Para variar, el caucho
title.body:
> ​ # Para variar, el caucho ​ # Un mal día nadie lo quiere, pero lamentablemente sucede y cuando menos te lo esperas ese momento cuando estás apurado para llegar a un lugar y el tiempo no te rinde para completar de repente te vas a subir al carro y justo **lo que faltaba**, un caucho espichado. Es que en ese instante inevitablemente pronuncias una palabrota porque además de estar bajo una pepa de sol tienes que cambiar el caucho y eso que también puede ser en medio de una lluvia; y aunque dicen que hasta esos malos ratos hay que agradecer que pasen, créanme que humanamente cuesta mucho estar tranquilo y ver un poco el lado positivo de una situación como esa. El problema de un caucho espichado no es solo cambiarlo y listo, sino que con eso viene un gasto adicional porque debes mandarlo a reparar, ya que es muy inseguro andar así sin caucho de repuesto ante este tipo de desafortunada eventualidad. Pero bueno así es la vida real llena de tantas cosas que ni te imaginas vivir tan solo en un día; al final si se cumple ese dicho que todo pasa, resuelves y sigues para adelante, es cierto que la actitud que tengas ayuda muchísimo entonces si te descargas con decir una grosería hazlo, pero lo importante es no quedarte pegado en ese mal momento que si no pasas la página te dañará el resto del día. Hoy puede ser un caucho y en otro momento algo distinto, no lo esperabas, pero que puedes hacer más que resolver lo que se pueda hacer solo, sino pedir ayuda porque más puedes perder. ​ # ​ ​Te invito a participar: [\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\*\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\*Concurso. title.title: Who is the Better Elowen Sylphie Player?
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeLoZi8viZXAT9XNym4ADC1ffoCchz9NQicyLxaow2Ah1/Cover.PNG 
Counterspell Modifier is one of those Modifier that just makes magic units feel bad to use right away. The moment you see it, you already know melee and range units will be more common in the battle. Because of that, abilities that interact with melee and range damage become more important and you start building around them instead. This modifier is a battle of wits where it tests how good you are without the help of magic damage units.

# Modifiers

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf4F3KQwXmzYD6KwQR6VBfo6m4WnekTBpJdFztvKGJBRe/counterspell_60.jpg </center>
Counterspell - All units receive the Magic Reflect ability at the start of the battle. Enemy units that attack with magic receive damage back.
Counterspell modifier gives Magic Reflect that returns a portion of the damage back to the magic attacker. This means you would most likely use less units with magic damage since there's a disadvantage when using those. The use of melee and range units gets more benefit and preparing for these are better.

# Good Abilities to use in Counterspell Modifier

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ1R8ZyQB2KJFmu4n2KA4f2YcdPtM9mf1SPyaaYvzj4Ah/shield.png </center>
Shield - Reduced damage from Melee and Ranged attacks
Shield is very strong in Counterspell Modifier because most players avoid magic damage. This means they go for melee and range attacks which Shield can reduce by half. Having Shield on your front unit makes it very hard for enemy units to break through your defense. It gives you more time to deal damage while your tank just stays alive longer.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdAcP4uDJNjASU2rvfdSsSviTPQVREQDgtRXBeVjXEk6Y/thorns.png </center>
Thorns - When hit with a Melee attack, does damage back to the attacker
Thorns becomes very scary in this Modifier because melee units are everywhere. Every time they attack, they take damage back which slowly kills them. This is very strong especially if the enemy relies on full melee team. It creates a situation where attacking feels like a punishment for them which is really fun to watch.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUBGcKuL7vrV8cw26kvMQBnDH9hc7yjCvdipE9Jn3HCie/sneak.png </center>
Sneak - Targets the last Unit on the enemy Team instead of the first Unit
Units with Sneak, Opportunity or Charge is better since this gives your melee units more flexibility. You can use them with different positions even if they are melee units.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTRQ5WhzQ63baSQwotD2czx1xnLsi6h8t2bVQaoYP9FXT/amplify.png </center>
Amplify - Increases Magic Reflect, Return Fire, and Thorns damage to all enemy units by 1
Amplify is a bit situational in Counterspell Modifier but it can still work. It increases the Magic Reflect damage which punishes enemy units even more if they still use magic. Some players ignore the risk and still go magic so this ability can surprise them. It is not always useful but when it works, it feels really strong and satisfying.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdGAWZPd7zhGfqCCRXxXpyEMMSQ3rbZkxRuoZbZkcDecg/void.png </center>
Void - Reduced damage from Magic attacks
Void is the only reason you might still consider using magic units in this Modifier. Since the reflected damage is still magic damage, Void can reduce it. This makes your units survive longer compared to normal magic units. It is still risky to use magic but with Void, you at least have some protection and can make it work in some situations.

# Battle Summary

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY7d3WKQizP1kTJwyyrZwG5hHoMt7JJM5Gem4yUvdnHrH/Battle.PNG 
This has been day 5 of me using Elowen Sylphie and I finally found someone using the same archon and strategy. I like that they also know the secret of using Resurgence on a Scavenger unit like Endless Ape. This was a very interesting battle since I really thought I would've win and that I had the advantage. The difference of positioning with Lioceros made a huge difference. My units getting hurt by the Thorns and my Lioceros getting destroyed by Thorns and 4 Resurgence in total hurt my team a lot. At the same time, I never expected to see a similar lineup so I never expected someone not using any melee Sneak unit or having a similar lineup so I guess that's fair. If the enemy was using a different lineup or strategy, I would've won this battle easy.


To see the full battle, you can click this link:
https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_65c7e7df67b8c374ea526562dda8f85a

Counterspell Modifier is simple but very punishing and forces players to adjust their strategy. It makes magic units risky and pushes players to use melee and range units more. In my experience, it creates very fun battles because you need to think more about your choices. If you adapt well, you can easily win but if not, you might end up killing your own units.











Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@aiko2ne1/who-is-the-better-elowen-sylphie-player-3vu)

title.title: A Beginner's guide to reading the Bible//mcgi Topic review
title.body:
https://youtu.be/pTf6AJVuhB8?si=IEtK8bOc_bhg6t0c

When you read the Bible, don’t just read it casually—take time to meditate and seek understanding with the help of God’s Spirit.

I recommend starting with the New Testament because we are now under the new covenant. Begin from books like Gospel of Matthew through to Book of Revelation. After that, go back and read from Book of Genesis to Book of Malachi.

The reason for this approach is that reading the New Testament first helps you better understand the Old Testament. Studying the Bible is not about rushing—it requires time, reflection, and deep meditation. Even though I can read quickly, I realized that true understanding came when I slowed down and reflected on what I read.

As you study, don’t just read—seek God’s guidance through His Spirit so you can truly grasp the message. When you read the New Testament, you’ll notice that many teachings are based on writings from the Old Testament.

For example, when Paul the Apostle says “it is written,” or when Jesus Christ uses the same phrase, they are referring to earlier scriptures. Likewise, when Matthew the Apostle writes, he often points back to prophets like Isaiah and Malachi.

By reading this way, you will discover how the New Testament is rooted in the Old Testament, giving you a deeper understanding of the Bible as a whole. This is why starting with the New Testament can be more insightful and rewarding.

Thanks for reading.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Nearly **1 in 10 U.S. births** in 2023 were to mothers in the country illegally or in mixed-status situations that would be affected if birthright citizenship gets narrowed. That’s the headline number: **320,000 out of 3.6 million births**. The article’s real point isn’t just the number — it’s that this has become a live legal and political fight again, not some dusty immigration debate from 10 years ago.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The breakdown matters. The piece says **245,000** of those births were to parents who were both in the country illegally. Another **15,000** involved mothers with temporary legal status and fathers who were neither citizens nor lawful permanent residents. The remaining **60,000** were births to illegal-immigrant mothers where the father was a citizen or lawful permanent resident. Same 320,000 total, but very different family/legal situations inside that number.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The trend is what gives the story teeth. The article says this is the **highest total since 2010**, when the figure was **325,000**, and that the number has now **risen for 3 straight years**. So the claim here isn’t “this exists” — everyone knows it exists. The claim is that it’s growing again and may be hitting a political pressure point at exactly the moment the courts are weighing the issue.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The article leans hard into the conservative case against the current interpretation of birthright citizenship. It quotes Heritage Foundation’s Brandy Perez Carbaugh arguing that children born under current policy can unlock access to public benefits and that taxpayers are covering costs through things like labor, delivery, and some prenatal care. That framing is blunt on purpose: the piece is presenting this as a policy loophole being exploited, not as a humanitarian or constitutional gray area.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body:
5/5 🧵 The legal backdrop is the whole engine here. The article ties the data to **President Trump’s executive order** aimed at ending or limiting automatic birthright citizenship, now being challenged before the **Supreme Court**. So the story is really doing 2 things at once: citing fresh data and using it to argue the stakes in that case just got bigger. Whether you agree or not, that’s the battlefield: **numbers, costs, and the 14th Amendment**. 📎 Source

title.title: Is economic stability possible in today's geo-political climate...?
title.body:
Chasing “stability” by sticking to strict fiscal rules feels extremely out of touch with today’s unpredictable world.

But sticking to those fiscal rules was the basis of Rachel Reeves's most recent spring Statement. She promised that the government would keep borrowing down but one has to wonder whether this is going to be possible in this world of ever increasing market uncertainty?


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23u64tYDFdUSWFZeJF2GTW9XxXNu46eoGhKKyTMgR1BsYu3daYCkve5xATtt96TrqhdKm.png)


### What’s the Price of This Stability?

Supporters claim fiscal discipline wins trust. Spend carefully, avoid big borrowing, and markets stay calm. Interest rates behave, and the economy gets a boost.

But that only works if the global picture is steady, but now we're in the era of a largely Trump-lead perpetual global shock-system. 

The Office for Budget Responsibility itself admits the UK could get hit hard by external shocks.

And global instability won't disappear just because the government keeps its books tidy. If energy prices soar, someone pays. If the state refuses to borrow more, that cost simply lands on households and businesses.

### Then There’s Growth—Or Lack of It

Another big flaw in Rachel Reeve's plan is that growth remains sluggish, widely forecast to be crawling at 1.5% a year, while taxes could rise past 38% of GDP by the end of the decade. 

Whereas stability depends on real, lasting growth. 

Ironically the government hopes the private sector will drive growth, yet the government's economic policies to date are stifling them. 

### Final thoughts...

People want stability after years of chaos, but not all forms of stability work.

If stability depends on geo-political calm, that’s not real stability. That’s just hope.

title.title: Hills, fields & peace 🌿
title.body:
Greetings lovely members of the community. I hope you all are doing great and enjoying quality time with your loved ones.

>समुदाय के प्यारे सदस्यों को नमस्कार। मुझे आशा है कि आप सभी अच्छे होंगे और अपने प्रियजनों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय का आनंद ले रहे है।



Today I’m sharing a few pictures from a potato farm I visited a few days ago. I didn’t take a lot of photos at the time, but I did capture a few moments that felt worth keeping, and I thought I’d share them here.

>आज मैं कुछ तस्वीरें साझा कर रही हूँ उस आलू के खेत की, जहाँ मैं कुछ दिन पहले गई थी। मैंने वहाँ बहुत ज़्यादा तस्वीरें तो नहीं लीं, लेकिन जितनी भी लीं, वो पल अपने आप में खास लगे, इसलिए सोचा उन्हें आप सबके साथ साझा करूँ।


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTaJoSoFKW3uiUBfD5Nz1Zmn1sZS2bkhe3JBd1suPGMvs/img_2797.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeTQv8wLfLUaZhvtKa4aqvdGY4D219UFVomjF6mabX9V7/img_2798.jpg)


The farm is located on a hilltop, which makes the whole place feel open and peaceful. Right in the middle of the farm, there was a man-made pond, neatly enclosed with railings.You could clearly see the reflections of the nearby trees on its surface, almost like a mirror. It added a very calm and soothing feel to the surroundings.

>यह खेत एक पहाड़ी की चोटी पर स्थित है, जिससे पूरा माहौल खुला और शांत महसूस होता है। खेत के बीचों-बीच एक छोटा सा कृत्रिम तालाब बना हुआ था, जिसे रेलिंग से घेरा गया था। जिसमें आसपास के पेड़ों की परछाइयाँ साफ दिखाई दे रही थीं। वह दृश्य बहुत सुकून देने वाला था।

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcm7hLPYF6VLVjyELFC1VRDWWN95AQ2c6Nm5c4icbrw7e/img_2799.jpg)


It was sometime in the late afternoon, around two hours before sunset. The light was soft and gentle, not too bright, which made everything look even more beautiful. The fields around showed patches of land where potatoes had probably been sown.

>यह समय शाम होने से लगभग दो घंटे पहले का था। धूप हल्की और नरम थी, जो पूरे माहौल को और भी खूबसूरत बना रही थी। खेत में कुछ जगहों पर ज़मीन साफ दिख रही थी, जहाँ शायद आलू बोए गए थे। 

The view from there was honestly the best part. Straight ahead, the landscape opened up beautifully. To the right, there was a dense forest, deep and rich in greenery. To the left, you could see layers of hills stretching into the distance, one behind the other, fading slightly as they went farther.

>वहाँ से दिखने वाला दृश्य सच में बहुत सुंदर था। सामने की ओर खुला हुआ नज़ारा था, जो दूर तक फैला हुआ था। दाईं तरफ घना जंगल था, हरियाली से भरा हुआ, और बाईं तरफ पहाड़ों की परतें एक के पीछे एक दूर तक जाती हुई दिख रही थीं।

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRZUKuwkv5RsJqN4e26Jcu4H2Zfikc8KJn7UqiqXx4Yh5/img_2800.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdBUm1FymLoiJbvuxFtH5sjBF87PotgcUSMs23wf9KY1e/img_2801.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRiLQ45un1hvrVCPmoPkK17bgBDrdK7m1RC6YB1cSxxKr/img_2802.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaRFCb42891DWjHF3inAkzmAHW8TyQSwYHVhpqxfWZD72/img_2803.jpg)

There were a few other people there as well, quietly walking around, looking at the pond or just enjoying the scenery. They seemed like visitors or tourists, drawn to the calmness and the view, just like I was.

>वहाँ कुछ और लोग भी मौजूद थे, जो तालाब के पास खड़े होकर या इधर-उधर घूमते हुए इस जगह का आनंद ले रहे थे। शायद वे भी मेरी तरह इस शांत और सुंदर माहौल की ओर खिंचे चले आए थे।

That's all for today folks. Happy snapping. 💜💙

Thankyou for visiting 🌸

title.title: A Journey to Seulawah RG Nature Tourism, a Place That Presents Natural Beauty with Complete Facilities
title.body:
----
Not far from Banda Aceh City, there is a natural tourist destination that is very suitable for a hangout spot with views that spoil the eyes, the place is called *Seulawah RG Nature Tourism*
----

![IMG-20260419-WA0028.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYjxgQ5DBAw3RgraXH2qG4C8FVPHKeoaBiwzdDfX2hcoJ/IMG-20260419-WA0028.jpg)

<div class=\

>

Good evening, my friends, wherever you are. I hope you are all healthy and happy, allowing you to carry out your daily activities as usual. I hope you all have a pleasant day.

In this blog, I want to share some images and my experience visiting a relatively new natural tourist destination, located in the prosperous village of Blang Bintang, Aceh Besar.

The destination is Seulawah RG Nature Tourism.

So, please continue to follow my blog to see this place through the images I will share later, along with short articles from me.

![IMG-20260419-WA0010.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTBzhyPdoigPS9Bo2JehqJvkcujuCEVbvAQREyEeL2Dnq/IMG-20260419-WA0010.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXJgy2KhyYGjikUfKGLkBjhkqNriwi8kDVHuqqxVfUgng/IMG-20260419-WA0009.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0015.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNq3SD15FjmJuGLucFTgSjMJ1ugn3fVa8pUBXs3qdbAx9/IMG-20260419-WA0015.jpg)

This place is located in Makmur Village, Blang Bintang District, Aceh Besar Regency.
In my personal experience, getting there from Banda Aceh City takes about 40 minutes by motorcycle.

Upon arrival, I immediately saw a welcome banner, and then we had to navigate a 500-meter-long alley with a rough road.

My friends...
This tourist destination is quite complete with general facilities and is also strategically located. However, it's a bit of a shame that the road leading to it is not yet fully developed.

![IMG-20260419-WA0012.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR9VPzpKR8D1AtJtAuzWzG99XohmVAnpsZScqh48nttpv/IMG-20260419-WA0012.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0011.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc2goKQ1quBLayedFgNGgbpZCRwyLuysdUww8ZWwoN699/IMG-20260419-WA0011.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf1t1uGwgCAeyDP9EAfdX37CkDLBzci4h7EpnLWGBnsKH/IMG-20260419-WA0008.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTx4mesiJJH6AkYgCpS9r9b9gqJ2boZaMdkFfQx4eCGrx/IMG-20260419-WA0006.jpg)

From a distance, I had seen the tourist destination which really attracted my attention. Besides that, on the way to the place, the road which was not adequate also presented a view that was pleasing to the eye, where along the road the view of the residents' plantations and hills decorated our eyes.

![IMG-20260419-WA0013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbGiJf5EUSJ6qhcXdbwdUDD2QwCqEKcNui8o6gqr4WjrA/IMG-20260419-WA0013.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0014.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXNZkPdgVndUTTh9u2p2N7JUhRQZz3PphtySWRjpEpp6X/IMG-20260419-WA0014.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXurfTupvMovhSod18NJXvNto1UwARMnjmRffh4NkYhty/IMG-20260419-WA0007.jpg)

Upon arriving at the tourist destination, I immediately took some pictures.

After briefly exploring the place, I can conclude that it offers villas, a VIP cafe, a coffee shop with a variety of food and snacks, and even a camping ground.

What caught my attention was one of the main gardens, which features a building shaped like a LOVE in striking colors. This spot is a popular spot for visitors to take photos.

![IMG-20260419-WA0019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdFRprG3TFzabSdcVRPWT6nmLowsSGymEnLJ8aDU9SWLC/IMG-20260419-WA0019.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0021.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSuSjDntq3LoQrSwQNLu2QMtauT79AJQS8VCMD4tb1Fs1/IMG-20260419-WA0021.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0025.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbY7A8mqDcfrcUET57uYaRExmpEX1sATKwHWNSoTVtTKm/IMG-20260419-WA0025.jpg)

Then, my friends and I decided to approach and take a closer look at the main building, which boasts striking colors.

This striking building also houses a VIP Villa, available for rent for visitors who wish to spend the night at the Seulawah RG Nature Tourism Destination.

![IMG-20260419-WA0022.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXtjL554hYN3SsGvKHgomP1u9fEpBnZ1XeAbvtM8uZ79B/IMG-20260419-WA0022.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0016.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdggqGHsXeYJ1f3QBm4W8PCBnJUK3cFnQktbvq6Lct3Me/IMG-20260419-WA0016.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0018.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfVNzX3iFdG1BjYkv3c4JwSasg4qAHnA3tQgC41DDx8Gq/IMG-20260419-WA0018.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0026.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVEj8GyWw935Jb45Fn7jHjMhA92rykFt2ksg2tiYZ5Swr/IMG-20260419-WA0026.jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0020.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbGkpjke2B8jLC5y3xdSFgoz2U3pxJiFB1qEH1Za2oddA/IMG-20260419-WA0020.jpg)

This striking building also houses a karaoke room, which was already reserved by other guests. To reserve a spot, you'll need to take a queue number to secure a time slot.

The VIP Villa area is also a popular photo spot, thanks to its striking colors and design and the stunning views.

![IMG-20260419-WA0024(1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcvffQAeGsyUaVi7WyEQAfrAwM3w2Xr98b8Rqs5ozK9ZV/IMG-20260419-WA0024(1).jpg)

![IMG-20260419-WA0023.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWS83doojXfaA3KnPH4jYBeLYSxuBv85LHs9cspG51A/IMG-20260419-WA0023.jpg)

This is the view we can glimpse from the VIP Villa area, offering a comfortable view of the rolling hills, with the occasional gentle breeze.

Typically, as the sun begins to set, this area is crowded with visitors capturing the beautiful sunset.

![IMG-20260419-WA0017~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdG4T6E2oZhmDNrndEe3A28XbZcSRiS8QyZyy9fMeb4Lu/IMG-20260419-WA0017~2.jpg)

![IMG-20260324-WA0140.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP7qAjbvmiriKb2kT4f6s8Wgmmz8qfyMwb1eGVcxVWide/IMG-20260324-WA0140.jpg)

![IMG-20260324-WA0136.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbYBca9PXgEYyrFR5kRkEuaA8J3oqpDFcZkFvva4wcSbQ/IMG-20260324-WA0136.jpg)

Alright, my friends, those are some pictures and my brief experience of the Seulawah RG Nature Tourism destination, which I visited a few days ago with my friends.

I hope you all enjoyed and enjoyed what I've shared in this blog. Thank you very much to all of you who took the time to view and read my blog to the end.

Please leave your comments, support, and input, which means a lot to me so I can create a better blog in the future. Stay tuned for my next blog about the places I'll explore.

That's all for now.
Greetings, everyone.
See you in my next blog.

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 19 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/DF3CBC73-2A1A-4DD6-B3D7-97AA797CFB2F1776619643.286292) The last night on the road was a bit loud. A group of teenagers had gathered at the parking spot. Talking, laughing, cars arriving with music turned up too high. Nothing that really bothered me. Until the end. One last moment of emphasis. A firecracker. Loud enough to cut through everything. I’m not sure what it was meant to say. This morning I woke up tired. Not fully rested. I made coffee and walked once more through the monastery park. A quiet round before leaving. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/DF3CBC73-2A1A-4DD6-B3D7-97AA797CFB2F1776619693.3961291) Then I drove. Slowly. Almost reluctantly. For the last hundred kilometers I took several breaks, as if there was no need to arrive too quickly. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/DF3CBC73-2A1A-4DD6-B3D7-97AA797CFB2F1776620392.9403129) Around one in the afternoon I reached home. A different kind of arrival. Familiar. Everyone was there. Even the cat stayed close, following me from room to room, as if making sure I wouldn’t leave again. After lunch we went for a short walk to the lake. Nothing special. Just back again.

title.title: Traffic Rider – Realistic Bike Racing Ka Ultimate Highway Experience 🔥
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776619905591-81c12fecb8b47363.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=soulmist/cc637ede)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=soulmist/cc637ede)


---

if you are a fan of racing games traffic rider is one such game that gives you the full experience of realistic bike riding with simple gameplay i tried this game myself and honestly it turned out to be quite addictive

traffic rider is essentially a motorcycle racing game where you drive the bike from a first person view which makes it different from other racing games its strongest point is that you feel as if you are riding on the road at high speeds in the game you have to dodge between cars and trucks on busy highways without crashing

the career mode of the game is also quite interesting with 90 plus missions that progressively challenge you you earn coins with each mission you complete which can be used to unlock new bikes there are over 30 bikes available in the game and each bike has different speed and handling

i personally liked its graphics and sound the most real engine sounds of the bikes have been used which makes the experience more realistic there are also day and night modes which keep the gameplay from getting boring

the gameplay is simple but not easy dodging traffic at high speeds is quite challenging and even a small mistake can result in a crash which makes the game more thrilling its controls are smooth and you can control the bike using either tilt or buttons

yes there are some drawbacks like ads appear occasionally and some players have also complained about lag or bugs

overall if you want a racing game that is lightweight plays offline and feels realistic then traffic rider is definitely a must try despite being simple the game is very engaging and will not let you get bored for long

title.title: Hard Truck Parking Truck Games
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776619905552-263ebfde1b28e82c.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=fearline/055c502a)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=fearline/055c502a)


---

i downloaded hard truck parking truck games just to pass the time but when i played it i realized that it is not a simple parking game but a very challenging and skill based game the first thing i noticed was its realistic feel the game main focus is parking the truck in tight and difficult spaces. Where even the slightest mistake results in a level failure therefore concentration is essential in every level the game controls are a bit sensitive but once you get used to them it becomes fun the steering brakes and camera angles are very helpful making parking easier viewing the truck from different angles allows for proper judgment.

The levels are also quite varied some are easy but as you progress the difficulty increases and the obstacles become more and more interesting making the game interesting the graphics are decent though not as high quality but the environments and truck designs feel realistic especially when parking with a trailer the game becomes even more challenging now lets address a few negatives sometimes the ads in the game feel too heavy and in some levels the truck controls feel a bit awkward where the truck moves too quickly even at slight acceleration.

Overall if you like truck driving and parking games this game is worth trying it is not just a time passer but offers a proper skill based experience you can improve both your driving and control.

title.title: Ultimate Stunt Racing Experience with Crazy Tracks
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776619911869-6a8387711e9b447c.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=salmanmadni/1d8b7482)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=salmanmadni/1d8b7482)


---

if you like racing games but are bored with simple racing then stunt car extreme is a great option i have played this game myself and honestly it is not just racing but a complete stunt experience where skill is equally important along with speed
the strongest point of the game is its gameplay here you do not just race but jump on dangerous ramps do flips and complete tricky tracks with balance the tracks are very interestingly designed some are easy which are perfect for beginners and some are so difficult that you will take multiple attempts this difficulty progression makes the game engaging and keeps you from getting bored

The game also offers different modes such as daily challenges where you beat other players scores and cups mode where you compete in multiple races the most unique feature is the endless mode where missions continue and you can test your skills the variety of cars is also impressive you will find everything from sports cars to off road vehicles and monster trucks customization options are also available allowing you to upgrade your car with paint engines and tires.

The graphics are colorful and smooth making gameplay even more fun the controls are simple but mastering them is a bit challenging which makes the game addictive if there are any drawbacks sometimes the levels start to repeat or the difficulty feels a bit high but the overall experience is quite solid.

title.title: Which is the real sabbath?
title.body:
https://youtu.be/QvnDw4NG_hg?si=gEkQ8fpE4Ij1G2I8

In the new testament it is another day. It is not the seventh day. Maybe, we all have heard that the sabbath is the seventh day. But the truth in the Bible is God appointed to Christian another day, not the seventh day. Let us read the book of Hebrews chapter 4, this is what the apostle Paul is explaining to the original Sabbath keepers, the Hebrews. 

The Hebrews are the original Sabbath keepers.
And apostle Paul is saying that the sabbath for christians is not the sabbath that was taught by Joshua and Moses to the Israelites. Let us read Hebrew 4:8. 

God had spoken of another day not the sabbath that Joshua and Moses implemented among the Israelites. That's why the Bible tells us, the apostle Paul explaining to the original Sabbath keepers, the Hebrews, that God had spoken of another day, not the seventh day sabbath.

In fact, the Lord Jesus Christ did not observe the seventh day sabbath. The Lord Jesus Christ did not keep the seventh day sabbath of the Jews, that's why the Jews wanted to kill him. But the Jews did not understand the scripture that there really is an end, an end to the seventh day sabbath, because it was preordained by God that the covenant of the sabbath and covenant of Moses shall end in a particular period of time.

The observation of sabbath, new moons, are not anymore in existence when the time of the Lord Jesus Christ came. Let us read Hebrew 7: 12. When the Lord Jesus Christ assumed the priesthood, there was a necessity for a change also in the law.

There is a time of reformation. And the time is the time of the Lord Jesus Christ. Even the law of ten percent or tithing is gone in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. When the Bible tells us that the law of Moses is not anymore existing, it was changed by the law of Jesus Christ.

Thanks for reading.

title.title: Entre el burnout y el equilibrio [ESP-ENG]
title.body: >\n\n​Saludos, gente! Creo que en los casi cinco años que llevo en Hive, nunca había pasado tanto tiempo en silencio. Siempre intento dejar registro de mis vivencias para mi \

, pero esta vez, el universo simplemente me obligó a soltar el ritmo.

​Si les dije que las semanas anteriores pasaron volando, estas han sido lo opuesto: lentas, densas y cargadas de pendientes personales que postergué durante demasiado tiempo. Llegó ese punto crítico donde la pausa ya no era una opción, sino una necesidad de supervivencia. 

Aunque mentalmente sentía que podía seguir, mi cuerpo empezó a enviar señales que ya no podía ignorar. Me vi ante una encrucijada: o me tomaba unos días para mí, o me hundía definitivamente en la oscuridad del burnout.

>Hello, everyone! I don’t think I’ve ever gone this long without posting in the nearly five years I’ve been on Hive. I always try to document my experiences for my “future self,” but this time, the universe simply forced me to slow down.

>If I told you that the previous weeks flew by, these have been the opposite: slow, heavy, and filled with personal tasks I’d put off for far too long. I reached that critical point where taking a break was no longer an option, but a necessity for survival. 

>Although mentally I felt I could keep going, my body started sending signals I could no longer ignore. I found myself at a crossroads: either I took a few days for myself, or I would sink definitively into the darkness of burnout.

***

![1001245668.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/242Cnt2pUPf1nugzTikG1cGc9MGxTz8NRFzhWzesexyYSWA7coBaNCSSHxVNkPRRtenYG.jpg)

***

​Casualmente, este mes he estado viendo una serie que seguro muchos conocen (The Pitt), y me hizo reflexionar sobre algo vital: los médicos solemos creer que tenemos todo bajo control. La realidad es que ignoramos el agotamiento o, peor aún, desarrollamos una capacidad magistral para enmascararlo.

​Esa máscara nos sirve para engañar al mundo. Seguimos siendo funcionales, sociales y productivos, pero por dentro, el vaso lleva años llenándose y solo falta una gota para que todo se desborde. Llegamos a casa y, en lugar de desconectar, seguimos respondiendo mensajes, estudiando casos, terminando historias médicas o revisando actualizaciones en redes sociales. En mi caso, incluso mis momentos de ocio estaban invadidos por la medicina. Es como si el hospital nunca se quedara en la puerta.
​
Por eso decidí alejarme. Fue un acto de responsabilidad propia y para con quienes dependen de mí. Entendí que, precisamente por esa habilidad que tenemos para ocultar el cansancio, somos nosotros los únicos responsables de identificar cuándo es estrictamente necesario poner un \

a la vida.

>Coincidentally, this month I’ve been watching a show that I’m sure many of you are familiar with (The Pitt), and it got me thinking about something crucial: as doctors, we tend to believe we have everything under control. The reality is that we ignore our exhaustion—or, worse yet, we develop a masterful ability to mask it.

>That mask helps us deceive the world. We remain functional, social, and productive, but inside, the glass has been filling up for years, and it only takes one more drop for everything to overflow. We get home, and instead of unplugging, we keep answering messages, studying cases, finishing medical records, or checking updates on social media. In my case, even my leisure time was invaded by medicine. It’s as if the hospital never stayed at the door.
​
>That’s why I decided to step away. It was an act of responsibility toward myself and toward those who depend on me. I understood that, precisely because of this ability we have to hide our exhaustion, we are the only ones responsible for identifying when it is absolutely necessary to hit “pause” on life.

***

![1001245667.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/EpxoRTZfZZhtnNQBD7hkcJdSNTrvy9yU977ksfLw88tjvPd51eR6Dah9SUcBEmhS3zB.jpg)

***

​Durante estos días, mi prioridad fue el silencio mental. No hice nada que requiriera esfuerzo intelectual; me refugié en la música, el descanso, mis propias evaluaciones de salud y en cuidar de mi perrita, que también ha estado delicada.

​En ese proceso de \

, pero haciendo mucho, me di cuenta de algo revelador: por mucho tiempo estuve corriendo para huir de un peligro que me acechaba, pero estas semanas me sirvieron para notar que ese peligro ya no me seguía. Era yo, por pura costumbre, quien seguía huyendo de una sombra que ya se había disipado. Sé que tal ve esto que digo podría no tener mucho sentido para ustedes. Véanlo como si mi psique estaba tan colapsada, que incluso veía un peligro que en realidad había dejado de existír desde hace muchísimo tiempo. Estaba tan enfocada en trabajar y en sobrevivir que nunca volteé hacía atrás de nuevo. >During this time, my priority was mental silence. I didn’t do anything that required intellectual effort; I took refuge in music, rest, my own health check-ins, and caring for my dog, who has also been unwell. >In that process of “doing nothing,” yet accomplishing so much, I realized something revealing: for a long time, I had been running to escape a danger that was stalking me, but these past few weeks helped me realize that danger was no longer following me. It was I, out of sheer habit, who kept running from a shadow that had already dissipated. >I know that what I’m saying might not make much sense to you. Think of it as if my psyche was so overwhelmed that I was still seeing a danger that had actually ceased to exist a very long time ago. I was so focused on working and surviving that I never looked back again. *** ![1001245666.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/244KCgvp3Fmm7hNtWiX5v4dP9PyrS51c9RWZQedYgixuzndsdCczTsi7LVUKu6JrhG95b.jpg) *** ​Hoy, dos semanas después, estoy aquí intentando redescubrir el balance entre mi vocación y mi vida personal. Todavía no logro encajar del todo el blog en esta nueva rutina, porque la vida últimamente ha exigido mucho de mí y sigo buscando el equilibrio. ​Por ahora, seguiré asomándome por aquí cuando el peso de los días se sienta más ligero. He seguido con mis rituales de arteterapia, organizando mi Bullet Journal y tratando de mantenerme saludable, aunque todavía no he tenido la claridad mental para escribir sobre ello con detalle. ​Pronto, cuando me sienta más recuperada, pasaré nuevamente para dejarles actualizaciones más profundas de este proceso, por ahora les dejo algunas fotografías que he tomado en una de mis salidas a realizar evaluaciones domiciliarias. Mientras tanto les agradezco por esperarme, por comprenderme y, sobre todo, por estar ahí al otro lado de la pantalla, aunque tal vez lo que diga no tenga mucho sentido para ustedes. ¡Les agradezco por pasar y leerme! 🫂💖 >Today, two weeks later, I’m here trying to rediscover the balance between my calling and my personal life. I still haven’t quite managed to fit the blog into this new routine, because life has been demanding a lot from me lately and I’m still searching for that balance. >For now, I’ll keep popping in here when the weight of the days feels a little lighter. I’ve kept up with my art therapy rituals, organizing my Bullet Journal, and trying to stay healthy, though I haven’t yet had the mental clarity to write about it in detail. >Soon, when I feel more recovered, I’ll stop by again to share more in-depth updates on this process. For now, I’m leaving you with some photos I took during one of my home visit assessments. >In the meantime, I thank you for waiting for me, for understanding me, and, above all, for being there on the other side of the screen, even if what I say might not make much sense to you. >Thank you for stopping by and reading! 🫂💖 *** ![1001245669.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/244o3JRwpBesvVKaMzQxVmMvZLVyd7m25XYEFvc89qrQQ3LgWs7WLWKKCLLuAywnL6PWc.jpg) *** ***
