title.title: MLB: Genio y humildad  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
title.body:
No a todas las personas les gusta reconocer en otros a un genio. Esto es algo más ligado a las inseguridades propias que a los verdaderos talentos de otros. Como quiera que sea, si alguien es un genio en su campo, pero además ese genio va acompañado de una humildad sincera, estamos ante una gran persona. Y eso quedó en evidencia en la entrevista pospartido del día de ayer, realizada al campo corto venezolano Brayan Roccio en el Progressive Field, luego de la victoria de 4 carreras a 2 de los Guardianes de Cleveland ante los Orioles de Baltimore. Brayan intentaba dar el crédito del triunfo a su compañero abridor del partido, cuando la insistencia del entrevistador, le obligó hablar de su enorme contribución. Al final de todo, el juego se trata de anotar carreras y el box score dejó claro, quien fue el héroe en la victoria. Si usted no vio a Brayan Roccio en la alineación abridora del clásico mundial de béisbol por Venezuela, fue porque el caraqueño decidió honrar sus raíces ascendentes, siendo el titular del campo corto en el equipo italiano. Y ¿Qué hizo de extraordinario en el juego? #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Not everyone likes to give a phenom his flowers. Usually, that’s more about personal insecurities than the actual tools someone else is flashing. But look, when you’ve got a guy who’s an absolute stud on the field and stays humble off it, you’re looking at a class act. That was on full display yesterday during the post-game interview with Venezuelan shortstop Brayan Roccio at Progressive Field, right after the Guardians downed the Orioles 4-2. Brayan was trying to pass the torch and credit his starting pitcher for the W, but the reporter kept pressing until he had no choice but to talk about his own clutch performance. At the end of the day, the game is about crossing the plate, and the box score didn’t lie about who the hero was. If you didn’t see Roccio in the starting lineup for Venezuela in the WBC, it’s because the Caracas native chose to honor his heritage, taking over the 6-spot for Team Italy. So, what kind of web gems or big flies did he pull off in this one?

---
![Brayan Roccio.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23uQkLXjTtqWUDQzDrZa9nHkfqZYQhF1JfZFDh1ZgUxGB91zdykXGCouqvvMRSyv5heuV.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/orioles-vs-guardians/2026/04/18/824451/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Sábado de una tarde nubosa en Cleveland, los visitantes oropéndolas se encontraban arriba en el marcador por 1 carrera a 0. Con hombres en primera y tercera en la parte baja de la quinta entrada y dos outs en la pizarra, le toca el turno a Brayan Roccio. El abridor naranja Dean Kremer había estado intraficable ponchando a 7 compañeros del venezolano, además puso en cuenta de 2 y 2 el comprometido turno, sólo para equivocarse y dejar una recta de 4 costuras a 94 MPH en la zona de poder. Roccio no vaciló en hacer swing de gradas y mandó a volar la pelota por encima de la cerca del jardín derecho, para hacer explotar en una sonora ovación al público, la cual imaginamos se escuchó hasta en el museo del salón la fama del Rock and Roll que se encuentra en la misma calle donde está emplazado el estadio. El triunfo significó el afianzamiento del liderazgo en la cima de la división central de la liga Americana para los Guardianes, mientras que la derrota alejó a los oropéndolas al tercer lugar de la división este de la misma liga. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      Cloudy Saturday afternoon in Cleveland, and the O's were holding onto a slim 1-0 lead. Bottom of the fifth, runners on the corners, two outs, and Brayan Roccio steps up to the dish. The Baltimore starter, Dean Kremer, had been shoving all day, racking up 7 Ks against the Venezuelan's teammates. He got Roccio into a tight 2-2 count, only to hang a 94 MPH four-seamer right in the nitro zone. Roccio didn’t hesitate—he took a mighty hack and parked that ball over the right-field wall. The crowd went absolutely wild; you could probably hear the roar all the way down the street at the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. That W solidified the Guardians' spot at the top of the AL Central, while the L pushed the Orioles back to third place in the AL East.

# ---

![Marquez.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/243zi28dzK7zo3AaoFJ6KwAF8xCnrbv8Ln1yaWtoe1tGszRKfFKfbwxgYqxtfPV3N6xnZ.jpg) Screenshot from [Source](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/padres-vs-angels/2026/04/18/824049/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     ¿El abridor venezolano Germán Márquez está de vuelta? No lo sabemos. Todavía es muy temprana la temporada para asegurarlo. Pero sí podemos decir que el hombre ha dejado atrás su problemas de control en los envíos. Y la mejor evidencia de ello fue tener bajo dominio a la peligrosísima toletería de los Angelinos de Los Ángeles, quienes venían de arrollar a los Yankees en Nueva York. El ex-abridor de los Rockies le ha sentado bien la ciudad de San Diego y ayer lanzó primores al home plate, logrando cinco episodios y dos tercios sin permitir anotaciones, regaló dos boletos y guillotinó a 5 oponentes para llevarse la victoria. Mason Miller se encargó del noveno ponchando a dos para su séptimo salvado, manteniendo su cadena de anotaciones no permitidas y ponchando a 25 en los 10 episodios y un tercio de labor en lo que va de zafra. Con el triunfo, los religiosos retoman la persecución de los Dodgers en el segundo lugar de la división oeste de la liga Nacional y la derrota estaciona a los serafines a medio juego del liderazgo en el oeste de la Americana. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Is Venezuelan starter Germán Márquez officially back? It’s too early in the campaign to call it, but the man has definitely found his command again. He completely shut down a high-powered Angels lineup that had just finished bruising the Yankees in the Bronx. The former Rockies ace looks comfortable in San Diego; yesterday he was dealing, tossing 5.2 scoreless frames, giving up just two free passes and racking up 5 punch-outs to earn the W. Fireballer Mason Miller came in to slam the door in the ninth, fanning two for his seventh save. Miller’s still rocking a clean sheet (zero ERA) with 25 Ks in just 10.1 innings of work this year. With the win, the Friars are back to chasing the Dodgers for second place in the NL West, while the Halos fall to a half-game back from the lead in the AL West.

---

![Vargas.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/242DT2bTdsAkGP9cFKjpVyUfRKmUrz5TeAMDit92F6AwpMufTUdyuFW1od7cHk4biN98h.jpg) Screenshot from [Source](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/blue-jays-vs-d-backs/2026/04/18/825098/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     El segunda base criollo de los Diamondbacks de Arizona Ildemaro Vargas, no es alguien a quien los reflectores sigan y eso se entiende, dado que los ofidios le permitieron declararse agente libre al bajarlo a ligas menores en Noviembre pasado. Todo, para re-contratarlo al ver su performance en la pretemporada. Y el hombre ha demostrado que esa confianza no fue banal. Ayer bateó un sencillo en su último turno al bate, cerrando el octavo episodio, para mantener viva la cadena más larga vigente de juegos seguidos bateando de hit en la MLB. El hombre acumula un AVE de .377 con un OBP de .400, un SLG de .623 y un OPS de 1.023 en lo que va de campaña. Nadie, en su sano juicio, puede creer que la racha no termine, pero será interesante hacer seguimiento de ella dada la realidad poco mediática del pelotero. Ayer se metió un jugadón defensivo junto a Gurriel Jr., cuando se combinaron para reventar en segunda a Myles Straw, queriendo extender un hit a doble con certero tiro del jardinero izquierdo para enfriarlo con el guante de Vargas. Genio y figura, hasta la sepultura. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Diamondbacks second sacker Ildemaro Vargas isn't exactly a guy under the bright lights, and that tracks—the Snakes actually let him elect free agency after outrighting him to the minors last November. They ended up bringing him back after he raked in Spring Training, and man, has he proven that wasn't a fluke. Yesterday, he poked a base knock in his last AB to close out the eighth, keeping the longest active hitting streak in MLB alive. The guy is slashing a ridiculous .377/.400/.623 with a 1.023 OPS so far this season. Nobody in their right mind thinks the streak will last forever, but it’s going to be a fun ride to track for such an under-the-radar player. He also flashed the leather yesterday, teaming up with Gurriel Jr. to gun down Myles Straw at second. Straw tried to stretch a single into a double, but Gurriel uncorked a seed from left field and Vargas applied the tag to cool him off. That’s just who he is: a ballplayer through and through.

title.body:
Today, after a long time, I have immersed myself in nature. The green field surrounded by small kash flowers has captured my heart. Due to my busy schedule, I haven’t been able to visit the green fields for a long time. 






![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcSRCPoWtvvdevhksCCDeicrMDmkijumepZVV5PbcL7sP/1776616797065.jpg)

by @jompiy on Black Ivory

 I get the laundry bags I carry The Camden Market Free Art Man display in from Wood Green High Street. King size for £2 each. Alan, the Camden Town crier, saw them and asked me to get him some, paying me there and then. This video was recorded 21st June 2025. I took some works on paper that were based on a series of Masks I made and work in a film I put on YouTube called \

. I've been meaning to make some more ever since, but as they're done using oil paint, I haven't gotten round to it yet. I'm painting exclusively in acrylic for now, as I'm short on studio floor space so need things to dry quickly. Ideally, I'd have a dedicated room in my house for oil painting, as I prefer to acrylic in a lot of ways. I'd also like a room just for music, and get started on a new Edgeworth Band album. A big house and a couple of assistants is what I need. Till then, it will all have to wait. \n ***\n[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/aLj5DngBJxXjkStRSZFvaU)

title.title: Dailyprompt: Not so hot now
title.body:
There’s always that one video on social media.

It suddenly shows up on every application everywhere.Everyone is watching it, sharing it, talking about it.
Then it becomes a viral trend.

People start copying each other's moves.
Same style, same lines, same idea same filters… just different faces.

For a while, it feels like that’s all you see.
If you don’t follow it, you feel like you’re missing something important.

But then, slowly… it fades.
Fewer people post it.
Then a new trends take its place.
And what once felt special becomes just another normal thing.

It’s strange how something can be everywhere one moment ago....
and then almost forgotten the next.
That’s how trends really are.

For a short time, they feel like everything...
and then suddenly, they’re not so hot anymore.

title.title: LESSONS FROM HEZEKIAH' S PRAYER
title.body:
Hello pals... I bring you all warm greetings and to discuss about Hezekiah prayer, Here's When faith turns a dead end into a new beginning.

“I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; surely I will heal you.” — 2 Kings 20:5
Said the Lord God.

Hezekiah’s story is one of the most powerful reminders that God responds to sincere, desperate prayer. King Hezekiah fell critically ill, and the prophet Isaiah came with a heavy message: set your house in order, for you shall die and not live. It was a final word—no hope, no negotiation. 

![17766165282853584428145083529877.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/242hoV5ExuKNiZgnkit9wsyWBdYNtkdqAq89pL2QeqqSZDQEaqrteskLDN6dAxHooCQYQ.jpg)


But instead of accepting defeat, Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed. He didn’t pray a long, complicated prayer; he poured out his heart with tears, reminding God of his faithfulness and devotion. In that quiet, broken moment, heaven listened.

Before Isaiah had even left the courtyard, God interrupted the verdict. The same prophet returned with a new message: God had heard the prayer and seen the tears. Healing was released, and fifteen more years were added to Hezekiah’s life.
 What was pronounced as an ending became a new beginning. This moment reveals something deep—God is not distant from our pain. He sees, He hears, and He responds when we call on Him with sincerity.

Hezekiah’s prayer teaches us that no situation is too final for God to reverse. Even when life gives you a “death sentence”—whether it’s failure, loss, sickness, or hopelessness—prayer can shift the outcome.

![Screenshot_20260414-220542.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23w2gkHZp3Ws3MRKWnqftfeTDdiBpKYJD7aQaJ2SRdSbKTwEBFdSDwbyU62zG65kFP6XA.png)

 God is moved not by perfect words, but by a genuine heart. Tears are not weakness in the presence of God; they are a language He understands deeply.

This story calls us to trust God beyond what we see and hear. When circumstances speak defeat, prayer invites divine intervention. Hezekiah didn’t run to people—he ran to God. 

And in that place of surrender, God showed His power. Your situation today may feel sealed, but if you bring it before God with faith, He can still rewrite your story. What looks finished can be restored, extended, and renewed by His mercy.
 You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra.

title.title: «El poder del descanso en el entrenamiento físico. NO LO SUBESTIMES»
title.body:
¡Hola a todos, amantes del fitness! Hoy quiero hablar de un tema que a menudo pasamos por alto en nuestra búsqueda del cuerpo perfecto: **¡el descanso!**

Sí, lo sé, suena contradictorio. ¿Cómo voy a conseguir resultados si no estoy machacándome en el gimnasio todos los días? Pues bien, déjame decirte que el descanso es tan importante como el entrenamiento en sí mismo. De hecho, ¡podría ser incluso más importante!

_¿Por qué es tan crucial el descanso?_

Imagina que eres un constructor y estás levantando un edificio. ¿Crees que podrías trabajar sin parar durante días y días? ¡Claro que no! Necesitarías tomarte descansos para recuperar fuerzas y evitar el agotamiento. Lo mismo ocurre con tu cuerpo.  
Cuando te ejercitas, estás sometiendo tus músculos a un estrés. Para recuperarse y fortalecerse, necesitan tiempo para descansar y repararse. Si no les das ese tiempo, corres el riesgo de sufrir lesiones, fatiga crónica y un estancamiento en tus resultados.

**Los beneficios del descanso en el entrenamiento físico:**

*   **Reparación muscular:** Durante el descanso, tus músculos se reparan y se reconstruyen, lo que los hace más fuertes y resistentes.
*   **Reducción del riesgo de lesiones:** Un cuerpo descansado es menos propenso a sufrir lesiones por sobreuso.
*   **Mejora del rendimiento:** Cuando estás descansado, tienes más energía y concentración para entrenar, lo que se traduce en un mejor rendimiento.
*   **Regulación hormonal:** El descanso ayuda a regular las hormonas que influyen en el crecimiento muscular, la recuperación y el estado de ánimo.
*   **Prevención del sobreentrenamiento:** El descanso adecuado previene el sobreentrenamiento, un estado de agotamiento físico y mental que puede tener graves consecuencias para tu salud.

**_Tipos de descanso:_**

▶️ **Descanso activo:** Realizar actividades de baja intensidad, como caminar, nadar o hacer yoga, en los días de descanso para promover la circulación sanguínea y la recuperación muscular.

![](https://entrenalavida1.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/9_20250804_104845_0000.jpg?w=1024)

▶️ **Descanso pasivo:** Relajarse completamente y no realizar ninguna actividad física. Dormir lo suficiente es fundamental para el descanso pasivo.

![](https://entrenalavida1.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/10_20250804_104845_0001.jpg?w=1024)

▶️ **Descanso entre series:** Tomar descansos cortos entre series de ejercicios para permitir que los músculos se recuperen parcialmente.

![](https://entrenalavida1.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/11_20250804_104845_0002.jpg?w=1024)

▶️ **Descanso semanal:** Dedicar uno o dos días a la semana al descanso completo para permitir que el cuerpo se recupere por completo.

![](https://entrenalavida1.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/12_20250804_104845_0003.jpg?w=1024)

Consejos para optimizar el descanso:

• **_Duerme lo suficiente:_** Intenta dormir entre 7 y 8 horas cada noche.

• **_Escucha a tu cuerpo:_** No te fuerces a entrenar si te sientes cansado o dolorido.

• **_Planifica tus días de descanso:_** Incluye días de descanso en tu rutina de entrenamiento y respétalos.

• **_Varía tus entrenamientos:_** No hagas siempre los mismos ejercicios para evitar el sobreuso de ciertos músculos.

• **_Aliméntate correctamente:_** Una dieta equilibrada proporciona los nutrientes que tus músculos necesitan para recuperarse.

• _**Reduce el estrés:**_ El estrés crónico puede interferir con la recuperación muscular. Encuentra formas de relajarte y reducir el estrés, como meditar, leer o pasar tiempo en la naturaleza.

> El descanso es una parte fundamental del entrenamiento físico. No lo subestimes y priorízalo en tu rutina. Tu cuerpo te lo agradecerá con mejores resultados, menos lesiones y una mayor sensación de bienestar.¡Así que ya sabes, deja de lado la culpa por no ir al gimnasio un día y date el permiso de descansar! Tu cuerpo y tu mente te lo agradecerán.

¡Nos vemos en la próxima entrada!

Hasta Pronto!

Emy Mora 🌱

title.title: Romper las reglas (es/en)
title.body:
* 
(Oscar Wilde)

Hola amigos de Holus Lotus como de costumbre traigo un escrito reflexivo sobre lo que implica ser uno mismo y porque serlo muchas veces puede ser un acto de rebeldía.

Porque a menudo lo que aprendimos por normas familiares, culturales o expectativas sociales nos van moldeando hasta convertirnos en alguien que no somos en esencia.

Porque vamos aprendiendo a priorizar la obediencia y la aprobación externa por encima de nuestros propios sueños, por eso cuando surge esa pasión, ese talento puede que parecer que ir tras ese llamado interno implica ***romper las reglas***

Pero no sé trata de una rebeldia sin sentido sino de empezar a elegirte, a ser quien eres y tener el valor de mostrarlo.

***\

***

Esto fue lo que empecé a escuchar cuando decidí a ser quien yo soy. Cuando comencé a decir no, a priorizarme y lo fui aprendíendo con los años y con mucha terapia (o al menos en mi caso) dónde aprendí acercarme a mi desde la conciencia.

Porque fui dejando mi esencia en manos de los demás hasta convertirme el alguien que no era, y estoy seguro que todos llegamos a ese punto de preguntarnos, ¿quien soy?

Y este proceso para mí fue muy revelador, incómodo, incluso hasta doloroso porque muchas gente se alejo de mi, pero ser uno mismo muchas veces implica decepciónarse y mirar la realidad como es.

Sin embargo dar ese paso es necesario para conocernos y vivir de una forma más genuina, coherente porque seguir lo que amas es tener libertad.

Por eso ser uno mismo, tener voz y poner límites se ve muchas con ser rebelde pero en realidad es amor propio porque ya no dejas que otros decidan por ti mismo sino que eres responsable de tus propios actos.

Tener una orientación sexual distinta para mi fue desafiante, por eso necesite ayuda terapeutica porque no era feliz siendo quien no era, y en terapia comprendí que mi mayor miedo era decepciónar pero también entendí que nadie se iba a morir por eso.

Así que comencé un largo camino lleno de miedo como de esperanza y, paso a paso sin presionarme, pero con determinación, fui superando mis propias limitaciones, en lugar de intentar superar a los demás.

Ahora sé que la autoestima no es algo que simplemente se espera; se construye a través de la acción constante y el valor.

Ser uno mismo implica romper las reglas para elegir lo que amas y construir tu propia filosofía de vida.

Yo tuve que dejar muchas cosas atrás para recuperar mi autoestima y volver a sonreír.

Por eso comprendi desde mi experiencia que hay cosas que el dinero no puede comprar, como la paz que se siente saber que eres leal a ti mismo.

*Bueno amigos, gracias por leerme y espero que esté post les haya gustado*

### English ###

![IMG_20190701_141548~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frankblack/242NjQ2umpE5J58v5FskupVu4NaNvnkpK3xKwRJHHcUhpbfYz3dpNJP8Z9ChgxHbrW7KY.jpg)
*Photo of My propiety*

***Breaking the rules***.

*\

* 
(Oscar Wilde)

Hello, friends of Holus Lotus. As usual, I’m sharing a reflective piece on what it means to be yourself and why doing so can often be an act of rebellion.

Because often, what we’ve learnt through family norms, cultural norms or social expectations shapes us until we become someone we’re not at our core.

Because we learn to prioritise obedience and external approval over our own dreams, so when that passion arises, that talent, it may seem that following that inner calling means ***breaking the rules***

But it’s not about senseless rebellion; it’s about starting to choose yourself, to be who you are and having the courage to show it 

***“You’re getting weirder and weirder”***

This is what I began to hear when I decided to be myself. When I started saying no, putting myself first, and as I learnt over the years—and through a lot of therapy (or at least in my case)—how to connect with myself through self-awareness.

Because I had been leaving my true self in the hands of others until I became someone I wasn’t, and I’m sure we all reach that point where we ask ourselves, ‘Who am I?’

And this process was very revealing for me, uncomfortable, even painful at times, because many people drifted away from me, but being yourself often involves facing disappointment and seeing reality for what it is.

However, taking that step is necessary to get to know ourselves and live in a more genuine, coherent way, because following what you love is having freedom.

That’s why being yourself, having a voice and setting boundaries is often seen as being rebellious, but in reality it’s self-respect, because you no longer let others decide for you; instead, you’re responsible for your own actions.

Having a different sexual orientation was a challenge for me, which is why I needed therapy – I wasn’t happy pretending to be someone I wasn’t. Through therapy, I realised that my greatest fear was letting people down, but I also understood that nobody was going to die because of it.

So I set out on a long journey filled with both fear and hope, and step by step—without putting pressure on myself, but with determination—I realised that I was overcoming my own limitations, rather than trying to outdo others.

Now I know that self-esteem isn’t something you simply wait for; it is built through constant action and courage.

Being yourself means breaking the rules to choose what you love and build your own philosophy of life.

I had to leave many things behind to regain my self-esteem and start smiling again.

That’s why I’ve learnt from my own experience that there are things money can’t buy, such as the peace of mind that comes from knowing you’re true to yourself.

*Well, friends, thank you for reading, and I hope you enjoyed this post*

title.title: How do we overcome doubts and anxities// The old path review
title.body:
https://youtu.be/3J4EEXHfIMo?si=MZQ_wlTFsMrXGQ39
Doubts and anxieties looks as a normal thing that happens to everyone, both non believers and true believers. For us to overcome this doubts and anxieties it all depends on how we put our hope and trust in God. Scripture encourages us to rely not on our own understanding but on God’s wisdom, which is steady and unchanging even when life feels uncertain.

Prayer is a good means which we can eliminate doubts and anxities in our everyday life. By bringing our worries to God honestly, we invite His peace into our minds and hearts.

>“Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God” (Philippians 4:6). 

Having faith in God increases our chance of eliminating doubts in our life, because God loves those who have faith in him. His presence gives strength and courage to face life’s challenges. 

>“Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God” (Isaiah 41:10).

title.title: Hiking Around Manali Exploring Hidden Trails and Unnamed Peaks in the Lower Himalayas
title.body:
![IMG_9739.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZQhJAAoFSrcXib8WGsWEg6BqSGkQtsdXyzggV1Xym45G/IMG_9739.png)


![IMG_7245.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYrdkYU9cVJS47XnXrSY4nu3fsywEgxCWaLX42nUmaaJW/IMG_7245.jpeg)

Julley Everyone

Starting this fresh new morning over here in the Himalayas, it was a beautiful day and especially at this particular time of the year when it was the time where these foothill mountains at kind of lower altitude location, the snow was not that much so that we could easily explore these particular potions, rather than having to go all the way to the top of the mountains and reach the top and more over it, even had a whole lot of a different vibe, exploring these mountains unknown. As literally these places they had no name nothing at all, but more over that even I got to know about this particular place. It was that I saw in the GPS maps when I was exploring and wondering around this particular location over here at this particular place in the Kullu Valley of Himachal Pradesh.

![IMG_7246.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmefJb4MR8tg9xEjm6DJWyvtrsfr4EtyopYxJZP3kfgH9d/IMG_7246.jpeg)

So currently, we were somewhere at an altitude of near about more than 2500 m and still going on a whole lot of different experience that I had when I was at this particular place, and now I thought why not to share these moments with you guys through this post so I tried kept saying as many photographs as I could all the way and now sharing it with you guys through this post and also in different perspectives and different angles so that you guys could also experience such beautiful moments all the way from these hidden potions around Himalayas.

![IMG_7247.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbRffcBonoqrr7tzKV348BaXZjzpxts5itEhv5tH1Hb58/IMG_7247.jpeg)

It was this particular portion in the mountain where we thought that we can’t go even further beyond this particular spot as there were these huge rocks that we saw in front of us, so we had to just walk all the way or find a way by the side of the mountain, not reach at a particular location from where we could see, and we could experience the views of the valley and just be at a higher altitude place.



![IMG_7248.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYymVvPaiLsioDsW3vt197MihJMCchrL2y46LfW7mkaNw/IMG_7248.jpeg)

And then it was the time when we were hiking around the place. It was somewhere near about 10 AM all the way that we were just wondering around this particular location over here in Himalayas, especially at this particular point and going further further and enjoying the beautiful views of the morning.



![IMG_7249.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSMwUu1sahvT7gSv5XeMp3zwJe4zVMbbyWyHFfq3Ufpqh/IMG_7249.jpeg)

After hiking for about more than two hours, we reached at this particular spot. It was a kind of plane location over here without why not to say relax here and sit for a while rather than just walking as continuously we have been wondering around the place near about quite a lot of time. And then we thought it’s the perfect time to relax and sit here for a while, and enjoy the beauty of the nature.

![IMG_7250.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY51WQKeDsxwojauSNuwUEZBcdWoLRJZku5y27yT3VaF9/IMG_7250.jpeg)

The moment, when we checked our location, we were at this particular spot over here in this GPS map that we saw.


![IMG_7251.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeXXt4YUdNpgUZhrpBvETjhUjtuEoKhEhCQn6xvhAyN3c/IMG_7251.png)

![IMG_7252.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme8WEa5YJ8GXJ7J41J2VNEaztrCV3ApaEPy6Y4vDPizyc/IMG_7252.jpeg)

Standing by the corner around the place.

![IMG_7254.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaNoT3PKmjGvjwSqsZCTDJQ4VNLFxzjjNmfBb5tD9dLZi/IMG_7254.jpeg)


Hiking into the woods.

![IMG_7255.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRcWzaLHmfXurdyT6UaQxw8kY6KocPzL2TS66JEKJL7VY/IMG_7255.jpeg)

And then, after resting for quite a lot of time, we thought why not to go and wonder on the location and explore the places unknown over here, so we just went all the way hiking near about for more than 40 minutes all the way until we reach reached at this particular spot and the whole glimpse. It looked something like this.


![IMG_7256.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdSciALhHqz7SrGoGdACgbioZcyjiFNZfsbt1vLj6RJ1q/IMG_7256.jpeg)
Another thing that I noticed when I was at this place, it was that I saw that few of the trees maybe near about hundred and hundred years old, they were these roots that I saw just by the side of the ground and it looked like this.

title.title: Your State of Mind Shapes Your Choices
title.body:
Hello friends, see, there are ups and downs in everyone's life and this is not my personal opinion, I should never take any decision in anger or in any kind of range because when we are not normal, when we are angry, our mind works differently and then we do not think what we are saying and what is right and what is wrong, we do not know much about all these things at that time. See, when our mental state is not normal, then we think differently, when we get angry, then our decision making ability becomes different and when we are normal, then we behave differently.



![anger 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23vsNTVYyR44rp7YpsYrTZgVL5vYJgLzfgV2rmZHtTGCZbRmo2ynknvwFoh38dJVuWKrA.png)




[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)

And no matter who the person is, everyone's nature does not remain the same, it keeps on changing. Every person's nature changes according to the circumstances. Sometimes you must have seen that people who remain very calm also become very angry. One should not get angry but still sometimes the situation around us becomes so great that we get angry even when we do not want to. See, my belief here is that we should live happily and peacefully with our family and whatever problem you are facing, you should share it with your family and not with any other people because see, it is your family who supports you and if you are expecting advice from other people or any kind of help from them then it does not happen.



See, when a person is sad, he goes to people for shelter and sometimes the circumstances of people become such that they are sad but some people are sad themselves, I feel that they have a habit of taking sadness forcibly and they keep all this going on in their mind only, see, whenever you have any problem, you should share your things with your loved ones or your companion and this is very important too. See if you keep it in your mind then ask him about yours.



![anger 3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tvcM1qHQ4qwBwqhAYNVyEaXavDmWWUqsK5vufMK7Y1LTmWqKwRue7ujYpJPjxx6wnPu.png)



[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)


And you also should not do this that you keep sharing your things with everyone, there is no good in it and first of all you should solve your matter among yourselves, sometimes angels take a very serious form, then you have to take the help of the court, but in the beginning try to solve the matter yourself, it will be much better.

That's all for today, I will meet you tomorrow with some other post.

title.title: Death of children what does the bible say about it// Mcgi Review
title.body:
The holy bible talks deeply about the death of little children and God understands the pain that mothers feel about the death of their child. Scripture often presents children as precious in God’s sight, reminding us that their lives are not small or forgotten. When a child dies, the grief is real and heavy, and the Bible does not ignore this sorrow but allows space for mourning and crying.

The Bible also shows that God has a special care for children, emphasizing their innocence and value. Jesus welcomed children and spoke of them as belonging to the kingdom of God, which gives hope that they are safe in His presence. This idea brings comfort to many, as it suggests that God’s mercy covers those who have not fully understood or lived out moral responsibility.

In the bible it also states where grown ups mourn the death of their younger ones, which show it can happen to anybody. Stories of loss reveal that grief is not a lack of faith but a natural human response. At the same time, these passages often point back to trusting God, even when the situation feels beyond understanding.

title.title: 在群山之间，我感受到一种无与伦比的宁静与壮丽。高
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g976149692892653e537d9f9a4bbe9b65277d6365f1438c24e533f5e6e410d358f23326ceadaf97b23ca5028a20ef8394afc1b40fadbd2f5a50eeb290f7283338_640.jpg)</center>

***

山脉的壮丽总是让人心生敬畏，巍峨的峰峦仿佛在诉说着时间的故事。站在高处，俯瞰大地，心灵感受到一种宁静与渺小，仿佛与自然融为一体。山间的清新空气和潺潺溪水，让人倍感舒畅，逃离了城市的喧嚣，仿佛进入了一个世外桃源。无论是徒步攀登，还是静静欣赏，都让我感受到生命的力量与美好。

***

[WhereIn Android](http://www.wherein.io)

title.title: Electrical Masters Exam... Passed.
title.body:
I have been working hard to make this the next phase of my life.

I have spent hours and days studying, chasing the hope of increasing my income and building something better for my sons. It has not been easy, but the joy I have felt from pushing through and seeing progress is beyond what I can properly explain.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcpYvZRozSyLeCdiJEKFf55LbWTDA9yN4miyzpDzysbMT/screenshot_2026_04_18_201917.png)

So many of the questions involve complex calculations and code rules that, not long ago, I never would have believed I could understand. This book below by Ray Holder, is definitely a must-have.

title.title: [ESP/ENG]  Jorge Luis y las piedras que hablaban / Concurso
title.body:
En el Servicio Geológico de Cuba, en una oficina llena de mapas y rocas etiquetadas, trabajaba Jorge Mariano. Él era Ingeniero en Geología, investigador destacado, y tenía una forma especial de ver el mundo porque el TEA —el autismo— formaba parte de su vida.

Cuando Jorge Luis miraba una piedra, no veía solo una piedra. Veía montañas que fueron jóvenes hace millones de años, ríos que ya no existen, volcanes dormidos. Su cerebro funcionaba como un imán para los detalles: notaba el brillo exacto de un mineral, la textura que otros pasaban por alto, el orden perfecto de las capas de la tierra.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVuwG88QQwrXh9fQrK6xx5fCZTAwHWrvJcxifF5r8Ffto/1776615464999.jpg)



Pero hubo un tiempo en que ese superpoder también era un desafío. Los ruidos fuertes de la oficina, los cambios de horario, tener que explicar sus ideas con muchas palabras… todo eso lo cansaba. A veces se quedaba en silencio, mirando su muestra, y algunos compañeros creían que no quería conversar.

Sin embargo, en el Servicio Geológico de Cuba pasó algo hermoso.

Sus compañeros —Marta, la paleontóloga de cabello rizado; Tomás, el cartógrafo que siempre llevaba una libreta verde; y Lili, la especialista en geofísica que reía con ganas— decidieron conocerlo de verdad.

Marta notó que Jorge Luis se sentía mejor cuando le avisaban con tiempo sobre las reuniones. Entonces empezó a escribir los horarios en una pizarra de colores. Tomás descubrió que Jorge prefería instrucciones claras y directas, sin frases como «quizás más tarde» o «sería bueno tal vez». Así que comenzó a decirle: «Jorge, necesito tu informe el martes a las diez». Y Lili aprendió que, aunque Jorge no mirara siempre a los ojos, sí escuchaba con una profundidad asombrosa. Cuando ella le preguntaba sobre un estrato geológico, él podía hablar durante una hora con datos precisos, emocionado como un niño mostrando un tesoro.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRUCH9cNX2MQMR9brqrzYnQe5Y6ah47ZzBFVfLd7MqXcQ/1776615550209.jpg)




Poco a poco, Jorge Luis se sintió seguro. Y esa seguridad hizo florecer todo su talento.

Él descubrió, por ejemplo, una falla geológica que nadie había visto. Pasó días y noches revisando muestras, comparando coordenadas, escribiendo en su computadora con una disciplina impecable. Sus compañeros le llevaban café y lo dejaban trabajar en paz, porque sabían que su concentración era su mayor fuerza.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbU7PQyBd9B1tyo6e969j4dFkKAURt5YaogU7aLZXFcq7/1776615643610.jpg)


Cuando Jorge presentó el hallazgo, todo el Servicio Geológico celebró. Él no alzó la voz ni dio un discurso largo. Solo sonrió, señaló los mapas con su mano firme y dijo: «Aquí la tierra nos cuenta una historia nueva». Y todos entendieron.

Jorge Luis no cambió su forma de ser. Sigue siendo un hombre de pocas palabras, amante del orden, que a veces necesita un descanso cuando hay mucho ruido. Pero también es un hombre que sabe que sus compañeros lo quieren tal como es.

Y lo mejor de todo: él también aprendió a quererlos. Una vez, Marta estaba triste porque su mamá se había enfermado, y Jorge Luis, sin decir nada, dejó sobre su escritorio una piedra transparente de cuarzo. «Esto es para que tengas luz en tu casa», le dijo. Marta la guarda hasta hoy.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRUCH9cNX2MQMR9brqrzYnQe5Y6ah47ZzBFVfLd7MqXcQ/1776615721809.jpg)


Así es Jorge Luis: inteligente como un geólogo, responsable como un investigador, y con un corazón que, aunque a veces parece callado, late con la misma fuerza que las montañas que estudia.

Porque en el Servicio Geológico de Cuba aprendieron algo muy valioso: cuando las personas se ayudan y se respetan, todos pueden brillar. Incluso aquellos que ven el mundo de una manera diferente. Quizás, por eso mismo, lo ven más hermoso.



Nota: Este es un cuento basado en una historia real.
El protagonista se llama Jorge Luis Torres Zafra, es Máster en Ciencias e Investigador Auxiliar.

Las fotos son de mi propiedad.
Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate.




ENGLISH 



Jorge Luis and the stones that spoke

At the Geological Survey of Cuba, in an office full of maps and labeled rocks, Jorge Mariano worked. He was a Geology Engineer, an outstanding researcher, and he had a special way of seeing the world because ASD – autism – was part of his life.

When Jorge Luis looked at a stone, he didn't see just one stone. I saw mountains that were young millions of years ago, rivers that no longer exist, dormant volcanoes. His brain worked like a magnet for details: he noticed the exact sheen of a mineral, the texture that others overlooked, the perfect order of the earth's layers.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVuwG88QQwrXh9fQrK6xx5fCZTAwHWrvJcxifF5r8Ffto/1776615464999.jpg)


But there was a time when that superpower was also a challenge. Loud office noises, schedule changes, having to explain your ideas in many words... all that tired him. Sometimes he would remain silent, looking at his sample, and some colleagues believed that he did not want to talk.

However, something beautiful happened in the Geological Survey of Cuba.

His companions —Marta, the curly-haired paleontologist; Tomás, the cartographer who always carried a green notebook; and Lili, the geophysicist who laughed heartily—decided to get to know him for real.

Marta noticed that Jorge Luis felt better when he was notified in advance about the meetings. Then he began to write the schedules on a colored blackboard. Thomas found that George preferred clear, direct instructions, without phrases like \
So he began to tell him: \

And Lili learned that, although Jorge did not always look into each other's eyes, he did listen with amazing depth. When she asked him about a geological stratum, he could talk for an hour with precise data, excited like a child showing a treasure.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRUCH9cNX2MQMR9brqrzYnQe5Y6ah47ZzBFVfLd7MqXcQ/1776615550209.jpg)


Little by little, Jorge Luis felt safe. And that confidence made all his talent flourish.

He discovered, for example, a geological fault that no one had seen. He spent days and nights reviewing samples, comparing coordinates, typing on his computer with impeccable discipline. His colleagues brought him coffee and let him work in peace, because they knew that his concentration was his greatest strength.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbU7PQyBd9B1tyo6e969j4dFkKAURt5YaogU7aLZXFcq7/1776615643610.jpg)


When Jorge presented the find, the entire Geological Survey celebrated. He did not raise his voice or give a long speech. He just smiled, pointed to the maps with his steady hand, and said, \

And everyone understood.

Jorge Luis did not change his way of being. He remains a man of few words, a lover of order, who sometimes needs a break when there is a lot of noise. But he's also a man who knows his teammates want him just the way he is.

And best of all: he also learned to love them. Once, Marta was sad because her mother had fallen ill, and Jorge Luis, without saying anything, left a transparent quartz stone on his desk. \

he told her. Marta keeps it to this day.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRUCH9cNX2MQMR9brqrzYnQe5Y6ah47ZzBFVfLd7MqXcQ/1776615721809.jpg)


That's Jorge Luis: intelligent as a geologist, responsible as a researcher, and with a heart that, although sometimes seems silent, beats with the same force as the mountains he studies.

Because in the Geological Survey of Cuba they learned something very valuable: when people help and respect each other, everyone can shine. Even those who see the world in a different way. Perhaps, for that very reason, they see it as more beautiful.

[Literature] Charles Dickens:  Little Dorrit #16/435
title.body:
Nothing for the spent toiler to do, but to compare the monotony of his seventh day with the monotony of his six days, think what a weary life he led, and make the best of it—or the worst, according to the probabilities.

At such a happy time, so propitious to the interests of religion and morality, Mr Arthur Clennam, newly arrived from Marseilles by way of Dover, and by Dover coach the Blue-eyed Maid, sat in the window of a coffee-house on Ludgate Hill. Ten thousand responsible houses surrounded him, frowning as heavily on the streets they composed, as if they were every one inhabited by the ten young men of the Calender’s story, who blackened their faces and bemoaned their miseries every night. Fifty thousand lairs surrounded him where people lived so unwholesomely that fair water put into their crowded rooms on Saturday night, would be corrupt on Sunday morning; albeit my lord, their county member, was amazed that they failed to sleep in company with their butcher’s meat. Miles of close wells and pits of houses, where the inhabitants gasped for air, stretched far away towards every point of the compass. Through the heart of the town a deadly sewer ebbed and flowed, in the place of a fine fresh river. What secular want could the million or so of human beings whose daily labour, six days in the week, lay among these Arcadian objects, from the sweet sameness of which they had no escape between the cradle and the grave—what secular want could they possibly have upon their seventh day? Clearly they could want nothing but a stringent policeman.

Mr Arthur Clennam sat in the window of the coffee-house on Ludgate Hill, counting one of the neighbouring bells, making sentences and burdens of songs out of it in spite of himself, and wondering how many sick people it might be the death of in the course of the year. As the hour approached, its changes of measure made it more and more exasperating. At the quarter, it went off into a condition of deadly-lively importunity, urging the populace in a voluble manner to Come to church, Come to church, Come to church! At the ten minutes, it became aware that the congregation would be scanty, and slowly hammered out in low spirits, They won’tcome, they won’tcome, they won’tcome! At the five minutes, it abandoned hope, and shook every house in the neighbourhood for three hundred seconds, with one dismal swing per second, as a groan of despair.

‘Thank Heaven!’ said Clennam, when the hour struck, and the bell stopped.

But its sound had revived a long train of miserable Sundays, and the procession would not stop with the bell, but continued to march on. ‘Heaven forgive me,’ said he, ‘and those who trained me. How I have hated this day!’

There was the dreary Sunday of his childhood, when he sat with his hands before him, scared out of his senses by a horrible tract which commenced business with the poor child by asking him in its title, why he was going to Perdition?—a piece of curiosity that he really, in a frock and drawers, was not in a condition to satisfy—and which, for the further attraction of his infant mind, had a parenthesis in every other line with some such hiccupping reference as 2 Ep. Thess. c. iii, v. 6 & 7. There was the sleepy Sunday of his boyhood, when, like a military deserter, he was marched to chapel by a picquet of teachers three times a day, morally handcuffed to another boy; and when he would willingly have bartered two meals of indigestible sermon for another ounce or two of inferior mutton at his scanty dinner in the flesh. There was the interminable Sunday of his nonage; when his mother, stern of face and unrelenting of heart, would sit all day behind a Bible—bound, like her own construction of it, in the hardest, barest, and straitest boards, with one dinted ornament on the cover like the drag of a chain, and a wrathful sprinkling of red upon the edges of the leaves—as if it, of all books! were a fortification against sweetness of temper, natural affection, and gentle intercourse. There was the resentful Sunday of a little later, when he sat down glowering and glooming through the tardy length of the day, with a sullen sense of injury in his heart, and no more real knowledge of the beneficent history of the New Testament than if he had been bred among idolaters. There was a legion of Sundays, all days of unserviceable bitterness and mortification, slowly passing before him.

‘Beg pardon, sir,’ said a brisk waiter, rubbing the table. ‘Wish see bed-room?’

‘Yes.

![Copy of Copy of Unboxing (1).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoCiYi8MYeF393g3yShwUihjMVZySjug9KRA6Srqka9gXjBjebZsrDrGp8pjqELahzs.gif)
Hello, how are you? We are going on a trip in a few days. I came prepared this time, I decided to buy my own powerbank because it has been years since I have. My brother and cousin have their powerbank at the same time, so I just asked them to lend theirs, but their powerbank is already broken, so I decided to order one for us to use for our trip. So, usually when I use the camera on my phone, the battery tends to drain faster than when I use it normally. So I followed my instinct this time and went by myself, and I didn't regret any of it. -----
Let's Unbox!

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK7MEbSbBrNKibx87zdg4Uw834DrgdRGR82XqdBzKEYf63cfXjaBaBuRGz8xPKiF9P.JPG) I was disappointed about the packaging because it was just covered with bubble wrap, and that's it, and then the cardboard packaging is not that thick to protect the power bank. Finger cross, I hope the power bank works fine because if not, I will be sad LOL. ----

> ![18.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EouAEsScbZrggJuHuCumj8hi46HQQNbD2c1MeAr4t3ok8BV5VNGeUTiFZfxxXPuB2so.JPG) I ordered the black color because it is my style, and as you can see, the box has a dent on one side, which makes me nervous to open it. ----

> ![5.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogPfshEAygDkk5ihNDp3TozbGmd1N9UL2RzzacBJBLB1Tri9upvoUQ4sXMy59dTjuq.JPG) I bought this GOOJODOQ Powerbank for about $10 bucks on sale, with 20000 mAh in black color. I felt relieved when it came out fine and perfect. ----

> ![7.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiX7gzwwnU6A5LkUVrYvKyQUVGoMXidRhrPtWn5jajsNgrTyUBF1TGxQhSFGRwBQwz.JPG) It came with a charging cord, and I don't trust the one they gave me, so I have my own usb c to charge my phone, and I am going to use that to charge my powerbank. -----

> ![9.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eokf3LHBZR9iVs5S97jNUCtFxuM2FcfPiDJZpad9y23em84ybuQcWKUZzemGwuf3RtM.JPG) And a manual for the product diagram to show what is that button or input/output is used for, and then you can see the product specification too. ----

> ![12.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep5oAnzHYiu7hmE5zqHjmtEkay1aornbXHHQFKHaWj1MsAcmRUurppRV9fTCfwNNhdR.JPG) What I like about it is that it has built-in cables and an LED display for the percentage of the battery, whereas the old powerbank I owned before only had 4 dots to specify what percentage my powerbank is. -----

> ![13.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoke3gwYvxy4NxEm7fzXpnghFAG6BsAgS9wgzpi8hVbpXsEPrWitzi4wUWzipQLwAkZ.JPG) An input/output port. In case the built-in cables are not working anymore. I saw some power banks only have a built-in cable, which is not a good thing to buy because if that cable breaks, the power bank is useless for that. ----

title.body:
https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiMw1Dvf4JddJ3ZYJR-9MvSpf_LrskjZZtVE1j4Nv1acT0zReOZNJWIaJXxG_3phEcnfYxhyqblZihHZulFs4OCcng4WtzfbtFQF-Dlr-odgdeTl_Qq0miRSc-A5kMO3vEEyUgBlj5qH4mZimSdm1050zT7A2-uWnfWUFTJJur_2DSweVghCGG19unQZ91O/w640-h214/1500x500.jpg

### Who Is RISE, And Who Is Lucas?

In a market where most narratives are engineered after launch, $RISE begins with something far more rare, a real origin story. At the center of it is Lucas, an 8-year-old boy whose imagination led him to design a moon mascot that would later be selected as the zero-gravity indicator for the Artemis II mission.

What started as a simple idea, a child looking at the Moon and believing he could reach it, became something much bigger. That idea was not only recognized, it was carried into a real space mission. This gives $RISE a foundation that most tokens simply cannot replicate.

In crypto, authenticity is often questioned. With $RISE, the story exists independently of the token itself. That separation creates trust, curiosity, and most importantly, memorability.

### The Narrative Behind $RISE

Crypto culture has always been built around a shared language. Terms like moon, launch, orbit, and lift-off are not just slang, they represent the collective belief system of the market.

What makes $RISE different is that it does not try to imitate that language. It aligns with it naturally. A moon mission mascot designed to represent lift-off and zero gravity translates directly into a crypto identity that feels intuitive.

Most tokens spend time trying to convince people why they matter. $RISE doesn’t need to. The narrative is already understood within seconds, and that level of clarity is what allows ideas to spread at scale.

When something is easy to understand, it becomes easy to share. And when it becomes easy to share, it becomes difficult to ignore.

### Artemis II And Its Significance

The Artemis II mission represents one of the most important steps in modern space exploration. It is humanity’s return to deep lunar space after decades, signaling a new era of exploration beyond Earth.

Within this mission, RISE plays a symbolic role. As the zero-gravity indicator, it floats at the exact moment the spacecraft leaves Earth’s gravitational pull. This moment represents transition, from limitation to expansion.

That symbolism carries weight. It mirrors the psychology of crypto markets, where participants are constantly looking for opportunities to break out, grow, and move beyond constraints.
The connection between this mission and the narrative of $RISE is not forced. It is aligned. And alignment is what gives narratives longevity.

### Ethereum Volume And Market Conditions

No narrative operates in isolation. It requires liquidity to move.
Ethereum has recently shown renewed activity, with trading volume increasing and capital rotating back into the ecosystem. Historically, these phases mark the beginning of new cycles where attention shifts toward emerging narratives.

When liquidity enters the market, it does not spread evenly. It concentrates around ideas that are easiest to understand and easiest to repeat.

$RISE benefits directly from this dynamic. It combines simplicity, relatability, and timing, positioning it in a way that allows it to absorb attention more efficiently than more complex or forced narratives.

### Growth Potential And Price Theory

At early market cap levels, the concept of asymmetry becomes critical. The difference between risk and reward is not linear, it is exponential.

If $RISE were to move from a 2M market cap to 20M, that represents a 10x increase. A position of $1,000 at this level could theoretically scale to $10,000. If the narrative continues to expand and reaches 100M, that same position begins to show significantly larger returns.

Beyond that, if a project enters the hundreds of millions or even approaches the billion-dollar range, the compounding effect becomes even more pronounced.

These scenarios are not guarantees. They are frameworks for understanding how early-stage narratives can scale when attention, liquidity, and belief align at the same time.

### Why Whales Rotate Into Narratives Like $RISE

Large players in the market are not just looking for volatility, they are looking for positioning. Whales tend to rotate into narratives that are early, easy to understand, and capable of attracting sustained attention.

The reason is simple. Liquidity follows attention, and attention follows narrative clarity. When a project like $RISE begins to gain traction, it creates a feedback loop where visibility increases, participation grows, and liquidity deepens.

From a strategic perspective, entering early into a narrative-driven asset allows larger players to position themselves before broader market awareness catches up. This is where the largest percentage gains are typically captured.

This does not guarantee outcome, but it explains behavior. And understanding behavior is key to understanding market movement.

### The Billion Dollar Potential

Every cycle produces a small number of tokens that move beyond expectations. These are not always the most complex or the most technically advanced. They are the ones that capture attention and hold it.

$RISE shows early signs of aligning the key components required for that type of growth, narrative strength, timing within the market cycle, and increasing visibility.

The simplicity of the concept allows it to scale across different audiences. The story allows it to resonate beyond just traders. And the current stage allows for expansion.
This combination is what creates the potential for outsized results.

### Conclusion

$RISE represents more than just another token launch. It represents a convergence of story, culture, and market timing.
What begins as attention can turn into belief. Belief turns into participation. And participation turns into momentum.
The foundation is already in place. The narrative is already working. The only variable left is how far it can go once the market fully engages.

title.title: The Innocence which childhood hold. Week-305.
title.body:
Hello everyone, hope you all are doing great. This weekend th ere was no fun or outing, I'm lying at by bed from the 2 days, I'm exhausted. I neither went out to play or shopping nor I am wishing to do anything except of sleeping. My energy is drained by attending various academic sessions and tomorrow is Monday so I have another session. That is what I'm upto from the last few weeks,  I mean there's no excitement but alot of laziness and work.


That's all the topic is about this weekend for #weekendexperiences: ABOUT ALL THE THINGS I MISS BEING A CHILD.

 I guess childhood is the most adorable time which you hold strongly in your  memory throughout your life it's because you remember s and compare the scenario.
When I was a kid I used to have great fun which includes all the extracurricular activities but now it's totally different I even don't gave time to step oug the room. As the academics didn't leave any time. 

![IMG-20260419-WA0021.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZCS8mYVpQRXTfjAdcRT4RGPXZ3kpZUY551i1eLZ6p5vp/IMG-20260419-WA0021.jpg)

The time I miss the most are those carefree days were I used to enjoy my whole day running, playing with friends and eating all time but now things are very different, as we grow up we are loaded with responsibilities and work and enjoying eating is replaced by a diet chart. We need to take each and every step with great thinking and considering all aspects.

Sometimes when I'm sitting idle, I look at all my memories and photographs from childhood and think how much innocence that time carriers and it cannot be brought back again. 

![IMG-20260419-WA0019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSiMVdBHk4jeZEFHbDrayhkqUdLEdvmTrFUHnkBWSyxP1/IMG-20260419-WA0019.jpg)

Actually I used to think that it will be great fun when I'll grow up like going out with friends, hangouts and the freedom but now it doesn't feel like fun anymore. Acedemics is very vast, you feel anxiety, there's a lot of other responsibilities compared to which the childhood was much easier but you value things when they are no longer available to you. 
I won't say I haven't enjoyed my childhood, I definitely had the best time of my life but the constant urge to grow up and leave this phase was also there.

Now most of my time in evening is either taken by studies or by sleeping which earlier used to be spent by playing with my friends. At night I'm mostly awake online but earlier the young me used to listen to stories by my mom. So that's how there is a very contrast in things which I did as young me and that's what I miss the most.

Thankyou @galenkp.
All images are mine.

title.title: A Warm Reunion.
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776613912590-cb340032d114af1a.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/db3fab06)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/db3fab06)


---

After escaping the pit, I reunited with Jonah and helped him remove a parasite before heading toward a nearby village. We navigated a dangerous cliffside together and worked to repair a divided bridge using a complex mechanism.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT15fCr9QF5Vexak5nhuLMNsYoBHmuRdsGSBmUrdSAhcm/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXGvmEkWduMLhsfaR6sK9YKt1wNTWsdQWVP44AomTV1t1/screenshot_2_.png)

After fighting the cougar in the pit, I finally found a way to get out of there. It looked like I was getting very close to another wreckage of our airplane that had crashed in the jungle. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrUcQfuqu66HCThyS2pPiZLrTR3WejUMQDK3KePNkmox/screenshot_3_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPwSagNmXq1VoKiXBwq7eHqWx1Fo6Dxo1ZTZ481cmoiKD/screenshot_4_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7B6zMwKP8sdxmKQj9xRSzwLQZctKJe8yQhNUGix2QCD/screenshot_5_.png)

I had to try a very risky jump towards a dead tree branch that was hanging over a steep drop. From there, I fell through the side of the wrecked plane and finally found my climbing axe. This discovery made Lara very happy, as she felt incomplete without her favorite tool 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcFWKiwgTwy5XsHaF5TPdV39xTvws2DNCseVGC6dHSWXN/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTFSRw8Dxab6nPtQNgLq5dtFBCwFuvxpN55RDwuLjQjmU/screenshot_7_.png)

Right after that, Jonah appeared from the trees, and both of them got very happy seeing each other alive after the crash. They hugged each other first to celebrate their survival in this dangerous environment. It was a brief moment of peace and friendship in the middle of a very difficult and scary situation.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZh2yHDc5wfr35Q7stMVgZ5DvjqQkBCoUFLTEqRQzc6B/screenshot_8_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXGjZfkvZNuisTPjog8Y4BSdCG5NhkFdTxZmUerPNoG5T/screenshot_9_.png)

It looked like Jonah got a parasite into his skin during his time alone in the jungle. He had been trying to take it out, but he couldn't do it, so Lara helped him with the painful task. She moved carefully to ensure he was okay before they prepared to move on.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1YjNZ6zk3SQ98spoYZL616jKfipKwnjnrTq6joPVWHA/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTqRrxKZXFrdarvd37BN5QS617dNYwMxbSJ39ZEE6frys/screenshot_11_.png)

Then we had to continue our journey ahead through the thick plants and trees. We noticed there was a place that seemed to be a small village with living souls just a short distance ahead of our position. Seeing signs of civilization gave them both a lot of hope that we might find help soon.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaoS8FuGVqjzyYbwt6anfR3eMchVDsXDWUE5zggSsJSmg/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWSFKqJPeHwbENZ4MYSS7KZta6KyJwGbpWwKrj7cKGzKg/screenshot_13_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXsCijyfqizN6dofj8CrTCU98R1AhZjN7AeT9WLrBFkCz/screenshot_14_.png)

We had to pass through this very risky edge on a high cliffside to stay on the right path. Jonah was the one getting scared all the time because of the height, but Lara was actually the one who almost fell down. Fortunately, Jonah reacted fast and helped her back up.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW9fCshig7nK6JcjTnU4EXGJ3fjhRruKceMY2pEGjAC7X/screenshot_15_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdxLw4RZVfU7ErNtE9N575BCZdh74vDHgQ3kRLVdb3Ycf/screenshot_16_.png)

Then we reached this large bridge that was divided right in the middle, making it impossible to cross. I had to look around the area for a way to join the two sides together again.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSUB9jkt7Zr8pfrV83s2ZjPsXpQSGqiTjUy7yHvkkoh2w/screenshot_17_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNzkHL6YP1pFNkQKfmAY8KAwrfiDxLJ7AbpodTB9TcG2Q/screenshot_18_.png)

I climbed up a slippery water tower and I found a lever there that I could interact with to move the ancient machinery. I grabbed the handle and pulled with all my strength, hearing the old gears begin to grind and turn for the first time in years.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPs5U6NVJi9fxWYZWRphvxTGQKJftcgLyH1XbKE8guVo1/screenshot_19_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmctx9rU65TvZWVYb5b4uSrsG4ar4VWPxwb2oAzAQSNWwE/screenshot_20_.png)

After pulling the lever, the water tower started releasing a heavy flow of water into a large bucket. This bucket acted as a weight which was connected to the mechanism designed to join the bridge.

---

>Sagt man nicht, dass wenn einem eine Pflanze so vor die Nase kommt, im eigenen Garten aufgeht, dann Braucht man sie?

Ja, mir gefällt der Spruch auch wirklich sehr und hört sich für mich auch plausibel an, wenn man bedenkt, was für Pflanzen direkt unter dem Fenster wachsen. Während ich auch schon darauf hingewiesen wurde, dass wenn ich so etwas sage, es sehr esoterisch, egozentrisch und überzogen sei, den Menschen in das Mittelfeld zu ziehen und dass alles um ihn dreht. Und, dass man ja eh nur das sieht mit dem man sich beschäftigt; während ich mich ja anfangs gar nicht damit beschäftigt habe und auch neue Pflanzen, wie das Hirtentäschel, gar nicht als Augenmerk habe bis ich sie ja dann sehe und mich dann erst damit beschäftige. Ich denke, das ist abhängig vom Weltbild und ich sehe den Menschen schon als ein sehr wichtiges Bindeglied zwischen Unbewussten und Bewussten, zwischen den Wirken der Naturkräfte und was wir in unserer Realität schaffen. Und bin demzufolge auch davon überzeugt, dass wenn wir Menschen die Pflanzen in uns aufnehmen, dass die Pflanzen durch unseren Körper als Medium in Wirkung kommen können, also mit in der Realität wirken können. Wie ein bisschen ein göttlicher Funken in uns, der durch Pflanzen aktiviert und explosionsartig entfalten kann. 

>Interessant, ich hätte nicht gedacht, dass es etwas gibt, was du noch nicht kanntest, weil du schon so viel über Heilpflanzen geschrieben hast.

Neeee, ich probier mich da Schritt für Schritt selbst ran zu tasten. Ich war auch bisher noch nie auf einen Gesundheitskongress, oder Kräuterwanderungen, oder sonst was. Und auch als ich Ende 2024 einen Beitrag über Große Kapuzinerkresse gemacht habe, war das 2 Tage nachdem ich es kennengelernt habe. Und da wurde ich auch von alten Bekannten, die Bauern waren, etwas verpönt, dass ich so etwas nicht kenne und gar nicht wüsste, wie man mit der Natur umgehen würde... während ich in der Stadt aufgewachsen bin und mir ja auch wirklich Mühe gebe :D'


Yep, das [Scharbockskraut](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@charlissy/krauterkunde-scharbockskraut-ranunculus-ficaria) hat den Gundermann, Knoblauchsrauke und ein paar andere als Verwechlunsgefahren. Allerdings sind die genannten kein Problem, da sie selbst Heilpflanzen sind. Das Haselwurz ist eine Gefahr und auch ein Doppelgänger, den man absolut nicht konsumieren sollte. Wobei jedoch das Scharbockskraut ab der Blüte bereits giftig ist, doch vor der Blüte genossen werden kann! und auch sehr viel Vitamin C enthält.
Auf dem ersten Bild würde man meinen, man könne das Scharbockskraut noch verzehren. Doch auf dem 2. Bild erkennt man 3 Blüten, was das Kraut giftig macht. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/charlissy/23tbkhES9nKXfcSiK33AuX2naqsLYuuaDeeXysdJKJRdTEJAWs2Q6Cib8AEQazTemVGgr.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/charlissy/23tRxJYxhqFWuMD7RXcyHo6szrUQJNJVbrRJ4aEZjZ4tb7XAtwiZWhPssYPqxqfaQSXWd.png)

Sumpfdotterblume hatte ich absolut gar nicht auf dem Schirm. Meiner Meinung nach sind die Blütenblätter der Sumpfdotterblume breiter als die des Scharbockskrauts. Und halt auf den Standort achten: Ersteres wächst im Sumpf, feuchten Gebieten, und Scharbockskraut unter Sträuchern und Bäumen. 

Ich mach mir meine Beiträge auch so, dass sie übersichtlich für mich sind und ich sie für mich selbst betrachten kann, denn wenn ich ein Kraut 1-2 Jahre selbst nicht sehe, brauche ich auch unbedingt Nachholbedarf zmd was die Verwechslungsgefahren anbelangt.

Im [Bärlauch](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@charlissy/krauterkunde-barlauch-allinum-ursinum)- Beitrag habe ich auch die kleinen Unterschiede Ende des Beitrags aufgeführt. Ich kann dich auch sehr gut verstehen: Ich muss auch praktisch die Kräuter im Wald sehen anstatt nur Theorie zu lesen :D
Bzgl Bärlauch habe ich auch bereits im vorherigen Jahr oder davor auch gelesen, dass selbst Bärlauch Produkte, die hergestellt wurden aus handgelesenen Bärlauch auch absolut keine Garantie ist, dass es nur Bärlauch ist. Deswegen gab es auch einen Rückruf des Produkts, weil es Aronstab oder Herbstzeitlose mit drinnen hatte. Deswegen immer nur auf sich selbst verlassen!
Und da stimme ich dir zu: In voller Hast und Wahn gesund sein zu wollen, greifen manche ausversehen mal daneben. 
Auch ist mir wichtig zu wissen, welche Kräuter in welcher Periode meines Lebens ich nutzen kann: Denn z.B während der Schwangerschaft muss ich auch wirklich darauf achten, was ich einnehme, ansonsten können wehenfördernde Kräuter eine Fehlgeburt auslösen. Oder wenn ich stille, dann brauche ich milchbildungsförderndes Kraut und keines, welches die Milch hemmt. Und vor allem in diesem Lebensabschnitt gibt es kontroverse Diskussionen, welche Kräuter du anwenden kannst und welche nicht. Bsp: Himbeerblätter und Brombeerblätter werden dauernd verwechselt. Oder es wird zur Argumentation herangezogen, dass es abhängig davon ist, inwieweit dein Körper bereits auf Kräuter gewöhnt ist und keinen zu starke Entgiftung von 3 Blättern Gundermann ankurbelt. 
Auch wird mega die Angst gemacht wegen des Fuchsbandwurmes. Oder auch, dass in jeder Pflanze auch eine geringe Dosis von giftigen Stoffen drin sind, wie bspw. Alkaloide oder auch Oxalsäure. Während dann gleichzeitig bei anderen Pflanzen die Alkaloide als heilfördernd gelten, und Oxalsäure auch immer entsteht, wenn man etwas kocht. Deswegen ist es für mich manchmal auch schwierig direkt für mich zu sagen, ob die Pflanze mir gut tut oder nicht. Ich hab bspw noch mega viel Vergissmeinnicht und wollte es fermentieren, während mir andere ausdrücklich davon abraten, doch in alten Kräuterbüchern es tatsächlich als Nahrung genutzt wurde. Da bin ich mir auch immer noch unsicher!

Ich denke an Kräutern wird es mir niemals ausgehen !! Weil es gibt auch noch Länder, wie z.B. Brasilien, die eine enorme Biodiversität haben und ich dann das Gefühl bekomme niemals genug von Pflanzen kennen zu können. Das ist schon eine so richtige Lebensaufgabe alle Pflanzen kennenzulernen und was darüber erzählen zu können! Und dann kann man ja noch soooo viel damit machen: ganz viele verschiedene Darreichungsformen, oder auch im Garten sie verschieden nebeneinander hocken, dass sie in eine Symbiose miteinander gehen. Oder auch irgendwann vielleicht mal selbst besondere Pflanzenarten züchten (davon träume ich).

Danke vielmals für deine Anerkennung :) Liebe Grüße zurück und einen guten Schwung in die neue Woche.

title.body: > This photo is from the girls varsity race at the 2019 Astronaut High Invitational at Chain of Lakes Park, Titusville, Florida. This photo was taken by me on September 7th, 2019. My son ran in an earlier race which is the reason for me being there and awake this early in the morning. I would usually try to get photos of all of the runners from his school in all of the races. These generally included boys varsity, girls varsity, boys junior varsity, and girls junior varsity. Occasionally, there would also be separate middle school races but my son's school is a junior/senior high school which includes grades 7-12 and they do not typically participate in the middle school races. title.title: 有趣的现象：亚洲人和西方人社交场的不同习惯
title.body:
最近在网上看到一个观点，感觉非常有趣。对我启发也很大，这不就是我经历的场景吗？下面和大家分享一下。

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfQc8DU4LeeoLv6CBctVtJbq86H5dXXZZbdkDkZ3iJpi1/image.png)
图源：Pixabay

在和不同文化背景的人，尤其是西方人打交道的时候，很多人都经历过类似的情况：在一些场合，大家聊的很愉快。期待还有后续的交互。但结束之后，就没有然后了。。。

究其原因，这源于双方对社交理解的文化背景是截然不同的。人类学家Edward Hall将不同种族，不同区域的文化分为：High Context Culture和Low Context Culture。

很多亚洲国家，比如中国，韩国，日本等，都属于前者，也就是High Context Culture。这种方式的特点就是大家在社交的时候，倾向于先寻找共同点。然后基于共同点进行社交。

而西方人则属于Low Context Culture。他们并不需要寻找过多的共同点，只是纯粹把话说明白了，把事情讲清楚了就可以了。

这种文化属性反馈到社交场合。就体现出截然不同的操作了。一般在社交的时候，有三个步骤：首先是对对方所说的话确认（或否定），其次基于对方的话寻找一些共同点，然后则是进一步的提问。

很多亚洲人在进行社交的时候，倾向于寻找非常多的共同点。比如对方说：我去过西安，你可能也会说，我也去过西安。对方说：我老家是东北的，你可能会说，我家也是东北的，距离你老家还很近。但一个有趣的现象就是，很多亚洲文化背景的人会在这一步上停留过长时间，而不会或很慢的进入到第三步。

这在西方人的思维里可能就有些觉得没有必要了。就我个人的理解而言，如果对方不问的话，没有必要说太多关于自己的事情。

而西方人在社交的时候，他们会在第二步短暂停留后迅速转移到第三步。比如：进一步聊一些对方相关的话题。既然是对方相关的话题，那么对方肯定是感兴趣的，这就为后续的聊天奠定了基础。

因此，在有些社交场合，如果当时大家聊的很好，但过后就没有进一步的交流。可能就是因为大家都是基于对彼此的尊重在做的交互。但并不代表对彼此沟通方式的认可。因此，过了之后就没有继续了。

听起来似乎很有道理，以后可以再观察一下。。。

title.title: Stop Killing Games goes to Parliament! Gamers strike back [ ENG - ESP ]
title.body:
https://news.northeastern.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/games_1400.jpg

---

What started as just another complaint within the gaming community is now evolving into something much bigger. Stop Killing Games a movement many viewed as an impossible crusade has just taken a massive leap forward: it has officially reached the European Parliament. And yes, there is good news.

# LET'S GOOOOO

To understand why this matters, we have to look at the root of the problem. Nowadays, buying a video game no longer truly means that you own it. An increasing number of titles rely on online servers, digital licenses, and systems that can be shut down at any moment. When that happens, the game simply ceases to exist for the user—even if they paid for it.

---

https://static.standard.co.uk/2024/12/24/12/29/gamepass-g.jpeg?trim=31,0,31,0&quality=75&auto=webp&width=1000

---

This is where Stop Killing Games comes in—a movement spearheaded by content creator Ross Scott that seeks something quite logical: if you buy a game, you should be able to keep playing it even after the company decides to stop supporting it.

The initiative has been growing gradually, but its true turning point came when it managed to gather over 1.29 million valid signatures across Europe. This is no small feat. Surpassing the one-million mark means the proposal must be officially evaluated by the European Commission, thereby forcing the issue onto the agenda of real political debate.

---

https://tech4gamers.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Stop-Killing-Games.jpg

---


The movement not only reached that milestone but also succeeded in bringing its proposal to a public hearing at the European Parliament—an opportunity typically reserved for initiatives that have truly gained significant traction. This marks a watershed moment: it is no longer just internet noise; it is an issue that politicians are now compelled to discuss. 

From within the industry, groups like Video Games Europe have already voiced their concerns. They argue that mandating the continued functionality of games could be costly, technically complex, and even legally problematic—particularly for titles involving licensing agreements or intricate online systems.


---

https://www.easterneye.biz/media-library/stop-killing-games.png?id=61109094&width=1245&height=700&quality=60&coordinates=8%2C0%2C8%2C0

---

On the other hand, however, players view this as a matter of basic rights. It is not merely about nostalgia or preservation; it is a question of ownership. If you paid for something, why should it be allowed to vanish into thin air?

Cases such as that of *The Crew*—which ceased to function following the shutdown of its servers—were instrumental in igniting this debate. Such situations made it abundantly clear that the current model disproportionately favors corporations, leaving the player with no real control over the products they purchase.

---


https://images.pushsquare.com/9df6678a2c11e/large.jpg

---

Now, an important caveat: this does not yet constitute a definitive victory.

Although the European Parliament has already heard the proposal, the European Commission has until July 2026 to issue an official response. And that response could range from enacting new legislation to simply taking no action at all.

Even so, the mere fact that the movement has reached this stage is a monumental achievement. We are witnessing a multi-billion-dollar industry being challenged on the political stage by organized consumers. That is not something you see every day.

---

https://techedt.gumlet.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Stop-Killing-Games-hits-1.2-million-signatures-but-challenges-remain.jpg.webp?compress=true&quality=80&w=376&dpr=2.6

---

Furthermore, this movement is also sparking a broader debate: what does it truly mean to \

something in the digital age? For if a product can vanish at the sole discretion of a company, then perhaps it was never truly yours. Regardless of whether or not laws are passed, it has already achieved something significant: bringing to the table a problem that had been ignored for years. And it did so through real pressure—backed by hard numbers and a community no longer willing to settle for the status quo.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)







### Español
https://news.northeastern.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/games_1400.jpg --- Lo que empezó como una queja más dentro de la comunidad gamer ahora se está convirtiendo en algo mucho más grande. Stop Killing Games, ese movimiento que muchos veían como una cruzada imposible, acaba de dar un salto brutal: llegó oficialmente al Parlamento Europeo. Y sí, hay buenas noticias. # LET'S GOOOOO Para entender por qué esto importa, hay que ir al problema base. Hoy en día, comprar un videojuego ya no significa realmente que sea tuyo. Cada vez más títulos dependen de servidores online, licencias digitales y sistemas que pueden apagarse en cualquier momento. Cuando eso pasa, el juego simplemente deja de existir para el usuario, aunque lo haya pagado. --- https://static.standard.co.uk/2024/12/24/12/29/gamepass-g.jpeg?trim=31,0,31,0&quality=75&auto=webp&width=1000 --- De ahí nace Stop Killing Games, un movimiento impulsado por el creador de contenido Ross Scott, que busca algo bastante lógico: que si compras un juego, puedas seguir jugándolo incluso cuando la empresa decida dejar de darle soporte. La iniciativa ha ido creciendo poco a poco, pero su verdadero punto de inflexión fue cuando logró reunir más de 1.29 millones de firmas válidas en Europa. Esto no es cualquier cosa. Superar el millón significa que la propuesta debe ser evaluada oficialmente por la Comisión Europea, obligando a que el tema entre en el debate político real. --- https://tech4gamers.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Stop-Killing-Games.jpg --- El movimiento no solo alcanzó esa cifra, sino que también logró llevar su propuesta a una audiencia pública en el Parlamento Europeo, algo reservado para iniciativas que realmente han ganado peso. Esto marca un antes y un después: ya no es solo ruido en internet, es un tema que los políticos están obligados a discutir. Desde la industria, grupos como Video Games Europe ya han mostrado preocupación. Argumentan que obligar a mantener juegos funcionales podría ser costoso, complicado técnicamente y hasta problemático a nivel legal, especialmente en títulos con licencias o sistemas online complejos. --- https://www.easterneye.biz/media-library/stop-killing-games.png?id=61109094&width=1245&height=700&quality=60&coordinates=8%2C0%2C8%2C0 --- Pero del otro lado, los jugadores lo ven como un tema de derechos básicos. No es solo nostalgia o preservación; es una cuestión de propiedad. Si pagaste por algo, ¿por qué puede desaparecer sin más? Casos como el de The Crew, que dejó de funcionar tras el cierre de servidores, fueron clave para encender esta discusión. Ese tipo de situaciones hicieron evidente que el modelo actual beneficia demasiado a las empresas y deja al jugador sin control real sobre lo que compra. --- https://images.pushsquare.com/9df6678a2c11e/large.jpg --- Ahora bien, importante: esto todavía no es una victoria definitiva. Aunque el Parlamento Europeo ya escuchó la propuesta, la Comisión Europea tiene hasta julio de 2026 para dar una respuesta oficial. Y esa respuesta puede ir desde impulsar nuevas leyes hasta simplemente no hacer nada. Aun así, el simple hecho de haber llegado hasta aquí ya es enorme. Estamos hablando de una industria multimillonaria siendo cuestionada a nivel político por consumidores organizados. Eso no pasa todos los días. --- https://techedt.gumlet.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Stop-Killing-Games-hits-1.2-million-signatures-but-challenges-remain.jpg.webp?compress=true&quality=80&w=376&dpr=2.6 --- Además, este movimiento también está abriendo un debate más amplio: ¿qué significa realmente “comprar” en la era digital? Porque si un producto puede desaparecer por decisión de una empresa, entonces quizá nunca fue completamente tuyo. Más allá de si se aprueban leyes o no, ya logró algo importante: poner sobre la mesa un problema que llevaba años ignorado. Y lo hizo con presión real, con números y con una comunidad que ya no está dispuesta a aceptar lo de siempre.
