title.title: My introductory post
title.body:
Introduction Post

Hello everyone,

I’m Amy, and I’m glad to be here on Hive.

I’ve always enjoyed writing in different forms , not just stories, but also anything that lets me express thoughts clearly and creatively. Over time, writing has become more than something I do for fun; it’s become a way I understand and share ideas.

Sometimes it’s storytelling, sometimes it’s reflective writing or even fiction, and other times it’s just putting emotions or everyday thoughts into words. I like keeping things simple, real, and easy to connect with.

A little about me,I started writing quite early, mostly in private at first. Over time, I began sharing my work with a few people, and that encouraged me to keep improving. That’s part of why I’m here now: to grow more, share more, and learn along the way.

I’m still developing as a writer, but I’m committed to consistency and improvement. Every post I share here is part of that process.

I joined Hive to share my work with people who appreciate reading, and to connect with others who enjoy writing in different forms.

If you enjoy honest, thoughtful, and creative writing, feel free to follow my journey. I’d really appreciate it.

Thank you for reading.

#hive #hivelearners #OCD #myhiveintroduction #hivenaija

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Hundreds of activists tried to force their way into a Wisconsin beagle breeding and research facility — and it turned into tear gas, pepper spray, road blockages, and arrests. The ugly part isn’t just the clash. It’s that this was the **second direct action in two months**, which tells you this fight is no longer a normal protest story. It’s escalation.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: Thank you so much for your support!
title.author: bombaycrypto

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The scene was Ridglan Farms in Blue Mounds, about 25 miles southwest of Madison. Authorities said **300 to 400 protesters** pushed past designated protest zones, blocked roads, and tried to breach the property. Protesters attempted to get over barricades that included a manure trench, hay bales, and barbed wire. Some made it through the outer fence, but none got into the main facility housing roughly **2,000 beagles**.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 Law enforcement’s position was blunt: this was not peaceful. Dane County Sheriff Kalvin Barrett said officers were being assaulted and emergency access was being obstructed, which is why police used crowd-control weapons. Ridglan also said one person drove a pickup through the front gate and nearly hit officers and staff. That moved the situation from protest into something a lot closer to chaos.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The activists weren’t improvising. The Coalition to Save the Ridglan Dogs had publicly promoted a plan to seize dogs, though they moved a day earlier than advertised. Their leader, Wayne Hsiung, was arrested at the scene. And this matters because in **March**, protesters already broke into the same facility and removed **30 dogs**, with **27 people arrested** afterward. Saturday was part two, not an isolated blowup.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body:
5/5 🧵 The deeper issue is why Ridglan has become such a flashpoint. The company denies animal mistreatment and says no credible abuse has been substantiated. But it also agreed in October to give up its state breeding license effective **July 1** as part of a deal to avoid prosecution on animal mistreatment charges. So both sides are dug in: activists see moral urgency, the company denies wrongdoing, and the standoff is getting more combustible. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/19/us-news/tear-gas-pepper-spray-and-arrests-as-protesters-try-to-storm-a-wisconsin-beagle-lab/)

title.body: > https://youtu.be/vC_jI1Vo39w?si=Td5J-qDmhnvC3pcr Whenever we talk about the purpose of our existence, for me it is something I usually take my time to think about it and not handle casually. I actually believe that everyone of us on this planet earth is not on this earth by accident. What do I mean? There is always a reason and agenda why God created everyone of us. The major reason first is for all of us to know God, to serve Him and not only that but also to live according to his will for our lives. The Bible says in Revelation 4:11, “You are worthy, O Lord… for You created all things, and by Your will they exist and were created. I personally have come to understand that when we talk about our purpose, it is not really about our own selves. It is actually about living for God and not only that helping others to achieve the plans and purposes for God in their life. In Ecclesiastes 12:13, it says, “Fear God and keep His commandments, for this is the whole duty of man. This is to show that our true purpose is not in us getting rich or even fame, it is in obedience to God and not even to man. Now one of the things I have come to understand about life is the fact that life can really be confusing. Sometimes I can keep asking myself why I am even here. But one of the things that I love about the scripture is the fact that it has a way of helping you out and trust me, it has helped me out several times. When I read Jeremiah 29:11, I feel comfort: “For I know the plans I have for you… plans for good and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope.”

title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/4 🧵 The core of the case is simple: Bingham, 35, was at Los Angeles International Airport on March 15, preparing to fly to Las Vegas, when he became convinced a TSA officer had taken his backpack and passport. Authorities say he grabbed the officer’s uniform, ripped off his ID lanyard, pulled his hair, and shoved him into a glass wall.

title.title: Splinterlands Gladius Pack Opening: Get Incredible Luck and Gold Foil in 4 Packs
title.body:
> Guild Brawl and Gladius Pack Opening in the Splinterlands game world are always exciting experiences. Especially when you work hard to accumulate Merits and open the packs with the hope of getting new cards with those accumulated Merits. Today, I will share with you one such experience in which I opened four Gladius cases at once. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZGvDRMeFYRT7jKbCAn4fLBDstczNQVcu4fYR1XF1M9yQ/1776613967918.jpg) Those who play the game regularly know that Gladius cards are a bit different from normal cards. Their special 'Bloodlust' ability can turn the tide of battle at any time. I had accumulated quite a few Merits, so I thought I would open the packs today. I went to the Guild Store and saw that I had more than 10,000 Merits. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZFHU2Nrvgpj67Uqq675opCYn7PL2h2pkrENFQD3TuKiq/1776613985714.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJwGX29b2nWvc625XvRjzw2gB3ofAhYTcGrjfhSFWSRY/1776613985737.jpg) It takes 2,000 Merits to buy each Gladius case. So I decided to spend a total of 8,000 Merits and buy four packs. But just buying packs is not enough, you also need some boosters or stones to increase your chances of getting good quality cards. So I thought of buying some Blood Stones and Power Stones. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmasjYBxhSukSejkrZgD7xr5rbXPvMinPqmWzWc2TsXFwP/1776614002912.jpg) Blood Stones basically increase your chances of getting Legendary cards. I collected 20 Blood Stones so that my luck would be a little more favourable when each card is generated. Then I looked at Gold Foil Cards. Because getting a Gold Foil Card means that your account value and your dominance in the game will increase a lot. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaiw3hahUCE2YzZFmRqejB8YhbcDq7GJ8HRqQDUDEfqi8/1776614019427.jpg) I also bought 13 Power Stones to increase the drop rate of Gold Foil Cards. After all the preparations, I now have 4 packs and enough booster stones. Now I just have to open the packs. Honestly, this moment before opening a pack is always quite exciting. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSnhzAkBvQYfENbBFKZxwycZcCajsVMvA2hVSSsNzF7xY/1776614030798.jpg) While opening the pack, there was a hope in my mind that I would get at least one gold foil or a good-quality rare card. As soon as I opened the first pack, my eyes widened. I got more than I imagined. The gold foil 'Katreba Gobson' came out of the first pack. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUWfx4bQcUDa4mDwmpHt5Yp5kcSp898kmkvNSAuFjaqye/1776614043313.jpg) Katreba Gobson is a very powerful card, especially its sonic attack and bloodlust ability make it unique. And when it is available as a gold foil, there is no limit to the joy. This pack also had a rare card 'Kotriphus Bayne'. All in all, the first pack was amazing in a word. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZA9Cbr4raH63Y7jehfjGvpXSmAn2Vdzugw37ch8BPo1u/1776614054446.jpg) This card will greatly increase the power of my Earth unit. Then I opened the rest of the packs one by one. After opening the second pack, I was not disappointed. There were two great rare cards there, 'Sarius' and 'Ajax Lightfoot'. Although there was no gold foil, the cards had a lot of utility. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR8VVUTqiZV9YZWrqTNLGQDET2frRohVAMjWGatqcaemP/1776614066060.jpg) There was also a kind of excitement when opening the third pack. In this pack, I got 'Relenor Cleaver', which is a great rare card. In addition, there are cards like Helmet Kharafax and Bertrol Gobson as common cards that will help level up the card. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQTChaqfn5hBbqA3S2FoMWr2P6mhEHMAMrrGbBK2QY7tj/1776614087697.jpg) Today's pack opening session was very successful for me. title.title: Pasta with vegetables and sausage
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb5hcxjiAWPQTpu7mNQC5YtmhQumSC2y2DLr51h1AwPZ9/image.png)

I haven't posted anything for a while.
No time due to work and studies. Also, to improve my workflow, I had to write a few generators.
I would like to post something creative, but today is Sunday and today is a small post about food.

In fact, it was prepared \

It all started when I took a frozen smoked sausage out of the freezer. Sometimes I freeze products that I bought too much of. This is one of those cases.

I peeled and chopped one carrot, a small onion, and some garlic.
I bought pasta that wasn't too expensive. I bought it on sale.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTmJaQk7kWv1qi3ufKeZrtXDA3wh2boGcMp2PVyJAB23v/image.png)

Frying pan time!
Sausage cut into thin slices, olive oil and a little pork lard fried with the meat. Yeah, it's not vegetarian at all and not very healthy) maybe about healthy food next time.
It needs to be fried a little to get a light crust.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeXSzeUmTNtf1xhNB7g8ttt1x8n5hqbW6RzrqxfJRdPdg/image.png)

At this stage I added the prepared vegetables. First the onions and carrots. Need to fry them for a couple of minutes so that the onions become a little golden.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVMd2pauv9cNR7fr9rEh48vcBcGmhKRAAKzXFZfoiPhpz/image.png)

Now I added spices and garlic.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdr1C8mGGP2fe8rR4ycyHTqmvWAWgrD63DiLdgEwoWPC/image.png)

Time to add frozen vegetables. For example, today I used \

(Now this is not an advertisement).
In fact, you can use any frozen vegetables that cook in under 10 minutes.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcioKXsXzRL5TZsJtKct4wjeN3EM8JGSS6yNfouiVUGbr/image.png)

Now I add a little water so that the vegetables are \

but not burnt.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma9C13yN2KKjcrxrRiyTLPRY7AE4wssk8M8DkmNzFaw6o/image.png)

While the vegetables are cooking, I throw the pasta into salted water (about a teaspoon of salt (5-7 grams) per 1 liter of water).

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdBLf9Cn9SBtBvucYHdgA4RknvGM2cYFdzJ49e6KuBXA4/image.png)

This time I added a little tomato (tomato paste). To add a little sourness. Actually, you can cook without tomato.

Of course, everything needs to be stirred from time to time and the temperature of the stove needs to be monitored.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZWLQDKvF5bh9Yugam5vdwprJ9Y4RFqYFWpWzr8RnSUfG/image.png)

The vegetables and pasta cook in just 7-8 minutes. After that, the pasta can be mixed with the vegetables in the pan.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYTBKtnLR8MWKYqSwroARmEdAFCtwghZkEEqh2kbwyon7/image.png)

The pasta and vegetables should be thoroughly mixed and fried for another 1-2 minutes.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeJU5ZUbGWaE1TocVaSAFfkVb5NomQa6VduYLQHjke225/image.png)

Total cooking time is a maximum of 20 minutes. The price in my area is a little over $1.

title.title: More than necessary.
title.body:
More than necessary.

Some time ago, I was cleaning out my closet and saw a ton of junk that had accumulated there over the years. I'd periodically shuffled things I thought might be useful one day, but I should have thrown them all out and started over. LOL.

On the one hand, excess isn't so bad, but it teaches, at least for me, not to focus on the more important things and to throw out the unimportant.

Supposedly important things are like the huge black shadow of a small white bird, which you don't immediately notice, because the shadow is the first thing you see.

![DSC07826.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUUEDxi5BehQSfy8TAWtaWjDwYWTkbJevgbEQ6y63Tiid/DSC07826.JPG)

What good is a river of dirty water when you just want to take a sip of clean water?

It's the same with old junk. For some, it's not junk, just like dirty water can be useful, for example, for watering, but I'm not thinking about watering it yet... or am I?

Doubts like these make junk accumulate in the pantry. LOL.

![DSC08957.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmP8UMoZp6zHadE4Mj8hFq6g1jqcGH6Pru4KWFkrqBzVCq/DSC08957.JPG)

also doesn't work in favor of getting rid of unnecessary junk as quickly as possible. title.title: Another PHO Story...
title.body:
Hello Asean Hive Community

Today I will share another foodie post, the usual thing I keep doing here on Asean HIVE Community. But this one is a bit different, it is a response or an idea I have got after reading @viviehardika post here: https://ecency.com/@viviehardika/my-first-pho-in-vietnam.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EoeEuct1S8B6zFiLEVcqjwwRKGpkX3jqEJCTtZR8kBNF3Uzr66VaX5WMF4YpsJcbcwU.jpg

I have visited many PHO outlet recently, well exactly in the last three months. I liked PHO a lot in the past, before Covid. I often ordered is and tried several places, but since Covid came I had not eaten them anymore due to the price. Yes, PHO is not a cheap one here.

The place I visited here had the highest rating among all PHO restaurant in Jakarta - Indonesia. So I could expect they were the best, right? This place was not the first one I visited in this year, there were other places too.

However I kept this one in draft, because I visited with someone I knew from some dating app and it ended up not well. So I could not use some of the pic I had stored in my disk.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tc3s4W5ozYSUPD4S5GwJbKXGSkT5txro8wMKAhGWBtmn48xwRAUJfCXgVwUpGGz8Z2q.jpg

Talking about the price, it was not the highest one. I could name two other places that had higher or more expensive price. For a couple people, they charged 263.000 Rupiah or around 13.6 USD. It was not something that expensive, but far from cheap.

Anyway the name BO TAI means sliced beef, but in Indonesia you should not yell BO TAI - BO TAI recklessly. It has different meaning, but I could not explain it... I will let uncle @happyphoenix and uncle @ekavieka to explain what is BO TAI in Indonesia if you are curious about it... hopefully you are not!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EpA1xmJvD59qNMRmZeJaw1S7fBZkqLz7LBzChHuXRXvJafLq16F1Ettezat6aukJKYE.jpg

So this was my PHO, it was PHO BA BA DAC BIET. The most expensive one but it looked so plain. I was a bit skeptical before, but the soup turned out to have a great taste.

Later I found out that the place had higher rating because people believe it was more delicious than the other brand due to having LARD in their dish. Yeah the lard made the soup more tasteful however it did not make much difference. Usually in Ramen or Chinese Lamian, we could taste a huge different from dish that use lard and which are halal. But not for PHO, the different is very small.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EpC9vbizpGC3jR4NWoeTLve95XWDpfXkPJ8u1JC9TpNoZkJVZJycd2mrzwRMdUHPZG4.jpg

There are various way to enjoy PHO, however all are depended on how well you know your taste and make a mix of herb and veggies on your PHO soup. Some people love high acidity soup, and they add some squished lime to add it more. I like it too, but not too acid because I have GERD issue lol.

And I do not like plenty of vegetables and herb. So as you can see above, I only added some cut of red peppers, lemon basil leaves and beansprout. at that time, I tried new leaf, it was Culantro or we called it Daun Walang Sangit. it was a hard, thorny and very bitter. It was a bad decision from me, but It was a good experience on the other part, as I never tried it before.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23xemxfaBvF96Gh9WHMVzwWrFQ2uiRfoDsRiwHArRn9QdAgWsvxKxvxWp8jpUYrjKNMYf.jpg

title.title: Daily Habits That Make You More Productive While Working from Home...
title.body:
Working from home gives flexibility and comfort, but it also demands strong discipline. Without a proper routine, it becomes easy to get distracted, delay tasks, or lose focus. Productivity doesn’t depend on working longer hours; it depends on building the right daily habits that keep you consistent and focused.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPFsnjkxZ9sMnG5UCJR5evkR34wN7vtdCMVFKf7rKfHm1/img_3588.png)

The first important habit is starting your day with a fixed routine. Waking up at the same time every day helps your mind stay structured. Instead of rushing into work immediately or spending time on your phone, giving yourself a calm start helps you feel more organized and ready for the day ahead. Even a simple morning routine like freshening up, having breakfast, and planning your day can improve your mindset.

Another important habit is creating a clear separation between personal life and work life. When you work from home, it becomes easy to mix both. Having a dedicated workspace helps your brain understand when it is time to focus. It doesn’t need to be a big setup; even a small table and chair in a quiet corner can improve concentration and reduce distractions.

Planning your tasks before starting work also plays a big role in productivity. When you know exactly what needs to be done, you waste less time thinking and more time executing. Writing down your tasks or mentally setting priorities gives direction to your entire day. It also reduces stress because you are not constantly figuring out what to do next.

Time management is another key habit. Working continuously without breaks may feel productive, but it actually reduces efficiency over time. Dividing your work into focused sessions with short breaks in between keeps your mind fresh. This method helps you maintain concentration and avoid burnout during long working hours.

Avoiding distractions is equally important. At home, distractions are everywhere—mobile phones, social media, TV, or even small household interruptions. Keeping your phone away or on silent during work hours can significantly improve focus. The less you switch between tasks, the more productive you become.

Short breaks during work are not a waste of time; they actually improve performance. A few minutes of rest, stretching, or walking helps refresh your mind and improves energy levels. When you return to work after a break, you are more focused and creative.

Finally, ending your day with a small review helps you stay consistent. Checking what you achieved and planning for the next day gives clarity and reduces confusion. It also builds a strong sense of progress over time.

Working from home can be highly productive if you build the right habits. Discipline, consistency, and proper planning are what turn an ordinary routine into a successful and efficient work life.

title.title: The Quiet Before the Storm
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcGcpV3pK6u4Txzd2fZAhqKq5W9dtsAMnnZKVek4MN8tT/img_6446.dng)

Sundays.

Lazy. Quiet. The storm coming in.

I stood there longer than I expected, just watching. The sky was doing that thing it does before the rain arrives, shifting, deepening, gathering itself. The sea did not resist it. It simply held it, steady and unbothered, like it had seen this all before.

There was no rush in the air. No urgency to fix or change anything. Just a slow unfolding. The kind that asks nothing from me except to notice it.

I realised how rare that feels. To stand still without reaching for my phone. To let a moment be enough without trying to capture or improve it. To sit inside the quiet and not rush to fill it.

Amazing how some days are more sublime than others, right?

Not because they are brighter or easier. But because something shifts inside me. I soften. I pay attention. I allow things to be as they are.

The storm will come. The sky will darken. The moment will pass.

But for now, there is this.

And it is enough.

title.title: 囚徒困境……
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![8TWuohIaFqNvE5QX_1000026581.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/8TWuohIaFqNvE5QX_1000026581/8TWuohIaFqNvE5QX_1000026581.webp)
![4W9MdUXslFTq5FCB_1000026582.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/4W9MdUXslFTq5FCB_1000026582/4W9MdUXslFTq5FCB_1000026582.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

这几天，看了一个帖子，忽然就感觉茅塞顿开。
套用一下网上常说的话，那就是，我们都被资本做局了。
设想这样一个场景，你没有结婚之前，如果你是单身男性，那么，为了利益最大化，你要做的是不是就是哪工资高就往哪里去，哪怕苦点累点。
但是只要熬几年，弄个车子和房子首付钱，然后就把重点放在找对象上。
那么，如果你是单身女性，你为了利益最大化，你或许就会把工资刨除衣食住行后的余额，用来健身啊或者护肤，又或者是成长自己之类的。
本质上，男方希望自己拥有更多钱，然后娶到一个更优秀的女孩，女性希望自己也更优秀，然后遇到一个优质男性。
这就是双方的利益最大化，而一旦步入婚姻以后，尤其是当有了孩子。
那么，双方的利益最大化就会变成，男性有可能觉得以自己一个人的工资养活全家有点压力大，而女性因为生孩子外加做月子乃至照顾孩子以后，有了几年的职场空窗期。
且目前职场依然会存在一些对于生育后女性的职场歧视，本质就是怕女生要照顾家庭无法全心投入到职场中。
所以这导致她们并不容易找到好工作，这时候她的利益最大化就成了再生个孩子去绑定老公，这样也有充足的理由不去上班。
而这样一来就容易陷入恶性循环，就是可能刚开始生一胎，女性的职场空窗期只是两三年，三四年，且年龄还不算太大，一旦生了二胎，又得空窗两三年，叠加下来，就空窗了五六年了。
假设25岁结的婚，这样一来，就已经过了三十岁，职场歧视更加严重。
那她的利益最大化，最终又只能继续往家庭和孩子身上付出，最终，就形成了传统的男主外，女主内的家庭格局，也就是可能靠着一个男生四五千块钱养一大家子人的格局……
如果没有双方父母的帮衬，那么最终，家庭就会陷入泥潭，需要整天在生存线上奔波，根本没有余力去干额外的事情，只能把全部精力放在鸡娃身上，希望孩子以后能有出息，带领家庭走出困境。
这就是一个典型的囚徒困境，明明看上去每个人都在追求利益最大化，但最终结果就是带着整个家庭陷入困境。
当然，这是那个帖子中举的案例，而生活中还有一个更常见的案例，也就是兄弟分家。
即父母的两个或者n个子女，在结婚后，为了各自小家的利益，都会开始分家，每个人都在追求个人利益最大化，而结果就是可能一个大家族，在老人去世后，直接分崩离析。
所以可以看到某些家庭最后越过越好的一个原因，就是人家两口子是追求家庭利益最大化，而非个人利益最大化。
举个最简单的例子就是，有的人结婚了还总拎不清，总试图通过在外人面前去贬低自己的伴侣，以此来诉说自己这段婚姻里多委屈，却忘记了，这样其实也是在贬低自己。
当然啦，说这么多，但是始终人还是自私的。
婚姻内背叛的案例也不在少数，所以重点还是得看人啊，有的人，他的确也不值得……
你觉得呢？

title.title: Cycling in Germany - My Actifit Report Card: April 19 2026
title.body:
This was the most active day so far, in the morning I went out cycling together with my daughter, lots of gravel paths here and forest to ride through, it's such a difference from what I'm used to in the area I live in. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a373ad08-c7e6-4c26-8c05-fe00098ea5d6.jpg) We're in Germany at the moment but only just 15km over the border with the Netherlands and we actually crossed the border back in to the Netherlands with our bikes, this sort of guard tower was really cool and marked the border with poles with both the German and the Dutch flag. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4a65e29f-1b9a-4f89-97d0-848c2909a7a4.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/219f59cd-47cb-4cf6-97b9-b2a87bff5520.jpg) Her legs got destroyed on the final climb back to the rental house, so I dropped her off at our house for the week, I went for a 'small ride' myself, I'll be back shortly I told my wife because it was only 17km... But DAMN then I arrived in the woods with yet another climb warning from my Garmin, 167 meters this time but it was all off-road and some of the climbs were really steep with roots and rocks making things difficult, awesome but difficult! Of course me being a total noob in climbing, I crashed 😅 so I tried again with another line and it worked, lessons learned and hyped from the experience. I've shot some awesome footage that will make a great video! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8d05bb44-e22d-4b7a-8b40-9932221a0958.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d54f3dee-a275-434c-85f1-83f15f4c5971.jpg) Thanks to @stella16 for making the pictures because I first need to edit the camera's footage when I'm home, for now I'm dumping every ride on a large external hard drive, every ride is about 180 - 230 Gigabyte 😄 pretty crazy! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5bbd69a4-d381-4855-b828-d347d1830a9f.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e1b70e07-f0c0-4bc9-a0ec-c5c40bb3f274.jpg) In total the two rides combined were about 54km, after a shower and a meal we went for a small walk with the dog and played beach tennis on the field in front of our house, it's dinner time now... Time to relax!

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXYKpgStfYzrzEmgJLEtqep2Ts1jUNYaDQtWSTKyHukcA/img_20260328_093720.png)</center>

​Hi everyone! I took this photo because I found the way the thorny trunk looked when I got close with my phone really interesting. It looks abstract, like a monster, and that caught my eye because you can only see it this way if you get close enough.

​From a distance, among many others of its kind, the plant looks completely normal. No one would guess that it looks half-alien when you take a macro shot 😁. Because of this, I finally understand why some photographers told me they’re passionate about macro photography: you can totally transform reality, and it's actually quite fun.

***
***
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXYKpgStfYzrzEmgJLEtqep2Ts1jUNYaDQtWSTKyHukcA/img_20260328_093720.png)</center>

Hola a todos. Tomé esta foto porque me pareció interesante la forma en que se veía el tronco espinoso cuando me acercaba con el celular. Se ve abstracto, como un monstruo, y eso me llama la atención porque solo se puede ver de esta forma si te acercas lo suficiente. 

La planta, de lejos y entre otras muchas otras parece muy normal. Nadie percibiría que al hacerle un macro parezca medio alienígena 😁. Por esta razón, entiendo ahora a algunas fotógrafas cuando me decían que les apasiona la macrofotografía: es que se puede transformar totalmente la realidad y es bastante divertido.

今天又舒舒服服的过了一天，放假真好，不过，今天欢欢可苦了，上午去上课了，下午老师叫过去补了一小时课，感觉这个数学老师真的负责，看着孩子没有搞懂，又把他叫过去了，还是很有责任的，天下如果多几个这样的老师多好。 

去小区外面走，也没有碰到特别熟的人，我在想，公司的同事都跑哪里去，楼下那个水果店，生意不好，终于倒了，这倒可是惨了我们，因为我和老公都爱吃香蕉，这样买个香蕉还要走好远的路。 

周五回来虽然心里很烦，可是在家过了几天，什么都给忘记了，还是要好好享受每一天吧，上午也没有做什么事，早样子，还是做饭给欢仔吃，孩子了去上课了，好吃的还是要好好的搞给他吃。

上午忙了一上午，下午还好去凤山走了走，每天没有晒太阳，我感觉心里慌，所了还是出去走走好，在凤山时看到一只可爱的狗，给他喂草都吃。

晚上我们又去跳了健身操，我把老公也叫过去了，回来时，看到一个穿着很性感的女生在领舞，整个队伍好热情的，搞得我和老公也停止了走路，后来加入他们队伍跟着热舞起来，呵呵，想起来挺好玩的。

欢欢现在表现，我还是很满意，上完课回来，还去外面打了蓝球，看来他把时间也排得紧紧的，非常充实的一天，给了欢欢50元钱，叫他买了零食回来，他既然买了好大几瓶喝茶的饮料，我说你什么不买些饼干，他说妈妈，我在减肥哟，我现在瘦了10斤，我还想瘦点，也不知这娃能不能成功。

不过，看着他的样，我也想笑，我说你怎么瘦下来的，其实很简单，少吃米饭就好了，呵呵，这真值得借鉴。

title.title: My first book signing /Ma première séance de dédicace EN /FR
title.body:
Hello dear readers, /Bonjour chers lecteurs,

Yes, that’s it! My first book signing took place in Jette (Brussels) on Saturday 11 April 2026, from 2 pm to 5.30 pm.

> Ouiii, ça y est ! Ma première séance de dédicace a eu lieu, à Jette (Bruxelles), le samedi 11 avril 2026 de 14h à 17h30.
 
![11avr26 dedicace jette bis.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/faustine.books/23xAbqmnDgV4BGHebcA4tXNM5T6Gkcmoi1wK4zskozNB9aekKNt2tudMDzHR8ofJfXhaS.jpg)
*My sister (on the right) and me (on the left) /Ma sœur (à droite) et moi (à gauche)*

A few people had indicated on Facebook that they were interested, so I was expecting to catch up with old acquaintances after more than 30 years.

The book signing was originally due to take place at the Tennis Club, but I was told the day before that a councillor had booked the venue for a private event and that I wouldn’t be able to use it that afternoon. 

Fortunately, not far from the tennis clubhouse, about a hundred metres away, is the sports hall with a large cafeteria, which was happy to accommodate us after a phone call the day before. 
I quickly spread the word about the change of venue on my social media, notifying those interested so they would have the information in good time.

The manager of the cafeteria set us up opposite the stairs, so that we would be clearly visible to people arriving.

> Quelques personnes avaient noté être intéressées, sur Facebook, je m'attendais donc à revoir d'anciennes connaissances, après plus de 30 ans.
> 
> Normalement, la séance de dédicace devait avoir lieu au Chalet du tennis, mais il m'a été annoncé la veille qu'un échevin avait privatisé l'endroit et que je ne pourrais pas m'y installer pour l'après-midi. 
> 
> Heureusement, non loin du chalet du tennis, à une centaine de mètres de là, se trouve la salle omnisports avec une grande cafétéria, qui nous a accueillis avec plaisir en passant un coup de fil la veille. 
J'ai rapidement fait passer le mot de la modification de lieu, sur mes réseaux sociaux, en notifiant les personnes intéressées pour qu'elles aient l'info à temps.
> 
> Le responsable de la cafétéria nous a installés, face à l'escalier, de façon à être bien visibles des personnes qui arrivaient.

No sooner had I sat down than an old school friend turned up to buy two copies (one for herself and one for her mother-in-law, who used to be my French teacher). A few other books were sold to people I knew. 

The customers at the sports hall didn’t seem particularly interested this time. Apparently, a book fair takes place around September in the same venue. We’ll make sure to come back then.

There were a few children playing with a (foam) ball behind us, as it was a wide corridor. Their balls would sometimes land against or under our chairs and, from time to time, fly over our heads as well. The surrounding noise was quite disturbing for me, as I like peace and quiet, but it all went well.

We then walked for half an hour to get back to the car. Fortunately, the rain had stopped. 

We were glad to get home, happy with this experience which went well, thanks to my sister’s help in accompanying us.

> A peine assis, une ancienne copine de classe a fait son apparition pour m'acheter 2 exemplaires (un pour elle et un pour sa belle-maman, qui est mon ancienne prof de français). Quelques autres livres ont été vendus à des connaissances. 
> 
> Les clients de la salle omnisports ne semblaient pas fort intéressés, cette fois-ci. Un salon du livre a, apparemment, lieu vers septembre au même endroit. Nous ferons en sorte d'y revenir à ce moment-là.
> 
> Il y avait quelques enfants qui jouaient au ballon (en mousse) derrière nous, puisque c'était un large couloir. Leurs ballons atterrissaient parfois contre ou sous nos chaises et, de temps en temps, volaient aussi par-dessus nos têtes. Le bruit environnant était assez dérangeant pour moi qui aime le calme, mais ça s'est bien passé.
> 
> Nous avons fait une demi-heure de marche ensuite, pour rejoindre la voiture. Heureusement, la pluie s'était arrêtée. 
> 
> Nous étions contents de rentrer à la maison, heureux de cette expérience qui s'est bien déroulée, avec l'aide de ma sœur, pour nous accompagner.

My next book signing will take place in Lessines on the afternoon of 21 May, during an open-house event. Lessines is also in Belgium, but I’ve never been there before. So the satnav will come in very handy.

After that, I’ll be taking part in the Belgian Literature Fair at the Palais des Congrès in Mons on 6 and 7 June. That’s very close to home, and we’re starting to get to know the area.

It’s the start of a wonderful adventure! 

The initial feedback has been positive, which is a real boost 😀. 
I’m thinking about the next part of the story, and a second book is currently being written.

> Ma prochaine séance de dédicace se déroulera à Lessines, le 21 mai après-midi, lors de portes ouvertes. Lessines se trouve aussi en Belgique, mais je n'y ai jamais été. Le GPS nous sera donc bien utile.
> 
> Ensuite, je participerai au Salon de la Littérature Belge, au Palais des Congrès de Mons, les 6 et 7 juin. Là, ce sera tout près de chez nous et nous commençons à connaître l'endroit.
> 
> C'est le début d'une belle aventure ! 
> 
> Les premiers retours de lecture sont positifs, cela fait du bien au moral 😀. 
Je réfléchis à la suite de l'histoire et un deuxième livre est en cours d'écriture.

My book is currently only available in French. The links below are also only available in French.

- For those who wish to read ‘Les Montana : au-delà du totem’ on Kindle: [Kindle version](https://www.amazon.fr/Montana-Au-del%C3%A0-du-totem-ebook/dp/B0GQJL5812/ref=sr_1_1?crid=Z6BJS7U949OA&dib=eyJ2IjoiMSJ9.VQbXmOyeuMmd7YSCp-pyquOG1Qva6sTdDnfKOmdR3F4-XVQ9xTeueXc_9SUrLaAEGQHNEXwacHn4BT_NHYX1LX4KvuBU23zjuFrs5q605G8hDV04Dsiy069YKBXuYpLUgqgiSfy1bTOXbeGLG0LHX7qtIlJZOcF8gf9zx75crus9mmW_1TYbSeDXYPv3_jm9qtzakAliwJUsi3LApscaNdsLbRXiRpbIRYnpvhWx51dmDWKWzxxzMAJteaikAfXrG94rYSQTy_HC9RNQeZLIUyAIVWLQ-0XBArsxBvJfQZQ.VMhrCZVxFKVe6NwzRLAgD68o3X35A4GSdfUC4C3f9bY&dib_tag=se&keywords=boens&qid=1776610371&sprefix=boens%2Caps%2C265&sr=8-1)

Enjoy reading and see you soon,

This will be *Week 213 Edition 03* of our Weekly Featured Content. ![Copy of Copy of Copy of TPEP's Friday Feature (7).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kronias/23xVTyFLGvEj7ZJjypsvkhoZ92HH1YqHzmkCYTXqLVmNNNi7E3rDLfQ42zxZn2vH5CVM3.png)
Made With Canva
So, last Saturday we had our hangout as usual, and it was just so much fun that we did not want it to end. We are currently on the third topic for this week, which is “COUNT YOUR BLESSINGS”. But before we proceed with the details of the topic, let us take a look at the winners of the last topic, which was “PLANNING OR IMPULSIVE”. This topic was geared toward each member of the community, telling us about their attitudes towards making decisions. For many, they could be impulsive, doing things without thinking much about them or the consequences they could have. And for others, they think hard and make plans before embarking on the decisions. We got to see that in the end, everyone only does what works best for themselves, and the method that they believe brings in more results. No one way is better, because in some cases, one would most definitely be more effective than the other. It was an enlightening topic, indeed. ***
> For this topic, we went through every entry post, and that is every post with the #hl-exclusive & #hl-w213e2 tag. And with the number of wonderful posts out there, it was quite difficult to make a selection. But eventually, we did just that. And so, the posts that will be featured not just for their exceptional content, but also for their level of engagement with other authors, will be listed below. ![hl_footer.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnAnsqHA4KMYRqnS9QzWMpQUxM71wRhKabXz7paozHKJ/hl_footer.png)

Featured Contents


[WHEN THE WORLD GOES TO HELL](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@intishar/control-the-life-as-much-as-possible-5dt) by @intishar
*For this author, he told us that life rarely goes according to plan. But still, he makes plans. Every step he takes is carefully planned and curated for major impact. He is always strategic. And he always tries to plan for things not going as he wishes, making sure that no matter how things go, he's not stranded.*
[DO YOU REALLY NEED A PLAN FOR EVERYTHING](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@bhattg/do-you-really-need-a) by @bhattg
*For this author, he told us that he is a bit mixed when it comes to planning and being impulsive. He plans for some things and doesn’t for others. Things work out more easily when you plan for them, and you also have the opportunity to consider all eventualities. In the end, it all depends on the kind of person we are.”
[PLANNING COMES FIRST FOR ME](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@treasuree/planning-comes-first-for-me) by @treasuree
*This author told us that she’s a planner both for big things and for the little ones. Life can be very unpredictable, and things can go wrong in seconds, so being without a plan could upset the balance of a person’s life. But then, she has also come to learn that regardless of how much we plan, not everything will always go according to plan.*
*** > All of the above contents were supported by our official curation account [lazy-panda](https://peakd.com/@lazy-panda) with an extra amount. The first 3 authors will receive 100 ECENCY Points [ Sponsored By Ecency Team (@melinda010100) ] and 1 $PANDAMINER each as a reward next Monday. These posts were selected because of their special attention to detail and how they followed the topic. There were a lot of good ones out there, but we just could not pick them all. But then, we have some honorable mentions listed below:

Honorable Mention

[MAP IT OUT OR FIGURE IT OUT LATER](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@nhaji01/map-it-out-or-figure) by @nhaji01 [THE MIDDLEGROUND LIFE: PART PLANNER, PART FREE SPIRIT- HERES WHAT ACTUALLY WORKS](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@idksamad78699/the-middleground-life-part-planner-part-free-spirit-heres-what-actually-works-l5d) by @idksamad78699 [STRATEGIC THINKING](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@emrysjobber/s-5b3b048bff3f4) by @emrysjobber These are posts that were also found to be quite exceptional. ---- ---- ![hl_footer.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnAnsqHA4KMYRqnS9QzWMpQUxM71wRhKabXz7paozHKJ/hl_footer.png)
AND NOW, WE MOVE ON TO THE NEW TOPIC!
***

title.title: Splinterlands -My Simple Plan for Back-to-Back Wins.
title.body:
‎Hello everyone,
I'm @naturaluttom. I hope everyone is well, I'm fine too.
Today I played my favorite game Splinterlands again and to be honest today was an amazing day for me. Because today I won three to four matches in a row, and I got about 40 points in each match. Due to this, my rank has advanced a lot and I am very happy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbc1pv2ZEMqn6gmeH3RELRB9B72zfPuuv7eRrYHHEv1g6/1776612649360.png)


[‎The image was created with AI.]()

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)
Today's gameplay felt a little different to me, because I played very hard today. Before each match, I thought carefully about which cards would be good to place, in which positions my team would be strong. These plans actually helped me win.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPJ1TnGLN7Ce9rUz1nF8TkFPrD5FZKxcYg39osx5Qbu7k/1776611940275.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcm8iQNsKFzbGVcu1HWTgUHUSyLBC12Rk8bVhzJtL8w6c/1776611940492.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZxZTA8sEfWiX6vh7tBN3wxitFRVJ99aTPGuFnZ3MCiFD/1776611940543.jpg)

Especially, I set the combination of my cards very well. I played with a balance of tank, support and damage dealer. As a result, the opponent could not easily break my team. And because of this strategy, I won one match after another.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfPgNwG9ziMftL1dBYKr62ZsHBGfuudmmLiq9HVjvGTmt/1776612046335.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYHprtT5F1wpG8onoNmpDJV91PhFxjVymcPjniCJ4ZREa/1776612046367.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma1pPFqrivQxWFa2Yr1T4yvqKhEGbG8W1yfACNSx4fRCS/1776612046409.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdwZY52qq5LnPzxVVMwoXjgdTYmXxv6gJwxAcK8FMU2BL/1776612046452.jpg)

What I liked the most today is that I realize that my gaming skills are gradually improving. Where I used to play cards haphazardly, now I make thoughtful decisions.

Overall, today was a very successful day for me. I hope to play better and win more matches in the future.

Thank you all for reading my post.. 🙏

title.title: Holy week is it biblical// the old path
title.body:
Holy Week, which is a church tradition, reminds believers of the final days of Jesus Christ. The events, which are written in the Gospels, include His entry into Jerusalem, His suffering, His death, and His resurrection. It, which is important to understand, is not commanded in the Bible as a required observance.

Scripture guides believers, teaches continual remembrance of Christ rather than keeping a fixed holy season. The Lord’s Supper, which is practiced among Christians, serves as a regular reminder of His sacrifice. Faith, which is lived daily, matters more than observing special times.
https://youtu.be/pPci63IrEQs?si=kzcqs5BqSgIa9v2q
Holy Week can be meaningful, helps people reflect on the work of Jesus Christ. It, which should be clearly understood, is not necessary for salvation. A sincere heart, which God values, is more important than religious traditions.

I just had to do a quick doodle today to get this idea out of my head U can totally tell what inspired me yep, my morning cup was just sitting there looking at me. I haven't added any colors yet because I really wanted to focus on getting the shape and the personality right first.
I’m really happy with how the steam on top turned into a little decorative curl that gives the character such a whimsical vibe. I also went for some bold, thick eyebrows like my previous and large eyes because I’m practicing how to give the character more expression . Those tiny ballet style legs and shoes at the bottom are a bit of a challenge for me with proportions, but I think they make the whole teacup body look really dainty and fun.just love the shape of it
The lines are sketchy and raw, but I like it that's the aesthetic. I’m just enjoying the process of turning everyday objects into little friends, even if I’m still learning how to balance all the details.

What color do u think would suit this character best —maybe a classic porcelain white or something more colorful like a floral pattern?

title.title: A Powerful Sacrifice in Battle
title.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ9nxV9Yam9JNYCugSZJttwYf5udGesf9B5qw7MCnzF3j/battle.png</center>

When I first started playing Splinterlands, one of the rewards was the Chaos Legion Reward Cards, and I remember how expensive those cards were compared to current Reward Cards.

One of my favorite Reward Cards back then was the Venari Wavesmith, and I remember it cost $5. That was a great price to earn money since the Venari Wavesmith was just a Rare Card, and you could get it for free by completing Daily Quests or Seasonal Rewards.

There were many other Reward Cards back then; I mentioned the Venari Wavesmith because it was very popular at the time.

Today I'm going to talk about another Reward Card, and that card is the Exploding Rats, a card that seems weak but that I liked to use in my Fire Deck strategies.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeKSDQZBZdJyFYoTmPpXv78ZEtfLWhzw2VrsbsUoTDJtQ/m.png</center>

This is the Exploding Rats, a card that has a major disadvantage: it only has 1 HP. It might seem crazy to use it in battle, but it's fun and it can be useful.

## How do I use the Exploding Rats?

My strategy for Exploding Rats is to use it in the first position, and since it has a large amount of attack speed, it has a good chance of dodging physical attacks.

The main reason I use Exploding Rats is because it has 3 great abilities: Blast, Redemption, and True Strike.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfXUkj4aZHL8hdeDVQEAdAwJkWFQPhyQDQxUurarnjkCM/mm.png</center>

**Blast**: Deals an additional 50% damage (rounded up) to units adjacent to the target.

*This is a great ability to deal more damage to your opponent.*

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRALmRdoUkPxNNs1FcYbyBnTEPtWLNHbPvwkuBdpHscwX/mmm.png</center>

**Redemption**: When defeated, deals 1 physical damage to all enemy units.

*Another great ability to deal more damage to your opponent.*

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcxvD6V4xizbFW6tM4Lg6PvEpn2fFrct12RbfqPC5q2BT/mmmm.png</center>

**True Strike**: Attacks will never miss.

*This is one of my favorite abilities in Splinterlands because I hate missing attacks.*

Currently, I rarely use Exploding Rats in my battles, but I like to use it when the battle rules Equalizer, Super Sneak, and Maneuvers apply.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf2gwEfu6tqmkQw2odVRP1zEptDXha5ne2cCGRgDuzXjD/mmmmm.png</center>

## <center>[Watch The Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_469e7b08a9130d91a8ba38b872150faf?ref=moonblast)</center>

I'll use this battle as an example because it uses the Maneuvers rule, but unfortunately, my opponent used a card with the Thorns ability in the first position, so my strategy didn't work very well with Exploding Rats. However, it was still useful dealing damage with the Blast ability and the Redemption ability.

The real star of the battle was Coeurl Lurker; honestly, this is my favorite card in Splinterlands, and I can't count how many times I've won a battle because of a card.

## Arcade Colony

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeVhSb4SzdyDLvV8kzgZHxx6k28Qf7zRFm1ENJnTfcxxR/mmmmmm.png</center>

Now I'll talk about the **[Arcade Colony](https://arcadecolony.com/)** platform. On it, you'll find the games: **[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=moonblast)**, **[Moon Karts](https://moonkarts.arcadecolony.com/)**, **[StakeHouse Den](https://stakehouseden.arcadecolony.com/)**, and **[Genesis League Goals](https://goals.genesisleaguesports.com/)**.

*For those unfamiliar with Arcade Colony, it's owned by Invennium Corp. Arcade Colony is a platform for arcades and video games with a functional economy based on a governance token, \

.*

**Invennium Corp. is a 100% subsidiary of Splinterlands.**

Find more information about Arcade Colony in my post: **[Discover the Arcade Colony Platform](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@moonblast/discover-the-arcade-colony-platform-lne)**.

title.title: ¿Quien es el Espíritu de Dios? Lectura de Consciencia
title.body:
En este escrito, leerás un perspectiva de acuerdo a lo que he aprendido y lo que he entendido sobre nuestro Padre Eterno.

El espíritu de Dios, es la personalidad de Dios, Shekinah como lo llaman en algunos textos y que también la consideran la pareja o también esposa de Dios, así mismo su traducción en el cristianismo es Espíritu Santo.

Al momento de crear al ser humano Dios el Padre se dirige en plural: ¡Lo haremos a nuestra Imagen y Semejanza!
Eso me despertó la siguiente pregunta ¿Con quien estaba Dios el Padre? La respuesta me llegó después, estaba con su esposa, Shekinah (Espíritu Santo, El amor de Dios). Cuando te dirijas al Espíritu Santo en tus oraciones, piensa en el más como un Ella, como una fuerza femenina pues la energía femenina es la energía Creadora es la que da Luz. Cuando pidamos Guía, Deseos, apoyo para nuestros objetivos o metas, podemos pedirlo al Espíritu de Dios que es Ella y le dará luz a nuestra peticiones.

title.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  David Copperfield #16/457
title.body: If it had ever been meant to be lived in, I might have thought it small, or inconvenient, or lonely; but never having been designed for any such use, it became a perfect abode.

>It was beautifully clean inside, and as tidy as possible. There was a table, and a Dutch clock, and a chest of drawers, and on the chest of drawers there was a tea-tray with a painting on it of a lady with a parasol, taking a walk with a military-looking child who was trundling a hoop. The tray was kept from tumbling down, by a bible; and the tray, if it had tumbled down, would have smashed a quantity of cups and saucers and a teapot that were grouped around the book. On the walls there were some common coloured pictures, framed and glazed, of scripture subjects; such as I have never seen since in the hands of pedlars, without seeing the whole interior of Peggotty's brother's house again, at one view. Abraham in red going to sacrifice Isaac in blue, and Daniel in yellow cast into a den of green lions, were the most prominent of these. Over the little mantelshelf, was a picture of the 'Sarah Jane' lugger, built at Sunderland, with a real little wooden stern stuck on to it; a work of art, combining composition with carpentry, which I considered to be one of the most enviable possessions that the world could afford. There were some hooks in the beams of the ceiling, the use of which I did not divine then; and some lockers and boxes and conveniences of that sort, which served for seats and eked out the chairs.

>All this I saw in the first glance after I crossed the threshold - child-like, according to my theory - and then Peggotty opened a little door and showed me my bedroom. It was the completest and most desirable bedroom ever seen - in the stern of the vessel; with a little window, where the rudder used to go through; a little looking-glass, just the right height for me, nailed against the wall, and framed with oyster-shells; a little bed, which there was just room enough to get into; and a nosegay of seaweed in a blue mug on the table. The walls were whitewashed as white as milk, and the patchwork counterpane made my eyes quite ache with its brightness. One thing I particularly noticed in this delightful house, was the smell of fish; which was so searching, that when I took out my pocket-handkerchief to wipe my nose, I found it smelt exactly as if it had wrapped up a lobster. On my imparting this discovery in confidence to Peggotty, she informed me that her brother dealt in lobsters, crabs, and crawfish; and I afterwards found that a heap of these creatures, in a state of wonderful conglomeration with one another, and never leaving off pinching whatever they laid hold of, were usually to be found in a little wooden outhouse where the pots and kettles were kept.

>We were welcomed by a very civil woman in a white apron, whom I had seen curtseying at the door when I was on Ham's back, about a quarter of a mile off. Likewise by a most beautiful little girl (or I thought her so) with a necklace of blue beads on, who wouldn't let me kiss her when I offered to, but ran away and hid herself. By and by, when we had dined in a sumptuous manner off boiled dabs, melted butter, and potatoes, with a chop for me, a hairy man with a very good-natured face came home. As he called Peggotty 'Lass', and gave her a hearty smack on the cheek, I had no doubt, from the general propriety of her conduct, that he was her brother; and so he turned out - being presently introduced to me as Mr. Peggotty, the master of the house.
>'Glad to see you, sir,' said Mr. Peggotty. 'You'll find us rough, sir, but you'll find us ready.'
>I thanked him, and replied that I was sure I should be happy in such a delightful place.
>'How's your Ma, sir?' said Mr. Peggotty. 'Did you leave her pretty jolly?'
>I gave Mr. Peggotty to understand that she was as jolly as I could wish, and that she desired her compliments - which was a polite fiction on my part.

>'I'm much obleeged to her, I'm sure,' said Mr. Peggotty. 'Well, sir, if you can make out here, fur a fortnut, 'long wi' her,' nodding at his sister, 'and Ham, and little Em'ly, we shall be proud of your company.'

title.title: Day 41: How well backed is the GLD coin?
title.body:
#
Trying to create a stable feeling Tribe token
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/244A93Lcq2bq6VmktL8Mdy9jM8j19pnH1okAMq6ytciXfF1VZb9FeRVioPtbeiu7X7trH.png)

For those who don't know, it is possible for anyone to create a Hive altcoin through Tribaldex. Just pay 100 BEE tokens and you too can issue your very own cryptocurrency. The much harder thing is to support it and make sure that it doesn't suck. Just look through the various offerings on the hive-engine and you will see many many dead coins.
#
The GLD coin started off as an ill informed decision

I will freely admit that the GLD coin was a good idea and a poor decision. It was created at the height of the Splinterlands craze as a \

coin to make our guild different than all the rest. A week or two later the price of cards cratered and the coin became irrelevant.
**But I made a promise to the coin holders that I expected myself to keep**
and that is when I learned the biggest lesson on Hive. **A reputation of trust is everything here** There is an awful lot of hype on the crypto world. There are a lot of broken promises. There is a lot of rubble from great ideas that crashed. **So how can GLD be structured to give it the best chance of success?**

#
Start by understanding there are no certainties

* If HIVE dies GLD dies. No-one can change that. * If hive-engine dies then GLD dies. Can't change that either. But the coin can still have backing that makes it one of the last coins standing over time. Here is the backing behind the GLD coin as it sits. ### Levels of support * Every token held is backed by an asset * Liquidity pool GLD/Hive * Liquidity pool GLD/Swap.Ltc * Trading bot on the hive-engine * Personal website to allow for redemption at PEG

#
Backing
If you look at the information on the GLD coin on the Hive engine you will notice that there are only 75,000 coins minted and that it has a peg price of 0.01 HBD. However if you were to look further you would find that only a tiny fraction of those 75,000 coins are held by individuals. The treasury holds most of the coins. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tSym8QDVHrH8kUzx8ayRp1KWyVr5V1xSwqEuGDwJdqMb2ipELRdMSGwVNG61VnUuUjb.png) Even if every coin was distributed to individuals on Hive it would still be backed by HBD. @tergan holds the HBD and every individual could be paid out with three days notice after the HBD was unstaked. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23t8CSPFBxuJiwkU6VRGzvXAkimeEQeZ7D7qyw6izpo13AFD6MhDbbbyRqz4KfwzAWEvg.png) Now perhaps you are doing some math and saying \

**750** HBD are required to fully back the coin! Which is true but @tergan provides the backing but there is also backing in the liquidity layer. A little math: * HBD locked (manual redemption if requested) -- $742 + $6 Liquid * Hive Engine layer : 100 Hive committed -- 2% commited to buy twice daily * Website for redemptions : Currently $3 HBD and 70 Hive plus 2000 GLD. Amounts will vary as redemptions and purchases happen. * Liquidity Pools : 5 LTC committed with 27K GLD.
GLD has its value backed in multiple places at the 100:1 peg. Liquidity and multiple methods of exchange mean every transaction isn't guaranteed at 100:1

#
Hive Engine backing

Now the hive-engine is the layer which traditionally underpins every tribe token out there. If you make a tribe token and if someone wants to sell you see it on the hive-engine. For GLD the biggest problem is that hive-engine will buy and sell based on HIVE. That is a huge pain for a token like GLD which values itself VS HBD. If hive-engine allowed a HBD/GLD pairing it would be super simple to just offer $0.01 HBD for 1 GLD and like magic it would be at peg all the time. Or at least a portion would be instant. But that isn't how hive-engine works. So there is a bot which will make a small buy order twice a day at a value calculated to simulate the 0.01 HBD to 1 GLD peg. The order book looks like this : ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23sxfpenN1dN2G98t9pagVgYb2L61fqZ1cqo2KPTVQG9EXLVb2SLLGaLQeJNJaRv34Li3.png) Will you reliably get the peg value here? **Honestly? No** Right now you would get **more** than the peg value here because the top bid is a little higher than peg. Also if HIVE tanks then the top buy order will be placed at the peg but the ones under it could be less valuable than the peg value. The hive-engine order book isn't ideal and it has annoyed me forever as there is a stated peg but it is hard to keep using a counter asset which goes up and down like a yo-yo. Also if you look at the order book it is only useful for small amounts of GLD (about 135) at this time. If you are eagle eyed you will notice that $1.35 isn't enough to put total backing over the $750 benchmark for total support of the coin. But there is another backing layer.

#
Private Website and bot

If you want to reliably get the actual peg value there is a website for that. https://gldtrader.netlify.app/ ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23t8D6MYf9SWog8CzrAVNSNFJqwPEedQsoYnsGZKRgE55YVF7ZPDspGHi833oS7d5rtSe.png) Look carefully and you will find it is possible to buy and sell the pairs of * GLD : HBD * GLD : Hive And GLD : HBD is locked at 100:1 .. Full pegged value. Even if the Hive-engine dies this does direct wallet to wallet transfer. It also calculates the instant rate to try and get a very close value for the GLD to HIVE value if you prefer to get actual HIVE. And why would you want HIVE vs HBD? There are many reasons but one of the biggest ones is that if you want to take money from the Hive chain you can't directly convert HBD to the LTC, DOGE, BTC of other \

coins. But now GLD has that covered also with a liquidity pool.

#
GLD : Swap.LTC Bridge

For anyone who holds GLD tokens and wants to get value to an external crypto wallet? There is a bridge for that now on tribaldex. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tmmXSdRPLDuueHNRhY4PttWcrhPLyYAfi61J1hH5vt8oMNMgenA49WhhvH76DNM1swH.png) 5 full LTC is available for exchange and almost 28,000 GLD is locked into that pool. Considering the market cap of 75,000 more than a third of GLD tokens are sitting ties up in that pool. Add in a few more in the GLD : HIVE pool. Liquidity pools aren't guaranteed at PEG. That's just out of the issuer control. However, it is currently holding the PEG value and it is a large enough pool that a fair trade is likely for most holders. Also it is as seamless a withdrawl method as the issuer could devise to allow GLD holders to get value quickly.

#
Final Thoughts

No tribe coin is bulletproof. Every project could vanish with a simple rug pull from the issuer. Many tribe tokens have limited liquidity and thin trading margins. The GLD markets ***are*** thin as the capital is focused on making a return to pay out weekly distributions. However: The coin is **BACKED** with a fixed treasury. The coin is **PEGGED** with a fixed redemption method. The coin has **LIQUIDITY** with the liquidity pools .... plus the liquidity pool allowed for **EXTRACTION** to LTC.... a historically trusted crypto. Plus.. the hive-engine is supported for people who don't know there are other ways to get value from their GLD coin. Even if it isn't perfect. In the crypto world the issuers can't **GUARANTEE** anything. Still, I like to think this shows a good faith effort to make sure no-one gets left holding a dead token.
So.... I told @lovlygirl that I would make a defense of why I thought that the GLD token was more stable than most hive altcoins. I hope I succeeded. ... But if anyone has ideas on how it could be better supported please let me know. I love comments and welcome ideas on how to make things better. Thanks for reading.

title.title: 👑 The Crown Jewel of Comfort: A Simple Dinner That Steals the Show!
title.body:
<div class='text-justify'> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb3nw7mfqU5CMiMwyun3vjZFn7y34hDF1zB68s5EHyuTM/image.png)


## 👑 The Crown Jewel of Comfort: A Simple Dinner That Steals the Show!

### 🇬🇧 English Review by Sakol

**Good evening, my wonderful foodies!** Sakol is here as the sun sets, and let me tell you a secret: sometimes, the greatest culinary masterpieces aren't found in a five-star restaurant. Tonight, we are going completely back to basics, and my heart is incredibly full! 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP1usuAeRstmHZm6MLtEPWqnsLy8piJyV2PC6ZVwhwwi9/image.png)


Look at this magnificent spread! The absolute star of the show is the legendary **Mackerel Chili Paste (Nam Prik Pla Too)**. It is pounded to absolute perfection—savory, spicy, and packed with that rich, unmistakable roasted mackerel flavor. Then, you take a piece of the **soft, naturally sweet boiled eggplant**, and dip it right into the paste... oh my goodness! The contrast between the fiery, pungent dip and the cooling, juicy vegetable is pure, unadulterated magic in your mouth!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZwXapVwESW95TYRpJUhftMYJ7vT74zxFfebThuArA2i/image.png)


And what is a Thai comfort meal without a **hot, golden Thai Omelet (Kai Jiao)**? Fresh out of the pan, it's dangerously crispy on the edges and beautifully fluffy on the inside, sitting proudly on top of steaming hot jasmine rice. When you mix a bite of that savory, oily egg with the spicy chili paste, it’s a flavor explosion that literally hugs your soul. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwP12ktP3dhzjAxHzpMSkzGXpKkygxc654sLXYePxWfC/image.png)


No fancy ingredients are needed today. Just this, right here, is pure, ultimate bliss. **100/10 for the soul!**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVGeAQWxv8y8ohPiY8nSbTX8o83Q7SCPzDNChE2V2jdWm/image.png)


---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQB7uEft44ENvPdwemGHD5Wg5yfQGuDMNvQuvAHrfHqMh/image.png)


## 👑 มื้อเย็นแสนธรรมดา... ที่ราคาความสุขประเมินค่าไม่ได้!

### 🇹🇭 รีวิวโดย พี่สากล ชวนชิม

title.title: Around the Yard - April 17, 2026@goldenoakfarm
title.body:
![Trees in bloom crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Ep7u2QkfhXm2fpuexJraTWc7o1wqymZmmodMDKtbGuDRtcGuDGWnKkbSq6hvt28dKz2.jpg)

*Trees in bloom*

On Friday morning when I finally got out to the gardens, I found so many things had changed out there. I hadn’t been out since the morning before and wow!

![Around the yard collage3 text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/242ryBURozGV427AY5FZrZ8aU4bvo8Ynyn2EXDQG11vrwRsGoRYF3HEBTpicftTYRBC7D.jpg)

There are daffodils in almost all the gardens. 

![Around the yard collage1 text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23tvnuiTLQYvaEatRg2W9HhKxwe3wR6AcsF5yV41MDf8kvpCfjbnBaAdG3tonCgaMSfXA.jpg)

I saw violets of all types in the grass and in the gardens and walkways.

![Around the yard collage2 text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23w2uWCexJNtim6hbPzwJsERSoYfJ6Gnvuj99B2bNdYyxcNqvCbF1dUzSV3pqc9tkCg1Z.jpg)

The crabapple had gone from leaf buds to flowerbuds in a couple days because of the heat. There are even buds on the lily of the valley in mid April! 

![Around the yard collage4 text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EptdvpsALrq51zdoUMo7bWMN9yn5MHRqdQQcGtvatimgWAgqxTxC1muU72FKB6zPh9h.jpg)

The magnolia’s flowers all burst open. And the Contender peach is covered in buds about to open. I had so many photos I didn’t go over to the Little Trees II. I bet there are blossoms there too.

![Little Trees - 9.Contender peach, 4.Serviceberry flowering collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23zvHbDE1BbD5ZMybAQn2qrLyKt7CF89T9XC6LMAvLjXfEVHSM3XcD4ZrSduCzXhkKkWP.jpg)

Not good photos of either. The serviceberry was a cloud of white and the peach tree was decidedly pink.

That heat sure brought spring on in a hurry but it will turn very cold by Sunday.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

.*

***I found it strange and interesting, though not beautiful. The reference to my grandmother motivated me to treat it with more affection.***

>*Me parecía rara e interesante, aunque no bonita. La referencia a mi abuela me motivó a que me dedicara a ella con más cariño.*

>*Sus hojas crecían y se multiplicaban muy erectas y agudas. Alguna vez se me ocurrió contarles las puntas para evitar que alguien se lastimara.*

>*Hace pocos meses la cambié de lugar y volvió a florecer. Una espiga con botones surgió de en medio de ella y, de nuevo,  creí que no era importante.*

>*Al comprobar que estaban abriendo algunas flores de la parte baja me acerqué y fotografié.*

![20260130_081105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23wCA1FXzWEW5XRcuSk1aRyhbgy8uiyLsdKGsKacXJRwqYG8yDU1gs4f8fN2Hxov835SU.jpg)

and it is from Angola. title.title: Getting Prepared For My Grandsons Birthday
title.body: /> This week we had to get our creative hard hats on to put together a birthday invite for my grandsons party. He wants to invite all of his classmates which is very sweet of him knowing this will be a first birthday party for most of them. Many of his classmates have special needs so we are not sure who is able to come and who is not. He enjoys watching Gold Rush on television so the latest craze is he spends time in the garden digging and transporting soil around in the hope there is some gold. This will be the theme for his party with construction vehicles and he will be in his element. I encourage this as I think it is pretty cool he is looking for gold and more importantly he is outside and not stuck behind a computer playing games. This morning I went to buy his birthday present looking for a remote controlled excavator but it turns out this is not exactly practical. The charging takes 4 hours and the battery life lasts roughly 20 minutes. The remote controlled loader was similar and once loaded the truck would last 30 minutes and 40 minutes without the dirt on the back. Plus the other downside is they looked cheap and would probably only last 30 minutes before breaking. This is why i dodged the toy shops and went to a specific specialist shop that deals in remote control items like, boats, cars, bikes, planes and trucks. They even had tanks, but I am not buying this for myself so I have to reign myself in slightly. In the end I opted for a remote controlled car which is sticking with the outdoor theme and this once charged will last a good 90 minutes plus I bought an extra battery pack so one will always be charged waiting to go. The one enjoyment I do get is when shopping for boys presents because I can put myself in their shoes thinking what I would have liked to play with. The budget usually gets thrown out the window as I also get to play with whatever I purchase and it is a great bonding time.

/></center>

This is the remote control car I purchased this morning and the hobby shop had so many to choose from. There was a Willys Jeep which I would have bought, but this was way too expensive so I had to keep things real and not get carried away. This RC vehicle goes 38 km/h and is fast enough for my grandsons needs which i know he will enjoy which is the important part here and why my presents are always well received.

Still quite shocked that this is an entry level price and there are others upwards of $4K and that is for the body and does not include all the parts.

My granddaughter's birthday is next month and for that I am clueless and will leave that to the girls to decide because I cannot put myself in her shoes. I have no idea what interests little girls besides dolls, but there must be more and I would most likely mess things up.

His birthday is on Tuesday so I guess after school we will be playing in the garden waiting until it gets dark because this car has lights on the top and that is going to be what gets his attention the most. Boys just want to have fun and this present is going to give just that.

I know his mum is doing his cake and it is going to be a construction site cake and her cakes are always very detailed and cannot wait to see what this looks like. I am not an arty farty type person so I leave the creative side to those that are.

title.title: ⚙️ Trapped in the \
? It’s Time to Switch Gears [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
as that endless cycle of working to earn money, paying bills, and working again to earn more money. It’s a wheel that spins very fast, but it doesn't take you anywhere.

If you work for a paycheck and your money doesn't produce more money while you sleep, you are on the wheel.

## 🤖 The Trapped Robot vs. The Architect Robot

1. **The Trapped Robot (The Race):** Their life is linear. If they stop working, the cash flow stops. Their most valuable \

is their time, which they sell to the highest bidder but never get back.
2. **The Architect Robot (The Exit):** They have understood that the key isn't working more hours, but buying or creating **assets** (things that put money in your pocket without you having to be present).

## 💡 How to jump off the wheel today

You don't need a million dollars to start getting out of the Rat Race. You just need a shift in focus:

* **Reduce your liabilities:** Every unnecessary luxury you buy is one less \

in your tower of freedom.\n* **Invest in real assets:** On Hive, your *Hive Power* is an asset. In the stock market, your dividends are assets. In real estate, your rents are assets.\n* **Money as a tool:** Stop seeing money as the end (the salary) and start seeing it as the means (seed capital). Every Hive coin you stake is a little \

working for you.

## 🚀 The first step off the wheel

Getting out of the Rat Race isn't a magic event; it’s a process. Start building an income stream that is independent of your work schedule. Even if at first it's only the equivalent of one coffee a month, **you have already started building your escape.**

---

## ✨ Reflection for Today:

If you stopped going to work tomorrow, how long would your current lifestyle survive? The answer to that question will tell you exactly how far you are from exiting the Rat Race.

**What small source of passive income are you going to strengthen this week? Let’s talk in the comments! 👇**

---

# 🇪🇸 VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL

---


# ⚙️ ¿Atrapado en la \
? Es hora de cambiar de engranaje\n\nRobert Kiyosaki definió la \

como ese ciclo infinito de trabajar para ganar dinero, pagar facturas, y volver a trabajar para ganar más dinero. Es una rueda que gira muy rápido, pero no te lleva a ninguna parte.

Si trabajas por un sueldo y tu dinero no produce más dinero mientras duermes, estás en la rueda.

## 🤖 El Robot Atrapado vs. El Robot Arquitecto

1. **El Robot Atrapado (La Carrera):** Su vida es lineal. Si deja de trabajar, el flujo de dinero se detiene. Su \

más valioso es su tiempo, el cual vende al mejor postor, pero nunca recupera.
2. **El Robot Arquitecto (La Salida):** Ha comprendido que la clave no es trabajar más horas, sino comprar o crear **activos** (cosas que ponen dinero en tu bolsillo sin que tengas que estar presente).

## 💡 Cómo saltar de la rueda hoy mismo

No necesitas un millón de dólares para empezar a salir de la Carrera de la Rata. Solo necesitas un cambio de enfoque:

* **Reduce tus pasivos:** Cada lujo innecesario que compras es un \

menos en tu torre de libertad.\n* **Invierte en activos reales:** En Hive, tu *Hive Power* es un activo. En la bolsa, tus dividendos son activos. En los bienes raíces, tus rentas son activos.\n* **El dinero como herramienta:** Deja de ver el dinero como el fin (el sueldo) y empieza a verlo como el medio (el capital semilla). Cada moneda de Hive que haces staking es un pequeño \

trabajando para ti.

## 🚀 El primer paso fuera de la rueda

La salida de la Carrera de la Rata no es un evento mágico, es un proceso. Empieza a construir un flujo de ingresos que sea independiente de tu horario laboral. Incluso si al principio es solo el equivalente a un café al mes, **ya has empezado a construir tu escape**.

---

## ✨ Reflexión para hoy:

Si mañana dejaras de ir a trabajar, ¿cuánto tiempo sobreviviría tu estilo de vida actual? La respuesta a esa pregunta te dirá exactamente qué tan lejos estás de salir de la Carrera de la Rata.

**¿Qué pequeña fuente de ingreso pasivo vas a fortalecer esta semana? ¡Hablemos en los comentarios! 👇**

title.title: The Final Strike || How I Imagined Voss Destroying Its Foes
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image Apr 18, 2026, 10_26_07 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uQjykv57kewqBizApTcJyvEg2LnKBiAd6xztWn8be8cGD9o5ifhqfxrHaxKtV4EDGY2.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


This character image that I shared belongs to Splinterlands. It is a very excellent monster whose mana cost is low only four and you can easily play it in low mana battles. Today I was looking at which card to choose so I found this card and I was impressed by its visual display and along with that its abilities are also very excellent.

Therefore I thought to make a visual art of this monster and to share my imagination ideas about this monster that how he hit his enemy units. 

Its special ability is its Bloodline Tribute and when defeated, all allied units of the same bloodline gain plus one health, speed and armor and +1 power to each shared attack type. This is its most special and best ability.

If we look at its stats, its health is four because of which you can place it in the mid to backline position. Besides this its speed is one meaning it will provide its allied unit plus one speed so that they can attack more effectively.

This monster card is available in the market at different prices depending on its level. At Level 1 it costs only $0.40 which is a very reasonable and affordable price for most players. At Level 2 the price increases to around $1.89.

![Screenshot 2026-04-18 222625.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wM4ibhYf4Spd2C7dav2xryasXDACByxui3BAYHKPBnVZFugLZiVqbGMkD837184tefB.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

The value of any monster card depends mainly on its level and card count. Lower level cards usually have a lower price because they are basic versions while higher level cards become more valuable due to their improved stats, abilities and stronger battle performance.

Its visual display is very beautiful where you can see that its shape looks similar to an eagle and in its right hand there is an energy power and it looks like it wants to throw it toward the enemy.

Besides this if I talk about its beauty, its dressing style is very beautiful and its claws are very sharp which points toward a dangerous and alarming situation.

I personally kept its imaginative and conceptual aspect in mind and I thought of preparing a specific visual display art of it with the help of ChatGPT and providing some information about it.

I imagined that this Voss monster is standing in one position and looking toward the opponents and from its body it is releasing an energy from its right hand and wants to throw it toward the enemy. 

![Screenshot 2026-04-18 222649.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23t7agg561C8cTGtXjo4p6neXjmYy8JegTpGNadbxEcYhrMNSYANQ7sV86ep7BGfdezWT.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

After throwing it it kills one enemy unit, the second one hides because of fear and the third remains busy running away and its background is a forest scene.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

is an animation I use to highlight key points in advanced studies.

This video explains why the Book of Revelation is so difficult to read and therefore so difficult to understand:
Consider that the Book of Revelation recounts the events of an accident! (If you watch the video, you will see the animation of the accident.)
Jesus could have given us a summary of the events of the accident, taking into account the different accounts of the witnesses! But no!
In reality, Jesus gave us the testimonies of the various witnesses: the 7 churches, the 7 seals, the 7 trumpets, and the 7 plagues, etc. The complexity of the reading stems primarily from this: it is actually up to the reader to create the correct chronological summary of the events.

This is why the book's structure is essential! Indeed, in an accident, witnesses have different perspectives, and in the structure, I explain that there are introductions to series of seven (churches, trumpets, etc.), which, unfortunately, are almost never used to interpret the text. This is a shame and certainly a source of errors! Because these reference points allow for a better understanding of the chronology of events in the book, in my opinion. 

What do you think?

title.title: Former Tomb Raider Developers Create Side Scrolling Fan Game
title.body:
Tomb Raider Side Scroller Edition has been announced and a few videos released. Former developers that worked on Tomb Raider Remastered are releasing updated videos showing their fan game in action. What is wild, this is not the first time a 3D game has been remade in 2D, or 2.5D. Tomb Raider Side Scroller Edition is expected in May 2026.

New View, New Action

3D is great but for me, 2D is best for my adventuring. Unless we are talking about a live service game, or a role-playing game (and ignoring sports altogether here), 2D is my favorite genre. 2.5D is even better to me. I was enamored with the 32-bit generation until I saw 2.5D was not going to be used much on the new PlayStation console so I leaned more towards Saturn (which burned me in other ways). https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wgp4TWOW0YY&t I was one of the fans that picked up [Duke Nukem The Manhattan Project]( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rtg4ySa7oQg) on PC and enjoyed it a lot. More than I did the 3D original, honestly (I have never really taken to FPS games). To see someone making a 2.5D Tomb Raider is exciting for me. 2.5D makes the game more action focused while 3D is great for exploration. I cannot wait to see how this plays.

Fans Doing What Companies Won’t

I say it a lot because it is true. Fans will do what companies won’t. To me, these fan games are almost free advertising. People come into a franchise via a free fan game and then explore the other entries that are paid. Everyone wins in the end. This is definitely a release I plan on grabbing immediately upon release. It just strikes too many chords for me. I was a huge fan of the PSOne games, skipped everything up to the remake and Legend and that whole generation. Source – [Time Extension]( https://www.timeextension.com/news/2026/04/a-fan-project-not-to-be-missed-this-new-project-reimagines-the-classic-tomb-raider-games-as-a-2-5d-sidescroller)

title.title: 当然可以！这里有几个旅游博客的主题建议：\n\n1. **“隐藏的宝藏
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g24afa914843f5e6a08b1e455cbba3f127cb3623c4e2422cb635f7d8921f7081fb60187a16bd567ff83b41b9efa266f634bbe9154d8747c0cf83748ad4a788fe5_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 隐藏的宝藏：探索不为人知的旅游胜地

在这个信息爆炸的时代，许多旅游者倾向于前往热门景点，如巴黎的埃菲尔铁塔或纽约的时代广场。然而，世界上还有许多隐藏的宝藏，等待着我们去探索。本文将带您走出常规旅游路线，发现一些鲜为人知但绝对值得一游的目的地。

## 1. **塞尔维亚的诺维萨德**

诺维萨德是一个位于塞尔维亚的迷人城市，以其丰富的文化和历史而闻名。每年夏天，这里都会举办著名的EXIT音乐节，吸引来自世界各地的音乐爱好者。除了音乐节，诺维萨德的彼得罗瓦拉丁堡垒也是一个不可错过的景点，您可以在这里俯瞰多瑙河的美丽风光。

## 2. **斯洛文尼亚的布莱德湖**

布莱德湖是斯洛文尼亚最美丽的自然景点之一，但却常常被游客忽视。湖中有一座小岛，岛上有一座迷人的教堂，游客可以乘坐传统的木船前往。环绕湖泊的山脉和森林为这里增添了宁静的氛围，是徒步旅行和摄影爱好者的天堂。

## 3. **葡萄牙的阿尔加维**

虽然阿尔加维以其美丽的海滩而闻名，但许多游客往往只停留在海岸线的热门城市。实际上，阿尔加维内陆有许多迷人的村庄，如卡尔达斯·达·拉伊纳和蒙奇克，提供了独特的文化体验和美味的当地美食。在这里，您可以品尝到正宗的葡萄牙美食，体验到热情好客的当地人。

## 4. **日本的高山**

虽然东京和京都是日本最受欢迎的旅游目的地，但高山（Takayama）却是一个被遗忘的珍宝。这座小城镇以保存完好的传统建筑和古老的街道而著称。每年的春秋季节，这里会举办传统的节庆活动，游客可以体验到日本独特的文化和风俗。

## 5. **印度的拉贾斯坦邦**

拉贾斯坦邦以其壮丽的宫殿和沙漠风光而闻名，但许多游客却只停留在斋浦尔和乌代布尔。实际上，拉贾斯坦邦还有许多隐藏的城镇，如小镇贾伊萨尔梅尔，以其迷人的黄沙和古老的堡垒而著称。在这里，您可以体验到真正的印度文化，享受热情的待客之道。

## 结语

探索隐藏的旅游宝藏不仅可以让您避开人潮，更能让您体验到独特的文化和风景。无论您是寻找宁静的自然景观，还是渴望了解当地的风俗习惯，这些不为人知的目的地都能满足您的需求。下次计划旅行时，不妨考虑这些隐藏的宝藏，给自己一个不同的旅行体验。
