title.title: At a Pointillism exhibition / En una exposición de Puntillismo
title.body:
A few weeks ago, a friend invited me to the arts and crafts school where she had taken a painting workshop. That day, the students were exhibiting the work they had created after completing the basic level of Pointillism. >*Hace unas semanas, una amiga me invitó a la escuela de artes y oficios donde había hecho un taller de pintura. Ese día los estudiantes estaban exhibiendo los trabajos realizados luego de terminar el nivel básico de Puntillismo.*
![IMG_20260227_110733.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpGSZ1sB8cmjCL5uiyVTxbisVtL9HdZPVmeUAB6BEgEXWRVmFyZTBMYDv3LdZv4szvE.jpg)
I was told that this artistic technique, which uses small dots of color to create figures, landscapes, and so on, originated in France. There, in the 1880s, it was popularized by Georges Seurat and Paul Signac. >*Esta técnica artística que utiliza pequeños puntos de colores para formar figuras, paisajes, etc., proviene de Francia, me comentaron. Allí, en la década de 1880 fue popularizada por Georges Seurat y Paul Signac.*
![IMG_20260227_110724.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23ynYbpqSXofWbJag31xDqKnxhETAeYrAjhUYpghp6tVEMYQdtZGbTxGvMW85QAmAQbcU.jpg)
My friend created several pieces during this workshop, some of which featured cats, she has several at home 😻. I thought that for a beginner’s level, the paintings on display were quite well executed. >*Mi amiga hizo varias obras durante este taller, algunas de ellas alusivas a los gatos, tiene varios en su casa 😻. Me pareció que para estar apenas en el nivel básico, las pinturas expuestas estaban bastante bien ejecutadas.*
![IMG_20260227_111103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23w2oQuTAifKqQ1T7KxbkiycQWdNzeWSuVD12rgqnHF5SVQzfsT2J2SFGDqCjennb1yFj.jpg)
She told me that in this workshop, in addition to learning the Pointillism technique, they also worked with recycled materials, which is why these paintings were created on materials such as boards or scraps of discarded wood, cardboard, damaged CDs, etc. >*Me dijo que en este taller, aparte de aprender la técnica del Puntillismo, también trabajaron con el reciclaje, por eso estas pinturas fueron hechas sobre materiales como tablas o pedazos de maderas descartadas, cartones, CD's dañados, etc.*
![IMG_20260227_111808.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23wX7qs7BREDnP9sVrvhBzsYWcZLquMWQ4hFk2LnePmZGAPiZtoPUsDpw4szsB3dDkF9b.jpg)
![IMG_20260227_111301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23xyREFG32PUnu8uQ89c4VWD2EPewftguHmbDRT4N97Eb5yXMpDY7EkbT8mpsmShw6igu.jpg)
As you can see, the themes of the works on display are very diverse, there were no limits to creativity. Although I had seen this type of painting before, I didn’t know much about Pointillism and its history. That’s one of the best parts of attending this kind of event: your mind expands. >*Como pueden ver, la temática de las obras expuestas es muy variada, no había límites para la creatividad. Aunque ya había visto este tipo de pinturas antes, no sabía mucho sobre el Puntillismo y su historia. Esa es una de las mejores cosas de asistir a este tipo de eventos: tu mente se expande.*
![IMG_20260227_111131A.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23xL4riNbNQ8qUnNikrici5g1PMu5uGKz2B6xtW9MxdkWh331fEv6UEpMheoMfg3YPnx7.jpg)
![IMG_20260227_112216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EoeHpEAw1MfD7TxSLXGguufir2dgmndYZbLM7Wa16g8mNXJ7yfgsdyZGyBDmXrQTDyv.jpg)
In addition to the basic Pointillism works, there were a few other items on display in the room, such as drawings in other styles and pieces created using the faux leather technique on bottles and small boxes. >*Además de las obras del nivel básico de Puntillismo, en la sala había algunas cosas más expuestas, como dibujos de otros estilos y también trabajos como la técnica de falso cuero sobre botellas y pequeñas cajas.*
![IMG_20260227_111823.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23w2uhk7taQZFXELUSsPYNH4L4ufn1R2iQxFgtMj9x9ENTFgAi3Vi7Z2eQx5eaGJ5iaY8.jpg)
![IMG_20260227_112109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Ep7w5nNDmNMgjChxtkjKz2uPzinhmREN2ADD8XwscaWZFrydy9QzJnmfxpU4rkZGCSt.jpg)
For me it's always nice and interesting to visit art exhibitions, whether they feature amateur artists or established ones. What did you think? Which piece did you like best? >*Para mí siempre es agradable e interesante visitar exposiciones de arte, ya sea de artistas noveles o consagrados. ¿Qué les ha parecido? ¿Qué obra les gustó más?*

We are finally getting some good weather here in Ireland, and i’m making the most of it to tackle some long overdue jobs in the garden.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdyArmoDKZjvpxtyFJjTCpBXqNjnsE98rC6xwxjc8r5Vq/img_8433.jpg)

At first glance it looks pretty good, with the cherry tree stealing the limelight, but i have 3 raised beds that i mostly neglected last year. As a result, they have basically been overrun by 3 kinds of cabbage, and potatoes that i missed when harvesting last year.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTAs14pLxrFCHSR8Y6tHQVigUHWdEu3vTUMhHKj24gwKL/img_8432.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdVXDKxUU2t7HTCQMCJANwGKUCGApeCY3FzkiCCPTAa2A/img_8430.jpg)

The closest bed to the house has also been taken over, rather delightfully, by strawberries! That one im going to more or less leave as it is, apart from a little tidying and weeding in between them. 

I tend to view gardening as a neverending series of experiments, so it’ll be interesting to see what this season has in store.

Happy planting, my green fingered friends!

title.title: Pokemon TCG - Local Tournament Report In Perfect Order New Format
title.body: Hi there. In this tournament report, I test out a deck in the new post-rotation format with the Perfect Order recent set. Note: This one is very long. Read and see what you want.   ## Post-Rotation Stuff --- There is a new format in the Pokemon TCG. Cards with the G regulation mark are no longer allowed in standard play. J cards are now legal. You can only play cards with the letters H, I or J in standard tournaments. With the G cards gone, you no longer have the main decks of Gardevoir ex, Gholengo ex, Charizard ex in the format. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/SVI/SVI_086_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/OBF/OBF_125_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/PAR/PAR_139_R_EN_LG.png | There is also no more Iono for hand disruption, Counter Catcher and Nest Ball. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/PAF/PAF_080_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/PAR/PAR_160_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/SVI/SVI_181_R_EN_LG.png |   ## Deck Choice & List --- I had a couple of decks in mind that I really liked. I almost chose to play a Cynthia's Garchomp ex deck or a Lillie's Clefairy ex deck. For this one, I thought that Arboliva ex with Teal Mask Ogerpon ex and Meganium is a solid and consistent deck. This archetype did place [second in Japan's Champions League tournament in March 2026](https://limitlesstcg.com/decks/list/24429). | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/DRI/DRI_023_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_025_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_010_R_EN_LG.png |   My deck list is similar to the Japan deck list. I use Max Rod instead of the very popular Unfair Stamp. | | | |---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/PRE/PRE_116_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_165_R_EN_LG.png | --- Pokémon: 20 4 Teal Mask Ogerpon ex PRE 12 1 Celebi MEG 12 1 Budew ASC 16 2 Smoliv DRI 21 2 Dolliv DRI 22 2 Arboliva ex DRI 23 2 Chikorita MEG 8 2 Bayleef MEG 9 2 Meganium MEG 10 1 Meowth ex POR 62 1 Fezandipiti ex ASC 142 Trainer: 29 3 Bug Catching Set TWM 143 2 Poké Pad POR 81 4 Ultra Ball SVI 196 4 Lillie's Determination MEG 119 2 Boss's Orders SHF 58 1 Air Balloon ASC 181 1 Judge FST 235 4 Forest of Vitality MEG 117 1 Max Rod PRE 116 3 Dawn PFL 87 1 Lana's Aid TWM 155 2 Night Stretcher SFA 61 1 Energy Switch SVI 173 Energy: 11 11 Grass Energy SVE 9   ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcz4T32NDCNn2UKwVncyFPsVyAPMprZvqPX79K8szWnnq/arboliva_apr12.png)   ## Key Cards --- **Arboliva ex, Teal Mask Ogerpon ex, Meganium** | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/DRI/DRI_023_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_025_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_010_R_EN_LG.png | These are the main 3 pieces in this Grass deck. Teal Mask Ogerpon ex serves as a small draw engine and as an attacker. Meganium doubles the amount of Grass Energy for you resulting in a more power Teal Mask Ogerpon ex attack. Arboliva ex is a beefy Stage 2 Grass attacker that can target the bench with its Oil Salvo attack at (20 damage times 6). With the Meganium and Teal Mask Ogerpon ex combo, two Grass Energy cards turns into 4 Grass Energy. Teal Mask Ogerpon ex can hit 270 damage if there are 4 Grass Energy on the Ogerpon (4 x 2 then times 30 damage plus 30 = 270).   **Forest of Vitality**

>Image Source Forest of Vitality is a powerful Stadium card for Grass evolution decks. Outside of the first turn, Grass Pokemon can evolve into another Grass Pokemon on the same turn. Normally you have to wait one turn to evolve but not with Forest of Vitality. You can go from Benching a Grass Basic and then evolve all the way to a Stage 2 Grass Pokemon on the same turn. This is provided you have the physical cards in hand to complete the Grass evolution line.   **Dawn**

>Image Source Bug Catching Set is a good Item card for Grass decks. Look at the top 7 cards from your deck. You may reveal up to 2 of any combination of Grass Pokemon and Basic Grass Energy you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into deck. If you get lucky, this card lets you get more Grass Pokemon and/or Grass Energy. Most lists have 4 copies but I think 3 is fine. The fourth spot could go into another Supporter card or Pokemon.   ## Tournament Format --- The local tournament was held at [A & C Games](https://acgamesonline.com) near Toronto's Chinatown area and near the University of Toronto downtown campus. Their tournaments are popular as they are free and you get one Prize Pack Series 8 booster pack per win. As of late, it is becoming one hot spot of many stores for Toronto's TCG scene for Pokemon, Magic the Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh and Riftbound TCG.

>Image Source   There are 3 best of one rounds at 30 minutes each. Ties result in a game loss for prizing purposes.   ## Round One --- My round one opponent was someone I have faced before. I won the coin flip and chose to go first on my first turn. I think my opponent bricked. In the first three turns, I saw a Noctowl and a Fezandipiti ex on her side. Maybe she was playing a Tera Box deck or something. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/SCR/SCR_115_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/SFA/SFA_038_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/DRI/DRI_023_R_EN_LG.png | I did manage to get a fast and aggressive Arboliva ex setup in play in turn two. Arboliva ex was there to put a lot of pressure on her Pokemon. Long story short, I end up taking two prizes at a time. The prize map was 2-2-2 to get all 6 of my prizes. This was a lucky win. I later found out she played an Eevee deck with Flareon ex. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/PRE/PRE_075_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/PRE/PRE_074_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/PRE/PRE_014_R_EN_LG.png | After this first game, we played a practice rematch to pass the time. Due to time, there was no conclusion. She had a better start with [Wellspring Ogerpon ex](https://limitlesstcg.com/cards/TWM/64).   ## Round Two Vs Mega Lucario ex --- My round two opponent was someone I faced many times while I am at that place. This may be my seventh or eighth time playing him. This one is different as we are in a new format. We don't know what the other person is playing. (In the previous round, he sat at a different table.) From the coin flip, I won and chose to go first again. My first turn was something like use Teal Dance from Teal Mask Ogerpon ex to draw 1 card and manual attach one Grass Energy to my active Chikorita. End turn. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_025_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_008_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEE/MEE_001_R_EN_LG.png |   The opponent's first turn was really bad. It was attach one Fighting Energy to the single Lunatone in the Active then end turn. His hand must have had no Supporter and a bunch of Energy. | | | |---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_074_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEE/MEE_006_R_EN_LG.png |   I win in my second turn. There was enough energy in the end for the Teal Mask Ogerpon ex to attack for the knockout. My opponent had no backup Benched Pokemon so I win. This win was in like 3 minutes. Disgustingly good luck to get me two wins and zero losses. I felt bad for my opponent.   --- I offered a rematch for practice and to pass the time. This second game was less one sided but I did win in the end. The Meganium engine powers up Teal Mask Ogerpon ex so it can hit big damage numbers. Arboliva ex can target Pokemon on the Bench and Active with its 120 spread damage in 20 damage increments six times. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/DRI/DRI_023_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_025_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_010_R_EN_LG.png |   ## Round Three Versus Raging Bolt ex Post Rotation Version --- My round three opponent was someone I faced once before and have traded cards in the past. He is pretty friendly. I really think this guy is loaded and is willing to pay thousands of dollars in buying something like 3 to 5 booster boxes every set release. His trade binders usually have shiny cards, illustration rares, special illustration rares and such. Apparently, this guy made top 64 or top 128 at Toronto Regionals tournament back in January 2026. That is what I heard before going into this one. He was 2 wins and 0 losses too. His regional result is nice but I was not too intimidated by this even though I am not highly ranked. The opponent won the coin flip and chose to go first. His opening Active Pokemon was Mega Kangaskhan ex. My first reaction thought was Raging Bolt ex. It could have been a different deck too. The Mega Kangaskhan ex in the active allowed him to draw 2 cards. Then he benches the single prize Raging Bolt. This confirms what I am up against. His start was good. | | | |---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_104_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TEF/TEF_123_R_EN_LG.png |   My first turn was something like Smoliv active, use Teal Mask Ogerpon ex ability. Then Dawn for the Arboliva ex evolution line with a second Smoliv. I expected a Knockout on a Smoliv from the Raging Bolt the next turn so I get a second one in play. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/DRI/DRI_021_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_025_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/PFL/PFL_087_R_EN_LG.png | --- The opponent does a lot of stuff and ends up Knocking out my Smoliv on the Bench, keeping the Active one alive. My next turn was something like using Lillie's Determination to refresh the hand. Setup a bunch of stuff and attack the opponent's Raging Bolt with my Teal Mask Ogerpon ex. I thought this was fairly safe as the opponent had no Teal Mask Ogerpon ex in play. The probability of the opponent Knocking out my Teal Mask Ogerpon ex with his own was very low (15% maybe). | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_119_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TEF/TEF_123_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_025_R_EN_LG.png | --- Opponent's next turn was play a bunch of stuff but ends up missing the attack on the Raging Bolt ex. I found this kind of shocking but it gave me an opening. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TEF/TEF_123_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/DRI/DRI_023_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_010_R_EN_LG.png |   For my next turn, I set up Arboliva ex and Meganium. Do some further setup to ensure a victory on my next turn as I have Boss's Orders in hand to target the Mega Kangaskhan ex. I use one of two Teal Mask Ogerpon ex to knock out the opponent's Raging Bolt ex. I have 3 Prize Cards out of 6 versus the opponents five Prize Cards left out of 6. At this point, I take the lead and feel pretty confident in winning this if there is no hand disruption. --- The opponent's next turn was using his own Teal Mask Ogerpon ex to knockout my Teal Mask Ogerpon ex. No hand disruption was used by him. I won the game in my next turn. Boss's Orders to target his Mega Kangaskhan ex and use my second Teal Mask Ogerpon ex with 5 Grass Energy on it for a big attack. (Five Grass energy x 2 from Meganium = 10 Grass Energy for 330 damage.) I collect my final 3 Prize cards for the win. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_025_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/ASC/ASC_183_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEP/MEP_025_R_EN_LG.png |   The early game for me was okay against his super setup. As the game went on, I got better setups while the opponent missed some attacks even with a large hand.   ## Prizing, Post Tournament Stuff --- I end up at 3 wins and 0 losses. This one felt weird as I felt lucky in all my games. There were 2 other guys who got 3 wins and 0 losses. They were near me in my round 3 match. Due to tiebreakers, I placed first as I had the highest opponent's win rate percentage. This is lucky as you cannot control the winrate of your opponents. With this win, I earn 3 Prize Pack Series 8 booster packs. For placing first, I get this Play Stamped prize thingy. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZuFfWMF6Hcibj5WKe7bZ89dogR6YG35NM6ANqRRRBcYJ/img_20260412_145557.jpg) When the organizer mentioned this prize before round one, some players were going `Oooh`. For me, I was not sure what this thing was. It is some sort of pin thing. Here are some of the cards I got from prizes. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWxWGakxJYa7BuvQRSY3nSZPVFY5jtGrsbeRPvx385W9J/img_20260412_195416.jpg) --- After the tournament, I grab a snack, pick up some cards and buy a few cards from other stores. I did manage to find some nice free cards including 2 Japanese Poke Pads and 1 Poke Pad. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUSLVKgB7bfszLgbwEassqhygSUTUA8YKSscVYvBLpL8L/img_20260412_195236.jpg) There was one Tyrunt illustration rare promo card at 8 CAD with no tax. It seemed like a good buy for a nice art card even though I did not check prices before this. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTytEqwRXULyJ8bCMLQ1GPJCE96PpcYyf6khbr7dT9G9A/img_20260412_195243.jpg)  
Thank you for reading.

title.title: Cross-Border Money Transfer in 2026: Faster, Smarter, and Built for Global Business
title.body: As businesses expand across borders, the ability to move money efficiently has become a core requirement. Whether it’s paying remote teams, settling supplier invoices, or supporting global customers, cross-border money transfer is now part of everyday operations. Companies such as **Thunes** are helping modernize [**cross-border money transfer**](https://www.thunes.com/insights/learn/what-are-cross-border-payments/) by enabling businesses to connect to global payment networks through a single integration. This reduces the need to manage multiple local providers while improving consistency across different regions. **Why cross-border payments remain complex** Even with advances in financial technology, international transfers are still more complicated than domestic ones. Each country operates within its own financial ecosystem, with unique rules, systems, and expectations. Businesses typically face: *

>Currency conversion challenges and fluctuating rates

\n*

>Varying payout methods depending on the market

Without a structured approach, these factors can lead to delays, higher costs, and inconsistent experiences. **The growing demand for global payments** In 2026, more companies are global from the start. Remote work, digital platforms, and international marketplaces have removed many of the barriers to entry. This shift has increased demand for efficient cross-border payment systems. Businesses need to: *

>Maintain consistent payment experiences across regions

Cross-border money transfer is no longer a back-office function. It directly impacts user satisfaction and business performance. **Speed expectations have changed** One of the biggest changes in recent years is the expectation around speed. What used to take several days is now expected to happen much faster. Users want: *

>Transparency throughout the transaction process

Delays can create frustration and reduce trust, especially for users who rely on timely payments. **Supporting diverse payout methods** Flexibility is a key part of modern cross-border payments. Recipients in different regions rely on different financial tools, so businesses need to support multiple payout options. Common methods include: *

>Cash pickup services

Offering these options ensures that payments can reach users regardless of their location or access to banking infrastructure. **Compliance and security as core requirements** Cross-border money transfer is subject to strict regulatory oversight. Businesses must comply with requirements such as Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) standards. Managing compliance across multiple regions can be complex and resource-intensive. It involves identity verification, transaction monitoring, and reporting. Modern payment systems help by integrating compliance processes into the transaction flow, reducing risk while maintaining efficiency. **The move toward unified payment networks** Traditionally, businesses handled international payments by building relationships with multiple local providers. This approach can work initially but becomes difficult to manage as operations grow. Unified payment networks offer a more scalable alternative. Instead of managing multiple integrations, businesses can connect to a single system that provides access to multiple countries and payout methods. This simplifies operations and allows companies to expand more efficiently. **Reliability matters as much as speed** While speed is important, reliability is equally critical. Failed or delayed transactions can disrupt operations and damage relationships with customers and partners. Reliable systems focus on: *

>Clear visibility into payment status

This ensures that payments are delivered as expected, even at scale. **The future of cross-border money transfer** The global payments landscape continues to evolve. Advances in technology are making transactions faster, more transparent, and easier to manage. At the same time, businesses are placing greater emphasis on user experience. Payments are no longer just a backend process. They are part of how companies build trust and maintain long-term relationships. As global commerce continues to grow, efficient cross-border money transfer will become even more important. **Final thoughts** Cross-border money transfer is a fundamental part of modern business operations. As companies expand internationally, the ability to move money quickly and reliably becomes a competitive advantage. By adopting more streamlined and scalable approaches, businesses can reduce complexity, improve efficiency, and deliver a better experience for users worldwide.

The bees were so busy today moving from one flower to another in my butternut garden! 🐝✨

title.title: Semana de descarga ❤️‍🔥🏃🏻 [ESP-ENG]
title.body: >Bienvenidos, amigos de Hiverun, es un gusto compartir con ustedes en el día de hoy. Llevo 2 semanas sin publicar para ustedes, admito mi inactividad; sin embargo, vuelvo otra vez con las publicaciones. Esta semana para mí en el mundo del running fue de descarga; honestamente, corrí solo una vez en la semana, que fueron 7.5 km. Quería correr más, pero un tendón de mi rodilla izquierda no me dejaba correr más; siento que estoy muy sobrecargado y hay momentos en que debemos escuchar el cuerpo.\n\n

>Welcome, friends of Hiverun, it’s a pleasure to be sharing with you today. I haven’t posted anything for you for two weeks – I admit I’ve been a bit inactive – but I’m back with new posts. This week has been a bit of a break for me in the world of running; to be honest, I only ran once this week, covering 7.5 km. I wanted to run more, but a tendon in my left knee wouldn’t let me; I feel I’ve been pushing myself too hard, and there are times when we need to listen to our bodies. ---
![1000970314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23t76pL8EYGPh2P4FFRqGa6hVhhsj9ELLtqiaadFdjyrZqjTH7Dsf1epx9ya3BqzSeU32.jpg)

>Esta carrera fue entre fácil y a la vez no; lo digo porque fue el día miércoles, cuando empecé a correr, mis rodillas estaban muy bien, sin embargo, no lo suficiente para exigirme tanto, chicos. Fue una carrera nocturna, en la cual no sentí tanto calor, pero sí sudé mucho. La idea era hacer alrededor de 8 km, pero la aplicación falló después de que estaba 500 metros del parque; la desinstalé y volví a instalar; menos mal, se solucionó.\n\n

>This run was both easy and not; I say that because it was on Wednesday, and when I started running, my knees felt fine, though not quite well enough to push myself that hard, guys. It was a night run, during which I didn’t feel too hot, but I did sweat a lot. The plan was to run about 8 km, but the app crashed when I was 500 metres from the park; I uninstalled it and reinstalled it; thank goodness, it sorted itself out. ---
![1000964441.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23xVPfaA55pKezkkVQ7derJ6TQncZbznAagzMWGvvQaKfpH2KJbbbmHmf9EUTt9bNbx5n.jpg)

A pesar de todo, el ritmo se mantuvo entre 6:10 y 6:50. Algo muy suave, pero me gustó. Lo importante fue completar la carrera y los 7.5 km manteniendo ese ritmo; para mí fue para descargar los músculos. Esta semana vuelvo con todo, chicos; a veces es bueno tomarse un descanso para volver con más fuerza.\n\n

>I ran for 47 minutes; there were times when I had to stop because, even though it was my first run of the week, I was still feeling a bit stiff. Despite that, my pace stayed between 6:10 and 6:50. title.title: Burok-Burokan Hidden Spring Resort: Nature’s Ultimate Refreshment
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTnqG5hfbm36oNXeE1guGmVJaMr9TNPkspQ7xj9jhTKEH/1776608085473.png)

‎We visited Burok-burokan Hidden Spring Resort, and it is definitely one of the most popular spots.
‎
‎As soon as we arrived, the parking area inside was already full.
‎
‎So we parked at a private space nearby for ₱50/$0.84.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbf4r2E4Ta3Ek1pDYz3r681jkPq8S1ZSPWMdNH8mt8q5/1776608128004.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbkxe3EVyk9grSQSLzF7vhLwhXxkoRxaeCJTyW2ZoSkbC/1776608128192.jpg)

‎Walking towards the entrance, we paid ₱70/$1.26 per head for the entrance fee, while the kids were free of charge. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRrbjZwFgSN6xTNiszH28ToGeQ8YS9hnRPpePddcMwW2/1776608162007.jpg)

‎To be honest, this is quite a significant change compared to before. I remember that in the past, the entrance fee was only ₱25/$0.42 pesos here, and now, it jumped all the way to ₱70/$1.26... It's quite a huge increase! 
‎
‎And it's very noticeable.
‎
‎Stepping inside, the first thing I noticed was the sheer number of people. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeEQPkkGzmyuFn5VKw3tdh4ApkekRhpLvcW2twbwu4Tpi/1776608254838.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTxx1X5D6FMRJGcpDCw8JqfagPqwcEGK8Ju3qT25R8W2v/1776608255042.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ5P1vUMyMseoqNHQX6p6meHXmDZM5aEJorBiXivuwv2s/1776608255338.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf9MMLwMWdHJu2nDffPXV6CybQERJW9nrgm4dsJHvjKU6/1776608255595.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUsykQLcU7jALbBwjDtHqkhquDFNGJ2oG8ViHeMUD6ttu/1776608255903.jpg)

‎I have visited this place before, and it was already crowded back then.
‎
‎Yet the number of visitors this time seemed to have multiplied! 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTawQj2vbD6zfCiWN9Bhotey9dnAGcUgKMk55bTtR2yZx/1776608305303.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1mXw4hHPyzHGvxveE13iTiK3mf9aequmRxk6TDt51a1/1776608305526.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZof6Pwc8KUDWLbUiyz1W9BrrGNj9iVyXXKiupFZoFyJG/1776608305792.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2HyZGB8iR9k69KfpNJdFm85rpynGKh7JUqa6u7kHoAL/1776608306040.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc4ADnqD5C3xByTLH5uUpALESaLAV4cnMbPmvK14nHWEC/1776608306359.jpg)
‎
‎The atmosphere was lively and every single cottage was already rented out. 
‎
‎Every corner was occupied.
‎
‎People were everywhere... swimming in the pools, sitting down to enjoy meals, chatting with friends and family, and of course, taking countless selfies and group photos to capture the memories. 
‎
‎It was a bit of a challenge finding space at first. 
‎
‎We weren't sure where to place our bags or where to sit because the area was so packed. 
‎
‎Thankfully, we managed to locate our group of friends quickly on the left side. They were able to secure a spot with tables and chairs, which was enough for us to settle in despite the limited space.
‎
‎Despite the crowd and the price changes, the experience was still amazing.
‎
‎Mainly because of the water itself. 
‎
‎It's the best feature of Burok-Burokan... the water flows directly from a natural stream. That's why it is so fresh, icy cold, and crystal clear.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhTVh8oNdScnoE4sZxMCowFJBK9TLUVfsjYP6x4PnXND/1776608362255.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2NEhQVwriFXu5j7nHX4dWwarDrme11R1EbZ6dHWmYCb/1776608362492.jpg)

‎Unlike typical swimming pools that rely on chlorine and chemicals for cleaning, here the water is naturally clean because of its continuous flow. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVyPBpJ29zTGjMfaPRi5KrJk9wm6C47wc2u2dBHJKDPbx/1776608389550.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRU1MAU4hJHjxn6Z4pbdV7mXwwfmzfFSAMvvnfKZoj1Rf/1776608389717.jpg)

‎It feels so refreshing on the skin and is perfect for cooling down.
‎
‎The resort also has 3 different pools, designed for both kids and adults. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSGQsU7KgBErnfLAM6J7WTbEDgRmNqyHgW6MP8auMGgJN/1776608563822.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWQSNpQCQooJzar8FQXMa11sm4CJp9JGnzeu31NchFBjH/1776608564098.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWerXvhkkmgxXx7LTsRSNzDcx4cMVDiri46kk3xuYhPLj/1776608564361.jpg)

‎There are shallow areas for the little ones and deeper sections for adults. 
‎
‎Because of this setup, even with the large volume of people, everyone still had enough room to swim and enjoy.
‎
‎Another thing I love about this place is the environment. 
‎
‎It is surrounded by plenty of tall trees and greenery. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP26Q6p2Y5qWz1o6BUS1XWk8vLgXanF1bG18WreZinXWX/1776608638062.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRhHs42ikMqHJ29J637Aaa7W1DsxHEAz51LWmVvYQJuYu/1776608638286.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbzAhW7FkMTKu3nB6s5PigDRZRY9swEtkvrubCPHHyE8Y/1776608638571.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHxNHuWY2HkhfXTnY6BtLntFgd8E6HkXmV8vMWZvhBMx/1776608638799.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7enmyvz8ctAg93tQLhVpkKgakUNyJEpBH1pQwZDKURa/1776608639028.jpg)

‎This provides excellent natural shade, making the atmosphere cool and breezy.
‎
‎So even though it was already afternoon... we didn't feel the intense heat of the sun because the trees covered us. 🌳

Introduction


Hello everyone! This is @ybanezkim26 and I'll present today's edition of Travel Digest. In our featured posts, we have the city of Frankfurt, Germany, a lake in Rovni, Serbia, and a museum in Maracaibo, Venezuela. Enjoy and keep on pinning your travel posts to the map!


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 Between Timbered Streets and Glass Towers: A Day in Frankfurt by @yugadi

Last month, I took myself on a solo day trip to Frankfurt. A city I technically had already “visited,” but only for five minutes. It was the first place I landed when I arrived in Germany, but that day was a blur of suitcases, directions, and trying not to lose my mind on the way to Stuttgart. So I had made a plan to come back and do Frankfurt properly.

🥈 Rovni Lake and Velika Stena Viewpoint near Valjevo, Serbia by @bibana

The second stop was right by the dam, those huge thick walls holding back the lake. There's a small stop there, a parking space for a few cars and signs everywhere saying not to cross the barrier on the dam and that the area is under video surveillance, but of course we didn't listen, so we went around and took a little walk, looking at the lake head on, right from the middle. The color of the water kept changing from dark gray to lighter shades, shifting into greenish tones, depending on how the sun was cooperating with the clouds.

🥉 Outside the Archdiocesan Museum in Maracaibo. | Frente al Museo Arquidiocesano de Maracaibo. by @noelyss

But initially I was able to walk past each of its façades, and as this one is situated on a corner at the end of Carabobo Street, it is known as Bishop Lasso Street, since he lived in this neighbourhood many years ago in the last century. Back then, Maracaibo had just one street for entering and leaving the city, but as time went on, certain changes were made in Maracaibo with the construction of new roads, and now, in a way, that particular essence has been lost the fact that a single street connected you to the city’s only entrance and exit and Bishop Lasso Street was no exception.

title.title: Dust Bunny: A Review
title.body:
**Spoiler**--Some might consider information in this review as spoilers.  I don't think so because I don't give away the end. I do analyze and give my interpretation of the child's motivation--which is not clear in the beginning.

____________________________________________________________
___________________________________________________________

*Dust Bunny* is a strange, brilliant movie.  On first viewing it seems to be a grotesque fairy tale.  When I say fairy tale, I mean in the sense of the darkest Grimm story.  The plot revolves around a 10-year-old girl who has a people-eating dust bunny living under her bed. After the monster has eaten three sets of parents, the child hires an assassin to kill the thing off.  

Trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQqmOjPDlWg
  

Obviously, this is not a good vs. evil story. The assassin is a kind of monster himself, and the little girl is hardly sweet innocence. She has brought this thing into existence by wishing it would come and eat her first set of parents.  These two, according to the child, did not treat her well.  They were the first of successive, ill-fated foster parents.  Not only does the child summon the beast to commit parricide, but she steals from a church in order to pay the assassin. Shortly after meeting him, she helps him dispose of someone who was sent to murder her.  

The characters in the movie are complex. Even the dust bunny isn't *all* evil.  This monster has come, after all, at the behest of the child, to protect the child.  Definitely this is an imperfect bunny, but still, in a sense, a champion.  

*Dust Bunny* is a horror movie, and it's funny--but you have to be ready for the humor in the midst of the mayhem.  

For example, the assassin, played by Mads Mikkelsen, cannot pronounce the child's name, Aurora. This mispronunciation is a running gag throughout the film.  In one scene, near the end of the movie, the monster has just eaten a pile of people. We can hear its gustatory delight as it digests.  The creature is about to eat the assassin when this killer articulates...or tries to articulate...the child's name.

body.title: Not So Hot Now – When the Shine Slowly Fades Away
body.body: Time is a reality that never stays the same. In life many things people and situations are at one time very hot meaning popular, powerful or attractive but as time passes, they lose that same shine and appeal. “Not so hot now” actually points to this changing reality where something that was once at its peak is no longer the same.\n\n

>
Picture source www.pixabay.com

We can see many examples of this phrase in our daily lives too. Sometimes a player shows outstanding performance at the start of their career and becomes the center of everyone's attention but after some time their performance declines and people say they're not like before. Similarly when some technologies or mobile phones are new, they’re very popular but over time new things come along and the old ones lose their importance.

This phrase isn't limited to just things or fame but also applies to human behavior and relationships. Sometimes relationships are very strong and beautiful in the beginning but over time that same warmth and sincerity doesn't remain in them. People start drifting apart and the same love as before isn't felt in their hearts. In such cases it can be said that the relationship has become “not so hot now”.

Besides this the phrase also teaches us an important lesson that nothing in the world stays the same forever. Success, fame, power or beauty are all temporary. That’s why a person should value their time and adopt humility because what is at its peak today can face decline tomorrow.

“Not so hot now” reminds us that change is an essential part of life. We should not only accept this reality but also learn to adapt ourselves to it. Those who change with time are the ones who achieve real success while those who keep living in the past get left behind.

body.title: El dia que el Bitcoin va a un milió de dòlars: una bogeria mundial
body.body: Era un matí qualsevol de l'any 2035. El sol sortia tranquil·lament sobre Barcelona, els coloms feien el seu passeig per la Plaça Catalunya i jo, un humil programador de Gràcia que havia comprat dos bitcoins l'any 2022 per fer el ximple amb un amic, em despertava amb el mòbil explotant de notificacions. \n\n\

cridava el titular de tots els mitjans. 

Al principi em pensava que era un error de l'aplicació, o potser que algú havia hackejat CoinMarketCap. Però no. Les gràfiques no mentien: una línia verda que pujava com si fos un coet de SpaceX en dia de llançament. El meu petit portafoli, que feia anys que dormia com un os en hibernació, s'havia convertit en una fortuna de dos milions de dòlars. Dos milions! 

Vaig sortir al balcó en pijama, mirant el carrer com si esperés que els edificis es transformessin en palaus de marbre. I en certa manera, va passar.

Primer van ser els meus veïns. La senyora del tercer pis, que sempre es queixava del soroll de les meves tecles a les tres de la matinada, va trucar a la porta amb un somriure que no li havia vist mai. \

Resulta que la dona tenia 0,5 BTC guardats en un USB dins d'una capsa de galetes. Ara valia mig milió. De cop i volta tothom era expert: el carnisser de baix, que abans només parlava de botifarres, ara dissertava sobre halving, hash rate i \

.\n\nPerò la bogeria de veritat va començar quan vaig decidir anar a celebrar-ho. Vaig baixar al carrer i vaig veure una cua interminable davant del caixer de bitcoins que havien instal·lat fa anys al costat del Mercat de la Boqueria. La gent no comprava tomàquets, comprava Lamborghinis virtuals. Un taxista que abans renegava dels preus del gasoil, ara aparcava un Ferrari vermell brillant i cridava: \
\n\nEls governs van entrar en pànic. El president dels Estats Units va fer una roda de premsa dient que \
mentre al fons es veia com el seu propi tresorer intentava comprar BTC amb targeta de crèdit del govern. A la Unió Europea van declarar l'estat d'emergència cripto: \

Però ja era tard. A Andorra, que sempre ha sigut terra de bancs discrets, ara hi havia cues de banquers suïssos fugint cap a les muntanyes amb maletes plenes de frases seed.\n\nA Catalunya la cosa es va tornar èpica. El president de la Generalitat va sortir al balcó de Palau amb una samarreta que deia \
i va anunciar que la independència ja no calia perquè \
La Rambla es va omplir de gent ballant la sardana amb auriculars posant \
de fons. Els castellers van fer un pilar de nou amb tothom cridant \

i al capdamunt un noi amb una samarreta de MicroStrategy aguantava una bandera amb el logo taronja.\n\nPerò no tot eren flors i violes. Els bancs tradicionals van començar a tancar portes. El director del meu banc de tota la vida em va trucar plorant: \
Els preus de les cases es van disparar: un piset de 50 metres a Barcelona ara costava \
0,3 BTC. I els restaurants? Un menú del dia a la Barceloneta costava 0,001 BTC, però et servien el pa amb oli i sal amb una targeta de crèdit que deia \
.\n\nEls influencers van multiplicar-se com bolets després de la pluja. De cop tothom tenia un canal de YouTube titulat \
. Un youtuber famós va fer un vídeo des d'un iot al port de Barcelona dient: \

Mentre al fons es veia com el seu gos portava un collar de diamants i un collar de hardware wallet.\n\nI jo, enmig de tot aquest caos, vaig decidir fer una cosa senzilla: vaig anar a comprar pa amb tomàquet al meu forn de sempre. El forner, amb llàgrimes als ulls, em va dir: \
\n\nPerò el millor moment va ser quan vaig rebre un missatge anònim al meu wallet: \

. No sé si era veritat o un trol, però em va fer somriure.

Al final del dia, mentre el sol es ponia sobre una Barcelona plena de Lambos grocs, Ferraris verds i Tesles voladors (perquè amb tants diners tothom volia innovar), em vaig adonar d'una cosa: el Bitcoin no havia canviat només el preu. Havia canviat la gent. De cop tothom era més feliç, més boig i... una mica més pobre en sentit comú.

Perquè quan tothom és milionari gràcies al Bitcoin, el que realment val un milió de dòlars... és una bona llauna de pa amb tomàquet feta amb amor i sense FOMO.

I colorín colorado, aquest conte de criptomonedes s'ha acabat. O potser només acaba de començar. Qui sap? Potser demà baixa a 500.000 i tornem tots a la normalitat.

**HODL fort, amics. I recordeu: el que puja... també pot fer una correcció de 30% en dues hores.** 

😂

body.title: Too Quiet To Feel Alive.
body.body:
It was around evening that very day. I took a nap in the afternoon and woke up around 6:30pm. I didn't know what woke me up; I can't say.




![1000955289.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23wBxtPwNDyK862hbufghNkH2YfsTRdhwBwJvMRZNxCHE8fnZ7j24hH7PMxuio9j43aft.png)



That was my first evening at home in a very long time. I arrived home from the hospital just the night before; it was even midnight already, so I wasn't really myself. I just ate a little food, took my pills, and slept off. I did the same in the morning too, ate, and just slept off again. Not only that, but I have just been sleeping all through. That afternoon I just wanted to rest a little, but I didn't know when I slept off. Again. But when I woke up this evening, it was different; unlike the other times I woke up to eat and sleep back, this time it wasn't that. I woke up because something felt different, more like something was missing.



There was absolutely no sound at all, I mean...at all. Everywhere was quiet. No side talks, no arguments, no hospital tray sounds, no bed creaking sounds, no shouts of patients and relatives, not even a distant one, nothing at all. I couldn't say if anyone was home because it was just silent all through. Even the rolling fan seems to make no sound.


And in all honesty, that kind of silence was not normal.

*\

* I said to myself, trying to hear if I will hear myself.

Because for a long time, my life has been a loud one, let's just say the direct opposite of what's happening now. There have been various voices: patients crying out in pain, nurses calling out to doctors, emergencies, beeping of machines, prayers here and there, and a lot more. And I became used to that noise; it got to a point I felt I needed it as it made me feel still alive and here.



So, having to see and be experiencing this kind of quietness feels somehow. It didn't feel like peace; it didn't feel like what I have been used to. I sighed, sat up on the bed, and reached for my phone. I checked; there were no notifications, messages, or even a missed call. As if I'm not even existing. My mind quickly went back to those first few months in the hospital when my phone wouldn't stop ringing with calls and messages from friends trying to reach out to me and check in on me.



I dropped the phone, and that was when I started paying attention to where I was. I stood up to look around. It's not night yet, just evening, and I could still see very well. I saw how neat and well arranged the room was. Everything is in place and within reach. Arranged in a way that even if there's no light and it's dark, I could walk directly to where a certain thing is and pick it up without tripping over another thing littered around.





![1000955301.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xAY3V5wSehrXhjPbo3XrqAMV18gEjCp6XzrfmFGQmJqiw8YnzeXjWrjAYMytns8nLYz.png)




It was just the exact way I love my space. No scattered stuff around. I walked to the window and pushed it open. Well, the last I remembered, my window did make a sound. But this time, it didn't. Didn't even sound like I opened anything. I almost questioned my aliveness.






As I was about to turn away from the window, I heard a distant sound. It was the sound of a dog barking. But it only did for a few seconds, and then it stopped. It's strange, or maybe I thought. I leaned my back against the window frame and smiled.


*\

* I said to myself.



I remember imagining the exact moment some time ago. That I will definitely rest from all of these surgeries and hospital smells. That one day all these pitiful eyes looking at me will stop, and I will finally be at a quiet place... resting.


But as I stood near the wall, I felt a little different. Maybe because of what I have been used to. I felt empty, like I wasn't alive, existing, or useful. Like something I have been used to—a sound I have been used to for a long time—has been turned off, and now, I don't know what to do with myself or my thoughts.


I was tempted to step out, but I didn't. I just walked back up to bed and lay there with my eyes facing the wall. Not only that, but I was lost in thought for what I guess was hours, because everywhere was getting dark already, and I didn't even reach out to my phone to check the time or anything again. Right there on the bed, a thought came to my mind quietly, like a thief in the night.

What if nothing is wrong? That was the thought.

I turned to face the wall and pondered it. What if this is exactly why I've fought so hard to stay alive? What if this is what I've been running towards and I didn't recognize it... because it wasn't what I thought or what I was used to?




I didn't know how and when I slept off again. I was woken up the following morning with a knock on my door. It was my mom.


*\

* She asked as she stepped in with pap, milk, and akara (bean cake) on the tray in her hand.





![1000955302.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xeXWLqkJ25pryp2vABpZcWN4wYMqvKiE1PBaDZF9LwWMXpVAumzuXpSkR89ke9hZ7Uk.png)




*\
* I said, nodding and rubbing my eyes.\n\n*\

* She said, smiling as she dropped the food on the stool next to my bed.


I just smiled.


*\

* She said and stepped out.


I sat up on the bed immediately after she left. I looked around the room, and it was still the same. Calm, neat, orderly, and quiet.

The difference now is it didn't feel strange like it was the day before.

Later that day, I was sitting on the bed reading a book when my phone made a sound. I checked and saw it was a message; I didn't open it. I just smiled and dropped it back down.

The quiet was still there, but it didn't feel strange or as if something was missing or turned off....it felt like something was waiting. And for the first time I wasn't struggling or trying to fill it. I just sat there...in it.





🌹

**Images are AI generated.**



**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

![LYlvf16wF8mR3Mcb_IMG20260418075624.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/aellly/images/LYlvf16wF8mR3Mcb_IMG20260418075624/LYlvf16wF8mR3Mcb_IMG20260418075624.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近这一段时间上班的时候一直在路边看到一只灰色的猫。
说它是灰色的吧，它倒是有一只白色的猫。就是白色跟灰色相间。
看起来肥嘟嘟的。特别喜欢它。我是天生喜欢这种猫多的动物。

之前路过的时候看见过两三次。距离比较远，所以也是没机会碰到的。
直到昨天下午要去上班的时候，它蹲在路边。它是背后向着我的。
等靠近它之后，我就轻轻的用手在它身上摸了一下。那毛发非常的柔顺。

特别是这只猫身上的肉好多。这样的猫撸起来是非常解压的。
结果我一摸到了猫头之后。这猫竟然在我脚边蹭了蹭。还不怕我。
刚开始的时候我还怕被它咬一下。没想到它不会咬人，还会在我脚边蹭来蹭去的。

在它的脖子上面还套着一个环。这证明的是人家养的家猫，宠物猫。
肯定不是在外面的流浪猫可以比的。而且他见到我这样的陌生人，还在蹭一蹭。
证明这只猫有多会讨人喜欢。一下子情绪下直接给拉满了。

这只猫被我摸了一会之后它也不抗拒。我就直接把它给抱了起来。
抱起来之后，我明显能感受到这只猫的表情有点紧张。它的眼神有点不知所措。
我怕吓到它了。然后就把它放回到地上。再摸了一会就走了。它应该是这个小区里面的宠物猫。

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@aellly/6byozm)

body.title: Mikutopia Part 3 \
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZoYWX2GcQqk4Nei3T7TY8oVR13X2dR53LT3RTkrGQqB8/neutral_simple_elegant_travel_vlog_youtube_thumbnail_.png)

Hi, I am Arveno from Surabaya city. In this content i want to share about my last vacation in my hometown. Lets continue the journey from [Part 2](https://peakd.com/hive-141359/@arveno/mikutopia-part-2-lets-advanture)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPtCG71oKhBgoMqumBHoXaFqeFe6LXTpY4UMaij3oEi9/image.png)

Ummm, since we are in the new place of course dont forget to take a picture together. But, its really backlight since the weather is really hot that day. But, its okay at least we are making memories with this picture. So far, this place is not pretty interesting, i mean this place is just for kids playing and thats it. No other things that make other people will come back to this place. No signature rides or something that really attract to come back. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVE3auErNYCmzeGPGB5igabYZLkVWeDz1zJEqTcHG9xDH/image.png)

But, at least Yes, this place is really great for social media picture and for family trip (especially who loves riding rides and walking a lot). And for the food, really i dont think there are healthy food inside. All of the stall is just selling sugar and ultra proccessed food inside. Nuggets, Sausages, Fried Chicken which is i seen there is a lot of oil. All the drink mostly is sugary. Only water that really expensive too. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczF9zPpfEpLD3ziwD1xurjQMjictBaAY21s6MVcCQcYh/image.png)

So, for the rest is we are just walking and hovering outside to see what kind of rides outside. And there are many rides that not ready yet and still developing. Really actually this place is not ready to be opened but i think the developer or the owner needs money fast, so they are just opened as fast as they could and developing while already getting money. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY1gSSa5q1YDBooRXjmANMyFWECKzcS4Yb6iRdfPCx6LV/image.png)

This is the view that i took from above. And yeah this place is really big. Maybe as big as Secret Zoo that we are usually goes to. But, in here there is no animals at all except rabbit that really exhausted and frightening to human and also full for its stomach. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWuZ4hPnY2crjmrMPfTnSp8K3VoRBVbWvvApzFPAA8q7t/image.png)

And like i said before there are no staff stand by around the rides because of they are already break or still praying so the rides area is really quiet. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5isQRbc7NT3DGcvtrPCnUtSUVmcvT4PHtpQa241qaJZ/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZ8mNHg85JQzZEjgHEP9GTJ3EzmKYszaXcJuBnRhw5rm/image.png)

This is what i talking about the only place that having animals inside. And this place is full of kids. I cannot goes inside. So, this time it just my son goes inside. And i really dont know where he is. My wife that look after my son and waiting there. In this time i was going to buy drinks for them. 
After my son dissapointed in there because no rabbits want to get feed. So, he just going out and seeking my wife. After that we are decided to go home. Because the weather is strange. I felt that the air pressure going down that usually led to heavy rain. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRuCVYNBzw8ZXYo32GNsedeYUj5FxVKQdDTknFGr1FXHh/image.png)

But, since we are still not eating lunch. We decided to eating lunch in place that really cool called **Waroeng Bamboe**. In here we can eating while enjoying view of Zen Pond filled with so many Koi's Fish and we can fed them by paying 0,5$. But, my boy already sluggish to feeding animals since he got ignored by all the rabbits

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY68Wza8ybhqPhuEsx5hGDsECumTeJYmZNvTb41UixXfF/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBbpnzGPKL239EFpmWmm6cE3uC2xASCUqxt4qh43UQ74/image.png)

This time we are eating Roasted Chicken and Fried Chicken (without excess Oil of course) and with much vegetables there. This place taste is really standards. Not very delicious but the taste still good. What extraordinary about this place is the vibes is really amazing, sound naturally. Water sound, Koi's Feeding Frenzy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbn6DimLGEbQigLmpJ4Q1oyFg5QPMkKzUHGi7CGSoRR4F/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTDieKyzjjZhZVKMWDRpwa1paL9sst5myhyXFba681D8V/image.png)

And also there are so many animals in here. So, my son is happier there than in Mikutopia. I think he is really looks like me. Better seeing animals than rides. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS2PpZy4Ywv2iSfMpz7cCjsmgZovm7KhfbujZGbyyfX3h/image.png)

See right??? His eyes cannot lies. He is still want to looking the Koi's instead to get pictured. And yep this time we got really cool advanture of holidays.

body.body:
![mmexport1776593464040.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQTHbPJXFz5NnihrnXkeaco24d3w3U2tywvZM3k4BGiBZ/mmexport1776593464040.jpg)

哈哈，太壮观了。已经联想到一个月后那些小猫在地板上爬爬走走玩耍的场景了，夸张点说就是无处落脚。但是也有一点一定要做好事前防范，就是角角落落犄角旮旯都要给堵住，省得到时跑哪个角落去做坏事。虽然它们天生有定点排泄的习惯，但也要防个别爱捣蛋的小猫干坏事。

黑米昨天傍晚也开始生了，大概用了五个小时生了五只猫崽，那样我家就有九只小猫了。加上大猫一共十二只，是不是有画面感了呢。

那几胎下来也有一点经验了。这次小猫断奶绝对不会给它吃乱七八糟的食物了。在三十几天开始就给它吃幼猫猫粮，最多煮点鸡胸肉给它们加加餐。有时候爱就是害，觉得给它们养的肥嘟嘟的可爱，吃些它们无法消化吸收的食物，导致它们消化不良得胃肠疾病。上一胎就被我搞坏了，四只幼猫有三只得了消化不良，小猫受尽了折磨，我还花了好多钱。吃一堑长一智，都是养育经验，要自己参透。

body.title: Sunday's Hunts [On Shiny Floors and Table]
body.body:
We took the round table. It is the perfect spot, away from the windows and glass walls, so it wasn't too hot. As I sat down, I noticed something cool on the glossy tabletop. Phone out from my purse, a few taps, then snap!
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23xVToY99iVXmCV5Mh7mwkBKhw4nLxgU46tieXGsgkZA3ogRpdr7Wm31h3BprLgP7ahJt.jpg
Actually, it started while we were in church. My eyes have been accustomed to noticing reflections, and they didn't miss a few while we sat in one of the pews near the front. The stained glass windows were partially mirrored on the tiled floor, and so were the candle stands, chairs, and other things. I discreetly took photos of them while the mass hadn't started.
|||| |-|-|-| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/EoGztYqVzrE2e8udkj1pyeiDxNBRnkneK4p6b73i1bjAW5YndfK5tmcSvi36b7VUSUD.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23w2eK7xqjDMvTomkg8uBmSvR1vGX16HuWT7dFEc1RyitHeKQZSEpX1aHCLzkDbboRF9B.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/EogPfsDrUou3uua7o1d1MqbW4VzV12NFheydoJL93a73Kc6w1hV4PrSQtzHpiWKpNhA.jpg|
Anyway, we went for brunch after the mass. At the restaurant, I noticed and captured some more. The first shot was the top photo in this post. Looking around, the mirrored lights on the floor behind the hubby's chair caught my attention. They are pretty cool, so click! click! click! I took plenty, but sharing only three, lol!
|||| |-|-|-| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23xKvd5uuoQyXL14qwGxoM3Qo7gPtXyAHvoXzh6KEhUJXYFTWAi1q9H21dpVfRzf99z7K.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/Eo8UD7SqJNbsACNAbmxWX2xaJsponiPr3Rggzpz5JF521kDHuY2GnW5PZfzfFnUp4de.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23vi1sh8EJSkJP8teZF3mr7q4UkYRh2Z1m9WnXMUu3BTFK5269127uGtWLeHWQpmtB9CK.jpg|
This on the other hand, was a few meters from where I was seated. Reflections are on the floor and on the glass windows too!
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23uQvwbdQwqkn1qPX1zDSQAQPK3qVdZAEhipvUAhpgXnbeHQDpr3819MXahY6kRJ1osA5.jpg
The hubby's food was served, so my attention shifted back to our table. I took a few pics before he started eating.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/EokfbEdhJqTRkx18FkC584ESAJw1vYAKJi7W5YHubsWjq5DTz4PUkU8fnJdTdDDENkw.jpg
This was the sandwich tray. We were done eating when I saw its reflection. Love how the patterns on its underside showed up on the table.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/Ep7xUvqmqrsyxLbFk79TXFcQzN5GqMR4XwZ9RW6mZJNpTcZTv5v6v6xn8KnJ2WbuT7D.jpg
Chandeliers, curtains, tables, chairs, plants, balcony railings, and such. The shiny ceramic tiles mirrored almost everything. With Yongi in my arms, I paused to take a couple of shots when we were leaving the food place.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/Ep5nEvn4Aoqjjh8HLtdW8XZ6FXMQ59CpPghauNzryAyBg75NhpDoMyHHjjjF4CbbMs3.jpg
A closer look at the floor. The photo was slightly manipulated (warmer tone, adjusted contrast, sharpness, light range, etc) to highlight the display.😍
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23z7DmUHNJ4GapyFoQe53GFTktincQhdSQGiYrAZUoxgGNutMQzendobamYYAKm7hdQ1U.jpg
And with that, let me end the day's reflection hunt. It's been fun as always. Until next time!
--- --- **

>Smile... laugh often... love more... be grateful always!** --- ---
*All photos are my own unless specified. 19042026/22:16ph*

body.title: Introducing Hive Witness Monitor: Making Witness Evaluation and Voting Decisions Simple and Intuitive
body.body:
In the HIVE ecosystem, we can evaluate a witness from many dimensions: community reputation, historical contributions, activity level… but ultimately, **the most important factor is just one thing — whether they are running a stable node that consistently produces blocks.**


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyr9BUEhswgJ5aBD1BAo9T48qdiYXxW7mEaCGpprvpyo/image.png)


If a witness node is running an outdated version for a long time, producing delayed or stalled blocks, or frequently going offline, then regardless of their past contributions or reputation, it may be time to reconsider your vote.

The problem is:  
👉 For most users, **evaluating node health and reviewing their votes is not an easy task.**

Although we previously introduced a witness list tool (https://www.cutehive.com/witnesses) to simplify this process, it still lacks intuitive clarity for fast decision-making.

---

## 🧭 Hive Witness Monitor: Turning Complexity into Clarity

That’s why we built a new tool:

## 🚀 Hive Witness Monitor

Its goal is simple:  
👉 **Make witness evaluation and vote checking effortless, intuitive, and even enjoyable.**

---

## ✨ Why Do You Need It?

In HIVE’s decentralized world, **witnesses are the backbone of consensus**.  
As a stakeholder, every vote you cast directly impacts the network’s security and future.

But in reality:

- There are hundreds of witnesses  
- Node status changes frequently  
- Traditional lists are not intuitive enough  

👉 This is exactly the problem Hive Witness Monitor is designed to solve.


![8d829f5df67dbc5a1ff24336a5b8ae3d.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTApEqCVBh8i8y6FCFGP2kK3aCVifV1W7vhL2fmaTxdfX/8d829f5df67dbc5a1ff24336a5b8ae3d.png)


## 🔍 Key Features

### ✅ Instantly Understand Node Health

We use multi-dimensional data analysis to classify witnesses intelligently:

- ✅ **Healthy**: Correct version + actively producing blocks  
- ⚠️ **Outdated Version**: Below current hard fork requirement, posing consensus risk  
- ⏰ **Delayed / Stalled**: Potential sync or node issues  
- 💤 **Inactive / Offline**: Consider removing your vote  

👉 No need to analyze raw data manually — just glance and decide.


![97750ab4291bc2056153296132abef98.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRa9UBE3dNxvAuN7YJacC2urA6xosAoAoJLvkqAWqVAhW/97750ab4291bc2056153296132abef98.png)


### 👀 “Who Did I Vote For?” — Instantly Highlighted

Simply enter your Hive username:

- Your voted witnesses will be automatically highlighted  
- Quickly identify:
  - Votes supporting problematic nodes  
  - Votes that are no longer effective  

👉 **Your voting power becomes fully visible and actionable.**

---

### 🎨 Modern UI: Bento Box Experience

We moved away from outdated tables and adopted a modern design:

- 🍱 Bento Box layout  
- 📊 Real-time block height display  
- 📈 Visualized status ratios  

A smooth and clear experience on both desktop and mobile.

---

### ⚙️ Highly Customizable

To meet different user needs:

- 🌍 Custom RPC nodes (global selection)  
- 🔢 Adjustable monitoring range (Top 50 ~ 300+)  

👉 Use trusted data sources and focus on what matters to you.


![c2a0cfa5b7685285bed186eced585504.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVgVfBhscr7hpWs71BarJHPTgvNkAG9xbqoBBABbdAnmR/c2a0cfa5b7685285bed186eced585504.png)


## 🧰 Not Just for Users — Also for Witnesses

This tool is equally useful for witnesses themselves:

- Detect block delays  
- Identify version mismatches  
- Monitor missed blocks  

👉 Spot issues early and fix them before they impact your reputation and votes.

---

## 🔐 Technology & Privacy

Maintained by @cutehive.com, this tool follows strict principles:

- 🛡️ **Privacy First**: No private keys, no personal data collection  
- 🌐 **Frontend Only**: All data fetched via public Hive RPC nodes  
- 🔍 **Transparent & Verifiable**: Open data sources and clear logic  

---

## 🚀 Get Started

👉 Visit now: 🔗 https://witness-monitor.cutehive.com/  
🌱If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to leave a comment below 👇

body.title: On photography and luck
body.body:
![set.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23yTUf6TcKCY8nrkQQCyixcvtrUj7EErb6bEMNzcDS4KeWqTw2ia7ZkgYSoNjCr4S4kxx.jpg)

Yet again I find myself uploading a few photographs here and just sitting looking at them, incapable of finding some words to say. I guess you could call it writer's block, but perhaps it's more just a general disinterest in the blogging side of things in general. Part of me wishes I could just post images somewhere and not have to do the rest. It almost feels forced to find something to say here. I have noticed I'm not alone in that, I have seen more and more posts here when I check in that say similar things: we're all facing a bit of burnout. Maybe it's the chaotic times. Maybe it's the years of doing this daily in many cases. Maybe it's part of us just growing up and finding other things to fill our time with in our day to day lives. I guess I'll find a way to fill this with some thoughts. The weather has been picking up a bit, finally some warmer days mixed within the cloudy and the rain. I've felt more energy as of late with that, the sunny days have me waking up feeling a bit better. More motivated, more excited to do things. Though I know that life is still finding ways to keep me down.

![crosses.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23wgF9Jviqr57KP64jTo5VTTv9thRz8RQB7JzVN1yieUvKWrMQq1fH3sP22QUNsFcuANY.jpg)

I still have struggled a bit with photography. As if I have found some boredom within the city. Where there isn't a whole lot going on still. The same streets. The same faces. The same atmosphere. It's a challenge for sure, but I tell myself that photography is always about getting out in the first place, and whatever you take is just a nice addition to the fact that you *did* actually go out into the world and do something. Though I can't deny that knowing I'm going home with a few nice photographs makes it that much nicer. To know I didn't *just* walk for an entire day only to take nothing. Sometimes that's okay. Sometimes it's inevitable. But when it starts to happen a bit more often, I start to question whether there's something wrong. Is it me? Or the location? Is it really weather? Maybe I'm missing the entire point. Maybe I'm not connecting with people enough to shoot the things I want to. 

![tree.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23u64xNLZZk8rYAzbhozbz6pReyKosvvGL9XcF9VVgGxc2GYhXYVs7QUqRZPeQVa3oxvB.jpg)

I think that photography is one of those weird hobbies that can really change your life. But it's not that having a camera is enough for that. It still takes a bit of yourself to change with it to get where you want. The camera can sit there, but it's up to you to take it to those unique spots where you're wanting to capture certain things. This returns to that thought: is it just me? Maybe a location is riddled with opportunities that may not appear on the surface, and I just need to create them for myself somehow. Though at the same time, the other day I did fly my drone and it simply fell out of the sky. I'm now minus a drone. Which sort of does sum up \

as I have come to calling it. At the same time, it was due for an upgrade. And while I probably won't do so anytime soon, at least there's knowing that once it is replaced, it'll be with something far more capable and modern.

![underpass.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23tv4V37L5sfRwhjy68HCimnPXf8Lzn5Lz8d2H6NyoDUvHR44CgN2rboNqhyegQC5wMfj.jpg)

Anyway, there's my somewhat recent rant on whatever I've been feeling or thinking about. No idea again when I will bring myself to posting again. But I am content with knowing that I don't feel like I *need* to do it. That I'm not missing out on rewards for not doing so. That I can step away and focus on myself when it's needed.

body.title: [Literature] Johann Gottlieb Fichte:  The Vocation of Man #16/65
body.body:
But thou shouldst then content thyself with saying,—“I feel myself affected in the manner that I call red, blue, smooth, rough.” Thou shouldst place these sensations in thyself alone, and not transfer them to an object lying entirely out of thyself, and declare the modifications of thyself to be properties of this object.

Or, tell me, when thou believest that thou seest an object red, or feelest it smooth, dost thou really perceive anything more than that thou art affected in a certain manner?

I. From what has gone before, I have clearly seen, that I do not, in fact, perceive more than what thou sayest, and this transference of what is in me to something out of myself, from which nevertheless I cannot refrain, now appears very strange to me.

My sensations are in myself, not in the object, for I am myself and not the object; I am conscious only of myself and of my own state, not of the state of the object. If there be a consciousness of the object, that consciousness is, certainly, neither sensation nor perception:—thus much is clear.

/>
Spirit. Thou formest thy conclusions somewhat precipitately. Let us consider this matter on all sides, so that I may be assured that thou wilt not again retract what thou hast now freely admitted.

>​

Is there then in the object, as thou usually conceivest of it, anything more than its red colour, its smooth surface, and so on; in short, anything besides those characteristic marks which thou obtainest through immediate sensation?

I. I believe that there is: besides these attributes there is yet the thing itself to which they belong; the substratum which supports these attributes.

Spirit. But through what sense dost thou perceive this substratum of these attributes? Dost thou see it, feel it, hear it; or is there perhaps a special sense for its perception?

I. No. I think that I see and feel it.

Spirit. Indeed! Let us examine this more closely. Art thou then ever conscious of thy sight in itself, or at all times only of determinate acts of sight?

I. I have always a determinate sensation of sight.

Spirit. And what is this determinate sensation of sight, with respect to that object there?

I. That of red colour.

Spirit. And this red is something positive, a simple sensation, a specific state of thyself?

I. This I have understood.

Spirit. Thou shouldst therefore see the red in itself as simple, as a mathematical point, and thou dost see it only as such. In theeat least, as an affection of thyself, it is obviously a simple, determinate state, without connexion with anything else,—which we can only describe as a mathematical point. Or dost thou find it otherwise?

I. I must admit that such is the case.

Spirit. But now thou spreadest this simple red over a broad surface, which thou assuredly dost not see, since

>​thou seest only a simple red. How dost thou obtain this surface?

I. It is certainly strange.—Yet, I believe that I have found the explanation. I do not indeed see the surface, but I feelit when I pass my hand over it. My sensation of sight remains the same during this process of feeling, and hence I extend the red colour over the whole surface which I feel while I continue to see the same red.

Spirit. This might be so, didst thou really feel such a surface. But let us see whether that be possible. Thou dost not feel absolutely; thou feelest only thy feelings, and art only conscious of these?

I. Certainly. Each sensation is a determinate something. I never merely see, or hear, or feel, in general, but my sensations are always definite;—red, green, blue colours, cold, warmth, smoothness, roughness, the sound of the violin, the voice of man, and the like,—are seen, felt, or heard. Let that be settled between us.

Spirit. Willingly.—Thus, when thou saidst that thou didst feel a surface, thou hadst only an immediate consciousness of feeling smooth, rough, or the like?

I. Certainly.

Spirit. This smooth or rough is, like the red colour, a simple sensation,—a point in thee, the subject in which it abides? And with the same right with which I formerly asked why thou didst spread a simple sensation of sight over an imaginary surface, do I now ask why thou shouldst do the same with a simple sensation of touch?

I.

body.title: When Every Monster Suddenly Has “Low Health” — and I Run Out of Answers Too
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXaAGDBYE7ECxgCL7atKtHFP8BE8rvTRPHT32pQBhUsDk/anemic_thumbnail.jpg)



Greetings, Splinterlands warriors.
Last season, I wrapped things up with a result that was… well, not too bad, but not exactly something to brag about either. Still stuck in the same league, still using the same old strategies, and occasionally still losing due to poor positioning—or simply being overconfident. But that’s how it goes: a season always ends, and a new story always begins.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXxeWP8UkQ5kdFvvsgxKgEnPhfKqLtDvYcdUQtH4t1xWA/anemic_icon.png)</center>


And at the start of this season, I encountered something new. The name even sounds like a medical diagnosis: **Anemic**.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeFNm4PNH7pMBizXp4N1RUgR8rLbrTVfGxUrjTrcWEk52/anemic.png)</center>



At first, I thought it was just another standard ruleset. Turns out, it’s not that simple.
**Anemic** is a ruleset where all monsters, no matter who they are, **start the match with a maximum Health of only 4**. It doesn’t matter if it’s a bulky tank with massive HP—everything gets equalized.

---

### First Encounter: I Lost, Without Much of a Fight

The first time I faced this ruleset, I’ll be honest—I went in with my old mindset. Still thinking about thick tanks, long sustain, and defensive formations. To make things worse, the ruleset was combined with **Global Warming**, making the situation even harsher for monsters.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSogVf8SYfmspPv4hzs7B7QiECufGU7Zt1hKTeWCuP7PK/round_1.png)


The result?
I lost. Quickly. No heroic story to tell.

Usually, battles go on for several rounds with exciting back-and-forth exchanges. But in Anemic, it feels like *sudden death*. One hit, one mistake, and a unit is gone. There’s no room for slow thinking.

I even sat there for a moment after the battle ended.
“Wait… that was fast.”

You can watch the battle here:
<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_7d6726a8cdb19442c4327958d89e2e9a?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>

---

### Starting to Understand: It’s Not About Strength, It’s About Speed

After that loss, I started rethinking everything. In this ruleset, the very definition of “strength” changes completely.

Since all HP is capped at 4:

* Tanky monsters lose their advantage
* And most importantly: **whoever is faster, wins**

That’s when I realized that **Speed is everything**.
If you can strike first, chances are your opponent won’t get the chance to strike back.

I also began to see the value of abilities I used to consider “just extras”:

* **Strengthen** → increases HP beyond the 4 limit 
<center>https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_strengthen.png</center>

* **Life Leech** → slowly builds survivability
<center>https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_life-leech.png</center>

* **Scavenger** → grows stronger as units fall
<center>https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_scavenger.png</center>

* **Shield & Void** → reduce incoming damage
<center>https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_void-armor.png</center>

* Multi-attack abilities → because one extra hit can mean one extra kill

In short, it’s no longer about lasting longer—it’s about **eliminating your opponent as quickly as possible while maintaining just enough protection**.

---

### Reflection: This Ruleset Isn’t Fair, But It’s Honest

When you think about it, **Anemic isn’t fair… but it is honest**.
It forces you out of your comfort zone. You can’t rely on your favorite cards or old strategies anymore.

And that’s where its real value lies—especially for newer players.

For those with limited collections, this ruleset actually opens up opportunities:

* Expensive cards don’t always dominate
* Smaller monsters can shine
* Strategy matters more than collection size

---

### Closing & Quick Tips

If you ever face the **Anemic** ruleset, don’t panic.
Think of it not as a limitation, but as an invitation to play differently.

My advice:
**focus on speed, use abilities that improve durability, and don’t be afraid to play smaller monsters.**

Because in a world where everything is “low on health,” the ones who survive aren’t the biggest—
but the fastest and the most prepared.

See you in the arena. ⚔️

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)



Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___
