body.body:
El delantero francés campeón del mundo y de la Champions League con el Chelsea, a sus 39 años sigue dando de que hablar, y con pronósticos, esta siendo uno de los jugadores más decisivos de la Ligue 1, donde no sólo es la referencia en ataque del Lille, sino que además, es el goleador del equipo con 11 goles y 1 asistencia en los 41 partidos jugados en todas las competiciones. En Francia ya suma 7 goles, y ha sido pieza clave para que en este momento estén luchando por las plazas de Champions League. 

> The French striker, a World Cup and Champions League winner with Chelsea, continues to make headlines at 39 years old, and according to predictions, he is proving to be one of the most decisive players in Ligue 1. He is not only Lille's main attacking threat, but also the team's top scorer with 11 goals and 1 assist in 41 matches across all competitions. In France alone, he has scored 7 goals and has been a key player in their current fight for a Champions League spot.

<center>![1000652248.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaAiA1wxvY7UM8enkXwWg4qJE1F6kt7VQcKrzgx4cUfZb/1000652248.jpg)</center>

<center> <a href=\

>Fuente Aunque no son cifras de auténtico escándalo, hay que observar lo influyente que es el jugador en el juego para darle más importancia a su temporada, pues no sólo su función es la de rematador, sino que además tiene buen juego con el balón, siendo igual de importante para ganar segundas jugadas, y sobretodo, su función es la de arrastrar marcas, ayudando a generar espacios para sus compañeros que llegan desde segunda línea, o inclusive, algún espacio para la corrida de los extremos. > Although these figures aren't truly scandalous, it's important to consider how influential the player is in the game to give more weight to his season. His role isn't solely that of a finisher; he also has good ball control, making him equally important for winning second balls. Above all, his role is to draw defenders away, helping to create space for teammates arriving from midfield, or even space for wingers to make runs. Su físico también es privilegiado para cumplir estas funciones, pues con su altura de 1,93 mts, sumado a su corpulencia física, le permite ser muy bueno en el juego aéreo, desde donde a marcado muchos goles, siendo también uno de los mejores delanteros pivotes de la última década. Todo esto le ha permitido ser un referente del Lille actual, marcando varios goles importantes, como uno frente al Mónaco en el tiempo agregado, que les permitió conseguir los 3 puntos in extremis. > His physique is also ideally suited to these roles, as his height of 1.93 meters, combined with his physical strength, makes him excellent in the air, where he has scored many goals, making him one of the best holding midfielders of the last decade. All of this has allowed him to become a key player for Lille, scoring several important goals, such as the one against Monaco in stoppage time that secured a last-gasp 3 points. Este trabajo táctico siempre ha sido una de sus principales virtudes, viendo esto en otros equipos como el Arsenal, donde al mando de Arsena Wenger, se volvió un experto en esta función, teniendo además los mejores números asistidores de su carrera. Pero esta función llegó a su cúspide en el Mundial de 2018 en Rusia, donde fue el 9 titular de los galos, resaltando por esa función poco valorada por los aficionados, pero indispensable para el equipo, jugando casi todos los partidos como titular, llamando fuertemente la atención que no llegó a marcar ni 1 gol en los 7 partidos. > This tactical work has always been one of his main strengths, as seen at other teams like Arsenal, where under Arsena Wenger he became an expert in this role, also achieving the best assist numbers of his career. But this role reached its peak at the 2018 World Cup in Russia, where he was the starting number 9 for France, standing out for this often underappreciated but indispensable function for the team. He started almost every match, and it's striking that he didn't score a single goal in those seven games.
![olivier-giroud-francia-mundial-qatar-2022jpg.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeAMScYpXagzQ4ejdb12jcM5ZH4Zr7PAvtQV4oH8r3fnA/olivier-giroud-francia-mundial-qatar-2022jpg.webp)

>Fuente Esto hubiera sido lapidario para cualquier otro 9, pero justamente ese trabajo para que sus jugadores fueran mejores, fue algo indispensable para que al final Francia se terminará proclamando campeón del Mundo. En Qatar mostró una faceta un poco diferente, pues jugaba más dentro del área, llegando a marcar 4 goles, siendo pieza importante para ese subcampeonato galo, demostrando nuevamente su ductiibilidad táctica. > This would have been a fatal blow for any other number 9, but precisely that work to improve his players was essential for France to ultimately become World Champions. In Qatar, he showed a slightly different side, playing more inside the penalty area, scoring 4 goals, and being a key player in France's runner-up finish, once again demonstrating his tactical versatility. Después de la Eurocopa en 2024, anunció su retiro de la selección francesa, viendo ya como su papel había pasado a un rol secundario, jugando poco más de 50 minutos en todo el torneo. Pese a que fue tan criticado en toda su carrera nacional, el Giroud es el máximo goleador de la historia de su selección, y aunque en poco tiempo será aventajado por Kylian Mbappe, su relevancia histórica es indiscutible. > After Euro 2014, he announced his retirement from the French national team, having seen his role relegated to a secondary one, playing just over 50 minutes in the entire tournament. Despite facing considerable criticism throughout his international career, Giroud remains the all-time leading scorer for his country, and although he will soon be surpassed by Kylian Mbappé, his historical significance is undeniable. Como goleador, también ha disfrutado de momentos interesantes, tanto es así, que recuerdo un par de golazos en su carrera, y otros bastante decisivos. Creo que el más mediático de todos fue cuando aún jugaba para el Arsenal, donde remató un centro ligeramente pasado de una forma poco ortodoxa, simulando el escorpión, y clavando el balón al ángulo, uno de los mejores goles de la historia, ganando incluso el premio Puskas en 2017. > As a goalscorer, he's also had some memorable moments; in fact, I recall a couple of spectacular goals in his career, and several other quite decisive ones. I think the most high-profile of all was when he was still playing for Arsenal, where he finished off a slightly overhit cross in an unorthodox way, simulating a scorpion kick, and curling the ball into the top corner—one of the best goals in history, even winning the Puskás Award in 2017.
![_93201612_oliviergiroudscores.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZjbPStLNCkS1AuYr2VZqaUsZUU7gHLWo1xyMkpzQPozu/_93201612_oliviergiroudscores.jpg)

>Fuente A punto de cumplir 40 años, una edad poco común para un delantero de élite, su nivel actual es aún muy bueno, y aunque no le fue del todo bien en la MLS, pues no brillar del todo con Los Angeles FC, su regreso a la Ligue 1 demostró que tiene un par de años por delante, y aunque se acerque el final de un de los delanteros con más clase de los últimos años, hay que disfrutarlo mientras aún nos regale destellos de su calidad, pues Giroud parece un buen vino, mejorando con el paso de los años. > Approaching his 40th birthday, an unusual age for an elite striker, his current level is still very high, and although he didn't fare entirely well in MLS, failing to shine completely with Los Angeles FC, his return to Ligue 1 showed that he has a couple of years left in him. And although the end is approaching for one of the classiest strikers of recent years, we should enjoy him while he still gives us glimpses of his quality, because Giroud is like a fine wine, improving with age.

body.title: Movie Review: Materialists (2025)
body.body:
If you’re in the mood for a romance that actually tries to say something, you may come by the 2025 romance film: The Materialists 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katerinaramm/48VEsx9cDPnfC9g36DQcktsZKPp8isqseXM6D7vzKk42TbXMpQrgBf4uWUEDeXf71X.png)
https://www.imdb.com/title/tt30253473

It caught my attention for a variety of reasons, will it be a good watch for you?
Check it out below

I went into this film knowing very little, just that it’s a romance and that it features some seriously impressive names like Dakota Johnson, Chris Evans, and Pedro Pascal. That alone was enough for me to commit to a two-hour watch without hesitation.

(In case you did not know, I learned about it yesterday, Dakota Johnson is the daughter of Melanie Griffith and Don Johnson. I had never seen a film with her before, so I was really curious to see this one)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katerinaramm/23x1KmkJkzk7KaC3hnAm2Wncee7ZAyPzv66spJRCxJQFuGXKevyZJxAf3Wb4h7fW7iLU8.png)




From the very beginning, the film pulls you into a world that feels polished, intentional, and a little bit seductive. 
Everything is carefully crafted, good acting by everyone, great atmosphere, even though I admit that I found it to be rather slow most of the times.

It’s one of those movies where the photography and aesthetic add up to the movie, so the slow pace is not so disturbing, as it gives you time to pay attention to the story & the characters. 

The story: 
At the center of it all is a high-end matchmaker—someone who doesn’t believe in love alone, but in optimized love. She’s built her career on pairing people based on compatibility, status, and calculated perfection. Her goal? The most successful matches, the most flawless unions. In the film, she already celebrates the 9th successful wedding!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katerinaramm/EoEoAwfLoMSsNrjkh9UfzofHbaPEReskHa73p5xf9LFVD7RJdVv7r8C4DPRihNtYunz.png)


Love, in her world, is almost mathematical. (and perhaps this is where the movie took its name from)

But things get complicated when she meets what is considered a “unicorn”. Someone who seems to tick every box, maybe even more than all. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katerinaramm/23x17Jfsc12SxQ9NjMgf4PMpKxE2fXgLjDe9m5TdqkGysMcFTAH4SW9mYmZdxmzY8Qwkz.png)

Instead of trying to perfectly match him, she is gently getting into the game and into the perfect relationship for both of them!

How the movie evolves, I cannot share - this post will not contain spoilers.

You may question yourself after it.
What is love, really?
Can it be measured, predicted, orchestrated?

I saw the film for almost 2 hours, but with some breaks.
I felt that several scenes could be shot in a faster pace, while others were ok to be so slow as the emotion should be showed. I guess this is just a personal taste.

The movie is also considered as a comedy, but I did not spot any comical elements, dramatic perhaps but not comic.

I would give it a 6.5 if it would be shorter, now I am giving it a 6/10
In imdb, you will see a 6.2 at the moment


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katerinaramm/23uFu88Dh58reepq6q38RGsdUHco83hKTtvzEafVHcwqG8xmM8ev1qBP8KZn4zJgsEuGt.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katerinaramm/EoCpPqkviku6J3qGp6oumiNSQcUAtskT9LVzNHQRi2D4zrCxdLXuhxZdPhDEDVL2rmr.png)

Thoughts?

Will you watch this?

body.title: Do NOT feed your dog pork bones
body.body:
Do not give your dog pork bones Recently, someone came into our local shop complaining about a dog that was both vomiting and pooping blood and obviously, this is a less-than-desirable event. This can mean a lot of things some of which include being poisoned. Thankfully this was not the case because when that does happen, especially if it has been a while, there really isn’t a great deal that can be done to help. I will cover what you can do in that sort of incident at a later time but in this instance this was not a situation of a 3rd party being evil towards someone’s dog, it was a situation where an owner was doing something that they thought was a nice thing, but it turns out it is actually terribly detrimental for this dog’ and all dog’s health (potentially.)
https://fortheloveofcooking.net/wp-content/uploads/2013/02/DSC_0175-2.jpg [src](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTOBEO5WbjE7KIrrXaFhuumUBEB5dicOPkEsg&s)
The thing is, your dog is always going to look at your and desire whatever it is that you are eating. This is just how it is, right? I have 3 dogs and if I so much as sit down at a table and start to unwrap something that was delivered that isn’t even food, they will stare at me intently because they want some of whatever it is. Most recently it was a replacement charger for a phone and just as a side note, you shouldn’t feed dogs those either. Dogs are incredibly resilient animals but there are certain things that throughout time, even long before they were pets, they likely wouldn’t have ever had access to. One of those is cooked or smoked pork bones. I think most people are already aware of the dangers associated with chicken bones because they splinter when chewed on. But a lot of people will look at their pork ribs after they have had all the wonderful “baby back” bits off of it and think that it looks really solid and perhaps believe there is no way that a dog could possibly chew that in half, right? Well that is where people are wrong and you are seriously underestimating the power of a dog’s jaw. Also, when cooked, pork bones aren’t as solid as you might be thinking. You may regret it after you try it, but there is a really good chance that your own jaw is strong enough to bite through a cooked or smoked pork rib bone. The really horrible attribute that pork bones have is that when they do break, it’s not a clean break straight through, it splinters off in pieces almost like a brick would break if you threw it on the ground. These edges can be quite sharp and while your dog will just go ahead and gobble them down, they wreak havoc on their internal organs including stomach and intestines. If you are lucky it will only cut their esophagus but dogs are pretty persistent creatures when it comes to food and they will likely force it down even if it hurts them on it’s path to the stomach. The major problem with pork bones isn’t just that they are sharp, but that they also don’t normally stay in the stomach long enough to be fully digested, so this sharp bit of “rocklike” substance ends up traveling all the way through the intestines and can and often will cut on its way. In the case of our dog that was brought to our office, there were cuts in the throat as well as in the intestines and there really isn’t much we can do about it other than wait it out and hope for the best. Like with most things in dog ownership, prevention is normally a much easier task than the fix and while if someone was truly willing to pay for very invasive surgery for removal of the stuck pork bone, it will normally run is course and the dog will recover. The problem in the meantime is that a dog’s reaction to this is normally to simply not eat, and this can be scary to any dog owner. So, to recap, don’t feed your dog pork bones and if you have the sort of dog that will get into the trash without your permission, just make sure that they don’t have access to them. In a majority of cases this is just some temporary sort of minor suffering that the dog will have to endure while its body heals itself, in really bad situations, they can suffer for a long time with internal bleeding, end up with ulcers and while it is very rare, they can die from this. A good rule of thumb is to only give your dog bones that are meant specifically for this sort of thing. We give out certain bones to dogs but these are types of bones, normally lamb shanks, that very few animals on earth have the jaw strength to break. The **Best** rule would be to just never give your dog any bones.
If you would like to see how you can help out or simply spread the word, please visit our website at

http://krabianimalwelfare.org

![21462758_174743779763179_4154543215066704521_n.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXHEhXj4e6AzsbAJKsFo8csozuoq1uUcMSdFQTYifzi55/21462758_174743779763179_4154543215066704521_n.jpg)

body.title: Still life with bouquet on table
body.body:
>Hello! I hope you are all well. First, I will describe this pen drawing, then the technique and style used.

\n\n

>I created this drawing in blue ink (blue ballpoint pen) on a sheet of white paper. The drawing depicts a bouquet of flowers placed on a piece of furniture, a rectangular coffee table. The main element is a vase containing a bouquet composed of: several tulips, recognizable by their characteristic cup shape; a sprig of lavender or a spike flower reaching upwards to the right, adding verticality and movement; and roses or round, more fully opened flowers. The vase rests on a rectangular table or console, viewed from the front, which serves as both a support and a container. The tabletop is simple and flat, while the body of the table is treated with vertical and cross-hatching to suggest wood or a textured effect. The vase sits on a rectangular support resembling a coffee table or a wooden sideboard. The lower part of the piece of furniture is treated with vertical and cross-hatching to suggest the grainy texture of the wood.

\n\n

>Technique and Style
The material used is a blue ballpoint pen. The drawing is entirely monochrome. The lines are quite free, with cross-hatching and shading to create volume and texture. The vase is shaded with curved lines to give the impression of roundness. The bouquet is rendered more loosely and expressively. The wooden base is depicted with fairly dense hatching to convey texture. The style of the drawing is semi-naive realism. The rendering remains simple and spontaneous. It is an observational and practice drawing, probably done quickly.

\n\n

>The bouquet is well-centered, and the base provides a solid and stable foundation. The contrast between the light and airy flowers at the top and the heavy mass of the furniture at the bottom works well. The placement of the actual pen next to the drawing creates a playful effect. The ballpoint pen used to create the drawing appears in the final image.

\n\n

body.title: Wheat Farming
body.body:
Hello Hive Fam!

I hope your day is going well and that you're having a good time. 


The time is kind of year end of farming and it's a crucial time for wheat farming. It's very important to get the harvesting and Threshing done so that grain can be taken home. This is if it rains, it will really make things difficult and before the weather changes, I want to get this done. It's the season and there is high demand for labours. 

Because of high demand for the labours it is really difficult to get the labours and that is why I thinks are getting delayed however I am still trying to get more labels so that they can finish all this work as early as possible. Even though I am ready to pay slightly higher on the regular price for the labour but still it is a problem. It is every years problem because it's the time for everyone to harvest there crops and everybody try to get these done as soon as possible to avoid any loss because of weather change or if it rains.


![1000247420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/EqhQfXr7Wn3pr2dngRK4JqNMnLQLU9uqzAAniPPo5ru4dbLWZ13ScT7LGyjkNDMVAUa.jpg)

I have many fields for wheat farming and getting these than gradually so I have tied up with a doctor on earth with having all the necessary equipment and he is helping me out to get this thing done. 


![1000247426.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/EpCBpb7k8cdEWr9a3B7RtSj2AjffQ6EutL3zinEdtWogVTUA1y2exmxZJBmaCJEQRM9.jpg)

![1000247421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/EqSX1ged6d5wCHgvRqc62v3AHhkeJQ48nHrahCGtiFQbLkVsEbgrZuAr8D7x5HxPbTg.jpg)

![1000247419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/EppMZbKZ2jiAKzaFfri2JCXSf6ZHUr98ZqjKhvwq9kYftxafKebfyNRJTxKLLVrpSVn.jpg)


I use fertilizers in wheat farming but for some portion I did not use any pesticides or fertilizers so this year I want to do a comparison that how much I lost in terms of the outcome against both type of forming. Soil is not so strong and if anybody wants to go for pure organic farming it takes at least 3 years and since last year I started this process where I am using the natural composed fertilizer instead of pesticides or other fertilizers manufactured in factories. 


This is a kind of experiment I am doing and I know that it will take a few years for me to figure out with the organic farming is going to be a good business because I have seen many examples on the Internet were people are sharing good feedback but since I want to do it by my own keeping a closed track is important and that's what I am trying to do with my farming. People oftens believe that forming is an easy job but let me tell you that it is not easy and it requires a lot of efforts and time and I can say this because I have been doing a for last many years. 


With time technology is evolving and it is helping the farmers to get it better and improve but because of the cost issues not every former is able to do that and sometimes even I also struggle with that because it is not possible for me to buy everything and that is where I take different support from banks still I struggle in many areas. Machine sare expensive and new seeds are also very expensive were availability is another concern so all these things that I am trying to learn and improve for the period of time to make my forming more organic and profitable year on year. Thank you.

body.title: Splinterlands | The ESPER SHADOWBEAK is a Defensive Dual Attack Power Beast
body.body:
![Kaylia Silverleaf.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/2432B737sRdoCkutJmaWUr7SE5np8u3AVmcq58qd6bx73V5adbaivTNw9hBarmMoicuAJ.jpg)

 --- 



### Hi there Splinterlands Warriors,

Welcome back to another fresh and awesome Splinterlands post and I guess all of you are doing pretty well in your lives and enjoying a calm and pleasant day with your loved and close ones. Now, if I address those of you in particular who are actively playing this web3 strategy game and building your NFT card and other asset collection in splinterlands, I believe many of you are already busy fighting on the battlefield through this new ranked season and trying to increase your trophy rankings. If we take a quick look at the current ranked season timer, there are still around 11 days and 0 hours left before the reset takes place. So there is still a great amount of time in our hands to climb the trophy ladder steadily, secure your goal league tiers, and later make a push for bigger rewards or leaderboard positions if you have enough card collection and skills. Just keep an eye on your battle energy bar and make sure to manage those energies wisely throughout the season.

 --- 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/Eoe8B3qEAThCUVZAdXaUKGr19NMZAukFPfThQKDj3oMfEnNRXmqWQqdK6kTXPZ3ua8y.png)


 --- 


Now, talking about my own progress in the Frontier mode of this game, I am currently playing in the highest Gold I league tier with a trophy count of around 3,020. This time, I have set my goal a bit higher than usual, as I am aiming for the 4,200 trophy mark first and then trying for an entry position on the leaderboard. It will not be easy, of course, but there is still enough time left to grind consistently, so let's check out.


 --- 



![Screenshot 2026-04-19 at 11.49.27 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23xAMMe5nPXaPHYZwnRDCJMLuRtAyM8KoEQFjFpssgYj5puyRNnhTyLmG9otSFXk1Gc8g.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-19 at 11.49.43 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wBxowSbLmgisTEVUPkUnXj2MgjwNuzCHESRRgSVYdiPu8L79vVmjf1SvTdWs5TPDHsV.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-19 at 11.49.59 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/EoryKtGZwuAktVZAQLhmawdQwjnkNTC4quzgWKuyTw3k74CSuSyhdTLFfbJtXA1wkqx.png)


 --- 


On the other hand, if we take a look at the weekly Frontier raffle, I have currently collected a total of 45 entries. With around 23 hours and 30 minutes left before the raffle draw, I will try to increase this number to somewhere between 52 and 55 entries. Let’s see if luck finally decides to notice me this time. On the other hand, as you can see from the screenshots above, this is the outcome where I have opened a total of 5 foundation packs. As you can see, i have got 2 gold foil rares, 6 regular foil rares including 1 archon and all rest common cards.


 --- 


![image-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AJg2Z1ek4ia2ZBCGQkHLVYWqHQqVMNonoBTqmrUewQvbWeWGPBSP1EcNuwj9Z7v.png)

 --- 



### Esper Shadowbeak

Now moving forward, let me come to the main topic of this post, as today I will be taking a closer look at another powerful monster from the newest Escalation mini cardset edition. As you have already seen in the title and thumbnail above, today I will be talking about the Esper Shadowbeak. So if you are interested in learning more about this monster card, let us take a deep dive without any further delay.

The Esper Shadowbeak is a monster type card that was introduced in the game with the newest Escalation mini cardset edition. This monster belongs to the Fire element and it comes from the Avian bloodline. By rarity, this card is a Legendary monster, so you will require a total of 11 CC cards in order to upgrade it to its maximum level. Now, if you want to use this monster in battles, you need to spend a hefty 9 mana, which makes it more suitable for medium to high mana limit matches. The most exciting part of this monster is its dual attack type, as it comes with both Melee and Magic attacks. Along with that, it also carries solid health, useful speed and multiple strong abilities. At its maximum level, this monster gains a total of four abilities. Let us now take a closer look at its league-wise stats and abilities below.

 --- 


![Screenshot 2026-04-19 at 6.50.04 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wM2w2V6cwRexP3ufy3Vi6gsYJFmQG5ebkfW5o6FV877B1RF2C1b9dHZfwrnnJkJBRW4.png)

 --- 



#### BRONZE

At level 1, this monster starts with impressive stats that consist of 2 melee attack power and 2 magic attack power at 4 speed with 2 armor and 7 health. Apart from these stats, it also gains an ability called Flying. This ability helps the monster survive longer against melee and ranged attackers.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vrtpjfjK9XXk5vhaShP7TxLDhtMvdk7RwVMsRpUDg3qFhPZtGBZdyV1Ks9tSaperxGg.png)

`FLYING` – +25% chance to evade physical attacks. No effect if the attacker also has Flying. Immune to Earthquake.



#### SILVER

When you upgrade this monster further to level 2, all of its stats remain the same as level 1. However, it unlocks another useful ability called Kindred Will: Shatter. This can be very effective when paired with the right allies, especially against armored enemies.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AKKRsDiQnSnJiyGdr9uKws1fTYwUopNocRzyFhB6qbCw69r4qJutyWsbCkxut4h.png)


`KINDRED WILL: SHATTER` – At the start of battle, adjacent units with Kindred will gain Shatter.



#### GOLD

As this monster gets upgraded further and reaches level 3, its offensive stats improve and it now carries 3 melee attack power and 2 magic attack power at 4 speed with 2 armor and 7 health. At this level, it also gains another ability called Determined. This gives the monster another chance to land important hits if the first one misses.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AK9Mx5HSxzUxpiU7A7KaAHrwN3aTLtMCd9ThrFpNGZgGdppptVPS6w7VAbXmm5C.png)


`DETERMINED` – Once per round, after missing an attack, makes the second attack at the same card.



#### DIAMOND / CHAMPION

Finally, when you upgrade this monster to its maximum level of 4, it becomes even more dangerous. It now holds 3 melee attack power and 3 magic attack power at 6 speed with 2 armor and 7 health. At this level, it also gains another strong ability called Piercing. This helps both of its attacks deal maximum value against defensive enemies.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vsBuuS5PYLc5Po7rGD66ed3mxeVAruoAjkGm46X1UpbRzQNZ4FuZQubyR3gX8uZxiCY.png)


`PIERCING` – Damage in excess of the target's armor is applied to health.



Last but not least, I think this monster can be extremely useful in many different battles. First of all, the dual attack type is the biggest attraction of this card. Having both melee and magic damage together, especially combined with Piercing, allows it to make full use of both attacks and punish enemy tanks. Another strong point is the Kindred Will ability. If you place other compatible bloodline monsters next to it, they can gain Shatter and remove enemy armor with a single hit, which can swing battles quickly. The Flying ability is also very useful for dodging physical attacks from non-flying enemies, making it stronger in matches where magic damage is less common. On top of that, the Determined ability gives the monster extra attacking opportunities if it misses, which feels like a nice bonus on an already powerful card. Overall, I think the Esper Shadowbeak is a dangerous and well-rounded legendary monster that can bring huge value in the right lineup. What do you think?

#### I hope you enjoyed reading my post about ESPER SHADOWBEAK. Let me know your thoughts about today's post in the comments section below, and I look forward to seeing you all in my next post.

 --- 


<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVjRvqqj6rjKZp9xk5H54AZMoSXGU8oqRBJVvWjmVq53f/image.png)</center>

No, the 'apples' are tiny; the size of cherries and as far as I know not edible. 
Too bad, because there are loads of them 😂

The pitcher plant is really cool. I received it from my daughters two years ago for my birthday. My wife doesn't like the plant, so they hang in my office now. They get a lot of sun there, what they really like. I don't fill the pitchers. The plant does this by itself. I do spray the plants a couple of times a week since they love humidity.
Here's a picture of one of the pitchers from last year:

The root of our problems is large HBD debt. It comes from various sources but could work even with 20% interest if everybody acted with a single rule in mind. 

Don't trade your HBD to HIVE, convert it. 

When you trade the liquid amounts are unchanged. But when you convert the HBD amount disappears and the corresponding HIVE appears. Yes it's slower because you have to wait for the conversions 3 days, but this way you actively offset the debt caused by interest, dhf, etc.

body.title: Für den Psychologischen Dienst mit KI gelernt.[GER/ENG]
body.body:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nerdtopiade/23tkhmRDknCjxXDXyPEbCanD8DfQycRH2NEw7r5Go4JXybKaBt2VvGZ7V6biufAodJ49J.png

Guten Tag meine lieben Squadis.

Es ist jetzt schon 14 Tage her, dass ihr was von mir gehört habt. Sorry für die Funkstille, aber hinter den Kulissen lief mein persönliches „System-Overhaul“ auf Hochtouren.

Wie ihr wisst, war ich am 30.03. beim Jobcenter wegen des Bildungsgutscheins. Seit diesem Tag trainiere ich fast ununterbrochen für den Test beim Psychologischen Dienst am kommenden Mittwoch.

Dafür nutze ich keinen trockenen Vorbereitungskurs, sondern meinen KI-Agenten NetRunner.

Good Day my dear Squadis.

It's been 14 days since you last heard from me. Sorry for the radio silence, but behind the scenes my personal \

was running at full speed.

As you know, I was at the job center on March 30th regarding the education voucher. Since that day, I've been training almost non-stop for the psychological service test next Wednesday.

I'm not using a dry preparation course for this, but my AI agent NetRunner.

Das Training seit fast drei Wochen zeigt echt Wirkung. Am Anfang bin ich noch in jede Falle getappt (Hebelgesetz, ich sag's euch...), aber mittlerweile sitzen die Abläufe.

Ein Highlight der letzten Tage: Ich hatte eine heftige Diskussion über die Aufgabenstellung zum Ausschlussprinzip und was soll ich sagen? Ich habe gewonnen! Die Logik sitzt jetzt so tief, dass ich sie sogar gegen eine KI verteidigen kann.

Es geht nicht nur um das richtige Ergebnis, sondern darum, das „Warum“ dahinter zu verstehen. Das gibt mir ein ganz anderes Selbstvertrauen für Mittwoch.

The training for almost three weeks is really showing results. In the beginning, I still fell into every trap (law of levers, I'm telling you...), but now the processes are solid.

A highlight of the last few days: I had a heated discussion about the task description for the exclusion principle and what can I say? I won! The logic is now so deep that I can even defend it against an AI.

It's not just about the right result, but about understanding the \

behind it. That gives me a whole different level of self-confidence for Wednesday.

In Kontakt bleiben!

Ancient Coastal Tower - Watercolor on Paper

Hello to all my dear Hivers friends, and welcome back to my blog. I’m back to share one of my paintings after more than a week spent taking my students out on a sailboat for a project called “Classroom on the Sea.” Despite my teaching commitments, I also managed to paint a couple of watercolors, and today’s piece I created directly from life, on the boat under the sun and wind of the island of Capraia in Tuscany. As you can see, it depicts a 16th-century tower in ruins on a stretch of rocky and, above all, volcanic coastline, as evidenced by the red, iron-rich rocks. ![IMG_20260415_122826880_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/armandosodano/EpEFqCLV8fDk72ctjByEGVZ46ErbgBDzAiJb2UpF6Xia4szYabykCiM9Xg59qPwFkSo.jpg) ![IMG_20260415_123014422_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/armandosodano/EqSUWdfSLJtwW7d5tNHZXtKswbBLQYfKT2awP2rKBH42bACAg4x8z9eyoFV5RP2byVF.jpg) ![IMG_20260415_123107283_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/armandosodano/EqL5Tia6PXL2wj9g5QkSRb1FFS8QYi6ThCBBGL9epDdrpY2xNdfoda5YCceH7QgEMJu.jpg) I hope you like my watercolor, just as the captain to whom I gave it liked it—he’ll hang it in the dinette of his sailboat. Antica torre costiera - acquarello su carta

Ciao a tutti cari amici Hivers e bentornati sul mio blog. Torno a condividere un mio dipinto dopo oltre una settimana nella quale ho portato i miei studenti in barca a vela per un progetto denominato \

. Nonostante i miei impegni da insegnante sono anche riuscito a dipingere un paio di acquarelli, e quello di oggi l'ho realizzato direttamente dal vero, sulla barca al sole e al vento dell'isola di Capraia in Toscana. Come potete vedere si tratta di una torre del 1500 in abbandono su un tratto di costa rocciosa e soprattutto vulcanica, visibile dalle rocce rosse e ferrose. Spero che il mio acquarello vi piaccia, come è piaciuto al comandante al quale l'ho regalato e lo appenderà nella dinette della barca a vela. Vi lascio gli steps del processo creativo ed i miei migliori saluti, vento in poppa. Armando.

body.title: Shit Sleep, Spokane Bike Swap, 23.85 Mile Ride, Grilling - Saturday
body.body:
Really shitty night with the first dream I have had in many years. I'm not used to it in any way and combined with having seen Art and my reaction to his situation being opposite what I expected my head was a mess. I HATE dreams!!! They do nothing but cause my sleep to be absolute garbage. ![IMG_20260418_055643.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uFKEL1AC163S4fz5hV1XRwxaJsgFZ6GNG9EDg65JadXsMvoKxJqPwVobjupuSi3DFiL.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_071220.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uQpMipnL5XQkynV4hwrQHm6WhbJdUrSTZGjw6p9NiSY6EVAPYtSm2iakD9skXcp2Y1G.jpg) The dewalt battery holder printed off and the batteries fit it right. ![IMG_20260418_100229.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uFK2JFo78d7WeDJ8wXCP3htLLYvV7w7QqYHD5ruq4btDobwuELpTsWJSRNyUrfag7Wf.jpg) Headed to the fairgrounds and found a much better bike for @stryeyz. This one has really easy shifters and just required I hack a couple inches off the seat post to make it fit right. ![IMG_20260418_111635.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uFaMhsioRF3s99ZmAuSYF4yTtZNcFzs83YnGwJJMPyaUoZTRBU1s7tmxY1FKLuNcaRQ.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_111639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tSSKZgZKT7N6wawTofQ7YMRCTQiDGS4gVURuE4CXEVytsnrCqR9F8FPf7xP5sfcbWxR.jpg) Did a tune up on it once home and got the derailleurs working smooth, seat post cut, lubed, and tires aired up. It rides quite nice and ready for her to use much more often than her old one. ![IMG_20260418_122513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tbnxDs37o9K2mKU4XM1d2Y6ZqHQ4ZQgGbkSbkHCuejfYjEuhE9onpwkcYRcEUejzU39.jpg) The robin bolted her nest when I walked near but she lands in the chokecherries nearby and then gives the stink-eye until past. I managed an ok picture. ![IMG_20260418_123152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vsGJGx61xbj6ZnE3fWVscN2h5WmWJD3SV1GeGECRBW5otSgE813NyfmnNJmbaabzG1u.jpg) Utd miracled themselves to a win over Chelsea. ![IMG_20260418_124716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w2f44Q4zm3p58m2HxapLmJUEZ9nkj14qELtkUx1K4durrLASdftZhHiXQ1i9R84UDgL.jpg) We all headed out on a ride up to the lake and back towards home. ![IMG_20260418_142730.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wMcPA4caLdhGEXz2Zausj7qJeStaDdae1w8dMd8FeF64dum1Nt71pbuzSTJXTiTCPxk.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_142736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wzzw1yntfJCF7FCEswJHMwKBEp8Khi9p5v3GGYDtQrn4AgxCFoycQc24QAGnUAZiWNP.jpg) The rest headed for home and I kept going for another hour and 15 miles. ![IMG_20260418_152808.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/243zXiQzSN6zQEqK9szJvceniEY2jzqUz5tEjwwFjHQ2dZndFZjBEdYYwVXtokZZwErwj.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_152811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/244e5qaVHd6RZqsu1bRNrbxKPpWHvBEZohLxVkrvaJk4m1W8AXZG5FcsQv3H6eLHGZQ5H.jpg) Rode a couple sections of road I have not been on before or only once. ![IMG_20260418_153100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tvcDumDF2tFJtzq1EyiHMJmGYoZHLrLRFZZbsk8jSvX3PqvnCuXNBmSYNM11VT1U6vB.jpg) Shy of 24 miles but it put me over 600 for the year so far. No clue if I will be able to continue my push towards my goal at this point. ![bike 4-18.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tbMB4Vzdhjr4UDwHSyAwDBm97qiLX2njncnVKgczudBYXPt9QvTPN6BgFYsQ8E1x6Vt.JPG) Got steaks out and then grilled for dinner. Boys watched the new Mario movie. ![IMG_20260418_170908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23ynKzeUV4SJShJQzEwhAgQ99qJsLtTxJLy3xQKPLptbwhVzjEzTKLT1pPQvhPMaHEbu1.jpg) Another pure garbage night of sleep with another fucking dream and my shoulder feels like I have a vice squeezing the muscles. I am going to North 40 this morning to stand in line for opening so I can get a new battery for my truck so I can get back to troubleshooting it. My body is feeling like pure shit this morning so ibuprofen and muscle relaxers will be my best friends today. Might have a quick job today as well it looks like. ---

body.title: The Economy of MydEmpire
body.body:
![mde g e.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mydempire/244ofcuZzWAFNmvBmLqtwu6HA16exofFh7nucUkQNPmL3MLhThPNHmD4KnbWCjgczq64c.png) [Image Source](https://chatgpt.com/s/m_69e4d8dbb1808191bab346179edd7a2e) ![image.png](2) **Hello to all Hivers and Gamers!** For the past weeks MydEmpire has been quietly built step by step. Today I want to explain about our simple and sustainable economy.

Why We Chose Treasury Rewards Instead of an Inflationary Token

Every blockchain game must answer one critical question: **How does the economy sustain itself long-term?** Many games choose to issue their own token and reward players through token inflation. This model has enabled several successful projects across Web3 gaming. For **MydEmpire** , we explored this path as well. But after careful design and simulation during the Genesis phase, we ultimately chose a different direction. Our economy is built around **a real treasury system rather than token inflation.** This decision was intentional and shaped by three goals: - Long-term sustainability - Transparent reward mechanics - Alignment with the Hive ecosystem

The Treasury Model

In MydEmpire, rewards come from a shared treasury pool rather than newly minted tokens. Players generate Empire Production (EP) through their factories and industrial infrastructure. This production determines how much of the treasury reward pool a player can claim. You can see this reflected directly inside the game dashboard where players claim HIVE rewards from the treasury rather than receiving newly minted tokens. **This means:** Production ⇨ share of treasury ⇨ real reward **Not:** Production ⇨ mint new token ⇨ increase supply

Why We Avoided Inflationary Tokens

Inflationary token systems can work well when carefully balanced. Many Hive projects successfully use them. However, they also introduce several long-term design challenges: **1. Constant Inflation Pressure** New tokens must continuously be minted to reward players. Over time this can create downward pressure on value unless demand grows faster than supply. **2. Economy Balancing Complexity** Inflation models require constant tuning: - emission rates - burn mechanics - staking incentives - sinks vs supply Even small imbalances can destabilize the economy. **3. Market Dependence** If the reward token becomes the primary reward currency, the player experience becomes tightly tied to token price volatility. For a strategy-driven empire game, we wanted rewards tied more to game participation rather than token speculation.

Why Treasury Rewards Fit MydEmpire

The treasury model changes the economic dynamics. Instead of creating new supply, the system distributes existing value generated by the game itself. Key benefits include: - **Sustainable reward pool** Rewards scale naturally with the treasury rather than infinite emissions. - **No token inflation** There is no constantly expanding token supply to dilute player rewards. - **Transparent economics** The treasury acts as the single visible reward source. - **Alignment with Hive** Rewards are paid in HIVE, integrating directly with the existing ecosystem.

Production Still Matters

Even without a token, player progression remains deeply strategic. Players increase their reward share by: - Building factories - Expanding land infrastructure - Unlocking blueprints - Increasing Empire Production (EP) - Using relic boosts The more productive your empire becomes, the larger your slice of the treasury reward cycle.

A Different Kind of Game Economy

MydEmpire is not designed as a token farming economy. It is designed as a strategic industrial economy. Your empire grows through infrastructure, efficiency, and long-term planning. Rewards are a reflection of productive contribution to the system, not simply token emissions.

Respecting Other Hive Game Models

Hive has a rich ecosystem of games, many of which successfully use token-based reward systems. Our approach is to create something different then existing models. A treasury-driven economic engine designed for long-term stability and strategic gameplay. Different games can thrive with different models — and that diversity strengthens the Hive ecosystem as a whole.

Looking Ahead

The Genesis phase is only the beginning. As MydEmpire evolves, the treasury system will continue to grow alongside the player economy, new industries, and future expansions. We are excited to see how players build their empires within a transparent, production-driven economy. **The first empires are rising.** And this is only the beginning. The MydEmpire world is just starting to grow. [**MydEmpire**](https://mydempire.com)

body.body: > ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUAQnV1sJbGphVC5GXo34HWbEbjqXTuwKJ3CGoyTjQjYc/1776605593192.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/money-profit-finance-business-2696228/) When working on growth in the Hive platform, it is important to understand how to use Hive rewards properly. For steady growth, there should always be a balance between Power Up and Cash Out. After receiving rewards, you will always face a decision between Power Up and Cash Out. Because this is not only about money, but also about long-term planning. Personally, I prefer Power Up if I want to grow on Hive in the long run. I believe increasing Hive Power is very important to stay strong on this platform. When I power up, my account becomes stronger, my upvote value increases, and slowly my influence in the hive community also grows. I see this as an investment that can give me better returns in the future. However, earning good rewards is also important to power up regularly. To be honest, it’s not that I never cash out. Sometimes, when I need money, I cash out a portion of my rewards. One interesting thing is that even when I cash out, a part of the reward still goes into Hive Power, which I cannot withdraw instantly. So while I get some liquid Hive, another part remains saved from post payouts. This is helpful, although it slows down my overall growth if I don't power up regularly. Personally, I think powering down is not a good option for me. But in case of personal needs or emergencies, using a small portion through cash out can be reasonable. Still, I do not support full cash out. For me, Power Up and Cash Out should always be balanced. Decisions should depend on your rewards and your situation, but long-term thinking is very important. My strategy on Hive is simple, regular Power Up and limited Cash Out when necessary. This way, I can strengthen my account while also using some rewards when needed. However, I admit that due to a lack of consistency, I have not always followed this strategy perfectly. In the end, success on Hive requires patience and planning. People who want quick earnings may prefer cashing out. But those who want to build something long-term should focus more on hive Power Up. For me, Hive is not just a place to earn, but a platform to grow. That’s why I try to think about the future and move forward step by step. Thank you for reading.

## The Lightning Lane—Coffee at Warp Speed! ⚡🏎️

We’ve learned that Bitcoin is very special and secure, almost like a **Giant Gold Bar**. But imagine if you went to a snack stand to buy a soda and tried to pay with a heavy gold bar. 
The person at the stand would have to get a scale, check if the gold is real, and try to cut off a tiny, tiny sliver to pay for your drink. It would take **forever!** That is why we have the **Lightning Network**.

---

### The \

🛣️
If the main Bitcoin network is like a big, sturdy highway for heavy trucks carrying treasure, the Lightning Network is like a **Super-Fast Bike Path** right next to it.

* **Main Highway:** Best for moving huge amounts of money safely.
* **Lightning Path:** Best for buying a candy bar, a video game skin, or a cup of cocoa!



---

### How It Works: The Tab 📝
Imagine you and your friend go to the arcade every day. Instead of running to the bank every time you want to trade **one single token**, you keep a \

between the two of you. 
1. You write down who owes what on your own little card. 
2. You trade back and forth all day long—super fast! 
3. At the very end of the week, you look at the final score and send just **one** big payment to settle up.

**That’s the Lightning Network!** It lets people trade tiny bits of Bitcoin (those \

we talked about!) back and forth thousands of times in a second. 

---

### Why is it \
? 🚀\n* **Instant:** You don't have to wait for the \
miners to finish a block. It happens as fast as a text message!\n* **Almost Free:** Because you aren't using the big \

the fees are so small they are basically invisible. You could send a single penny across the world for almost no cost!

### 🔍 Fun Fact: The Global Tip Jar 🍯
People use the Lightning Network to \
their favorite creators on the internet. If you see a cool video, you can send them 5 cents of Bitcoin instantly to say \

It’s the world’s fastest high-five.

---

### 🎮 The \
Race\n1. **The Highway:** Have one friend walk across the room carrying a heavy stack of books (The Gold Bar). Time how long it takes!\n2. **The Lightning Lane:** Have another friend \

a photo or send a quick text message across the room.
3. **The Question:** Which one would you want to use if you were waiting in line at the grocery store?

**Bitcoin is the gold, but Lightning is the zoom!** ---
**Next Level:** Does Bitcoin only work in your city? No way! Let's see how it connects the whole planet in **Borderless Freedom!** 🌍✈️

body.body: > @steevc just finished a 11.68km run, that lasted for 84 minutes. This run helped steevc burn 791.0 calories. --- **Description from Strava:** Today was my slowest run in a long time and I am totally fine with that. I have been reading a bit about heart rate training and the consensus is that [heart zone 2](https://www.runnersworld.com/uk/training/beginners/a64914113/zone-2-running/) is beneficial as that is when your body can deal with the lactate the muscles generate and adapt to give better endurance. I will will do speed workouts on other runs to build my strength. ![Heart rate zones](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/23vsqqKFgr62zYMwPFubdBkjWq1D6aWe3SX4EUwnz7y6tZkZZT9LBzw7KdPv1JyuqFH4P.png) On previous long runs I was mostly in zones 3 and 4. Today I had my Garmin watch displaying my heart rate and zone, but I think the latter needs adjusting to match what Strava shows. The watch uses a light on the back to measure my heart rate on my wrist and I have to assume that it is reasonably accurate. Keeping it in zone 2 meant running really slowly compared to what I would usually do and that felt strange, but it got easier as I went on. In the latter half it seemed I could go quicker whilst keeping the rate down, but at times it drifted up. If my heart gets stronger then I should be able to go quicker with less effort. It was a lovely morning, but not too hot for me. At this pace I was not feeling too drained and could have kept it up for a long time. On the newish estate at Stotfold I often see ducks by one of the houses and there was a whole mallard family there with at least twelve ducklings. ![Duck family](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/23xoymzSRcDU9NhbtH1HAZrsgGnVTUyw6JPL4AAJpyASuKNYGiV5u3oaim4k7ji9Riot5.png) I did my usual loop and that was enough for today as I had jobs to do in the garden. I will aim for a couple more runs during the week and one of those will focus on speed. I am also trying more exercises at home to get fitter. I am not planning on lots of races, but I just think that I can do better. parkrun is my main way to check that. Enjoy your Sunday and run free! --- If you would like to check out this activity on strava you can see it here: https://www.strava.com/activities/18167871942 **About the Athlete:** *Older guy trying to keep fit, but still hope to go quicker.*

body.title: Digital sovereignty sounds simple. Until you actually look at it Europe
body.body:
**Datensouveränität ist kein Buzzword mehr.**
Zwischen CLOUD Act, NIS2 und DORA stehen Unternehmen vor einer ziemlich unbequemen Realität: Kontrolle über Daten ist nicht mehr selbstverständlich. Ich habe das Thema etwas tiefer beleuchtet - hoffe es interessiert jemanden hier wie @jedigeiss @detlev @michaelreischer oder @solarwarrior zumindest. 


![Screenshot 2026-04-19 at 15.33.35.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uwelang/23tGdwtgs8ksjK1XfpQ5iHj13dzG8ca5Qy8zR6zuGX4nQGqUFZQUZfzrgUW5XqCZb4i1W.png)
*Visual created with help of AI*


## Digital sovereignty in Europe - what options do we have?

On the surface, many companies still believe that storing data in Europe is enough to be compliant. But once you dig deeper, the picture changes quickly.

The real issue is not where your data is stored. It’s which legal system applies to it.

As soon as providers fall under non-European jurisdictions, things get complicated. Laws like the CLOUD Act create potential access scenarios that can conflict with European regulations. At the same time, frameworks like NIS2 and DORA are raising the bar significantly when it comes to resilience, governance, and accountability.

This creates a tension that is hard to ignore.

On one side, there is the push for stronger digital sovereignty across Europe. Governments are investing in infrastructure, regulations are tightening, and initiatives around sovereign cloud models are gaining momentum. France is often leading, others are catching up.

On the other side, reality inside companies looks very different.

Most organizations are deeply embedded in US technology stacks. Core systems, integrations, workflows, and even business models depend on them. Replacing these components is not a quick decision. It’s a structural change with real operational risk.

So the discussion is not as simple as “move everything to European providers.”

It becomes a question of trade-offs.

- Where do you really need sovereignty?
- Where can you accept dependency?
- And how do you manage that balance without breaking your own processes?

For me, this is the uncomfortable but honest takeaway:

1. Digital sovereignty is not a switch.
2. It’s a strategic decision under constraints.

And right now, many companies are somewhere in between ambition and reality. At the end of the day, control over data is control over business.

Everything else is just a matter of perspective.

## Thoughts welcome!?

body.title: Sol-2-Soul Sunday 81: Abundance Year Episode 1941 (audio: noxsoma.substack.com)
body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1876
Sunday 19, April 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1941
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Sol-2-Soul, my brothers & sisters. Welcome to, 

Synesthesia Theater.  

Our super hero persona has been retired for many years at this point. We salvaged what we could from the “save the girl” dynamic and constructed a “protector” model. “An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.” We have always thrived on the prevention side. 

But shit happens.  

Universe provided us with an image. The roof is on fire. It’s my house. My family is inside. I must get them out. 

Then, in that cinematic style, the distance between me and the house is widened. The roof is on fire. Not my house. But hey are neighbors. We are not running into this burning building, but we can help in many ways that will not take me away from my primary obligations.  

The scene shifts again, I move backwards through a newspaper, (remember those), and I am looking at an image of a house, or maybe an apartment complex. It’s on fire. I turn the page. Nothing I can do. It’s in my city. I pass by this address on my way to work. Small impact. It doesn’t stir emotions.  I don’t feel it.  

Some accounts across social media seem to, or claim to “feel,” or at least, react to situations they are not involved in, and cannot do anything about, let alone change. That’s fine. A lot of folks do that. This is how charities get you. Sarah McLaughlin, sitting there with her dog, (or a dog), appealing for donations. But here’s where it gets, let’s call it “social.” They feel somehow compelled to share their experience of being deeply and emotionally wounded by some remote activity that they cannot change or do anything about. This used to be called, “Virtue Signalling.” I don’t see the term much anymore, but it doesn’t seem to have stopped happening. 

But then there’s that next level. Someone posted something to the effect that, ‘everyone should be outraged that,’ dot-dot-dot. Apparently this has a name too, “Rage-baiting.” (I so enjoy the social media lexicon..) Not only are they pissed off about something they cannot do a damn thing about, they, literally want, “everyone” else to be, “mad as hell about it too!” To what end? What could possibly be the benefit, aside from clicks and likes, to descend into someone else’s outrage? Because, you probably cannot do anything about the situation either. 

The only reason, “rage-baiting” exists as a term, is because it works. “Doom-scrolling” is another of my top ten social media words. The implication is, the individual is searching for some “rage-bait” to become outraged by, so they can re-post it, invite their flock to become outraged, like & share so the next doom-scroller will not be left out of the experience to release harmful chemicals in their vessel, get hungry, order food, which will be delivered by a wheeled (spy)  robot.  

This is why your life sucks.  (In the spirit of rage-bait.)  

“I’m having a wonderful and abundant day. Everyone else should one too.” Like. Subscribe. Share.  (Crickets.) 

My beautiful beings of mostly water, We are realizing at this moment, that every day is a 3 in 1, melange a trois, just for you. There’s an episode. The audio we attach that’s supposed to describe the episode, but is usually completely different,  and this bit-o-scribbling, that goes with the audio, that goes with the episode, that gets remixed and posted at 4 20 Eastern Daylight Saving Time, just because I’m a smart-ass.   

When sheeple like your humble anti-social loner vagabond, become a threat to society, psychology will forge a dangerous-sounding label for us. They will probably dig up a name from one of the lesser Greek myths, a la Echo, Narcissus, Sophia, Money (that’s Roman), and launch a multi-media blitz to defame the “archetype.” We shall cross that bridge when we come to  it. However, if you can relate, keep your head down. Don’t let them know we exist and that we are here to protect humanity. Meanwhile. 

Stay safe. stay strong, stay savvy, stay sane, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.   

PEACE    





Sol-2-Soul Sunday 81

![1941.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVYBv5DRsj3nZgDMPDRqLUVHoW2wcBF1L3orzqMu5LKn7/1941.png)

Prosperity  
Crime Pays 
We are so deep into the matrix, the only way out is through.                     
 
Today's Episode:    https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1876_full_4-19-26_1941_sol81:e?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9  
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe. 
So Deep into the Matrix the only way out is Through.  (The Audio is way better.)  
Today we have a Trilogy of Trials that revolve around two, (of many) maxims that fuel my energy cells in the simulatrix. First of all, “if you panic, you die.” And secondly, “when you’re in so deep there’s no turning back, the best way out is through. Our snippets are based on true stories. The names have been changed to protect the innocent.   

Kash, 2016. The lighting’s soft, but his eyes are still hard. 

“We were the only three left breathing after the ambush. Deep in Indian Country (hostile territory). Even deeper than that. I was a corporal. Two peckerwood privates, both green, both full of the kind of generational hate that basic training don’t bleach out. They wanted to shoot our way through every village, every trail. ‘Kill Charlie,’ ‘body count,’ they kept sayin’. 

I told ‘em, ‘We play it cool, man. We move at night. We hide in the swamps. We don’t look at the villagers. We become ghosts. I’ll getcha thru this.’

They didn’t listen. One of ‘em pulled a rifle on an old woman collecting water. The VC came out of the elephant grass like they were born from it. Took the two of ‘em. I heard the shots. I heard the groans.  I knew they were finished.’ 

I kept moving. Through the rot. Through the leeches. Through the difficult decision of leaving them, but they brought that shit on themselves.

High school taught me something different, Mr. Callahan, my history teacher, white man, Irish Southerner, told me, ‘Son, the only way out of a trap is to stop fighting the trap.’ In ‘Nam, that meant stop fighting Charlie like a cowboy. Start moving like water. 

I came out the other side. Not because I was tougher. Because I was smarter. And I had nothing to prove.”

Vivian, 2011. Her voice is calm, almost warm.

“I was twenty-six then. NewYorican to da bone, ya’know? Poppi told me once, in Spanish: “Mija, los hombres buenos respetan. Los otros, los reconoces por como te miran cuando creen que no estás mirando.” (My daughter, good men respect. The others, you recognize them by how they look at you when they think you are not looking.”)  

That night, ‘John-boy’, that’s what I called him in my head, like the Walton kid, we connected on a dating app. I thought he was kinda fly, for a white guy.  It was cool. We were chillin’. Then he put his hand where it shuddint be. I moved it. He laughed. I got up and left out. 

He followed me outside, he grabbed my wrist. Said, ‘You chicas like it a little rough, right?’ 

I told him, ‘You don’t know me. Or mi gente.’ He squeezed harder. Tried to pull me toward his car.  That’s when the switch flipped. The flashback. Memory. I was fourteen, practicing for my black belt test. Sensei taught me the hip throw. “Use his weight, not yours.” 

He reached for my chest. I dropped my center, pivoted, and threw him over my hip. His body thumped on the sidewalk. He groaned. But it sounded more like a whine. The fall knocked the wind of him. 

I didn’t wait. Ran four blocks to the F train. Didn’t look back. Didn’t exhale until the doors closed. 

Men like that? They think machismo is muscle and money. Real machismo is, well, you just know it, right? 

Becky, 2011. Sun-weathered hands, easy laugh.

“Twenty years on the job. First female on my squad. They gave me hell, burned my lunch, called me ‘Princess’ till I proved I could drag a two-hundred-pound dummy up six flights. But when that ceiling came down in that warehouse fire? They showed me who they were. Real pros. They had my back, especially the chief. 

He grabbed my facemask. Looked me in the eyes and Said, ‘Take a breath. If you panic, you die. You’re this far in. The only way out is through.’ And he got us out too. 

Fast forward. Hawaii. Vacation. Me and a rented longboard. I’d taken three lessons, thought I was hot stuff. Paddled out past the break. Caught a few two-footers. Then one wave grabbed me like a bad structure fire, rolled me so hard I lost which way was up. 

When I broke surface, the shore looked like a postage stamp. My lungs were screaming. My legs were jelly. And that old panic started to crawl up my throat. 

Then I heard Chief. “If you panic, you die.” 

I looked at that beach. Looked at my board, still strapped to my ankle. And I thought, “You’ve crawled through black smoke with zero visibility. You can paddle a thousand yards.” 

So I did. One stroke at a time. I locked on to a lifeguard tower. Took me for ever. I lost track of time.  My shoulders were on fire. But I made it. 

When the lifeguard ran up, I just pointed at the ocean and said, ‘That sucker almost had me.’

He said, ‘Ma’am, you should not be alive.’

I said, ‘Honey, I’ve been not supposed to be alive for twenty years.’”

Being genuinely interested in humans, even if I cannot take, “the public,” has its advantages. I’ve learned that people in bars love to talk. About themselves. Their pasts. They have one story they tell over and over again, and I’m that guy who hasn’t heard it yet. The trade-off for my genuine attention, is whatever I’m drinking. Dark & Stormies, in a Park Slope bar with Vivian. Karaoke night and fruity rum drinks at a Waikiki Beach Club with Becky, or City Winery in Philly listening to war stories with Kash, while sipping watered down Long Island Iced Teas and listening to Incognito perform live. This is something your curious vagabond doesn’t have to fake. 
Epilogue – I haven’t heard stories like these since I quit drinking.

body.title: Raising the Dead         …Part 11          …Obsession
body.body:
*I want her to melt into me, like butter on toast. I want to absorb her and walk around for the rest of my days with her encased in my skin.... I want... ― Sara Gruen*


![Obsessed .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnjgeddes/23uR1FkjD5mYVXqCm6R6orXW9Kw4Qph4vzCGWuRBcfRb1x69irNyUeBbVhmoQQBFtUKaB.png)
*Elizabeth and Alex*


Alex was sick at heart. Everything turned out so badly. What started as a merely academic exercise borne out of curiosity about the way memory was transmitted and stored in the brain, turned into an obsession. It all began innocently enough when he read accounts of Wilder Penfield's experiments in electrical brain stimulation. Apparently, in Penfield's attempts to map areas of the brain using electric needling, he unwittingly stimulated a region that caused a female patient to relive a part of her past. This incident fascinated Alex and led him to experiment with stimulating brain tissue from the deceased never dreaming it would enable him to 'read' memories of dead people. But that's what happened.

Alex was shocked because there was no scientific way he should have obtained such a disturbing result. He actually saw the face of a beautiful young woman. There was more metaphysics than physics in the proceedure. What happened was more a psychic encounter and it thoroughly mystified Alex. He had to make sure it wasn't some hallucination on his part so he convinced Len, his lab assistant, to repeat the procedure and the same thing happened to him ― he saw the haunting face of a beautiful girl. Alex now knew the experience was real and was fascinated by it and needed to know who the girl was.

What happened next was shocking to both men. Len saw the mystery girl on campus and found out her name was Elizabeth Miller and she was enrolled in graduate studies. Alex tracked her down and hired her as his research student but never told her why he chose her in the first place, The truth was, he wanted to observe her and see what could be her connection to the donor brain. He discovered the dead donor was Mark, her former fiance and now he was in despair because he had hired Elizabeth under false pretenses and now was able to channel Mark's intimate conversations with her. So, even though he and Elizabeth had been developing a relationship, there was no way she could ever forgive him for misleading her and peering into the personal details of her relationship with Mark.

\

Len was furious and clearly frustrated at what Alex was planning.

\
Alex shrugged his shoulders and turned to go. \

The truth of the statement seemed to sting both men but each felt helpless to change what had been done. For his part, Alex could feel the door closing on his relationship with Elizabeth... a relationship that he had never wanted to end.

To be continued…

![rBm3P2grDX8NCxUz_120655.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/gaviotawriter/images/rBm3P2grDX8NCxUz_120655/rBm3P2grDX8NCxUz_120655.webp)
![BWkEIP7KNGToHQCX_120651.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/gaviotawriter/images/BWkEIP7KNGToHQCX_120651/BWkEIP7KNGToHQCX_120651.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

In February, I found out I had won the **2025 Calendario Award for Science Fiction and Fantasy**, one of the most important awards for under-35s in Cuba. I don't have any photos of that because the ceremony hasn't happened yet, and I haven't received my beautiful certificate to hang on my wall.

I also got an Honorable Mention in the **2025 Edad de Oro Award in the Science Fiction and Fantasy** category. This is another of the most important awards for all ages in my country. So, in theory, my career should be on solid ground, sailing full speed ahead with wind in my sails. 

That's not the case 🙃

My friend @yecier insisted a lot that I post this back in February when it happened. It's just... I've been linda... Down this days.

The awards made me happy, yes, but every feeling, good and bad, felt dull. As if I were looking at the world through a fog of apathy that I really don't like. I'm trying to get better, give me time 😅

The reason this is happening is that these awards are very nice, but I feel like a ghost writer. I already have 5 awards, 4 books in the editorial process, 2 of them ready for a year now. None have been published yet, not even digitally.

What good are so many awards if, when it's time to show my work, there's nothing? Oh well, sh*t happens.

But I'll keep writing and maybe someday things change. I really hope so.

---

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![lv7FN3HiVtqijW54_1776605638252.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/lenalu/images/lv7FN3HiVtqijW54_1776605638252/lv7FN3HiVtqijW54_1776605638252.webp)
![2BC2wi9HJrVugRFS_1776605545347.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/lenalu/images/2BC2wi9HJrVugRFS_1776605545347/2BC2wi9HJrVugRFS_1776605545347.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天出门去打米酒，还挺巧的，没走多远就看见一家杂货店，啥都卖，门口还摆着一罐米酒。我也是第一次碰到，就好奇上前问问，看店的是一对年纪挺大的叔叔阿姨。我在马路边喊了一声：“这米酒怎么卖呀？”叔叔耳朵有点背没听见，阿姨反应特别快，直接说五块。
 
说完立马就从旁边拿了个矿泉水瓶要给我装，看她这么热情，我对价格也没概念，就说那来一斤。刚说完我又琢磨了一下，等下还要去买菜，提着酒绕一圈实在不方便，不如买完菜再回来。我就跟阿姨说先去买菜，等会儿回来再买，阿姨连着说好。
 
结果去买菜的路上，又碰见好几家专门卖酒的酒坊，比刚才那家选择多，有米酒、高粱酒，各种度数都有。我上去问老板：“叔，30度的米酒多少钱一斤？”老板乐呵呵地说三块。我当时就惊了，这比刚才那家便宜不少啊，太划算了。我就让老板给我打个一两斤，刚要装又想起来菜还没买，就跟叔说买完菜再回来，叔也特别爽快，说随便你。
 
买完菜往回走的时候我就纠结了，第一家五块钱一斤实在太贵，不想再去，可又担心刚才那个阿姨已经帮我打好了，我不去买显得太不讲诚信。虽然人家不一定认得我，但我心里总过意不去，良心有点不安。
 
后来我还是先在酒坊买了，跟叔说要两斤。他问用什么装，我说用矿泉水瓶就行，干净吗？他说都洗过消毒过的。可我看着这些二手瓶子还是有点不放心，他说新瓶子要加钱，我就让他直接用塑料袋装了两斤。
 
之后我还是绕回了最开始那家杂货店，果然，阿姨已经用矿泉水瓶帮我装好了一斤米酒。我问叔叔瓶子干净不，他说用开水烫过的，我也不好意思多说，就扫码付了五块钱拿走了。
 
这下一下子有三斤米酒，够喝好久了。心里也打定主意，下次再也不去那家五块的了，太贵，而且瓶子我也不太放心。后来还想到个两全其美的办法，以后自己带瓶子去打酒，就不用纠结干不干净、花不花钱的问题了。

---

body.title: Belgian Shepherd Malinois - Monomad Challenge.
body.body:
![cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23u63Lwsgba8ihyNxGJYJrUpyFKzY3EwD3L5jvubiWjib5ywT5663tzK8V1HrSkenV7kF.jpg)
Today I am back with a new set of photographs that I took in the metropolitan park of my city, on this occasion I came across a beautiful Belgian Shepherd Malinois dog and the truth is that I had never seen this breed before. From afar I saw how his owners were training him so I decided to approach and ask them if I could take a couple of photos of him and they gave me their permission, the first photo we took was with the dog sitting.
  Hoy estoy de vuelta con un nuevo set de fotografias que hice en el parque metropolitano de mi ciudad, en esta ocasion me topé con un hermoso perro de raza Pastor Belga malinois y la verdad es que nunca antes habia visto esta raza. Desde lo lejos ví como sus dueños lo estaban entrenando asi que decidi acercarme y preguntarles si le podia hacer un par de fotos y ellos me dieron su permiso, la primera foto que hicimos fue con el perro sentado:  
![IMG_3072.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23uFRd61DJ4AgK5CwoFfMkcS1yyzS3FMoTtjkrfs2gNnCbnNXhWHsjqyE9C4ZRYPwWVNQ.jpg)
Since the dog was trained it was very easy to take good photos of him, he stayed still for a long time while I looked for the best angle.
  Como el perro estaba entrenado fue muy facil hacerle buenas fotos, se quedaba quieto durante bastante tiempo mientras yo buscaba el mejor angulo.  
![IMG_3074.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23u63AnG5eFugQbe972zwiog7YLoWHr7oAj1rc8mrtwkdbpLXQoiSXpJtFomMzJaGz4Wp.jpg) ![IMG_3079.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23w2o87jGUfE9WgFAVXtvUgRUPqijwNJKKAqXGP7ZgMR1TJYAPhezThWkMv9ykjZMXLaX.jpg)
And now a close up.
  Y ahora un close up:  
![IMG_3076.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23w2aXnCV3UQ4ACducUEjUd7LnaTAMAcCa8eTFgm9E2XXc6YGxsrKAdymU1kRbK3X16kc.jpg)
He also knew how to lie down and most importantly, wait....
  Tambien sabia echarse y lo mas importante, esperar....  
![IMG_3084.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23tvgjYdeRb61r2WZBEmTs17ctto9gm1MEXcryJxSGu6efjUJJed6hQnr7V3SunhcUNxf.jpg)
Something that surprised me a lot is that this dog is still a puppy, he is only 6 months old and already looks giant and still has to grow even more!
  Algo que me sorprendió muchisimo es que este perro aun es un cachorro, tiene solo 6 meses de edad y ya se ve gigante y aun le falta crecer aun mas!  
![IMG_3087.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23uFTZN1Tg5UryU9ycowu9AzxqCgz7BRvcaTrf5mLcsYS1h59cQfXkHZUwqwovKRu1LLj.jpg)
I asked the owner if the dog knew how to shake paws and he said yes, we made my favorite photo.
  Le pregunté al dueño si el perro sabia dar la pata y me dijo que si, hicimos mi foto favorita:  
![IMG_3090.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wgKua9DFEPsTSDL2uJgzLQMVgmhuZYELfE24ECWzz2VrxqGGeXqfmbx4yskKe6CYQ5i.jpg)
And to finish I took some photos of the dog standing normal.
  Y para finalizar hice unas fotos del perro estando parado normal:  
![IMG_3098.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23vhunr9E39CeHSXdGfvTzASjwvW4x2oibw6Up75rFmyXev2FbMoGHUxvVNagkcfA6dzH.jpg)
He still has a baby look!!
  Aun tiene mirada de bebe!!  
![IMG_3099.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wgMdnPdkn5srueTHhpwW4TS466RU7BxSc8q8B6jVEXJxd2EvEThabBcff2x2GkMQBDZ.jpg)
I took all the photos with my Canon R8 camera, a 50mm 1.8/f lens and only natural light. At the end of this spontaneous photo session the owners and I were super happy with the photos and I hope you like them as much as we do!!
  Todas las fotos las tomé con mi camara Canon R8, un lente 50mm 1.8/f y solo luz natural. Al final de esta sesion de fotos espontanea los dueños y yo quedamos super contentos con las fotos y espero que a ustedes les gusten tanto como a nosotros!!

body.title: Behind the Curtain: Why a Quiet WOO Weekend Feels Like a Setup, Not a Slowdown
body.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

If there’s one thing wrestling has taught me, it’s this. The most important moments don’t always happen in the ring. Sometimes, the real action is happening behind the curtain. The planning, the setup, the decisions that shape what we eventually see. And as a WOO fan, I can’t shake the feeling that this quiet weekend falls into that exact category. Because when things go silent, it doesn’t feel like nothing is happening. It feels like something is being prepared.

>*I have gotten some feedback that reminders are pretty useful when it comes to the regular events held in WOO. So here I am again with a quick reminder for any upcoming events.*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23tvAaDyQXcFD1wZMFcDgzEsntdWx66ByfkpVdey9zhZY3ybAti8zNh1ZmLYG82v5WWLp.png)

---

* **WOO has been showing signs of more structured event planning.**
  
Looking at how recent events have been rolled out, there is a clear sense of progression. Things feel more deliberate, less random. A quiet weekend fits into that pattern as a transition point rather than a gap.

* **Preparation phases are often invisible but essential.**
  
Before any event goes live, there is likely a lot of coordination happening behind the scenes. Balancing rewards, finalizing details, and ensuring everything runs smoothly takes time. As fans, we don’t see that process, but we feel the results.

* **The Jobber expansion suggests ongoing development work.**
  
With multiple divisions and rarity tiers now in play, there is a growing level of complexity in WOO. Managing and expanding that system likely requires attention that does not always translate into immediate announcements.

* **A quieter weekend reduces noise and builds anticipation.**
  
When nothing new is being pushed out, players naturally start wondering what’s next. That curiosity builds anticipation in a way that constant updates cannot replicate.

* **It reflects confidence in the current state of the game.**
  
If WOO needed constant activity to keep players engaged, this kind of silence would be risky. But the fact that it can afford to slow down suggests that the foundation is strong enough to hold attention even without constant stimulation.

---

So when I look at this quiet weekend, I don’t see a slowdown. I see a setup. The kind of setup that happens before something bigger takes center stage. The kind that makes the next moment feel more impactful because of the silence that came before it. And if WOO is building toward something behind the curtain right now… Then I’m more than willing to wait for the reveal.

---

**TLDR: This is a reminder to all my readers (and WOO fans) that baring any last minute sudden surprise events, this weekend should be a relatively quiet one. 😜**

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉
