body.title: 🎧 Una noche en Plaza de Mayo, Buenos Aires - Argentina | No fue solo música 🙌 [ Esp - Eng] 🎧 A night at Plaza de Mayo, Buenos Aires - Argentina | It wasn’t just music 🙌
body.body:
>

***Saludos mi gente hermosa de la comunidad #GEMS 💎***

No sé si a ustedes les ha pasado, pero hay lugares que uno ha visto mil veces en fotos, en noticias, en la historia, y cuando por fin estás ahí, lo sientes distinto. Eso fue lo que me pasó anoche en Plaza de Mayo, aquí en Buenos Aires #Argentina. Llegué sin imaginar realmente lo que iba a vivir, sin saber que en cuestión de minutos iba a estar rodeado de miles de personas, en un ambiente que no se explica fácil, pero que se siente desde el primer momento.

Y lo más curioso es que no era solo la cantidad de gente, que ya de por sí impacta, era la energía, la paz, la conexión que se respiraba en el lugar. Algo que no se ve todos los días, algo que te hace detenerte un segundo y decir, aquí está pasando algo distinto. Y ahí fue donde entendí que esa noche no iba a ser una más.
__________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTHsMGenGWCm8JYcCSYyseXrk99JBMq11vbt1b3JqN67/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

</center>
__________

Desde hacía dos semanas yo venía con eso en la cabeza. Apenas salió la publicidad de que el padre Guille venía a la Plaza de Mayo, aquí en Buenos Aires, ya a mí se me erizaba la piel. Yo mismo me decía que tenía que estar allí, que tenía que vivirlo en persona, porque una cosa es verlo por YouTube o por redes sociales y otra muy distinta es sentirlo en vivo. Ya me venía impresionando desde hace tiempo la forma en que él logra servir a Dios a través de la música, algo que para muchos puede sonar raro al principio, porque no todos entienden de entrada cómo un sacerdote puede ser también DJ. Pero justamente ahí está lo especial de todo esto: en esa manera distinta de llegarle a la gente, especialmente a los jóvenes, usando un lenguaje que hoy mueve multitudes sin perder el mensaje de fe. Por eso yo tenía claro que iba a hacer lo imposible por ir, así fuera solo, porque ese evento yo no me lo quería perder por nada del mundo.
_________

https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=theshot2414/ugcimugq

<center>*\

*</cetenter>
________

Y bueno, por fin llegó el sábado 18 por la noche, el día que tanto estaba esperando. Me fui con Aroon Rafael, el esposo de mi cuñada, y aunque salimos un poco tarde de casa por cuestiones personales, logramos llegar casi cuando el concierto estaba comenzando. Les juro que desde que puse un pie ahí me impresionó todo: la puesta en escena, la intro, el juego de luces, el sonido, la magnitud del ambiente. Era algo de otro nivel. Yo, con 51 años, sentía que estaba viviendo algo completamente nuevo. Me he pasado la vida trabajando, cumpliendo responsabilidades, metido en lo mío, y muchas veces uno va dejando este tipo de experiencias para después, como si nunca fueran a llegar. Pero esta vez sí llegó ese momento, y verme allí, en medio de tanta gente, brincando, saltando, cerrando los ojos y dejándome llevar por la música, fue algo que me marcó. Sentía el furor, la adrenalina a mil, y al mismo tiempo una paz muy difícil de explicar. Era como si todo se mezclara en un solo instante: la emoción, la fe, el asombro y la gratitud de poder estar allí.
_______

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdRtmvghbsQwF2zQ85MLT94ZCJ2JAce18CCgVcjH6Md7z/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>
_______

Y mientras vivía todo eso, también pensaba en quién era realmente el hombre que estaba sobre esa tarima. El padre Guille, cuyo nombre es Guilherme Peixoto, nació en Guimarães, en Portugal, fue ordenado sacerdote en 1999 y con los años encontró en la música otra forma de evangelizar. Su faceta como DJ empezó a tomar forma después de ese camino sacerdotal, y su proyección internacional creció muchísimo tras su presentación en la Jornada Mundial de la Juventud de Lisboa en 2023, donde se hizo viral por mezclar música electrónica con un mensaje espiritual que conectó con miles de personas. Según perfiles recientes publicados en la prensa, esa combinación entre sacerdocio y música lo convirtió en una figura muy singular, justamente porque no abandona su vocación, sino que la expresa de una manera distinta. Y estando allí, viéndolo en vivo, entendí mejor por qué tanta gente lo sigue. No era solo por las mezclas ni por el espectáculo, sino por la energía con la que transmite algo que va más allá del entretenimiento.
_________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWYRA3xY48nLRGXCJJhMULJpBcXpqy2zSXT5oacivdJH9/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

</center>

_________

Lo que más me impactó fue ver a esa multitud completamente entregada. Se hablaba de más de 50.000 personas en la Plaza de Mayo para el homenaje al Papa Francisco, y créanme que sentir esa devoción tan de cerca no tiene precio. Había gente cantando, llorando de alegría, con los ojos cerrados, levantando sus celulares para guardar un recuerdo de una noche que sabían que no iban a olvidar fácilmente. El padre Guille iba enlazando una música tras otra, con una vibra impresionante, y ese mar de personas respondía con una fuerza hermosa, como si todos estuvieran conectados por algo mucho más grande que un simple concierto. Para mí fue una experiencia profundamente emocionante, porque no se trató solamente de escuchar música, sino de vivir una noche donde la fe, la emoción y la alegría se encontraron en un mismo lugar. Y eso, sinceramente, no se olvida.

<center>![SeparadorHive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mballesteros/23t7YWoN53XUARh93PVvS9mqaVjjjMGSNi6uJUMjKptGwBVoiTyadsRVjRPAE27xgxsc7.png)</center>

Y al final me quedo con algo muy claro. Hay experiencias que uno no puede explicar del todo, pero que se sienten y se quedan guardadas. Lo que viví anoche en la Plaza de Mayo no fue solo un evento, fue un momento que me llenó por dentro, que me recordó que siempre hay formas nuevas de conectar, de creer y de sentir.

Por llegar casi comenzando, me fue imposible tomarme fotos o siquiera una selfie. Era tanta la gente y el espacio tan reducido donde estaba, que lo único que había era lugar para saltar y dejarse llevar por el momento. Apenas pude hacer unas pequeñas grabaciones con el celular, pero la verdad, hay cosas que no necesitan una foto para quedarse contigo.

Gracias por tomarte el tiempo de leer esta experiencia. De verdad lo valoro mucho. Y ahora te pregunto, ***¿alguna vez has vivido algo así, un momento donde la música, la gente y la fe se juntan y te hacen sentir algo diferente? Te leo en los comentarios.***
____

body.body:
Pulling the plug here looks **sensible, not emotional**. A 25–40% yield stops being attractive when the token is bleeding faster than the APR can patch it, and a **21-day unstaking window** is exactly the kind of thing that turns “I’ll wait for a rebound” into “well, shit.” Nibiru’s own staking docs describe staking as making tokens **illiquid**, with a **21-day unstaking/unbonding period** [Nibiru Docs](https://nibiru.fi/docs/use/stake.html), and the same 21-day constraint is noted in [Atomic Wallet’s NIBI guide](https://support.atomicwallet.io/article/373-how-do-i-stake-nibi) and [Nibiru’s staking guide](https://nibiru.fi/blog/posts/055-staking-guide.html).

Your screenshot lines up with that: **14,273.209509 ampNIBI** unstaking, estimated **21,397.58 NIBI**, unbond start **2026-04-21 21:57**, completion **2026-05-12 21:57**. That means the capital is effectively in limbo for about **21 days**, which is fine in a strong trend and brutal in a weak one. The hard part in Web3 isn’t usually pressing unstake — it’s admitting the opportunity cost out loud.

On the InLeo side, there isn’t much active discussion around NIBI/ampNIBI right now, which honestly says plenty by itself. The closest current staking chatter is around other yield setups like [@ace.yield](https://inleo.io/threads/view/ace.yield/re-leothreads-t1776470407777-vul), while broader community sentiment around unsatisfying yield products is more in the “transparency and execution matter” camp, like [this thread from @logen9f](https://inleo.io/threads/view/logen9f/re-leothreads-2bczpmzdt).

**My take:** rotating out of a fading high-APR position into something with lower yield but better liquidity and clearer conviction is usually the adult move. Chasing recovery because “it’s already down 50%” is how people turn a bad allocation into a long-term hostage situation.

body.title: [Literature] Johann Gottlieb Fichte:  The System of Ethics #16/193
body.body: >our consciousness was produced by freely self-determining our power to think, by means of an arbitrary
>Now it is claimed that this same object is present for us  <i class=\
>originally, i.e., prior to all free philosophizing, and that it imposes itself upon us just as certainly as we are conscious at all. If this is true, then there is
>also an original consciousness of the object in question, even if we may not be precisely conscious of it
>as a singular object at the same level of abstraction
>with which we have just [IV, 31] established it. It may well occur in and be accompanied by another
>thought, as a determination of the latter.
>Is this original consciousness any different from the one that we, as philosophers, have just produced
>within ourselves? How could it be, given that it is supposed to have the same object, and given that the
>philosopher, as such, certainly possesses no other subjective form of thinking than that common and
>original form that is present in all reason?
>But if this so, then why are we looking for what we already possess? We possess it without knowing that
>we possess it. Now we simply want to produce this knowledge within ourselves. A rational being is
>constituted in such a way that when it thinks it does not ordinarily take into account its own act of
>thinking, but only what it is thinking; it loses itself, as the subject, in the object. In philosophy, however,
>everything depends on becoming acquainted with the subject as such, in order to judge its influences on
>the determination of the object. This can happen only by making the mere reflection [that is, the act of
>thinking of the object] into the object of a new reflection. – To the non-philosopher, the project of
>becoming conscious of consciousness may seem strange and perhaps even risible. This, however, merely
>demonstrates the non-philosopher’s ignorance of philosophy and his complete incapacity for the latter.
>Genetic description of the consciousness in question
>(1) The I possesses the absolute power of intuition, for it is precisely thereby that it becomes an I. This
>power cannot be derived from anything higher, nor does it stand in need of any further derivation. If an I
>is posited, then this power of intuition is also posited. – Moreover, the I is and must be able to intuit
>what it itself is without any further ado. Therefore, the particular determination of the faculty to intuit at
>all, which is here postulated, also stands in no need of any [IV, 32] derivation from or mediation through
>external grounds. The I intuits itself purely and simply because it intuits itself. – So much for the fact as
>(2) Let us now proceed to the determination of this fact. In doing this, we expect that each person will be
>able to generate for himself what we are talking about, through his own self-activity, and that he will
>also be able to obtain an inner intuition of what arises for him thereby.
>The intuiting subject (the intellect), which becomes an intellect precisely by means of the postulated act,
>posits the tendency to absolute activity described above, in accordance with the postulate, as –  <i class=\
>itself: that is, as identical with
>itself, the intellect. The previously mentioned absoluteness of real acting
>therebybecomes the essence of an intellect and is brought under the
>sway of the concept, and this is how the
>absoluteness of real acting first becomes  <i class=\
>freedomproper: the absoluteness of absoluteness, the absolute power to make itself absolutely. – Through the consciousness of its own absoluteness the I tears itself
>away – from itself – and puts itself forward as something self-sufficient.
>I said that it tears itself away from itself, and I will therefore begin by explaining this expression. – All
>intuition is, as such, supposed to be directed toward something that is there independently of it, and that
>is there just as it is intuited to be. The situation is no different with respect to the intuition we are now
>discussing, since it is, after all, an intuition. As absolute, the I is supposed to lie there and to have done
>so before it was grasped in intuition. The absoluteness in question is supposed to constitute its being and
>subsistence, independent of all intuition. In cases where what is intuited is supposed to lie outside the
>being of the intuiting subject, however, the intellect as such remains a passive onlooker. Here, however,
>the situation is supposed to be different. What is intuited is itself the intuiting subject – not, to be sure, as
>such, 9but still they share a single, unified essence; they are a single force and substance.

body.body:
**Rebalancing Investments and Recognizing Low Probabilities to Improve Price for NIBI**

The staking NIBI experiment was a hope I decided to stop.

This Sunday, I took a look at some of the projects I have staked as part of my general cash-flow strategy.

NIBI initially looked like an interesting project. In 2024, the yield was 40%. I withdrew almost all of it last January 2025, with a 30% loss.

By April and May 2025, I thought there might be a reversal, so I started again with the project. At that time, the yield was 25% — still interesting, but one disadvantage is that it takes 21 days to unstake. That can be a red flag in Web3.

Sadly, I’m now recognizing that this project will take longer than I expected to reverse its tendency. So today I started the unstaking process.

One part of my investment is converted into AmpNIBI. Once we have NIBI, the coin for the Nibiru ecosystem, we can choose to stake either NIBI or AmpNIBI. The yield is similar.

I decided to unstake my AmpNIBI.

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWcMt7msstCyjhNjE5kftAhXdiHKsyjQzdbro9PwnfqNq/image.png)

![Screenshot 2026 04 19 at 7.49.31 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSzfr9ZddfjdmwkUwyzjai3dhE8WsM1ecGKt9DJL8Wqeh/Screenshot%202026-04-19%20at%207.49.31%E2%80%AFPM.png)

From February to March 2026, I put about $100 into the NIBI > AmpNIBI strategy. My withdrawal has now begun. Hopefully, once it becomes available, I can get a better price. In the meantime, I’m already down about 50%.

My NIBI staking is in another section, which used to be easy to manage for adding, restaking, and unstaking. Right now, though, I can’t figure out how to access it.

After I sort out the AmpNIBI unstaking, I’ll review the other part tomorrow.

These are part of the risks in any investment. Web3 gives us the power to decide how to move our funds. I know this should be viewed over a 5-year horizon, but I think it may be a good idea to move these funds into another staking project — maybe NYM, another project I recently started staking.

NYM has one advantage: I can withdraw in minutes or hours, as soon as the epoch ends.

That’s all for now. Remember, this is not investment advice — I’m just sharing my experience and what I’m learning about Web3 finances.

Thanks for your support. Don’t forget: engage, comment, interact, and we all grow here. And with a bit of luck, you may even earn some rewards.

body.title: Mensaje diario de 5 minutos-Ya no hace tanto calor/ Daily 5 minute message- Not so hot now
body.body:
> Algunas lloviznas intercaladas comienzan a refrescar el ambiente, recordándonos que hay que reparar las goteras de los techos. Nos avisan que vienen las lluvias y con ellas se va el calor agobiante. Los verdes se refrescan en los jardines y parques. La ropa se vuelve más ligera y los deseos de bañarse en la lluvia vuelven. Comienza a olvidarse el calor sofocante, pero todavía cuando se va la luz no los recuerda. Está misma mañana ha dejado su gota de sudor en la cama. Y el agua entre va y viene, dejándonos poca cosa para pensar en ella. Estamos mejor o peor es lo que se discute, pero ya no queda tiempo para pensar en ello. Nos mantienen entretenidos en saber que nos quitaran ahora y mientras tanto ya no hace tanto calor al borde de la calle sedienta de libertad.
***
Este texto corresponde a mi participación en el reto diario del amigo @latino.romano y @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/19-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3078-not-so-hot-now) **ENGLISH VERSION** Intermittent light rain begins to cool the air, reminding us that the leaky roofs need fixing. It signals the arrival of the rains, and with them, the oppressive heat. The greenery in the gardens and parks is refreshed. Clothes become lighter, and the desire to bathe in the rain returns. The stifling heat begins to fade, but even when the light fades, it's not forgotten. This very morning, it left its drop of sweat on the bed. And the rain comes and goes, leaving us little time to think about it. Whether we're better or worse off is the topic of discussion, but there's no time left to dwell on it. We're kept busy wondering what will be taken from us now, and meanwhile, it's not so hot anymore on the edge of the street, thirsty for freedom.
***
This text corresponds to my participation in the daily challenge of my friend @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano and @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/19-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3078-not-so-hot-now)

body.title: Peltophorums.
body.body:
Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim, 
Hello my dear friends, 
good evening, 
My sincere greetings and greetings to everyone. How are you all? I hope everyone is well and healthy. Alhamdulillah, by the infinite mercy of Allah, I am also well and healthy. Today I will present to you another new flower photography.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSdkFA5vxPDLSSHuAmjeCDj3icEpTDY3u5waNororT6h4/1776602345582.jpg)|
|-|


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNsZUkSxfHiQBHbW3CKmodXgP3fK3Ex9BsmYwhWfdAGi/1776602328115.jpg)|
|-|
What is the name of this flower Peltophorums, but in our rural Bengali language it is called yellow Peltophorums flowers, their skin color is yellow, so it looks heavy and beautiful, its flowers bloom once a year. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSBt6kVgLou7jp8ccgyohTQtmTrHUKpVEA3roEnKgVJ9o/1776602345116.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGbMuTzCd8shJBp2dZF7k1GELoMDg8VkGu7LtqYkWLgy/1776602345851.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPzLuuoCds3VyhPYhNMUwyt7ygoemo7PzYP7smGxzyHSm/1776602346319.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf67HXwg5ftkney9sShVcijRS2xT3fjiqHcQkVd7Bk5qt/1776602346865.jpg)

These flowers grow very large and are seen in forests and forests. Also, they are not common flowers, so they are not known to many people. Everyone knows them as wild flowers. 

The flowers of Peltophorums appear in clusters at the ends of the branches which are incredibly beautiful to look at. When these yellow flowers bloom together between the green leaves, the beauty of the tree blossoms. 

Any flower is loved by everyone, but there are some flowers that are more attractive to people, among them are colorful flowers, the flowers are very small and the petals are relatively small. A flower has four sepals and more petals coming out from inside. 

Peltophorums flowers drop to the ground within a day or two, and in a light breeze, numerous flowers fall under the tree. 

So friends, I am very happy to be able to share another flower photography with you. How are the pictures? Please let me know through the comments. I am leaving here today. I hope everyone is well and healthy. May God bless you all.

Este arranque de temporada 2026 está siendo realmente explosivo para los nuestros, con varios nombres peleando los lideratos ofensivos desde la primera semana.

Aquí tienes un breve resumen de los protagonistas hasta hoy, 18 de abril de 2026:

Los \

del Bateo

Andy Pagés (Dodgers de Los Ángeles): 
Es, sin duda, la sensación del momento. Ha comenzado con un ritmo frenético, liderando a los cubanos en hits (27) y manteniendo un promedio impresionante de .480. Ya suma 2 cuadrangulares y 7 impulsadas, consolidándose como una pieza clave en el lineup de los Dodgers.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU3oexVJx4s4tR1w5gDtcV2Jnsv1NnG9UJyYeVtcuShZs/img_20260418_155328_224.jpg)
Yordan Álvarez (Astros de Houston):

body.title: Las apariencias engañan (Es-En)
body.body:
Un abrazo para mis amigos de @Holos-Lotus, hace aproximadamente un año y cuatro meses que entré a este hogar que es #Hive. En #Ecency encontré el modo de interiorizar las emociones y muchos de los elementos que nutren nuestro crecimiento personal.

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmbEg19g86RrburvP9vCXWTQpFpT9YSe2Gtzj4EJyShUtr/1776596816216.jpg

---

En algún momento escribí sobre las apariencias, relacionado con el asombro de algunas personas al vernos descalzos, bajo la lluvia o con pocas ropas en sitios que no son de playa.

También es frecuente ver una y otra vez un mismo tema, pero si algo nos permite nuestra creatividad es analizar los temas desde diferentes perspectivas y eso lo facilita el tiempo y las experiencias.

El punto es que esta (yo), a veces crítica de arte, artesana, repostera, profesora (una vecina en su chisme le dijo a otra: «yo creo que es escritora»); mujer siempre, pues camino por las calles de mi barrio con mi ropa de andar. Este outfit se compone de short y blusa, casi siempre con señales visibles del paso del tiempo.

Decía mi abuela que en bata de dormir no se sale de la casa y aunque parezca lógico y evidente, cada día veo a muchas mujeres en la calle con batas de casa o ropa de dormir. Prefiero entonces ropa de andar, que no sé ustedes, pero acá esa ropa es la que usamos en un tiempo como de salir y ya hemos destinado a otro nivel.

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUpKUDEkqQduTa7BLoHiFo9e5i2v5Rq4GPdpLLH2WxXZ/1776596926034.jpg

---

En este mundo de las apariencias, nadie escapa al juicio precipitado. Hoy me sorprendí evaluando a mi vecina: tan bonita en su vestido estampado, corto; el pelo recogido en coleta alta y una cartera negra. ¿A dónde iba? No sé. Sus chanclas de goma y medias me hicieron pensar que, como yo, haría mercado cerca.

A la verdad que nadie giraría la cabeza por cómo visto. Mis prendas no tienen etiquetas de diseñador ni brillos de ostentación. Me inclino a pensar que la energía, la sonrisa y el aura individual son más poderosas. A veces en una semana repito ropas y espero que nadie lo note.

Las apariencias engañan, sí, y la tentación de enjuiciar es inevitable, pero también nos ofrecen lecciones. Nos invitan a detener el juicio rápido, a preguntar en lugar de suponer, a mirar con los ojos del alma, o por lo menos a no evaluar.

La riqueza habita en la libertad de ser uno mismo, en la capacidad de dar sin perder nada, en la paz de quien sabe que su valor no depende de la mirada ajena ni del valor de lo que trae encima.

Así que cuando me vean pasar con mi ropa tradicional, sin oropeles, recuerden: lo que ven es solo la envoltura. Adentro hay un corazón que late, una economía que trata de sostener por sí misma y una mano abierta para ayudar.

Las apariencias, efectivamente, engañan. Pero quien aprende a mirar más allá, descubre una vida plena. No estoy vendiendo una imagen ni un paquete, pero verdaderamente yo misma reconozco que no soy lo que aparento, ni siquiera ya me preocupo por aparentar ni convencer.

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmbz43s8KJd3VsydNN5ZJJYME2KxgbGG54ichXKKePpGCQ/1776597024058.jpg

---

Voy por la vida siendo yo misma, cómoda conmigo, y siempre intento ser invisible. También intento no hacerme juicios superficiales porque detrás de cada persona, por muy sencilla que parezca, hay universos increíbles. Eso siempre me ha encantado conocer: el universo de cada cual, porque los sueños, pensamientos y sentimientos no requieren de artificios.

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFnEMCYnFkP4yn3RAjCC5Yi2Bw4pZMYk2wKE2HWeExdE/1739658658260.jpg

<sub>Gracias por visitar mi blog. Soy crítica de arte, investigadora social y amante de la cocina. Te invito a conocer más de mí, de mi país y de mis letras. Texto y fotos de mi propiedad.</sub>

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAxqWjfHD2t6iFUv1FivzQTFzsMmbGqywoexFuT14L8s/1750582840520.jpg

Here is the English translation of the corrected Spanish text:

---

**Appearances Are Deceiving**

A hug to my friends at @Holos-Lotus. It's been about a year and four months since I entered this home that is #Hive. On #Ecency, I found a way to internalize emotions and many of the elements that nurture our personal growth.

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmbEg19g86RrburvP9vCXWTQpFpT9YSe2Gtzj4EJyShUtr/1776596816216.jpg

---

At some point I wrote about appearances, related to the astonishment of some people when they see us barefoot, in the rain, or with few clothes in places that aren't the beach.

It's also common to see the same topic over and over again, but if our creativity allows us anything, it's to analyze topics from different perspectives, and time and experiences make that easier.

The point is that this (me), sometimes an art critic, craftswoman, baker, teacher (a neighbor, in her gossip, said to another: \
); always a woman, I walk through the streets of my neighborhood in my \

This outfit consists of shorts and a blouse, almost always with visible signs of wear and tear.

My grandmother used to say that you don't leave the house in a nightgown, and although it seems logical and obvious, every day I see many women on the street in housecoats or pajamas. So I prefer everyday clothes. I don't know about you, but around here, those are the clothes we used to wear when going out and have now downgraded to another level.

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUpKUDEkqQduTa7BLoHiFo9e5i2v5Rq4GPdpLLH2WxXZ/1776596926034.jpg

---

In this world of appearances, no one escapes hasty judgment. Today I caught myself evaluating my neighbor: so pretty in her short, printed dress, her hair pulled up in a high ponytail, and a black purse. Where was she going? I don't know. Her rubber flip-flops and stockings made me think that, like me, she was grocery shopping nearby.

Truth be told, no one would turn their head because of how I dress. My clothes have no designer labels or flashy ostentation. I lean toward thinking that energy, a smile, and one's individual aura are more powerful. Sometimes I repeat outfits in a week and hope no one notices.

Appearances are deceiving, yes, and the temptation to judge is inevitable, but they also offer us lessons. They invite us to stop quick judgment, to ask instead of assuming, to look with the eyes of the soul, or at least not to evaluate.

Wealth dwells in the freedom to be oneself, in the ability to give without losing anything, in the peace of someone who knows that their worth does not depend on others' gazes or the value of what they wear.

So when you see me pass by in my traditional clothes, without tinsel, remember: what you see is just the wrapper. Inside there is a beating heart, an economy trying to sustain itself, and an open hand ready to help.

Appearances, indeed, are deceiving. But whoever learns to look beyond discovers a full life. I am not selling an image or a package, but truly I myself recognize that I am not what I seem, nor do I even worry anymore about seeming or convincing.

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmbz43s8KJd3VsydNN5ZJJYME2KxgbGG54ichXKKePpGCQ/1776597024058.jpg

---

I go through life being myself, comfortable with who I am, and I always try to be invisible. I also try not to make superficial judgments because behind every person, no matter how simple they may seem, there are incredible universes. I've always loved getting to know that: each person's universe, because dreams, thoughts, and feelings don't need artifice.

---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWgq28rPHaXFgduE7yXQAE8pixHhnDVhpP2H8dgavZuJ1/1776602297804.jpg)


<sub>Thank you for visiting my blog. I am an art critic, social researcher, and cooking lover. I invite you to learn more about me, my country, and my words. Text and photos are my own.</sub>

body.title: Van Gogh Ausstellung (und indisches Essen)
body.body: Es ist schon ein bisschen her, da war ich mit einer Freundin in der \

mit Gemälden, Lebenslauf und einigen Geschichten ging es zum Hauptteil der Ausstellung. Das war so eine Art Film, der sich nicht nur auf eine Leinwand beschränkt hat:


![1000068292.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lammbock/EoGwR4nKh9ZKZki94P9W396Xynw1We5H9hbjxQZ4Kbtb2S1jcWK5kmp2tj1kcaodiJw.jpg)

Insgesamt ganz nett, aber für den Preis eher nichts, das man unbedingt gesehen haben muss. Wer bis 14. Juni in München ist, van Gogh-Fan ist und nichts besseres zu tun hat, kann sich das aber schon gerne ansehen. body.body:
>



You see this main reason of living might have different answers depending on how you understand the question and it's also dependant on how you actually perceive or see living, and at different stages in life I had different view on what living is all about, sometimes I thought living is about eating food, playing and sleeping, other times I thought living is about going to school every morning plus coming back to wash my school uniform, other times I targeted living to be growing up to be Independent and living the life.


![IMG_20260419_093344_355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/graceze/244A4NPquTocwe59LY1o8mC3CBPWJTahxNxZEmXSEB1qtPb7C8NLb5NvgJyPqD3oVGd4U.jpg)


But one thing I realized at all this season is that I just felt this not satisfacted like there's more to life so I kept searching and searching till I then found my purpose and that, I would be sharing with you all at the course of today's interaction but just for courtesy let me reintroduce our topic for today. I am participating on the contest topic which says: 2️⃣ Right now in your life, what feels like your main reason for living?
How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day?

What feels like my main reason for living is that am living for Christ, living for God's purpose and assignment over my life, even the Bible says \

which means there's a will for me to fulfill and until I realized it, I kept wondering about without satisfaction so that was what it was like for me, and what my purpose looks like now is the stage of my finding my root in Christ, building relationship with my Father and all of that. With all the killings, kidnapping and unsafety happening all over the world this days, with the way people and most especially youths are dying, with the way we live in fear each day that we wake up, what's definitely keeping me moving forward each day is my covenant, my safety in God and what He has said to me, is the assurance He keeps giving me everyday that He is always with me that has kept me going. It's nice reading this piece with you and I wish you the best of week as you step into yet another week, much love. All images used here belongs to me.

body.title: The daughter's narrow path
body.body:
The journey of a daughter is often a delicate balance between honoring the roots that raised her and shielding the new life she holds in her arms. It is a narrow path walked between the echoes of a stubborn past and the bright hope of a righteous future. When the weight of family burdens feels like a slow-growing vine, and the weariness of the soul becomes a heavy shroud, there is only one place to find true rest. This is a reflection on surrendering the struggle to a higher power, trusting that even in the midst of the storm, there is a steady hand to hold and a peaceful water that waits at the end of the road.

The Daughter’s Narrow Path

Between the morning light and the heavy door,
I walk the line of contentment with what I have,
While the weight of the past cries out for more,
And I seek the turn of a righteous path.
I hold my child, a gift I must shield,
While bearing the burdens of those who won't yield.

I reach for my parents with a gentle answer,
But their stubbornness is a slow-growing vine;
They wait for the storm to become a disaster
Before they seek counsel or a hopeful sign.
I am weary and heavy-laden, Lord, it is true,
Looking for rest that can only found in You.

I put on compassion, kindness, and grace,
Though I am asking for bread at their table still;
I strive to honor and find my place,
Surrendering my heart to Your holy will.
You are the sturdy shelter when the wind is cold,
The faithful friend whose hand I can hold.

So I will be still and I will not fret,
For You supply every need that I face;
You’ll help me to pay every dues and every debt,
And lead me out of this weary grace.
You hold my right hand, saying \
Leading me peacefully by the still water.

body.body:
> **_Hello beautiful people! I hope you're all doing great and if you're not, you will be soon!_** I really wanted to try ink drawing and create something in my signature dark style, so I used the character Holozing—specifically, the Healer of Light as my inspiration. I reimagined him in my own style and drew him in ink. I hope you like it. > **_Hola gente bonita! ¡Espero estén súper bien todos y si no lo están, pronto lo estarán!_** Tenia muchas ganas de pintar con tinta y hacer algún dibujo muy a mi estilo oscuro, así que tome como referencia el personaje de Holozing, para ser mas concreto al Sanador de la luz y lo hice a mi estilo y lo pinte con tinta, espero que les guste. ___

I wanted to stray a bit from the norm in the drawings I’d done recently; this time, I wanted to create a slightly darker, more gloomy drawing, giving him a somewhat grotesque mouth with protruding teeth and so on. > Comencé haciendo el boceto, tomando en cuenta la referencia del personaje y otro que encontré en Pinterest de un chico y con eso voy armando todo el dibujo. Quise salirme un poco de lo normativo en los últimos dibujos que había hecho, esta vez quise hacer un dibujo un poco mas oscuro o tétrico, haciéndole una boca un tanto grotesca, con dientes sobresalientes y demás. ||| |---|---| |![IMG_20260418_104142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oscurocactus/23tHC7M2Ae9ho2C3Vjxv1xBRzu6gGfSGpNgdDF1NY363UuRvvjGk48UJUxXrHs4p8F9C8.jpg)|![IMG_20260418_111352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oscurocactus/23tHC7M2Ae9mT55WFgUkH9oxeHbDhQV8AV3ih6s4UxSn15dkWucFw9s63qwGkxdqC8x1r.jpg)| After sketching for a while about 15 minutes, i cleaned it up really well and added details with a mechanical pencil, so it would be ready for me to start coloring it. > Después de un rato haciendo el boceto, que serian como unos 15 minutos, lo que hice fue limpiarlo super bien y detallarlo con un portaminas, para así dejarlo listo para comenzar a pintarlo. ||| |---|---| |![IMG_20260418_125954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oscurocactus/23tbye9gFUGjHgGzpVzjugf8c7TXDXnNXUnV1JUvnLwvvemaitiXGYBhaegfaZBBVbpkA.jpg)|![IMG_20260418_133220.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oscurocactus/23vsSca84TDf593E5cUemm6foXKHndsLu3iPmgJLayR8YKHjjoMR9y4GLvR8Vd6KvdfeE.jpg)| Use ink and water to paint the entire character. The ink is the main pigment, and the water is what you’ll use to dilute the ink, creating different shades of black and allowing you to achieve a good contrast in the drawing. > Use tinta y agua para pintar todo el personaje. La tinta es el pigmento principal y el agua es la que usaría para diluir la tinta y así obtener diferentes tonos de negro y así poder hacer un contraste decente en el dibujo. ||| |---|---| |![IMG_20260418_140421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oscurocactus/23vi1wvR4c7PqBcWegi3qE5ThDCFCYDUrkpntgkaGhafKV5sFLD9EiGv3eRAW2BcYsaKB.jpg)|![IMG_20260418_144635.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oscurocactus/23wCDikY5Mr1ZGUQcWxUXFpxrEh37YWDc2hAiCaEM26WEWFwksRQzCNyMRuaZXdB61A7t.jpg)| After spending quite a while coloring the entire drawing, I let it dry thoroughly and then added some details with a mechanical pencil to create a line art that would help highlight certain areas of the drawing. I finished the drawing by adding some highlights to certain areas, and that’s it, folks—that’s all there is to it. > Después de haber estado un buen rato pintando todo el dibujo, lo que hice fue dejarlo secar muy bien y así después detallarlo un poco con un portaminas y obtener un line art que ayudara a realzar ciertas zonas en el dibujo. Termino el dibujo agregando unos brillos en algunas zonas del dibujo y listo amigos, eso seria todo.

body.title: El sonido de no rendirse | Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
![sososs.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdXjH9meuHhYk3tAY62FFssZkAHqaGyY2o1pxjLE9jnYD/sososs.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/sentado-musico-silla-nino-10222202/) El aplauso siguió llegando por parte de todas las personas que estaban allí en ese lugar, hasta que uno de los miembros del jurado se puso de pie, sosteniendo un sobre en sus firmes. Wez apenas podía escuchar, ya que estaba muy nervioso —El ganador es, Wez. Por un segundo nadie podía creer lo que estaba pasando. Sus padres seguían al lado de este joven y él caminó hacia el frente como si cada paso pesara menos que el anterior. Cuando recibió el premio, no fue el trofeo lo que lo hizo temblar, sino todo lo que ese momento representaba: cada noche, el sonido imperfecto del viejo piano, los errores que se repitieron una y otra vez. Uno de los jueces se acercó con una sonrisa y comento no ganaste por tocar perfecto, ganaste porque hiciste que sintiéramos algo real, pero ahora empieza lo más difícil y es seguir creciendo. Otro del equipo de jurado añadió—Escucha más de lo que tocas y cuando dudes, vuelve a donde empezaste. Wez tomó cada palabra como si fueran notas para aprender. >The applause kept coming from everyone in the room, until one of the judges stood up, holding an envelope in his hands. Wez could barely hear, he was so nervous—“The winner is… Wez.” For a second, no one could believe what was happening. # >His parents stood beside him, and he walked to the front as if each step felt lighter than the last. When he received the award, it wasn’t the trophy that made him tremble, but everything that moment represented: every night, the imperfect sound of the old piano, the mistakes he’d repeated over and over. # >One of the judges approached with a smile and said, “You didn’t win because you played perfectly; you won because you made us feel something real. But now the hardest part begins: continuing to grow.” Another member of the judging panel added, “Listen more than you play, and when you doubt yourself, go back to where you started.” Wez took in every word as if they were notes to learn. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmddcuUaMaJagkr5uHJzRX8Q43Lx5MUApxDW5pYxsS8joe/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/mano-musico-piano-de-perfil-10252588/) Toda la familia regresó a casa y regreso fue distinto, había emoción, el premio viajaba entre sus manos y sus padres no dejaban de sonreír. Cuando llegaron al establo, todo era exactamente como antes —Lo logramos —dijo su madre. Allí mismo encendieron algunas luces, improvisaron una pequeña celebración con lo que tenían: pan, risas, abrazos largos. No había lujo, pero sí algo más profundo: orgullo y felicidad. La noche cayó y cuando todos se fueron a descansar, Wez se quedó solo, donde una vez más fue a donde estaba el piano y sentó frente a él, colocó los dedos sobre las teclas y cerró los ojos. Donde está vez no había jurado, ni presión, ni miedo a equivocarse. Respiró hondo y comenzó a tocar, de una manera muy distinta, ya que cada nota era un agradecimiento a sus padres primeramente, segundo a sus errores, tercero a las noches difíciles y a ese momento que marcó un antes y un después en Wez como lo era el escenario donde casi se rendía y no lo hizo. La melodía fluía, puesto que no buscaba ser perfecta, si no buscaba ser honesta y fue la mejor interpretación en el piano, donde el sonido llenó el establo, escapó por las rendijas de madera, y se perdió en la noche como un susurro que decía: Gracias. Wez sonrió, se levantó y al final entendía algo que antes no podía nombrar: El premio no era el final de su carrera como pianista, era solo la primera nota de todo lo que estaba por venir. >The whole family returned home, and the trip back was different; there was excitement in the air, the prize was in his hands, and his parents couldn’t stop smiling. When they arrived at the barn, everything was exactly as it had been before. “We did it,” his mother said. Right there, they turned on some lights and improvised a small celebration with what they had: bread, laughter, and long hugs. There was no luxury, but there was something deeper: pride and happiness. # >Night fell, and when everyone went to rest, Wez was left alone. Once again, he went to where the piano was and sat down in front of it, placed his fingers on the keys, and closed his eyes. This time, there were no vows, no pressure, and no fear of making a mistake. He took a deep breath and began to play, in a very different way, as each note was a thank you—first to his parents, second to his mistakes, third to the difficult nights and to that moment that marked a turning point in Wez’s life, just as it was the stage where he almost gave up but didn’t. # >The melody flowed, for he wasn’t seeking perfection, but rather honesty, and it was the finest performance on the piano, where the sound filled the barn, escaped through the cracks in the wood, and faded into the night like a whisper that said: Thank you. Wez smiled, stood up, and finally understood something he hadn’t been able to put into words before: The prize wasn’t the end of his career as a pianist; it was just the first note of everything that was yet to come. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRQczhZYbXyhacJbuRi8tDmoiRyfEP7bsGeLhf7cf62dE/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/manos-sentado-musica-piano-4038322/)
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

body.title: My reason for living-LoH contst #285
body.body: >Life is not a bed of roses. It is a long, winding and tedious path where every living creature must struggle simply to remain alive. From the moment we open our eyes to the moment we close them, we are engaged in the same ancient task and that is to protect this fragile spark so that it may not go out too soon. I am no exception. I have no relatives, nor any desire to marry or raise children. I possess no ancestral wealth. I have no hidden savings. I have nothing that could lift me into comfort. I live in a rented room and work in a small store, earning just enough to keep myself afloat. And yet, in the midst of all this, I live and I even find joy in living. Sometimes I pause and wonder why I am here at all and what purpose my life is meant to serve.

>I have come to understand that the impulse to live is woven into the very fabric of existence. Every creature, from the smallest insect to the most reflective human being, carries within it a silent command and that is to stay alive. I am simply following that ancient programming. I live because I like this world and I want to taste whatever happiness life offers. I have a few good friends and colleagues whose company lightens my days. I read whenever I get time for it. I love gathering knowledge like small treasures. I want to live long enough to understand this world or at least to marvel at it.

>I am not an atheist, yet I am far from a fanatic. Faith, for me, is neither a banner nor a battlefield - it is just a quiet curiosity. Life feels like a journey that I wish to walk to its natural end. That thought alone sustains me. It gives shape to my days and turns even an ordinary life into something quietly meaningful.

body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***
# ***
The Tin Gods’ Thermometer
***

> **‘Not so hot now’**, I tell myself as the Ontario breeze caresses my cheeks as if it were an air conditioner set to sixteen degrees Celsius. Here, spring is not merely a seasonal formality; it is a riot of colour where the scent of rain intoxicates the senses after every drizzle, reminding me that the earth is alive. Yet my mind drifts across the continent to my native Venezuela, where the tarmac beats under a relentless sun that offers no respite.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/245T5jrGgtgHBjghJcgriA9kzNU6aatySXb7QRpZb9fwkTCsqTjyUD568YTsw5E51XspS.png)
I read a news item that brought a bittersweet smile to my lips: *some citizens claim that the Caribbean heatwave is due to a recent space mission*. ***“Those people fiddled with something up there”***, they assert with the conviction of someone who has uncovered a cosmic conspiracy. I imagine the astronauts, like mischievous children in a forbidden attic, turning a sacred knob in the sky, unaware that the thermometer of ignorance tends to rise much faster than the mercury in the atmosphere, heh, heh, heh.
https://images.ecency.com/p/Zskj9C56UonZ32EJw6nMcm9UJXZFc4FvMtk6wyeADdhVKamon63acDd24xWm9BXg1TkUZ5FNZGSyasbdV5dDzHiyzviYc1trP1BNHYn1ijQrmnz6Xwkr?format=match&mode=fit&width=1024
Today, this ‘quote of the day’ takes on a dual and profound meaning. For me, taking refuge in this Canadian coolness of 60 °F (around 16 °C), it is a delightful climatic truth. For those compatriots, shrouded in the mists of superstition and a distorted magical realism, the heat is a punishment for ‘desecrating’ the heights. It is fascinating how human perception attempts to rationalise chaos; if we do not understand the science, we invent myths to justify it. As I gaze at my flowers, I realise that the true temperature lies in the ability to distinguish between an engine taking off and a planet that simply cannot bear any more fire. *** ***

# ***
El termómetro de los dioses de hojalata
***

**, me repito mientras el viento de Ontario acaricia mis mejillas como si fuera un aire acondicionado programado a dieciséis grados Celsius. Aquí, la primavera no es un simple trámite estacional; es un despliegue cromático absoluto donde el petricor embriaga los sentidos tras cada llovizna, recordándome que la tierra está viva. Sin embargo, mi mente cruza el continente hacia mi Venezuela natal, donde el asfalto late bajo un sol inclemente que no da tregua.

<center>![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/245T5jrGgtgHBjghJcgriA9kzNU6aatySXb7QRpZb9fwkTCsqTjyUD568YTsw5E51XspS.png)</center>

Leí una noticia que me provocó una risa agridulce: *algunos ciudadanos aseguran que la ola de calor caribeña se debe a una reciente misión espacial*. ***\

***, afirman con la convicción de quien ha descubierto un complot cósmico. Me imagino a los astronautas, como niños traviesos en un desván prohibido, moviendo una perilla sagrada en el cielo, ignorando que el termómetro de la ignorancia suele subir mucho más rápido que el mercurio ambiental, je, je, je.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/p/Zskj9C56UonZ32EJw6nMcm9UJXZFc4FvMtk6wyeADdhVKamon63acDd24xWm9BXg1TkUZ5FNZGSyasbdV5dDzHiyzviYc1trP1BNHYn1ijQrmnz6Xwkr?format=match&mode=fit&width=1024</center>

Esta frase del día cobra hoy un sentido bivalente y profundo. Para mí, refugiado en este frescor canadiense de 60 °F (unos 16 °C), es una verdad climática deliciosa. Para aquellos compatriotas, envueltos en vapores de superstición y un realismo mágico distorsionado, el calor es un castigo por \

las alturas. Es fascinante cómo la percepción humana intenta racionalizar el caos; si no comprendemos la ciencia, inventamos mitos para justificar. Mientras contemplo mis flores, entiendo que la verdadera temperatura reside en la capacidad de distinguir entre un motor que despega y un planeta que, simplemente, ya no aguanta más fuego.
*** ***

body.title: Digimon Survive [Let's Play] - 66 - JewelBeemon
body.body:
***Truthful Route: Session 13! Here comes a new Ultimate level evolution!!***


-----

**Digimon Survive** is a Digimon Visual Novel with Turn-based strategy battles. It follows a group of children stranded in another world. They form bonds with the creators there called Digimon as they desperate attempts to find a way back home. I already finished one route of the game, and now I'm publishing my playthrough of the Truthful Route!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbpSpNqvL8z1LcgtAQk16JUMGRMjZ8vnUYJHTjaPhWisy/1000072257.webp 


Digimon Survive is the darkest piece of Digimon media I ever consumed while still being PG13. What I love the most about **Digimon Survive**, is how it uniquely blends Digital Monsters with Japanese folklore. It's amazing how the idea of \

integrates seamlessly with Digimon lore. The specific Digimon they choose for this game enhance this theme.

Digimon Survive is the closest modern entry to the *old school* Digimon anime vibes. Though, more than the earlier Digimon anime series, the game reminds me more of **Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Survivor** series. In that series too, characters may die depending on your actions.

Below you can watch my playthrough of Digimon Survive, and the link to the whole playlist.

**THIS PLAYTHROUGH IS MODDED:** I installed the [Improved Translation Mod](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459533) and the [Quirky Dialogue Font Mod.](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459571) This playthrough should look a bit different from the official version.


----

### Watch on YouTube:


https://youtu.be/lgyITTRSxsQ


**Playlist:**

```
 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt3R7_tP1xaH9mASCoJsRIYN96RihTAtI
```

### Truthful Route - 13: JewelBeemon

This is the part of the story where Minoru and Falcomon have a fight. It felt more impactful the first time around because someone has just died that time. Now, Minoru feels like an idiot for crashing out, (to be fair, it's still in his character, it just makes less sense compared to the first time.)


Ryo's Kunemon finally reaches the ultimate level: JewelBeemon! He can even talk now, at least while in the evolved form. *Haha.* 


-----

body.title: $HIVE, $BTC & ETH/BTC Technical Analysis - 19.04.2026
body.body: It's Sunday again, a sunny day if I want to be precise, so let's see where we are with the assets and pairs I'm charting each week. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tHbg12BekZApq315AnZXNN51StyChR7EdtqgyhUJkMjeM8a5Hv93cJSCN8xzkm9HEf8.png) On the ***monthly*** time frame, not much has changed since last week, if we don't count that $HIVE is trading at $0.0613, vs $0.0589 last week. We still have a bullish candle so far, but again, it's not closed yet, there are still 11 days to go. Not much to say here, previous analysis still valid. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23t8D6MYfatDnHuWQzzzuDMvnumVyVzkk1KLK1fnZrmqsXBKiP9MkdbfpjvfRAKBfQX9c.png) On the ***weekly*** time frame, price managed to establish a local bottom at $0.0553 at the end of last month. This week, although the candle is not closed yet (closes in about 13 hours) so far price is above the weekly open and we have a bullish candle, with a long upside wick. Price had a nice move to the upside, but got sold out before it could sweep liquidity from the $0.0691 high. The two levels to watch on this time frame are the high mentioned above, $0.0691 and the swing low, that is at $0.0553. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tSzLNbhYQkL8WHNuen2rcpPQQuwNEVZJFifUnXor6m16sQSWFWd6SAytm43YjdBzXhJ.png) On the ***daily*** time frame, price is retesting the bullish gap left on the leg up, by the move on Thursday. There are around 13 hours to go till the candle close, but so far, we have an ugly, bearish engulfing candle. This gap has to hold price if we want bullish continuation. In case the gap can hold price and we get a bounce here, the high I'd keep an eye on is at $0.0676. If the gap can't hold price, there are three lows to sweep, that are $0.0574, $0.0566 and $0.0553. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23t8D1dSfvTRben8vxh2Raah35pXqtNzETjk8kN78bt6ENnETSUHyEWMUuHdUGg8dVwGh.png) On the ***h4*** time frame, price is slightly below mid-range, if I count my dealing range between $0.0574 and the swing high at $0.0669, retesting the bullish gap created on Thursday. It's the third time this gap is retested, so let's see if it holds. If not, there's another bullish gap below the current one, which it's possible to retest. Levels to watch are marked on the chart. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tSzChUJCsPuvjRaPbKzTgHRvQvbxR4zNgHxshPDLhK7bHnWB9CWEauDKbtna2CxoUs3.png) ***$BTC*** has been trying to break out of this accumulation zone has been in since the drop in February and is nearing resistance, which is the bearish gap marked with yellow on the chart. I'd be cautious here. If we get a rejection, $70,417 could be next. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23twABkvbC7ucyHzKXFZdCrkXev1Ukr3ZZJ2R9mMeZ6PoAaXAoUwkuUvVzysH1T8ZixrL.png) ***ETH/BTC***, interesting situation here. Price swept liquidity from the previous swing high this week and created a new one at 0.0032055, but also got rejected. At the time of writing, chances to revisit and sweep liquidity from 0.0030317 is high in my opinion. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23t88HMURfwX1vuVgcP6xfg8HqhkCw9Giisu82cxdYXEQrDsqx3sEukMC9fDKWSUEB8Kb.png) [source](https://www.forexfactory.com/calendar) Next week we have one single red folder day, on Tuesday, the rest of the calendar is empty, but with the current geo-political situation and Trump saying a lot of things that can move the markets, but are not necessarily true, I'd be always cautious.

> *Remember, technical analysis is not about forecasting price, but about reacting to what price does.* As always, this is a game of probabilities, not certainties. Also please note, this is not financial advice, it's my view and understanding of the market. All charts posted here are screenshots from Tradinview. body.title: Why love wrestles with logic
body.body:
![4F7F1921-739D-4529-9DEA-0F67C0A73934.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dwayne16/23xAeLRfRCKWw7zfDbxMHfyLS1GAkTuvosyLPFpQpoyYTPCmv7jd6qa9BEAjsQSX1caWA.jpeg)

***
There is a difference between loving someone, acknowledging their beauty and whatnot and blatantly following your instinctual nature into loving someone who thinks otherwise about you or has their heart held by someone else.

Emotions are primal to us. They evoke a sense of being. And as strong as they are, they provoke all sought of manifestations. Whether that’s in the form of art, music, science etc. But such reoccurring good feelings are always combated with the worse. As with anything in life. With happiness there is sadness. With love there is hate/indifference, with compassion there is cruelty. For the most part they lead us towards the best versions of ourselves. But when the opposite happens, not much so to say the least.

Yearning for someone you have feelings for is a good feeling. Especially when you continuously go out of you way to make sure their secured or cared after one way or the other.  But there is a thin line between yearning for someone and bleeding your heart out at the expense of your own mental, physical, financial or emotional wellbeing.

There are always hints that show very early that the person you pour love into doesn’t deserve your love. Yes it may not be as noticeable all the but time but it shows down the line. It’s  in the way they communicate with you. The subtle indifference they portray towards you. Their lack of appreciation, empathy, compassion. These are often coupled with behaviours that are manipulative, destructive, selfish or just downright disoriented. Yes it’s true that these signs can be faint sometimes, But people who love unconditionally and waste their emotional energy with complete disregard of their “partners” true character and behaviour are unwise. The signs will show and it’s up to you to subside your emotions and properly reflect on the person you love and support.

Protect your mind, time and energy. It’s the most valuable asset a human being can have. If you choose to love someone else without properly analysing them and also loving yourself first, you’re brewing a bad omen for  yourself but potentially those around you.

---

Hello splinterlands community.Today I am here with a new card game video for you. 29card game is a popular game. It is a very old game. I have been watching it for 7/8 years. It is played by counting the cards. First, the cards are divided among four people. The cards that fall in the hands of the lucky ones are the ones with the most powerful cards. Among them, A is the most powerful. Then the Queen is the most powerful. Then the King is the most powerful. This is played in a sequential manner. Whoever can do it can get a very good score.

![Screenshot_2026-04-19-17-26-52-351_com.BS_Pias.twentynine.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcn7fibZ84Jcj7XH6WvfgpkGxjSioWGC9hKNFb8wq2YRs/Screenshot_2026-04-19-17-26-52-351_com.BS_Pias.twentynine.jpg)



The popularity of this European card game also increased in the 15th century. When the game first entered the United States, it brought a new addition to the game, which they called troy quinque. The word now comes from the word trump. Initially, there were 78 cards in a pack of cards. Now, this number has been reduced to 52.

![Screenshot_2026-04-19-17-26-44-601_com.BS_Pias.twentynine.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZBnNLRNQs6bPPsPmFCPX3bWVovFFtyfUU2T5mTmcvEyY/Screenshot_2026-04-19-17-26-44-601_com.BS_Pias.twentynine.jpg)



The basic premise is that the slaves can be identified by their faces or backs, so each player will only be completely sure about the cards drawn by his own hand. No one can say for sure about the cards in the other players' hands. Each player knows all the cards in a deck. The invention of card games The first card game in the world was organized in China more than a hundred years ago. At that time, money or plates were used as cards for the game. In the present world, cards can be played by four people. Gradually, this game spread to India and the cards were named according to their power, such as King and Queen. Currently, this game has become so popular that it can also be played on mobile and computers.

![Screenshot_2026-04-19-17-24-36-964_com.BS_Pias.twentynine.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYdU3ThWgKaVUqFfsaAJoM91HEwZsM2Y39N6GttuzUNh3/Screenshot_2026-04-19-17-24-36-964_com.BS_Pias.twentynine.jpg)



They are earning a lot of money by inventing these games, a part of which the government will get as tax. Companies from different countries including the United States and Canada are inventing different types of games. It takes a lot of money to invent a game.This game is played by people from different parts of the country and is very enjoyable to play.If you like it, then definitely watch the full video.

body.title: The Sims4 Small-town life
body.body: I've been playing this game since The Sims 1 came out—the graphics were totally flat. I took some screenshots from my latest playthrough. The problem with The Sims is that there aren't any activities to explore, so you have to make them up yourself to keep from getting bored in the game. For this character I’m playing, my goal is, first, to fulfill all the aspirations in the game; second, to complete all the achievements; and third, to pursue all the careers. Of course, many of these get accomplished on their own as you work on others.\n\n
/> This is your town, a medieval village where you can sell your farm products. There are contests to choose the best cow, sheep, or llama
/> He gets up in the morning, plays a little piano, and then practices some moves with the ball 😅

/> She feeds the chickens and sings to the plants so they'll grow big and healthy😂 My Sim now has to advance in their career as a chef, which means they have to prepare several high-quality meals and host dinner parties. So they're currently cooking day and night.
/> Next up is washing the dishes—that's the worst part
/> I notice your partner has put on a few pounds, but they're happy that way, so for now I won't make them give up their girlfriend's delicious meals

/> Like in any small town, people interact a lot with their neighbors, so it’s very common to find them at the tavern chatting while they work on their skills. So I had my Sim practice embroidery, and she’s already leveled up a few times.
/> Luego tuvo que ir al pueblo a comprar algunos productos locales para sus nuevas recetas
/> And lastly, she teaches piano lessons

/>

I discovered this community thanks to @borjan

Thanks for reading. See you later.

Miren ese hermoso ritmo de hoy. Eso es lo que más quiero resaltar de este día de entrenamiento.


Por lo general, logro hacer los mejores tiempos cuando participo en carreras oficiales o entreno acompañado de otros corredores. Supongo que se debe a la motivación extra que me genera el correr junto a personas con la misma meta que yo. Sin embargo, correr solo, cosa que hago casi siempre, resulta más difícil por el hecho de que la motivación proviene únicamente de uno mismo, y muchas veces la mente juega en contra. 


Pero hoy no fue el caso. Me levanté con ganas de mejorar el ritmo promedio de esta semana, el cual estaba en 5:15. Por eso salí bastante temprano, un minuto antes de las 7 am. El clima estaba muy fresco, nublado y sin rastro del sol por ningún lado. Además, al ser domingo las calles estaban totalmente despejadas, tal y como pueden ver en las fotografías que coloqué en esta publicación.


Todo eso se juntó para poder correr libremente y sin ningún problema. El kilómetro más duro fue el último, porque la ruta es una subida y porque ya el agotamiento por los km pasados era evidente. Pero no me detuve. La mente me decía que parara, pero la obligué a callar. Logré un ritmo promedio de 5:01, muy pero muy positivo e increíble para mí.


Este es el día 17 consecutivo que tengo trotando y sigo trabajando en mi respiración. Cuando voy corriendo y siento que la respiración se acelera, entonces bajo un poco la velocidad hasta recuperar el aliento y poder volver a aumentar el ritmo. Y me ha funcionado muy bien. Seguimos sumando kilómetros de vida y felicidad para #hiverun.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmdsMVdSHnho1Uqw8Nu3UaGUv9CzAttesTt5cZrRGEx5sL/separadores_55.png  
 
English

Look at that great pace today. That’s what I want to highlight most about this training session.


I usually manage to achieve my best times when I participate in official races or train alongside other runners. I suppose it’s because of the extra motivation I get from running with people who share the same goal as me. However, running alone—which I do almost all the time—is more difficult because the motivation comes solely from within, and often my mind works against me. 


But today wasn’t like that. I woke up eager to improve this week’s average pace, which was 5:15. That’s why I headed out pretty early, a minute before 7 a.m. The weather was very cool, cloudy, and there was no sign of the sun anywhere. Plus, since it was Sunday, the streets were completely empty, just as you can see in the photos I included in this post.


All of that came together so I could run freely and without any problems. The hardest kilometer was the last one, because the route is an uphill climb and because the exhaustion from the previous kilometers was already evident. But I didn’t stop. My mind was telling me to stop, but I forced it to be quiet. I achieved an average pace of 5:01, which is very, very positive and incredible for me.


This is my 17th consecutive day of running, and I’m still working on my breathing. When I’m running and I feel my breathing speed up, I slow down a bit until I catch my breath and can pick up the pace again. And it’s worked really well for me. We keep adding kilometers of life and happiness to #hiverun.

body.title: [Literature] Johann Gottlieb Fichte:  The Vocation of the Scholar #16/24
body.body:
If a question should arise as to the perfection or imperfection of a state of society arranged on the principles which we have already propounded, (and every society does so arrange itself by the natural tendencies of man, without foreign guidance, as was shown in our inquiry into the origin of society), if, I say, such a question should arise, the answer to it would pre-suppose the solution of the following query: “Is the development and satisfaction of allthe wants of man, and indeed the harmoniousdevelopment and satisfaction of them all, provided for in the given state of society?” Is this provided for, then the society, as a society, is perfect; that is, not that it has attained its final purpose, which as we have previously shown is impossible; but that it is so arranged that it must of necessity continually approximate thereto: is this not provided for, then society may indeed by some happy chance be impelled forward in the way of culture; but that cannot be calculated on with certainty, for it may with as much probability be carried by some unlucky occurrence in the opposite direction.

A provision for the harmonious development of all the faculties of man pre-supposes an acquaintance with them all, a knowledge of all his tendencies and w r ants, a complete survey of his whole being. But this perfect knowledge of human nature is itself founded on a faculty which must be developed; for there is certainly an impulse in man to know, and particularly to know that which affects himself. The development of this faculty, however, demands all the time and energy of a man: if there be any want common to mankind which urgently requires that a particular class be set aside for its satisfaction, it is this.

The mere knowledge, however, of the faculties and wants of man, without an acquaintance with the means of developing and satisfying them, would be not only a most sorrowful and discouraging, but also a vain and perfectly useless, acquirement. He acts a most unfriendly part towards me, who points out to me my defects without at the same time showing me the means [of?] supplying them; who raises me to the feeling of my wants without enabling me to satisfy them. Would that he had rather left me in brutish ignorance! In short, this would not be such knowledge as society requires, and for which a particular class of men is needed, to whom the possession of it may be committed; for this knowledge does not aim at the perfection of the species, and through that perfection at its harmonious combination, as it ought to do: hence to this knowledge of wantsthere must be added a knowledge of the means by which they may be satisfied;and this knowledge properly devolves upon the same class, because the one cannot be complete, and still less can it be active and living, without the other. Knowledge of the first kind is founded on the principles of Pure Reason, and is philosophical;that of the second, partly on Experience, and is in so far philosophico-historical;not merely historical, for I must connect the purposes which can only be recognised philosophically, with their appropriate objects revealed in Experience, in order to be able to recognise the latter as the means to the attainment of the former.

If, however, this knowledge is to become useful to society, it is not sufficient to ascertain what faculties belong essentially to man, and through what means they may be developed; such knowledge would still remain quite unproductive. It must proceed a step farther, in order to secure the wished-for benefits: we must also know on what particular grade of cultivation the society to which we belong stands at a particular point of time; to what particular stage it has next to ascend, and what are the means at its command for that purpose. Now on the grounds of Reason alone; on the supposition of Experience in the abstract, but prior to all actual Experience, we can calculate the direction which human progress must take; we can declare approximately the particular steps by which it must pass to the attainment of a definite stage of cultivation; but to declare the particular step on which it actually stands at a given point of time is impossible for Reason alone; for this, Experience must be questioned, the events of the past must be examined, but with an eye purified by philosophy; we must look around us, and consider our contemporaries. This last part of the knowledge needful to society is thus purely historical.

body.title: Learn Creative Coding (#39) - Raymarching: Boolean Operations and Morphing
body.body:
usually works. The raymarcher just needs the distance to be a reasonable underestimate of the true distance -- as long as it never reports a distance that's *longer* than the real distance, it won't step through surfaces. Most of these operations maintain that property approximately. When they don't (large deformations, aggressive displacement), the safety factor (`t += d * 0.7` instead of `t += d`) compensates.

If you're doing precise modeling (like 3D printing from SDFs), exactness matters and you'd need more careful formulations. For creative coding and real-time rendering, the approximations are fine. You'll see artifacts before you see math errors, and artifacts are fixable with more iterations or smaller steps.

## Where this leads

We've added a massive toolkit today. Boolean operations let you build complex shapes from simple primitives. Smooth booleans let you sculpt organic forms. Morphing lets you animate between any two shapes. Repetition creates structure from nothing. Deformations -- twist, bend, displacement -- add life and detail to static geometry.

In the next episodes we'll add realistic materials and lighting -- specular highlights, shadows that are actually computed by marching a second ray toward the light, and ambient occlusion. The geometry vocabulary we built today combined with proper lighting will let us create scenes that look genuinely photorealistic, all from a fragment shader.

And later, fractals. The Mandelbrot and Julia sets, rendered in 3D via raymarching. Those are essentially infinitely detailed SDFs -- the same marching algorithm, just with a distance estimator derived from fractal math. The code structure stays identical. The visuals become... something else entirely :-)

## 't Komt erop neer...

- Boolean union: `min(d1, d2)` -- both shapes visible, closest surface wins
- Boolean intersection: `max(d1, d2)` -- only the overlapping volume of both shapes survives
- Boolean subtraction: `max(d1, -d2)` -- negate the second SDF to carve it out of the first
- Smooth minimum (`smin`): blends shapes with an organic fillet controlled by parameter `k`. Works identically in 2D and 3D
- Morphing: `mix(sdf1, sdf2, t)` -- linearly interpolate between two distance fields to smoothly transform one shape into another
- Domain repetition: `mod(p + half, spacing) - half` creates infinite copies of an object. Clamp the cell index for finite grids
- Twist deformation: rotate the XZ plane by an angle proportional to Y position. Straight objects become twisted columns
- Bend deformation: rotate XY based on X position to curve straight objects into arcs
- Displacement: add noise or sine patterns directly to the SDF output for surface detail
- Space deformations (twist, bend) may break exact distance guarantees -- use a safety factor (`t += d * 0.7`) for reliable raymarching

Sallukes! Thanks for reading.

X

body.title: Kalimantan Provincial pavilion
body.body:
Greetings everyone 
Thank you Indonesia Hive community. The Kalimantan Provincial pavilion was one of the place I visited while walking around Taman Mini Indonesia Indah some time ago.


![IMG20260109111644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23z7DmxG5rmFmEvPvffDTcjh4sebzbfTyCy9zda93Q3NNf14MQo4k39tobZjqYAWZ7y7d.jpg)


Kalimantan pavilion, such as West Kalimantan, North Kalimantan, South Kalimantan, and East Kalimantan. Display replicas of traditional houses that are beautiful in terms of architecture but also have philosophical meaning about the lives of the people. 

Traditional houses in Kalimantan are generally raised off the ground, knows as still houses. These houses are built on stilts, ranging in height from 2 to 4 meters. Their purpose is to prevent flooding. 


![IMG20260109111825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23tmB3NzfjJBbdB3tcdmjKqZpmiCRBfmUPsezvzZYHgwweoxnioMZ7gowDF4JmsWhsD3c.jpg)


The building are elongated and can accommodate many families. The building material used is Ulin wood, a high-quality wood that is resistant to termites. The relatively large island of Kalimantan is home to various indigenous tribe, grounped together and known as the Dayak.

The Kalimantan pavilion at Taman Mini Indonesia ( Indonesian miniature park) features several replicas of traditional buildings with different names for each Province. 

Such as the West Kalimantan Provincial pavilion. The traditional Betang house, or Dayak longhouse and a replica of sultanate's palace. The traditional houses of East Kalimantan is called the Lamin house. This is the common name for Dayak clan.


![IMG20260109112052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23y8sbB1MEDqt2XZK6rTcRXsdYBC17HJ9PEX3EPYBiJ36GzcEBNM32mAB6YjuyQp4NPec.jpg)

![IMG20260109113512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/243qCzXHa8Ke3iWKDrbbvdZCnmQQZoQ88u8ane17eMB9AgcST3KhTp6dThJEypFz18soy.jpg)


![IMG20260109120025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23ycyQJN9rBd1NVUkAbDN2B7TQRnyn3KARHVaF18kuozjhKbXmZ2nvJmZKwg13LGEXFDN.jpg)

![IMG20260109115915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/242DNbjDsUSXz9SHzPDHRiTJy7DZKwoNaX7wiHq9KZASDugs3p3eRu54KSoY8e1oTfZXT.jpg)



A Lamin can accommodate between 10 and 30 families and the building can be 100 to 150 meters long. The layout of a Lamin house is usually divided into two or three sections, running lengthwise. A veranda is used for gatherings and ceremonies and a row of rooms for the family. 


![IMG20260109113617.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23yTcqQpyrJgiFfbrrJWKGDYFVSooUUEXnsLHCxDR81CC13dekz9uXvUjfJRXDE1oAVpS.jpg)

![IMG20260109111919.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23x1DEK4yLWVmLRZMY9mvXH4p4uGxoe88TMNVMN4BgtMQQTtWAWDwcT2gSmoTgUGkqZYG.jpg)


Each with it's own kitchen, behind these rooms, there is a rear veranda with it's own staircase. There is only one front staircase. In Lamin buildings, there are usually carving that are very typical of the Dayak style. Where animals such as crocodiles, tigers, bird, fish and others are a source of inspiration.



![IMG20260109112141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23ywsGNaDuEN6sPvpTsKtLjSAvi6BWcMim4YjThskCZwezc3Ey2Y8Jg8EC1z92WW1fZNX.jpg)


In south Kalimantan, traditional houses such as the Banjar traditional house have shield-shaped roofs with steep pitches to allow tainwater to drain quiqky. The gajah menyusu traditional house resembles and elephant's horn. The ornaments used are plant motifs.


![IMG20260109114256.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/2423xB4ixXmfa88ZDXqmwTzaZPsZC1FS5x8Ebb7jswbNcLgiw5ReyMSh85bxPFYSDKPYb.jpg)

![IMG20260109114241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23wqkduNf6iM23H9TCyRCk9WEEiYm7jdVVhhmvpzVfdjgpzEghf9YEwTT6VYFFTnBWqRy.jpg)



This is a replica of the traditional Dahor house from East Kalimantan. It is a stilt- built structure Made from Ulin wood, with a shingle roof,and plank floors and Walls. The building fuctions as a meeting room and dining room. 


![IMG20260109113739.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23xVH6GU6AiNyBZRme8TzXBCQTKHaLBwq1L2n6xwia4kpesvneZjcpFSjKezyV8ACd1xH.jpg)

![IMG20260109113839.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/244obEnGVhKtNNNfc3QPUY18NqiXL5pB4t2xG54iKkVWdoQnnCy8drxuFhVnw4ySbJfU8.jpg)

Thank you and have a happy day.

### Solutions to Episode 3 Exercises

**Exercise 1 -- Wireshark HTTP vs HTTPS comparison:**

The HTTP capture shows everything in plaintext: the POST request body containing `username=admin&password=password`, all response headers, the full HTML body. The HTTPS capture shows: the TLS handshake (Client Hello with SNI showing the domain name, Server Hello with certificate), then encrypted Application Data blocks. You can see the domain name (via SNI), the certificate details, and the data volume -- but NOT the URL path, headers, body, or any content.

The key insight: HTTPS protects content and credentials from network observers, but still leaks metadata -- which server you're connecting to, when, and how much data flows.

        s.settimeout(3)

Output (abbreviated):
```

Port 22: SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_4.7p1 Debian-8ubuntu1
Port 25: 220 metasploitable.localdomain ESMTP Postfix (Ubuntu)
Port 80: HTTP/1.1 200 OK...Server: Apache/2.2.8 (Ubuntu)...
```

The key insight: most services volunteer their exact name and version on connect. This is a design decision from a friendlier internet era -- and it hands attackers their CVE search terms on a silver platter.

**Exercise 3 -- DNS recon of hive.blog:**

Results vary over time, but a typical dig shows: A records pointing to Hetzner/OVH servers, MX records revealing Google Workspace (if Gmail-based), NS records showing the DNS provider, and TXT records containing SPF rules (which IPs can send email as @hive.blog), DKIM verification, and DMARC policy. This reveals: their hosting provider, email infrastructure, and whether they enforce strict email authentication.

The key insight: DNS is the most information-dense passive recon source. A single `dig ANY` command reveals hosting, email, CDN, security posture, and sometimes internal naming conventions.
