and in this episode, I feature for the first episode our homie named **Carlos Zapanta**. He came back after he stopped skating for 10 years, and today I just wanted to share with you how he perfectly landed his **Ollie Drop** over with one deck. 

I think this is the best trick he has done so far after he came back. He landed an Ollie Drop over with one deck, and that is pretty amazing. What he did is not really hard because I also did that so many times before. I also tried what he did, but after five tries, I never landed, not even once. I really don't know why, because I'm not really scared to do that trick, maybe not that day. 

## Tricks Highlights
***

When he told me that he wanted to land an **Ollie drop** over with one deck. I already knew that it was not going to be so easy to do that trick, and I was right.

I can't remember how many times he failed before he perfectly landed his Ollie Drop over with one deck. But I made at least three busted photo action sequences of his trick. 

On this attempt, he really failed to land his **Ollie Drop** over with one deck because the board didn't even pop over the deck. I understand why he failed to land his Ollie Drop on his first attempt. I think he just calculated first how high that thing that is why he just jumped on the deck without his board.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWm2THEs6pwRAPHVseNVccGEZKsVGorCVDHKJpsH3AgKA/highlights.jpg)

On his second attempt, he failed to land his **Ollie Drop** over with one deck again, but this time he Ollied over the one deck together with his board. But unfortunately, his board hit the deck, which is why he fell to his board. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ51UA1x8eXifpSSp3JXN7XU96JPd23nAuctLEsP8tUfS/highlights_2.jpg)

It looks like he popped his **Ollie** really high, but sadly, it's not enough, he hit the deck again and fell to his board again. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQvZQ5KEMzNEUNridrDvntqxmyAZHaULbG5tnGJRw97r/highlights_3.jpg)

On this attempt, I really don't know if he really landed his **Ollie Drop** over with one deck. But something good happened, he perfectly landed his Ollie Drop over with one deck, and that is really amazing. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYRus2v27m7apUEFcagZteAugwPnrRSGCawh6L9z5fcaV/highlights_4.jpg)

<center>

I also made a GIF format to see how **Carlos Zapanta** landed his trick.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSdptMZCVbbgAUSuukMfcFmeuVomhy6nipfQRFySwQeCo/gif.gif)

***

P.S.: I've been playing skateboarding since 2005 and started filming and editing in 2011. On the **TWS** skate video, you'll find a random of tricks and behind skateboarding, we are not pro skaters we just skate for fun and I really love this.

title.body:

<center>

![BBbxoswetPkifFOH_faceu_0_20191102111452744.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/kokoroyin/images/BBbxoswetPkifFOH_faceu_0_20191102111452744/BBbxoswetPkifFOH_faceu_0_20191102111452744.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

昨天见了一个老朋友，他来天津参加马拉松比赛，顺便来见个面吃个饭，上次和他见面是在两年前的漫展上，那时候我们之间的关系比较微妙复杂，我也因为自卑和胆怯一直躲避，没有和他一起吃饭，后面才知道他一直耿耿于怀这件事，这次我决定不能再逃避了，而且我们之间的关系已经恢复如初了（我认为！），况且，这也有可能是我们最后一次见面了。

其实六年来我们也没有见过几次，故事开始还要从大一说起，他是我高中同学的大学同学，听说他也是二次元，刷了当时很火的电影《天气之子》很多遍，冲动和好奇驱使我加了他的好友，我们很有共同话题，他讲话也很有意思，渐渐的我们几乎每天都聊很久，有种别样的情感正在萌芽。后来，他来我的大学找我了，但他表明我们不能在一起，异地会很艰难。我悲痛欲绝，那个年纪的我满是冲动和恋爱脑，从来没想过其他因素会怎样阻碍我们，一心只想和他在一起。但后来，可能是我的死缠烂打，也可能是他的优柔寡断，我们还是一直在保持联系，直到大学毕业。由于一次聊到一件小事，我认为他真的是一点都不在意我，于是决定和他彻底断绝联系，他可能也意识到事情的不对，后来也把我拉黑了，直到三年前我考上研，他才把我的联系方式加了回来，其实我一直都没有拉黑他，因为那个时候我已经做出决定了，删不删好友对我已经不再重要了。后面他应该也走出来了，我们又回到了最初的关系，只是不再保持频繁的联系了，就像普通朋友一样，直到现在。

昨晚他问我恨他吗？内心os：恨的话我就不会出来吃饭了吧！我不恨，我是个自愈能力很强的人，小时候喜欢过很多男生，但从来没有被接受过，于是我的内心变得很强大，不再在意最后的结果，只专注于喜欢一个人时所带来的快乐，也可能正因如此，我养成了现在回避性依恋的性格，抵触于开始一段双向奔赴的感情，我认为这很恶心（）...

他还说：\

我以玩笑话认真的回答了这个问题，现在的我已经不是当初幼稚的小孩子了，我开始变得现实，感情不仅仅是冲动，还要权衡利弊，以物质为基础，以长远发展为主，如果当初他借着冲动和我在一起了，即便坚持到现在，我们最后还是会因为工作和异地的原因分手，长痛不如短痛，我们终究只是对方人生中的过客，发挥了各自的作用后就又会重归人海，不过双方也会因此变得更加成熟，成为更好的自己，就让这段经历封存在记忆里成为人生的一部分吧，希望下次见面我们都会成为更厉害的大人！
——以此文纪念我的人生过客：zym同志

---

title.body:
The bible did not talk anything related to reincarnation, which means reincarnation does not exist. People believe that after death, the person comes back to life in another body. Instead, it shows that each person has one life on earth. After this life, a person faces God. The focus is on how we live now, not on returning to live many different lives.

The Bible speaks more about resurrection than reincarnation. Resurrection means that God will raise people from the dead and give them life again. It is not about starting a new life as a different person, but about being brought back by God. This shows that life has a clear beginning, an end, and then a future decided by God.

title.title: Sardine Scam or Delicious Novelty?
title.body:
![20250512_175336~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23wMgyG5xwqWGRwAteYKpLRhAg4Du2EpZZEt8swMTTYDKfXEMPp8f2CBjxDzzDyj2YZVz.jpg)

I buy sardines quite a bit at home. I often eat them for lunch on weekends. They are a good source of protein, calcium and omega 3 fatty acids. They are healthy, easy and I have a brand that I actually like the taste of. 

![20250512_175406~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23uR37Bjqh8EWffJAnRRTDu8JSy5j5aQUSQtxKNstReMi11TsrB5MAD8Gp6BNEHjrgGF7.jpg)

When we were traveling in the Azores we came across a novelty sardines store in the city of Ponta Delgada. I'm pretty sure that its a franchise chain of stores, because I've seen these shops in other parts of Europe, specifically in Mainland Portugal. There is one in the city of Lisbon, if I'm remembering correctly. 

![20250512_175427~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23w2wRdJFTd8WhsTv4YQjWzt3DLkPJvKGRQu1yFWt4RRusn7jmZEA5r4ruGRkVw6r3fNR.jpg)

The store sells an assortment of different sardines and canned seafood products in colorful trendy packaging. They were, of course, being sold for very exorbitant prices as well. It is clearly a store that caters to tourists and is marketed as a novelty gift shop. Sardines and canned fish to bring home from vacation, for friends or family or oneself. I don't get the impression that this is a store that locals frequent often for their regular sardines meals. They are just too expensive to be practical. The shop sells tins of lobster and I think the most expensive even had gold flakes in it. Again, these are very clearly a novelty item. 

![20250512_175359~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23xL59Dvz5WDciYbZ78e5Q6g832ah3asqspLCz8ZNnHeTfsBLuiWHEfsELy2L6jKfqJHD.jpg)

#### Question: At what price tag do sardines become a scam do you think? 

So anyway, I got suckered into buying a tin. The assortment of colorful marketing. How could I resist? I got a bit of sticker shock when I saw how much they were but after humming and hawing about it for a while, and some encouragement from my wife, I decided to just go for it. Give them a go for fun. What the hell. 

I went with the most basic option of simple sardines. I wanted to try the most basic to really get a sense if these were anything better than what I normally buy at the grocery store. They were also the cheapest option.  

![20250512_173007~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23uR1FHLURR2LYLfRRev871z9Q8UvQ1GNPQf48spCu3pegs6MJYWMF6JeUTf18odjUQDS.jpg)

#### So what do you think they cost me? Any guesses?   

![20250512_175421~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/2423zK1hVUCZF3e7spqm7eqr9dz3WkmSoUDXiazMyG9Bbk5n4UbUga1cYg6wdv2NVzJx4.jpg)

Well I paid €15 Euro for one single can of sardines!  

To put that into perspective the sardines that I buy at the grocery store cost $3.99 regular price and $3.29 on sale. 

![1000018059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoeGpgL9sKBix5k3rQuiSau8PCMgxqLdwJxKv5qqn9DBze7Ak5J5vLK8Ja3hHVP9sJv.jpg)

Those are CAD prices also, which is approximately €2.49 to €2.03 euro!

So to reverse the pricing into CAD to make a proper comparison the vacation sardines cost me $24.32 CAD which is 8x more expensive then the grocery store variety!! Or around that I think. 

But look at the fancy packaging they wrapped them in... worth it right??..

![20250511_185706~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23wCBrhRE8JikN2TU3EbApgqCTZL3ejmQpXpVzpxvd7smwWxsKyUfPh17A3vcCjNxEfR5.jpg)

So I ended up eating these for lunch one day on that same trip. It was a way to recoup some of their cost. I didn't need to buy extra food that day at a restaurant. I will admit, they were very good. They weren't fishy at all and I would go as far to say that they were probably the best sardines that I've ever tried. I have probably only tried 3 or 4 different brands and varieties of sardines though, so take that with a grain of salt. Even though they were the best sardines that I've ever had, the enjoyment that I got from them was not 8x more than my normal grocery store variety. For that reason, my final judgement is that these are not worth the hefty price tag and are therefore a scam. Albeit a delicious one. I'd call them a low risk scam overall, but a scam nonetheless. 

![1000018060.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23uFbvofKCQJcNoog4deSzpqBmkZSSY65N1UA8WSNLqNCW822gHhTUSTPsFBev52YhdEH.jpg)

#### What do you think about that price? Are they worth it? Do you think that these sardines are a scam or a fun novelty vacation souvenir? Let me know your thoughts in the comments.

title.title: Recent TikTok Budols (Part 1)
title.body:
![TikTok Budols (Part 1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23vi21QTA9yg6TQBmT71bHfs5mWHMDHNsqZECGcSVEEtYhRDMzDkV6TESm4GaWNnAcZ4b.png)
As a TikTok affiliate, I need to invest in multiple products. I need to purchase items since I do direct selling. In some cases, I do POV-style videos, but it’s not my priority. Although I purchase a lot of items, I’m not guilty since I know that I will use and earn from them. When I buy something, I analyze its demand and flexibility. Personally, I don’t buy an item if I can only film it once. Maybe I could do that once it becomes my bread and butter already. Without further ado, let’s get started.

# Turbo Fan

![IMG_20260414_142047_024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23wqnnq9SGvfuAzjeYNfpWHMhjCCKkm9CP2uhTtriLswzWkPft6fEAbn3RF6F8HwXmUVD.jpg)

I purchased this Turbo Fan for ₱64 only, and I’m glad that it gained sales already. It is a handheld fan where it has up to 100 wind speed levels, is portable, and can last up to 3 hours. Personally, I love it since it matches my expectations. Just don’t expect that it is high quality like other turbo fans, which are double its price. During the live, I was embarrassed since it immediately turned off. I hadn’t charged it for 2 days while promoting it, though.

**BUY HERE**: https://vt.tiktok.com/ZS9LWgPGnCC5B-Mjst2/

# Desk Fan

![IMG_20260414_142035_910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23z7C1KRCTKnHkQY9U1ZjGPZBL5iU5thJAo62EdgxjDmjPNsDS5a8qGkeRKk6vwHQKW1H.jpg)

So far, this is the product where I didn’t regret anything. It is a desk fan that you can plug into your laptop, power bank, or charging brick. I don’t recommend plugging it into a charging brick, especially if it has high watts. Moreover, it is not loud compared to other fans, and you don’t need to charge it. It exceeds my expectations, and I see demand since it also gained me sales. If you are WFH or a student who needs extra air for productivity, you might consider it. It is a refundable sample, and I already met the seller’s criteria. I’ll just wait for it to be settled, and I’ll get a refund on what I purchased.

**BUY HERE**: https://vt.tiktok.com/ZS9LWgQnwjjHk-LimfE/

# Youmei Ballpen

![IMG_20260414_142035_910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23z7C1KRCTKnHkQY9U1ZjGPZBL5iU5thJAo62EdgxjDmjPNsDS5a8qGkeRKk6vwHQKW1H.jpg)

I purchased this pen since it’s expensive if you buy it outside. Imagine buying a single piece for ₱15.00, while you can get it for at least ₱60.00 if you buy it in a box. It’s 12 pieces per box, so it means that it’s roughly ₱5.00 per piece if you do the math. I love this pen since it has gel ink with a 0.5 mm tip, and it’s smudge-proof. I can’t promise that it’s quick-drying, but its quality is top-notch.

**BUY HERE**: https://vt.tiktok.com/ZS9LWgqs34eSu-teEAO/

# Mini Umbrella

![IMG_20260419_115528_112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23wqgbDyyC4ydSrzP9LNtRvYBdqnS1f2PnDWuD1cAgfXc1zSvr6xZudHnQyrphq6fdqL3.jpg)

After getting my ₱100 voucher from TikTok live tasks, I decided to buy this mini umbrella. I thought about purchasing others, but I ended up buying it. I haven’t tried it yet, but I bought it since I need a portable umbrella. You know, it’s hard to bring a big umbrella, especially if you only have a small bag. I know I’m going to film multiple videos with this umbrella, so I’m excited about it.

**BUY HERE**: https://vt.tiktok.com/ZS9LWgWBfDLBy-1jQ6X/

Thank you for reading. You might check out those links if you want to buy. This will help motivate me further in being an affiliate. I'm planning to purchase multiple products again, but I think I could do it next week.

---

---

<center>**Hello everyone and welcome back to my blog.**</center>

---
#

Sakai had unfinished business near the place where he fought and earned Tadayori's armor. He set off for the next mission, **\

**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTe6cuihbk3SMtkTAbmb2nH3YBuW8rjSgv55G4T1Pxbn/snapshot.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRDACXMfxobCtfEnSbbbWV4y26irUbw9JsJcMtQ8RL1pV/snapshot_1.png)

On the way to my destination, I faced some enemy soldiers. They were looting a house when I attacked them. This group was powerful as they had many different weapons and soldiers. But they couldn't stop me because I had become an legendary archer. 😁 I killed all of them from a distance with my bow and arrow.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZDbgaSPHN9WCdXnXERqkKbeqVhmnAEoKXt2waE5uUBiC/snapshot_2.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcdPMehPktyyYY4752vQoWXewSrzHfmgSx1yYuxS9ZHnJ/snapshot_3.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUkimYUFRpoMn91b4Wc4sjohWqJnBkvMm4sskmmHXYejj/snapshot_4.png)

After the fight, I reached my destination. You all must remember the fort from where I saved Taka, Yuna's brother. I saw many more innocent villagers were captured inside that fort. So the relatives of those people had decided to fight with the Mongols and save their family. But it was too risky for them. So Sakai decided to help those poor people.

Hola a todos Es un gusto saludarlos nuevamente. En esta oportunidad, me siento muy emocionada de unirme a la semana 314 del Hive Open Mic para compartir con toda la comunidad un verdadero clásico del repertorio llanero venezolano: \

, una obra del maestro Eladio Tarife. 

Para esta interpretación, he decidido trabajar en la tonalidad de Re mayor, buscando capturar esa esencia nostálgica y vibrante que caracteriza a esta canción que rinde tributo a los paisajes y al sentimiento de la tierra llanera. Como siempre, es un honor contar con el respaldo musical del Maestro Ramón, quien con su maestría en el cuatro venezolano aporta el ritmo y la armonía perfecta para darle vida a esta pieza tan significativa para nuestra cultura. 

Grabar este tema ha sido una experiencia maravillosa, ya que \

no es solo una canción, sino un himno nos invita a valorar la belleza de lo nuestro. Espero que disfruten de esta versión tanto como yo disfruté grabándola para ustedes la música es un lenguaje universal que nos permite unirnos semana tras semana en este espacio de creatividad y talento. body.title: MY MOTIVATION WHEN IT SEEMS EVERYTHING IS FALLING APART
body.body:
Hello everyone your welcome to my blog 


There are so many uncertainties in life and just as people say life is not balanced and a lot of people are going through a lot in different aspects of their life and the struggle keeps getting worst and harder as the day goes on. The economic situation of the country is really taking it’s toll on so many people are in the society so much. Yet we wake up everyday and go out into the world trying to keep our heads high and invest our life into things that we value in the life.

why do we still go out each day and try to do more despite the fact that life throws so many bad times at us most of the times, some times things go according to plan and sometimes things don’t go as planned. And sometimes things will go so well that it seems to good to be true ,you might in a position where you want a promotion and you will go for the examinations and you get promoted and you celebrate your small wins. And you get compliments for the for passing the interview for your promotion this gives you a different kind of joy and happiness.

But then again life happens again the next minute after getting the promotion you get happy and the next minute life throws something disturbing at you again and its like you going from level one to zero again. The struggle continuous relentlessly like it never stopped , even with everything happening we decide to still push on and face head on and stand strong .

From my personal experience I have battled with financial breakdowns in the last one year and it was indeed not a very fun experience as a graduate that freshly left school and I have not gotten a job then and although that year I struggled with finance .So a lot of bad things happened a lot through the year. But the next day things got better I got a good job and I’m in a better place now. I celebrated my small wins.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today 😊

When you join the trail you can set your trail vote to what ever you want. Even if you set the up vote to 0.01. Imagine if we had 1,000 people in the trail that would be 10.00 to the post. Fantastic stuff. A little difference can end up making a giant difference to a Hiver.

That being said, we do have 442 members, I know not all are active, some have passed, but the majority of use are still here.

Imagine if we could get 100 people doing just 1 blog post about the curation trail. Do you think the membership would go up quickly?

Give it a shot, the more, the better for everyone.

And if you are following the trail please support our witness. @thebbhproject. 

## DRIP DAY 

Saturdays are Drip Day. That means it is/was drip day. Now if you are not a regular reader of mine you are wondering what is drip day.

I run a income token and tipping bot all in one. The token is BBH. Every Saturday I payout the people holding BBH tokens. Passive income if you like. I like to call it a 'drip' of a token(s) to the people that own BBH tokens. And unlike some all you have to do is own it. No staking, no nothing.

If you own 10 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive.
If you own 1,000 or more BBH tokens you get a drip of swap.hive and TOOFUCKEH.
If you own 5,000 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive and the PIMP token, TOOFUCKEH, GLITTER and CTP Tokens.
If you own 10,000 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive, PIMP, TOOFUCKEH, GLITTER, CTP, and LEO tokens.

If you stake 20,000 or more BBHO tokens you get a drip of swap.btc, and ALIVE tokens
If you stake 5,000 or more BBHO tokens you got a drip of ALIVE tokens.

All just for owning BBH. There are two ways you can get BBH. First you can buy them from the open market. I use TribalDex myself.

Or they can be tipped to you. The great part about BBH tipping is that when you tip a token to someone else you do not loose any of your own. There is a central pool that supplies them.

And a third way to get BBH would be people gift them to you. There was an update to the tipping bot. If you now tip 1 BBH you get 1 BBH also. How facking awesome is that.

And now a forth way to get BBH with the BBH Miner.

The goal is to have 1 BBH = 1 Satoshi. I do a bit of math and get the price. body.title: An Unplanned 11-Hour Long Distance Walking Adventure with My Best Friend in Bulacan, Philippines
body.body:
![collage.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/AJmu1tDcpCi7b7RNbhL6BmzF8tZeL6jQ7N2qyQ7dg2VgtSSKfR4rgG1UgUHYjBJ.jpeg)

**Hello Hive Fam!** I hope you’re all doing well and having a wonderful Sunday. May your day be filled with positivity, good health, and joyful moments.

![willowbend.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23xL92oe7qa92f2owjNLAVWrrCS41BNRBn8nTthfypvW6q7GW9K4qBsBCzEY3hxVDDKbN.jpeg)

![willowbend2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23xL9NyiNHqbwUBtPR9JF3aWpR2UgzHCDJwHQqWWczWuLiDDQcsRDg5d61h5SQL5EVZpZ.jpeg)

Last Friday, my best friend and I decided to take on a challenge; though honestly, it wasn’t planned at all. We just wanted something adventurous and fitness-focused, so we thought: why not go for a **pure long-distance walk**?

![pandi.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23vsfjbp1Ey25i1cBAsiFEsyDtzcbFM1BDpQdccxU1jKRuRj4DYHrt9ThimBrrFwnBv8G.jpeg)

![pandi2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/245n9XrhJ3mofhntdt8FhtC1tZuBKsnpK7SJPqyq5AcAsjSbVXhsiRP7rn1WYhLCRNQSN.jpeg)

![pandi3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23wgN3XSebnB6NJmWMqy7JNsQECPMXpnwmAGKa3VgR7GyVGHs4yY6MieM2XP62Z6faiZ7.jpeg)

From our subdivision in **Pandi, Bulacan**, we set out toward **Poblacion, Sta. Maria, Bulacan**. What started as a spontaneous idea quickly turned into one of the most memorable fitness journeys we’ve ever had.

![pandi4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23wMYZpdrQnxyh1nNGC5fk3odrN72NYRhq5zwjyQpCcfT3FyoRVMFVzuHAbZkofKwmUGu.jpeg)

![pandi5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23vsfZyxPS6UXGNa2hV3NmNe2mGebu7mR4MNwqpoLwamsK9EVLjp52By3uPTrJL9SDo6R.jpeg)

![pandi6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/244ooZbhGLBc1i3D18MMKHWo8mA2HSfzVn1UeRyZr1ryGJdaniyYQntt3z812mtoymrH3.jpeg)

**Duration:** It took us about 4 hours to reach our destination.
**Breaks:** We allowed ourselves short 5-minute rests here and there.
**Photos:** Along the way, we snapped random shots to capture the beauty of the journey.
**Return:** After enjoying Sta. Maria, we walked all the way back home. Including breaks and merienda, the entire trip lasted around 11 hours.

![pandi7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/245cj9hcoMpL2v9X2hnS2SX8yWg2ZNTUpQ6K7atfdsZWFHKUtrnpZHTtTibFsT1VH3KA4.jpeg)

![pandi8.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23wCLUBEu7naBS2VSNQpwqBaC5gQnDSLqoVwy8KshbTMuGdPmgMixm2TK6TKA7EqMTPt2.jpeg)

***No shortcuts, no rides; just us, the open road, and determination…***

![manggahan.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23wCQPhSsPUGcz3Qo5UPMxPcwG6n9d27DYwbA2r4umvhKZh4p4oDYJjXMc8RQ8mFrZbmh.jpeg)

![manggahan2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/242DSc3o8ZQJwRTGvdvYkhYJ7BwM58n2LRbJYT3LWrABXFVbEYqWePTug8rjtf3v3pkKn.jpeg)

![manggahan3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/243MFkte4JLkxxmceyUeqraB8gMQXt4fqXGzHyzVkiVa475wRZMSktvoEreb7N57oK54u.jpeg)

It was undeniably tiresome, but at the same time incredibly fulfilling. Our legs felt the strain, yet our spirits soared. The walk tested our endurance, strengthened our friendship, and reminded us that sometimes the best adventures are the ones you don’t plan.

![alfamart gabi.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23y8yxWE6aRMYQTd31NsKcRuZ8kbqJCkVZc1qkEAScENh11yCybumP399B4ggvFeUj4G2.jpeg)

![alfamart gabi2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23xybBnVvCrkK4VvvLVETDWVpuAJg1o5zoRBBZUcrRXkeKXtjndBNMBShNsS1BjATog5J.jpeg)

**Thank you so much, Hive Fam, for joining me in reliving this long-distance walking adventure.** Your support means the world, and I look forward to sharing more stories with you soon. Stay active, stay adventurous, and keep spreading positivity! 💖

body.title: Воднева революція без «платинового» цінника: як один винахід може змінити наш рух
body.body:
>Привіт!
Знаєте, я завжди скептично ставився до прогнозів про «світле майбутнє на чистому паливі». Щоразу, коли я читав про водневі авто, моя внутрішня жаба починала голосно квакати, підраховуючи вартість платини, яка потрібна для того, щоб ця залізна колісниця взагалі зрушила з місця. Платина — це круто для обручок, але як каталізатор для масового транспорту? Ну, це як намагатися побудувати бюджетну малолітражку, інкрустовану діамантами. Але нещодавно я натрапив на новину, яка змусила мене переглянути свій песимізм і навіть відчути легкий азарт мисливця за технологіями.

>Вчені нарешті зробили те, що раніше здавалося алхімією навпаки: вони розробили каталізатор, який взагалі не містить платини, але при цьому справляється з розщепленням водню не гірше за цей дорогоцінний метал. Коли я вперше про це прочитав, я подумав: «Знову чергова лабораторна іграшка, яка ніколи не вийде в серію». Проте, вчитавшись у деталі, я зрозумів — ми на порозі справжнього тектонічного зсуву в енергетиці.

>Source
Команда дослідників під керівництвом Ган Ву створила новий енергоефективний каталізатор, використовуючи два фосфіди для розділення водню з води. Зображення зліва показує водяний електролізер з аніонною мембраною з сухим катодом, а зображення зверху

>Давайте будемо чесними: водень — це ідеальне паливо. Він не димить, не смердить і після згоряння залишає лише чисту воду. Але була одна величезна «але». Весь цей процес тримався на вузькому горлечку рідкісних металів. Виходить парадокс: ми хочемо врятувати планету від екологічної катастрофи, але для цього нам потрібно перекопати половину земної кулі в пошуках платини. Це все одно що лікувати головний біль гільйотиною. Новий підхід базується на використанні доступніших матеріалів, які в рази дешевші та легші у видобутку. Я уявляю, як зараз нервово курять у сторонці власники платинових копалень, адже їхня монополія на «зелене майбутнє» щойно дала тріщину.

>Коли я заглибився в технічні моменти, мене вразила елегантність рішення. Це не просто заміна одного шматка металу іншим. Це переосмислення структури на атомному рівні. Дивлячись на те, як динамічно розвиваються ці технології, я мимоволі згадую перші мобільні телефони-цеглини. Хто тоді міг подумати, що через двадцять років у кожного в кишені буде суперкомп'ютер? Так само і з воднем. Зараз ми дивимося на ці складні установки як на щось екзотичне, але завтра такий каталізатор може стояти в системі опалення вашого будинку або в двигуні вантажівки, що везе продукти до магазину під вікном.

>Мене часто запитують: «Слухай, а навіщо нам взагалі водень, якщо є електрокари на акумуляторах?». Питання слушне, і я теж про це думав. Але спробуйте зарядити величезну фуру або літак від розетки. Вам знадобиться акумулятор розміром з саму фуру, який заряджатиметься тиждень. Водень — це енергія високої щільності. Це свобода. І саме відсутність потреби в платині робить цю свободу доступною не лише для мільярдерів з Кремнієвої долини, а й для звичайних людей. Це демократизація технології, і це саме те, що мене найбільше захоплює.

>Звісно, я не наївний хлопчик і розумію, що шлях від лабораторного зразка до заправки на трасі Київ-Чоп довгий і тернистий. Потрібна інфраструктура, потрібна політична воля, потрібні інвестиції. Але головний бар'єр — ціна входу — щойно впала. Коли я роздумую про це, мені стає трохи спокійніше за майбутнє моїх дітей. Вони, можливо, вже й не знатимуть, як це — стояти в хмарі сизого диму від старого дизеля.

>Зараз ми бачимо класичну боротьбу старого з новим. Нафтові гіганти, звісно, не здадуться без бою, але наука — штука вперта. Якщо можна отримати ту саму енергію дешевше і чистіше, ринок рано чи пізно зробить свій вибір. Я особисто вже готовий проміняти рев двигуна внутрішнього згоряння на тихе шипіння водневого елемента, якщо це означатиме, що ми перестанемо спалювати власну планету заради комфорту.

>Цей винахід — не просто рядок у науковому журналі. Це маніфест людського інтелекту, який каже: «Ми знайдемо вихід». І знаєте, в такі моменти я відчуваю гордість. Ми нарешті вчимося співпрацювати з природою, а не просто грабувати її запаси. Платина залишається в ювелірних магазинах, а водень виходить на велику дорогу.

>Що ви думаєте про це? Чи вірите ви, що водень зможе витіснити літієві батареї, чи це просто ще одна красива казка від вчених? Мені справді цікаво почути ваші думки, бо, як на мене, ми з вами є свідками початку кінця ери викопного палива. Майбутнє вже дихає нам у потилицю, і воно пахне не бензином, а свіжістю після дощу.

body.title: [WE-305] Missing The Time When Life Was Just All About Climbing The Tree and Hiding on The Roof.
body.body: > ![1000034757.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EpCCLvoYPysW5H9ursuroNdT7sKV9rAm3iXLpjjyhjJMQJ2YAvufjW5nZAgNX6nmQrL.png) I never even thought back then, that I will miss being a kid because of how much I want to grow faster so that I can finally escape home and live on my own. Being a kid as I am who doesn't know much how to be an adult, I have a lot of determination then and expectation that once I live on my own, my life will get better, my courage back then is at max too. ![IMG_20260419_173443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/23uQfuYiUfndJ7By89Qvp9P8LBYDYyxJcpugPuh4YuiAxih4vAgeaGPe1ZCZp2GaraLwy.jpg) But as time goes by, I realized that it is actually not that easy. But the difference of my *then* to *now* is that, I am happier now. And now that all of my hatred in the world is gone, I can reminisce the past with a happy heart. I seriously miss a lot of being a kid. I miss those times I can run around, play with friends, and live as freely as a bird. ![IMG_20260419_173407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/23uQiCBarJW8QG5hSeEcLvhemRhUuuK3zjLVPsVG7pGPoHPFRJ8u3PRkDiq2tzNNo7Cc8.jpg) Hahh..those are my fun childhood. And to be honest, I miss those times than my time with my family. I kinda hated my family then, not anymore now though. I love my time with them now ♪⁠┌⁠|⁠∵⁠|⁠┘⁠♪ Now for the topic: ***What do you miss about being a child and why?*** ![IMG_20260419_154730.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EogMNRN7vohibohznFTEU8asTnSbtE7YDqp4vXQErfBC6jpxbebjM7WFzV5esVLyuww.jpg) ***Climbing the tree without fears*** -I even climb up school fences just to buy junk foods at the small sari sari store at the back of the school, so climbing a tree back then is super easy. Why I miss it? Because on top of the tree, I can eat the fruit directly on top. Like you know, I work hard to pick the fruit, even climbing it, so eating it there is like a reward and I always love a **rewards.** Another thing is, when I'm on top of a tree, particularly the guava tree in our yard, I can escape the eyes of the oldies for a while. And seriously, I miss it because I can't climb them now. I am always overthinking that a branch of tree won't be able to carry me. But how I wish I can do that again. My favorite tree to climb up is a guava tree of course. I remember shaking it using my weight -and really, without fears. 0 ![IMG_20260419_155038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eou8i5o9V47kidDqTfXpoTPPmFAbUovciNGCro2PFohcN2fkU2X7tbqvHLWkoSRQK9d.jpg) Next is **going to the rooftop using our window.** Our old house really has a nice setup and I miss going to the roof just to hide when we play hide and seek or when I want to hide because I did something bad -this is where my escape route is, lol. The way to the rooftop is on the second floor and it has window, it has no proper support to go up to the rooftop but the second floor room has other door, its like a door on a ground floor, maybe for extra security purposes, made with a plywood and with hard wood. And I used it to climb up there. With my short legs, climbing is a challenge, its scary too because if I accidentally fall, the height is surely to kill a kid, lol. But still yeah, its a fun experience for me and I miss it. See, I don't fear this kind of thing back then, but I am so afraid to Mom, lol. I also miss secretly eating a muffin while packing them, lol -we had bakery back then. And yes, that too, I miss the sight of my parents making bread and baking them too. Thinking about the bakery, I'm wondering how those people who used to work there now. Hope they're fine and happy too. I kinda miss being a pain in the arse for the people who used to take care of me when my oldies got busy delivering baked goodies. Hahhhh, I miss that I could do everything back then, as a kid, without the care in the world. I got in trouble a lot of times too but they are just a cute and funny memories now for me. And you know, there are times that I wish I am just a kid again. Just to experience those good times. (⁠✿⁠^⁠‿⁠^⁠) Lead Image Edited in [Canva](https://canva.link/wn9gu287kbjkp0z)

body.title: Quiet Peace
body.body:
/>

My brain was full.

But it wasn't the productive kind. It was the kind where your brain is filled with only noise and nothing makes sense. This time I was staring at a page that stopped making sense to me twenty minutes ago.

Finally, I stopped deceiving myself and slammed my laptop shut.

I saw the girl beside me in the library flinch and cut me a weird look. She smelled of garlic. I gently mouthed sorry and grabbed my bag. I needed air, time out, or even something I couldn't name yet. I just couldn't tell which one but I was very sure I just needed to be out of that library at that moment.

Outside, Sunderland received me with its usual coldness. The kind that doesn't ask permission before it finds your skin. I grabbed my coat and tried to hide my skin under it. The sky was grey. The street was almost empty. I could hear the sound of my own boots on the wet pavement.

I walked without direction.

My phone buzzed. I checked, and it was a WhatsApp message, three unread messages from home. I shoved it back into my pocket. Not now. I wasn't sure if I could carry any more right now. My brain hurt and was already too heavy.

I had been walking for ten minutes when I realized I was walking in the direction of my church. I could see it from a distance. Old built with stone walls dark with age, narrow windows, a wooden door so thick it looked like it had survived several lifetimes. A small board stood outside. The words were simple.

_All are welcome to come in and rest._

I stopped and stared at the door. I felt a strong urge to step in and another to just walk home.

I stood there looking left and right and at the door again.

It wasn't Sunday, so I was sure I wasn't in the mood for anything that required faith or prayers. I just wanted somewhere to clear my head.

Finally, I pushed the door.

I was hit first with the silence. Peaceful. Undisturbed. Like it had been sitting there for centuries waiting for someone who needed it. The smell was of incense and candle wax. Thin pale light from the pulpit chandelier fell through narrow windows onto wooden pews in the front.

The church was empty.

I walked straight to the first pew and sat down doing nothing. Just enjoying the peace from the quietness. No performance for a city that didn't even know my name. Just me. And the silence. And the light shining on me.

Slowly, I felt something in my chest that had been there for weeks slowly melt away.

Homesickness. The loneliness of Sunday mornings in a small apartment. The academic pressure whispered daily that I didn't belong here. The exhaustion of being brave without a break.

I felt it all slipping away. Somehow, at that moment, I found the courage to stop arguing.

And slowly, the more I sat there, the quieter and more peaceful it got.

Hours later, I stood up to leave. The sunlight through the windows had shifted. I must have spent so much time inside.

I walked outside to the cold again. The sky had darkened. My assignment was still due. The messages from home were still unread.

But I walked differently. Like someone who had put something heavy down and decided not to pick it up again - Peace.

[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/church-religion-evangelical-7583110/)

周末两天去监考，第一天直接掉链子。

早上七点十分考务室集合，我六点出门，前往十几公里外的地方，本来想打车去，结果叫不到车，路费要25+，然后如果追加5+才有人送，我就想放弃了，想转地铁，人已经走到地铁口了，发现地铁要七点左右才发车，太早了都停运了。

然后我又给帅哥打电话，结果他不接。

本来我自己有一辆电动车，但是我又怕骑走了，帅哥的挣钱工具—电动车就没有了。

所以我最后选择了共享电动车出行，但是走了一路居然看不到一辆共享，我人都崩溃了，一路找共享一路继续打车，还是没有人接单，最后在一个转弯找到了一个共享。

我又骑着共享一路狂奔，但是再快也只有23码的速度，我都拧到头了它也不走多快，后面我还是想打车，因为真的快要迟到了，在等红绿灯的地方我又发起订单，灯绿了结果还是没有人接单，我又只好取消，后面我也想通了，不要浪费时间了，就直接一心一意骑共享去得了。

到红绿灯的地方没人我就过，如果路线不一致，为了不等灯我就先左转再掉头直行，再左转。最后到了考场，地方太宽敞了，好几栋，根本找不着北，不管三七二十一，看着导航还要往里走几百米，但是车进不去，我还了车之后一路狂奔，见人就问，最后终于到了。

去到的时候，其他小伙伴都吃饱了早餐了，我才来到。🤣然后手机也关机了。

一路导航到没电，出门还忘记带充电器，最后还是小伙伴的充电宝拯救了我。

然后惊险的赶路终于结束了，幸好没有迟到影响监考。

---

Thank you. Your pieces are also beautiful. Yeah, thank you.

Don't think we are not reading it. Actually, Drew, every single one of them, I do. Thank you.

Thank you. Thank you so much. Thank you so, so much.

body.title: Sublime and Beautiful Sunday  A spring walk
body.body:
# Sublime and Beautiful Sunday A spring walk \ This post is for #SublimeSunday is inspired by @c0ff33a and #BeautifulSunday is initiated by @ace108. For me what is most sublime at the moment is the spring like weather we have had recently, with highs in the mid to low 70s and warm enough for me to get out for morning walks again and see the beauty of the start of a new day. that said, the shots I will share today are from the one-day time walk I have taken so far. I dont get out for day time walks so much as my wife doesnt fele up to getting out and about much these days and I feel bad heading out and doign what I enjoy while she is stuck at home, but I am hoping to get her out for a few times over the warmer months, even if I dont get to take photos, it would be good for her to get out. But I digress lets get to these photos. Buttonwood park is a lovely park here called by many, including myself the jewel of the city, it is about 97 acres so quite large. But the shots I took today are all in a small part of it near the pond Let me start with some daffodils, their lovely bright yellows are often the first sign of spring taking hold and as such I do love to see them.
![spring in buttonwood-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23x159rULYv7wreYrGT77f6UhXh3Tw6SDKQu9QbgPC8TfMcHmbHJjBsfqv9tXr38dcpeb.jpg) **Sony A7iv 33mm F9 1/200 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23x159rULYv7wreYrGT77f6UhXh3Tw6SDKQu9QbgPC8TfMcHmbHJjBsfqv9tXr38dcpeb.jpg)**

Alas lookig at the forecast ahead seems its going to be cooling down for a few days, dropping to below freezing point tonight apparently, but hopefully the temps will bounce back up quickly Now this next shot came as a surpise to me as I was walking around the pond, I often see ducks on the pond, but not sure I have seen a Cormorant there before, luckily I had my longer 50-400mm lens with me as was able to catch this shot of them
![spring in buttonwood.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23uFZwZUkP4Bg4bzLDrvsdnNfmCeWGg7ejasBCtmdNzi6RLfkEofzrXpfy4qzT5tFRXGP.jpg) **Sony A7iv 264mm F11 1/125 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23uFZwZUkP4Bg4bzLDrvsdnNfmCeWGg7ejasBCtmdNzi6RLfkEofzrXpfy4qzT5tFRXGP.jpg)**

Of course if you know me you know that if I visit the pond I always end up taking a shot of this tree on an island inthe middle of the pond
![spring in buttonwood-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/244UfPUQePzHFmB7vZcATQbw3mYEg9fPLsQq6nVgvT7tMge8gThVA1QaVFJeQyg4Kpkh4.jpg) **Sony A7iv 84mm F11 1/160 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/244UfPUQePzHFmB7vZcATQbw3mYEg9fPLsQq6nVgvT7tMge8gThVA1QaVFJeQyg4Kpkh4.jpg)**

The park has this one open field where as you can see tons of daffodils comeup

Hello, friends of #hive, and especially the @Music community. As always, I hope you and your family and friends are doing well. Today I’m stopping by to share a cover of the song “Perdón” by the Spanish duo Ha Ash—a beautiful song that I truly love, and I hope you’ll enjoy this cover.

the protagonist frees herself from guilt and from the responsibility of having idealized her partner and the relationship. I just hope you enjoy this song and have a wonderful day. A thousand blessings.

body.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  Night Walks #15/43
body.body:
All these busy figures between
         decks, dimly seen bending at their work in smoke and fire, are as nothing to the figures that shall do work here of another
         kind in smoke and fire, that day. These steam-worked engines alongside, helping the ship by travelling to and fro, and wafting
         tons of iron plates about, as though they were so many leaves of trees, would be rent limb from limb if they stood by her
         for a minute then. To think that this Achilles, monstrous compound of iron tank and oaken chest, can ever swim or roll! To
         think that any force of wind and wave could ever break her! To think that wherever I see a glowing red-hot iron point thrust
         out of her side from within – as I do now, there, and there, and there! – and two watching men on a stage without, with bared
         arms and sledge-hammers, strike at it fiercely, and repeat their blows until it is black and flat, I see a rivet being driven
         home, of which there are many in every iron plate, and thousands upon thousands in the ship! To think that the difficulty
         I experience in appreciating the ship’s size when I am on board, arises from her being a series of iron tanks and oaken chests,
         so that internally she is ever finishing and ever beginning, and half of her might be smashed, and yet the remaining half
         suffice and be sound. Then, to go over the side again and down among the ooze and wet to the bottom of the dock, in the depths
         <?pagebreak number=\

??>of the subterranean forest of dog-shores and stays that hold her up, and to see the immense mass bulging out against the upper light, and tapering down towards me, is, with great pains and much clambering, to arrive at an impossibility of realising that this is a ship at all, and to become possessed by the fancy that it is an enormous immovable edifice set up in an ancient amphitheatre (say, that at Verona), and almost filling it! Yet what would even these things be, without the tributary workshops and the mechanical powers for piercing the iron plates – four inches and a half thick – for rivets, shaping them under hydraulic pressure to the finest tapering turns of the ship’s lines, and paring them away, with knives shaped like the beaks of strong and cruel birds, to the nicest requirements of the design! These machines of tremendous force, so easily directed by one attentive face and presiding hand, seem to me to have in them something of the retiring character of the Yard. ‘Obedient monster, please to bite this mass of iron through and through, at equal distances, where these regular chalk-marks are, all round.’ Monster looks at its work, and lifting its ponderous head, replies, ‘I don’t particularly want to do it; but if it must be done—!’ The solid metal wriggles out, hot from the monster’s crunching tooth, and it isdone. ‘Dutiful monster, observe this other mass of iron. It is required to be pared away, according to this delicately lessening and arbitrary line, which please to look at.’ Monster (who has been in a reverie) brings down its blunt head, and, much in the manner of Doctor Johnson, closely looks along the line – very closely, being somewhat near-sighted. ‘I don’t particularly want to do it; but if it must be done—!’

??>Monster takes another near-sighted look, takes aim, and the tortured piece writhes off, and falls, a hot tight-twisted snake, among the ashes. The making of the rivets is merely a pretty round game, played by a man and a boy, who put red-hot barley sugar in a Pope Joan board, and immediately rivets fall out of window; but the tone of the great machines is the tone of the great Yard and the great country: ‘We don’t particularly want to do it; but if it must be done—!’

>How such a prodigious mass as the Achilles can ever be held by such comparatively little anchors as those intended for her and lying near her here, is a mystery of seamanship which I will refer to the wise boy. For my own part, I should as soon have thought of tethering an elephant to a tent-peg, or the larger hippopotamus in the Zoological Gardens to my shirt-pin. Yonder in the river, alongside a hulk, lie two of this ship’s hollow iron masts. Theyare large enough for the eye, I find, and so are all her other appliances. I wonder why only her anchors look small.
>I have no present time to think about it, for I am going to see the workshops where they make all the oars used in the British\r\n Navy.

Interessant, ich hätte nicht gedacht, dass es etwas gibt, was du noch nicht kanntest, weil du schon so viel über Heilpflanzen geschrieben hast. Mir war nicht so bewusst dass es eine Heilpflanze ist. 

Sagt man nicht, dass wenn einem eine Pflanze so vor die Nase kommt, im eigenen Garten aufgeht, dann Braucht man sie? 

Das mit den (giftigen) Doppelgängern finde ich sehr wichtig, hab Deinen Post gesehen.👍 Da war ich anfangs sehr unsicher. Vor allem wenn ich die Pflanzen noch nicht in echt gesehen habe. Bsp. Bärlauch: Maiglöckchen kannte ich, Aaronstab hab ich dann auch mal gesehen, aber nie eine Herbstzeitlose, um sie zu vergleichen. Scharbockskraut hat auch so seine Doppelgänger, da sind wir neulich durch einen Post von @stayoutoftherz gekommen. 

Das finde ich eine wichtige und sehr gute Aufklärung. Wenn Dir also die Kräuter ausgehen, dann hättest du da Postideen. Es ist schön dass die Leute sich wieder damit befassen, aber schade, wenn sie dann im Krankenhaus landen, weil sie was falsches erwischt haben und dann vielleicht noch ganz davon abkommen, sowie Angst davor gemacht wird. Wenn man, wieder Bsp. Bärlauch, sieht wie manche Leute am Sonntag im Wald gierig rupfen statt Blatt für Blatt zu pflücken, dann wundert es mich, dass da nichts falsches auf dem Teller landet. Zumal komplette \

auch nicht sinnvoll sind. Es muss was stehen bleiben. 

Danke für deine wertvolle Arbeit mit den Pflanzen und Liebe Grüße

!LADY

** Hello, #holozing community! It’s a pleasure to greet you all and wish you a happy and blessed start to the week. Today, I’m sharing some fan art inspired by a character known as Cinelara. My fan art is a flat knot bracelet made with colorful threads and the initial (C) of the character’s name. Without further ado, I invite you to join me in this fascinating creation and get your hands on the thread.

> **
ENGLISH
** ¡Hola, comunidad #holozing Es un placer saludaros a todos y desearos un feliz y bendecido comienzo de semana. Hoy voy a compartir un fan art inspirado en un personaje conocido como Cinelara. Mi fan art es una pulsera de nudo plano hecha con hilos de colores y la inicial (C) del nombre del personaje. Sin más preámbulos, os invito a que me acompañéis en esta fascinante creación y os pongáis manos a la obra con el hilo. ![1000385782.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep1YLRHytR71nx4MfCaaQ32TNwwUJ1xLu6xTWM2TWKBLFWnXkck48Hz9MUDfCWg6tNo.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)
> The materials I used to make this beautiful bracelet are as follows, namely: Thread Scissors Lighter Measuring tape Adhesive tape

> Los materiales que utilicé para realizar esta hermosa pulsera son los siguientes, a saber: Hilo Tijera Encendedor Cinta métrica Cinta adhesiva ![1000384775.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23xL113yE3masb8WSdASZjqvVX9xcvsHUfumK5tieNXVmnuikow5T7yLsNGyh44FN3KJw.jpg)
> To begin this beautiful jewelry I started by cutting two 40cm strands of thread which I will use as the base for our bracelet.

> Para empezar esta preciosa joya empecé cortando dos hebras de hilo de 40 cm que utilizaré como base para nuestra pulsera ![1000384776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23yd3rkfVJVYkB3pwxtWHhKkDRUVEvjtyrJSKpLUCfKvt9UcNTVLxry17sxxJRdBRN48n.jpg)
> Then I cut a 130cm strand of thread to make the flat weave of the bracelet.

> Después corté una hebra de hilo de 130cm para realizar el tejido plano de la pulsera. ![1000384789.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23yd5bwBVdqazG4RQ77R8XVNJ4zdx9SK7xMfHL4a2nMc5QFqEKwT1rdWCrRzEyEJ4L3gH.jpg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

> Started the bracelet by making flat knots in the following way: First I took the right strand, passed it over the base, made a P shape, then took the left strand, passed it over the right strand (which was on the left side), then passed it over the base and pulled it through the inside of the right strand (the P shape). Then I stretched the thread on each side evenly to make the knot. With your fingers you press it so that it is even on both sides and so we begin our weaving

> Inicié la pulsera realizando nudos planos de la siguiente manera: Primero tomé el hilo derecho, lo pasé por encima de la base , hice una forna de P, luego tomé el hilo izquierdo, lo pase por encima del hilo derecho (que estaba del lado izquierdo) , seguidamente lo pasé por dejado de la base y lo saqué por dentro del hilo derecho (la forma de P). Después estiré el hilo de cada lado uniformemente para hacer el nudo. Con los dedos se presiona para que quede igual de ambos lados Así comenzamos nuestro tejido. ![1000385783.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23u697thkNcoYhDjz5jvmavCWsoV8LgBhzvC2TSLEriGEpNcwS3qLEfw4hoXn917LUnHV.jpg)

> Now I took the thread on the left side and passed it over the base thread, I formed a kind of four, then I passed the thread on the right side over the left thread that we have on the right side, then I passed it under the base thread and took it out through the inside or ring of the left thread as shown in the image. Then I pressed with my fingers so that both sides have similarity

> Ahora tomé el hilo del lado izquierdo y lo pasé por encima del hilo base, formé una especie de cuatro, luego pasé el hilo del lado derecho por encima del hilo izquierdo que tenemos en el lado derecho, después lo pasé por debajo del hilo base y lo saqué por el interior o argolla del hilo izquierdo como nos lo señala la imagen. Seguidamente con los dedos presioné para que de ambos lados tengan similitud. ![1000385784.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23vi268EHmsb3aLnQxLM64djJRpi3K6yYb7tWhkABzw4jRgQcuyn17r646ghEXrzavqZ2.jpg)
> I continued making seven complete flat knots until I reached 7 cm.

> Seguí realizando siete nudos planos completos hasta llegar a 7cm ![1000384817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wX33fqpALkKYbQAmSKKHYvwnxgztkozsHWmSUnuZ16oRVnxWCf2kJJFxu1WXt7jExrv.jpg)
> Then I threaded two beads onto the knotting threads and the initial letter of the name Cinelara.

> Luego introduje dos mostacillas por los hilos anudadores y la letra inicial del nombre Cinelara. ![1000385785.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23tSYpw8t3EXnBmB6crTBCueZXmBM6NpM7JPMdaG8Z6pBvZ6pGAmiStKk6oJgWoLLqorM.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

title.title: Garden upgrade
title.body:
![IMG_5092.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNvwRqDd37hRRfsZqXFobK6vGD1nmiseSWcDVBJ3B3JZm/IMG_5092.jpeg)

Today I have a small but very pleasant garden renovation. I bought three bushes of boxwood. I didn't hesitate for a long time: they look great - dense, bright, healthy, and the price is quite adequate. At some point you just catch yourself thinking: well, why not? I was in the car, there was money, the need to buy boxwood, too. I'll explain why now.

I knew in advance where I would put them. Decorative reeds began to fall on the fence in several places, and the view, to be honest, became not very good. It's annoying to leave it like that, and it's not possible to redo everything completely yet. And here the boxwood was right on the spot. It is evergreen, calmly tolerates shade and looks neat all year round. For such \

- almost an ideal solution.

![IMG_5089.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXk71nxAE6NEZfdppKTo8fQNAVL7YMZZgDP5sLkk7riS7/IMG_5089.jpeg)

However, I had to tinker a little with the landing. When I started to take the bushes out of the pots, it turned out that the roots had already grown a lot and literally braided the entire bottom of the pots. I had to help carefully, untangle it a little, trying not to damage the roots, so that it would be easier for the plants to take root in a new place. At such moments, there is always a doubt whether it hurt. But, on the other hand, leaving everything as it is by simply cutting off the bottom of the pot is also not an option, the roots simply would have nowhere to grow further.

As a result, I planted, watered, tamped the ground - and went to see. And that's the feeling when you look and understand: it's better. It's noticeably better. Everything somehow got together, was formalized, there was a feeling of order and well-groomed garden. At least in a small area.

There is a suspicion that I will not stop there. Most likely, I'll buy a few more bushes and continue along the fence. Because when you find a good solution, you want to develop it. And, to be honest, this is one of the most pleasant types of \

- when you work with a living person and immediately see the result.


![IMG_5091.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXGqMDhzQACeUCx697tWqXrgKSJhx6gmfbpZ6LTQhjs13/IMG_5091.jpeg)

**Những giấc mơ trúng số XSMB có mang ý nghĩa nào đặc biệt?**

Những giấc mơ về việc trúng số, đặc biệt là liên quan đến XSMB, từ lâu đã khiến nhiều người tò mò và suy nghĩ về ý nghĩa ẩn sau chúng. Có người xem đó là điềm báo may mắn, nhưng cũng có người cho rằng đó chỉ là sản phẩm của trí tưởng tượng. Vậy những giấc mơ trúng số có mang ý nghĩa đặc biệt nào không? Xét trên hai phương diện tâm lý và niềm tin cá nhân, có thể thấy rằng những giấc mơ này vừa phản ánh mong muốn nội tại, vừa mang màu sắc hy vọng của con người.

**➡️➡️➡️Bấm ngay:** [**https://www.sooplive.com/station/xosomienbacm**](https://www.sooplive.com/station/xosomienbacm)

Giấc mơ trúng số XSKTMB phản ánh mong muốn và trạng thái tâm lý của con người trong đời sống thực

Trong cuộc sống hiện đại, áp lực tài chính, công việc và những lo toan thường nhật khiến nhiều người khao khát một sự đổi đời nhanh chóng. Hình ảnh trúng số xuất hiện trong giấc mơ chính là biểu hiện rõ ràng của khát vọng đó. Não bộ khi ngủ vẫn tiếp tục xử lý thông tin và cảm xúc trong ngày, từ đó tạo ra những kịch bản mang tính \

, trong đó việc trúng số trở thành một biểu tượng của sự giải thoát khỏi khó khăn. Vì vậy, giấc mơ này không phải là điềm báo siêu nhiên, mà chủ yếu là sự phản chiếu của những suy nghĩ, mong muốn sâu kín bên trong mỗi người. Những ai thường xuyên nghĩ về tiền bạc, cơ hội hay vận may thì càng dễ mơ thấy những tình huống tương tự.\n\n

/>

Giấc mơ trúng số chỉ phản ánh mong muốn của người chơi

**➡️➡️➡️Đọc thêm:** [**https://bsky.app/profile/xosomienbacmobi.bsky.social**](https://bsky.app/profile/xosomienbacmobi.bsky.social)

Giấc mơ trúng số XS miền Bắc còn mang ý nghĩa tinh thần, thể hiện niềm tin và hy vọng vào tương lai

Dù không có cơ sở khoa học chứng minh giấc mơ có thể dự đoán kết quả xổ số, nhưng đối với nhiều người, nó vẫn mang lại cảm giác lạc quan. Sau một giấc mơ như vậy, con người có thể cảm thấy vui vẻ hơn, có động lực hơn trong cuộc sống. Ở một góc độ nào đó, giấc mơ đóng vai trò như một \

, giúp con người tin rằng những điều tốt đẹp vẫn có thể xảy ra. Tuy nhiên, điều quan trọng là không nên quá phụ thuộc vào giấc mơ hay xem đó là dấu hiệu chắc chắn để đưa ra quyết định trong thực tế, bởi điều này có thể dẫn đến những kỳ vọng sai lầm.

➡️➡️➡️Tra cứu tại: [https://pinetbook.com/xosomienbachomnay](https://pinetbook.com/xosomienbachomnay)

Tóm lại, giấc mơ trúng số XSMB không mang ý nghĩa đặc biệt theo kiểu dự đoán tương lai, mà chủ yếu phản ánh tâm lý và nuôi dưỡng hy vọng của con người. Hiểu đúng về những giấc mơ này sẽ giúp chúng ta giữ được sự cân bằng giữa niềm tin và thực tế, từ đó sống tích cực và chủ động hơn trong cuộc sống.

title.body:
První soutěžní snímek nás zavede do městského centra a představuje nám dvouvěžatou dominantu kostela. Jedná se o noční snímek a barevná kompozice nasvícených budov vytváří příjemný kontrast plný detailů staveb. Hlavním objektem jsou dvě věže, jež jsou okrové barvy s bílými doplňky. Pomyslnou třešničkou na dortu je modře nasvícená střecha jedné z věží s něčím, co připomíná svatozář. Okolní budovy na náměstí jsou lehce osvětlené pouličním osvětlením a sekundují tak kostelu uprostřed. Mokrá, lesknoucí se dlážděná plocha už jen zvýrazňuje pomocí odlesků noční osvětlení. Celek nechává vyniknout černá obloha, která díky světelnému smogu přechází do odstínů šedé. A zaregistrovali jste ty malé lidičky s deštníky?

Druhý snímek je více než dost imaginární. Jednou z možností, jak probudit divákovu fantazii, je vyfotit obyčejnou věc v nadměrném přiblížení. Tímto vznikne jediná zásadní otázka u diváka: Na co se to dívám? A to je přesně tento snímek. V dolní části jsou patrné části starého rezavého potrubí. Je to součást moderního umění zasazeného do starého kabátu, nebo jen součást technického zázemí? A co jsou ty osvětlené oblouky? Je to průzor ven, na sluncem osvětlenou vedlejší stavbu, nebo je to něco, co září a je přichycené na třech tyčích? V tuto chvíli, bez kontextu, nevím, na co se dívám, ale líbí se mi to.

Další snímek nás zavede opět do vlhkého exteriéru. Což nevadí, protože stejně už máme deštníky mokré z prvního snímku. Na snímku je zachycena lehce ponurá nálada, za což jistě může pozadí zahalené lehkou mlhou. Jedinou optimistickou maličkostí jsou rozkvetlé narcisy a zlatý déšť. Jedině tyto dvě indicie určují, že se nejedná o podzimní snímek, nýbrž jarní. A když ještě chvilku vyčkáme, budeme si moci dopřát šálku dobré kávy na židličkách pod stromem.

Milujete vlaky? Nejsem si jist, jaké sny mají dnešní děti. Já, jako dítě, jsem toužil být popelářem a mít vláčky v obýváku. Tento snímek přesně vystihuje můj druhý dětský sen. Pohled z ptačí perspektivy na nádraží plné vláčků. Hlavní dominantou je nádraží, zjevně v plné dopravní špičce, které zabírá spodní polovinu snímku. Svou tmavou paletou barev kontrastuje se světle šedou až modrou oblohou. Na horizontu je možné rozeznat hlavní dominanty města. Ale pokud je divák duší malý kluk, jediná otázka zní: S kterou mašinkou pojedu jako první?

Má zlaté ručičky. Tak se u nás může vyjádřit obdiv někomu, kdo je šikovný. Zde na snímku je vidět, že význam rukou je povýšen na úplně jinou úroveň. Snímek vezme diváka na místo, kde symbol prosebných nebo modlících se rukou má jistě nesmírný význam. Dominantou je zde socha sepjatých rukou, vyvedená se všemi precizními detaily. Autor nezapomněl doplnit i ozdobný řemínek. Celkově snímek vyvolává dojem, že mimo zorné pole diváka odpočívá obr a drobné postavy okolo chystají svačinku, až se probudí. Barevným kontrastem snímek příliš nevyniká, šedou monotónnost zpestřuje barevné oblečení a malý keř v popředí fotografie. Tematicky se snímek může zařadit mezi pozvánky na místní kuriozity a zvláštnosti v turistickém průvodci.

Jestli jste ranní ptáčata a brzké vstávání je vaší běžnou rutinou, můžete vidět tuto barevnou koláž na vlastní oči. Pokud ne, stačí se na chvíli zastavit u posledního snímku, který zachycuje ranní cvrkot a vycházející slunce těsně nad obzorem. Říká se, že jde o velice zajímavou paletu barev: žluté, červené a tmavě modré až skoro šedé. Tímto barevným kontrastem vznikají na snímku dvě oblasti. Tmavě modrá zatažená obloha dominuje horní polovině snímku. Linoucí se silnice do dáli barevně sekunduje obloze. Vycházející slunce ozařuje horizont města a vzniká tenký šíp, který svou jasně žlutou barvou rozráží pochmurnou šeď zatažené oblohy. Společně tímto světelným jevem projasňuje snímek barevná konstrukce zábradlí a kousek v pozadí je hlavním objektem strom. Přesněji obrys stromu, jenž díky prosvětlenému pozadí vyniká do detailu. Snad jediným negativním prvkem je sloup trakčního vedení. Anebo je to všechno úplně jinak. Autor navštívil ocelové město ve vzdálené budoucnosti a zachytil jeho osud v poslední vteřině před ohromným výbuchem, po kterém zůstane jen poušť a trosky. Možná vás napadne ještě jiný příběh, který může snímek vyprávět, klidně se o něj podělte v komentářích.

Závěrem již patří poděkování všem přihlášeným autorům za povedené snímky. Tentokrát dva hlasy – jeden pro Bazyliku a druhý pro fragment v Brně.

title.title: Today election day in Bulgaria. Former president Rumen Radev (PB) leading in the polls. No money for Ukraine war from Bulgaria, but won't block EU aids. Similar to new Hungarian (Magyar) position.
title.body:
Bulgarien befindet sich politisch und wirtschaftlich seit Jahren in einer Dauerkrise, alle paar Monate wird ein neues Parlament gewählt, in den letzten 5 Jahren gab es 8 Parlamentswahlen. Die Wahlbeteiligung lag zuletzt unter 40%.

Diesmal is es aber anders, der bei der Bevölkerung beliebte Präsident Rumen Radev, der sich gegen die Euro-Einführung positioniert hat und dessen zweite Amtszeit bald geendet hätte, ist im Januar überraschend zurückgetreten, um jetzt im April bei den Parlamentswahlen mit einer eigenen Liste anzutreten. 

Seine Chancen stehen dabei sehr gut, in den Umfragen erreicht er den ersten Platz mit 30%, manche Umfragen sehen ihn sogar noch deutlicher vorne.

Radev punktet auch im Kampf gegen die vorherrschende Korruption bei den Wählern und vertritt auch in Sachen Ukraine-Krieg eine neuen Standpunkt, der sich sehr nahe an der neuen ungarischen Magyar-Position orientiert.

Radev lehnt weitere Zahlungen an die Ukraine ab, möchte eine Ausnahmeregelung für Bulgarien ähnlich wie Ungarn erhalten, würde aber EU-Hilfspakete nicht blockieren, solange sich Bulgarien nicht daran beteiligen müsse.

Bin gespannt, wie die Wahl heute ausgeht, und ob Radev tatsächlich Premier und mit wem er koalieren wird. Die Regierungsbildung wird voraussichtlich nicht einfach werden, da die Standpunkte der Parteien so unterschiedlich und die Parteien so verfeindet sind.

Wie denkt ihr wird die Wahl in Bulgarien ausgehen? Mit wem könnte Radev koalieren?

## Bulgarian April 19th 2026 parliament elections (Polls)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/AJdKtCCGJU4yirtekfb7gZveX6xvT1A1WrZT1YFCLDq4nvcFndbbSBsgLU12nxg.png)

https://www.politico.eu/europe-poll-of-polls/bulgaria/

https://x.com/Reuters/status/2045145254253207766

## English

Bulgaria has been in a state of political and economic crisis for years; a new parliament is elected every few months, and there have been eight parliamentary elections in the last five years. Voter turnout in the most recent election was below 40%.

This time, however, things are different. President Rumen Radev, who is popular with the public, has opposed the adoption of the euro, and whose second term would soon have ended, surprisingly resigned in January to run in the parliamentary elections this April with his own party list. 

His chances are very good; he leads the polls with 30%, and some polls show him with an even wider lead.

Radev is also scoring points with voters in the fight against rampant corruption and is taking a new stance on the war in Ukraine that closely aligns with Hungary’s Magyar position.

Radev opposes further payments to Ukraine, wants to secure an exemption for Bulgaria similar to Hungary’s, but would not block EU aid packages as long as Bulgaria is not required to participate.

I’m curious to see how the election turns out today, and whether Radev will actually become prime minister and with whom he will form a coalition. Forming a government is unlikely to be easy, as the parties’ positions are so divergent and the parties are so at odds with one another.

How do you think the election in Bulgaria will turn out? With whom could Radev form a coalition?

title.title: Life Is Choice
title.body:
In this life, we all have a choice in whatever we do. The only problem is that we may not always have power over the results of our choices. It is just as the saying goes that beggars have no choice. In all honesty, beggars certainly do have a choice. Though they might not be able to control what they receive, they can decide whether to accept it or not. The giver cannot force them to take it simply because he is the one giving.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYuZD2C7mrjoAzLTyUVs4MzBNFbDbsbDyXjhp5DhfHkw9/1776593198349.jpg)

In this life, in my own understanding, we all have choices, and there are three major ones we make in this world.
The first is that you can watch things happen to you.
>Watching things happen to you.

This is like observing life without being in control. You simply watch and allow things to happen willingly. It is like having a garden and doing nothing, then watching weeds, thorns, and other unwanted plants grow. But if you want something meaningful, you have to act, plant something, nurture it, and watch it grow into a bountiful harvest.
Choosing to watch things happen and not react is still a choice. Many people believe that “what will be will be.” To some extent, it might be true, but not in all cases. If you want to be educated, you must be deliberate about it. You don’t get rich by doing nothing. You don’t succeed by folding your arms and saying “what will be will be?\

body.title: Old Things, Old Memories, and a Quiet Heart
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcpcVAzfKPhPZNMjkAEfVTMKSRFJoL4pgqeSmMprD5gvL/1776593205559.jpg)
https://shorturl.at/DxJLs



Sometimes I feel that I am a strange kind of person. Maybe it is because I always love my old things. My old clothes, my old notebook, my old memories… even my old habits. Many people around me change very quickly. They buy new things, follow new trends, learn new ways of living. But I don't know why my heart still feels comfortable with old things.
Maybe it is because old things carry stories inside them.
For example, in our village there is an old wooden chair in our courtyard. It is not beautiful anymore. The paint is gone and the wood has small cracks. But my father used to sit on that chair every evening after working in the fields. When I see that chair, I don't see an old chair. I see my childhood. I see evenings when we used to drink tea together and talk about simple life.
New things are shiny and attractive, but they don't always have soul.
Another thing I notice about myself is that my prayers have become very quiet. When I was younger, I used to make long prayers with many words. I would ask for many things. But now it feels different. Sometimes I sit quietly and look at the sky, and I feel that Allah already knows everything in my heart.
So my prayers become silent.
Maybe this happens when a person grows older or when life teaches some lessons. Words become less important, and feelings become deeper.
In village life we see this a lot. Old farmers don't talk too much. They sit quietly under a tree, watching the fields and the sky. But inside their hearts there are many thoughts, many memories, and many prayers.
I think human hearts are also like old houses in villages. From outside they may look simple or even broken. But inside there are stories of love, loss, happiness, and patience.
Sometimes we also remember people who are not around anymore. When we think about them, a strange peace comes into the heart. It is like loneliness becomes a little softer.
Maybe memories are Allah’s small gift to humans. Through memories, people who are far away can still live inside our hearts.
Life today is moving very fast. Social media, new technology, new lifestyles… everything is changing. But some people like me still move slowly like village roads. Maybe that is not a bad thing.
Because slow roads often lead to peaceful places.
And maybe loving old things simply means that a person has not forgotten where he came from.
In the end, I think it is okay if someone cannot easily adapt to every new thing. Hearts are not machines. They grow in their own way.
Sometimes silence is also a prayer.
Sometimes memories are also a comfort.
And sometimes old things hold the most beautiful parts of our life.

body.title: Playoffs Week 3 Sunday Previews
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmYgL3HWiP2HCxpZp4DwF91tSoef2bCCAtyMbBTL4Ai8Wj/002.jpg
These are previews from matches involving Belgian Teams with all the latest on team news, player form, and injuries along with my personal betting angles, ...

/> Sstaurday turned out in a break-even day as one of my bigger bets ended up as a loser. However, by far the most weight is on Sunday with 2 kind of confident positions that I got into...

AA Gent vs Sint-Truiden

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmPeJ21C77ZQrT2DW8bWCqqNi9CV9ggpakn5LkYwxY7wN1/image.pngAA Gent has been a team who at times show good things but it's never 90 minutes good and they always find ways to screw themselves up. Last week they lost with a 3-1 score to Anderlecht after they already should have sealed the match in the first half. A similar scenario happened in the match before against KV Mechelen where they came 1-0 ahead but were pushed back (crawled back) in the 2nd half to get to a 1-1 FT score. This was against the 2 weaker teams in playoff 1. Stvv already faced Union where they lost 1-0 and were close to a draw while they also could have taken more than the 1-2 against Club Brugge. This now puts them in a spot where they lost 4 matches in a row but all against top sides (2x Union / Brugge / Genk) while still showing why they are in 3rd place. So the big question today is ie small losing streak killed the momentum and confidence of Sint-Truiden or if they are simply the better playing more consistant team. Given the fact that the losing streak came against top teams while they still showed good things combined with the fact that Gent at times showed really poor against the weaker teams I'm just approaching this match from the core qualities these teams have. In that regard, Stvv is simply the better team and they also won twide from AA Gent in the regular season. So 0.5 units on Sint-Truiden +0 @ 2.019 is the bet I ended up taking leaving some space to potentially take more. Gent is a team who can be opposed when they take the lead while Stvv is a team that can be backed when they fall behind. A draw also isn't the end of the world for both teams. I see Sint-Truiden as the 1.86 favorite or better against the DNB Line.

Dender vs Cercle Brugge

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmPrZ49D1V6jcqpdNGJLKcutpyktbjSPJMnA1XM2u16Vdx/image.pngDender still has a mathematical chance to overtake La Louviere even though it is extremely unlikely and Cercle Brugge since last week is mathematically safe. So for Dender, risk will again have to te taken as only a win will do while Cercle hasn't really anything to play for anymore. I am pretty much waiting for Dender to be 100% sure of the last place and the others to be safe to start backing Dender who are still working toward the test match against the 2nd division team. Right now, I don't really know how to estimate this especially with Cercle Brugge as the clear favorite on the betting market. The only real angle that I have is that Dender needs to take risks to get the win which should leave the door open for Cercle possibly late in the match. No Pre-Game Bets

Union vs Club Brugge

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmUmpS76owPHvhcpqDZzkGwwSPr5XsCn8Q7EnsVkSBT4yy/image.pngTo me this match is pretty straightforward in that Union will try to play their usual defensive game breaking down the opponent while not being good enough to create that much unless they get lots of space on the counters. Club Brugge is the only team in the league who should have the quality to break their defense but at the same time, they know thay are vulnerable in the back and likely will lose if they go full offense. A draw for both teams also is not the worst result as that keeps Union ahead while Brugge still keeps things in their own hands with a home match to go. I fully expect a match where Defense and intensity on both sides rules and a 0-0 correct score would not surprise me. If Brugge wins, I can see them capable of doing so by more than 1 goal. A dry 1-0 Union result also would not be a surpise. The odds on the under for me are just way too generous between the best and 3rd best defense in the regular season as it's more shaped by the fact that they are 1st & 2nd in xg created mostly against weaker teams. I took 0.5 units on Under 2.5 @ 1.985, 0.3 units on 1st Half Under 1 @ 2.118, 0.1 unit on 1st Half Under 0.75 @ 2.610, 0.1 unit on Under 2 @ 2.960, & 0.1 unit on Correct Score 0-0 @ 11.869. I also took a 0.08 unit bet on Club Brugge -0.25 @ 7.480 & 0.12 units on Club Brugge +0.5 @ 1.804. I do plan to reduce my exposure along the way if possible. I also took a 1.6 LTC Crypto bet on 1st Half under 1 @ 1.990 over at

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmSsUWZnNyHQ7WsL327bEad9UZ7CirRBRDHTzVAKqjhtro/image.pngThis match partly depends on what Dender did before as a loss would mean a draw is enough to be mathematically sure and a draw would mean they need a win to be mathematically sure. Zulte-Waregem is safe and has nothing to play for which could go both ways in them playing without purpose or them playing freely. I'm leaning toward the over bet as La Louvere is no longer the super defensive teams they were at one point but I first need to see what Dender did and what the match picture brings. No Pre-Game Bets

/>
I take all my Pre-Game & Live bets with my Betting Broker

Eres una persona llena de sorpresa; desconocía que remabas. Qué hermosa aventura, y como bien dices, esta es una actividad divertida de hacer, pero también es muy saludable para mantenernos en forma.

[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/images/download/x-6603252_1920.jpg)



On Caturday, I think about the quiet lives we ignore.

Where I come from, a stray cat is rarely just a cat, it carries stories people didn’t write but somehow believe and whispers of bad luck, suspicion, things unseen.

 A cat crossing your path can earn side-eyes, sharp warnings, even distance. It’s not always cruelty; sometimes it’s inherited fear, passed down like folklore, unquestioned.

But I have learned to sit with my own eyes, not borrowed ones.

The first time a stray cat lingered near my door, it didn’t look mystical or dangerous. It looked tired, it's fur told stories of survival, not superstition. It didn’t hiss or haunt, it waited, watching and measuring if kindness lived here.

I won’t lie, the voices echoed in my head, be careful. Don’t invite what you don’t understand but something quieter, stronger, spoke too: What if it’s just hunger? What if it’s just life trying to live?

So I chose differently, I didn’t rush to carry it inside. Trust was what I needed to, not demanding from it. I left food out first, from a distance, watched it eat like it hadn’t in days. The next day, it came back, not bold, but hopeful. And slowly, day by day, the gap between us softened.

What I’ve noticed about cats is this: they don’t beg for love the way dogs do. They negotiate it, they teach patience, boundaries, respect. A stray cat doesn’t hand you loyalty, you earn it in quiet and consistent ways.

And when it finally sits near you, not out of need but choice, it feels like a small miracle.

Taking a stray cat home isn’t just about shelter, it’s about unlearning. It’s about choosing compassion over inherited fear. It’s about realizing that not everything we were warned about is meant to harm us, some things are just misunderstood.

I still hear the whispers sometimes, the sideways glances. The subtle questions: Why would you bring that home?

But I’ve seen what they haven’t.

I’ve seen a creature soften, i’ve seen fear turn into familiarity. I’ve seen how something once avoided can become a quiet companion, curling into the corners of your life without chaos.

So this Caturday, I’m choosing my own narrative.

Not every stray is a warning, some are just waiting to be seen.

I hope this reasonates with us all
