reserve\\.title: When hands take centre stage in photographs.
reserve\\.body:
> --- >Every art exhibition I visit has something special about it, whether in its overall feel or in the finer details, but being able to see the underlying story and the emotions that led the artist to take that particular photograph—and not another—is what really interests me --- ![20260418_213848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFaXuUQUdDRNGfnnbAM8JwNKu3Nzya3S1RJo9pzqM2gUJi58tYSC7gXmsLonZsRjs6z.jpg) --- The other day I told someone that I’d love to be a professional photographer; I inherited my love of photography from my grandfather, and I practise it all the time. I always want to improve, and when I see an exhibition with such beauty, it moves me. And this is mainly because both eyes and hands are very important to me: with my eyes I see beauty, and with my hands I create art in various ways. Therefore, seeing an exhibition where hands take centre stage, regardless of the setting, is fascinating. ---
![20260416_191352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKvR5Ppxnhkvc2xB1KuQmrCHwaTaLwonWBbPL77ALbdSQfcWpA4T3fWGABuUdBNTqiz.jpg)
--- I visited this exhibition on two different days, because on the first day there was a talk taking place in that very room, which prevented me from taking good photographs, so I returned the day before it ended and was able to admire each of those wonderful photos at my leisure. ---
![20260326_181229.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJboMn5q44C1fCD9yMs9dbA79kjgDa1wGaLEFSCkiBp9FjBp2VBGvwHUfxxQN44MEZq.jpg)
--- At the entrance there was a sign; it’s in Spanish, but I’ll translate it for everyone, because it’s worth it. The art exhibition is titled “Cinco lobitos”, a reference to a Spanish nursery rhyme or song that was also popular in my native Argentina. ---
![20260416_191728.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xLFFtKEGuF6fvnkcH4dYffjHkEwd7PnTUrW8RH1JCb369VpvSjxaqTFAR4SeZCw9CuG.jpg)
--- In Pepe Gómez’s work, the image can be heard. There is a silent resonance to it, a subtle vibration that cannot be heard, but can be felt. His photographs stem from a form of attention that recognises, in everyday life, the traces of what is shared. Each one appeals to memory and evokes an emotion that goes beyond the moment it was taken, expanding like an echo in a ritual that remains alive. In Conco lobitos, the intensity lies not in what is shown, but in what is revealed. During Holy Week in Málaga, hands become a place where time takes shape, where experience is deposited and transformed into gesture. In them, the individual merges with the collective, and a bond spanning generations is recognised. It is in this persistence that the image finds its depth. Sergio Croma, curator. --- ![20260416_191815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48b34HR1YuQXZBmmswxvDU1H4Cc8hZJuA9999Hnyt1eprqJ544sGn3pyMmqcVLVuma.jpg) ![20260416_191806.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVVxwCtHtjfodvYqnqAGNcwrS58q7ACdMDLE5UQcEbvBnRibEbmy8jThtiZdvtVnEp4.jpg) ![20260416_191736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xL9Y9U26MB2kV7ye3XGvrXt8SwKKkp2AoNZ1ywkcPucJPS5P6z4AnyhJA1t1JvtcSkR.jpg) ![20260416_191746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xexrYQZFjg2qqtSEJ7YQUasABHH2LRdokv26XWynt2RgEpo8uW5Fp3cpH2BRaCLiv1B.jpg)
![20260416_191757.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/EpA6LT2epGCaS8Eh9W43bGgo9jPn7hUAPveiamD164RHYapmgfySgzYaLpCDRYvqKGS.jpg)
--- This text is highly significant for each of the photographs that make up the exhibition; they did not each have a title, but rather form a cohesive whole. And this goes beyond the fact that they are photographs related to Holy Week. Have you ever stopped to think about all the things we use our hands for? When looking at each of these photos, you can appreciate those details, those moments when we don’t even realise we’re using our hands the gestures, the poses as I always say, the smallest details. ---
![20260416_191757.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/EpA6LT2epGCaS8Eh9W43bGgo9jPn7hUAPveiamD164RHYapmgfySgzYaLpCDRYvqKGS.jpg)
![20260416_191843.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xpKETAeWxYHbiLrz3tnFcmoSHcQbxVVDf85iskGuRvoZuAprgSFVafGNGbiBrEKLiPj.jpg)
![20260416_191822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241thVTiS592Uj7nF88LNjPawcTaTaBnaX2YeYTq2dFeuP3NK7tmvif2t5FE9fokbNhEC.jpg)
![20260416_191939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyg82Hqg94iBK5KXjS4NHFBu5vqzyB2LBdVANQVo8n696arzeNkKABLJuozn8MSic3X.jpg) ![20260416_192018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1Fg88EzdorR7nHTCgA2bFoqqCbQbitJtCKmLtSQQSy4HPbhX4J26Y7KFFNjKWXMuBs.jpg) --- This exhibition took me back in time and reminded me of how many times my art teacher made me draw and paint hands and feet. They are very difficult to depict, just like faces, because they involve so many details, but that is precisely what matters: those details, the wrinkles, the marks, the knuckles, the nails, accessories such as rings everything counts. Hands that hold objects, those resting on a shoulder to offer comfort, hands that take part in an embrace or those that are praying. Hands that greet with a firm handshake, those that wipe away tears of emotion or sadness, hands that point, that lend a helping hand, hands that carry things, hands that work, hands… --- ![20260416_191846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w38Y91z3GxMPmMA61nqcb995AvhoPudpoXp7htvmoMiNobuXP6Yk7FiXiTq3NuyCoN2.jpg) --- “The hand is the soul’s tool, its message, and the body has in it its fighting limb” Miguel Hernández. --- ![20260326_181236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244KZaGB2WuSFTPVxTnD7NfNtitvBUU9Ckw3szKdbykw6CvCb2L4LHg2z98P3KDS9tX9Q.jpg) ![20260326_181443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48Yd9W4Bme4CgmjoyoTn2HamPyHrX8k6rAp9Mu3Feq4Bts7d3ZGqJ71ykWDToAR5Z2.jpg) ![20260326_181335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48XBPeajXzrz2HcRfnAajHjLxrqy3r4xjc83fv7xQURy4MdbZGfYDifR7Tqo2wvuhH.jpg) ![20260326_181316.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48XfS6qf18G3bVKwFz3UafH5fdoBFrndiVdTsiQjMjjCNf82YXGE7A9vzxhY4iPRdG.jpg) ![20260326_181437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48WhQb9yF5ymwq1rNxmUhm6ijYQinMYq9j7Z16TJv6aEGvrBNuVn9ePTZR2ZYutpiv.jpg) --- Let us reflect on this phrase, which was on one of the walls: hands are the tool of the soul, and how true that is. They carry out the very mission of the soul in our daily lives, conveying that message to others; and yet, with our hands we also fight not in a battle, but in life itself, that life which so often leads us to face difficult challenges. ---
![20260326_181241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Ep7xyLVjKJX3CPhTybxD6jFMFetf2F2EXtjgWCn2ckmdWnRG3ekseeWP7r97XsSBeUq.jpg)
![20260326_181359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zSC4Zs2qaiN6uufErQwsAvEithMYCQ3TBVTqYuUSPWfKQzvGpnX9Gt1WxsQ2cpa1ZPE.jpg)
![20260326_181304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/EpA4wm8awP8A3RJ3E1VzYwyEmwKEJuSbf5nLCDbq47FdgReLJrJM53tSFxcQXXEdCis.jpg)
![20260326_181419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241ti1meiYmpUxZ1NZLDXTBFwdQPWAUGcpZh5o8FmrxTtNZpcsdoh8ocLsqMbJE7uQEgx.jpg)
--- Hands are used to work, to offer a caress, to hold a flower, to help those in need of strength; they hold a camera or a phone that takes photographs, the very ones I bring you today. With our hands we greet and bid farewell. ---
![20260416_191954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJJpamrPdJuJ3QYStCXFyK4vN3DSL43E6gi57DZfAai1JtM8DWP4wHc62jYd7A4Drmf.jpg)
![20260326_181451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ywyrBJdYrSaGK98grzLXshhSj4eaK1yweMYFntwJVpTgS6Fr42ZL3aoy6vns45zp43r.jpg) --- Our hands are with us every minute of our lives, and I think that’s why they’re so important to me. With my hands, I hold the brush I paint with, the pencil I write with, and with those very same hands, right now, I’m writing this for you, something that comes purely from my soul. Can you see how important they are? It has been an exceptional and very thought-provoking exhibition for me. Thank you very much for joining me today; I wish you a wonderful Sunday. See you soon. Amonet. >All photographs are my own. ![Separador Amonet rosa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo45huwdpJdeDRRmb3tm3Sv7mxs8Uq3XUZDd5bjvGqBDKfDE5DLGQM1duXTEQQYhyjs.png) [//]:# (!worldmappin 36.721393 lat -4.422386 long When hands take centre stage in photographs. d3scr)

reserve\\.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 18 2026
reserve\\.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4796b7ec-2534-4c5c-9558-a9dd40e4f2e2.jpg) The blossoms are really good this year. It is such a shame when it all falls off and disappears for another year. But thats nature 😕. Actually, May is also very good for blossoms. The hedgerows really come to life then. Looking like snow. However, that brings me to the weather as I have seen long range forecasts for end of April, predicting snow for higher ground. You can never write off a cold snap in spring here in the UK as the jet stream drives our weather and due to contorted flows we can be caught in a deep trough of cold air.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVaprG6EGU7sNh8yzcxgVtJbC7w8hCw6NymJSQTrwfE4/img_0945.jpeg)


This is one of my favorite airports because it's so traveler-friendly. The first time I set foot in Singapore's Changi International Airport was when I was going to Japan and had to transit in Singapore. I found Changi to be incredibly beautiful. There are so many supporting ornaments, and of course, the beautiful Jewel. I loved hanging around Changi and looking at the artificial waterfall. Ah, if I lived in Singapore, I'd go there as often as possible.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcavFNzYR2vLxXjpiwgX7HsevZjXNvnGsAAE7VvspLYzm/img_6950.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTKGNA9KymzuDtbUde6n2jx7oPmXXEAvQJLRh7o4zpab/img_0937.jpeg)



One of the things I love most about Changi is its beautiful, thick carpet. It's very comfortable for transit passengers to sleep on. I've tried it, sleeping on the carpet, and you know that Changi is famous for travelers who choose to sleep at the airport rather than having to rent a dormitory. Aahh, I really like Changi because--even though it's expensive, the airport management doesn't prohibit passengers from staying there, unlike other airports that are very strict and don't provide proper places.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRqeuyW862u7mU5dAPvLQRQUCTUp6N7ePbhdFyNCXxZYT/img_7036.jpg)

Additionally, there's a luggage storage facility that offers highly reliable security. If you're going on a trip and don't want to carry your heavy suitcase, you can simply leave it with one of these. I've tried it, and it's been quite helpful.

| https://images.ecency.com/DQmPsTKThyymbFEyAm5JTrnzDtu8Ma4W8aZHBdqL25SSj5R/img_7034.jpg | https://images.ecency.com/DQmSTjYiSMwQy9XVKfSybQYBQS4vFRrNSZKi8uXdtp77keJ/img_7035.jpg |
| ---| ---|

Third, I love how easy it is to get to the city from this airport. There's a train, making it easy for travelers to get around without having to worry about missing their flight. Lastly, there are tons of free drinking water spots. I love it all. Changi Airport is truly the best airport in the world, I totally agree!

一直都脾胃不咋好，也没有特别的去调理，只是在饮食上注意了很多！从去年开始发现舌中间一道竖裂纹，开始是裂纹会持续一段时间消失，后来就一直持续有，再也不消失了，想着要不自己炒点红枣姜米茶喝喝，看看一段后会不会有改善。

炒这个茶 我一直都是每样用量随意放，有个差不多就可以了。先把姜丝放锅里炒，姜丝炒软后放剪好的红枣和小米，炒至小米金黄色就可以关火出锅了。今天炒至第一遍关火后觉得小米似乎还差点火候，在回炉炒两分钟吧！结果把火打开后，我却鬼使神差的去找了一下 当下不急需的东西，火还开的比最小火大点，是糊味把我召唤过去的😂满屋都弥漫着糊味！一心二用 真的是浪费食材浪费时间。

开始还有点纠结不太糊的那部分还能不能要呢，实在不想重新炒！算了算了，万一糊的影响功效呢，还是从新炒吧！今天用了3个锅才炒成功。想着砂锅好炒呢，结果炒姜时粘锅，又换到铁锅，铁锅又炒糊了，锅上都粘了好多黑炭，刷起来费了老大劲！最后又换到另一个铁锅才算完事。

reserve\\.title: El ruido de los juguetes rotos: El síndrome del niño hiperregalado y el vacío emocional
reserve\\.body: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTmAWQXfZEimur2f4yLfY733A98HtNV6b78V9rPMSjTVK/1776531390957.jpg)\n\nComo psicólogo, una de las conversaciones más recurrentes que tengo con madres y padres en consulta gira en torno a una queja casi universal: \
. Y cuando abrimos el baúl de los juguetes y las rutinas, casi siempre encontramos el mismo diagnóstico ambiental: Sobredosis de regalos y déficit de presencia.\n\nLo llamamos coloquialmente \

. No es una categoría diagnóstica oficial del DSM-V, pero es una realidad clínica que se manifiesta en forma de baja tolerancia a la frustración, apatía crónica y dificultades severas en la gestión emocional.

Hoy quiero hablarte, colega o padre/madre preocupado, sobre la paradoja del exceso. Porque en el fondo, el problema no es el objeto en sí, sino el mensaje que esconde detrás.

La anestesia por saturación

Cuando un niño o adolescente recibe estímulos nuevos (juguetes, tecnología, ropa) de forma constante e indiscriminada, su cerebro entra en un estado que yo llamo \

. El circuito de recompensa se quema. Ya no hay anticipación, no hay deseo, no hay anhelo. Y sin anhelo, el ser humano pierde la capacidad de entusiasmarse por la vida.

He visto en consulta a adolescentes de catorce años con una abulia alarmante. Tienen el mejor móvil del mercado, las zapatillas de moda y dinero en el bolsillo, pero sus ojos están vacíos. ¿La razón? Han recibido tanto a cambio de nada, que su psique ha aprendido que el esfuerzo es inútil y que el mundo exterior debe entretenerlos por decreto.

El regalo como chantaje emocional silencioso

Hay una variante especialmente tóxica de esta dinámica: El Hiperregalo Compensatorio. Es aquel que aparece cuando el adulto, agobiado por la culpa de trabajar demasiadas horas o por la ausencia emocional (aunque esté físicamente presente), llena la habitación del niño de \
.\n\nEl niño no lo verbaliza, pero lo siente a nivel inconsciente: \

. Es un soborno afectivo que, a la larga, enseña al menor a confundir el amor con la posesión material. Así construimos adultos que creen que querer a alguien es comprarle el último iPhone, pero que son incapaces de sostener una conversación incómoda o un abrazo largo.

Pautas para desintoxicar el cuarto de juegos (y el alma)

Desde el ámbito profesional, no se trata de demonizar los regalos ni de volvernos monjes de clausura. Se trata de regular y significar. Aquí algunas claves de intervención educativa que suelo pautar:

1. La regla de los 4 regalos (adaptada): Algo que realmente deseen, algo que necesiten, algo para leer y algo para compartir o donar. Parece simple, pero enseña categorización mental y control de impulsos.
2. La espera obligatoria: Elimina la gratificación instantánea. Estableced un \

mensual donde, si se ha cumplido con ciertas responsabilidades, se adquiere un objeto largamente deseado. La espera fortalece el lóbulo prefrontal.
3. Más presencia, menos paquetes: Esto lo sabes bien, colega. Una tarde de construir un fuerte con sábanas viejas en el salón genera más serotonina y vínculo seguro que cualquier videojuego de última generación envuelto para regalo. El niño no recordará la caja, recordará la risa compartida.

Reflexión final para la comunidad Hive

Quizás este post sirva para que hoy, al llegar a casa, en lugar de abrir Amazon, abras los brazos. El mejor juguete que puede tener un niño hiperregalado es el aburrimiento y un adulto dispuesto a mirarlo a los ojos sin prisas.

Me encantaría leer vuestras experiencias en los comentarios. ¿Habéis detectado estas señales en vuestro entorno familiar o educativo?

Un abrazo,
Roberto Alexander González Alvarez- Psicólogo.

That white spider, which we also call a ‘arañuela’ in Argentina is a real headache. I don’t have a garden at the moment like I used to; it used to be a large garden measuring 20 by 50 metres, but now I only have a balcony. However, that spider is attacking one of my succulents—it’s really going at it so I’ll definitely take your remedy into serious consideration. It seems very useful, easy to make, and effective.

Here’s the recipe a gardener—the foreman of a rose garden—gave me: melt some neutral soap in a container, mix it with plenty of water, and spray it using those special bottles for spraying clothes before ironing. It’s also very effective. Thanks for this tip; I hope it helps lots of people. Have a lovely Sunday!💗

>Esa araña blanca que también en Argentina llamamos arañuela, es un verdadero dolor de cabeza. En este momento no tengo jardín como tenía antes, era un gran jardín de 20x50 metros, ahora sólo tengo un balcón, pero esa araña afecta a una de mis suculentas, se ha ensañado con ella, por lo que tomaré tu remedio muy en cuenta. reserve\\.body:
> ![1000608586.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoputTUUZk3gfWeF8Z5wDp2HKogcWU6xWggxibrYt5paTMV8ZNNzjaJq5qjbCuGUtNG.jpg) *** *** *** Usually we often hear or enjoy beef or chicken sticks. Well, who would have thought that today I have an idea to make sticks from potatoes, these potato sticks are very suitable to be enjoyed by people who are stopping consuming meat, so as a substitute, you can enjoy these vegetarian sticks. Potato sticks are also very safe to give to children at home, the sticks are very soft, not hard at all, just like when children eat boiled potatoes at home, ![1000608585.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23x1HpxWSpkaJyW6oBPi1ShhxFQuGetJZrUMuN7AVMr9VcmbJurwH6ASF1tvmZbfZcjRi.jpg) because of the cooking process, I boil the potatoes first until they are really soft, then I take them out, and mix them with the spices of my choice, finally I fry them until the potatoes are cooked. I got this potato stick recipe from my social media a few days ago and I was curious to make and enjoy potato sticks which I had never tried before. ![1000608583.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMikpSrjxqfVaZiSjt8NkSMLPVEFzscfmc4ULCLBSe7BitmbEA1VqPsBQ7vQ1bDyCCS.jpg) It looks really tempting to my appetite to enjoy it, curious about the recipe, okay, just follow the steps that I will share in my post today *** ###
Materials used
### *** ![1000608072.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23w2oQw7U8n4jiPisygox8kqdAGLEFSg7bXrygfK5wa1d4bSjV7MfGzBZERpRmGMSkcgU.jpg) ***
2 potatoes 1/2 tbsp salt 1/2 tsp pepper 5 tbsp flour Breadcrumbs to taste Sesame seeds (optional)
*** *** ###
Manufacturing procedure
### ***
**First**
*** First of all, I peeled the potato skin until it was clean, then I washed and cut the potatoes into small pieces while I heated the water |![1000608073.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMgkkGRgrEV6T9GSeWjhB6fvVFbahhSrMakUBBTecWn962QdWz6ab36ACoqe13aka1B.jpg)|![1000608074.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wgW5eiHMrQWx1vxkEn4JT8CZiHE7YDBpAT4WRYucjPzR8AH9YMPMPAYgLeCAG92M4st.jpg) |-|-| |![1000608075.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMgycq582MGr2HAam1NWSqXRTMZK21RkBjbSh5E8rbyJ6jxMiBe5VcieJNJ72GhJAFm.jpg)|![1000608076.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoeDsrUVNZPPx8xuB7cJZnUA6euDjuBXpkyyBq9SJDchFRQvDmjjqwgTLoNwhSmEkJM.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Second**
*** Next, I boiled the potatoes until they were soft. Once they were soft, I took them out and mashed them. |![1000608078.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoiVf9CQFfLjeMf9DPkL3gR6oYKxJFMFjVGbtyseVYvjuMUZQoMRDVCMhs3EgS7uCGJ.jpg)|![1000608150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EowFfhqSx4Bwj8PxGapHaSfcugQYHYYmkzhnisdTFAPvhFqpEUmnQLdwKiGCDiQmH3E.jpg) |-|-| |![1000608151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wqkWgKg7fHQtb3c6kF9xP5MMCNsTtLpXEchB4HNrNBH2DbxuhWewJirh18VagYCyYbR.jpg)|![1000608152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eos1kJs7fkfPwxxspAePWXFqcqmMwfjjmTf8kivYKkGzzPxgVLBxzqFQ8BAad6gFYyS.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Third**

body.title: Daily Story: There's so much to do today, starting from this morning. 24 hours won't be enough!
body.body: />Hello, my lovely friends! Today I have another story to share with you. Even though it's a simple story because we haven't been going anywhere, there are still exciting things happening every day. Let's see what happens each day! The story begins early every morning with small chores like sweeping and mopping.\n\n

/>After finishing the housework, it's time to find something to eat. First, I'll make some bread to go with coffee. At first, I thought I wouldn't have coffee, but hey, it doesn't make me feel excited or energetic enough. So, I beat an egg in a small bowl, heated a pan and poured it in. Then I placed slices of bread on top of the egg and cooked both sides. That's it! Sprinkle with chili sauce and it's ready to eat!\n\n

/>In the afternoon, we gathered up items we no longer used but were still in good condition and could be used as second-hand goods, and took them to a place where people collect old items to sell later.\n\n

/>In the evening, we went to the market to buy fruits and vegetables. We thought we wouldn't be able to go out after the rain, but the atmosphere after the rain stopped was so nice. Then, my little girl started posing for photos to show her mom again.\n\n

/>The shop offers many kinds of fruit. Some are displayed in baskets with large prices clearly shown, so customers don't have to spend a long time deciding. They can buy immediately when they feel like it, which is good for faster sales as customers don't have to hesitate about how much to buy and staff don't have to constantly answer price inquiries.\n\n

/>In addition, there were musicians playing beautiful music for people to enjoy. Some kind people put money in the donation box, but it wasn't free. The musicians who were singing and playing guitar had small packets of tissues available; when you put money in the box, you could take one tissue. And the music was so catchy and upbeat that my daughter couldn't stop dancing whenever she heard it.\n\n

/>The last stop before heading home was a dessert shop. They had a wide variety of sweets to choose from at reasonable prices – 35 Thai baht per box, or 3 boxes for 100 baht. Sometimes the colors were a bit too vibrant, so we only bought what we thought would be enjoyable and healthy. We bought one box, but couldn't finish it all! We needed to have dinner by the time we got home. Thank you to everyone who read my article today. Thank you for your continued support and followings. See you again, bye!

What I can tell you about the rain that’s been following you around is that it’s been very productive, and if it inspires you to take wonderful photos like these, then it’s better that it keeps raining. But I’m not going to wish for that, because it would be torture for you. It’s better to think that it rains for about two hours a day, leaving wonderful dewdrops like the ones I see, which make the plants and flowers look majestic and allow a great photographer like you to capture them.

Rain can evoke different emotions; for me it’s inspiring, and for you it makes a photographic composition take on a magical quality. Excellent work!! I love it!! Thank you very much and have a lovely Sunday!🤗

>Lo que puedo decirte respeto de las lluvias que te han perseguido es que han sido muy productivas y que si incentivan a tomar fotografías maravillosas como estas, es mejor que siga lloviendo. Mejor es pensar que llueva unas dos horas al día, deje maravillosas gotas de rocío como las que veo, que hacen que plantas y flores se vean majestuosas y que un gran fotógrafo como vos las capten.

>La lluvia puede generar diversas emociones, en mi es inspiradora y en vos hace que una composición fotográfica cobre magia. Excelente trabajo!! Me encanta!! Muchas gracias y muy buen domingo!🤗

Death as we all know is inevitable as far as human race is concerned,we therefore have to make peace with the subject matter of death as no one will be exempted from it.

MCGI Topic Review | WHY DO PEOPLE DIE (PART 2) https://ecency.com/hive-182074/@thepromise/mcgi-topic-review-or-why-do-people-die-part-2 

God's original intension for man was a Zoe life, death was not part of his plan for man. But then there's a close relationship between sin and calamity,as such the fall of man led to man's death both spiritually and physically.
Death came into existence as a result of disobedience and man's disobedience to God became a sin to God, and his entire agenda for humanity.

When man died spiritually, man's mortal body was also subject to death cause the body doesn't have a life outside the spirit. Humanity literally lost it essence to live and exist like God,as such even the elements was now against man and man became a vulnerable being.

Before the death and resurrection of Christ, death was as a result of man's disobedience and sin against it's maker. But after the resurrection of Christ,death is no longer a subject matter that should breath fear and worries among humanity because death is no longer the end of man. After Christ death and resurrected,it was the beginning of hope for both the death and the living because death is no longer a penalty of sin but death had become a platform of transition into eternity ( heaven and hell) for all men.

Before the death of Christ,death was a penalty of sin but Christ came took all the penalty of man's sin and nail it to his cross.
Today death is a platform for transition into eternity with God,death is only the end of the mortal body and the beginning of a Zoe life.

body.title: Inflation and Life
body.body: > _The rate of inflation in my country is getting higher everyday by day. What's our budget are before can never be the same again, the value of your money can never be what the same thing 2 weeks ago with today. Earlier before now during our elementary schools will record that before inflation can affect the economy it takes a little while sometime years, but these days inflation increases and affect every economy of the country even at the point of stability inflation occur that is how corrupt the country is._

/> [Image Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/stop-inflation-man-male-cartoon-7241624/) _We always make budgets in our various capacity to make sure we spend within what we earn, and at the end of the day you see yourself spending more than you are earning and still struggling to survive, however in our country we have learned to survive even when we are not earning, that is one miraculous or magical aspect of Nigeria I don't understand. The medium individual in the country earn around N80,000 to N100,000._ _Ideally there is no way you plan yourself to leave even as the lowest class entity in the society that N80,000 to N100,000 Naira will be enough for you to sustain yourself for the month before ending another N80,000 to N100,000._ _However you always find a way to device a means to make living so that you can meet up with the current situation. I did have decided to join my work with another part-time job. Is not going to be easy because I'm still running a program in school which is taking about 70% of my actual time. However I have draft out some strategies to be making income outside my actual salary._ _I have evaluated it in a smaller scale and I I believe with the strategy and following it up if I can put a little more capital into it a good amount of money can come as a return._ _Even with the strategy it also required actual funding to make a good living as well. The only way to make action give you and continuous being in profit is doing a business that follows the inflation in the country. That's the only way you can make more money. Most of the Wealthy men in the country, benefit from the inflation, that's why it is becoming difficult to control the bad economy of the country._ __

body.title: Chapter 6: Between Lab Luxury and Field Dust – Why We Need Realistic Engineering
body.body: \n​I often read in prestigious scientific journals about smart technologies and complex software solutions tested in air-conditioned labs under perfect conditions. However, as an engineer who s
/>\n\npent years among generators in mining sites and field operations in Sudan, I know that \
The gap between what researchers write and what we actually need is what I am trying to bridge in this series.  \n​1. \

Engineering vs. European Labs:  \nIn university research, they assume that the internet is always available, electricity is stable, and sensors never fail. But at our sites, we face dust storms and temperatures that make even metals groan. Therefore, when I talk about \
I am not talking about luxury; I am talking about building \
systems that can withstand harsh conditions and guarantee the truth amidst all these challenges.  \n​2. Seeking \
:  \nThe biggest mistake designers make is building complex systems that a field technician cannot handle. The solution we need is a system that the \
trusts second. We need technology that protects our data with the same strength a \

protects an engine from sand.  
​My Message to Young Engineers and Researchers:  
Don't settle for the numbers appearing on your lab screens. Go to the field, feel the heat of the generators, and understand how data gets lost amidst the noise of the machines. The Fourth Industrial Revolution will not succeed in our region unless it stems from our understanding of our local reality and daily struggles.  
​Conclusion:  
In the next chapter, I will reveal the \

I’ve designed to integrate these partners (Ministry of Health, suppliers, and engineers) into a single network where everyone trusts each other without the need for a middleman.\n\n#Engineering #things #BusinessGrowth #Blockchain

</center>

你们有没有过摆地摊的经历？上大学时勤工俭学，去南昌最大的批发市场——洪城大市场批发一些饰品到校门口售卖。

那时候的精品店非常火爆，所以饰品还是挺好卖的。现在因为电商和淘宝的盛行，这种店很难开下去了，已经倒闭了多家。但是商场的“绿光”精品店生意不错，都在一楼的显眼位置处。看来门店还要开的大才行呀！

话说摆地摊我们今天就来安排了，三姐老早就网购了一些小孩子的玩具，说让孩子们体验一下这个谋生的辛艰和摆摊的乐趣。说干就干，批了好几百块钱的东西，有玩具、有发夹、发箍、还有泡泡水等等。

三姐带着她的三个孩子就在街边摆起了地摊。我带着两个宝去找她们。刚好中午给她换一下，方便她回家吃饭。三姐说一个上午都没开张，在哪里摆摊呢？就在我们上次去的林科院，但是林科院的花已经谢了。没有多少人来这里玩了，人比较少自然就很难开张嘛！而且一般像这种公园门口如果是卖饮品会比玩具好卖很多，所以地址跟选品都很重要。

看这个发箍多好看啊，仙气飘飘的，好吸引人呢，小女孩戴上肯定很好看。

还有部分 3D 打印机打印出来的玩具，连我都没见过。我家大宝一个人就挑了八样玩具和发夹。我转钱给三姐又被她退了回来。

三姐还准备了自制麻辣藕片过来卖呢！还是挺用心的，行动力非常强。我也想着等大夏天的时候，自己制作冰绿豆和冰凉粉到校门口或者是景点门口卖，带上两个孩子帮忙，今年一定要试试。

趁着他们回去吃饭的功夫，我就成了临时的地摊老板了。见到小朋友我就吆喝着:“小朋友，买玩具吧！”我边吆喝边安排大宝把弄玩具吸引他们。

这时一个男孩想买一把小风扇，我给三姐打去视频得知只要10 元，家长也非常爽快的付款，总算帮三姐开了个张。

一直等到他们几个吃完午饭回来，再没卖出第二件商品，后来我们把摊位移到林科院大门口，这样更醒目一点。

待了两个多小时我家孩子就坐不住了，尤其是大宝吵着要去旭辉广场玩。年前充值的充气城堡花了 300 元，玩了一次，结果年后就没看到影子。

都说不能随便乱充值吧，当时我充值的时候我还犹豫呢，毕竟是在商场一楼搭建的，问他们会不会中途不开了，他说他们一直营业，结果过完年这么久了都没见到人来，也不知道会不会来，没有任何联系方式，也许这 300 元就打水漂了。

我提议先去旭辉旁边的经开公园看看，如果那边人多就让三姐把摊子转移过去，看看效果如何。

到了经开公园，这里比往常的人少，可能是天气渐渐热起来了，白天温度较高，在外面游玩的人并不多。但是摊位还是比林科院多多了。很多在草坪上摆摊的，卖玩具卖风筝都有。

我跟三姐说明了情况，三姐还是选择在林科院那边继续摆着。后来我问战绩如何，她说一共卖了不到三十块。第一天摆摊，生意虽淡，收获却不少。重要的不是赚了多少钱，而是让孩子们亲身体验一回生活的不容易。

我想，这次经历，对孩子们来说，会是一次很特别的成长。

---

body.title: El hastío de no saber cómo ni cuándo desconectar - Reflexiones filosóficas de un pensador nocturno: 19/04/2026
body.body:
> Un problema muy común y que pocas veces se menciona en el mundo actual es el del hastío que todos sentimos por momentos ante la realidad que acontece, ya sea a nivel personal o global. Es por ello que en este post de reflexiones filosóficas de hoy es el tema que vamos a tratar. ### El hastío o cansancio: ¿A qué se debe? Pocos temas con mayor carga filosófica que este existen, y sin duda que al profundizar ante el mismo nos daremos cuenta del porqué. Ya que el hastío es un problema tan común de sentir como cualquier otro tipo de emoción en la vida, pero con efectos negativos de todo tipo para nosotros si no tenemos cuidado. Ahora, darnos cuenta de que no tenemos más que cansancio y agotamiento en el ánimo por la rutina y ritmo de vida que frecuentemente estamos obligados a cumplir o llevar (o por cualquier otra motivación) es el primer paso para entender de qué va todo esto.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVdrLRJzHVjsuQwC4uY1B7U8djjDvzEaweV48riyJHTh5/image.png) [Fuente de imagen](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-sadness-depression-tiredness-7185943/)
Ir al trabajo, asistir a la universidad, pagar facturas, salir de compras, ver siempre las mismas caras, lugares, o hacer siempre las mismas cosas es, de alguna manera, algo que se va acumulando en nuestro estado de ánimo, hasta que lleguemos a sentir en algún punto que nos agota, lo que a su vez nos genera un sensación de frustración. Salir de este estado de inercia o sofoco, no es fácil, ya que una vez que hemos detectado qué es lo que causa nuestro hastío, la primera impresión que tenemos suele ser superficial o errónea por lo que requiere que nos estudiemos muy bien a nivel personal para entender qué es exactamente (y realmente) lo que nos está generando el problema, para luego poder solventarlo de raíz. Ya que podemos sentir en un primer momento que estamos cansados o agotados ante el todo (ante todo en nuestra existencia), pero nunca resulta ser cierto, porque siempre hay una causa (o serie de causas limitadas) que son las culpables de nuestro estado de ánimo negativo. El mayor problema y riesgo que percibo con respecto a la sensación de hastío (para ser directos) es que perdemos la confianza en nosotros mismos, nos sentimos vulnerables, inseguros y dejamos de perseverar. Si bien la sensación de agotamiento de por sí es indicativo de un nivel de depresión en cierto grado, cuando dejamos de sentir confianza en nuestros pensamientos, decisiones y en lo que hacemos, es cuando la depresión se intensifica y el desgano o desánimo puede volverse una cosa patológica. Eso es precisamente lo que hay que evitar en todo esto.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQma6HUqcXEiPBbYincARw8oSkGoS1Rs6bZWPUdGToukbCn/image.png) [Fuente de imagen](https://pixabay.com/photos/girl-young-lifestyle-woman-female-1026246/)
### El problema no es la rutina es otra cosa Uno de los mayores peligros iniciales con el tema del hastío es el de subestimar el problema o el de estimar erróneamente las causas del mismo. Ya que hay que entender que veces el hartazgo nos viene de la sensación (real o imaginaria) ante una situación conflictiva que nos genera enorme incomodidad, es crónica o parece insolventable. Obviamente se trata de un estado de ánimo negativo, pero el problema de fondo, si lo analizamos, no es la rutina per sé (como ya habremos intuido), ni tampoco es que sea insolventable desde un estricto punto de vista analítico, sino que generalmente viene de no saber cómo manejar nuestras emociones y nuestro tiempo. Eso es lo que nos genera el cansancio o hastío a final de cuentas. Ahora, como siempre digo, sentir hastío en la vida podemos tomarlo como una cosa positiva, si lo vemos como el síntoma o móvil para entender qué nos pasa, porqué nos sentimos así y para lograr lo que queremos lograr a través de un cambio proactivo de acciones concretas en nuestra vida. Diciéndolo en otras palabras, esto pasa por entender la raíz de nuestra infelicidad o inconformidad y no hay otra forma mejor de verlo y abordarlo.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd8DpWwLnF56kbptD1JPjtaLTsV5vDFRGuoPhxaYC5KsX/image.png) [Fuente de imagen](https://pixabay.com/photos/portrait-man-male-person-adult-2194457/)
### ¿Cómo superar el hastío en la vida? Aparte de todo lo que he expresado hasta ahora, considero que el hastío o tedio viene más que todo de no saber cómo ni cuándo desconectarnos mentalmente ni emocionalmente de las situaciones, esto es lo que nos genera apatía, desánimo y falta de energía. Porque cuando no nos damos cuenta de que estamos cansados física o mentalmente (por una jornada de trabajo o actividad extenuante) podemos llegar a los excesos, y seguir forzándonos a continuar; y precisamente eso es lo que hace que nuestro estado de ánimo nos pase factura inmediata a través de la sensación de fastidio o hartazgo. El hastío se manifiesta en ese caso como desgano, como incapacidad para cumplir nuestras obligaciones personales a pesar de nuestro interés y empeño por llevarlas a cabo. Por lo que cuando eso pasa sucede que debemos hacer una tarea, y estamos dispuestos a hacerla, pero de alguna manera, nuestra mente no colabora (no prestamos atención, o no nos vienen las ideas necesarias o correctas para actuar), ya que nuestras energías físicas y mentales se sienten mermadas. Pero debo aclarar que existen formas efectivas para superar el problema del agotamiento o hastío. Se podrían hablar de muchos métodos, pero en esencia, todos ellos de reducen a identificar lo que nos causa el agotamiento, y atacar la raíz de lo que lo produce. Si es el cansancio por jornadas de trabajo muy seguidas o muy duras, entonces debemos buscar tiempo para descansar, para relajarnos y poner la mente y nuestras acciones en otra cosa. Y si por alguna razón nos urge de cualquier forma realizar lo que nos causa fatiga, siempre podremos suavizar el impacto de la faena con pequeños descansos de minutos o por poner música relajante o por practicar meditación durante esos minutos. Esto nos permitirá desconectar de lo que nos estresa y permitirá reducir nuestra sensación de agotamiento.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgoJXALbt6izo7QsVvAGyF58XWcsTtZcLpxawF8C3nLu/image.png) [Fuente de imagen](https://pixabay.com/photos/girl-meditation-nature-yoga-4981766/)
Puede parecer simple, pero escuchar la música que nos gusta (aclaro que cuando hablo de música, me refiero a la real y armoniosa, y no al ruido que suelen escuchar las masas) activa ondas cerebrales en nosotros que nos ponen en una mejor disposición personal y nos aliviana las cargas o tareas. Pero debo reconocer que a nivel personal (aunque ya sabía todo esto que les comento en este post hoy), a veces lo olvido por tantas cosas. Recientemente me sentía de esta manera y mi disposición mental mejoró oyendo música clásica y jazz. Si no te gusta ninguno de esos géneros, puedes elegir el que más te guste, siempre y cuando recuerdes que tiene que ser una música que te inspire tranquilidad y armonía, ya que cualquier tipo de música que haga lo opuesto generaría en ti el efecto contrario al que buscas. A veces el simple cambio de aires, tomarte un café o un té con un amigo o ponerte a ver un programa de Tv que te guste, o salir a dar una caminata para despejar la mente, puede lograr un cambio significativo en nuestro estado de ánimo. El caso es que muy en el fondo todos tenemos (como parte de nuestra propia autogestión emocional y personal) la obligación y la responsabilidad de experimentar y descubrir por cuenta propia lo que puede reducir o eliminar nuestros niveles de agotamiento o hastío y aplicarlo. Sabiendo y haciendo todo lo que hemos conversado en este post de reflexiones de hoy sabremos cómo y cuándo desconectar para lograr superar ese problema tan común de la modernidad; recordemos que nuestra felicidad personal y efectividad de nuestras acciones dependerá siempre de ello. **¿Qué opinas sobre el tema tratado? Por favor comenta.**

body.title: POLLO A LA PARRILLA CON ARROZ-----GRILLED CHICKEN WITH RICE
body.body:
Buenos dias a todos los componentes de esta maravillosa plataforma social, sabemos que los fines de semana como el domingo, son muy buenos porque marcan el comienzo del esperado descanso, el cual nos merecemos, luego de haber compartidos las rutinas diarias de la semana, es por eso que prepare para el almuerzo una comidad muy repetida, pero es la que mas facil se preparar y la que mas sabrosa sale siempre, como lo es el pollo a la parrilla bien condimentado, acompañado con arroz.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/Eonm4NM7edBzNEmWHZnfUHBVcQSrJkS2UqYcEgMuXEN3rRBiAkxiJPcc8KetaE1kMkF.png)

Para cocinar el arroz, agregamos la olla, en la hornalla de la cocina, le vertemos un poco de aceite, luego unos dientes de ajo, para luego comenzar a verter el arroz, para ir revolviendolo lentamente, luego se le agrega agua caliente, tapamos la olla y dejamos que se asiente y asi queda listo el mismo.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/23tSUESrV3D5MxuafQ6cGJeGUniPb9N36U8U28b7xU6xyzHBwJLPXBPQvZFZw2BBzcgZp.png)

De esta forma preparamos el almuerzo del dia domingo, el cual lo concidero un dia muy especial.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR LEERME Y SEGUIRME.

TRADUCIDO AL INGLES

Good morning to all the members of this wonderful social platform. We know that weekends like Sunday are very good because they mark the beginning of the much-awaited rest that we deserve after sharing the daily routines of the week. That's why I prepared for lunch a very repetitive dish, but it's the easiest to prepare and always the tastiest, like well-seasoned grilled chicken, accompanied by rice.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/Eonm4NM7edBzNEmWHZnfUHBVcQSrJkS2UqYcEgMuXEN3rRBiAkxiJPcc8KetaE1kMkF.png)

To cook the rice, we place the pot on the stove, pour in a bit of oil, then add a few cloves of garlic, and start pouring in the rice, stirring it slowly. Next, we add hot water, cover the pot, and let it sit, and that's how it's ready.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/23tSUESrV3D5MxuafQ6cGJeGUniPb9N36U8U28b7xU6xyzHBwJLPXBPQvZFZw2BBzcgZp.png)

This is how we prepare lunch for Sunday, which I consider a very special day.

THANK YOU VERY MUCH FOR READING AND FOLLOWING ME.

body.title: 🌸 Spring in the City – Between Concrete and Nature 🌿/🌸 Wiosna w mieście – między betonem a naturą 🌿
body.body:
🌸 Spring in the City – Between Concrete and Nature 🌿

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWrg549cevxnftubZ19TmChm1scPovKdjxsYgVnq3v79J/1776586325117.jpg)

There are moments in the year when the city suddenly softens.
The rush fades away, the gray of the sidewalks stops being dominant, and between the roads and buildings… something magical begins to happen.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVoEBphcz3bhY1b1JigBPQfyiL4NdPrvzNCvtfqvSvksy/1776586359373.jpg)

At first, quietly – single tulips peeking out from grassy patches along the streets.
Then more boldly – bright yellow forsythia lighting up every corner.
Until suddenly everything bursts into green, pink, and sunlight.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYtN959hL6kkRXNiXMRk82oWcBZPzedGT9TUxdV5jYYBM/1776586384392.jpg)

And just like that, even an ordinary walk to the store turns into a small adventure.
A stroll among trees slowly waking up to life…
Shadows of branches dancing on the path…
The scent of earth after winter…

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS7eLrPcjeVSEJnfkZiU27BQycXnASuR7xc2cWrPKXTwq/1776586410681.jpg)

The city breathes.
And we breathe with it.

I love that moment when nature reminds us that we don’t have to go far to find peace.
Sometimes it’s enough to slow down and simply look around.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPSBpHfjEeUC4AAMV7tB547kRXuhMa4oRfKBfRPQzAi7U/1776586465282.jpg)

Because spring is everywhere – even where we usually see only asphalt. 🌱

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU36mZJSVRo9n63y57tvMtgNH53UVfEk1y8nbBa7gMxzx/1776586483522.jpg)

#photofeed #spring #citylife #nature #photography #urbanjungle #naturelovers #walk #mindfulness

🌸 Wiosna w mieście – między betonem a naturą 🌿

Są takie momenty w roku, kiedy miasto nagle mięknie.
Znika gdzieś ten pośpiech, szarość chodników przestaje być dominująca, a między pasami ruchu i blokami… zaczyna dziać się magia.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUjaLbLhpgEU3k2kuz5WLU7Qj7aHREJiDq28ddSBVZbqQ/1776586507355.jpg)

Najpierw nieśmiało – pojedyncze tulipany wychylające się z trawników przy ulicy.
Potem coraz śmielej – żółte forsycje, które jakby chciały rozświetlić każdy zakamarek.
Aż w końcu wszystko naraz wybucha zielenią, różem i światłem.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPQbfXYPSUwchQfC3XUdcmmrYxFhiHYQgGUg4qpqhfZrz/1776586539157.jpg)

I nagle okazuje się, że nawet zwykła droga do sklepu może zamienić się w małą przygodę.
Spacer między drzewami, które dopiero budzą się do życia…
Cień gałęzi na ścieżce…
Zapach ziemi po zimie…

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmScXB21Y24NiMBfX2pcQS6n2w9uniNGUktJyBCKwRz9gu/1776586561060.jpg)

Miasto oddycha.
I my razem z nim.

Lubię ten moment, kiedy natura przypomina nam, że nie trzeba uciekać daleko, żeby znaleźć spokój.
Czasem wystarczy zwolnić krok i rozejrzeć się dookoła.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYig3Jb3jYsUAsXYFH5AuwnTL6basSMSKNHrTZy153Qoi/1776586576085.jpg)

Bo wiosna jest wszędzie – nawet tam, gdzie na co dzień widzimy tylko asfalt. 🌱

#photofeed #spring #citylife #nature #photography #wiosna #miasto #spacer #naturelovers #urbanjungle

body.title: Sakura Haiku 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
body.body:
![IMG_8214.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/Ep7uaS5jhe66PFDUxRzjEKkByiWRm3oua5Bugu3RzJ3LyKLtsYLe1ZgM7N2ofmSGsQG.JPG) I don’t want to say too much today; I’d rather just let my pictures speak for themselves. It’s still cherry blossom season, and I didn’t want to miss out on this wonderful spectacle again this year. As usual, it all went by way too fast, but it’s probably this very fleeting nature that makes this time of year so special. That's why I've brought us a little haiku today—a Japanese poem that perfectly captures the magic of the cherry blossoms once again. When you read through the words, you immediately realize that nothing more needs to be said.
__桜の木の下では__
__誰もが他人では__
__なくなる__
__Sakuranoki no shita dewa__
__daremoga tanin dewa__
__naku naru__
Under cherry-flowers, None are utter strangers.
(Issa)
![IMG_8207.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EpVB9uFKfq2jBxTk3fCD8FxmkYRrYtwh2xqX19FQdW2HYLm88YkKYbQkF7JTFCUQ2Qw.JPG) DEUTSCH Heute will ich gar nicht so viele Worte verlieren, sondern einfach mal meine Bilder für sich sprechen lassen. Es ist irgendwie immer noch Kirschblütenzeit, und dieses wundervolle Schauspiel habe ich mir auch in diesem Jahr nicht entgehen lassen. Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. This post is a simple trip with my wife. It was a simple trip for us before our autistic son's school break. And we haven't been able to go anywhere since our son's school break. At that time after my wife and I take our granddaughter and autistic son to school. My wife and I went to Mae Ai District to enjoy the scenery in the district. It's just a short drive from our district to Mae Ai district, the distance is approximately 30 kilometers.

The atmosphere of our journey on the main road from our district to Mae Ai district.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVSb4G9Wb7qLD9YQw2FSxFYRpouXQfEHhk5vA9YyHJiFd/1776580789817.jpg)

body.title: The Hidden Beauty of Flowers
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYUjemG6WvbeLYVCj673AJtZTgFHSN4kLWEHHSMQsHbEs/1776582981488.jpg)

How are you, friends? Best wishes to you all, wherever you are.

We often overlook many wild plants and vegetation, but we often overlook them. They may seem insignificant to us, but there's a hidden beauty hidden within these wild plants. One such beauty is the beauty of flowers emerging from these wild plants.

But on my journey today, as I stepped into a rice paddy, I clearly saw wild plants growing among the grass and other weeds, blooming beautifully. Bright red and yellow colors adorned the flowers. This flower is called lantana, as our people call it. Small petals cluster together to form a beautiful flower.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRrbwd5tSSEMjfbixutUZT5yT2G6JmenGYz3iQbGGMFdT/1776582981555.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNxrfjh7wjYmmYqd4xiRi7rgk5XpTJPqUUJVfN4CFkQ2Q/1776582981674.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaNEHXrnvsr7qVGqm9DuEhYvPqoxGGn4bWdJHHSssHck5/1776582981758.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXjjWfY4zMg6E3TgtsnzdnKMdDGsrnwwgEaJbS9XvpeZG/1776582981842.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmavCQ1XBpSX6MWzeosjpsrvxMcwJTDhJVbYCSNwyaVsnd/1776583057423.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFX7y311hiuHk2o8CLeXzBNVACtuf9x5ZxqWwYh2o6jY/1776583057581.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXVvtFkJcnZQxfpeVkz7YppNnUKbqZM3UZWAjJg7qSqRP/1776583057671.jpg)

The small branches are green and flexible. Tiny, thorn-like hairs adorn the branches of this lantana flower. The flowers grow between the leaf axils. This is one of nature's beautiful paintings.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUQedNMfpwgcg4HWuCkg6fa62KEoykzCoBcv3FWyx7NEu/1776583057785.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSEt5mWtHupNudiXpbiNn97kWoF4BiWGxGnJaWEsox7SX/1776583057887.jpg)

Although the flowers are small, the leaves are wide and large, with a deep green color. They have clearly visible leaf fin lines.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSywpLVd1HDX6WN7QsMMfcTARyHAY4TfmDZpp2MX48qhv/1776583111196.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSV5V83hChdpi7Nt7B9p54iVRdqGH25GmFknEptyVZkTq/1776583111306.jpg)

On closer inspection, I saw small green fruits and small black ones. The green ones were still young, while the black ones were ripe and mature. I didn't expect this wild plant to bear fruit in addition to its beautiful flowers.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXG9QmCQydooqoGBV5phHzDDdr2FfhpWBZQ6bSLvY1sek/1776583111420.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYwmkGrFAUGALatAdvsM7VyCBvQSexV1wHQhhJh44fGXu/1776583111502.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbrhFSFMGUnMYxUQ8zfx9NSjFEyRC3fPP27G3VzXEbuwE/1776583111572.jpg)

This is a wild lantana plant that I found on the edge of grass and weeds near a rice field in North Aceh, Kuta Makmur district. The wild plant I found was almost a meter tall among the other grass and weeds. I hope you enjoy the images I've shown.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRXzaH9yrsoyDJL8FhrujcdJxwmuRNL75Y7rFh8AevG1w/1776583137536.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcPdeKPA49edKcgfcFsykoEedvZYLvrKev7JvVVx9qLbK/1776583137675.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb4KqcdWmTRrugdn9qzDSSeFQMf1q9viSvPpcAcU3wLvg/1776583137798.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQjhsjYA9xKr1K6jkY7FuTV2vB4rUn2WLr511C2hqG1c/1776583137986.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaeac8YsFthM88NVLisqANieiWbUPgveappAAkBrHuYoz/1776583138186.jpg)

body.title: Curator Cat on Caturday: Days Are Getting Warmer!
body.body:
Greetings Fabulous Felines and Hoomans of Hivelandia and surrounding communities!

I hope your weekend has been treating you well so far, and that you had a wonderful Caturday!

![2817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23tmLE18mUh8evDFzu7SvThQSE426PLot36rhCAhNTs2kGSZQzw2CfE7U2dmfpci2Eys8.jpg)
*Shangri, enjoying the sunny spot!*

In our little corner of the world, it finally seems to be getting a little bit warmer, and the sun has a little more *\

* than it did even just 2 weeks ago.

The Hoomans have started their gardening projects and spend a lot more time outside now. I actually quite like that because they always are bringing in interesting new smells when they return to the house!

![2645.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/244eEjL76trAct4YeoDZBHvdnS82PYQ2F7e8cWUkjDhtnAFEUfnj267VyUqgf3F8rba2U.jpg)
*Nala in her perch*

The Mom-Hooman even brought us in a special treat the other day. It was a planter tub that had been outside and had grown with nothing but grass in it so she thought it would be some good greenery for us!

And she was right of course! We were all over that grass as soon as it came in!

![2851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23ynQW1U8YFxGFSzCRHo43nPiFdWZeR4myWg6X7pF5YChYLmg1jbVqT7q93KBHi2Uf4Kz.jpg)
*Always a challenge to get all the cats in one photo!*

Just goes to show that even cats need to eat their vegetables!

Thankfully the Dad-Hooman has finally finished with that thing he keeps calling taxes which was causing him a great deal of stress. I don't like it when he is under stress because he becomes kind of grumpy and doesn't have much time for cats.

![2723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23xKsyqJb7AEj6zouymCopdSjHUwQanMdivxKPSPruwis4efCCKcixYP9EWbMjEDfLZ8x.jpg)
*Portrait time!*

But now he is pretty much back to his happy self and that's great.

It has been nice to finally see our Hive token — as well as the rest of the cryptosphere — showing a little more life over the past week or so.

![1824.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23x15Ec1a5j9HPCSaeVH1MhGatcvVnLgquKLwiHCEzQWdZ4A9keptRMjuQZ3uc3PCpoNs.jpg)
*Best friends*

While I realize that is still a lot of uncertainty and unrest in the world that can cause everything to come crashing down again, it's still nice to have a few days when things are going in a positive direction!

Our very furry housemate smudge got her spring haircut a few days ago, but she made me promise that I would not post any pictures of her until at least a *little* of her hair has grown back out!

![2725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23z7E4NM9d9krKASaNABFotSYhNBTMxUmJNpSrRD7pLEK98AnH8UeCyDLqPjKEZwxBs5v.jpg)

I can understand that perfectly. We cats do tend to be somewhat vain, after all!

And that's about all we have to offer for this week. I hope your weekend continues to be a good one and we appreciate you visiting our little cat blog!

# =^..^=

![CC0000-AI-Free.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23wqZfkRC9Jh5ik8xPCQA75bg6ezLJfhLUB7G1zH17zWy9DZMCpSZkhaUdvZzN4KZXBu2.jpg)

body.title: Volviendo a la rutina de los asados del domingo en familiaºººººReturning to the routine of Sunday family barbecues
body.body:
Hola a todos los seguidores de esta maravillosa plataforma social, en donde y cada uno agrega con sus post o publicaciones un granito de arena, por el solo hecho de agregar como lo que podemos ver y leer, referente a compartir un asado de domingo con la familia, el contiene, chorizo casero, morcilla, tira de costilla de carne de res y pata y muslo de pollo.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/Ep3crzATnQZBspNALFRDhk3co8sWH45BUkgaPJjgPoVCLTrcucLTMtfp8A1D44T28zP.png)

Asi que amigos para un asado, lo primero que se debe hacer es encendder el fuego en este caso el carbon, con leños, que una ves encendido quedan las brasas al rojo, para luego agregarlas debajo de la parrilla.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tmFP1GnjcSQMVYGvvA39Shj7fPESQrfXcw1U2sx3ycceYADuPrvtX3ku53F2sEkWs13.png)

Bueno como todo asado comence de la siguiente manera, luego de agregar las brasas, la parrilla, lo siguiente fue agregar la carne de res-costilla y las patas y muslo de pollo.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/EoEq6213yT2dUevBFLLDcdvyqZyFHvtb2gkibUJa77GqJemUrPrrxCDbPMw4qRtXpYo.png)

Luego de que dicha carne se cocine de un lado, al darla vuelta para que se termine de cocinar, agregue tambien los chorizos y la morcilla.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23vsSpXXf1aSFQyEU8zinMCGixhmw3DNJW15Vn9mokRdh1iFJ5pvRVsMRfMQ24vz49Djo.png)

Como lo podemos ver en esta fotografia, de esta manera se cocina todo junto y acerlo de manera lenta o sea con poco fuego, dicha carne sale bien cocinada y jugosa.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/Eos2Cz65AFWYELJPq4x3EahyxbPktgf1Uaategs67uojc8GoFPgd39mkDrPLCeYGdWS.png)

Asi que una todo cocinado, a la carne la cortamos en trozos pequeños, como asi tambien el pollo y los chorizos.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/EpJY9qKU2YAuNQS2GLuM1EFcn6emwmTucMNfo6ogZ5gZXcaboKjYn2RdpFxuoRiXf5y.png)

Acompañando dicho asado con lechuga y ensalada rusa o sea papa, arbejas, zanahoria, papa, huevo, choclo y mayonesa.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR SEGUIRME Y LEERME, QUE PASEN UN BELLO DOMINGO.

ENGLISH

Hello to all the followers of this wonderful social platform, where each one of you adds a grain of sand with your posts or publications, simply by adding what we can see and read, regarding sharing a Sunday barbecue with the family, which includes homemade chorizo, blood sausage, beef rib strips, and chicken leg and thigh.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/Ep3crzATnQZBspNALFRDhk3co8sWH45BUkgaPJjgPoVCLTrcucLTMtfp8A1D44T28zP.png)

So, friends, for a barbecue, the first thing you need to do is light the fire, in this case, the charcoal, with logs, which once lit, the embers glow red, and then you add them under the grill.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tmFP1GnjcSQMVYGvvA39Shj7fPESQrfXcw1U2sx3ycceYADuPrvtX3ku53F2sEkWs13.png)

Well, like any barbecue, I started as follows: after adding the coals and the grill, the next step was to add the beef ribs and the chicken legs and thighs.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/EoEq6213yT2dUevBFLLDcdvyqZyFHvtb2gkibUJa77GqJemUrPrrxCDbPMw4qRtXpYo.png)

After the meat has cooked on one side, when flipping it to finish cooking, also add the chorizos and the blood sausage.

body.title: Why conservation of resources is so important?
body.body:
Hello, Ram Ram, Namaste, Sastriyakal, to all Hive users. Today, I'll tell you that why conservation of resources is so important. All of us know that there are two types of resources of the basis of their exhaustability, which are renewable and non-renewable resources. Resource is defined as any object or thing that can fulfill our need and which is economically feasible and culturally acceptable. Mostly the non-renewable resources should be preserved and used wisely, but, humans are not using them wisely and increasing the use of resources day-by-day. We should perform sustainable development which is very much useful. Sustainable development means using resources wisely and preserving them for the use of future generations.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdGP6GC9hiM7LftZtTSmw2pWNcnqsZULmxVE9gbqyEev4/iiiii.png)




[img src](chatgpt.com)

The non-renewable resources are so important because they are less in quantity and they take a lot of time to get renewed after being used so, that's why non-renewable resources play an important role in the world. If these resources will not be used wisely then furture generations would not be able to use these resources and this would be the wastage of the resources. Resources help us in our daily life, like petrol and disel helps us to travel in our vehicle and for public transport and for moving from one place to another rapidly like from one continent to other and even from first to last place on the Earth, everything is possible due to technology and resources, if resources get fully used, by not caring about future generation then, this could be destructive and the upcoming generations would suffer a lot so, we should use resources wisely and most importantly non-renewable resources.

body.title: Ananas comosus - Bromeliaceae (ENG/ITA)
body.body: > ### Ananas comosus - Bromeliaceae (ENG) Ananas comosus is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Bromeliaceae family. It has a basal rosette of leathery leaves, linear and spiny at the edges, from which a short stem emerges bearing the inflorescence. **The fruit, commonly called pineapple, is actually a sorosio, that is, a set of berries welded together and with the central rachis. The plant is native to tropical South America, but is now cultivated in many warm climate areas.** ![ananas.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EqJ4npobjP6Hc6L4usz6t3zvUJVxDMzEcWAFERmDmnpimjxmDVehpWfuC62FBKwcW4C.png) image created with canva.com Pineapple requires constant temperatures and does not tolerate the cold: the minimum cultivation temperature is 10 °C, below which the plant drastically slows down growth or may suffer damage. It prefers well-drained soil, rich in organic substance and a bright exposure. In optimal conditions it can bear fruit once a year. The period of maximum concentration of the active ingredients in the parts used is August, when the fruit reaches full ripeness and the enzymatic activity of bromelain is highest. **Main active ingredient: bromelain Bromelain is a complex of proteolytic enzymes contained mainly in the stem and, to a lesser extent, in the fruit. It has the ability to break down proteins, a characteristic shared with other plant enzymes such as papain (papaya) and ficin (ficus).** Anti-inflammatory: useful in the treatment of edema, trauma, bruises and inflammatory conditions of soft tissues. Diuretic: promotes the drainage of body fluids and can be used in case of water retention. Carminative and digestive: facilitates the digestion of proteins and reduces the formation of intestinal gas. Functional food: the fruit is rich in water, fibre, vitamins (especially vitamin C) and minerals. The only activity fully recognized as a food is that linked to the consumption of the fruit, which provides nutrients and substances useful for general well-being. Pineapple juice Obtained from fresh fruit, it retains part of the bromelain and digestive and diuretic properties. It is consumed as a functional drink, especially if obtained from ripe fruit and not pasteurized (pasteurization inactivates the enzymes). **The toxicity of pineapple is low, but bromelain can: cause allergic contact reactions in sensitive individuals; interfere with some antibiotics, especially tetracyclines; enhance the effect of anticoagulants and antiaggregants (data to be considered in a clinical setting).** Avoid Ananas comosus supplements during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Always consult a doctor before taking phytotherapeutic preparations containing bromelain, especially in the presence of pharmacological therapies. **Pineapple intended for large-scale distribution is often harvested before fully ripe, compromising aroma and sweetness. To choose a ripe fruit: smell the base: a sweet and intense scent indicates optimal maturation; check that the central leaves come off with a light pull; check that the peel is elastic and not too green.** ![hive dividers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/23t7BKexriBKviA9doWkBpvE3WA2yKQxfis1QCtDQU7rvAhxaNrDHcMfy5XLqadsaDEDf.png) ### Ananas comosus - Bromeliaceae (ITA) Ananas comosus è una pianta erbacea perenne appartenente alla famiglia delle Bromeliaceae. Presenta una rosetta basale di foglie coriacee, lineari e spinose ai margini, da cui emerge un fusto corto che porta l’infiorescenza. **Il frutto, comunemente chiamato ananas, è in realtà un sorosio, cioè un insieme di bacche saldate tra loro e con il rachide centrale. La pianta è originaria del Sud America tropicale, ma oggi è coltivata in molte aree a clima caldo.** ![fitoterapia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EoiW7vV1iNdbPAu48RSNX3FA44CE16HK74aEHuWEf5mZSMQWgTc91zo14mQKHWyiLLo.jpg) image created with canva.com L’ananas richiede temperature costanti e non tollera il freddo: la temperatura minima di coltivazione è 10 °C, sotto la quale la pianta rallenta drasticamente la crescita o può subire danni. Predilige terreni ben drenati, ricchi di sostanza organica e un’esposizione luminosa. In condizioni ottimali può fruttificare una volta all’anno. Il periodo di massima concentrazione dei principi attivi nelle parti utilizzate è agosto, quando il frutto raggiunge la piena maturazione e l’attività enzimatica della bromelina è più elevata. **Principio attivo principale: bromelina La bromelina è un complesso di enzimi proteolitici contenuti soprattutto nel gambo e, in misura minore, nel frutto. Ha la capacità di scindere le proteine, caratteristica condivisa con altri enzimi vegetali come papaina (papaya) e ficina (ficus).** Antinfiammatoria: utile nel trattamento di edemi, traumi, contusioni e stati infiammatori dei tessuti molli. Diuretica: favorisce il drenaggio dei liquidi corporei e può essere impiegata in caso di ritenzione idrica. Carminativa e digestiva: facilita la digestione delle proteine e riduce la formazione di gas intestinali. Alimento funzionale: il frutto è ricco di acqua, fibre, vitamine (soprattutto vitamina C) e minerali. L’unica attività pienamente riconosciuta come alimento è quella legata al consumo del frutto, che apporta nutrienti e sostanze utili al benessere generale. Succo di ananas Ottenuto dal frutto fresco, conserva parte della bromelina e delle proprietà digestive e diuretiche. È consumato come bevanda funzionale, soprattutto se ottenuto da frutti maturi e non pastorizzato (la pastorizzazione inattiva gli enzimi). **La tossicità dell’ananas è bassa, ma la bromelina può: provocare reazioni allergiche da contatto in soggetti sensibili; interferire con alcuni antibiotici, in particolare le tetracicline; potenziare l’effetto di anticoagulanti e antiaggreganti (dato da considerare in ambito clinico).** Evitare integratori di Ananas comosus in gravidanza e allattamento. Consultare sempre un medico prima di assumere preparati fitoterapici contenenti bromelina, soprattutto in presenza di terapie farmacologiche. **L’ananas destinato alla grande distribuzione viene spesso raccolto prima della piena maturazione, compromettendo aroma e dolcezza. Per scegliere un frutto maturo: annusare la base: un profumo dolce e intenso indica maturazione ottimale; verificare che le foglie centrali si stacchino con una leggera trazione; controllare che la buccia sia elastica e non troppo verde.** Sources - Fonti : https://www.humanitas.it/enciclopedia/alimenti/frutta/ananas/ https://makadamia.it/ananas-proprieta-e-curiosita/ ![firmaGhilvar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/48SqxfhNw6nwwJEZACBwzAmKDssU5forXXdWSwLWVbz8NizZXvx3EVgejfYYTvq7cb.png)

body.title: The most beautiful in their simplicity
body.body: A devise presented as art.\n\n

/> No, it was not an already existing device that was placed here as a relic, as in an exhibition, as sometimes happens with already used planes or tanks. This is a brand new device, a brand new monument, a brand new installation from 2005, which nowadays even looks a little strange.

/> But I'm especially attracted to these devices. You know all those important buildings from the past, from the distant past, that had sundials on them - castles, churches and administrative buildings. Then you know all those important buildings, which later, with the development of technology, put on mechanical clocks on their towers.

/> I know that there is great psychological and practical significance in this, and architects know best why this is so. It's not just because these buildings want to remind people of the most important thing - that time is the only master of this world. That time passes and it is the only constant, the only sure thing in this constantly and rapidly changing world.

/> If so, these buildings could simply bear a symbol of death to remind people in an even more direct way that time is running out, they are mortal, and their time on this earth is limited. Or by placing a master's representative on authoritarian buildings, people inside wanted to show their authority and proof of their authorization to exercise that authority?

/>

But have you seen anyone worship this greatest lord, Cronus, today?  
On the other hand, sundials are the most 'harmless' clocks. Nothing ticks in them, nothing is reported in an intrusive way like mechanical clocks, nothing flows like in hourglasses. That is why they are the most pleasant, the strangest in their simplicity, but also the most beautiful in their simplicity clocks.

Don't you think so?

body.title: Адміністрація Трампа може зобов’язати банки збирати дані про громадянство
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUhWpvGpMmesMzEMcLQBfpnvnUpy8qXE3rHG1hG4X4ho4/image)

Адміністрація президента США Дональда Трампа розробляє указ, який зобов’яже банки збирати та перевіряти дані про громадянство своїх клієнтів. Документ перебуває в процесі підготовки.

Наразі американські банки зобов’язані перевіряти лише особу клієнта (ім’я, дату народження, адресу та податковий номер), але не його громадянство. Іноземці можуть відкривати рахунки в американських банках без перешкод.
Новий указ вимагатиме від банків отримувати документи, що підтверджують громадянство, як-от паспорт або свідоцтво про народження.
Серед українців найбільше ризикують мешканці сільської місцевості з обмеженим доступом до документів та студенти, чия адреса в документах не збігається з місцем навчання.

У ЄС та інших країнах перевірка громадянства під час відкриття рахунку є звичною практикою. Однак у США це стане суттєвим розширенням федерального контролю над фінансовою системою та новим фронтом у боротьбі Трампа з нелегальною міграцією.
