links.title: Storms within
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbp3idjW85e4J21Lyybs3hojaW1ZyWtburZnhyZfXYeMv/ai_generated.webp)
[Al image](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbp3idjW85e4J21Lyybs3hojaW1ZyWtburZnhyZfXYeMv/ai_generated.webp)


It was a cold evening, with a gentle breeze blowing and birds chirping in the trees. The sun was gradually retiring for the day. The environment was peaceful and quiet, but Dina's heart was under pressure.  


The young woman in her mid-thirties sat on the ground after fetching water from the stream. She was a mother of two beautiful girls but a wife to an irresponsible man.  
Dina was a young, vibrant, and friendly person. 

Everyone in the village loved her, including her children. The chaos started when she gave birth to her second child, Anny. Her husband, Jerry, complained about her giving birth to females instead of males, saying that female will not continue his linege and they will later give their father's properties to their husbands.

Therefore, since then Jerry had stopped giving her money and food, saying until she gave him an heir. 

Her home, which used to be like heaven, has now turned to chaos. Her man, who seemed like an angel when their love story began, has now turned into the devil's advocate.


 He left his wife to struggle, providing for the home, with all bills on her. Debt mounts up daily, and slowly depression began to set into her heart.

One fateful day, a woman who sells raw food came to their hut very early in the morning to ask for the money Dina owes her. She rained insults on her so that neighbours came around to settle the matter. The good people Dina had helped in times past pitied her. They contributed money and gave it to the food seller, then handed the remaining amount to Dina.

Although she was very grateful for their acts of kindness, deep in her heart she was dejected. She cried every night for her pain to end. Her children were the reason she chose to stay in the marriage; she endured the hardships for many years until one day when she went to the stream as usual.

The only place Dina usually goes to get her peace back is the village stream. It's always quiet around that time of the day. In the evening, she thinks about life, her children, her welfare, the future, and her husband. 


The village stream is the only place she goes whenever she is troubled to pour out her heart before going back home. She always prays silently that her life becomes lively again and her home homely too. After a long while listening to the gentle flow of the water and watching calmly, she feels peace again.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWqe7NhU18NTSFBJjkghNU5Rnzck1XLNrvdrCt1mXco6i/1776577502273.jpg)
[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/old-wrinkles-white-hair-human-5178257/)


As she turned to go back home, she saw an old woman standing and smiling at her. Dina was startled; she did not expect anyone to be at the stream at that moment. It was believed that the stream water was not usually good at night but rather in the early morning. So no one fetched water from it in the evening.

\

said the old woman. She had white hair on her head and all over her body. She was barefoot, holding a staff, and had tied a shining white wrapper around her chest. 

Her eyeballs were blue, and when she spoke, it echoed. The staff in her right hand was taller than she was; the tip was covered with white feathers and was also shining. 

\

Dina sobbed.

I know all your pains and struggles, your troubles as you always come here to talk about them. My name is Peace. I brought peace to you, she said, and handed over a small necklace to Dina, urging her to put it around her neck as a symbol of peace and love. 


She further said that anywhere Dina goes for the next three months, as long as she has the peace necklace, she will find peace there; there is no need to come back to the streams every day to cry. You are free from all your troubles, the old woman declared.

Dina thanked the woman profusely and then watched her walk into the middle of the stream and disappear. When she got home, her husband was happy to see her. \

Jerry hugged her warmly.


Then be began to apologizes for all his wrongdoings and sentiments. Dina was amazed to see a very drastic chan6in her husband. It works, it really works, xhe whispered.

Their kids were also elated to see their parents in such good moods.

So, Dina always had peace in her mind, in her home, and around her since she had the peace necklace on her.


One day, after three months of using the peace necklace, Dina returned it to the woman with a heart full of gratitude. Now, she continued to live in peace and harmony.

還有一家挺好逛的就是寶可夢布偶館，裡面賣很多寶可夢都挺可愛的，寶可夢在台灣2018年時可是全民運動啊，雖然現在沒那麼夯了，但還是很多小朋友的愛。

![man-8547436_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/Ep5mf78jiGNSPVkrRDLJ27ZdFA5jce3Ru6HM5eHyyZoig3hgwtW1CM2F2UpmxVYuty7.jpg)

<hr>

As a child, Michael had a vivid imagination. At age twelve, he promised his friends he would conquer Hollywood. It wasn’t just a dream; he stated it with the conviction of a young boy. Over time, the rumor grew into a local legend. 

Fifteen years later, at the alumni reunion, Michael made a triumphant entrance. He wore an impeccable suit and dark sunglasses, even though it was nighttime. 

He raved about his upcoming projects being filmed out West and how exhausting fame was. His old classmates listened, spellbound, asking for autographs and photos. Michael played the role of a lifetime to perfection, smiling with the exact arrogance of a celebrity. 

However, hours later, the glittering illusion shattered. Michael turned the key and entered his gloomy, musty bachelor apartment. He carefully removed his rented suit so as not to wrinkle it and slumped heavily onto a sofa. He turned on his old TV with a remote control; and, as luck would have it, an action movie was playing.

As he watched the actors on the screen living extraordinary adventures, depression completely overwhelmed him. There were no red carpets, no million-dollar contracts. In the solitude of his living room, he faced the harsh reality: he was just an unemployed man, hopelessly trapped in a lie that he himself couldn’t stop acting out.

links.body: Саме так тепер виглядає мій настрій напередодні вихідного дня, неділі. По-перше, непрацюючій людині, як от я, пенсіонер, взагалі всі дні тижня часто як одне ціле, можна і не знати, який саме день сьогодні. А по-друге, на Заході України з давніх давен строго притримуються звичаїв, що в неділю нічого робити не можна. Тобто - у дворі чи на городі ти вже будеш \
, якщо вийдеш недільного дня підрізати дерева чи просапати малину. Звісно, в хаті можна щось собі тихенько мутити. Та часом от сяду в'язати на улюблений диванчик, а це ж - великий \

у неділю, і думаю: люди-то не бачать, а Бозя ж знає, що грішу!😇
Щоб не чіпати більше теми релігії, - йдемо далі. На ставок. Де вже обжилися прекрасні птахи. Вранці ми побачили і лебедів, і чапель, і качок. І риба скидалася, гарна, велика. От тільки ловити її тут ми не вміємо. А всі спроби порибалити за минулий рік так і не дали системного розуміння, що це за водойма і які причуди в тутешньої риби. І наше спасіння на протязі багатьох років життя - перетворити вихідні у дні активного відпочинку на дикій природі - вже давно не діє. Бо виїхати і нема куди, і нема можливості. Тому - радіємо життю і тому, що маємо. Бо коли озирнешся, скільки біди наробила русня на нашій землі, то розумієш: мені пощастило...

links.title: Disfrutando unas Ricas Hamburguesas en tierras Falconianas. [ESP/ENG]
links.body: # Disfrutando unas Ricas Hamburguesas en tierras Falconianas. [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Buenas noches amigos de están gran comunidad de @hivefood, espero que todos estén pasando un excelente fin de semana, lleno de salud y mucha alegría, disfrutando al máximo. Sean todos bienvenidos a mi blog.

![52e8ed16-7767-4ae8-b06f-113b6814b7c2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xAe4bHnKYF4PBL2Nwz3LhQBgeDKKcwsYehFVdsk4LHUPs91cjwULZCa5UCz5nMh4jtv.jpeg)

Hoy quiero compartir con cada unos de ustedes lo que fue este fin de semana. Ayer llegamos a las 6 de la tarde al hotel aventuras donde me alojé con mi esposo y mi hija en el estado Falcón especialmente en tucacas, para disfrutar de sus playas y de la comida de esta tierra Falcon. 

![IMG_8998.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x16s9f8dzFuLKvhNU1WkL53sYL8gE5ohfX87g42tFXThM2Z7w5n3xLZP8uJTzCU5Muj.jpeg)

Cómo llegamos tarde ya era hora de cenar, por lo que pasamos al área de piscina, pedimos una deliciosa hamburguesa, doble carne con queso amarillo fundido, jamón, tomate, lechuga, Ketchup, mayonesa, pepinillo y todo los tipos de salsa de la casa, de bebida ordenamos chinotto.

![5cf78241-e20c-419d-b7fa-bef6cc9842ae.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yTfCMgicQXZHRh6i8KVfYsZmNqiXr75U8PhHFS7ZNkn55hJcGrBPosNJpcyNv1agioU.jpeg)

![8b727dfa-3928-4038-82d6-9dc87fa87053.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zGioVSs4mquHo6gJQtuDMJmQgjMmxMaHmUfEEBjdmgjwGUEePiZ5g8MAbyUfY3qJFRf.jpeg)

Les comento que el tamaño de la hamburguesa fue bastante grande, además venía acompañada de un servicio de papas fritas, muy crujientes y deliciosas, al igual la hamburguesa estaba súper rica, me nos mal que ordenamos uña hamburguesas para cada uno porque quedamos muy satisfechos. 

![e29ba044-2ac1-4d91-813e-308dda4f1dfa.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wCFsBUzVR5YEkdgHUo6xxnWUu728iiBUksU4DKHn2f932CQf3yS2GBvq62YNpAFeQGE.jpeg)

La he pasado muy bien en estos días de relajamiento y sobre todo que me ha servido para esparcir mi mente y sobre todo descansar un poco de la cocina y probar otro tipo de comida fuera del hogar y sobre todo en otra zona o estado.  

![IMG_8988.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc7TbBiXq9HqMakkEvW38isyT8qGuRYvpqnc2UGm1D2fsFZDbbzEFDY1F4DzLxP8iW.jpeg)

Bueno amigos si llegan a venir al pueblo de tucacas les recomiendo las hamburguesas de este hotel, súper ricas y full carnes, la atención nada de que quejarme, todo excelente, el hotel muy lindo, los colores que sobre salen es el blanco, azul, naranja, amarillo y verde manzana. A este sitio le doy 10/10.

![a9d25fbd-b27b-4809-b38f-461ec1149b62.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xVM9WREN8MQy5jUBJZzQGvxaEjD737rGoAs3sBXkHH895ZdSz3F7imUXUd9w8h3LAKs.jpeg)

Hasta aquí mi contenido espero sea de su agrado y nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad.

# Enjoying some delicious burgers in Falcon. [ESP/ENG]

Good evening, friends of this wonderful @hivefood community. I hope you’re all having a wonderful weekend, filled with good health and lots of joy, and enjoying yourselves to the fullest. Welcome to my blog.

![52e8ed16-7767-4ae8-b06f-113b6814b7c2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xAe4bHnKYF4PBL2Nwz3LhQBgeDKKcwsYehFVdsk4LHUPs91cjwULZCa5UCz5nMh4jtv.jpeg)

Today I want to share with each of you what this weekend was like. Yesterday we arrived at 6 p.m. at the Hotel Aventuras, where I stayed with my husband and daughter in Falcón State—specifically in Tucacas—to enjoy the beaches and the local cuisine of Falcón. 


![IMG_8998.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x16s9f8dzFuLKvhNU1WkL53sYL8gE5ohfX87g42tFXThM2Z7w5n3xLZP8uJTzCU5Muj.jpeg)
Since we were running late, it was already time for dinner, so we headed over to the pool area, ordered a delicious burger—double patty with melted cheese, ham, tomato, lettuce, ketchup, mayonnaise, pickles, and all kinds of house sauces—and ordered Chinotto to drink.

![5cf78241-e20c-419d-b7fa-bef6cc9842ae.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yTfCMgicQXZHRh6i8KVfYsZmNqiXr75U8PhHFS7ZNkn55hJcGrBPosNJpcyNv1agioU.jpeg)

![8b727dfa-3928-4038-82d6-9dc87fa87053.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zGioVSs4mquHo6gJQtuDMJmQgjMmxMaHmUfEEBjdmgjwGUEePiZ5g8MAbyUfY3qJFRf.jpeg)

I should mention that the burger was quite large, and it came with a side of french fries—very crispy and delicious. The burger itself was also super tasty. It was a good thing we ordered one burger each because we were very satisfied. 


![e29ba044-2ac1-4d91-813e-308dda4f1dfa.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wCFsBUzVR5YEkdgHUo6xxnWUu728iiBUksU4DKHn2f932CQf3yS2GBvq62YNpAFeQGE.jpeg)


I've had a great time during these relaxing days, and above all, it's helped me clear my head and take a break from cooking to try different kinds of food outside the home—especially in a different area or state.  


![IMG_8988.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc7TbBiXq9HqMakkEvW38isyT8qGuRYvpqnc2UGm1D2fsFZDbbzEFDY1F4DzLxP8iW.jpeg)

Well, friends, if you ever come to the town of Tucacas, I highly recommend the burgers at this hotel—they’re super delicious and packed with meat. The service is top-notch—I have absolutely no complaints. Everything is excellent. The hotel is very nice, with white, blue, orange, yellow, and apple green as the standout colors. I give this place a 10/10.

![a9d25fbd-b27b-4809-b38f-461ec1149b62.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xVM9WREN8MQy5jUBJZzQGvxaEjD737rGoAs3sBXkHH895ZdSz3F7imUXUd9w8h3LAKs.jpeg)

That's all for now. I hope you enjoyed this post, and I'll see you next time.

NAC
Vitamin C Ascorbate
MSM Methylsulfonylmethane
Cysteine Glutamine 

acetyl group enediol structure related similarities

While they appear distinct, the enediol and acetyl groups are connected by the shared presence of oxygen atoms and carbon backbones that can undergo electronic rearrangement.

Acetyl Group (CH3CO): Consists of a methyl group single-bonded to a carbonyl group (C=O). 

Enediol Structure (OHCCOH): Consists of a carbon-carbon double bond (alkene) where each carbon atom is bonded to a hydroxyl group (-OH).

The chemistry of vitamin C (ascorbic acid) and its ionized form, ascorbate, is unique because it functions as a vinylogous carboxylic acid, giving it acidity and reactivity similar to compounds with traditional carboxyl or acetyl-related groups. 

Ascorbate and Acetyl Group Interactions

While \

are distinct chemical entities, they share similar reactivity in biological systems.

Functional Similarity: Both can be involved in transferring or accepting moieties in metabolic pathways (ascorbate via redox, acetyl via transferases).

Anion at pH 7: Both ascorbate (as a deprotonated enediol) and acetyl groups (as part of Acetyl-CoA or acetylated compounds) exist in highly active, charged forms at physiological pH.

Acidity (pKa): Vitamin C is more acidic than acetic acid (the acid in vinegar, which contains an acetyl group). Its first pKa is 4.2, compared to acetic acid's 4.74.

Proton Transfer: Ascorbate is primarily a proton/electron donor to mitigate oxidation. Acetyl groups are typically involved in covalent modifications like acetylation of proteins or sugars. 

The acetyl group (NAC) and enediol structures (Ascorbate) are closely related in organic chemistry, particularly within carbohydrate metabolism, sugar tautomerization. 

The relationship between these two groups is most evident in how they function within larger molecules, particularly sugars and metabolic intermediates.

Tautomeric Intermediates: The enediol is a transition state between different carbonyl forms. For example, in glycochemistry, an acetyl-like carbonyl group can shift into an enediol intermediate to allow for the rearrangement of atoms, such as the conversion of glucose to fructose.

Reactivity as Nucleophiles: Both groups can act as nucleophiles. In an acetyl group, the alpha-carbon can be deprotonated to form an enolate, while in an enediol, both carbons are electron-rich and can participate in reactions like allylic alkylation.

Metabolic Precursors: Acetyl groups (as acetyl-CoA) and enediol intermediates (in glycolysis) are fundamental building blocks.

links.title: Korean culture and my daughter's birthday party/한국 문화와 딸의 생일 파티(eng-ko)
links.body:
I want to share this wonderful experience with the Korean community to participate in the Korean Hive Village Contest #42.

I'm going to tell you about my recent experience with Korean culture.

My daughter recently had a birthday and asked me to have a K-pop Warriors theme party. She wanted her hairstyle to be inspired by the K-pop Warriors, especially Rumi's, and her outfit to be inspired by them as well.

The music that played throughout the party was the K-pop Warriors' theme song called \

performed by the fictional group HUNTR/X. My children love this song; they sing it all day long, and even I end up singing it. It's a very catchy and rhythmic song—it was even nominated for Best Original Song and Best Original Song at the 2016 Academy Awards and the 2016 Golden Globes.

![1000000477.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23uQriFekUcKEAEu7TL7nFFG53YHfx93jutRB79LYafPbzNaZYyUziLSbZmRsZHd9yG2a.jpg)

Her birthday cake was decorated with the three characters from the movie:

* Rumi
* Mira
* Zoey

![1000000471.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23wMSNkVtfYnxBKHqWfVb3RViQKPEfv5gPhhs2ZArysq2fWw59q9YjMtpufqViJzK9HUL.jpg)

I, like my daughter, was very I was thrilled to be able to fulfill her birthday wish. My daughter was incredibly happy. And I was a very proud mom.

![1000000470.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23uQJgxEut3jQC9n7PJTXxDz6NSuzxhc8f31CY8Mwneoby5BfGpBdZLXKZjNVj4uhF4v9.jpg)

Thank you for joining me on this wonderful journey exploring Korean culture through film, specifically this amazing children's movie that has captured the hearts of both children and adults and taught us so much about Korean culture and customs.

I invite @arribaeltelon @robotgirl2024 @angeluxx to participate in this wonderful initiative.

**Sources**

*Original story by @yusmelys.
Images from my gallery.
I used Google Translate.*


___

### 한국

한국 커뮤니티 여러분과 제가 한국 하이브 빌리지 콘테스트 #42에 참여하면서 겪은 멋진 경험을 공유하고 싶습니다.

최근 한국 문화와 관련된 제 경험을 이야기해 드릴게요.

딸아이 생일이었는데, K팝 워리어즈 테마 파티를 열어달라고 했어요. 헤어스타일도 K팝 워리어즈, 특히 루미의 헤어스타일에서 영감을 받고 싶어 했고, 옷도 워리어즈 캐릭터들로 맞춰 입고 싶어 했죠.

파티 내내 K팝 워리어즈 주제곡인 \

이 흘러나왔어요. 가상의 그룹 HUNTR/X가 부른 곡인데, 아이들이 정말 좋아해서 하루 종일 흥얼거리고, 저도 모르게 따라 부르게 되더라고요. 중독성 있고 리듬감 넘치는 곡이라 2016년 아카데미 시상식과 골든 글로브 시상식에서 각각 주제가상 후보에 오르기도 했답니다.

![1000000477.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23uQriFekUcKEAEu7TL7nFFG53YHfx93jutRB79LYafPbzNaZYyUziLSbZmRsZHd9yG2a.jpg)

딸아이의 생일 케이크는 영화 속 세 캐릭터로 장식되어 있었습니다.

* 루미
* 미라
* 조이

![1000000471.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23wMSNkVtfYnxBKHqWfVb3RViQKPEfv5gPhhs2ZArysq2fWw59q9YjMtpufqViJzK9HUL.jpg)

저도 딸아이처럼 무척이나 흥분했습니다. 딸아이의 생일 소원을 들어줄 수 있어서 정말 기뻤어요. 딸아이는 너무나 행복해했고, 저는 정말 자랑스러운 엄마였죠.

![1000000470.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23uQJgxEut3jQC9n7PJTXxDz6NSuzxhc8f31CY8Mwneoby5BfGpBdZLXKZjNVj4uhF4v9.jpg)

영화, 특히 아이들과 어른 모두의 마음을 사로잡고 한국 문화와 풍습에 대해 많은 것을 알려준 이 멋진 어린이 영화를 통해 한국 문화를 탐구하는 이 특별한 여정에 함께해 주셔서 감사합니다.

@arribaeltelon @robotgirl2024 @angeluxx 님도 이 멋진 여정에 함께해 주시면 좋겠습니다.

links.title: Larva of the spotted swordtail butterfly
links.body: > On a seemingly simple green leaf, a spotted swordtail butterfly caterpillar, or larva, was crawling slowly. Its movements were slow and deliberate, as if it didn't want to disturb the world around it. Its small, segmented body was covered in simple brown and white colors. It continued to walk on the leaf. I was a little wary when photographing it, afraid it might jump. But fortunately, it ignored me and continued to slowly move forward.

> Today, the caterpillar looked scary and greedy, so many people didn't want to see it. Sometimes, its presence was even considered disturbing. But in two or three weeks, it would become a beautiful creature, admired by many. It would already have wings with patterns that could hypnotize everyone.

> This caterpillar doesn't immediately become a butterfly, it must go through another, more terrifying phase of its life. Even scarier than the one we see now. If no predators attack it, it will probably enter the terrifying stage of its life, the chrysalis in a few days. The room is narrow and dark.

links.title: The Svinni's Stuffed Man. Part 1\\Der Svinni-Stopfmann. Teil 1
links.body:
Hello,my friends!
New story of Svinni the pig right now!


![lovushka-duraku.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUkf7cni5fLcRubbWPxBcbcxcJ68fjHABSABWU5xa5iLd/lovushka-duraku.jpg)


It's time to put a stop to the mango smoothie theft! The rascal Cthulhu had a strange weakness. I'd even say he had a rather unhealthy weakness and craving for mango smoothies. Sure, let him drink his mango smoothies—no one's against it, it's perfectly legal—but the squid wanted to drink only Svinni's mango smoothies! And he did it secretly, because that's when the smoothies taste even better! The taste of a freshly-snatched pork mango smoothie is incomparable! It's ambrosia!

Svinni poured himself another glass of mango smoothie and sat down in the shade of a palm tree. Cthulhu immediately tensed up; he knew the stupid pig would take a sip and grunt, and maybe even go for a swim. History teaches nothing to stupid pigs! How many times had they flown past their cocktail, yet they'd learned nothing from those lessons? But the little pig continued to sit next to it. He simply sat there, meditating, or whatever he was doing. You can't steal a mango cocktail! Cthulhu was getting nervous! Meanwhile, Svinni himself was swimming in the warm sea on the other side of the island. And the mango cocktail was being vigilantly guarded by a stuffed pig with a built-in security camera in its snout. And Cthulhu fell for it! So who's the other stupid pig here?! Having splashed around in the sea to his heart's content, Svinni hid in the shade of the palm trees and began to observe the events. The squid was becoming increasingly nervous. On one hand, the mango cocktail was so close, and on the other, the pig was sitting right next to him. But he was sitting too still; maybe he'd meditated too much? It was decided! Fear the pigs, don't drink other people's cocktails!

Cthulhu lunged at the cocktail and greedily sipped his mouth from the straw. The bliss of slurping someone else's cocktail! Priceless! Behind Cthulhu, someone chuckled coldly. It was the real Svinni, who had caught the mango smoothie thief red-handed, and the effigy of Svinni had helped. The villain had been caught, and this time he wouldn't be able to evade the clutches of justice! All the evidence had been gathered!

...to be continued...


![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Es ist an der Zeit, dem Mango-Smoothie-Diebstahl ein Ende zu setzen! Der Schlingel Cthulhu hatte eine seltsame Schwäche. Man könnte sogar sagen, eine ziemlich ungesunde: eine unstillbare Gier nach Mango-Smoothies. Klar, lasst ihn seine Mango-Smoothies trinken – niemand hat etwas dagegen, es ist völlig legal –, aber der Tintenfisch wollte nur Svinnis Mango-Smoothies! Und er tat es heimlich, denn dann schmecken die Smoothies einfach noch besser! Der Geschmack eines frisch geklauten Schweinefleisch-Mango-Smoothies ist unvergleichlich! Ambrosia!

Svinni schenkte sich noch ein Glas Mango-Smoothie ein und setzte sich in den Schatten einer Palme. Cthulhu spannte sich sofort an; er wusste, das dumme Schwein würde einen Schluck nehmen und grunzen und vielleicht sogar schwimmen gehen. Dummen Schweinen lehrt die Geschichte nichts! Wie oft waren sie schon an ihrem Cocktail vorbeigeschwommen, ohne daraus zu lernen? Doch das kleine Schweinchen blieb einfach daneben sitzen. Es saß da, meditierte oder was auch immer es da tat. „Man kann doch keinen Mangococktail stehlen!“, dachte Cthulhu und wurde nervös. Währenddessen schwamm Svinni selbst im warmen Meer auf der anderen Seite der Insel. Und der Mangococktail wurde wachsam von einem Stoffschwein bewacht, dessen Schnauze eine eingebaute Überwachungskamera hatte. Und Cthulhu war darauf hereingefallen! Wer war denn nun das andere dumme Schweinchen?! Nachdem Svinni sich nach Herzenslust im Meer ausgetobt hatte, versteckte er sich im Schatten der Palmen und beobachtete das Geschehen. Der Tintenfisch wurde immer nervöser. Einerseits war der Mangococktail so nah, und andererseits saß das Schweinchen direkt neben ihm. Aber es saß zu still; vielleicht hatte es zu lange meditiert? Die Entscheidung war gefallen! Fürchtet die Schweine, trinkt nicht die Cocktails anderer Leute!


Cthulhu stürzte sich auf den Cocktail und nippte gierig durch den Strohhalm. Welch ein Genuss, den Cocktail eines anderen zu schlürfen! Unbezahlbar! Hinter Cthulhu lachte jemand kalt. Es war die echte Svinni, die den Mango-Smoothie-Dieb auf frischer Tat ertappt hatte, und die Svinni-Figur hatte dabei geholfen. Der Schurke war gefasst, und diesmal würde er der Gerechtigkeit nicht entkommen! Alle Beweise waren gesammelt!

…Fortsetzung folgt…

links.title: How Did the Foundations Set and Campaign Mode Shape My Journey in Praetoria?
links.body:
![Igm.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wizardwarrior/23xAVbpTUxigoqV9a369DEDh7sYp8inkzWQSrgtWoBxDsmwQK6R6tVphd2KQY1XwGyou4.png)



<center>```Image created in CANVA using CANVA AI```</center>

<div class=\

> Seeing the Splinterlands dashboard for the first time in 2026—after last seeing it around 2022 or 2023—is frankly intimidating. It’s not the simple “card-versus-card” game that some remember from the early days of GameFi; today, it’s a high-fidelity ecosystem where the SPS economy, Glint management, and the complex mechanics of Bloodlines dictate who thrives and who simply “burns” their capital. Like @wizardwarrior, my journey from a drawing and role-playing enthusiast to an aspiring game strategist wasn’t a straight path. It was fraught with the struggles every beginner faces: the fear of losing assets in leagues where veterans dominate with legendary cards, and the frustration of not understanding why my unit missed a crucial attack. This is the story of how I found my “bearing” through the Foundations Set—and why you should do the same. Of course, I’m not investing in major cards yet because I still have more to learn, but starting with the minor ones is definitely the way to go.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wizardwarrior/23tbPXzMcEfBm92cAHPjFpWg2gBjaiSYQZ5U4HYyyvVmc5n4XufmgPckqsnPfMUJZ1Lvb.png
###
The Leap of Faith: Fears and Doubts of a Wizard Warrior
---

> Before I fought my first battle, I spent nights studying the market. My doubts were the same ones you probably have right now: * **Is it too late to join in 2026?** * **Do I need thousands of dollars in DEC to be competitive?** * **How on earth do new abilities like Pinpoint or Invigorate work?** I was afraid of “financial suicide”: buying cards that the meta-game would render obsolete in a week, or joining leagues where my R-Shares would be insignificant because of my low SPS staking. I felt like I was facing a very complex machine with no instruction manual. That vulnerability was what drove me to seek out a structured method. I didn’t want to play by chance; I wanted to play with a clear strategy.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wizardwarrior/23t75BQJsjBVDTsZC5j4JemLTTq3QC8Kg5qLgbyDFwS8vJ6SKX6ofT6fKJEbvi8LRq2kq.png
####
What is SET Foundations? The Foundation for Success and a Strong Start
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wizardwarrior/EoeDSjC1q3h8T31BFdwFHXGL5sBAEQLCZUv1AafJBRJz2Sb69mizyeX8yeoCobrF5hK.png)
```Foundations SET ```

> While researching the DAO forums and the updated white papers, one concept kept coming up again and again: the Set Foundations. The 11th edition of Splinterlands is based on the Foundations set. Unlike expansion editions (such as Conclave Arcana), Foundations is designed to serve as the tactical foundation for any player. --- ##### The Pillars of Foundations: --- 1. Accessibility for all: This is the starting point provided by the protocol to ensure that the skills gap is not insurmountable. 2. Graduate Learning Mechanics: Seamlessly integrates critical skills such as Bulwark (defense) and Reflexes (evasion). 3. Bloodline Synergy: This is where you learn how to use the Bloodline Domain. In Foundations, you’re introduced to the basics of bloodlines—such as Dwarves or Humans—so you can see how faction spells affect the outcome. 4. Why is it the best option? Because in the current meta, trying to build a deck using only cards from the secondary market without the Foundations base is like trying to build a skyscraper on sand. Foundations give you the consistency you need so your strategies don't rely on luck.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wizardwarrior/23tGXzKPb6s22ZbpNTUubNobQrzfxGE6ZQmvYCyhmgsgBNHnqqDGCNgMneeNumN4dhP7e.png
###
Campaign Mode: Your Personal \

> The Foundations Set is your arsenal, and Campaign Mode is your training ground. In the year 2026 of Splinterlands, Campaign Mode (or the Foundations Prologue) is a PvE (player vs. environment) experience designed to help new users secure their Base of Operations. --- ##### Purpose and Relevance: --- The goal isn't just to provide you with visual rewards, but to simulate real combat with controlled risks. This is vital for new players because: 1. Learn without losing progress: This feature lets you test different combinations of Archons (high-level Summoners) without losing your rating or Glint. 2. Acquiring Assets: Upon completing the Prologue, you’ll unlock basic cards that will form the foundation of your starting deck. 3. Precision Training: This is where you learn the ins and outs of combat. It’s important to pay close attention because this is where you’ll lay the groundwork for mastering the game—or at least that’s what I think, since I’m currently going through that process myself.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wizardwarrior/23t75BQJsjBVDTsZC5j4JemLTTq3QC8Kg5qLgbyDFwS8vJ6SKX6ofT6fKJEbvi8LRq2kq.png
####
Clear Goals from the Start

>

If you don't know what you're looking for, you can't win. As a new player, your goals in Foundations and Campaign Mode should be:

* **Objective 1:** Complete the Prologue 100% to claim the basic set of non-transferable (Soulbound) cards that will allow you to compete in Bronze.

* **Objective 2:** Earn your first 5,000 Glint and spend them in the rewards shop, prioritizing Alchemy potions.

* **Objective 3:** Master the Pinpoint ability. In the lower leagues, preventing enemies from escaping is what separates a winning streak from a losing streak.

* **Objective 4:** Understand how SPS Staking works. It’s not entirely relevant when you’re just starting out, but it will be very important if you want to take this seriously in higher-level leagues or other formats like \

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wizardwarrior/23u5bhsDWXPHRuZELkKPVc5nf7fzX2rd6o8az2EAT3CuBQh9J5tm3w8ENeejCmGFENGeU.png
### Have a great day, and join me on this journey of art and gameplay in Splinterlands
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wizardwarrior/48PucsgrTTVq9PNoKgv9SwFx1nWbiiuP7Gpy1F1oAQqjdmVWYKh455bqkgzEd5tZ7E.png

links.title: ✨ A Quiet Dream with a Strong Future
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXJYv8LBcHQwnU4BDpTGBpsZ9jo73WptJx8BhGFNLAexw/IMG_8107.jpg 

Sometimes I look at a photo like this and realize how much my life is changing. Finishing high school feels like closing an important chapter, but at the same time, it feels like the beginning of something bigger. I am still discovering who I want to be, what I want to do, and how I want to build my future.

Lately, I have been thinking a lot about chemistry. There is something about it that truly catches my attention. I like the idea that everything around us has a process, a reaction, a reason. The more I think about it, the more I feel that this could be the path I want to follow. I still have a lot to learn, but I also have a lot of excitement for what is coming next.

This photo feels like a small reflection of that moment in my life. Calm on the outside, but with many thoughts, dreams, and questions inside. I may not have everything figured out yet, but I do know that I want a future that challenges me, helps me grow, and makes me feel proud of myself.

For now, I just want to keep moving forward, keep believing in my dreams, and keep trusting that every step I take is shaping the woman I am becoming.


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@alanacont/-a-quiet-dream-with-a-strong-future-jtd)

links.title: Would you look at these fucking crows?
links.body:
My hands shook and the blood thumped in my ears. I nearly dropped the phone as I scrambled to pull it from my pocket and get the video rolling on this thrilling new level of trust I had reached with my two friends, Bo and Lorena. 

If only I had captured the foreplay. It truly was a magnificent display. Lorena started it all.

While ‘tis the season for making whoopee, whoopee-making is a vulnerable activity for anyone on the food chain. But perhaps it was my looming and formidable presence and their trust in me that I would frighten away any potential predators that led them to do it right there in the road not ten feet from where I stood with my little dog.

The crow couple has been busy with nest-building, and it had been a few days since I’d seen them. When I entered their territory I expected the usual greeting: Bo landing on my head or hand to be fed; Lorena landing at my feet and waiting for me to toss treats into her shiny black bill. But when I arrived, rather than come over for snacks, Bo chose to poke around across the street through a small mess of garbage. He was inspecting a piece of plastic when Lorena, about ten feet away on the ground in front of me, bowed her head and let loose a long, rattling call. 

Not yet understanding the myriad nuances within each crow call, I was surprised by the immediate affect it had on Bo. He pressed his breast low to the ground and stuck his feathered ass into the air. Still holding the piece of plastic in his bill, began to vigorously vibrate his tail feathers. His wife must have made a come-hither call, though, alas, I can’t remember what it sounded like. All I know is it got Bo moving, and in big, cocky strides he crossed the street toward his bride, flinging his plastic prize to the side to claim the real deal.

And the rest is internet history:

links.title: [ENG/ESP] A Saturday of work and travel on the way to a well-deserved rest.
links.body: > **I truly love days off—those days when my body relaxes and my mind breathes more calmly. This Sunday is one of those gifts, a day I plan to spend with my family, enjoying those little moments that mean so much. In an upcoming post, I’ll tell you how it went, because I know that every day brings its own story, and I always like to share a little piece of mine with you. As I mentioned, I had to work this past Saturday. Luckily, it was a simple task for us, since we’ve got our work routine down almost by heart. Even so, every day has its own rhythm, its own details, and its own scenery, and that always adds a special touch. The weather remains a bit strange, with that constant cloud cover that seems to hang over the island without ever actually raining. Even so, we left the house without rushing, not too early, but very calmly. We like to do it this way, because that leisurely pace allows us to appreciate the urban and natural landscapes that surround us. Even if the sky is gray, the beauty is still there, intact, waiting to be observed. There’s something about those muted tones that also has its charm, as if nature were speaking in a whisper.**

> *Me gustan profundamente los días de descanso, esos en los que el cuerpo se relaja y la mente respira con más calma. Este domingo es uno de esos regalos, un día que pienso dedicar a compartir con mi familia, y disfrutar de esos pequeños momentos que tanto valor tienen. En una próxima publicación les contaré cómo transcurrió, porque sé que cada día trae su propia historia y siempre me gusta compartir un pedacito de la mía con ustedes. Como les había comentado, este sábado que recién culminó me tocó trabajar. Por suerte, era algo sencillo para nosotros, porque ya dominamos nuestra rutina de trabajo casi con los ojos cerrados. Aun así, cada jornada tiene su propio ritmo, sus detalles y sus paisajes, y eso siempre le da un toque especial. El clima continúa un poco extraño, con esa nubosidad permanente que parece quedarse suspendida sobre la isla, pero sin llegar a llover. Aun así, salimos de casa sin apuros, no muy temprano, pero sí con mucha calma. Nos gusta hacerlo así, porque ese ritmo pausado nos permite apreciar los paisajes urbanos y naturales que nos acompañan. Aunque el cielo esté gris, la belleza sigue ahí, intacta, esperando ser observada. Hay algo en esos tonos apagados que también tiene su encanto, como si la naturaleza hablara en voz baja.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xehVPL3J1HLrYYJ6zDEUbepz15XxSvB1qrBPwgXKb7a5jutTLCdvY7Wm9GsjwXZFTPe.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-19_01-09-54.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqSWv1z7U9ssRWVz7wcxPewXQQpq7nmxkJCNS5VkxmCEjrLjD5qhpHz9powe6TyQu8v.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-19_01-09-31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqSWTg4gpoqtFu4hWCouTsiuaQSqmGLwY2JHciCrbNCUpftHpoVgJ87XRXhea7sL4KT.jpg)

> **Our task for the day was simple: carry out our routine disinfection and parameter testing at the Sunsol Unik hotel, and then deliver some paperwork to Lidotel. Amid serene scenery and pleasant conversation, my husband and I arrived at the Sunsol Unik. We stayed there a little longer than usual because they were filling the water tank with tanker trucks, and we had to wait before we could chlorinate the water and measure the parameters. Far from bothering us, that wait allowed us to observe the hotel’s activity, the coming and going of the staff, and that unique atmosphere hotels have when they’re getting ready to welcome their guests.**

> *Nuestro trabajo del día era simple; realizar nuestra rutina de desinfección y medición de valores en el hotel Sunsol Unik, y luego entregar una documentación en Lidotel. Entre paisajes tranquilos y una conversación amena, mi esposo y yo llegamos al Sunsol Unik. Allí nos demoramos un poco más de lo habitual, porque estaban cargando el tanque de agua con gandolas y debíamos esperar para poder clorar y medir los parámetros. Esa espera, lejos de incomodarnos, nos permitió observar el movimiento del hotel, el ir y venir de los trabajadores, y ese ambiente particular que tienen los hoteles cuando se preparan para recibir a sus huéspedes.*
![photo_2026-04-19_01-09-59.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpT58mAr7AcZXVa8b5UETi84HJ5Bk7dR6pHFQK8aY9PyYG9zwiHk9zhLLRds3HDMvt2.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-19_01-09-58.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqUeKD5HK4m98sm9jrDwAGkUMR7vAGj5JERGuUZTtUv8CxWY5v31UW24bFbq7dDwEKU.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-19_01-09-57.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EptaXPCRRhC5ff9NZDHkjHNr2PG7WjjrwCv1xHRw6xqZtchb9Kn9VzzLjDsGieiwDMX.jpg)

> **Once we finished our routine, we headed off to tackle our second task of the day: dropping off the paperwork at Lidotel, where the maintenance manager was already waiting for us. We took care of what needed to be done, and with our responsibilities fulfilled, we set off on the return trip.**

> *Al terminar nuestra rutina, nos retiramos para dirigirnos a nuestra segunda tarea del día; entregar la documentación en Lidotel, donde el gerente de mantenimiento ya nos estaba esperando. Cumplimos con lo necesario y, con nuestras responsabilidades concluidas, emprendimos el camino de regreso.*

> **We took Aldonza Manrique Avenue, passing through part of the Playa El Ángel neighborhood. We drove past the Hotel Tibisay, one of the island’s most renowned hotels, which came alive this Holy Week thanks to its amenities and prime oceanfront location. Seeing it so bustling and full of activity reminded us just how vibrant Margarita can be during that time of year.**

> *Tomamos la avenida Aldonza Manrique, atravesando parte del sector Playa El Ángel. Pasamos frente al Hotel Tibisay, uno de los más reconocidos de la isla, que esta Semana Santa cobró muchísima vida gracias a sus servicios y su ubicación privilegiada frente al mar. Verlo tan activo, tan lleno de movimiento, nos recordó lo vibrante que puede ser Margarita en esas fechas.*
![photo_2026-04-19_01-09-49.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqL8kUwDqxJXcsJjfoTQBNy7Nec2PDKJ6J4pNR3muPsEvk5uAA8dxeUxxeAJgJ7xjsc.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-19_01-09-41.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqfGswGczaqvs7f1gLjMBtQDVJummK5taPvPbwtAhkPPwUsDsEVirjJDaFeh1We2Vxw.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-19_01-09-40.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EprT764WzDEfWorJ9o5koRBexQXQqa8FUJwSPncnJT39GM8X6bQ51E9JHYXC4GGM9e7.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-19_01-09-40 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EprSBMz4bzYNxHxnjAJv2MFwNHyGhhzikchqXnZiqkW4aMPRR3LDvcQWiRKQDYdUFYF.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-19_01-09-39.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EonkUdfob6mqAdV5Yeppvp68MquarqvBncR5qdovRGZPJ1Vt6cqk8LNFeiWuLk1uLTM.jpg)

> **We continued our journey, taking in the beautiful views the area had to offer. Every corner seemed to bid us farewell on the last workday of the week, as if the island itself were giving us a gentle and well-deserved send-off. And so, amid the scenery, our conversations, and a gray but charming sky, we made our way toward our rest.**

> *Continuamos nuestro recorrido disfrutando de las hermosas vistas que el sector tenía para mostrarnos. links.title: 76ers set to face Celtics in First Round of NBA Playoffs! - Game 1 this afternoon in Boston!!!
links.body:
![nba-philadelphia-76ers-logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AK3eyGpWbyoaTTjJeeKnj44681PrD7tPGkoXMiDJYKDywwjPDVKgyqJH3UhvszU.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/nba/nba-philadelphia-76ers-logo/)

The Sixers were locked in against the Magic on Wednesday in their Play-In game! They got a gritty, physical [victory](https://youtu.be/NRrsPfJRB70?si=rj0uKmwJGR0IYAJ-) and locked up the seventh seed. The energy in the arena was awesome! I'm so proud of the squad, their defensive effort in particular really stood out to me. **The Sixers held the Magic under a hundred points, and they had eight steals and nine blocks as a team!** I think defeating the Magic in that game was a good way to prove to everyone that the Sixers are more than just Joel Embiid. This roster is deep and ready to go! After last season's ugliness, this win in Philly just felt nice.

Now the Sixers are set to face the Celtics who are an excellent team and won the NBA Championship only two years ago. 

Now, everyone who even mildly follows the NBA knows that the Celtics are in fact the favorites in this series. It's not rocket science. 

But I'm not about to just write my team off and be negative. That's boring and I wouldn't feel like a true fan if I just have zero belief in this team. 

I really do think the Sixers have a chance. Not a huge chance, but a chance. Even with Embiid out, I think this team has all of a sudden found a respectable Big Three in Tyrese Maxey, Paul George, and V.J. Edgecombe. Edgecombe was absolutely amped against the Magic and I have a feeling he's gonna hit the gas more than ever in this series. I like how each of the Big Three vary in age too. Edgecombe is a star rookie, Tyrese Maxey seems to be in his prime and reaching his full potential, and Paul George is the vet and he looks pretty reinvigorated at the moment.

Also, while I know the Celtics are proven and mentally tough, I think psychologically speaking, many people assume the Sixers will be a bit of a pushover without Embiid. I think the Celtics could underestimate them and see the Sixers as a vulnerable target. The Sixers could surprise them and potentially steal a game or two this way...

Also, while Jayson Tatum has looked good since returning sooner than expected from his Achilles injury, I am curious how he handles the Playoff intensity. 

The Sixers know the Celtics well at this point, so the Celtics won't surprise them in any particular fashion. 

I am SO ready. It's going to be difficult but the Sixers could shock the world!

This duo could disrupt the league...
![89656535007-28739052.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/23wC9hwhf8fQpdJRGEpgsa3Wr4eu8RNU7nsKUrprRqTmnVhjpweAKPJboxtbMTXafACbE.webp)
[Src](https://sixerswire.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/sixers/2026/04/17/celtics-vs-76ers-nba-playoffs-game-1-how-to-watch-live-stream-game-time/89666029007/)

I am so excited to watch the Sixers in the Playoffs again, thank God I'm healthy and able to watch them compete!

links.body:
![IMG_0774.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/242hm7jfvsagpr73suxnmv71RFrmqCUuXujUBCoirjcjZA3vG9p5UE4uA6enFFkUbmfFL.jpg)

**Hola hola gente bonita de hive, hoy me van a acompañar a sabadear en Pampatar, soy partidaria de sacarme a pasear cuando la mente está corriendo muy rápido y el sábado no fue la excepción.**
>Hello hello beautiful people of Hive, today you're going to join me for a Saturday in Pampatar. I'm a big believer in taking myself out for a walk when my mind is racing, and Saturday was no exception.

![IMG_20260411_150620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/243q2EMuVrLqwBUos4LZQzT8szb1Wd4YfYTad1v7yUAStsYzyuUKv5x43BYWcuLrC84Rp.jpg)

**Mi primera parada fue en Papaíto, un bar restaurante ubicado en la Magnesita, Pampatar. Aquí estuve unas horas escuchando el mar, aunque sinceramente odié que era fin de semana y por el fácil acceso estás playas están full y con con música.**
>My first stop was at Papaíto, a bar and restaurant located in Magnesita, Pampatar. I spent a few hours there listening to the sea. Although I honestly hated that it was the weekend and because of the easy access these beaches were full and with music playing.

![IMG_20260411_155445.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23zS1DTzgdgsjsPJHRKACy9ZiNFyitvZZyVSpgMK7Dk5fbUh3B484EDP4oBA6N489qr4t.jpg)

**Aquí me comí un par de empanadas de pescado y pase mucho rato con este amiguito debajo de una palmera.** 
>Here I ate a couple of fish empanadas and spent a lot of time with this little friend under a palm tree 

![IMG_20260411_150207.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23wqbyiiFS4TFHXhjDXbo2RiJWaZed3kUERHNQar3bpZ4C5qycHbuViPKm4CJ6vQZ7beh.jpg)

**Cuando estoy no tan al cien emocionalmente me gusta vestirme linda, esforzarme por salir y ver cosas nuevas, porque soy una persona que siente muy profundamente las cosas, y aunque si hay días que solo quiero estar en la cama, no me permito dejarme llevar por esos sentimientos porque puedo caer en un hoyo tremendo.**
>When I'm not feeling my best emotionally, I like to dress up, make an effort to go out and see new things, because I'm a person who feels things very deeply. And although there are days when I just want to be in bed, I don't allow myself to be carried away by those feelings because I could fall into a terrible hole.

![202296.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23y8onuw988rv45mk4TAaarzrSJGDfpnJXMTcHafwZXFQCmw6CsDW3YWtC34Eo6nRR5m9.jpg)

**Este día no me metí al mar, pero si le conté y agradecí muchas cosas desde la orilla. Gracias por acompañarme una vez más, nos vemos en un próximo post ❤️✨**
>I didn't go in the sea today, but I did share and give thanks for many things from the shore. Thank you for joining me once again, see you in the next post ❤️✨

![IMG_0801.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23z7Um1HcQNuNP3jtgVGqNVe4oy6J3qEkiPouMw7Mxpq9VwFc4fNXmmcYL7mg1qiKytCF.jpg)

links.title: El Astro Moderno /The Modern Star
links.body:
<center>

El sol se jubiló,
por muchos años trabajó 
y en su reemplazo dejó 
una lámpara de brillo mayor
y en el centro de la ciudad quedó.

Un día un gato ladrón,
hasta este lugar llegó,
la lámpara en su mochila guardó 
y se la llevó,
en penumbra todo quedó. 

>The sun retired,
after working for many years,
and in its place left
a lamp that shone even brighter,
which remained in the center of the city.

>One day, a thieving cat
came to this spot,
stuffed the lamp into its backpack,
and carried it away,
leaving everything in darkness. 

![32503.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23vsUYoA7TCjateyA777j8AhaY8tBy5bJXYKQa1z17MmzBD8p2qxQqtUa8YTRi8uwdSvU.gif)

El señor Manzana salió de casa
y no encontró la lámpara,
esto le generó nostalgia
y se sentó a llorar, con justa causa 
en la oscuridad que lo acompañaba. 

El sol anciano llegó al lugar
traía un nuevo sol para regalar,
lo dejó volando en la ciudad,
todo se alumbró de forma sin igual 
y la manzana lo abrazo con felicidad.

>Mr. Manzana left his house
and couldn’t find the lamp,
which made him feel nostalgic,
so he sat down and cried, with good reason,
in the darkness that surrounded him.

>The old sun arrived on the scene,
bringing a new sun as a gift;
he let it float over the city,
and everything lit up like never before,
and the apple embraced it with joy. 

![32504.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23uR3QYDMna1cFddz5tQLNarCfT8SyCywbjACMMi7FsoS1uC2RAp7gQHVgtrCjvFULue8.gif)

El sol se marchó a descansar,
el señor Manzana se fue a su hogar
y un día regreso el gato a robar
e intento el nuevo astro alcanzar,
pero no lo pudo lograr. 

El gato ladrón se fue de mal genio,
por no poder llevarse el sol nuevo,
la ciudad quedó con resplandor intenso,
iluminada y sin misterio,
con un astro moderno 

>The sun went to rest,
Mr. Apple went home,
and one day the cat returned to steal
and tried to reach the new sun,
but couldn’t manage it.

>The thieving cat left in a huff,
unable to take the new sun with him,
and the city was left bathed in intense light,
illuminated and devoid of mystery,
with a modern sun.

![32505.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23u6BhLvSHU2afGni9Cy5mMQQ1s5H8zv7XHdJsUd5eM448AsQSxpvT8aqk8RPHMxHBsre.gif)

</center>

links.title: Adventures In Homesteading (Day 622)
links.body:
Hello Everyone!

**On time at last, Making tea with an espresso maker, A brief hike, The plants are looking good & A late day storm!**

Alright, I am on time with my writing routine this evening... and hopefully I can stay on track with the editing and posting as well. Since I am still not 'armed' with my favorite beverage... we will see how that last bit goes but I did figure out that if I put a few tea bags (with a few scoops of coco atop them) inside the basket of the stove-top espresso maker... it makes for one dark strong drink!

It is one of those things, that I should have done earlier given how much I love making espresso... but when it came right down to it... I did not want to 'foul' my stove-top maker with tea residue. Obviously, I caved on that and one of my justifications was that I have had a terrible time feeling relaxed enough to rest sans coffee... and if making 'tea-presso' helps then I *should be* all for it.

Anyways, my sleep cycle is still on that weird schedule that I mentioned previously... but today I began wresting it back into a semblance of my usual pattern by getting to bed much earlier than I have been. I did not stay asleep for all that long on my first try... but after getting up and tending to the dogs I zonked back out again for another few hours.

Later, when I woke up again... I forced myself to get outside (aside from having to let the dogs in and out) and did my best to hike around and look at everything. Not that I went all that far beyond the old camp... but just getting out in nature, stretching my legs and looking at plants and trees was a good feeling.

While I was in that area, I also fetched water from the rain barrel there... watered the nearby plants in the greenhouse... and then lugged it uphill to the chicken coop and watered all the flower pots atop the coop. It was pretty tricky being able to reach all the plants... but my foot was feeling 'okay' enough to climb the sides of the coop (and be able to reach everything) so I did it *and* at long last... I finally got to see what is growing.

Those squash (or pumpkin) plants that I could barely see before are way larger than I though that they were... and there are also lots of smaller ones that have a lot of growing to do to catch up. I am unsure if some of the other plants popping up in the pots are the tomatoes that I planted... but there were at least a few dozen really small seedlings as well as what looks like a random grape vine or two.

By the time that I was done piddling around with the 'hiking' and watering the plants... my foot was in no shape to lug more water to the flower pots near the studio. Right at the end of doing everything I was limping along back to the studio considering watering them... when my brain was like: If it hurts to the point of wanting to get off your feet do not push it and turn what might be a mild temporary injury into a not-so-mild long term injury!

As it turned out, I got back indoors just in time to miss the initial heavy winds that abruptly started... and sent pollen and road dust (in these super dry conditions) swirling everywhere. Not long after that a big storm began forming off on the horizon... and even though the wind eventually died down the storm kept building until just a few moments ago when it began raining.

Well, on that note I am going to wrap this entry up because it is getting late and this storm has the dogs on edge. I hope that everyone is doing well. Ta ta for now.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV9JM84JYnp7B4qUks4FRa1ydwkNEVSa1Prv5SeisDrUg/img_20260418_183019599_hdr.jpg)</center>
<center>*This is that storm that started blowing in!*</center>

<center>**Thanks for reading!**</center>

<center>**Please check out the [Homesteading Community](https://ecency.com/created/hive-114308)!**
</center>

<center>***Cheers! & Hive On!***</center>

<center>*All content found in this post is mine!*</center>

##### **Hola a toda mi gente de Hive... 🐱** Hoy una vez más como parte de la colección de los tantos Pokémon que he hecho, decidí hacer para compartir con todos ustedes, un Pokémon Magnemite, el mismo es de tipo eléctrico/acero y tiene forma de imán, se los traigo en forma de una figura decorativa en 2D en la técnica de quilling. #### ***Esperando que sea de su agrado, les dejo mi proceso creativo:*** ># **Comencemos:😃**
|| |-| |![InShot_20260418_221450109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKU6X4n7Bp6aZSSZHRtEzQDh8ep7kuiZYQSAPfPwefv6fgyydskdSGdX6xRDZCs.jpg)| || |-| |![InShot_20260418_221315515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKU5Xp8y3BgroqxXrmWmX3PtpesyZFQfm3pf9FgXx5YTiJVh4LxDouUeznyqdht.jpg)| || |-| |
![2de3c0c3ad234d5a8abff273bd973b84.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/23y8zFkcVpQip2PHv41mwyvHHvXdPS4LJQfDnxhSAdPpFbSnbTinYCotBvinhjz7DoFdb.gif)
|
![39.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48TJcMfHbMdJtjKSUA9KCCCSTbXrJQy1idAjYi2Hr1tDf2kZnRoyVGyYfXHEpwFvCM.png)
>• Cintas para quilling. • Aguja para quilling. • Mandril para moldear círculos. >• Cartulinas. >• Guillotina de cortar papel. >• Pintura al frío color rojo y azul. >• Pega blanca extra fuerte (de carpintería). >• Pincel. >• Tijera. >
• Quilling paper. • Quilling needle. • Circle-making mandrel. • Cardstock. • Paper cutter. • Red and blue cold-set paint. • Extra-strong white glue (woodworking glue). • Paintbrush. • Scissors.
![40.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48SpZgefHFSX4tcvQfhpdVsM51fKanb8EdcWXzo36HoQj5CPD6vKMgprVtxnX9E7xG.png)
• To make the centerpiece, we’ll use 3-mm-wide quilling paper in various colors: black, white, and gray. • We’ll start by winding the paper around the needle with a piece of black paper to form a small circle. Next, we’ll use white paper to create a slightly thicker strip. Then, we’ll go back to a small piece of black paper, followed by gray paper to make another thick strip. We’ll finish with another piece of black paper, secure it with extra-strong white glue, and remove it from the needle.
![41.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48TnU9jLg64ufmgLUHNQeMMZv9Nm5DtPcXhFv9jTCKALifHYrtfxTJ4P3wHScvh1RH.png)
• Para realizar la pieza central vamos a tomar cinta para quilling de diversos colores de 3 mm de ancho, negro, blanco y gris. • Vamos a enrollar con la aguja iniciando con un trozo de color negro para hacer un pequeño círculo, continuaremos con color blanco realizando una franja un poco más gruesa, continuaremos nuevamente con un pequeño trozo de color negro para luego seguir con color gris realizando otra franja gruesa, finalizaremos con otro trozo de color negro, sellamos con pega blanca extra fuerte y sacamos de la aguja.
|||| |-|-|-| |![InShot_20260418_215836310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EoyTrrVNasRZisQCUuCLBBX3MFnXqJhmY5ui2P4hB9JFkjGvZyLWbaZCJAGbjW5bqwz.jpg)|![InShot_20260418_215942587.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/Ep7xYsQsjbQtK1kqF2QnaX6hqWPCFJNdhEBSo3iLeNtTNJ4qAyT5VdzM32KK7Rqanhe.jpg)|![InShot_20260418_220044404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EonoqUeej6i6vUnJqKFuLKeJYiFhGY6CUPh4DbdJ5eg8L12hGHw5KkEBSBTLvXnKVBF.jpg)|
• To create the details of the centerpiece, take a 3 mm wide dark gray ribbon and use it to make a small closed circle. • Next, use a 1 mm wide gray ribbon to make another closed circle that’s slightly larger. • Join the two pieces together to form a screw, then glue it to the top of the centerpiece. • We’ll use a circle-making mandrel and, using size 4 from top to bottom, make a ring with gray tape. • Once the ring is ready, we’ll apply extra-strong white glue and let it dry thoroughly.
![S.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/Eo1xq5mBnfyu766mjzRfzkkxQSiU3xbRk277sqvok1PSSskBeGZ15YzyQw52yZAx3w8.png)
• Para hacer los detalles de la pieza central, tomaremos cinta de color gris oscuro de 3 mm de ancho con ella haremos un pequeño círculo cerrado. • Proseguimos con cinta gris de 1mm de ancho con la cual realizaremos otro círculo cerrado un poco más grande. • Uniremos ambas piezas para formar un tornillo, este lo pegaremos en la parte de arriba de la pieza central. • Vamos a tomar un mandril para moldear círculos y en la medida número 4 de arriba hacia abajo haremos un aro con cinta de color gris. • Una vez listo el aro, aplicaremos pega blanca extra fuerte y dejaremos secar muy bien.
|||| |-|-|-| |![InShot_20260418_220236013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpJbWkTbPiugCpqnD9Z8ZyM8V2MK11RXMavKzWjNt8Q6294igzXZQNHjV5RcL8TmcUA.jpg)|![InShot_20260418_220356197.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/Ep5pggkKds5sNum8Lxzqz72tCjrSduezxdZy8W2z5KPDv1C4uffZHQAPdXeAPHQFWaB.jpg)|![InShot_20260418_220433238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EqSYrv2eJkQAxSBmu8AZmBpeoY99sxjAwkCpsrkYmZKhiDjVBpUV2hvk6ahnaNDHcEz.jpg)| || |-| |![InShot_20260418_220535829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EonpSQhh5oFYYHJJEBdoWPbVQuadV78iqFweAxekyFtwdbDADwjKPQWUx1bWA8AFfcF.jpg)|
• To finish the remaining details, take a 1-millimeter-wide gray ribbon and use it to make two closed circles. • Once the circles are ready, take a piece of dark gray ribbon and glue a cross-like shape onto each piece to make them look like screws. Glue them to both sides of the bottom of the center piece. • At this point, take the ring we made earlier, cut it in half, and shape both parts into magnets. • Using red and blue cold-set paint, paint the tips of the piece to create the magnet’s poles. Glue it to both sides of the central piece. • To protect and laminate it, apply several layers of extra-strong white glue, allowing each layer to dry before applying the next. >This completes the Magnemite Pokémon as a decorative figure, created using the quilling technique.
![S.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/Eo1xq5mBnfyu766mjzRfzkkxQSiU3xbRk277sqvok1PSSskBeGZ15YzyQw52yZAx3w8.png)
• Para continuar con los detalles restantes, tomaremos cinta de color gris de un milímetro de ancho, con ella realizaremos dos círculos cerrados. • Listo los círculos tomaremos un trozo de cinta gris oscuro, y pegaremos una especie de cruz en cada pieza para simular que son tornillos. Pegaremos en ambos lados de la parte de abajo de la pieza central. • En este punto tomaremos el aro que hicimos con antelación, lo picaremos a la mitad y moldearemos ambas partes en forma de imán. • Con pintura al frío color roja y azul, pintaremos las puntas de la pieza para hacer los polos del imán. Lo pegaremos en ambos lados de la pieza central. • Para proteger y plastificar, podemos aplicar varias capas de pega blanca extra fuerte dejando secar entre una capa y otra. >De esta manera finalice este Pokémon Magnemite en forma de una figura decorativa, en la técnica de quilling.
||| |-|-| |![InShot_20260418_220631362.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EptdqHQaEvjvF5tE5UYLM4cTFpVMbQdjyMn1aETzac6oJBSz7y3X3anMUH1qxUD8V9i.jpg)|![InShot_20260418_220736661.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpELjNcJAttKawtWjm7kc1ADasYDkW2kKSkkJMxtd6hWwVr3gD56x6Lqwrfs5JPaEhg.jpg)| ||| |-|-| |![InShot_20260418_220852481.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EowK1nAAZW4wzmraCDSe5Jo81FjA9zhGd9ur3ZsZTmxum5rPB1t4RXUYSRMrVsHkVTR.jpg)|![InShot_20260418_221156582.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EppQ2ESGQdRNe76MvRjq5ftAj1ZM5JJ7PxRH6QaVTGZv9FmjdgVjzNQiExZpYLDq8J4.jpg)|

links.title: Mi problema con los audiolibros
links.body: Seamos claros: leer y escuchar no son lo mismo y muchas son las razones de ello. En primer lugar, porque hay una diferencia semántica implícita en estos dos verbos. Son dos acciones distintas, dirigidas hacia diferentes sentidos biológicos de nuestro ser. Uno requiere de nuestra vista, mas el otro utiliza nuestra audición y, si bien ambos reclaman de atención, concentración y esfuerzo, estos elementos se manifiestan en dimensiones diferentes para cada acto. Es por ello que cuando alguien marca en Goodreads como “leído” un libro al que realmente solo hizo click mientras viajaba en auto o se desplegaba en el sofá, ojos cerrados, a escucharlo (y quién sabe cuántos pensamientos convergían en dicha cabeza mientras lo hacía) es ahí cuando empieza mi problema: en el hecho de confundir o reemplazar tales actividades. No tengo nada en contra de los audiolibros. Me parecen una opción fascinante ¡es cómo escuchar un podcast de ultratumba con nuestros escritores favoritos como locutores! Pero el simple gesto de pasear nuestro ojos por el papel o la pantalla, el reconocer los grafemas y palabras de una frase, eso, señores, requiere de otro nivel de disfrute. **Te pierdes muchas cosas cuando escuchas por primera vez una novela, en lugar de leerla.** La primera de ellas es que se omite la cuestión de la forma y el estilo. Hay sutilezas en la prosa que se saltan al oído. Igual que no e s lo mismo que te describan una pintura que verla con tus propios ojos, así también es imposible interactuar con la prosa del autor, su forma de estructurar oraciones y construir imágenes, si no vuelcas tus ojos en el texto. También está el asunto de los símbolos. **Vivimos en una sociedad disociada**, eso es un hecho científico. Nuestra capacidad de retención y asociación ha sido violentamente arrollada por el paso de cientos de estímulos diarios. Con semejante cifra encima ¿crees tú que podrás captar al vuelo una metáfora, dato escondido o algún recurso lingüístico con elevar el volumen de tus audífonos? Y hablando de distracciones, tenemos que mencionar el factor concentración. A menos que cierres los ojos mientras escuchas, te será super fácil perder el hilo (o mezclarlo) de la narración. Añadiría, por último, la sensación placentera de palpar, oler, observar un libro; pasar sus páginas y deleitarse con ellas. Eso no tiene sustituto alguno. **¿Cuándo creo que es bueno escuchar audiolibros?** Como opción de disfrute alterno, luego de leer esa obra que te dejó extasiado o ese libro de divulgación que sacudió tu mente. Escuchar es un acto de reafirmación: las ideas prenden mejor con ello. Además, no podemos ignorar las múltiples opciones que tiene el formato. Hay ediciones audibles con la voz de nuestros actores o personalidades favoritas leyendo para nosotros ¡incluso sonidos ambientados y música de fondo! Un audiolibro es una fiesta, un paquete Premium de sensaciones más allá del texto. A mí me gustan mucho, solo que jamás de los jamases confundiría “leer” con “escuchar”. Jamás abordaría por primera vez una obra en formato audio, violando el acto más introspectivo, retroalimentativo e íntimo de todos: el de leer. Así que hazte el favor de comprarte ese tomo o encargarlo por la web para que puedas abordarlo correctamente en su primera vez; ya podrás luego encender tus airdrops para una segunda aventura.

links.title: Visitando la Cascada la Llovizna 🤗 en épocas de sequía... [ENG/ESP]
links.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the Lifestyle community. Today I’m joining you here to share another day in my life with you. This time, I want to tell you about my weekend during my visit to La Llovizna Park here in Ciudad Guayana. For this Saturday, my partner had planned a trip to the park so we could spend time together in a different way. He usually really enjoys this kind of setting, surrounded by nature and with the anticipation of a possible adventure (finding a new path, for example). Although the park itself is designed to be accessible, safe, and intuitive for people of all ages—whether children or adults—there is no immediate danger, or at least not to a certain extent. That said, if you venture beyond the park’s boundaries, you can reach the Loefling River and surrounding areas where certain risks may exist, since there are no park rangers or safety personnel. Back to my original point. Before heading there, we stopped to eat some delicious empanadas to fuel up for the hike.

\n\n>

>Saludos a todos en la comunidad de Lifestyle. El día de hoy me uno por acá para compartir con ustedes un nuevo día en mi vida. En esta ocasión las quiero contar cómo me fue este fin de semana durante mi visita al parque de la llovizna acá en Ciudad Guayana. Para este día sábado, mi pareja había planificado un viaje hasta el parque y así poder pasar tiempo juntos de forma diferente. Él suele disfrutar bastante de este tipo de ambiente, rodeado de la naturaleza y con la expectativa de una posible aventura (encontrar un nuevo camino, por ejemplo). Aunque el parque en sí mismo está planificado para ser accesible, seguro e intuitivo para cualquiera de las edades, ya sea niños o adultos, por lo que no hay un peligro inminente o al menos es así hasta cierto punto ya que si se atraviesa los márgenes del lugar se puede llegar hasta el Loefling y zonas aledañas donde puede existir ciertos riesgo, ya que no hay guardabosques ni equipo de seguridad. Vuelvo a la idea primera. Antes de ir hasta allá, pasamos a comer unas buenas empanadas para ir con la energía necesaria para la caminata.

![IMG_3047.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EowJ26GnbjvHSMnjBrviGM73Fi9LiseE6TUTiUdLpbZB2wBqeZ5NoLXRvSm2fgsRUV2.jpeg) ![IMG_3046.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EoptuEjPvDWbjfBzM129fz9wpezTLSmpv4uD49xvzUSf7LdqwSd3moywkNWaHvyrZvU.jpeg) ![8E76FFDE-A6D7-49A3-8ACA-6A923CA480B7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Ep7ve2gsNmkgYC5SgL2eMCJKmBvSECo3a5cUE42B7ueLYgZqRatzXHjT7L393WDjAcL.jpeg) ![IMG_3191.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eou9gYnpAVekTKWcGavo8GuwCvgRMpRPJDTDYW45L6t3cJbc4achqS1dp79WwhGfei9.jpeg) ![IMG_3230.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eoc8U1pqyLYgfaYGH2VPtZRCMrzN5J2FmEP2n4eK7YDgTk7dLW6nLeS1MTm2JXUkDab.jpeg) ![IMG_3072.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqL7NTAGqXHhQrBf6y2TTgouJf9jtoWXXzi1g4fA2zQRBFeVehnRGFjL68Hy7TPh2jm.jpeg) ![IMG_3131.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EppLcZ4wBCizRzBBRacdic5TTLQCeBrkvwYz6oX9YePVmBiWQnrYmLqmtec2kiWrAWB.jpeg) ![IMG_3200.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpEKErdGrjnq6qnzB2Bu3Q1582kRCsVuUemsezXMj7YBfjrUtdqJHgnwaSkAuwgFddX.jpeg) ![IMG_3208.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqNFC6xHBTLXsKEXLB2D7zKeEsnMN4YajCX1p1wWKYaDZZcZFBKMAZ88vwi9CnndKGf.jpeg)

>We used to go by van (at least two of them), but after calculating the costs, I think it turned out much better and faster to take a private car—that is, a taxi. So we arrived at 10 a.m., and I must say that thanks to the droughts that have been plaguing the country, the park looked pretty barren... the grass was dry, and even the trees were bare. It’s only natural that it would be like that. The heat was much more intense than ever, and it was a bit intense to feel the sun so close, but despite that, I was comfortable (I always come prepared with supplies). And what can I say about my partner? Well, he doesn’t like the heat, but he was happy taking his photos and walking.

\n\n

>Today we saw lots of little animals: monkeys, fish, and even ducks. I loved it because I was able to take some videos and photos of them. And I also took the opportunity to capture the park in its April state. We passed by the different spots in the park (the ponds and so on), until we finally reached the waterfalls, and as we expected, the waterfall was super low and you could barely feel the flow. Compared to other times of the year, today it wasn’t dressed in its grand white gown. In fact, there’s a spot in the park that’s the closest to the waterfall, and you usually feel the mist falling on you, but today there was none of that. On the other hand, I think it’s just as admirable, and we have to learn to appreciate those differences. I had a great time. I’ll leave you with the photos. Hugs, thanks for stopping by.

\n\n>

>Anteriormente íbamos en camioneta (al menos unas dos) pero calculando los precios, creo que salió mucho mejor y más rápido tomar un carro particular es decir un Taxi. Así llegamos a las 10 de la mañana y debo decir que gracias a las sequías que han estado azotando el país, el parque se veía bastante apagado... la grama seca y hasta los árboles sin su hojas. Es natural que sea así. El calor estaba mucho más intenso que nunca y fue un poco intenso sentir el sol tan de cerca, pero a pesar de ello yo estaba cómoda (siempre voy preparada con recursos). Y que decir de mi pareja, bueno a él no le gusta el calor pero estaba feliz tomando sus fotografías y caminando.

\n\n>

>Hoy encontramos muchos animalitos: monitos, peces y hasta patos. Me encantó pues pude tomar algunos videos y fotografías de ellos. Y también aprovechar de registrar el parque en este estado del mes de abril. Pasamos por los distintos puntos que hay en el parque (las lagunas y demás), hasta que finalmente llegamos a las cascadas y como esperábamos, la cascada estaba súper bajita y apenas se sentía su caída. En comparación a otras épocas del año, hoy no se vistió con su gran vestido blanco. De hecho, hay un punto en el parque qué es la zona más cercana a la cascada y se suele sentir el rocío que cae sobre uno pero hoy no hubo nada de eso. Por otro lado, yo creo que es igual de admirable y bueno hay que aprender a apreciar esas diferencias. La pasé muy bien. Los dejo con las fotografías. Un abrazo, gracias por pasar por aquí.

![IMG_3178.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqJ1QvZcQH44Z7mZ9kLjU9jctZC3WmuVjuchFerhJAgkwvA9gM9qf4y4TvG6WsUGqMM.jpeg) ![IMG_3092.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpxqGpRDo7A45y8pcL4tfrSFqzHTk7rnTViztVqERHE4KUUJBptWpVj8twVFwsE4P6Z.jpeg) ![IMG_3136.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqJ1QtXgZiYN2Y4hUYBG6tMugtrn9gnmLCRFws5yFSdEazKSXCSHpUHgXhaY6b4neqP.jpeg) ![IMG_3104.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpNpR56w5jjXPSiwtjrH2VbGe2PyhdR2GpbH1saik9VDsvfsz1N9dQmfXk93vdffzr8.jpeg) ![IMG_3101.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EopsPKn8xtgjPem4LBWeStdkV5X5vF8NBwdvaTYnByC2DdZUUAr5YAyY3rH8FvwLd9F.jpeg) ![IMG_3107.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpzxCcnJDgGSsF5KzhHXMayVnfDA8Myffd7DiW6iQhhGSBpfKuPkV6PJB4jp37Wnxqo.jpeg) ![IMG_3140.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EoyPWSyPhzagdakV6fXp7sfCqZt53C85kcMhPQtKBBuGZL29LwC5k68XNtGAUYARKSJ.jpeg) ![IMG_3216.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpVD4sKnhWgQMZ5a4ardXncxSRfntabXGatmePphPekoo2GFyonuCpYsTu2MZMz1VQm.jpeg) ![IMG_3102.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eq9UGnRx2kEzh3Y36onPEFAuQeCbywvRNfxnBVNuzZ5etAzdwchLRQTUjr2wTrCt5XJ.jpeg) ![IMG_3105.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpCBNN8uqCRahWCSjxmrSR5msK41x64GditwFhJFQL7QS8ixsHmdiALENvTyjF5aCcG.jpeg) ![Thank You for stopping by_20251222_235935_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqQRuBXhDFu9VJKoUi9KYBHi1fizexq9zibK9463CkCj7BCiSq9HsujVhAP8Vem6kgg.png)

links.title: Health is essential for students to focus on their studies.
links.body:
Greetings Education Community. How are you students and parents? I hope that by the infinite grace of God, you are well and your educational activities are going well. Today I would like to discuss the importance of good health for students.


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQKvFLRU54bYRRUEjVANnne82sxTTeVWzDyQK9j4HdFSR/pexels-bilal-moazzam-3225124-6725321.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-boy-in-a-red-polo-shirt-wearing-a-face-mask-6725321/)



Basically, one has to study from education. The first and main goal of a student is to study well. To study well, a student must work hard and be very diligent. If a student is not diligent, then he can never do well in studies. To do something good in studies, it is very important for the student to have good health. 

By health, we mean two types of things. One is mental health and the other is physical health. However, today I want to inform the students about the issue of physical health. 

If a student does not have good physical health, then he will never be able to do well in studies. There are many people among us who do not pay attention to the good health of students. But if the health of students is not good, then they can never concentrate on studies. Students face various kinds of stomach problems. Headache is a common problem for students who study excessively. Moreover, sometimes headaches and fatigue can come due to excessive studies. These are physical problems.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNfpN5NPmGBdqNH5CXJPPHsje1dn7t9QkBEMN6agALoVZ/pexels-bipspatiala-31864434.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/young-student-presenting-anatomical-model-in-classroom-31864434/)


A student should be monitored well. And for this, the most important responsibility is of course that of the guardians and parents. If a parent cannot take care of his child, then what kind of responsible family is he. A responsible family should definitely educate him well and try for the health of his child. It should be kept in mind that the child's health should not deteriorate in any way. 

If a student cannot be physically fit, then he can never concentrate on his studies. And for this, the school authorities and parents should definitely keep an eye on the health of the child. 

If necessary, a student should be monitored constantly in school. It is necessary to ensure whether his health is fine, whether any student has attended school. Or whether there is any mental or physical illness among the students. 

Also, students can discuss in their classrooms about how students can stay healthy. Because students go to school to learn constantly. And if teachers are aware of the matter, it plays a very important role for them. Therefore, tips for staying healthy must be taught to students and this is the responsibility of teachers and parents.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRjVbMXDKV2suPizuPWW8jWq1gEw59QHvcG6DWDjaPjkX/pexels-sahilcaptures-35645527.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/healthcare-workers-checking-blood-pressure-in-clinic-35645527/)



A student is the future of the future. Students will receive education and then they will enlighten their own lives. There is no alternative to education to enlighten their own lives. 

However, the biggest obstacle for these students is illness. It can be human or physical illness. Be it mental or physical illness, we must ensure the well-being of students. If we can ensure the mental and physical well-being of students and encourage them, then they will be able to do something good in life. 

So the real parents and teachers. Let us keep a close eye on the students and ensure their health and well-being. Only then can a student bring major success in his life, I believe. 

Thank you very much for being with the education community. Thank you very much for reading my writings today. I hope this blog today will help you take care of your students at least a little. I am saying goodbye like today.
