links.title: Rosarita By Anita Desei || Book Review
links.body:
![1000103763.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/AKCH3Ffebt22KwEECFVYyqM8vd23px8Ua7ipB3xPNXUTK7k2XNzpPpoXSEtn1yU.png) *
You had resisted her fantastical tale but now find you would like to believe it. Could she, like a wizard or a magician, bring your mother to life again even if it is a life you never knew or suspected?
*
This is the first time I'm reading a book by this author after seeing some good reviews of it on Goodreads. It's a novella of about 100 pages and so I thought, why not read it and get to know more about this author. Within three hours, I was done reading and had a new perspective on human nature. **Rosarita** is a haunting and reflective story. It focuses on Bonita, a young Indian woman who travels to Mexico to learn Spanish. Sitting on a bench in a park and enjoying the beauty around her, a lavishly dressed older woman, Vicky, approaches her. She says Bonita is a spitting image of her mother, Rosarita, who came to Mexico some years ago to learn arts. Bonita is reluctant at first, doubting the authenticity of Vicky's tale. She has no recollections of her mother painting or travelling to Mexico. Curious, she decides to follow Vicky whom she nicknames ‘The Stranger’ and ‘The Trickster’ on a tour of Mexico to visit places her mother had lived. On this journey, she struggles to understand who her mother is and why she made certain choices. Even more, she questions whether Vicky's tales are reliable or a figment of her imagination. **Genres:** Fiction, Classics **Publication:** July 2024 **Pages:** 112 #### My Review And Rating In this finely written novella, this author attempts to bridge the gap between two people of opposing worlds through the lens of arts, culture, history and memories. The book is short yet covers much more than many 500-page novels. The plot is compelling and straightforward—a daughter seeks to truly understand her mother. The storytelling is unique, told in the second person which makes it seem like the conscience of the characters speaking. Every action of the characters, especially the lead, is weighed on the scale of sensibility and what the society expects. I like that this novella delves deep into the philosophy of human pursuit and desires, understanding the line between fantasy and reality; and if a person can truly know another. The lead character, Bonita, seeks to differentiate between the version of her mother sold to her by The Stranger, and the woman who birthed her. It's like knowing two different personalities, so the question arises—which one of them is the real one? This leads Bonita into philosophical evaluation of her upbringing, family and culture. I can't decide if I like Bonita but she's a character who doesn't do much beyond observing people and her surroundings in Mexico, and comparing them through flashbacks to her life in India. Though she's determined not to live a domesticated life like her mother, she's kind of laid-back, preferring to travel and learn languages. She doesn't show much interest in anything else unlike her mother who pursues art in Mexico contrary to what her family expected of her. I like Anita Desei’s writing style. Written in second person, her story is lyrical; every scene captured in rich, vivid details such that it feels like I'm present in Jardín or San Miguel. She explores the gap that can exist between parents and children. A child's image of a parent can differ from how others see that same person. People make choices and pursue desires that may surprise their children. This novella gives an insight into a part of human nature, reminding us that no one is ever exactly who we think they are. Rating this novella, I will give it 3.8 stars out of 5. The writing style is unique and the story pulled me in. The author's love for her culture is beautiful, seen and felt in every page. I'd say it's a book worth reading. ![3yZiouw5jgtrj8RZntzpYvPkttnUNCNB3bKsugcDmKrZysEhsVCu7HmxWG7sYd9c3PJiWe24wRnpAB7HXq2WMvHX9AyxjgRuTY38KWSsv8...GFDdhx4UzPxqzjjpVMXNYgRDyspwo7pFw2RpyHZvde1tK7QLmYqnXBk9hDVg1dAooe2nLquVnXKjzS2uR5yQNqx1V5qutNgmqpFfKYLpS93ajRQosgFNPk3e1s.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23t7BFjADUCGjsLPt1YzFafTb9BeZ3Err5bNPwTi6RYNWED9TfZAhqAcZ8JCb2rGLLeT6.gif) *All images above are from my E-library* *Header images compiled in [Canva](https://canva.link/6oi9dbkd4cqz9td).* *Thank you for visiting and supporting my blog.* 🤗

links.title: ¡Un lindo atardecer nublado en Playa Concorde! 🌦 [ESP/ENG]
links.body:
>
Bienvenidos! 🙋🏻‍♀️
¡Hola amigos!! Espero que estén muy bien, por aquí yo estoy algo cansada a decir verdad, hoy es mi día más pesado de trabajo y ya no aguanto el sueño jajaja además de ser un día pesado vinieron familiares de tierra firme así que fue un día lleno de cosas bonitas que me dejaron exhausta, como también lo fue que en la academia tuvimos ensayo general, es decir, terminar de pulir y montar bailes para nuestra próxima presentación, y la elección de la reina de la academia y la bailarina homenajeada, quien demostrará su talento en un evento y recibirá su certificado por haber crecido y demostrado que siempre se puede ser mejor con esfuerzo y dedicación, en fin, un día bonito y muy ocupado. Aun así no quería dejar ir la oportunidad de compartirles este atardecer, el último que pude disfrutar hasta ahora, quienes están en la Isla saben que hemos tenido (gracias a Dios) ya 4 días con mucho frío, cielos nublados y lluvias esporádicas, aprovechando que se me dio la oportunidad decidí ir hasta mi lugar favorito para admirar atardeceres, y aunque todo estaba nublado, una vez el sol de escondió, yo estaba segura de que los tonos en el cielo cambiarían, y así fue!! Recuerdo que mis amistades quedaron algo impresionados con mis dotes de conocedora de atardeceres jajaja, esta es mi parte favorita, cuando el cielo y el mar se pintan de tonos cálidos y hermosos, así que tome muchas fotos jajaja, espero les gusten tanto como a mí y a mis acompañantes, espero como siempre, poder admirar otro atardecer, pero que sea de un rojo intenso, amén!! jajaja.
ENGLISH

Welcome! 🙋🏻‍♀️
Hi everyone! I hope you're all doing well. I'm a bit tired, to be honest. Today was my busiest day at work, and I can't stand the sleepiness anymore, haha. Besides being a busy day, family members came to visit from the mainland, so it was a day full of wonderful things that left me exhausted. We also had a dress rehearsal at the academy—finishing and rehearsing the dances for our next performance—and the selection of the academy queen and the honored dancer. The honoree will showcase her talent at an event and receive a certificate for her growth and for demonstrating that you can always improve with effort and dedication. All in all, a beautiful and very busy day. Even so, I didn't want to miss the opportunity to share this sunset with you, the last one I was able to enjoy so far. Those of you on the island know that we've had (thank God) four days of very cold weather, cloudy skies, and sporadic rain. Taking advantage of the opportunity, I decided to go to my favorite spot to admire sunsets, and although everything was cloudy, once the sun disappeared, I was sure that the colors in the sky would change, and they did! I remember my friends were a bit impressed with my sunset knowledge, haha. This is my favorite part, when the sky and sea are painted in warm and beautiful tones, so I took lots of pictures, haha. I hope you like them as much as my companions and I did. I hope, as always, to be able to admire another sunset, but one that's a deep red, amen! Haha.

links.title: Hay quien lleva la luz en la mirada (eng-esp)
links.body:
Hay quien lleva la luz en la mirada,
el susurro del tiempo en los oídos...
y va naciendo sol. 
Pocos amigos
degollan una lágrima por cada 
mañana que amanecen sobre el mundo.
Entre los pocos vas,
como una suerte de antídoto y de isla ante la muerte;  
(ese mar tempetuoso 
en que me hundo.)
Agradezco a la vida por tu abrazo,
por la amistad que salva del ocaso
y por lo que es lo mismo: la poesía.

links.title: Algo de rato libre tras el trabajo [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
Ay la catedral de Maturín, tan maravillosa como famosa, y tan frecuente como redundante. No es la primera vez que voy, pero sí la primera en la que logro fotografiarla bajo un cielo de noche esplendido, medio nublado y medio despejado. Estas fotografías no iban a existir porque no fue mi intención ir a tomar fotos, solo quería sentarme un rato y disfrutar de la vista y el frío agradable en una ciudad donde usualmente el calor te convierte en un manantial de sudor. --- ![Fashion2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23uQhuLVpfTtPvotAq9MXqf6rmY8x8ATbkdmggJYqeDxnTCTmWQL9EXWUZssJ3dtvDJjy.png) --- Me acompañó una amiga. A ambos nos habían despedido del trabajo. No estábamos ahí porque nos sentíamos tristes, más bien, estábamos felices porque o sea, tras largos meses de una ardua jornada laboral, atendiendo gente que nos preguntaba hasta por la función de los tornillos (trabajábamos en una ferretería), era lógico que nuestro estado de anímo estaba como la fiebre alta. Ella no quiso fotografiarse, yo tampoco quería, pero de alguna forma lo hice. Había gente alrededor; un niño estaba jugando con un perrito pero lo zarandeaba tanto que mi amgia casi se levanta del banco y lo regaña. ¡Los niños no se regañan! Los de al lado pensaban que éramos una pareja y, como estaban vendiendo helados, querían promociar su sabor para enamorados. Les dije que ella era mi novia -cosa que no es cierta- pero el dolor en sus muelas no le permitía comer cosas frías. Ella me golpeó. Igual no compramos nada porque no nos habían pagado nuestra liquidación -excusa para no comprar helados- (😂). Fue una ocasión bastante agradable. Después que culmina una etapa laboral exigente, uno se da la libertad de descansar un poco. Ya luego vendrá la preocupación de buscar empleo en un país donde no hay empleos, o donde te quieren explotar por un sueldo de limosna. ¿Vale la pena preocuparse? ¡No! De alguna forma u otro, lo bueno siempre llega. ### _Mira los momentos más destacados en esta Galería de Fotos ⏬_ Cuando llegamos estaba casi vacío. La gente suele pararse en la plaza a tomar aire fresco, en una ciudad que suele ser muy calurosa. |![photo_14_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23wqnWQNmCfvqW5kkPFYMFPshYBXohzV4HBqWeNGuZ9sKm72ttTmmW6z3t1xBnwcfCsrW.jpg)|![photo_13_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/241tb4NGhUU2ZpFqUVyHxuydAothHXMaAofGXv23FqJQWH2TbeSq9ATvd2EVbaEeCiYuU.jpg)|![photo_12_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23xAZh2iuvDoxHBAqXtCJtpiTLFddTBxJRkYqTsR7L5m6aM82qxo8iS1equjvHGgDmfdf.jpg)| |-|-|-| La gente suele atravesarse justo cuando me toman una fotografía. |![photo_11_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23xAZh2iuvDoxHBAqXtCJtpiTLFddTBxJRkYqTsR7L5m6aM82qxo8iS1equjvHGgDmfdf.jpg)|![photo_10_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/242DNbcThCp7SUSvYapJwoLdXVZjiygsGsQkocx6NN6MipBCpZwLKJ8p4GFZhBMot2zKr.jpg)| |-|-| --- Al llegar la noche, fui bajando la iluminación del lente de la cámara para contrastar mejor las luces de la catedral y la luna. -Práctica de un inexperto en la fotografía :P- |![photo_8_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23tRveHMr9b8C51qWVz2Ab6qYDT5x34UvLtan8SfwCZbvcXekh5K3ctVWaCbTu4BPJ9A1.jpg)|![photo_7_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23tRveHMr9b8C51qWVz2Ab6qYDT5x34UvLtan8SfwCZbvcXekh5K3ctVWaCbTu4BPJ9A1.jpg)|![photo_6_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23t72XDjSgQw6pdwxko1qiKuVQ7XFPSgsB6LmZyk7WC8CgYK9RXRVNDB4rks1KRAoW7na.jpg)| |-|-|-| La noche estaba preciosa y fría. Una convinación perfecta para despejar la mente. |![photo_5_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23swcJge4dh9BwCVuU7EwopAiV83nvgZMtXqLcNLmiZ2SFWbiwnmQXmGztAwodDTEAh6i.jpg)|![photo_4_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23swcJge64uKAwoTNvMuWRBbxvgCGxEp9yCw5LDYfhLqZQQKU9m1U494utnDMBVG4HM2T.jpg)|![photo_2_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23swXhfud1vojScnyRMooyatQhS2vPwXwXcfKCqBqSktbECeoiWepJaqndCJ6YvTqLy2c.jpg)| |-|-|-| --- _Conversamos largo rato allí, y luego, en lugar de ir a comer helados, fuimos por unas cervezas -material para otro post, :P- ¡Y no había dinero para helados pero sí para cerveza XD!_ --- Y aunque antes ya he visitado esta catedral, puedo decirles con seguridad que es la primera vez que puedo capturarla danzando con la luna. ---
ENGLISH VERSION Ah, the Maturín Cathedral, as marvelous as it is famous, and as frequently seen as it is redundant. It's not my first time there, but it is the first time I've managed to photograph it under a splendid night sky, half cloudy and half clear. These photographs weren't going to exist because my intention wasn't to take pictures; I just wanted to sit for a while and enjoy the view and the pleasant coolness in a city where the heat usually turns into a fountain of sweat. A friend accompanied me. We had both been laid off from our jobs. We weren't there because we felt sad; rather, we were happy because, well, after long months of a grueling workday, serving customers who asked us about everything, even the function of screws (we worked in a hardware store), it was only natural that our moods were as high as a fever. She didn't want to be photographed, nor did I, but somehow I did. There were people around; A little boy was playing with a puppy, but he was shaking it so hard that my friend almost got up from the bench and scolded him. Kids don't scold each other! The people next to us thought we were a couple, and since they were selling ice cream, they wanted to promote their \

flavor. I told them she was my girlfriend, but her toothache prevented her from eating cold things. She hit me. We didn't buy anything anyway because we hadn't received our severance pay (😂).

It was a pretty pleasant occasion. After a demanding work period ends, you give yourself the freedom to rest a little. Then comes the worry of looking for a job in a country where there are no jobs, or where they want to exploit you for a pittance. Is it worth worrying? No! One way or another, good things always come.


### _See the highlights in this Photo Gallery ⏬_

When we arrived, it was almost empty. People often stop in the square to get some fresh air in a city that is usually very hot.

|![photo_14_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23wqnWQNmCfvqW5kkPFYMFPshYBXohzV4HBqWeNGuZ9sKm72ttTmmW6z3t1xBnwcfCsrW.jpg)|![photo_13_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/241tb4NGhUU2ZpFqUVyHxuydAothHXMaAofGXv23FqJQWH2TbeSq9ATvd2EVbaEeCiYuU.jpg)|![photo_12_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23xAZh2iuvDoxHBAqXtCJtpiTLFddTBxJRkYqTsR7L5m6aM82qxo8iS1equjvHGgDmfdf.jpg)|
|-|-|-|

People often walk in front of me just as I'm being photographed.

|![photo_11_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23xAZh2iuvDoxHBAqXtCJtpiTLFddTBxJRkYqTsR7L5m6aM82qxo8iS1equjvHGgDmfdf.jpg)|![photo_10_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/242DNbcThCp7SUSvYapJwoLdXVZjiygsGsQkocx6NN6MipBCpZwLKJ8p4GFZhBMot2zKr.jpg)|
|-|-|

As night fell, I gradually lowered the camera lens's brightness to better contrast the cathedral lights and the moon. -Practice of a photography novice :P-

|![photo_8_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23tRveHMr9b8C51qWVz2Ab6qYDT5x34UvLtan8SfwCZbvcXekh5K3ctVWaCbTu4BPJ9A1.jpg)|![photo_7_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23tRveHMr9b8C51qWVz2Ab6qYDT5x34UvLtan8SfwCZbvcXekh5K3ctVWaCbTu4BPJ9A1.jpg)|![photo_6_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23t72XDjSgQw6pdwxko1qiKuVQ7XFPSgsB6LmZyk7WC8CgYK9RXRVNDB4rks1KRAoW7na.jpg)|
|-|-|-|

The night was beautiful and cold. A perfect combination to clear my mind.

|![photo_5_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23swcJge4dh9BwCVuU7EwopAiV83nvgZMtXqLcNLmiZ2SFWbiwnmQXmGztAwodDTEAh6i.jpg)|![photo_4_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23swcJge64uKAwoTNvMuWRBbxvgCGxEp9yCw5LDYfhLqZQQKU9m1U494utnDMBVG4HM2T.jpg)|![photo_2_2026-04-18_21-32-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soldierofdreams/23swXhfud1vojScnyRMooyatQhS2vPwXwXcfKCqBqSktbECeoiWepJaqndCJ6YvTqLy2c.jpg)|

_We talked there for a long time, and then, instead of going for ice cream, we went for some beers—material for another post, :P-_

links.title: What Community Do You Want to Join?
links.body: I've been thinking quite a bit about starting my own community here on Hive. I want it to be something where it draws people here on Hive to it, but especially people from outside Hive. Why? Onboarding. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd6huK4Rs6JKmkEDhuo3zsZPgTmi4hCdskAgkuodqVb1o/1776574240224.jpg) (Created with Bing) People want to interact, share their passion and be part of a community. Reddit is a great example of this. The difference is people earn nothing for their time, while Reddit takes everything. The problem is people feel like they belong and it's relevant to them, so they stay. The best way to get people interested in joining is through content that speaks to people, and they want to be part of. It needs to be something common to all of us and not unique to Hive itself. Even though someone could get that same content somewhere else, they can't be rewarded for it anywhere else. I want to create that community, grow it, curate it, and have it be a beacon to draw others to Hive. I want it to eventually take on a life of its own without me. As such, it also needs to be a community created with input from others who would want to join it, create, grow it and keep it going. I have some ideas but I want to hear from you. **What kind of community would you like to be a part of and create in daily or weekly?** ![1000017156.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulliontools/23uEyyyWCHidcDUBLiCySb4thnoMosshmypAS8GVUkhHC52LCiQqrB6L9Fom29shmtCMN.gif)

links.title: No Way Other Than to Trust
links.body: It's hard to distinguish whether the prevalence that lies all around us is a need or something supplementary carried over. No lie is the same, a lie told to a child, whether to sustain his mind or preoccupy it, a lie told is a lie transferred. The betrayal is that there is no way other than to trust; otherwise the only sensory abilities we have, to listen, smell, and see. It may be enough in a setting in which everything is laid out in front. When there is occlusion of some kind, a mysterious person who enters the room, or you pushing into a scene, the only things we feel are perceived deductions. The only way to find out is to ask, and then the tricky phase comes in. You asked. You are obliged to trust.

/>

Photo by [Julien](https://unsplash.com/@domsson?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText) on [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-walks-down-a-wet-street-at-night-PK8HIDIH4gU?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText)

_A liar rehearsing lines he did not write,  
obscuring the truth,  
Never enough, and knowing it.  
Still reaching._  
_Sinful. Deserving.  
For being reluctant  
I see it too plainly._  
  
_A lie to disclose.  
A lie to recite._  
_Do not make me  
never enough...  
A liar. And forever  
still —_

links.title: Risen-With-You-T2-1
links.body:
by @manuel78 on Manuel 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/manuel78 [![Risen-With-You-T2-1](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/a3778bbe-196e-4299-839c-7eda8ef55aab.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/uEdN9vrxTf12Ws7Er6M1tS) 
 
 - Steps Toward Dawn

Hey friend. Grab a warm drink and just breathe with me for a minute. I want to talk about those heavy seasons we all walk through. The mornings where the ceiling feels too close, and simply putting one foot forward feels like wading through deep water. Maybe you’re sitting in that exact quiet right now. If you are, I see you. This isn’t a lecture. It’s just a quiet conversation about how 

we sometimes fall, how we stay down, and how, eventually, a little light finds its way back to us.
Let’s be honest about the fall. It rarely happens in one dramatic crash. Despair doesn’t kick the door down; it seeps through the cracks. It starts as a quiet disappointment, a dream that slowly stops feeling possible. You tell yourself you’re fine. You keep showing up. But somewhere along the way, the spark dims. The things that used to light you up start feeling like heavy chores. Friends get busy. Routines turn into ruts. And before you know it, you’re not just tired—you’re hollow. That’s when you stop climbing. That’s when you finally let go.
And you fall. Not into a physical hole, but into that internal place we don’t talk about enough. The pit. The one where time slows to a crawl, where colors 

fade to muted grays, where your own thoughts become the walls closing in. At first, there’s a strange comfort in surrender. You stop resisting. You stop 

pretending. You just let the darkness wrap around you and tell yourself it’s easier this way. No more expectations. No more trying. Just stillness. But stillness isn’t peace. It’s just numbness.
Days blur. You stop tracking time. You’re just breathing in, breathing out, 

waiting for nothing. And then, one ordinary evening, the air shifts. It’s not loud. It’s just a flicker. A warmth. Faint. Distant. But real. You don’t move. Moving means hoping. Hoping means risking disappointment. So you stay still. But the presence comes closer. Footsteps. Soft. Deliberate. Then comes the light. Not blinding. Just a soft glow, like dawn filtering through thin curtains. She doesn’t offer cheap platitudes. She just sits down on the cold 

stone beside you. Like sharing coffee. Because it isn’t about fixing you. It’s about sitting with you. In the dark. Without flinching.
You sit like that for a long time. Something shifts. The silence isn’t suffocating anymore. It’s just quiet. Room to breathe. She doesn’t promise the top. She just waits. Lets you find your footing. And eventually, you do. Not with a grand gesture. Just a shift in weight. A hand on the stone. A 

realization that you don’t have to stay down here forever. You’re tired of the dark. And tired, in this case, is a good thing. It means you’re ready.
The first step is always the hardest. Moving means leaving the familiar pit. 

But stillness isn’t living. It’s just waiting. So you move. One hand. Then the other. She doesn’t pull you up. She just lights the path one step at a time. Breathing hard. With every inch, the light grows. Not because she’s magic. Just because you’re moving toward it. That’s how it works. You reach solid ground. You collapse onto your knees. And when you finally look up, you see the world. Trees. Sky. Color. Life. You’re part of it again. Flawed. Tired. But present. She steps back, making space. You take a step forward. Into the 

day. Into the unknown. The dark doesn’t disappear. It just becomes a place you’ve been. A compass. A reminder that even when you swear you’ll never see the light again… it’s still there. Waiting. For you. 
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/uEdN9vrxTf12Ws7Er6M1tS)

links.title: Infurnal: The Power of Fire [ENG/ESP]
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP3GzmZ2NMJm38zb5vNopYKKwNXEQzD69JPTyeu7fu9pZ/copia_de_copia_de_light_healer.jpg)

Hello friends, and hello Holozing community. I hope you are having a nice day. Today I return with new art, a new fan art featuring one of the most visually attractive and beautiful creatures in the Holozing universe. It is Infurnal with its characteristic fire power, but in my case I will be drawing its Radiant version, where the flames change from their normal red color to an intense blue. I hope you like this review of the character, and of course, as usual, I will share the drawing process from the beginning. If you are ready, let us welcome Infurnal and let us begin.


> Hola amigos, y hola comunidad de Holozing. Espero que estén teniendo un lindo día. Hoy regreso con nuevo arte, un nuevo fan art que tiene de protagonista a una de las criaturas visualmente más atractivas y bonitas del universo de Holozing. Se trata de Infurnal con su característico poder del fuego, pero en mi caso estaré dibujando su versión Radiant, donde las llamas cambian de su color rojo normal a un azul intenso. Espero que les guste esta revisión del personaje, y por supuesto, como es costumbre, les compartiré el proceso de dibujo desde el principio. Si están listos, le damos la bienvenida a Infurnal y comenzamos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZaSjWmkCJxKZZQ3g8GxHQB9fn37yNRZDSekKme85YuPQ/8.jpg)

This was my final result, but like every drawing it started with a sketch that I made several corrections to on the fly. And truth be told, since I started with fear, first because of the shape since I am not good at drawing animals, but little by little I felt more confident. I share with you a small animation in GIF format of my drawing process. I hope you enjoy it.
> Este fue mi resultado final, pero como todo dibujo empezó con un boceto al que le hice varias correcciones sobre la marcha. Y la verdad, desde que comencé con miedo, primero por la forma ya que no soy bueno dibujando animales, pero poco a poco me sentí con más confianza. Les comparto una pequeña animación en formato GIF de mi proceso de dibujo. Espero lo disfruten.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT5PwX8unichgQW8vvDEmv3DWaX8awpgRYzQAk8DY7Q4a/uniconverter_20260418110307.gif)

So that was my first sketch. As you can see, I later made some changes because there were areas of the character's facial structure that did not convince me.
> Así quedó mi primer boceto. Como ven, después le hice algunos cambios porque había zonas de la estructura facial del personaje que no me convencían.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTw1wK9xmrQfUQbhKtEuEUBzHuHNX93MfSgpZH8uRdynv/1.jpg)

Then, using the fine pen brush, I did the lineart. I tried to keep the strokes as fluid as possible, although I corrected some details afterwards.
> Luego, utilizando el pincel de pluma fina, realicé el lineart. Traté de mantener los trazos lo más fluidos posible, aunque corregí algunos detalles después.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbF3vcnPSvtbr6xSoMXh3SGJrs2BotEJaRRsFBTwVdPoh/3.jpg)

The skin tone of Infurnal in this version has blue highlights due to the black of its fur and the bounce light from its flames. I wanted to capture this in my drawing by adding many areas of light and reflections.
> El tono de piel de Infurnal en esta versión tiene destellos de azules por lo negro del pelaje y las luces de rebote de sus llamas. Quise capturar esto en mi dibujo añadiendo muchas zonas de luces y reflejos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWWK2H9ArSrhiyjkjcCgxymDwu1hkPnuNhgHUHZc56iDV/4.jpg)

I colored the white part of the fur with a tone closer to yellow, and I added the red details to the inside of Infurnal's little ears.
> Coloreé la parte blanca del pelaje con un tono más cercano al amarillo, y di los detalles rojo del interior de las orejitas de Infurnal.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXiC8pEYAR8ephCEBpPB4arkVj7JbdukvX6tDhN6QN8Uz/5.jpg)

I really like the detail of Infurnal's very blue eyes.
> Me gusta mucho el detalle de los ojos tan azules de Infurnal.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSPBgDBtGVgUYUanzYgu8bHGLsFtNY9sGXi41dZcdBZpL/6.jpg)

I left the coloring of the flames for last. I used a blue background color and on top in another layer I added loose white lines that I merged, and with the Gaussian blur effect I created the brightness or glow that stands out. All of this will contrast very well with the black background, a simple background but a character full of the power of fire, of a fire so pure that it burns blue.

> Dejé el coloreado de las llamas para el final. Utilicé un color azul de fondo y encima en otra capa agregué líneas sueltas de color blanco que uní, y con el efecto de desenfoque gaussiano creé el brillo o resplandor que sobresale. Todo esto contrastará muy bien con el fondo negro, un fondo simple pero un personaje lleno de la fuerza del fuego, de un fuego tan puro que quema en azul.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW5Zoj8gWUJyLSkroi3m1AQzxVUoeD8CxebuNAehTfbBH/7.jpg)


Thank you friends for coming this far. I hope you liked this fan art. As always, I invite you to share your ideas for future drawings with me, and from here I wish you all the luck and all the success in the world. Until the next drawing. Bye bye.
> Gracias amigos por llegar hasta aquí. Espero que les haya gustado este fan art. Como siempre, los invito a compartirme sus ideas para próximos dibujos, y desde aquí les deseo toda la suerte y todo el éxito del mundo. Hasta el próximo dibujo. Chau chau.

links.title: My first try
links.body:
Hi, guys!

Yesterday was my first book presentation with the author, and it looks like I did very well. Now I'm waiting for my payment because I want to buy myself something nice, to treat myself after such a great performance. Of course, I expected it to be a little more lively and active, and that the author would be more willing to talk about her book, but she was very quiet, which made things quite challenging, but especially under such difficult circumstances, I did more than well.

Now my next blogging events are at a book festival, and fortunately, I'll be the one being asked questions there, not me, and I hope that will be a little easier. Although, who knows. I still have three or four books to read before the event, so I don't have much planned for the next few days other than reading.

Of course, the toys for the commercial have arrived, and I still need to film it, but compared to what I experienced yesterday, that's nothing. After the festival, I'll be able to relax for a while.

Besides, I have a lot of other plans. I need to expand my scope of activities. I hope I can do it, because I really have quite a lot. I don't know yet how I'm going to balance it all, but I hope I find a way. Today, I'm hoping my husband and I will celebrate my debut yesterday a little; I'd like a cup of coffee and a new book.

I haven't bought books in a while, so next week I want to make a big order from Artbooks. I'll buy everything I've missed lately, which is quite a lot. But I think I've well deserved it. And then I want to get back to them as a blogger.

Have a great day, everyone!

links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![5jcX6viTKFqZsjqo_3.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/5jcX6viTKFqZsjqo_3/5jcX6viTKFqZsjqo_3.webp)
![Ui4yKzPsrLE0eYWS_2.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/Ui4yKzPsrLE0eYWS_2/Ui4yKzPsrLE0eYWS_2.webp)
![F64ck0fImUeeGE7p_1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/F64ck0fImUeeGE7p_1/F64ck0fImUeeGE7p_1.webp)
![zDwDuiQesccrGYLa_4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/zDwDuiQesccrGYLa_4/zDwDuiQesccrGYLa_4.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近在网上经常刷到一句话，挺有意思的：年纪大了，干什么都心酸。最开始是在游戏直播间里看见的，就是嘲笑主播因为年纪大了，操作缓慢。其实主播才是零零后，年纪也不大。

我一看零零后主播都被嘲笑年纪大，那我这个八零后还怎么混呀？负债群里的老哥，哪一个不是心酸的，而且看年纪都是三四十岁，甚至有五十多的，唉。年纪大了，干什么都心酸，背着负债就更是酸上加酸了。

按理说年纪大了就应该躺平，因为体力、精力都跟不上了，如果再奋斗的话，那就是和自己过不去。之前网络名师猝死，让很多人反省有没有必要再奋斗下去了，毕竟保命才是最重要的。

越努力越幸运，似乎成了一个笑话。很多努力的人都没有好结果。当然并不是提倡躺平啊，该努力就努力，该休息就休息。特别是年纪大了，如果再那么拼命下去，那就真的是很心酸了。

---

links.title: CGRF Sponsorship Proposal - April 2026 Batch
links.body:
The purpose of this proposal is to determine if the SPS DAO would like to officially sponsor Web3 gamers that were negatively impacted by the shutdown of the games listed below via the Crypto Gaming Recovery Fund. If this proposal passes, eligible players will be able to visit a claim page made available by the Splinterlands team to verify ownership of an impacted wallet to participate.

The SPS DAO will allocate the following shares of the Crypto Gaming Recovery Fund as follows:

- Up to 500,000 shares will be allocated to applicants from 77bit. No wallet will receive more than 500 shares
- Up to 300,000 shares will be allocated to applicants from XOCIETY. No wallet will receive more than 300 shares
- Up to 200,000 shares will be allocated to applicants from HYTOPIA. No wallet will receive more than 200 shares
- Up to 100,000 shares will be allocated to applicants from Pixel Heroes Adventure. No wallet will receive more than 100 shares
- Up to 100,000 shares will be allocated to applicants from Radiant Arena. No wallet will receive more than 100 shares
- Up to 300,000 shares will be allocated to applicants from GensoKishi. No wallet will receive more than 300 shares
- Up to 500,000 shares will be allocated to applicants from Forgotten Runiverse. No wallet will receive more than 500 shares
- Up to 100,000 shares will be allocated to applicants from Somnis World. No wallet will receive more than 100 shares

- Distribution will be done on a best efforts basis based on a snapshot of the wallets relative to the projects announcement of closure of sunsetting of development.
- Individual share allocations will be determined by the average token and NFT holdings of all eligible applicants' wallets that apply for Crypto Gaming Recovery Fund sponsorship relative to other applicants from the same project.

***Sponsorship shares are based on an assessment of the projects overall size and valuation at the time of closure by the CGRF Committee.***
***All CGRF Sponsorship Proposals are run for 7 days and if passed the approval is final.***

links.title: Splinterlands 49th Season of Glint, Merits and SPS
links.body:
The [Splinterlands](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/what-is-splinterlands) season ended earlier this week so I want to review my rewards and check up on some things in the game. I didn't get as many fights as I would like in Modern because I have been more focused on Frontier. I did have to do some fights during the last few days, but it wasn't too many.

## Season Rewards

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23w2cu5U9NT5u67qkZj862KQE79yPRy5616b5i6bs5KpT4nWHYEaioSnmbp4dBoT6t8KW.png)
I ended up with 484 Glint for last season, which is slightly less than what I was getting before. I didn't start as early as last time, but I managed to get the fights in during the last few days.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uQfXvzUF9vjFNXxoPk7zmbgGMRUAk3TXFRAXWzUDv8BUmuAjmrKBFiTq4CXMpmnWCca.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wC1PMuayo9AP9hjrCr6CFMQkLvPSRc85yWL5okZZ6HDLN39e3WoAmtHzxoa3re7yH8G.png)
I did get two league advancement rewards in Modern. This time, it was worse than last season. I did get some common cards, but it just feels lackluster.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23w2ajJtKDJy3xo3AqRsDoGyi5kTv8xGJr3zg2owa9BAZbmxEGJvbCTAqNHDwtKpeB6Bo.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23vrtseC9BXoG77zE8ZPSTcpgnixaeHrtBJ8B6frm2w7k5zYpPovhwJBRfKmACdFY2rm3.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uEyuhHgLPfnvKaqbjT8J6aaKWreAR4UQtMdNz6fkTRV2BymSk3ZvWVhWjEerMMonHUY.png)
No jackpot cards this time, but two gold foil cards and a jackpot common card. One of the gold foils is rare, and the other is common. I did get some legendary cards, but it wasn't that many.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wqaC75EZgdU32rxXVCD5XNB6sJbwjyHBRwhVNZzsDtaV3nUzebTkmBhoZAiwbYa4CsX.png)
I went for two rare cards this time around because I don't have enough Glint for an epic.

## Gladius Packs

![gladius openings.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23t7Dit5Q4Zku6LovVDY2PAYnNKgJZSTGE5cpniahtnMSTFog5DEZdnbe3vwr8W1uiBZh.png)
I got 4 packs this time around, and the opening seems worse than last time. No gold foil, epic or legendary cards.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tGcDGXfG6RtznD7J2RmJAJAku1cE5phMkrouwfcVsMy8icB8uQvKArq9ZNsU6cxVrTj.png)
I was able to upgrade my Chimney Wallstop to level 7. It gains one more armour, but I can't use this card often. 

## SPS

![SPS.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/Eo43q3ctnYLggeYwmVVHzsVgQHHno7M4LMm49Z4qzGWb5XmjgBMpEs74FNYsQzho8vj.png)
My [SPS](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splintershards-sps) rewards were higher than last time. My guild did way better on brawls this time around, and there were a few more days between the end of the season and this report. So an extra brawl may have been included.

![staking SPS.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tGZdppt7wEhGk2tUXwkzRrT5eNd2yJo7rQwhPiZUCFUTxf2GBAA7aXZgzNkneZDinut.png)
I plan on staking all of the SPS I got from staking for a total of 155.053 SPS. The total SPS was around what I usually expected if I factor in the time difference of a few more days added on top. 

## Conclusion
This season was bad. I didn't earn as much glint, and my openings were kind of bad. The only positive thing would be the frontier pack openings, because those ended up with some gold foil cards, and some of my cards are starting to max on that end. I hope the next season is better.

Feel free to leave a comment if you read my post. If you have any questions, feel free to ask and I will do my best to answer. 

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@jfang003/splinterlands-49th-season-of-glint-merits-and-sps-fna)

title.title: anti party. My Actifit Diary: April 18 2026
title.body:
5.30pm and I’m only at 3k steps. That speaks volume. I rested almost all day, besides going to the bakery for some inventory and watching the areal silk presentation that Lily’s group was doing. Without Lily. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ec096599-a30d-4121-a572-e4f67c4bfeb3.jpg) When I sent her a message about that and some videos, her mom got angry at me. I guess Lily made some trouble, wanting to be there, too. She had trained a lot for that before her mom had taken her away. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f39579a5-59ad-4225-b38d-f52f7b1c9a22.jpg) And then I watched Dark Winds on Netflix. For a long time. I love that show. I had a couple of beers and suddenly it was late. I wrote [my Saturday Selections]( https://peakd.com/@beelzael/whats-one-more) post on my main account, and now I’m going out for a walk. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6e804fbc-ec91-483b-a240-8c870e6eb68f.jpg) Shaking those legs, breathing some fresh air and preparing for a rather late night. I’ll accompany Ellie to Otavalo, where er daughter Kami is going to her first party, which is a huge party. We’ll stay close by, having some date or so, just in case. And then pick her up to go home. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d89306e6-53b0-45fe-824e-24ac7ddf908d.jpg) While the day was quite beautiful, the clouds have taken over by now. I better get out before it starts raining… Have a good night! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/be369815-d4a8-4c6d-9daf-4dd38d79dd01.jpg) Yeah, so. That was the plan. But boy did that whole party thing go sideways. Kami went in, and 10min later Police was there. Ellie and I were parked outside, were some power high dude told us not to park for no reason. Glad we stayed... ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c0c8371f-9012-4f1e-9e4f-01331da4b029.jpg) Ellie had to get Kami out of the police truck because she was under 16, and despite the announcement of this being a party for minors there was alcohol at the bar. Yeah. Meanwhile, my daughter was abducted by the mother and nobody does anything. Ecuador is weird that way...
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@beelshops/actifit-beelshops-20260419t043329168z)_

>It was reported that Venezuelan interim President Delcy Rodriguez, who had been on a roll under Nicolas Maduro's regime, has begun the largest-scale reorganization of power.

>The New York Times (NYT) reported on the 18th local time that Rodriguez dismantled the ruling group that has been going on for decades since Hugo Chavez took power and reorganized power in the absence of Maduro.
Rodriguez has reportedly replaced 17 ministers and replaced key military commanders with his loyalists over the past three months. In particular, he has consolidated his power base by replacing hardline Minister Padrino López, who was appointed under Maduro and headed the Pentagon for 12 years, and Attorney General Tarek William Saab, who was at the heart of the situation.
He is also at the forefront of eradicating the Maduro family. Emerging conglomerates (Oligarchs) who had accumulated wealth by joining the Maduro family were arrested at their homes in a surprise move, and Maduro's relatives were completely excluded from the oil business and banned from media appearances. The vacancy was filled by his confidants or businessmen friendly to U.S. capital.
Maduro's relatives and pro-Madurofa, who have yet to be purged, are also being watched by secret police, leading an uneasy life. Many of them are said to be considering moving abroad.

title.title: King Harald's Truce.
title.body: > After a fatal fall, I used my raven to find a safe ground route to Alrekstad. I met Sigurd and faced the coward Gorm, who was protected by a truce. Basim then taught me how to move unseen to reach Gorm's cabin, but the truce ultimately forced me to leave him alive. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWYJAiJvtUCQn8bZTnAKMmdfaPYF98yiogtg3QvSVYgs8/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW7kFNHUhvYTEra14tPyTGNToaxG8N34DeScrketkrp91/screenshot_2_.png) After dying from the fall last time, I didn't want to try the same way again. I called my raven to check for a ground route that was much safer for my journey. The bird flew high above the cliffs and found a clear path through the valley that avoided the dangerous ledges I had failed to cross before. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXYQyn3fxJT1KjMB6aawRvzpa2hkN8LULuwgnMwzWdhaE/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW28sy1Uy6fYrBSRPhyXHHatjgz5rMYSysFECwhyFrXYj/screenshot_4_.png) I started riding my horse to the frozen land on the mountain that I had ignored last time. I was looking for a shortcut before, but the long way proved to be much more stable for the animal. The snow was deep and the wind was cold, but we made steady progress toward our destination. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPiKVBTdPCQf88V1yoMbNmYbNrvXzXQYeJv3QbfKgwdD3/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdiGx79C5dQtkjJYoxcqjwGrAdfk7cPXNbqZzFie9zMhd/screenshot_6_.png) I reached Alrekstad after a long ride, and it looked like a very crowded town. The sun was setting in a beautiful way, casting long shadows over the wooden buildings. I had to find and speak to Sigurd, so I called my raven again to look around from the sky. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczTu9rAUou3z5mLqHHZixnGaMv6qUd8sYJa6z5ZUm2Fh/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSERRVvRN5Ay4Ktzqi4N9wphWxiLeGQ1SAF87Ma3epvVM/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeXKEURawuMiGZHQcyicqbhgqFJTEUTRUrVuzuAJZ1rhQ/screenshot_9_.png) I found Sigurd, and there was also Gorm, the coward son of Kjotve the Cruel, with the last of his men. Sigurd mentioned they didn't have anything to do about it because they were under King Harald's truce. So Gorm got to leave the room in one piece, much to the frustration of everyone there. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSRU9kQnuRmHLJx7zMf58Dzs2z8DwfqXHKeDWShw6fozb/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaYQS7mMbGa9akKUoSa9BddDRLKZ6XZZpd8VBtrzAZAgE/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXEVy2jgdAGkX2hXhgcWCsKt74Z7HoYZ3MMtAv9sz2EMF/screenshot_12_.png) Sigurd left Eivor to Basim, asking him to watch over the warrior and see that he warmed himself with a drink. But Eivor was much more interested in taking down Gorm once and for all. After seeing the sigil that Eivor got from Kjotve, Basim offered his help to take down the coward. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmesaMLddQA5TUg8xwohtScPNSuKbCkhzvMT9NJ1UhjtiK/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXdhARthqcFBY7ipAen2m58mRarRM5BHGUt8iPPDbEZfG/screenshot_14_.png) Basim mentioned he knew where Gorm was camped and who could help Eivor see Gorm while remaining unseen. I started following him outside toward the camp of Gorm. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSJASjusBRaqUHA3vJYpcv1Tos8kSDaZ1XVqWCwdtLsf/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd73v7Hqzoy1jyFRKUg5LTZ8QPYmg1DLPakSbch5KFUaG/screenshot_16_.png) On our way, Basim was teaching me the ways of walking unseen through hostile territory. He suggested that I put up my hood for the trick to work when we were close to the place where Gorm was hiding. I pulled the fabric over my head to blend in with the common folk. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6qr8YAAqvcnnKZx33ooN2CMnzVQqT9fS2Kgtg1DvE4Y/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUZQXU93L5MtKhWF29BjLAyuyRDWKXNJWUCxujdJNVM4L/screenshot_18_.png) I had to enter Gorm's cabin without any Norse soldiers noticing my presence. I was walking slowly, with the hood hiding my face from the curious eyes of the men around the fire. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDDH4Q3PRSSF71DHbgcNZSCFTKoerfE11WBX754YGF8h/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW4iXNXHEpQS9XYvz9VA9kM4KzCHxd1wqyFragakV999Z/screenshot_20_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUFmPciNQtSZpdKyRKXuF43dbfUZghTquXyDxp39RYS28/screenshot_21_.png) There were some Norse soldiers who saw me even when I was hiding in the hood. I had to take them down anyway, realizing I had to take the other side of the camp where they were not looking. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNoRyMc2AEcTXHKitknUT6rLq1kqhZj4drn3XJARKeT5v/screenshot_22_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdXfuEN4SGAUYxQsfJrSpFkuKUireDwHGENzJc1LRVTux/screenshot_23_.png) Then I entered Gorm's cabin, where Eivor was challenging him for a fight. But some Norse soldiers came to warn Eivor that he was subject to King Harald's truce. They said breaking the peace would cast them all out of Alrekstad, forcing Eivor to lower his gaze. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX1vAXv4r5XYpb6Njmwg3Rh322txUM3ZXuP7NHVnpMtmo/screenshot_24_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP5jySknPZw1KmSSx7Bbip3SvT3BikxR8jci2gUMHVMMX/screenshot_25_.png) Eivor had nothing to do but leave Gorm in one piece for the time being. He said some bold words to the coward before leaving the cabin and walking back into the cold air. It looked like it didn't affect Gorm at all, as he remained the most coward person in this world. That's all for now. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=coooldude/ec223984)

The snow was deep and the wind was cold, but we made steady progress toward our destination. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPiKVBTdPCQf88V1yoMbNmYbNrvXzXQYeJv3QbfKgwdD3/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdiGx79C5dQtkjJYoxcqjwGrAdfk7cPXNbqZzFie9zMhd/screenshot_6_.png) I reached Alrekstad after a long ride, and it looked like a very crowded town. The sun was setting in a beautiful way, casting long shadows over the wooden buildings. I had to find and speak to Sigurd, so I called my raven again to look around from the sky. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczTu9rAUou3z5mLqHHZixnGaMv6qUd8sYJa6z5ZUm2Fh/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSERRVvRN5Ay4Ktzqi4N9wphWxiLeGQ1SAF87Ma3epvVM/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeXKEURawuMiGZHQcyicqbhgqFJTEUTRUrVuzuAJZ1rhQ/screenshot_9_.png) I found Sigurd, and there was also Gorm, the coward son of Kjotve the Cruel, with the last of his men. Sigurd mentioned they didn't have anything to do about it because they were under King Harald's truce. So Gorm got to leave the room in one piece, much to the frustration of everyone there. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSRU9kQnuRmHLJx7zMf58Dzs2z8DwfqXHKeDWShw6fozb/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaYQS7mMbGa9akKUoSa9BddDRLKZ6XZZpd8VBtrzAZAgE/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXEVy2jgdAGkX2hXhgcWCsKt74Z7HoYZ3MMtAv9sz2EMF/screenshot_12_.png) Sigurd left Eivor to Basim, asking him to watch over the warrior and see that he warmed himself with a drink. But Eivor was much more interested in taking down Gorm once and for all. After seeing the sigil that Eivor got from Kjotve, Basim offered his help to take down the coward. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmesaMLddQA5TUg8xwohtScPNSuKbCkhzvMT9NJ1UhjtiK/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXdhARthqcFBY7ipAen2m58mRarRM5BHGUt8iPPDbEZfG/screenshot_14_.png) Basim mentioned he knew where Gorm was camped and who could help Eivor see Gorm while remaining unseen. I started following him outside toward the camp of Gorm. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSJASjusBRaqUHA3vJYpcv1Tos8kSDaZ1XVqWCwdtLsf/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd73v7Hqzoy1jyFRKUg5LTZ8QPYmg1DLPakSbch5KFUaG/screenshot_16_.png) On our way, Basim was teaching me the ways of walking unseen through hostile territory. He suggested that I put up my hood for the trick to work when we were close to the place where Gorm was hiding. I pulled the fabric over my head to blend in with the common folk. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6qr8YAAqvcnnKZx33ooN2CMnzVQqT9fS2Kgtg1DvE4Y/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUZQXU93L5MtKhWF29BjLAyuyRDWKXNJWUCxujdJNVM4L/screenshot_18_.png) I had to enter Gorm's cabin without any Norse soldiers noticing my presence. I was walking slowly, with the hood hiding my face from the curious eyes of the men around the fire. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDDH4Q3PRSSF71DHbgcNZSCFTKoerfE11WBX754YGF8h/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW4iXNXHEpQS9XYvz9VA9kM4KzCHxd1wqyFragakV999Z/screenshot_20_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUFmPciNQtSZpdKyRKXuF43dbfUZghTquXyDxp39RYS28/screenshot_21_.png) There were some Norse soldiers who saw me even when I was hiding in the hood. I had to take them down anyway, realizing I had to take the other side of the camp where they were not looking. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNoRyMc2AEcTXHKitknUT6rLq1kqhZj4drn3XJARKeT5v/screenshot_22_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdXfuEN4SGAUYxQsfJrSpFkuKUireDwHGENzJc1LRVTux/screenshot_23_.png) Then I entered Gorm's cabin, where Eivor was challenging him for a fight. But some Norse soldiers came to warn Eivor that he was subject to King Harald's truce. They said breaking the peace would cast them all out of Alrekstad, forcing Eivor to lower his gaze. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX1vAXv4r5XYpb6Njmwg3Rh322txUM3ZXuP7NHVnpMtmo/screenshot_24_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP5jySknPZw1KmSSx7Bbip3SvT3BikxR8jci2gUMHVMMX/screenshot_25_.png) Eivor had nothing to do but leave Gorm in one piece for the time being. He said some bold words to the coward before leaving the cabin and walking back into the cold air. It looked like it didn't affect Gorm at all, as he remained the most coward person in this world. That's all for now.

title.title: A Radiant Sunset [ENG🇬🇧|ESP🇻🇪]
title.body: > Hello everyone. On this occasion, I want to share a couple of photographs that I managed to capture during a particularly bright sunset. Sometimes I joke with my friends, saying that when I share the photos of the sunsets I capture, people will simply think they are fake. The truth is that in my city, we often see authentic spectacles in the sky as the sun goes down. # This time, my friends and I witnessed an extremely bright sunset. The horizon was painted with a very intense orange and rays of light piercing through the clouds. I had never seen anything like this before. There are no words to fully describe it, but I hope that through these shots you can perceive at least a bit of that light and the atmosphere that surrounded us at that moment. # I often think that no matter how many times I photograph the sky, nature always finds a way to surprise us with new tones and shapes. Even though I only had my phone with me, I didn't want to miss the chance to document this unique event. The intensity of the colors was so strong that for a few minutes, everything around us seemed to stop just to admire the view. # I hope you enjoy and treasure these photos as much as I do. It is a reminder that beauty can be found in the most common moments of our day, as long as we are willing to look up at the right time. For me, it was a memorable afternoon that I am glad to share with all of you. # Without anything more to add, I bid farewell. Stay tuned for future posts! Until next time!

> Hola a Todos. En esta ocasión, quiero compartir un par de fotografías que logré capturar durante un atardecer particularmente brillante. A veces bromeo con mis amigos diciendo que cuando comparta las fotos de los atardeceres que capturo, simplemente pensarán que son falsas. Lo cierto es que en mi ciudad se suelen ver auténticos espectáculos en el cielo cuando el sol cae. # en esta oportunidad, mis amigos y yo presenciamos un atardecer sumamente brillante. El horizonte se pintó con un anaranjado muy intenso y rayos de luz atravesando las nubes. Nunca antes había visto algo así. No hay palabras para describirlo por completo, pero espero que a través de estas tomas puedan percibir al menos un poco de esa luz y de la atmósfera que nos rodeaba en ese momento. # A menudo pienso que, sin importar cuántas veces fotografíe el cielo, la naturaleza siempre encuentra una forma de sorprendernos con nuevos tonos y formas. Aunque solo llevaba mi celular conmigo, no quise perder la oportunidad de documentar este evento único. La intensidad de los colores era tan fuerte que por unos minutos, todo a nuestro alrededor parecía detenerse solo para admirar la vista. # Espero que disfruten y atesoren estas fotos tanto como yo. Es un recordatorio de que la belleza se puede encontrar en los momentos más comunes de nuestro día, siempre que estemos dispuestos a mirar hacia arriba en el momento adecuado. Para mí, fue una tarde memorable que me alegra compartir con todos ustedes. # Sin más que agregar me despido, estén atentos a los próximos post. ¡Hasta la Próxima! ------ ---- |

title.title: El mejor regalo (cuento corto)
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRA7PUebS8Tf3NRb1UqngRUY2LRgbuTZQYgYqwUJCRxXG/1776565176221.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/gift-present-wood-package-gift-box-1420830/)

Él parecía un escolar; no en el primer día de clases, sino cuando se enamoraba la primera vez. No sabía que más hacer para impresionar a su chica. Le había regalado flores, chocolates, caramelos, cenas en restaurantes de lujo y otras salidas y regalos tan caros, que casi lo llevaron a la quiebra. Menos mal que tenía la legendaria fortuna acumulada por sus antecesores. Eso, y aquellas útiles tradiciones y peligrosas costumbres y deberes trasmitidos de uno, durante generaciones desde tiempos previos al Medioevo, cuando las cacerías de brujas. Prácticas que le habían sido enseñadas y estudiadas por los pocos que habían sobrevivido para hacerlo, y desde entonces trataba arduamente de evitar si quería continuar en esa era para hacer el cuento.
Agotadas casi todas las maneras de impresionarla, y no había nada en ese mundo, que lo alegrara más que el rostro de ella cuando él lograba algo sorprendente. La última vez, le había dedicado una canción y, sin importar lo mal que lo hizo, ella rompió a llorar de regocijo. A él también le faltó poco por secundarla en el llanto, ya que sí lo hacía en la alegría.
Seguro estaba, por primera vez en su vida, que aquello era amor real, nada de invento, sin interés material alguno. Aunque era lo que llamaban una humilde aldeana, ella no quería su dinero, solo a él. Eso le imponía mayor presión. Nunca había querido tanto en su vida y llevaba días sin hacer nada por su amada. Aunque no lo aparentara, estaba asustado, temía que ella se aburriera o pensara que él había perdido el interés. Además, se le estaba terminando su tiempo. Sin embargo, ella se parecía contenta. “Solo te quiero a ti”, le decía a él con cariño, “nada más importa: solo tú y a ese hermoso corazón. Con eso tengo para ser feliz por siempre”. Por supuesto, él estallaba en besos, sonrisas y abrazos. De todas formas, solo pensaba en que se acercaba el 14 de febrero y no tenía nada que sorprenderla. Y de paso, decidir qué haría en el futuro.
Con renuencia y mucho temor, la llevó aquel día a la biblioteca de su castillo. Tal como había hecho la Bestia a la Bella como regalo, pensó con ironía, y le regaló todo aquel conocimiento; con el pretexto de que eso era lo más importante en la vida, ya que el saber es poder. Ella rebosaba de felicidad, lo cubrió de besos y promesas de amor. Recorrió los estantes llenos de libros antiguos de bizarras cubiertas y pergaminos, hechos con cueros y materiales extraños desconocidos por ella. Muchos de ellos sin autor en la cubierta e incluso sin nombre. “¿Por qué haces esto?”. Preguntó ella mientras lo tomaba de las manos. “Sabes que no era preciso. Me vas a malcriar si sigues así.”
Aquello era justo lo que él esperaba para contarle, no sin mucho miedo al rechazo y a ser abandonado, la realidad sobre su condición, su casta y los equipos extraños que tanto le habían llamado la atención a su enamorada. Le dijo que ese era solo el inicio de su regalo, “solo es la envoltura, amor mío, a ti...: te brindo el futuro; si decides seguirme”. Y al decirlo, con toque de sus manos sobre una zona de la mesa, creó un portal frente a ella. Al ver su expresión, le pidió que no se asustase.
Ella estaba paralizada, no sabía qué hacer. Pasaba la vista del vórtice abierto al frente, hasta los temerosos ojos de su novio. “Solo dime que me quieres seguir, amor.” Le dijo él. “Escoge lugar, fecha. No importa si te parece real, ficticio o te lo inventas por el camino. Puedes ser, tener o hacer lo que quieras. Es tuyo el multiverso para hacerlo, mi reina hermosa. Porque no puedo vivir sin ti”. 
La tomó de la mano. Ella temblaba como una hoja. Él le besó los dedos con ternura y con suavidad se adentraron en el portal abierto. Una vez dentro él modificó su alrededor como quien modifica la interfaz de un ordenador y creó una habitación circular con varias puertas para que ella escogiera un mundo al que adentrarse.
“¿Cómo lo haces?”, preguntó ella. “Es sencillo. Para alguien único como tú, que me has dado lo que no he encontrado en ninguna época; aquello que es imposible comprar o crear; que me has hecho sentir vivo y completo: te lo doy todo, solo pídelo y tuyo será. No hay imposibles en este lugar”, le dijo e hizo un ademán invitándola a que recorriera las puertas. “Cada una es tiempo o lugar diferente en la historia”. Ella lo hizo, con la timidez que la caracterizaba. En su rostro el miedo, poco a poco había ido desapareciendo y la sonrisa fue ocupando su lugar. Caminó a la redonda y llegó otra vez hasta su amado sin entrar a ningún mundo. “¿No te decides, amada mía, deseas que te ayude? No temas”. “No lo hago, mi amor, es que no deseo estar en ningún lugar que no sea este, a tu lado, ni deseo otra cosa que aquello que siempre te he pedido: tu corazón”, le dijo ella y con un rápido movimiento, introdujo su mano en el pecho del joven amante y extrajo aquello tanto tiempo anhelado. 
Con la misma sonrisa de siempre, dejó a su enamorado en aquel lugar y salió del portal hacia su casa, donde la esperaba su anciana madre. “¿Lo tienes, querida?”. “Sí, madre, al fin tengo el último de aquellos magos que tantos problemas nos han dado. Lo malo es que estoy segura que seguirán viniendo” Le respondió y colocó el órgano, aún palpitante, en un pomo de cristal, al lado de los demás corazones colectados de los anteriores cazadores de brujas.

title.title: My Successful Attempt in making a puffy and delicious twisted bread
title.body: Hello @asean.hive 👋🏽👋🏽I'm back after being rested for how many days because of my asthma that just keep coming back and I needed so much rest for a while and be relaxed..So here I am today sharing to you another cooking snacks recipe that I'm fond of making to treat my little kid ..this is her favorite snacks requested this afternoon...and it's called TWISTY FRIED BREAD \n\n

> This is my second time making this but I think I didn't made it so perfectly this time😊I still need to enhance my skills in forming the dough.. So here are the ingredients I'm using.. 2 1/2 cups of all purpose flour 2 tbsp of white sugar 1/2 tsp salt 2 tbsp melted butter 1pc of medium sized egg 2 1/4 tsp 3/4 cup of evap milk Oil for frying White Sugar for coating
> Here are the simple steps you're gonna do to make it tastier..
> Combine all the dry ingredients and make sure to sift it first..
> In a bowl,combine the flour,sugar and salt..Mixed it thoroughly..
>\nIn a glass of milk,activate the yeast by stirring it and let it sit for 5 minutes..\n
> This time add the yeast mixture in a dry ingredients and start kneading it until smooth and elastic.. It it's too sticky you can add or sprinkle a little flour..
> Washed thoroughly your hands or you can use plastic gloves when start to knead the flour..

> So in a plastic plate or in a bowl,cover your dough and let it rise for 1 hour or until the size is doubled.. There you go...though I had a hard time making this dough..but it's all worth the effort to see after its being risen..

> Once the dough will rise or doubled its size..Make a one Punch down and knead briefly the dough..Using the dough cutter,divide it into a small roll/balls and start twisting it forming into small ropes..
> I had a hard time twisting the dough😂 so here's my unfiltered output of it..
> There's some that were luckily formed and there's not.. Another minute will be given to let this twisted bread rise and become puffy..
> So it's rising..and it's ready to be cooked..I just prepared the pan with oil and see to it that it's being cooked in a medium heat..
> Fry the twist on each side or checked if it's already golden brown ..
> Looked at how happy I am seeing my not so perfect twisted bread 😁
> But fortunately I've got the perfect taste 😁
> So I started to coat it with sugar..and looked who's my fist customer of the day--- it's my daughter 😁

>
And I'm the happiest that she find it delicious and tasty 😁..though it take so much effort kneading the dough but after all it's all worth the knead..

This would be all for now..and see you next time 😊😍🫰🏽

body.title: Breaded chicken breast with fried plantain and salad (Eng-Esp)
body.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wMmR62NJBGhFDuHNn3VFNYsQvzeweQLdDd7XdNrFXDhPecxFoxsrQRejqg4L4YhVdCk.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening, Hivers, welcome back to my blog. This time, I'm sharing with you the delicious lunch I enjoyed with my family. This dish is very complete, balanced, and easy to prepare. I'd been wanting to make \

for a while, and I thought it would be great to serve them with: fried plantains and salad... Let's put on our aprons and get started!\n\n>* Buenas noches hivers, bienvenidos de nuevo a mi blog. En esta ocasión, comparto con ustedes el exquisito almuerzo que disfruté con mi familia, este plato es muy completo, equilibrado y fácil de preparar. Tenía tiempo deseando realizar \

, me pareció genial acompañar con: plátanos fritos y ensalada... Pongámonos el delantal para empezar nuestro maravilloso proceso, empecemos!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23z7QA3boawChxQSb8zXqfTx6hWGQqnSQVx3hacCpaDoMwgJNw1kZdVHw4oiPVXNPwX4E.png)</center>

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* Cut the chicken breast into thin fillets, season with pepper, dried oregano, herbs, and salt. Refrigerate for 20 minutes to allow the seasoning to penetrate.

>* Cortamos la pechuga de pollo en filetes delgados, sazonamos con: pimienta, orégano en polvo, finas hierbas y sal. Reservamos en la nevera durante 20 minutos, para que el aliño se impregne bien.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23u6BmjXUW2rA6uN9s78grPYnfMraNDbmnXtTr5EKZLb3kAG4xFfhf16ErztCvGSZVNm6.png)</center>

* We add the egg to a shallow bowl, season with pepper, oregano, and salt. We beat it well... We dip the chicken breast in the egg, then in breadcrumbs. Whenever I make this recipe, I usually repeat this process twice; this way, the breading will be crispier.

>* Incorporamos en un plato hondo el huevo, sazonamos con pimienta, orégano y sal. Batimos bien... Pasamos la pechuga de pollo por el huevo, luego por pan rallado. Siempre que realizo esta receta suelo repetir este proceso dos veces, de esta forma el empanizado quedará MÁS crujiente.

body.title: What I miss most about my childhood - Week 305
body.body: Anonymous In my opinion, childhood is the most beautiful stage of every person’s life, because that’s when the adults we’ll become begin to take shape. Values matter a great deal, which is why, as parents, we must do our very best to raise our children. There are three important things I miss about my childhood the ones that come to mind as I write this post and make me feel a little nostalgic.

> **The first* and most important thing is that I really miss my parents; they were both great parents to me. I always remember that at 6 p.m. my dad would come home from work, and every single day he’d bring home two liters of juice and two liters of milk. He’d also always bring me a slice of pizza, palm-shaped cookies, or some other treat—he always brought me something. My mom, on the other hand, also worked for a while, and when she got home at 5 p.m., I’d run to see what she’d brought me and always grab her purse to look inside. She’d always bring me cookies—most of the time they were Maria cookies, which were my favorites. So both of them brought me things to eat, and I miss them both so much.

> **Secondly**, and I was just thinking about this recently there were the games we played in the afternoons, especially on weekends. Several of my cousins lived in the houses next door; the houses were right next to each other, and I remember we played hide-and-seek, tag, marbles, kite flying, perilla, old car, cat and mouse, and countless board games. In the afternoons, we sometimes played until 8 p.m. on weekdays, and on weekends, if they let us, even later— sometimes in my yard and other times in my cousins’ yard.

> I remember we used to spend a lot of time together, and now we hardly ever see each other or talk like we used to. I think that as we grow up, we lose that closeness we had with some people; others do stay in touch. We were a big group when the other cousins came to visit. I also miss riding bikes together it was fun. **Third**, and the last thing I miss is the agility and not being afraid of anything. When we were kids, and just recently I was remembering a day when we were playing baseball in the backyard, I hit the ball and ran off. At that moment I thought, *** when I grow up, I won’t stop running like other adults; I’ll always play and run nimbly something that’s far from reality now, since running is the last thing I do, but I miss that. Besides that, I remember climbing trees; that was something I wasn’t afraid of, unlike other things. As a child, you’re more daring and fearless, so I miss being more daring, agile, and fearless.

- lápiz de color verde

- HB pencil  
- An improvised extender made from the back of a pen for the 2B pencil 😅  
- Green colored pencil  
- Red and blue bicolor pencil  
- Kneaded eraser  
- A mechanical pencil improvised from a pen for 5B leads 🤭  
- Charcoal  
- A sheet of paper to avoid staining my hands and damaging the drawing  
- Hair lacquer (due to the absence of professional graphite or charcoal fixative), although not all hair lacquers work to fix charcoal.

body.title: Compra de insumos / Shopping for supplies (Esp/Eng)
body.body: > [Esp] ¡Saludos comunidad! Ayer aproveché en reponer mi stock de materiales para crear, algunos de ellos se me habían terminado, cartulinas, libretas, lapiceros y marcadores, hoy me llevé una grata sorpresa, abrieron una nueva tienda en el centro de la localidad y la atención es estupenda. Es una papelería - quincallería que tiene de todo. Llevo semanas buscando unos marcadores que pintan perfectamente cualquier superficie pero no son los marcadores que conocemos de toda la vida, son una nueva generación, son marcadores de pinturas acrílicas. Quiero comenzar a dibujar en lienzos negros, siempre quise, generalmente consumo videos de artistas pintando en cartulinas negras o de colores fuertes. Pero no sabía cómo pedir el tipo de marcador que buscaba, la chica de la tienda amablemente me atendió y me dio toda la información, no dudé en comprarlos a pesar que son algo costosos. Espero sean duraderos ya que no conozco de marcas.

> [Eng] Hello everyone! Yesterday I took the opportunity to restock my supplies for crafting; I’d run out of some things – card, notebooks, pens and markers. Today I was pleasantly surprised: a new shop has opened in the town centre and the service is brilliant. It’s a stationery and haberdashery shop that has everything. I’ve been looking for weeks for some markers that work perfectly on any surface, but they aren’t the markers we’ve always known; they’re a new generation – acrylic paint markers. I want to start drawing on black canvases; I’ve always wanted to. I often watch videos of artists painting on black or brightly coloured card. But I didn’t know how to ask for the type of marker I was looking for. The girl in the shop was very helpful and gave me all the information I needed. I didn’t hesitate to buy them, even though they’re a bit pricey. I hope they’ll last, as I’m not familiar with the brands. ---
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-18 at 8.20.48 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoGxVDEBCQfJVxQkvRe4R8yXysxALPno9m6wkKLjagFpYgk9gD1aYCXe91tCiRVier3.jpeg) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Ep3dmbjmKu18A91m8Jga9EQpix9Ta2MtU6ekPszUR63h8aWd89WaVYYFsquaS9WBHX8.png) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-18 at 8.20.49 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpC9zXMqyVJ4YvdmQbx45sc7omwGvLzzsGnakJSkNW8HVYGsEW3HRKMX17tujp83H7j.jpeg)

> [Esp] Compré cartulinas negras grandes, ahorro dinero cortándolas, pues cada cartulina de color negro tamaño carta tiene un costo de 0.4$ sin embargo la cartulina grande tiene un costo de 0.8$ y saco 5 piezas de ella. Mi intención es hacer una libreta de arte. Luego de cortar las piezas debo enderezarlas pues como venían en un rollo quedaron con la forma. Puedo plancharlas o colocarles peso sobre ellas para que regresen a su estado plano. Tomo la medida de un hoja tamaño carta y corto las piezas.

> [Eng] I bought some large sheets of black card; I save money by cutting them myself, as each letter-sized sheet of black card costs $0.40, whereas a large sheet costs $0.80 and I can get five pieces out of it. My plan is to make an art notebook. After cutting the pieces, I need to straighten them out, as they were rolled up and have retained that shape. I can iron them or place weights on top of them to flatten them out. I measure a letter-sized sheet and cut the pieces.
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpNnTHCsgTHC8sqVspDaH1t27sCSvwxQLE4haUPemkht7Ng7KJuG3twG7TseG5KzTE4.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpXJRYc6B6RgP5JCWfMuXFitKg1Fn9dWJQMVMXbw85fMuu9u34Des7JREs2ZFHCmtqU.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpJXgcMEuQpJo8LgLQfqqUURPhAJhbkNxtmiJo8WuU2V8LfwHQaGiTp3oWHorchdmc5.png)

> [Esp] Luego de cortar las piezas coloco unas pinzas para que vaya tomando forma. Busco mi encuadernadora con el anillo de encuadernación y una tapa plástica de color negro, es una pena no se vea bien en la imagen el detalle de la tapa tiene aspecto de cuero con toda su textura. Pongo todas las piezas organizadas para proceder a abrir los orificios por donde pasarán los aros.

> [Eng] After cutting the pieces, I secure them with clips to help them take shape. I fetch my binding machine with the binding ring and a black plastic cover; it’s a shame the detail of the cover isn’t clear in the photo – it has a leather-like appearance with all its texture. I lay out all the pieces neatly so I can start punching the holes through which the rings will pass. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EqUePu57HrPJqA5x8YATgawSp4pTokn8EGcHqG9SxDL5YDu42kVVx7FFNj8rCfE3GXi.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpLfTTiLzG3KJUj3qbSnoio4ZDBuABGHvcQiFkXbTA7D37mxezgUP5pMqV1bJYFJc1e.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpXJ5o9yqUfmDTjU9jRBSrmFz98aujBgfoWnbrfhgTUC5WZr7WwdJqKRDygiBUDgqXW.png)

> [Esp] Con la encuadernadora perforo las tapas y las cartulinas negras. Luego coloco el anillo de encuadernación en la parte superior y abro. Seguidamente introduzco por cada orificio en orden la primera tapa y luego cada cartulina y finalmente la tapa. Cierro el anillo de encuadernar y con ello obtengo mi cuaderno de arte. Siempre es una alegría comprar insumos, ir a una tienda y encontrar más de lo que buscas. Nos vemos en mis siguientes creaciones.

> [Eng] I use the binding machine to punch holes in the covers and the black cardstock. Then I place the binding ring at the top and open it. Next, I thread the first cover through each hole in order, followed by each piece of cardstock, and finally the cover. I close the binding ring and there you have it: my art notebook. It’s always a joy to buy supplies, go to a shop and find more than you’re looking for. See you in my next creations.
---
