body.title: Havanas's handcrafted corner [EN/ES]
body.body:
![cover.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/jordy0827%2F2026-04-19-03-04-544-cover-jpg)
English Version Obispo Street in Old Havana is one of the oldest and busiest roads of the colonial city. Surrounded by old buildings, it is characterized by being only for pedestrian passage, which is magnificent since it is a narrow street and it is very comfortable to be able to walk in the center without the worry of crossing paths with any vehicle. Pedestrians are the absolute owners of Obispo, and the only traffic we should worry about is that of people who sometimes crowd together and make passage difficult. # ![IMG_20260330_144514.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/jordy0827%2F2026-04-19-03-04-288-img_20260330_144514-jpg)
This is a street known for its wide boulevard, much visited in other years, where one could find any product or food. In these recent times of economic problems, the quantity and variety of stores has decreased but even so, it continues to be a place of reference and with a varied commercial offer. Something that has not changed in Obispo and that maintains its popularity is the fair of artisans and artists that is located at #411, corner of Aguacate. There, on the different platforms, a great variety of items are exhibited for sale, such as souvenirs, pieces of goldsmithing, handicrafts made with different materials, and commercial paintings. #
![IMG_20260330_144647.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/jordy0827%2F2026-04-19-03-04-382-img_20260330_144647-jpg)
# ![IMG_20260330_144814.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/jordy0827%2F2026-04-19-03-04-137-img_20260330_144814-jpg) # ![IMG_20260330_144854.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/jordy0827%2F2026-04-19-03-04-663-img_20260330_144854-jpg)
The fair is open every day and is managed by the Cuban Association of Artisans and Artists, which guarantees that the products exhibited meet certain standards of quality and authenticity. For these reasons this is a very visited space, especially by tourists who want to take a memory of Cuba. Here quality prevails and the artisans who have their place in this fair are experienced artists with mastery of their art and a passion that is reflected in each piece. In fact, many of them sell their creations directly, so in addition to taking a beautiful memory one can meet the artist who created it. # ![IMG_20260330_144624.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/jordy0827%2F2026-04-19-03-04-166-img_20260330_144624-jpg) # ![IMG_20260330_144720.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/jordy0827%2F2026-04-19-03-04-363-img_20260330_144720-jpg) # ![IMG_20260330_144827.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/jordy0827%2F2026-04-19-03-04-350-img_20260330_144827-jpg)
Walking along Obispo and visiting this fair is like taking a pause in the middle of the bustle. Outside the street boils with the heat of the day and the comings and goings of passersby. Inside, among platforms and colorful products, time seems to move more calmly, and although Obispo is no longer what it once was, its artisans’ fair remains with its creativity and tradition. # ![IMG_20260330_144908.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/jordy0827%2F2026-04-19-03-04-962-img_20260330_144908-jpg) # ![IMG_20260330_144710.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/jordy0827%2F2026-04-19-03-04-403-img_20260330_144710-jpg) # ![IMG_20260330_144911.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/jordy0827%2F2026-04-19-03-04-522-img_20260330_144911-jpg)
Here simple handicraft products are not sold, a piece of Cuba made by hand is sold. So if you ever walk along Obispo, go in, perhaps you will leave with something more than a souvenir, a beautiful story to tell.
Versión en Español

La calle Obispo en La Habana Vieja es una de las vías más antiguas y transitadas de la ciudad colonial. Rodeada por antiguas edificaciones, se caracteriza por ser únicamente para el paso peatonal, lo cual es magnífico ya que es una calle estrecha y es muy cómodo poder caminar por el centro sin la preocupación de cruzarnos con algún vehículo. Los peatones son los dueños absolutos de Obispo, y el único tráfico que debería preocuparnos es el de las personas que a veces se aglomeran y hacen complicado el paso. Esta es una calle conocida por su amplio boulevard, muy visitada en otros años, donde se podía encontrar cualquier producto o alimento. En estos últimos tiempos de problemas económicos, la cantidad y variedad de tiendas ha disminuido, pero aun así, sigue siendo un lugar de referencia y con una variada oferta comercial. Algo que no ha cambiado en Obispo y que mantiene su popularidad es la feria de artesanos y artistas que se encuentra en el #411, esquina Aguacate . Allí se exponen, en las diferentes tarimas, una gran variedad de artículos para la venta, como suvenires, piezas de orfebrería, artesanías elaboradas con diferentes materiales y pinturas comerciales. La feria está abierta todos los días y está gestionada por la Asociación Cubana de Artesanos y Artistas, lo que garantiza que los productos expuestos cumplen con ciertos estándares de calidad y autenticidad. Por estas razones este es un espacio muy visitado, sobre todo por los turistas que quieren llevarse un recuerdo de Cuba. Aquí se impone la calidad y los artesanos que tienen su sitio en esta feria son artistas de experiencia con un dominio de su arte y una pasión que se refleja en cada pieza. De hecho, muchos de ellos venden directamente sus creaciones, por lo que además de llevarse un bonito recuerdo se puede conocer al artista que lo creó. Caminar por Obispo y visitar esta feria es como hacer una pausa en medio del bullicio. Afuera la calle hierve con el calor del día y el ir y venir de los transeúntes. Adentro entre tarimas y productos coloridos el tiempo parece moverse con más calma, y aunque Obispo ya no es lo que era ante, su feria de artesanos se mantiene con su de creatividad y tradición. Aquí no se venden simples productos artesanales, se vende un pedazo de Cuba hecho a mano. Así que si alguna vez caminas por Obispo entra, quizás salgas con algo más que un souvenir, una bonita historia para contar.

body.title: My visit to the Copey lagoon, a place to enjoy being in contact with nature (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
>

**<center>INGLÉS</center>**



Hello fellow travelers! It's a pleasure to greet you and share my visit to Laguna de Copey, located in the municipality of Bermúdez, on the Cumaná-Carúpano national highway. A beautiful viewpoint and a theme park featuring the famous flamingos, or corocoras, that inhabit this mangrove area were recently built at this lagoon. At the entrance, the sign reads \

(Copey Lagoon Ecotourism Viewpoint), set within a concrete circle and featuring a shark sculpture in front. Next to the identification fence, there's a red concrete walkway with a circle in the center featuring several flamingos, some white and some red. The central one is the largest and one of the most striking. It's made of concrete, and I must say I liked the design; it looks realistic. Each flamingo is in a different pose, some eating, others resting, and some standing. Around the largest flamingo are several blue concrete benches. There's also a red bench next to the fence. I liked these benches because they have a small, multicolored wall at the bottom. In front of the fence, there's a beautiful white heron that seems to be reading the sign. A closer look reveals the red flamingo, the central figure at this viewpoint, and behind it, a lovely walkway ending at a swing. The walkway is made of wood, giving the lagoon a beautiful, tropical, and eco-friendly feel. It also features LED lights that complement the beautiful landscape framed by the mountain and the lagoon. And the spectacular Flamingos, very close to the walkway is a red Flamingo, which is the guardian of this walkway, to get to the swing, you must first ask permission from this beautiful vigilant Flamingo.

>

**<center>ESPAÑOL</center>**


Hola, hola amigos viajeros, es un placer saludarles y compartir mi visita a Laguna de Copey,  la cual se ubica en el municipio Bermúdez, en la carretera nacional Cumaná - Carúpano,  en esta laguna se construyó recientemente un hermoso mirador y un parque temático con los famosos flamingos o corocoras,  que habitan en esta zona de manglares;  en la entrada se lee el identificador \

, que reposa en un círculo de concreto y al frente tiene un tiburón. Al lado de la valla de identificación, hay una caminería de concreto en color rojo, esta tiene un círculo en el centro donde se ubican varios flamingos, de color blanco y rojo, el del centro es el más grande y uno de los más llamativos, está hecho de concreto y debo decir que el diseño me gustó, parece real y cada uno de ellos está en diferentes posiciones, algunos comiendo otros descansando, parados y alrededor del Flamingo más grande, se ubican varios bancos de concreto pintados en color azul, al lado de la valla también hay un banco de color rojo, estos bancos me gustaron porque en la parte inferior tienen un pequeño muro de variados colores, al frente de la valla hay una hermosa garza blanca que da la impresión de estar leyendo el escrito, en una vista detallada se observa el Flamingo rojo, que es la figura central en este mirador y detrás de ella hay una hermosa caminería que finaliza en un columpio, la cual está elaborada con madera que le dan un estilo ecológico tropical y muy bonito a esta laguna, cuenta además con luces LED que complementan el hermoso paisaje adornado por la montaña, la laguna y los espectaculares Flamingos, muy cerca de la caminería se ubica un Flamingo de color rojo, que es el guardián de esta pasarela, para llegar hasta el columpio, debes primero pedirle permiso a este hermoso Flamingo vigilante. ![laguna copey body.title: 「生活」爬山后的惬意时光
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![EttgIihMGQU8r877_9996445d3c3e490bfc7c2edf51dd6280.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/EttgIihMGQU8r877_9996445d3c3e490bfc7c2edf51dd6280/EttgIihMGQU8r877_9996445d3c3e490bfc7c2edf51dd6280.webp)
![UZJ8cG3HPMjsLYTd_caa1d117d1caec9a446041ffa9a4ee58.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/UZJ8cG3HPMjsLYTd_caa1d117d1caec9a446041ffa9a4ee58/UZJ8cG3HPMjsLYTd_caa1d117d1caec9a446041ffa9a4ee58.webp)
![IxjDuuQ1Qek9SBXp_IMG_6487.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/IxjDuuQ1Qek9SBXp_IMG_6487/IxjDuuQ1Qek9SBXp_IMG_6487.webp)
![llAvvpemQTu9FxU9_0caf55008c16638dc019669eb6a6c230.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/llAvvpemQTu9FxU9_0caf55008c16638dc019669eb6a6c230/llAvvpemQTu9FxU9_0caf55008c16638dc019669eb6a6c230.webp)
![BU4o31gtjjMWorce_9bbeb8178aa9dfb0f180e7ec34d96e3c.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/BU4o31gtjjMWorce_9bbeb8178aa9dfb0f180e7ec34d96e3c/BU4o31gtjjMWorce_9bbeb8178aa9dfb0f180e7ec34d96e3c.webp)
![FgWO0rOxV0IyQ1Dx_3a72d14a12e75b236a79ec75e5cacbf7.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/FgWO0rOxV0IyQ1Dx_3a72d14a12e75b236a79ec75e5cacbf7/FgWO0rOxV0IyQ1Dx_3a72d14a12e75b236a79ec75e5cacbf7.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

那天去爬龙泉山森林公园的仰天窝，全程一共花了三个多小时，整体还算轻松，就是下山的时候小腿一直在抖，终于体会到了什么叫上坡容易下坡难。

下山后，我们沿着公路又走了大约一公里，才走到停车的地方。一路上我们都在手机上找环境不错的户外场地，既能让孩子们玩耍，大人也能歇脚。可合适的地方都很远，还在半山腰，开车上去又堵车，最后只能就近找了家咖啡厅坐下。

我们光顾的这家咖啡厅叫两忘·折耳，就在滨河路边，对面的风景很不错。虽然临街，但环境比较清静。

下午时段咖啡厅里人并不多，室外只摆了两张桌子，还都有顾客坐着，我们就只能选室内的位置。这家店大概有三间门面那么宽，不过门开得很小，往里走是分隔开的小隔间。虽然打通会更敞亮，但这样隔开反而多了几分私密性。整体风格偏半复古，部分墙面没有刷漆，保留着做旧的砖块和水泥质感。

坐下来点了些吃的，看了半天菜单，也没找到我特别喜欢喝的。于是我悄悄在网上点了两杯瑞幸的黄油拿铁，毕竟咖啡厅一般都不允许外带饮品，只能偷偷点。我跟点哥各点了一杯店里的黄油美式，十月妈妈给孩子们点了两杯牛奶，自己喝了一杯美式，另外还点了一份松饼和一份小蛋糕。

当牛奶和松饼端上来时，两个小朋友眼睛都亮了，赶紧把牛奶拿到旁边桌单独坐着，还一直在说悄悄话，生怕我们听到。俩人把盘子挪过来不停地夹松饼，凑在一起胃口特别好，吃了好多。

这样反倒解放了我们大人，感觉无比清静，终于能坐下来好好放松一下了。这时外卖到了，我们悄悄把外卖袋丢进外面的垃圾桶，只把饮品拿进来。

结果还是被店员看到了，哈哈，不过她没有制止我们，只是额外拿了两个杯子过来，让我们倒进去喝，免得被其他顾客误会跟着点外卖，毕竟9块9确实比38块钱一杯的咖啡香。

小蛋糕的味道还不错，现在大多用动物性淡奶油，本身就清爽不腻，吃着刚好。我们这一坐又是两个小时。感觉周末只要不用忙工作，随便找个地方坐坐，喝点东西，就觉得特别解压又治愈。

---

body.title: Crispy Banana Empanadas (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> I was craving some banana empanadas for breakfast, so when I saw that I had all the ingredients on hand in my pantry, I got started early in the morning. The banana dough turns out really well, and even better when combined with wheat flour because it makes it soft. I followed a recipe similar to the one for arepas; let’s take a look at the preparation.
![1000110165.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zbHbwCWa2WwocedBuwfjzLBwWsa4TrGzTJK3UL7p4qSkg8tfUtefxDNcoS8E5a1CZDd.png)
## Ingredients: - 1 banana - 100 grams of corn flour - 2 tablespoons of wheat flour - 1 tablespoon of sugar - 1 cup of water - Hard white cheese for grating - Oil
![1000110150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8h14z9J3eBh6Y9onESHv4fkFfmyxJSaGx5vWtpqBHmg6d2RWMFmFtdBP1j12nme1rr.jpg)
![1000110152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8hXUsFNyi3LmQ4vhJTQwXeVYoYWfcnB2cQCUfUMUu949iMHgoJbkUwmLLfEhtNaYrR.jpg)
## Preparation: I placed the cup of water in the blender along with the banana, which I had peeled and cut into pieces. This produced a juice that became the base for my empanada dough. I poured it into a bowl, added the tablespoon of sugar, and then the cornmeal, kneading it until there were no lumps. Shortly after, I added the wheat flour and kneaded again until all the ingredients were perfectly incorporated.
![1000110163.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zS11vtW8ekaip9vwXhPhSWASk11AgMp7zkrLpUSu1GGZDED41C66NCUpbLK19FeKHhs.png)
![1000110157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tmKjD7Eg7e7ydeE2cPRdcCwRsVM5nkXDuPFNNMGSWLVwjLbDRV8CPNv8T6jezrqW1Um.jpg)
The next step was to assemble the empanadas. I used the same bag the cornmeal had come in, brushed it with oil, placed a portion of the dough inside, flattened it into a thin circle, grated enough cheese on top, and sealed it, leaving the edges rough to achieve a crispy texture. I repeated the process four more times.
![1000110160.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23uQp285frvPAVd5CSyCf3nJRAziRakYmx6163LQDPF7QxhqgUdkiHFUnZM9Qy3Fjjj4o.jpg)
Finally, I fried them until they were golden brown, the cheese melted, and its wonderful flavor permeated the dough; the banana pairs very well with this ingredient. I enjoyed my delicious empanadas with the satisfaction of having made a new contribution to creative cooking. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Tenía antojo de unas empanadas de cambur para el desayuno, así que al ver en mi alacena que tenía todos los ingredientes disponibles, empecé la labor a tempranas horas de la mañana. La masa de cambur queda muy buena y aún más si se combina con harina de trigo porque queda suave. Seguí una receta parecida a la de las arepas, veamos la preparación.
![1000110165.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zbHbwCWa2WwocedBuwfjzLBwWsa4TrGzTJK3UL7p4qSkg8tfUtefxDNcoS8E5a1CZDd.png)
## Ingredientes: - 1 cambur - 100 gramos de harina de maíz - 2 cucharadas de harina de trigo - 1 cucharada de azúcar - 1 taza de agua - Queso blanco duro para rallar - Aceite
![1000110150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8h14z9J3eBh6Y9onESHv4fkFfmyxJSaGx5vWtpqBHmg6d2RWMFmFtdBP1j12nme1rr.jpg)
![1000110152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8hXUsFNyi3LmQ4vhJTQwXeVYoYWfcnB2cQCUfUMUu949iMHgoJbkUwmLLfEhtNaYrR.jpg)
## Preparación: Coloqué la taza de agua junto al cambur, previamente desconchado y cortado en trozos, en la licuadora. Obtuve un jugo que se convirtió en la base para la masa de mis empanadas. Agregué en un envase, añadí la cucharada de azúcar y luego la harina de maíz, amasé para que no quedaran grumos. Poco después agregué la harina de de trigo y volví a amasar hasta alcanzar que todos los ingredientes se integraran a la perfección.
![1000110163.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zS11vtW8ekaip9vwXhPhSWASk11AgMp7zkrLpUSu1GGZDED41C66NCUpbLK19FeKHhs.png)
![1000110157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tmKjD7Eg7e7ydeE2cPRdcCwRsVM5nkXDuPFNNMGSWLVwjLbDRV8CPNv8T6jezrqW1Um.jpg)
El paso siguiente fue armar las empanadas, usé la misma bolsa de la envoltura de la harina de maíz, unté aceite, un porción de la masa, aplasté hasta hacerla un círculo delgado, rallé suficiente queso encima y cerré, dejé con las orillas rústicas para lograr una textura crujiente. Repetí el proceso cuatro veces más.
![1000110160.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23uQp285frvPAVd5CSyCf3nJRAziRakYmx6163LQDPF7QxhqgUdkiHFUnZM9Qy3Fjjj4o.jpg)
Por último, freí hasta que estuvieran doradas, el queso se derritió e impregnó de su magnífico sabor la masa, el cambur combina muy bien con este ingrediente. Disfruté de mis deliciosas empanadas con la satisfacción de lograr un nuevo aporte a la cocina creativa.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: (es.en) Lo que aprendí de mi teléfono ✦ What I learned from my phone
body.body:
#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  
 
 
# <center> ✦ ***Lo que aprendí de mi teléfono*** ✦</center> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVGqvbv6wNmyekLQz6obg9VFtNzULDGvd5TJeNmVdhioN/william_hook_9e9pd9blato_unsplash.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/iphone-x-gris-espacial-9e9PD9blAto

Hoy me siento aquí nuevamente para contar una historia una que puede sonar un poco rara, y es que justo hace 3 días me pasó algo...llamémoslo interesante, mientras ordenaba la casa y el polvo me hacía estornudar, no solo ponía en orden muebles, libros polvorientos y platos, también ponía en orden mi cabeza. 

Cansado y con más alergias que deseos de vivir me senté en el sofá, con la intención de simplemente entretenerme un rato, un amigo me hizo una cuenta en Instagram y me dijo: si no subes fotos...al menos ves un poco de videos cuando te aburras. Y sí que he visto videos, he caído en un sin fin de videos uno tras otro. Ahora entiendo un poco mejor a los jóvenes, es que siempre parece que hay algo para ver y que si dejas de ver te pierdes de algo grande.

Y ahí estaba yo una hora después pegado a mi móvil, había olvidado el orden, los muebles, los platos y hasta el polvo. Qué pequeño ladrón de tiempo rectangular cargamos en el bolsillo. Justo en ese momento saltó una notificación de la misma aplicación, cosa sin sentido, ya que nadie puede darme un me gusta a una foto que no había subido...pero sí había una foto, había subido un pequeño video por error, y ya habían personas mirándolo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRMLdkn13MHYsnYdm1DSHqfEcdK5S9arYNZZUzRzC15Ze/maulana_ahmad_hflb3jpk_aw_unsplash.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/ilustraciones/hombre-sentado-en-el-sofa-usando-un-smartphone-con-telefono-hfLB3JPK_Aw

Y ahí estaba mi cara pegada a la pantalla, con especial atención a cada poro y cana de mi cara, no sabía que hacer y no encontraba el botón de borrar, hasta que después de muchos intentos lo logré. ¿Y ahora te preguntas por qué cuento todo esto? Vayamos al grano, el móvil no te quita el tiempo, el móvil no comete errores, el móvil no sube una foto sin que tú lo hagas, así que paremos de echar culpas a ambas manos, y comencemos a responsabilizarnos. El único culpable de que mi vieja cara casi fuese el nuevo meme viral fui yo, no mi móvil, el único culpable que mis libros sigan llenos de polvo soy yo, no mi móvil.

Revisé la galería entonces para borrar la evidencia de mi desliz tecnológico, no sabía que la aplicación no guardaba en la galería, así que después de una llamada de confianza a mi amigo y técnico de confianza, me lo confirmó, no tenía de que preocuparme...al menos si nadie hizo una captura...

Suficiente Internet para mí por un día me dije, y comencé a revisar mi galería en busca de viejas fotos, en ese contenido más antiguo y menos viral. Mi sorpresa fue encontrarme un pequeño video de unos segundos, salía yo. Era una habitación pequeña y con muy mala iluminación, a mi lado la cara de unos amigos me resultaron entre extrañas y familiares. Imagino que el video fue tomada hace unos 5 años y desde ese entonces hemos cambiado, cambiados todos menos mi móvil, fiel guerrero al que no culpo de mis entuertos tecnológicos. De él aprendí muchas cosas a lo largo de todos estos años que lleva conmigo.



**Lección 1. La batería baja no es falla es señal**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYhG6KMztmj5Fq1wGJF1w5RGyUB8pUrMMwqYDM58x7kYi/photo_1655802326047_407fe37539ae.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/interfaz-grafica-de-usuario-aplicacion-FyAz6mH3WLY

Siempre que veo el 15% de batería entro en modo pánico, busco el cargador, me estreso y lo conecto con prisa. Nosotros en ese lado somos muy parecidos a los teléfonos, lo que nuestra carga se llama Motivación. Sabes que pasa cuando sigues usando tu teléfono después del 15% verdad...termina apagándose, igual  os pasa a nosotros cuando hacemos algo bajos de motivación, terminamos desistiendo.

**Lección 2. El modo avión no es solo para Volar**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP9EY2p3C9hnibmHghUHbiRKQzPKWAhua8FZwTjSEy12k/sten_ritterfeld_jdfgqieevjq_unsplash.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/mando-a-distancia-en-blanco-y-negro-jDfgqieEVJQ

Aquí viene la parte práctica del asunto y quizás lo más importante de este escrito. Cuando quiero tiempo para mí pongo Modo Avión y ahí se detiene mi teléfono pero me detengo yo también, ahí tengo tiempo de pensar y mi teléfono tiene tiempo de descansar de dar gritos y señales para que sea atendido. Lección aprendida, usa el modo avión aunque no estés volando, desconecta del teléfono y que el desconecte de ti. Toma ese tiempo para un pase, o sembrar una planta en el jardín o sacar a pasear a tu perro, o acariciar a tu gato. 

**Lección 3. Hay Notificaciones que no esperan**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ56gAVnSFQJ2PvXKkHt7mk17BToBhn7xsM2o67aKXv1F/maulana_ahmad_kpkig6svteg_unsplash.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/ilustraciones/el-hombre-consumido-por-un-smartphone-y-contenido-digital-KPkig6sVtEg

Durante una semana hace mucho tiempo tenía una insistente notificación que no paraba de saltar y sonar en mi teléfono alertándome de una falta de almacenamiento, y yo que no entendía simplemente quería dejarla estar, pero abría la cámara y aparecía la notificación, abría la galería y aparecía, no podía usar la mayoría de las funciones. Gracias a mi amigo nuevamente descubrí por qué pasaba esto, y no pude dejar de notar cierto paralelismo con nosotros mismos, cuántas veces nuestro cuerpo, nuestra mente nos envía esa señal diciéndonos, detente, escúchame, haz algo, y lo dejamos pasar, así hasta que no aguantamos más y los remedios se vuelven peores y más largos que la solución simple de hacer caso. Si en tu vida tienes un problema que frena lo demás soluciónalo cuanto antes, eso lo aprendí de una notificación constante de almacenamiento.

El verdadero truco no es dejar el teléfono para ser más productivos, es convertirlo en tu aliado. Mi teléfono me enseñó todo eso, además es la mejor forma de estar en contacto con mis amigos y familiares, también es una forma de diversión, una barata y cómoda y siempre disponible, nosotros somos los responsables de que tanto lo usamos y como lo usamos, no lo culpes de no tener autocontrol. No guardes esa frase motivadora, úsala, no digas perdí el tiempo en mi teléfono, ciérralo y haz algo distinto, y regresa a él cuando sí lo quieres perder, riendo con algún video de animales raros.

Mi teléfono me enseñó que la motivaciones un ciclo, a veces eres de carga rápida y puedes hasta dar energía a los demás, a veces tu cable simplemente se rompió de forma mágica e invisible y tu batería necesita 4 días hábiles para recargarse, a veces simplemente necesitas cambiar el fondo de pantalla para decir: estoy aquí y estoy bien, no hago ruido, pero tengo un propósito claro.

Mi teléfono es el recordatorio constante de que él como yo se puede reiniciar, instalar nuevas aplicaciones o volver a las antiguas si las nuevas fallan, yo puedo tener nuevas metas y regresar a las antiguas si las nuevas fallan, y si es demasiado, apago y mañana vuelvo a encender. Esto más que un truco técnico es una lección de vida, si algo falla prueba encendiendo y apagando.

Así que si mañana te levantas desmotivado mira a tu teléfono y recuerda que hasta el mejor modelo y marca se queda sin batería y no por eso lo vas a tirar, solo conéctalo al cargador, da un respiro y espera...


#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  
![](https://images.ecency.com/p/5ShzsKnKF7vqASPAqXGPakzgncLgnonBpRauPEjcRbdChZiCDdqHbj9bi13uoNCeTf4S3djJxd4w1kBRB3j41eRMhVB5MEVpY7EsGWx2womXiDZ6WhzD1QWk8ZpfcxSeSd2S7oYashfySjy2Xeo1ZD49?format=match&mode=fit)

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  
![](https://images.ecency.com/p/F1sR3uPuh6LH81Fdp9FaMEn6Lj6bbLPoZeHEMBfppnqKSs9vbK2eh3XHr2yBr1epGwfabAbpoduF57yK2obKaJvujF5NXRBr5eP5jCHyWVo5Ptvwx17SLzrZwF1pK4SxLEp6Arc3Ag7Fjpf4UdSvC9qeVxH5mqU6vdkG3QJv2tjCiABkaKCfePqihJicfhWfuL3FGSAZJ1bUy8h6WPtvAWRpjeP5?format=match&mode=fit)

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  
 
 
# <center> ✦ ***What I learned from my phone*** ✦</center> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVGqvbv6wNmyekLQz6obg9VFtNzULDGvd5TJeNmVdhioN/william_hook_9e9pd9blato_unsplash.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/iphone-x-gris-espacial-9e9PD9blAto

Today I sit here again to tell a story, one that might sound a little strange. Just three days ago, something happened to me... let's call it interesting. While I was tidying the house, the dust was making me sneeze. I wasn't just putting away furniture, dusty books, and dishes; I was also tidying my head.

Tired and with more allergies than desire to live, I sat down on the sofa, intending simply to entertain myself for a while. A friend made me an Instagram account and said, \

And watch videos I did; I got hooked on countless videos, one after another. Now I understand young people a little better. It always seems like there's something to watch, and if you stop watching, you'll miss out on something big.

And there I was, an hour later, glued to my phone. I'd forgotten about tidying up, the furniture, the dishes, and even the dust. What a tiny, rectangular time thief we carry in our pockets. Right at that moment a notification popped up from the same app, which made no sense, since nobody can like a photo I hadn't uploaded...but there was a photo, I had uploaded a short video by mistake, and people were already watching it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRMLdkn13MHYsnYdm1DSHqfEcdK5S9arYNZZUzRzC15Ze/maulana_ahmad_hflb3jpk_aw_unsplash.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/ilustraciones/hombre-sentado-en-el-sofa-usando-un-smartphone-con-telefono-hfLB3JPK_Aw

And there was my face glued to the screen, with meticulous attention to every pore and gray hair. I didn't know what to do and couldn't find the delete button, until after many attempts I finally managed it. And now you're wondering why I'm telling you all this? Let's get to the point: your phone doesn't waste your time, your phone doesn't make mistakes, your phone doesn't upload a photo without you doing it, so let's stop blaming both hands and start taking responsibility. The only one to blame for my old face almost becoming the next viral meme was me, not my phone. The only one to blame for my books still gathering dust is me, not my phone.

I checked my gallery to delete the evidence of my technological blunder. I hadn't known the app didn't save to the gallery, so after a quick call to my trusted friend and techie, he confirmed it. I had nothing to worry about... at least if no one had taken a screenshot.

\

I told myself, and started scrolling through my gallery looking for old photos, for that older, less viral content. To my surprise, I found a short video, just a few seconds long. It was me. It was a small room with very poor lighting, and the faces of some friends next to me seemed both strange and familiar. I imagine the video was taken about five years ago, and since then we've all changed, except for my phone, my faithful warrior, which I don't blame for my technological mishaps. I've learned so much from it over all these years it's been with me.


**Lesson 1. A low battery is not a fault, it's a sign**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYhG6KMztmj5Fq1wGJF1w5RGyUB8pUrMMwqYDM58x7kYi/photo_1655802326047_407fe37539ae.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/interfaz-grafica-de-usuario-aplicacion-FyAz6mH3WLY

Whenever I see 15% battery, I panic, grab the charger, get stressed, and plug it in in a hurry. In that respect, we're very similar to phones; our \

is called Motivation. You know what happens when you keep using your phone past 15%, right? It ends up shutting down. The same thing happens to us when we're low on motivation; we end up giving up.

**Lesson 2. Airplane Mode Isn't Just for Flying**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP9EY2p3C9hnibmHghUHbiRKQzPKWAhua8FZwTjSEy12k/sten_ritterfeld_jdfgqieevjq_unsplash.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/mando-a-distancia-en-blanco-y-negro-jDfgqieEVJQ

Here comes the practical part, and perhaps the most important point of this article. When I want time for myself, I turn on Airplane Mode, and my phone stops, but I stop too. I have time to think, and my phone has time to rest from shouting and signaling for attention. Lesson learned: use Airplane Mode even when you're not flying, disconnect from your phone, and let it disconnect from you. Use that time for a walk, planting something in the garden, taking your dog for a stroll, or petting your cat.

**Lesson 3. Some Notifications Don't Wait**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ56gAVnSFQJ2PvXKkHt7mk17BToBhn7xsM2o67aKXv1F/maulana_ahmad_kpkig6svteg_unsplash.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/ilustraciones/el-hombre-consumido-por-un-smartphone-y-contenido-digital-KPkig6sVtEg

For a week, a long time ago, I had a persistent notification on my phone that kept popping up and beeping, alerting me to a lack of storage. I didn't understand it and just wanted to ignore it, but when I opened the camera, the notification appeared; when I opened the gallery, it appeared; I couldn't use most of the phone's functions. Thanks to my friend, I discovered why this was happening, and I couldn't help but notice a certain parallel with ourselves. How often does our body, our mind, send us that signal saying, \

and we ignore it, until we can't take it anymore, and the remedies become worse and take longer than the simple solution of heeding it. If you have a problem in your life that's holding you back, solve it as soon as possible. I learned that from a constant storage notification.\n\nThe real trick isn't to put down your phone to be more productive; it's to make it your ally. My phone taught me all of that. It's also the best way to stay in touch with my friends and family. It's a cheap, convenient, and always-available form of entertainment. We're responsible for how much and how we use it, so don't blame it for a lack of self-control. Don't just save that motivational phrase; use it. Don't say, \

Close it and do something else, and come back to it when you really want to waste time, laughing at some weird animal video.

My phone taught me that motivation is cyclical. Sometimes you're a fast charger and can even energize others. Sometimes your cable magically and invisibly breaks, and your battery needs four business days to recharge. Sometimes you just need to change your wallpaper to say: I'm here, and I'm okay. I'm not making a fuss, but I have a clear purpose.

My phone is a constant reminder that, like me, it can be restarted, new apps can be installed, or the old ones can be reverted if the new ones fail. I can set new goals and go back to the old ones if the new ones fail, and if it's too much, I'll turn it off and turn it back on tomorrow. This is more than a technical trick; it's a life lesson: if something isn't working, try turning it off and on again.

So if you wake up feeling unmotivated tomorrow, look at your phone and remember that even the best model and brand can run out of battery, and that's no reason to throw it away. Just plug it into the charger, take a breath, and wait...

body.body: Math Easy Solutions, you’re right: the standard term is **20/20 vision**, which means normal visual acuity at 20 feet, not “50/50” ([AOA](https://www.aoa.org/healthy-eyes/vision-and-vision-correction/visual-acuity), [AAO](https://www.aao.org/eye-health/tips-prevention/what-does-20-20-vision-mean)). “Perfect vision” is a sloppy phrase anyway, because eyesight involves more than acuity, but in normal conversation 20/20 is the accepted benchmark ([Vision Center](https://www.visioncenter.org/resources/visual-acuity-score/)). On InLeo, the search turned up nothing useful on this one, so your friend is confidently wrong — a dangerous hobby.

body.title: Mi visita matutina a la pista de Skateboard Cumaná, Venezuela
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Bendiciones abundantes y eternas para todos los miembros de esta fabulosa comunidad @Worldmappin. Encantado en saludarles y desearles feliz y Bendito inicio de semana. Deseo que la bendición de Dios abunde en sus vidas y tengan un bonito día. Hoy les comparto una nueva aventura por el centro de la ciudad, en esta ocasión hice una visita a la pista de skateboard que se ubica detrás del parque Ayacucho en la ribera del río Manzanares, este río pasa por todo el centro de la ciudad y su recorrido incluye importantes lugares como el parque Guaiquerí, Ayacucho, mercado municipal, entre otros, nunca había visitado esta pista pero mientras caminaba por la orilla del río, vi algunos murales que llamaron mi atención y avancé hacia esa zona, luego de ingresar al parque Ayacucho por la caminería de las palmeras, varios metros hacia atrás se ubica esta llamativa pista, donde se dan cita jóvenes y diferentes grupos para practicar este deporte. La pista inicia con varios muros y rampas donde los chicos hacen sus exhibiciones, es un deporte que considero extremo y de grandes destrezas, para desplazarse en la patineta por las rampas y tubos, al entrar a la pista se observa un muro de color negro en los bordes y las escaleras con rampas y tubos de hierro donde los chicos hacen sus demostraciones, luego una pared con un mural muy llamativo en el cual está escrito el nombre de Cumana. La pared está pintada en el fondo con negro, tiene las letras de color azul y varios bancos al frente, estos bancos además de usarlos para sentarse sirven para hacer exhibiciones con las patinetas, el mural se extiende desde el inicio de la pared, que es bastante grande valga decir, hasta el otro extremo, al frente se observan las escaleras una rampa y en la siguiente esquina inicia la nueva pista de skateboard, que me gustó mucho por sus coloridos murales la distribución del espacio y una increíble vista del río Manzanares.

> **
ENGLISH
** Abundant and eternal blessings to all members of this fabulous @Worldmappin community. It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed start to the week. I pray that God's blessings abound in your lives and that you have a wonderful day. Today I'm sharing a new adventure in the city center. This time, I visited the skateboard park located behind Ayacucho Park on the banks of the Manzanares River. This river runs through the entire city center, and its course includes important landmarks such as Guaiquerí Park, Ayacucho Park, the municipal market, and others. I had never visited this park before, but while walking along the riverbank, I saw some murals that caught my eye, and I headed towards that area. After entering Ayacucho Park through the palm-lined walkway, a few meters back, you'll find this eye-catching park, where young people and various groups gather to practice this sport. The skatepark begins with several walls and ramps where the kids perform their tricks. It's a sport I consider extreme and requires great skill to navigate the ramps and pipes on a skateboard. Upon entering the park, you see a black wall along the edges and stairs with ramps and iron pipes where the kids demonstrate their tricks. Then there's a wall with a striking mural that spells out the name Cumaná. The wall is painted black with blue lettering and several benches in front. These benches, besides being used for sitting, also serve as platforms for skateboarding demonstrations. The mural stretches from the beginning of the wall, which is quite large, to the other end. In front, you can see the stairs and a ramp, and in the next corner, the new skateboard park begins. I really liked it because of its colorful murals, the layout of the space, and an incredible view of the Manzanares River. ![SKB (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eou9fZN6X7gFSYxACWXvMFhsHWWjV3EjwqsouVjyHsNjdjYGjj5QVcTtgDw7BCFQHQQ.jpeg) ![SKB (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoK5sR2xTBeszyzXop9TFm11K9eqhCzrQxFSKKysEeXZPg95hyTYhkGbeKHXWzxP6kq.jpeg) ![SKB (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep3erptNZE5zysyHPQbyc1tPaxh7W3zfuGU2gNXbQjPXsmLWwTKRq4bJLSdzUjye1Rn.jpeg) ![SKB (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoGyTngvbneMReyUZDxbSpSrFpqHu6h3XftyQLgHedGNpSnakyYtp2s9tui9Yj1JX2R.jpeg) ![SKB (27).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23x1BF7TUpAH8R4cAwMnQbTqBg8ZcH8e5C9Tyv8vuLLAbAguEG9paePE3pH2RETvcT6Kz.jpeg) ![SKB (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23zGgaQ19iUTvVXQRjstJ7SZ4wGWGWHNXGLbuQjaUy5XCx6bf2J866m41ZAskoJJTDPMw.jpeg) ![SKB (26).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqDkcW4gZGenDy7pbdPusSNCtBywDYYagXnCMmhkwQzH3ZZPoyDKUo6N5nY9AdTngLs.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> Al cruzar el paredón principal se ve el tronco de un árbol y a continuación los murales que decoran la pista, se observan las rampas con tubos en los bordes, el piso es de concreto y permite a los deportistas desplazarse para hacer sus piruetas, se observa también en una vista cerca los detalles de la rampa y los muros donde estos chicos realizan sus exhibiciones y prácticas, están pintadas de color azul, las barandas son de color negro y las rampas principales son totalmente de concreto, están ubicadas en la parte trasera, lo cual facilita el desplazamiento desde lo más alto hasta llegar a las áreas planas, en varias ocasiones he visto estas exhibiciones y por lo que he observado no son nada fácil, requieren entrenamiento disciplina y habilidades para desplazarse en la patineta. Además de las rampas señaladas, hay varios muros ubicados a los lados donde también se realizan las prácticas, de acuerdo a lo que he visto, cada una de las rampas exige un nivel de preparación, inician desde lo más sencillo hasta llegar a lo complejo y exigente; la rampa tienen diferentes ubicaciones y elevaciones de acuerdo a el nivel de preparación que tengan estos chicos, durante mi recorrido pude ver algunos jóvenes practicando, haciendo demostraciones sencillas y permanecí varios minutos viendo las habilidades y facilidad a mi parecer, con la que estos jóvenes se desplazan y ejecutan diferentes movimientos en la patineta, es impresionante cómo se desplazan y saltan de una rampa a otra, me sorprendió ver chicos bastante jóvenes realizando las prácticas con versatilidad y agilidad.

> Upon crossing the main wall, you see a tree trunk, followed by the murals that decorate the skatepark. You can see the ramps with pipes along the edges. The concrete floor allows the skaters to move around and perform their tricks. A close-up view reveals details of the ramp and the walls where these kids perform their exhibitions and practice. They are painted blue, the railings are black, and the main ramps are entirely made of concrete. They are located at the back, which facilitates movement from the top to the flat areas. I have seen these exhibitions on several occasions, and from what I've observed, they are not easy at all; they require training, discipline, and skill to move around on a skateboard. In addition to the ramps mentioned, there are several walls located on the sides where they also practice. From what I've seen, each ramp demands a different level of preparation, starting from the simplest and progressing to the most complex and demanding. The ramps have different locations and elevations according to the level of preparation these kids have. During my visit, I saw some young people practicing, doing simple demonstrations, and I spent several minutes watching the skills and ease with which these young people move and execute different movements on the skateboard. It's impressive how they move and jump from one ramp to another. I was surprised to see quite young kids practicing with versatility and agility. ![SKB (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eou8GXkGEbpXppkKr7QS8hbdyazF9eDhQPm933M4Gqgo8iGk565SpVktuCjnfoRhUch.jpeg) ![SKB (14).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpviPmzZFajWnHTLSmxzgyuhtAopHhbtntgVyokcKXZBaCHQD55R5DgfLZUMy7o6jNb.jpeg) ![SKB (15).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpEGuZjSSkNxgoqq8kryNEu5LLxuMDeFQkgQmR24uyqouY2ZtXmQyGYxgvfjihPRczo.jpeg) ![SKB (17).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoErvNkZfs7iAUZGETvAe7AxZoNuGXv6ZVay53ctn8dNz8JbTy3Pa2U6iRWqXhkNu7K.jpeg) ![SKB (18).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqBceLD1UFE7iAN2nsfyv3FNcvkHteFMoMBE5n44b87SeGVBHYquYUX8ZpCgxaCVdvo.jpeg) ![SKB (19).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep7v5oBYkj4Zqr7aPkHvBTDSV1ZBgvUVXkkTCu6nDv69o11rn7m4CcgwiW2boag3ePb.jpeg) ![SKB (23).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpVB5JeMrZkNiKV8dkTcqKpNSuWdW2LmxehyCHLtfyek9uDEmesYueLn6TLUfYj8pLw.jpeg) ![SKB (24).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpEJpPv6xoN8kc7Nc4aoyRUZXf91ZrJLhhhTXFMGBv7iBmXMcHcPL48FwrEn5Pndgqe.jpeg) ![SKB (25).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EprU9Nc9HfD25vKZVB5CtJecpFuamAsLpf1sQqzDjpR38HQ7h4HBiJ1yTTv91tB1t7p.jpeg) ![SKB (28).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpNoSbm976mjNGDv94KwMUD4113pEyDPYJk14HEViJVpJcSQWMzbQY7ohwtcGRz6MyU.jpeg)

> Tras varios minutos observando a estos jóvenes, me dirigí hacia el paredón lateral donde se ubican unos coloridos, estos muestran algunos lugares conocidos en la ciudad como el castillo San Antonio de la Eminencia, la iglesia Santa Inés y los siguientes son jóvenes practicando ciclismo y skateboard, también hay un mural del sol, el poeta Andrés Eloy Blanco y un chico con su patineta, lleva un casco que es esencial para estas prácticas, ya que los protege de posibles caídas, el chico en la bicicleta se mueve velozmente y realiza también una pirueta, los otros murales me parecieron muy atractivos por sus vistosos colores. Uno de mis preferidos es la chica en la patineta, se está desplazando por la orilla de una rampa, también el mural tiene escrita la palabra Cumaná, las rampas ubicadas en la en la entrada tienen unas letras llamativas y extrañas en relación a las que he visto en la pista, después de observar a los jóvenes practicando, decidí hacer un pequeño recorrido por la orilla del río, ver el paisaje y observar desde lejos a estos chicos realizar las piruetas, fue una gran aventura, conocer las instalaciones de esta pista y ver las prácticas de algunos chicos, gracias por acompañarme en este fascinante recorrido.

>

 After several minutes watching these young people, I headed towards the side wall where some colorful murals are located. These depict some well-known places in the city, such as the San Antonio de la Eminencia Castle and the Santa Inés Church. The following murals show young people practicing cycling and skateboarding. There's also a mural of the sun, the poet Andrés Eloy Blanco, and a boy with his skateboard wearing a helmet, which is essential for these activities as it protects them from falls. The boy on the bicycle is moving quickly and also performing a trick. I found the other murals very attractive because of their vibrant colors.

One of my favorites is the girl on the skateboard, riding along the edge of a ramp. The mural also has the word \

written on it. The ramps at the entrance have striking and unusual lettering compared to what I've seen at the skatepark. After watching the young people practicing, I decided to take a short walk along the riverbank, admire the scenery, and watch these kids perform tricks from afar. It was a great adventure to explore the skatepark and see some of the kids practicing. Thank you for joining me on this fascinating journey. ![SKB (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EowG4R9YFrkBFyrbSky6RcpVcTLdY3JFRF3FtaP834xfMwycoWdeJtsgt2rpmD1mgDe.jpeg) ![SKB (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpT4cB7A47BPKK6FXZQsjHPLvfwmRLNoNog8dPPxeGfituvz1RXwGKk5KKNCbdoueC6.jpeg) ![SKB (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EouA6zQrVoiveAy4Pm2cVXWpgnJTu7NDdRckFcpsmQhPQ3tUraqdmHSjkJqXDbHHy8p.jpeg) ![SKB (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpQwGGB9iJMV14V3KUk1zJ1qd319Xu4oFnuWthEczWJjuThAPwxxMX3RyGjN6AfiVAK.jpeg) ![SKB (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpVC1N7Zrv8snz6n22mpFgZ4PiDKXnD74coMHTQ3McXxgFm1obdiaUKd2hs3ahp4Sqj.jpeg) ![SKB (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eos2GMToZybwCkRtnYpsRE1AxoNxBMWmHYNfbiPjRvLS8koSkuqKk1qTVC5ZivNv4X9.jpeg) ![SKB (13).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eq5DyUbHZmHn3LdgtP14V6TEdWAJ4AvynLajvAXeZRZ2baaLpPLuruBiiFx42UQQktY.jpeg) ![SKB (21).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqL8LvLFKwAr5MSuevVGSdPxdRLKzref7D4NZJghDmm659aKNnNV9qxjyY4gH1gy5Xk.jpeg) ![SKB (22).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpXKSr2JmmWtQZVZg95mxrHvjZ3h6iJ9bqseWvcvmVQUPkJ2hysswKAHeJG8rePpsxV.jpeg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

body.title: Rice with Two Meats 🥩 🐖
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Feliz noche para todos, espero hayan tenido un día excelente y que hayan descansado y disfrutado en compañía de sus seres queridos, Bienvenido a mi blog ! Les comparto la receta del almuerzo familiar que prepare el día de hoy, se trata de un arroz amarillo al cual agregué carne de res y carne de cerdo, quedó realmente delicioso; le muestro la preparación

> **
ENGLISH
** Good evening, everyone! I hope you had a wonderful day and that you got to relax and enjoy time with your loved ones. Welcome to my blog! I’d like to share the recipe for the family lunch I made today—it’s yellow rice with beef and pork, and it turned out absolutely delicious. Here’s how I made it ![IMG_20260418_153849_413.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uQxfJJFoP7DWX3Mfr5MkBZv8bECa76Q3KBbuqpNaAeyq6uJWsN2z1LG3xWWV973Wqn9.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** arroz, carne de res y cerdo, cebolla, ají, ajo, cilantro, cúrcuma, sal, aceite, adobo y comino

> **
INGREDIENTS
** rice, beef and pork, onion, chili pepper, garlic, cilantro, turmeric, salt, oil, adobo seasoning, and cumin ![IMG_20260418_140930_018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/Ep3epgBMGZEiEcrw43aDWzUa31xD2BnN62MqS7MVQ2G5DacNmBboiUxWkn1SZhHGHcm.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** El arroz lo llevé a sofreír y añadí cúrcuma para darle el color amarillo, lo reservé. Por otro lado, lavé muy bien los aliños, luego sofrei, y agregué la carne de cerdo y res, sazone con salsa de soya, caldo de pollo deshidratado, sal, adobo, comino, allí dejé cocinar por aproximadamente 8 minutos; luego baje un poco el fuego y dejé que secara por completo. Este guiso lo incorporé al arroz, agregué la cantidad de agua necesaria, comprobé de sal y deje cocinar hasta que hubo secado

> **
PROCEDURE
** I sautéed the rice and added turmeric to give it a yellow color, then set it aside. Meanwhile, I washed the vegetables thoroughly, then sautéed them, and added the pork and beef. I seasoned with soy sauce, dehydrated chicken broth, salt, adobo, and cumin, and let it cook for about 8 minutes; then I lowered the heat slightly and let it simmer until completely dry. I added this mixture to the rice, added the necessary amount of water, checked the salt, and let it cook until it had dried out. ![Collage_2026-04-18_21_07_33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wWwKYPd1JeYW4dRCEDaFnJUsmwkpQZvFgGZudaEfpF6gUpTt7qLH61zrVA3AN5HVS6Y.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_144745_002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wgMWfMCbGYvsMMu1Z4iZmbsv7XPoMExTNc8uPh7gBXmDJSSZrPZX5Lrx7xpX8TcPUu5.jpg) ![Collage_2026-04-18_21_08_11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uQtakZMcrgPo27S1bdgCMwfijyjyefGsfHxVBDUSku4K2uA2Xw3GQKyFCPB5JFryQmn.jpg)

> Una vez listo, servimos y disfrutamos este delicioso arroz doble carne, lo scompañé con un vaso de jugo de guayaba y mango . Espero haya sido de su agrado. Gracias por visitar mi blog ! Dios te bendiga🙏

> Once it’s ready, serve and enjoy this delicious double-meat rice. I paired it with a glass of guava and mango juice. I hope you enjoyed it. Thank you for visiting my blog! God bless you🙏 ![IMG_20260418_154010_591.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uQxSryBHYQJSCHxUnJicg5r62CZ6Q97rJ1fmroAESme3Js7f8ch2GymrLhD52kv6kgR.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_153850_787.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vi5xGvLHMcojZvqr3fVvgUEx9HHNJNjvxNtu2bhDULYQeroTQeF3HfCY6wV2u5X7if8.jpg) ![IMG_20260418_153959_001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xVTtvZaDpxAbdwKm9tqRzeVVz4b8RBRraVXvvMCLiMSoN8Ph3mBaccEbonfAPdzbbEU.jpg)

body.title: Repelente para plantas
body.body:
![1000522799.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23vsX8HMgbxp12DUxdjwE1YWgB2Bh3kV1JTXC5JA18yqc6Dz6DhiK3hZFFndhTMHiMhh5.jpg)
Hoy traigo un contenido diferente al que estoy acostumbrada a mostrar, pues hace mucho que no comparto algo relacionado con el cuidado del jardín. Esto se debe a que, aunque sigo teniendo algunas plantas en casa, ya no son tan variadas como antes; sin embargo, mi corazón verde sigue latiendo fuerte. Ya que iba a sembrar semillas de tomate cherry y tomando en cuenta que la vez que prosperó el tomate en mi patio se vio afectado por la plaga de la araña blanca, pensé que sería necesario tener un repelente listo para aplicar una vez que fuera creciendo la planta. En un post anterior les comenté que la planta de tomate no había dado frutos y pues... ### ¿Qué creen? Pocos días después de esta publicación, las plantas de tomate empezaron a florecer y luego aparecieron los bellos tomatitos. ¡Pronto se los mostraré! > Today I’m sharing something a little different from what I usually post, since it’s been a while since I’ve shared anything related to gardening. That’s because, even though I still have a few plants at home, I don’t have as many varieties as I used to; however, my love for gardening is still going strong. >Since I was going to plant cherry tomato seeds, and considering that the last time tomatoes thrived in my backyard they were affected by a whitefly infestation, I thought it would be necessary to have a repellent ready to apply once the plant started growing. In a previous post, I mentioned that the tomato plant hadn’t borne fruit, and well… >### Guess what? >A few days after this post, the tomato plants started to bloom, and then the beautiful little tomatoes appeared. I’ll show them to you soon! ![1000522805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wqik5GmnBjdVhxnGpua5BMt8JhNcHj586HBvFVRETCsz3y1YCyujwGZZqQcZvwurQce.jpg) Además de usar el repelente a base de ajo, también le coloqué cáscara de ajo a la tierra de las tomateras y les puedo asegurar que las plagas no se acercaron a mis plantas, y ahora se les muestro este repelente, pues he probado su efectividad. > In addition to using the garlic-based repellent, I also added garlic peels to the soil around my tomato plants, and I can assure you that the pests stayed away from my plants. Now I’m sharing this repellent with you, since I’ve tested its effectiveness. ![1000522811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23u69LVTchkAP2kPGPDvLgJjc1rCR5cwgTWWWbpgZvMJje73nokDtY46HKBNB5HJhqvr6.jpg) Este repelente lo vi en el canal de YouTube *PlanetJardin*, y se realiza con cuatro ingredientes: * Agua. * Ajo. * Vinagre. * Alcohol. >También necesitarás un envase de 500 mililitros; yo ocupé una botella de agua. En ella colocarás 2/3 de agua, 4 ajos picados en trozos, 1/3 de vinagre y algunas gotas de alcohol. A la tapa de la botella le abrí unos orificios usando un punzón para picar hielo, el cual calenté al fuego y así perforé la tapa. >I saw this repellent on the *PlanetJardin* YouTube channel, and it’s made with four ingredients: >* Water. >* Garlic. >* Vinegar. >* Alcohol. >You’ll also need a 500-milliliter container; I used a water bottle. Fill it with 2/3 water, 4 cloves of garlic chopped into pieces, 1/3 vinegar, and a few drops of alcohol. I poked some holes in the bottle cap using an ice pick, which I heated over a flame to pierce the cap. ![1000522800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23w2sLs5imBjnFGUvsCwnzFog2Pi9F8Rr6ZV8dQCuxY7LaWqFFW9r8pq9nbMn5rvxjApS.jpg) Esta mezcla se deja reposar durante 24 horas para poder usarla. Se aplica al finalizar la tarde o en la noche, es decir, cuando el sol no esté radiante o alcance a la planta. *Te recomiendo este repelente al 100%, es genial para proteger a tus plantas.* > Let this mixture sit for 24 hours before using it. Apply it in the late afternoon or evening, when the sun isn't shining directly on the plant. >*I highly recommend this repellent—it's great for protecting your plants.*

*Gracias por pasar por aquí, por detenerte a leer o a escuchar, por comentar, por votar-*

Vice President JD Vance, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessant, White House Chief of Staff Suzy Wiles, Special Envoy Steve Witkoff, CIA Director John Ratcliffe and Joint Chiefs of Staff Chairman Dan Cain reportedly attended the meeting.

body.title: Mi ascenso a lo más alto. / My rise to the top. The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Part 38. [Esp-Eng]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZDiDaxYB3KTL1jS1QPNBeAkiZU8RzArT3vSntw8UTNLT/1776523625789.jpg)

Hola querida comunidad de Hive Gaming. Espero que todos tengan un hermoso día hoy. Quería decirles que el resultado del éxito son los pequeños triunfos que vayamos logrando en el día a día. La perseverancia y la disciplina son la clave para llegar a nuestros objetivos en la vida. Esto lo comparto con ustedes para que no se rindan cuando quieren lograr algo. Como de costumbre aquí les dejo mi pedacito de historia. 

>Hello, dear Hive Gaming community. I hope you’re all having a lovely day today. I wanted to tell you that success is made up of the small victories we achieve day by day. Perseverance and discipline are the key to reaching our goals in life. I’m sharing this with you so that you don’t give up when you’re striving to achieve something. As usual, here’s a little bit of my story. 

Anteriormente habíamos encontrado a la última pequeña deidad que se encontraba en la gran Torre de los Dioses. Como las anteriores, solo teníamos que guiarla ya fuera sobre nuestros hombros o con la melodía de la voluntad hacia su nuevo altar. Luego de varios desafíos y poner mi cerebro a pensar logramos avanzar. Quédate cerca para que veas lo que sucedió a continuación. 

>Earlier, we had found the last little deity in the great Tower of the Gods. Like the others, we simply had to guide her to her new altar, either on our shoulders or with the melody of will. After overcoming several challenges and racking my brains, we managed to make progress. Stay tuned to see what happened next. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVRGf3qE15jKLH5iKts5pUCv7cxQFyKEKxwNcS7mBUqsj/1776523739608.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXsQirqkrQSb9ZM992BZqckU8aabBxbHxatqnit9TwvKT/1776523739687.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTswfxNtxRbeoR5tW36wGR6BcomAgHxFkHFJXAYtKUteF/1776523739725.jpg)

Dejamos en el suelo a nuestro pequeñín y solo siguió el camino hacia su nueva posición. La misma fuente de energía que lo despertaba volvía a su alrededor nuevamente en el nuevo altar.

>We set our little one down on the floor, and he simply made his way to his new spot. The very same source of energy that had awakened him now surrounded him once more at the new altar. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhmbTvVpv8iSFmpDUSYvato5f4ZeSrRQuKA8iKV87Jtz/1776525501043.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNjr61VtShVWDnTxDmF2nHgU97ikVv85s8QC1f3S93Nas/1776525501165.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVmj5D9R6j3kkXa5ZgK2Xf4cdtTCj6mcoNVjQKU7cDDwV/1776525501116.jpg)

De repente algo ocurrió. Todas las deidades que había encontrado comenzaron a despertarse de forma consecutiva, expulsando desde el centro de su cuerpo un fuerte rayos de luz o energía concentrándolo en el centro de esa sala. Algo muy poderoso estaba surgiendo porque en el aire se sentía así. 

>Suddenly, something happened. All the deities he had encountered began to awaken one after another, emitting powerful beams of light or energy from the centre of their bodies and focusing them on the centre of the room. Something very powerful was emerging; you could feel it in the air. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY7XaBpkTRjw8KUvcW4zm8Q9MVR4CWTyvWLieoTJBUqSa/1776525765764.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHkwxpDkMs5PYTJcYgGcWgNULR32H5B2WpZdRdAZ8W8y/1776525765829.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNq5gfjokRi8f4Tq4zBLsy4cHbyhaPGsix26qjfdPsSvF/1776525765883.jpg)

Solo me quedaba mirar desde la entrada de la habitación lo que estaba sucediendo ya que no entendía qué pasaba. En el centro de la habitación se concentró tanta energía de un color púrpura como si fuera una mezcla de todos los poderes lanzados por las deidades. Ahora tocaría explorar y ver que era aquello que había sido creado. 

>All I could do was watch from the doorway to see what was happening, as I didn’t understand what was going on. In the centre of the room, a vast amount of purple energy had gathered, as if it were a blend of all the powers unleashed by the deities. Now it was time to explore and see what it was that had been created. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbuzVDEBpvLnEhhPQsF2tfrkyjCyY2fkib7YMGkqERDU7/1776526014249.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaRUs2pQsvGC212nV17ZjwZhRq4bV773tXcnMoeGrZ8oy/1776526014332.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZDiDaxYB3KTL1jS1QPNBeAkiZU8RzArT3vSntw8UTNLT/1776526014380.jpg)

Me acerqué con mucha cautela a la zona donde se encontraba esa energía extraña. Algo muy fuerte me atraía hacia el centro y no podía regresar. Cuando miré hacia atrás ya era demasiado tarde algo muy poderoso me elevaba del suelo y comencé a levitar sin tener control de mi cuerpo. Fui ascendiendo poco a poco sin saber a qué lugar me llevaría ese túnel de energía. Estaba algo preocupado pero no podría hacer nada............

>I approached the area where that strange energy was emanating with great caution. Something incredibly powerful was pulling me towards the centre, and I couldn’t turn back. When I looked behind me, it was already too late; something immensely powerful was lifting me off the ground, and I began to levitate, with no control over my body. I rose little by little, not knowing where that tunnel of energy would take me. I was a bit worried, but there was nothing I could do............
**************************************************
Soy @loren89 un fanático de los videojuegos y espero que les haya gustado la historia de hoy.

>I’m @loren89, a video game enthusiast, and I hope you enjoyed today’s story.

body.title: 这一大口袋馒头真头大
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![9LZEaMRCuGwRMLN8_mmexport1776570273971.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/jingjing1616/images/9LZEaMRCuGwRMLN8_mmexport1776570273971/9LZEaMRCuGwRMLN8_mmexport1776570273971.webp)
![aOk0fFguktz42Sej_mmexport1776570276060.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/jingjing1616/images/aOk0fFguktz42Sej_mmexport1776570276060/aOk0fFguktz42Sej_mmexport1776570276060.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近这个天气真的有点热，这才四月中旬，夏天我可怎么办啊，我不爱吃冰的人都想喝冷的东西降温，还每天念叨小糖水冷饮之类的，最近的天气貌似回到几年前的一个夏天感觉似曾相识，白天太阳，晚上下雨，这样晚上就好睡觉了。

今年还没正式步入夏天，我竟然都吃了三次雪糕了，反而丑丑还没有念叨吃雪糕，虽然每次都没吃完整个，但是我提议吃的，然后吃两口剩下的就是给丑丑吃。晚上睡觉都要踢被子了，压根不用盖被子都可以度过整晚，周五晚上我感觉自己热到让他给我拿冰袋降温，我真的是个人才😂。

昨天下午又出去了一趟，还好是打车的，热得不行，下午回来的时候坐的地铁，然后路过那家包子铺了，我说给我买个第二天早上吃的早饭，结果我在旁边坐着等，他去排队，等他过来我发现他提了三个口袋，真是个哈婆娘，买这么多干撒子，感觉都可以吃一周多了，他还得意的给我说这个便宜，然后要买那么多才是这个价，突然觉得他有老阿姨的气质，以后退休生活不无聊了，这便宜都不放过，看着这么大包的馒头包子我脑壳都大了。

---

Now it is turning into a small flower garden oasis in the back yard!☺️ Silvertop is always checking out the price of 7/16 OSB 4X8 sheets every trip we make to Home Depot. The price will immediately tell you how the economy is doing……..😇 “$9.71 a sheet honey, that’s cheep, I remember when it was almost $50.00 a sheet!”🙄 You would think that with oil prices up (not counting this last week), and Spring home building starting up, alone with inflation, that OSB would be up in price!🤔 It normally goes like this every year……….. Spring…… OSB prices ramp up fast and hard!🙄 Then in the late Fall, prices start dropping back to close to where they started the previous Winter! I asked GROK……. who else😇……………. why are these prices down? “Silvertop with high mortgage rates, and economic uncertainty, building starts are slow, consequently lumber prices are down!” Good to know, I have been using AI everyday, it has become a powerful source of information!💪 In fact I just read that Michael Sailor of strategy, used AI to craft the latest stock offering of “STRC” a variable rate series A perpetual stretch preferred stock😇 For now, Saylor believes, this will be classified as a “return of capital”, tax deferred stock paying 11.5% “adjustable” for probably the next 10 years!😊 As always do your own research my friends!😇 Silvertop now has some planting with Liz, and some construction work to do Lol!😅 Enjoy your weekend my friends…..I certainly am!🤗 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike 😊

body.title: The Grimshield Hexpriest card
body.body:
I bought the Grimshield Hexpriest card today. I have  say that my interest in playing  game has increased even more now that I have this card. When I first saw  Grimshield Hexpriest card it was clear that it is not any ordinary card. The Grimshield Hexpriest card is actually a support and defensive powerhouse.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqEyZMJTNC3Uk515E5Z13ZQWWj5LQ8P1884K5Ru1Peq4/1776570201439.jpg)

The Grimshield Hexpriest card has a design, good stats and amazing abilities that make it a really balanced card. If you use the Grimshield Hexpriest card correctly it can make a difference in battle.

The Grimshield Hexpriest is a Feliform type card, which means it can become more powerful when used with cards. The Grimshield Hexpriest card costs 9 mana, which's a bit high but it is worth it because of the benefits it provides. Sometimes cards with mana costs can be hard to use but the Grimshield Hexpriest card is designed to work really well in late game or high mana matches.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5xbcqi4Qv8LJWXWKiAMKuZH2gSacKDpCpdx5yDBDrxM/1776570201538.jpg)

Looking at the stats of the Grimshield Hexpriest card its magic attack is really good. Gets even better as the level increases. This makes the Grimshield Hexpriest card really effective against enemies with armor.

The Grimshield Hexpriest card also has health and shield which makes it a durable card. I have used cards that cannot survive even if they attack well. The Grimshield Hexpriest card solves that problem. It can survive in battle for a time and gradually weakens the enemy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ15bLGPKePwz1ViassLSAg8wi4iMoyjPJsrYaEkEEAHx/1776570201680.png)

Now if we look at the abilities of the Grimshield Hexpriest card we can see where the real strength of this card lies. As the level of the Grimshield Hexpriest card increases it gains powerful abilities that make it not just an attacker, but also a support and control unit. These abilities work like reducing enemy attacks supporting your team or giving you advantages in certain situations.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP5BaRE3aaFA4uXFNqGdgTSNGBsopfhSynrVSKygKARxJ/1776570201792.png)

From my experience I can say that the best position to use the Grimshield Hexpriest card is to keep it in the backline. Because the Grimshield Hexpriest card is an attacker it is safe to keep it in the back rather than in the front and it can continue to attack for a long time. If the Grimshield Hexpriest card is in the front it can be quickly destroyed by the enemys attacks, which weakens the entire strategy.

However in situations it can also be better to use the Grimshield Hexpriest card in the midline especially when you build a team with a strong tank in the front. That tank will handle the enemys attacks and the Grimshield Hexpriest card will slowly finish off the enemy from behind.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTHF1RxPFjSZzMe1qyRC4dEwYZAQFnPjxDKXT9p3or9VG/1776570201885.png)

The Grimshield Hexpriest card works best in mana matches. Because then you can use tanks, supports and damage dealers together. The Grimshield Hexpriest card plays a role in that combination. On the one hand it deals damage. On the other hand it gives the team an advantage with its abilities.

If you want to use the Grimshield Hexpriest card your team composition is very important. For example if you put a health tank in front then a healer or support and the Grimshield Hexpriest card behind him you will get a balanced team. In such a setup it becomes much easier to defeat the enemy.

Another important thing is that the Grimshield Hexpriest card is more effective in magic-based teams. Because then the whole team can deal damage together which becomes difficult for the enemy to resist. Especially enemies that rely on armor are vulnerable to attacks.

In my opinion the Grimshield Hexpriest card is a card that needs to be used with patience and proper planning. It is not that it is guaranteed to win by putting it on the field but its real power comes from placing it correctly using it with the right team and adjusting the strategy according to the rules of the match.

The Grimshield Hexpriest card becomes more effective in rulesets. For example if there is no restriction on attacks in the match or if there is a high mana rule then it performs exceptionally. If the enemy team has armor it is still very effective.

However like all cards the Grimshield Hexpriest card also has some weaknesses. For example if the enemy has a Magic Reflect or Silence type ability the effectiveness of the Grimshield Hexpriest card may decrease. Therefore the Grimshield Hexpriest card should be used considering the opponents team.

In all the Grimshield Hexpriest card is a very powerful and versatile card. It not deals damage but also improves the strategy of the entire team. I personally think that if you can use the Grimshield Hexpriest card correctly you can win the most difficult matches.

After purchasing the Grimshield Hexpriest card today I feel more confident because now I have a weapon that can completely change the outcome of the match if used at the right time. I plan to level up the Grimshield Hexpriest card, in the future because as the level increases its power will increase further and new abilities will be added.

Finally I will say one thing. The Grimshield Hexpriest card is not a card it is a strategic asset. For a player who understands it and can use it correctly winning becomes much easier.

body.title: Going Home to the Bukid: Falling in Love with Every Beautiful View Again
body.body:
![1000195513.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wMaXeAsPWBQ6w4tGooH5CrgHkf9wXSmCP3fPRji61WBcjMhEj75Y4uok2LSirnHLQKF.jpg)


There’s a kind of magic that only happens when you are on your way home.

Today, while traveling back to our home, I found myself quietly staring outside, completely in love with the view in front of me. No matter how many times I pass this road, the feeling never changes. It is the kind of beauty that makes your heart soft and reminds you where you truly belong.


![1000195343.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/241tZL9ud4ou41D7qXCZUz8223PnHUYNSVADHJ3EFa5UXujsuZKZ3TR39c8ZcRyzKmbfs.jpg)

![1000195348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23ynQ97oGsZSKZd6DAGtWUGuGDTJUPy1xyo2xR5JQx2dsSXy8vxgaaGSxVNDnhGQKBoz2.jpg)

From far away, you can already see the mountains standing proudly in the distance. Those mountains are more than just scenery they are a sign that home is near. The moment I catch a glimpse of them, I feel excitement growing inside me. It is like the mountains are welcoming us back, patiently waiting after a long day away.


![1000195366.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/243Lzvoyg4mfmuXP9JySCaQZ8U3L15FeYr3qjRHUh6nkKstAioSgmcGjbC9rVKYLsqVTZ.jpg)

![1000195356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/244e84mamL2JpSCPKyKwTu4mcU7qh8Y4PaT3nGtUdnVfMUtZ5mp7bSW9tFm87V9TpVnnU.jpg)

One mountain that always captures my attention is Toro Toro Mountain. There is something so peaceful and majestic about it. Every time I look at it, I feel calm. Its strong presence, covered with the beauty of nature, reminds me how wonderful simple things can be. You do not need expensive places or grand adventures to feel amazed. Sometimes, all you need is the view of a mountain you have known for years.


![1000195545.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/243fnU7G6wiNpcdTWzTLyAVgMERhLzDCZYmSE9pHZgTvFCfRvFvCEhA7SJHKnKPgBscAU.jpg)

As we get closer to home, the air begins to change. It becomes fresher, cooler, and lighter. You can breathe deeply and feel the difference right away. It is the kind of air that refreshes your body and clears your mind. In the city, life can feel noisy and rushed, but here in the mountain everything slows down in the best way.


![1000195495.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xVCup1c3xqcpY4YjZhcLSUiR9M9oAiSHMJFUPgQGXThex7iZzpSNYrLVkMixQ7ztk8z.jpg)

Then come the sounds of nature the sweet sounds of birds singing from the trees, the rustling of leaves dancing with the wind, and the quiet stillness that feels so rare these days. It is a beautiful kind of silence, one that brings peace to the soul. I know majority of my friends this is what they wanted a peaceful life and surrounded by nature. 


![1000195370.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/2458JCuLGTfwGpWV2xitn5gHmTzdLtb1Y4zq58pXUgDuhfJUaUwT7dvWxnJET4FRtQxWb.jpg)

When I finally arrive home, I always notice the wild plants and unique leaves surrounding the area. Some grow freely along the path, some climb quietly on fences, and others stand tall as if proudly showing their natural beauty. They may be ordinary to some, but to me, they are special treasures of the countryside.

This is why going home to the bukid always feels different. It is not just about returning to a place it is about returning to peace, to beauty, and to the simple life that fills the heart with gratitude.


![1000195547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/244xsF5QQWohSVRhHJnmxqC9MnZhpP5g9QcecQfZ6khizsE4xy6Lw1KMuqnWcZVcbA4aL.jpg)

No matter where life takes me, the road home with its mountains, fresh air, birdsong, and natural wonders will always be one of the most beautiful views I could ever love.


![1000195548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/245HmQXbrTExVqrhobBzMPre62L9VXs7FEWUYavYNqW9F5N1jhDP4HfACnyULSEfqrbrp.jpg)

Thank you for reading my story! This is my owned picture, edited in Canva. Have a nice day!

body.title: HivePostify.cloud: Real Traffic, Real Users, Real Growth - Our Cloudflare Analytics Report  CRP-1
body.body:
I do not like making claims without evidence. Today, instead of asking you to trust my words, I am sharing our actual server analytics directly from Cloudflare, the infrastructure layer that supports hivepostify.cloud.


![pp24](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/243c011939fd9badf9207caefc75aba8.webp)


Every number below comes from our live Cloudflare dashboard. Nothing is exaggerated. Nothing is estimated. This is what is happening on this platform right now.

---

## Traffic Overview - Previous 7 Days

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Total Requests | 1,750,000 |
| Cached Requests | 14,230 |
| Uncached Requests | 1,740,000 |
| Total Bandwidth | 20.46 GB |
| Cached Bandwidth | 9.66 GB |
| Uncached Bandwidth | 10.80 GB |

In the last seven days, our servers handled one million seven hundred and fifty thousand requests. Over twenty gigabytes of data served real users loading real pages, real images, and real content from Hive worldwide.



![2](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/c18424baa56d81b41733b1e30c703a72.webp)


![3](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/90c578da4d026159e8dd89d3c584cc1b.webp)


![4](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/114104896514751be36454581e8eb14b.webp)

*These Images are 24 Hours Data*



The fact that 1,740,000 out of 1,750,000 requests are uncached and hitting our origin server directly indicates something important. Most of our traffic consists of dynamic, live, and personalized content. This includes logged-in users, API responses, and real-time Hive blockchain data. This is what an active social platform looks like, not a static landing page with inflated numbers.

---

## Unique Visitors - Previous 7 Days

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Total Unique Visitors | 9,140 |
| Peak Day (Maximum) | 2,440 visitors |
| Lowest Day (Minimum) | 309 visitors |




Over nine thousand unique people visited hivepostify.cloud in the past seven days. The growth trend between our minimum and maximum day shows that the platform is gaining momentum, not losing it.

---

## Top Traffic Countries - Previous 24 Hours

| Country | Requests |
|---|---|
| United States | 189,295 |
| Pakistan | 25,520 |
| France | 3,833 |
| Switzerland | 86 |
| Netherlands | 58 |





![5](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/f82253b407d7bd2b0df11bbd25c4f4e4.webp)


![6](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/92e437275997d196e12dc420ab9aa001.webp)

 


The United States leading our traffic is a significant point in this report. HivePostify is not just a local Pakistani platform; it is also being discovered and used by international audiences. American users reading content on a platform created by a student in Pakistan on the Hive blockchain indicates real product quality and content worth engaging.

Pakistan is our second largest source, which aligns with our mission. Our active Facebook ad campaigns targeting Pakistani freelancers and content creators are clearly converting into real visits.

---

## HTTP Version Distribution - Previous 24 Hours

| Protocol | Requests | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| HTTP/1.1 | 196,006 | 86.72% |
| HTTP/2 | 15,546 | 6.88% |
| HTTP/3 | 14,479 | 6.41% |



![7](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/e2d7e33d47972ebe3947fb7a34ba08dc.webp)
 

The presence of HTTP/3 traffic means modern clients are successfully negotiating our fastest available protocol. This indicates our server configuration is optimized for performance.

---

## Content Type Breakdown - Previous 24 Hours

| Content Type | Requests | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| JSON | 192,854 | 88.06% |
| HTML | 16,075 | 7.34% |
| Empty | 8,922 | 4.07% |
| TXT | 579 | 0.30% |
| JS | 150 | 0.07% |
| PNG | 131 | 0.06% |
| CSS | 109 | 0.05% |
| WebP | 102 | 0.05% |
| Other | 72 | 0.03% |



![8](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/d28dc16816c7c2cc5653a95d3d6f5b2e.webp)
 


This table is the most important one in this entire post for anyone who understands how web applications work.

88.06% of all our traffic returns JSON data. JSON responses are API calls, which represent users actively engaging with the platform. This includes loading feeds, submitting posts, retrieving blockchain data, placing orders on the marketplace, and voting on content.

A platform where nearly 90% of traffic is live API activity indicates that people are not just visiting; they are using it.

---

## Bandwidth Saved by Caching - Previous 24 Hours

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Total Bandwidth | 1.58 GB |
| Saved by Cache | 261.29 MB |
| Cache Saving Percentage | 17% |



![9](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/9d49172973717ae8f0fd1f27564fd959.webp)
 


Cloudflare's caching layer saved us 264 megabytes in a single day. This helps keep our infrastructure costs down and improves load times for users everywhere.

---

## Core Web Vitals - Page Load Performance

| LCP Score | Percentage of Visits |
|---|---|
| Good | 57% |
| Needs Improvement | 11% |
| Poor | 31% |

| LCP Percentile | Load Time |
|---|---|
| P50 (Median) | 1,832ms |
| P75 | 4,580ms |
| P90 | 6,620ms |
| P99 | 17,716ms |




![10](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/244806f092587d49dc520add51730397.webp)

*Latest On Track*
 


**Average Page Load Time: 880ms**

I am sharing this openly because I believe in full transparency, not just when the numbers look good.

The Poor percentage is real, and we know exactly why it happens. Posts containing images hosted on third-party services, like PeakD, can show LCP times as high as 15 seconds. These images are embedded in content created by Hive users across the ecosystem, and we have no control over their hosting speeds.

Our self-hosted images tell a different story. One of our WebP-compressed images in the debug data shows an LCP of just 3.1 seconds, which is significantly better and within an acceptable range for a live blockchain application making real-time API calls.

We are actively working on lazy loading and image optimization to reduce the Poor percentage. This is part of our roadmap, and we will fix it.

The 880ms average load time across all visits is a strong result for any platform making live Hive blockchain calls and rendering decentralized content in real time.

In the last seven days, over nine thousand unique people visited a Hive-powered platform. 1.75 million requests were handled by our servers. Twenty gigabytes of Hive content was served to users in the United States, Pakistan, France, and beyond.

HivePostify is driving real international traffic to Hive content. Every article read on our platform is part of the Hive ecosystem being engaged by someone who may never have discovered it through hive.blog or PeakD.
