I decided to run 4 km with my dad, something we hadn't done together in a while. 👟💨 We went to \

– a local park with a curious name. Why? Because about 30 years ago, several Russian families lived in this neighborhood, and the name just stuck! 🇷🇺🏘️✨

The sun was out, the trees gave us some shade, and the path was perfect for a good run. ☀️🌿 We kept a steady pace, pushing each other without even saying a word. 💪🗣️ Sometimes he led, sometimes I did. But the best part? Sharing stories between breaths, laughing at old memories, and making new ones right there on the track. ❤️😄

4 km never felt so meaningful. Grateful for health, for my dad, and for little adventures like this. 🙏👟

Spanish version 🇪🇦

Me decidí a correr 4 km junto a mi papá, algo que no hacíamos juntos desde hacía tiempo. 👟💨 Fuimos al \

– un parque del barrio con un nombre curioso. ¿El motivo? Porque hace unos 30 años, varias familias rusas vivían en esta zona, ¡y el nombre se quedó para siempre! 🇷🇺🏘️✨ El sol acompañaba, los árboles nos daban sombra y el camino estaba perfecto para correr. ☀️🌿 Mantuvimos un ritmo constante, empujándonos el uno al otro sin necesidad de hablar mucho. 💪🗣️ A veces él llevaba el paso, a veces yo. ¿Lo mejor? Compartir historias entre respiración y respiración, reírnos con viejos recuerdos y crear otros nuevos justo ahí, sobre la pista. ❤️😄 4 km nunca se sintieron tan significativos. Agradecido por la salud, por mi papá y por pequeñas aventuras como esta. 🙏👟

body.title: [EN/ES] Sketchbook 61 - Faces for the first time
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeLbRQ3saZZfejrmGqJcDG6QyTmq2wLXzXtvDDYN7qvcX/20260403_165550.jpg) I share my latest pages from my traditional sketchbook, pages that were full of mistakes and learning, since it's the first time I had the challenge of drawing human faces as realistically as possible. I hope you find this blog interesting, where I share the good but also the bad, and the processes. I start by warming up with this drawing of 3D shapes that I did both in pencil and ink. > Comparto mis últimas páginas de mi sketchbook en tradicional, unas páginas que estuvieron llenas de errores y aprendizajes, ya que es la primera vez que tenía como reto dibujar rostros humanos lo más realista posible. Espero que encuentren interesante este blog, donde comparto lo bueno pero también lo malo, y los procesos. Comienzo calentando con este dibujo de formas 3D que realicé tanto a lápiz como a tinta. | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR3BhMPyGmbuseT3dLBvk6SmDfYH79RLiDLzn5npqoyXV/20260403_165641.jpg)| ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR1mU3f6eNsVY3LHnVz8PmBdPUCMAyiyFXjkqxjpHRv8q/20260409_154034.jpg) | | ------------ | ------------ | Continuing with the pending work from the previous session, I made the Bratz page from Andrew Loomis’ book *Fun With a Pencil*. Here you will see a great selection of cartoonish baby faces. > Continuando con lo pendiente de la sesión anterior, realicé la página Bratz del libro *Fun With a Pencil* de Andrew Loomis. Aquí verán una gran selección de rostros caricaturescos de bebés. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWushUxDKDqkZpERpVPkUFcy2CaawkxzoyrSQRXa7Gg9P/20260409_162353.jpg) I took some notes and tried to make a model of the male human head both in profile and front view. I filled the page with some notes and measurements; this got quite complicated for me and I ended up somewhat frustrated. > Tomé algunas anotaciones y traté de hacer un modelo de la cabeza humana masculina tanto de perfil como de frente, completé la hoja con algunas anotaciones y mediciones; esto se me complicó bastante y terminé algo frustrado. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQUHEAZrPcZGBB4xWDcWHwFTg9o1xz6iTtHNoza5vLWA/20260409_171226.jpg) I kept trying, but the results were not what I expected. Perhaps it's simply part of the process to make these mistakes. It's been almost a year since I started taking drawing seriously, and I had put off realism for fear of this very thing, the frustration of not seeing results, but we are going to keep trying again and again. > Seguí intentándolo, pero los resultados no eran lo esperado. Quizás simplemente es parte del proceso cometer estos errores. Ya hace casi un año que me estoy tomando en serio dibujar, y había pospuesto el realismo por miedo a esto mismo, a la frustración de no ver resultados, pero vamos a seguir intentándolo una y otra vez. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTdHsdKiqWQcfoAiZPYg7cEVfn2m4Fv4FD1LpimqqZqdf/20260416_170257.jpg) I have an old book on skull anatomy by a fairly famous draftsman in my country, and I tried to copy his models (on the left). To be honest, I found the models too basic, so I took real models and made my own (on the right). Although I found the book's drawings very basic, I will finish all the exercises and models by that draftsman, since it is a book by someone who demonstrated experience and results. > Tengo un libro antiguo de anatomía del cráneo de un dibujante bastante famoso en mi país y traté de copiar sus modelos (a la izquierda). La verdad, encontré los modelos demasiado básicos, así que tomé modelos reales e hice los míos propios (a la derecha). Aunque encontré los dibujos del libro muy básicos, terminaré todos los ejercicios y modelos de ese dibujante, ya que es un libro de alguien que demostró experiencia y resultados. | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW2FsbAva8CijSBq7zopXdXAgkSNHSeJ2VQaM6bEmK6C4/20260416_170313.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR1R1D19Djo4ymq7uwEo75kffHqgxokDqWHc6tY8YqZcN/20260416_170336.jpg) | | ------------ | ------------ | To close the day, I will do drawing practice. I will copy drawings from Andrew Loomis’ book and share them exactly as they turn out, hiding nothing. This will be a good record in case I ever manage to draw something truly realistic. We start with different male faces with different expressions; there is a bit of everything. I liked some results, others not so much. > Para cerrar el día haré prácticas de dibujos, copiaré dibujos desde el libro de Andrew Loomis, y los compartiré tal y como queden, sin ocultar nada. Esto será un buen registro por si algún día logro dibujar algo bien realista. Comenzamos con distintos rostros masculinos con distintas expresiones, hay de todo; algunos resultados me gustaron, otros no tanto. | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSJZV9E8oq9vEuZZp51J5MVNxmXxRHBVh7L9nUgPA5Fkr/20260416_170355.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS5adDA9FjBGczUnrLidktuxWkeBmsqjAF26cXfBmEQiA/20260416_174509.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd1h58hs6ZZ43ef8PATnc9sXJ3NpMjBrmNzxsYX6gt5qJ/20260416_181734.jpg) | | ------------ | ------------ | ------------ | The following pages were dedicated to the study of the female face. Profile faces are extremely difficult for me, but not as difficult as faces with 3/4 views. The shape of the edge of the face and the distance between the features, no matter how much I try to use measurements, I just can't get them right. > Las siguientes hojas fueron dedicadas al estudio del rostro femenino. Los rostros de perfil me son extremadamente difíciles, pero no tanto como los rostros con miradas de 3/4. La forma del borde de la cara y la distancia entre los rasgos, por mucho que intente usar medidas, no me salen. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSuhdyNewXbehdnxGMs4KTG6SGMU6YkWqFvHDHUYxkZqp/20260417_105134.jpg) The last page was for baby faces; sorry if they look like they need an exorcism, hahaha. Well, with this I finish today's practice. I think it was quite fruitful in terms of breaking the ice on something I was afraid to draw. The results are not the best, but onward with drawing. > La última página fue para rostros de bebé; perdonen si parece que necesitan un exorcismo jajaja. Bueno, con esto termino las prácticas de hoy, creo que fueron bastante provechosas en cuanto a romper el hielo de algo que temía dibujar. Los resultados no son los mejores, pero a continuar dibujando. Thank you for accompanying me one more day of drawing. > Gracias por acompañarme un día más dibujando. --- ***About:*** ==*Sketchbook and Journal of a Learner*== **If you like my content, join my [Fanbase clicking here](https://hive.vote/dash.php?fan=nestodibuja&i=2)**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc31AecQSitU5xAjsqS4snajcWh6CMMyapx88itjomSah/thanks.png)
___ *All photos and images are created by me. These are pictures of my sketchbook. Many of my drawings are practice pieces rather than finished works. Images from the internet may or may not have been used as references, copies, or sources of inspiration as part of my learning process.*

body.title: Music Selection done...
body.body:
>

<center>![Unsplash](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516534775068-ba3e7458af70?q=80&w=1470&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D)</center>

Oh why oh why did we do this to ourselves????

As part of our ensemble's vision (well, my wife and I...) to bring together people to just enjoy playing music... and a taste on our take on Early Music (Baroque/Classical)... we did a little test run of a community music playing day at the end of last year.

... and that was surprisingly well attended, and the response was quite positive!

And so, we took it upon ourselves to expand it out to two days on a weekend... and then include little workshops, both instrumental and dance. And getting this thing organised is quite a bit of a haul... most of the logistical and admnistrative stuff was relatively easy. We are sort of vaguely competent at that... well, compared to other arts organisations anyway... but that is a pretty low bar!

But due to our desire to include but historical instruments (at 415 pitch) and modern instruments (at 440 pitch)... it has been a nightmare to find pieces in keys that work well in both pitches. If we had professionals only, then it would be just a matter of suck it up and play.... but given that we have a wide range of abilities and experience... not all keys are equally easy depending on the instrument!

And that 415/440 pitch difference is a semitone... which mostly means that if a piece is written in an easy key at one pitch, it is horrendous in the other pitch!

But there are a few overlaps... actually, about three! Where it is tolerably not too difficult in both pitches. 

My wife and I had shortlisted a whole batch of pieces, and today we finally chopped it all down to also take into account variety, instrumentation, and ability levels. 

The ability level is definitely a thing... and something that I'm having to come to grips with as I tend to pitch the ability level quite high (even when we have professional musicians join us...) and I am sometimes surprised that I'm pitching waaaayyyyyy too high! So, it is something that I have to temper expectations on... it is quite a stark difference to programming for our own concerts... where we just choose the pieces that we want to program that make for a good concert arc and we (and our colleagues) just do our jobs and learn it... 

... but that is from the perspective of a person who ONLY does performance for a living all the time... and that isn't quite the profile of our participants in this mini-festival. So additional though and care needs to be taken... 

Frankly, this has been stressing me out quite a bit... it is quite difficult to balance everything, and the biggest headache has been the pitch mixing. We learnt that lesson in the trial run... and so we have split sessions as well, but it is still nice to have EVERYONE together for a bit of musical chaos! 

Perhaps something to think more about when we evolve this into the future... But at least having settled the choices brings a sense of relief.

Now to get to work on transcriptions...

When I read your struggles with the calendar I was wondering if you were going to mention at the end that you couldn't visualise like one of my friends whom I remember previously saying that when trying to visualise an apple all they can get is a grey outline of a 2d apple shape.

Then it turns out that I'm kinda similar :O I can visualise the idea of a calendar as a generic icon like what one might find on their phone or computer but trying to imagine say this month I can get the rough shape of a week, possibly the previous and next weeks if I'm lucky and think really hard and I can see the outline of the month but it's like staring at something through heavily condensation on glass.  Now that you mention it I wonder if this is why I'm freaking terrible at planning despite my best efforts XD

body.title: Omelet with onions (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> Today I decided to make a traditional omelet with onions. I love the flavor of this ingredient because when it’s sautéed, it releases a delicious sweetness that pairs perfectly with eggs. At least the ones I bought a few days ago—medium-sized Creole onions—become caramelized when sautéed, which is why I add them to my dishes.
![1000110134.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vsWuFkjPwxMB74PUXAYCJDwemGm2PTVc3S6CUErFftZj6AD51hhf3XgkSeD9E3Ef4SF.png)
## Ingredients: - 2 eggs - 1 onion - Oil - Salt to taste
![1000110112.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xAkW9cQ5RY2qDfhyurJeuXrvH4fd1yMvowCuxyTxQLUqBQjEreH3a3u8v71h7YZk1yS.png)
## Preparation: I peeled off the outer layer of the onion and cut it into thin strips. Then I added a tablespoon of oil to a hot skillet and spread it around; I added the onion and cooked it until it turned translucent, having previously turned the heat down to low so it wouldn’t burn.
![1000110136.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xL4wggVgmhtnddsKzR3G9PC31frNNjrAgWQ5ZMtfqa9kFrQ2TQwNSkigceuNEgHmkne.png)
![1000110120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uFMUbPL9KXZvekmkqERaCs5ZwqYRmJHXJUE3zmKZdDzgevp14mCtHJRghYUCMNiK6HE.jpg)
In a separate bowl, I cracked the two eggs and beat them until frothy. I poured the sautéed onions into the bowl, added half a tablespoon of salt, and stirred thoroughly until everything was evenly combined.
![1000110123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xefazu3R8ShZRt5b7UEf2FmxhRVVqKn5mMfGoUunmBvQit2egu27F6dxYZ11BMtJd7W.jpg)
![1000110128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vsWprPmgbq5UA7vjAGzyBKLQbtmxGTJPXoDPWXV53uxxq4nNzAhNWnF6jNVHkGDgdsA.jpg)
I poured the mixture into the same skillet I’d used earlier to sauté the ingredients, and after five minutes I was able to flip it over with relative ease. I let it cook for another five minutes, and that’s how my tortilla turned out—fluffy and with an incredible flavor. To make a more substantial breakfast, I wrapped the tortilla in a piping-hot arepa and served it with a cup of coffee. A spectacular way to start the day. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy decidí preparar una tortilla tradicional con cebollas, me encanta el sabor de este ingrediente, dado que cuando se sofríe deja salir un dulzor muy sabroso que combina a la perfección con los huevos, al menos estas que compré hace pocos días atrás, criollas y medianas, se ponen caramelosas cuando se sofríen, por eso se las agrego a mis preparaciones.
![1000110134.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vsWuFkjPwxMB74PUXAYCJDwemGm2PTVc3S6CUErFftZj6AD51hhf3XgkSeD9E3Ef4SF.png)
## Ingredientes: - 2 huevos - 1 cebolla - Aceite - Sal al gusto
![1000110112.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xAkW9cQ5RY2qDfhyurJeuXrvH4fd1yMvowCuxyTxQLUqBQjEreH3a3u8v71h7YZk1yS.png)
## Preparación: Retiré la primera capa de la cebolla y la dividí en julianas. Luego coloqué una cucharada de aceite en un sartén caliente y extendí, allí coloqué la cebolla hasta que se transparentó, previamente ajusté el fuego a temperatura baja para que no se quemara.
![1000110136.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xL4wggVgmhtnddsKzR3G9PC31frNNjrAgWQ5ZMtfqa9kFrQ2TQwNSkigceuNEgHmkne.png)
![1000110120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uFMUbPL9KXZvekmkqERaCs5ZwqYRmJHXJUE3zmKZdDzgevp14mCtHJRghYUCMNiK6HE.jpg)
En un envase aparte coloqué los dos huevos y los batí hasta volverlos espuma. Acá vertí las cebollas sofritas, agregué media cuacharada de sal y revolví muy bien hasta que todo se integrara de manera uniforme.
![1000110123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xefazu3R8ShZRt5b7UEf2FmxhRVVqKn5mMfGoUunmBvQit2egu27F6dxYZ11BMtJd7W.jpg)
![1000110128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vsWprPmgbq5UA7vjAGzyBKLQbtmxGTJPXoDPWXV53uxxq4nNzAhNWnF6jNVHkGDgdsA.jpg)
En el mismo sartén donde antes sofreí eché la mezcla y en cinco minutos le pude dar la vuelta con relativa facilidad, dejé cocinar por el mismo lapso de tiempo y así quedó lista mi tortilla, esponjosa y con un sabor increíble. Para hacer un desayuno más contundente, introduje la tortilla en una arepa bien caliente y acompañé con una taza de café. Una espectacular manera de iniciar el día.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

The journey continues....

So this time last week I was just beginning my 3 weeks on the road.  I started out in Nanton Alberta and tonight is my last night all the way in Winnipeg, Manitoba.  That's over 1,000 kms away from home.

And it's bitter sweet.

On one hand, I really miss my family.  But on the other, I always enjoy my trips out to this city.  They call this place the 'middle child of Canada' because it's literally in the middle of Canada.  But also, it's forgotten most of the times.

When you think Canada, you think Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver and even Calgary or Edmonton....But Winnipeg, is often forgotten.  It's sad because while there is obvious social issues within the city, I do love it here.

The food, the people, the rivers....It's a hidden gem.

So enough of my Canadian tourism speech lol Let's talk crypto.  And the past 7 days on the blockchain.  Which has been pretty good for me.  While I didn't set the world on fire with rewards from my posts, I did manage to get a blog post in almost if no every day or the week.

Not bad for a truck driver huh ;)

Let's dig in and see how we did...

## 25,00 Hive Power

I'm pretty happy with my growth over the past week...

**25,000 - 22,430 = 2,570 left to go.**

That's great! And if I keep getting rewarded like I have been, I should hit my goal within the next few weeks.  Unless of course, I come across some crypto magically and then I'll flip it for Hive and power up :)

As for my k/e ratio, it went from 4.42 to **4.38**. Not a huge drop but still, she's going down.

## 100 BBHO Per Upvote

Yeah this is frustrating...

My full vote at [The BBH Project](https://www.thebbhproject.com/) is worth....*I have no idea.*

Because I can't bring up the front end. 

I really hope @bradleyarrow gets this figured out because the community website has a super hard time staying online.  Maybe it needs new servers, or someone over at Hive Engine to fix things.  But for whatever reason, it has a hard time loading. It's been like this for weeks now, but this past week I really noticed the errors.

So I'm not sure what I'm at....But yesterday I gave a full vote and it was worth about 67 BBHO.

Please please please get this thing working....It's a much needed community on the blockchain.

## 20,000 MEDALS

I completely SUCK!

I haven't added a single MEDAL to my stack this week, mainly because I haven't been watching a single sports game throughout my journey.

I hope to get back into things soon, and with the hockey playoffs under way, my attention will be there lol Still sitting at 12,000 MEDALS

Overall, like I mentioned, I'm pretty happy with the week that was.  And now I turn back and start heading back west.  It'll still be almost 2 weeks until I'm home, but this is as far east as I go.  

Next stop....Dauphin, Manitoba.

Find that on a map ;)

HBD is the base asset for all trading pairs for the time being. But you can easily do a BTC->HIVE swap or a HIVE->BTC swap, its all routed through HBD. 

When 1 base asset is used in all trading pairs like this that significantly increases liquidity efficiency as its spread across much fewer pools. 

For a 100 different coins pairing them with each other like Hive/BTC, you would need 5000 pools. 
If you use a base asset for a 100 coins only 100 pools are needed, liquidity isn't spread thin and the base asset (HBD) becomes the liquidity backbone.

body.title: 18 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3077: prevalence of lying
body.body:
/>

“The belief that you are inherently superior to someone else because of your ethnic origin is a lie. To live in that belief, and to make policy based on that belief, puts you in direct contravention with reality, in which contravention you begin to think that since you are superior to one area of creation, you of course are superior to all others. This prevalence of lying, of self-deception, has dominated most of the leadership of Lofton County for the better part of four centuries, with the most recent generations in delusion thinking themselves superior to topology, climate, and physics. Fortunately, justice always brings matters up to remembrance in due time. Unfortunately, real human beings in Lofton County have to deal with what that looks like today, in the wake of Hurricane Justicia and Mneme.”

This opening from James Varick IV, editor-in-chief of the Lofton County Free Voice, caused literal howling with rage in some circles, a deep sigh of acceptance and resignation in others, and a sense of deep vindication in others.

But –.

“No matter how you feel about it, you can't argue with it after driving ten miles in any direction outside of Big Loft, Tinyville, or Fruitland and the Veteran's Lodge,” Sgt. Vincent Trent said about it to his children as they drove around the county. “Everyone knows exactly who is being talked about, defying the laws of nature and of the land where possible to keep up the pretense that we are less than and they could do whatever they wanted to us and to the rest of creation, and all of us would bend. Well, we didn't bend after 1865, and creation just shows it knows one God and no white man in Lofton County is Him. Those who humbled themselves and prepared to meet the conditions of two hurricanes did fairly well, but this here?”

“But this here?” said Edwin Ludlow III to his cousin Garlene and uncle, Capt. R.E. Ludlow as they rolled around the county Edwin Ludlow Sr. did so much to build up in the 20th century in their uncle's car.

“It looks like everything your grandfather, father, and uncles didn't nail down has been destroyed,” Capt. Ludlow said. “It was like those storms were sent on a mission, and I don't say that lightly, because the Captain of the Hosts of the Lord knows every evil my generation of men back to Tarquin Ludlow I has done to anyone not like us and also to each other. I include myself because I've had my moments of siding with the folly.”

“Good thing it was just moments, Uncle Rob, because we need our last uncle to stick around, although I'm glad Uncle Henry in particular didn't live to see this,” Garlene said.

“Henry foresaw it,” Capt. Ludlow said. “He knew the Lord so well that he knew Lofton County would be visited in due time for what it did to our father and many others over centuries who labored here. To God, Edwin Ludlow was no better and no worse than the most mistreated among the enslaved who built long before him – to God, all accounts could be settled at the same time.”

“Yeah,” Edwin III said. “Is it just me, or is Littleburg littler?”

“It is,” Capt. Ludlow said. “The historic and business districts are gone. Littleburg Baptist Church is the only thing in the residential area that collapsed.”

“Isn't that the church where the folks met to burn down the _Lofton County Free Voice_?” Garlene said.

“It is,” Capt. Ludlow said. “Turned out that perhaps they should have listened, Edwin, to your father when he said that in a strong enough rainstorm with big wind out of the south, it was going to give Slocum Slide a rival.”

Edwin Ludlow III considered this, and then slowly shook his head.

“Well, given that they were planning a mass murder in there, they weren't on the Solid Rock anyway, because Christ has never been with this foolishness.”

“And, all other ground is sinking sand – if you actually believe the Bible and those old hymns based on it, you know,” Garlene said.

Capt. Ludlow sighed.

“Listen to your old uncle, who is trying to stay here for your aunt, all your little cousins, and you – there comes a day when whether you believe or not, you'll know. This is Lofton County's day. Let us hope that men like me get to and keep on repenting before another and worse thing happens to us all.”

body.title: Etihad Showdown:Arsenal’s Win or Draw Mission – Can the Gunners Hold Firm Amid Form Wobble and Seal Title Glory?
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVoppbRhEyqYszMkPdsi4wr1gjD7L9kj1TT3qGUYHmYTm/1776565551980.jpg)








[Source](https://www.genspark.ai/api/files/s/YeIATlMi?cache_control=3600)


Happy Sunday, football lovers all over the world!
This is the big one. Today, Sunday, April 19, 2026 (kick-off 16:30 UK time / 17:30 Nigerian time), **Manchester City host **Arsenal** at the Etihad Stadium in a Premier League Matchweek 33 clash that could decide the 2025/26 title race.
Arsenal currently sit top of the table with 70 points from 32 games (21 wins, 7 draws, 4 losses; goal difference +38). Manchester City are breathing down their necks in second place with 64 points from 31 games (19 wins, 7 draws, 5 losses; GD +35).



City have a game in hand. A home win would slash the gap to just 3 points (with that extra fixture still to come, potentially putting them top). A draw keeps Arsenal 6 points clear with the buffer of games played. An Arsenal victory would stretch the lead to 9 points, a potentially decisive blow with only a handful of matches remaining. For Pep Guardiola’s side, this feels like must-win territory; for Mikel Arteta’s Gunners, a positive result (win or draw) keeps the destiny firmly in their hands.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


**Arsenal’s Recent Struggles: Vulnerability at the Worst Moment**.
The Gunners have hit a concerning dip in domestic form.Their last Premier League outing ended in a shocking 1-2 home defeat to Bournemouth, exposing cracks in both attack and defence under pressure. This result followed a mixed run that has seen Arsenal drop points at a time when consistency is vital.In Europe, Arsenal advanced past Sporting CP in the Champions League quarter-finals but hardly in convincing fashion: a dramatic 1-0 first-leg win in Lisbon (Kai Havertz scoring a 90+1' winner), followed by a tense, goalless 0-0 draw at the Emirates. They looked leggy, struggled to break down a well-organised Sporting side, and advanced 1-0 on aggregate to face Atlético Madrid in the semi-finals. It was a professional job, but it highlighted fatigue from the relentless schedule.
Arsenal remain rock-solid defensively overall (just 24 goals conceded all season), but the lack of cutting edge,epespecially without key attackers and the Bournemouth slip have raised questions about their title credentials as the pressure mounts.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)



**Manchester City’s Momentum: Hitting Form at the Perfect Time**
City enter this fixture with renewed belief.They dismantled Chelsea 3-0 away in their most recent league match and have shown resilience in recent weeks. Their home record at the Etihad remains formidable, and Pep’s men thrive in these high-stakes, winner-takes-most encounters. With momentum on their side and Arsenal showing signs of wear, City sense an opportunity to claw back into the race.


**Head-to-Head: Tense, Tactical Affairs**
The rivalry is fierce. This season’s reverse fixture at the Emirates ended 1-1 (Erling Haaland opened the scoring, Gabriel Martinelli equalised late). Historically, Arsenal hold the overall edge, but City have been tough to beat at home in recent years. Expect a cagey, tactical battle between former colleagues Arteta and Guardiola.This promises to be a tense, high-quality thriller at the Etihad. City have the home advantage, fresher legs, and momentum, making them slight favourites to edge it.


**Most likely outcomes**: A narrow Manchester City 1-1 Arsenal draw or 2-1 City win. Many previews lean towards City nicking the three points due to Arsenal’s current vulnerabilities.
**As Fan**: A draw would be a massive result — keeping them in the box seat with games to play. A win would be heroic and potentially title-sealing. Anything less hands City real hope of overhauling them.The Premier League title race reaches boiling point here.Arsenal need to show the mentality and defensive steel that got them to the summit.




Lovers of football ⚽ in the house,who are you backing? Can the Gunners deliver a “win or draw” masterclass to stay on course for their first title since 2004, or will Pep’s City close the gap in dramatic fashion? Drop your predictions and scorelines, in the comment section below.

COYG! For the travelling faithful,this one could define the season! 🔥
Stay locked in for what promises to be an unforgettable afternoon of Premier League football. Let’s see if Arsenal can turn their recent struggles into steel at the Etihad.

Thank you for reading my post. Yours truly, @zusi78, signing off.See you for more updates,bye for now.

body.title: MONARCH: Requiem - S02E06 - RECAP
body.body:
https://i.postimg.cc/9XKGgnMw/MOARCH-S02E06-RECAP-000.gif

[Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew)

https://i.imgur.com/PGNq5Ek.png

Nobody warns you when a monster show decides to stop being a monster show for a full episode, and Requiem is just that but damn to be honest drama is getting a grip of this show, it just drops you straight into forty something minutes of grief television wearing a MonsterVerse costume, and if that sounds like a complaint I want to be clear right now that it is not entirely. Grief episodes are their own specific genre inside genre tv series like this one and they live or die on whether the cast can carry the weight without the spectacle doing the heavy lifting, in this case The Titans, and what Requiem manages to do is make you sit with a family falling apart in a way that actually stays with you, was really sad to see Hiroshi going down though, not because the writing is consistently great but its the actors in this case that pull this off, you can see Keiko, Kentaron and Kate really showing that grief. The Randa family is in freefall after Hiroshi gets struck down during the chaos of Titan X breaking loose from the Apex containment attempt, and watching that loss ripple through Kentaro and Cate separately, the way the episode harness their grief into something that literally almost make me felt we were watching a different show and I was ok with it, is the real meat of everything this episode is trying to pull off. Two weeks before the funeral, there is a quieter version of Hiroshi on Skull Island, sitting next to Kentaro while the man sketches Kong, and knowing what is coming for him makes that whole scene feel like someone left a bruise on the screen before the episode even really starts, these writers do that thing where they make you regret caring and then dare you to stop.

- IMDB: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt17220216/
- Platform: [APPLETV](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew)

https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/19/uS3Gme.png
<div style=\

> https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/19/uS3HQs.png [Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew) Ren Watabe is doing the kind of work in this episode that should earn him way more attention than this show gets I think his character Kentaro is going to start to grow from here just as Cate did, because the version of Kentaro at the funeral is not some romanticized version of grief, it is kinda uncomfortable, he goes after Cate and the truth is that it didnt felt fair and take in consideration Im no Cate fan, and not something you walk away feeling good about, and the fact that Watabe plays that scene without softening it even slightly is what makes it hit the way it does. Anna Sawai carries a different weight entirely, the specific exhaustion of a person who knows she is a the main reason not only a new titan is loose on Earth but now took down her father and why everyone around her is suffering, and the moment she shares with Keiko down at the pier, where the water starts moving around her in a way that cannot be explained by anything ordinary, is one of the most bonding scenes on this family since Season 2 started. Then Dr. Suzuki shows up at the funeral and the whole atmosphere shifts because this is a man everybody assumed was out of the story entirely, and Dr Suzuki brings a worn down version of scientific guilt to the role that feels completely real, like a man who has been carrying a specific failure for so long that his posture has changed around it. The detail that Suzuki has rebuilt the Titan phone, which Lee Shaw already though about using if there is any hope of drawing Godzilla into direct fight to take out Titan X, funny enough Titan X hasnt done shit to anyone, its just them scare of another G Day, but this sets the table for what the show is obviously building toward, and even knowing that the MonsterVerse movie canon makes certain outcomes structurally impossible does not stop you from feeling the confrontation can not be avoided. https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/19/uS3rD7.png [Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew) https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/19/uS38n6.png [Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew) Here is where things went sideways for me and I am not going to pretend its all perfect becuase the show even though is a good watch has it flaws and drags from time to time, its the dream sequence its a real problem and not a small one. Kentaro is walking the streets of Tokyo, the sirens hit, the skyline lights up, and Godzilla is right there above the city going at it with Titan X, and your body reacts before your brain does, you sit up, you lean in, and then the whole thing dissolves into a dream and you realize you got played. BIG WTH, its the show teasing you, I understand the executive producer went on record explaining that the MonsterVerse movie timeline cannot allow Tokyo to be destroyed inside a TV show, and knowing that reasoning does not make the trick feel any less as a cheap shot because we all been waiting a Godzilla fith. It is a bait and switch that the show tries to dress up as a window into Kentaro is psychological state but the execution lands somewhere between frustrating and condescending to anyone who has stayed patient with this season through its slower moments. What makes it worse is that right alongside this cheap move you have Keiko, a woman displaced across decades of time who should be one of the most fascinating characters this season, and the episode keeps treating her adjustment to the present day as background noise rather than something worth slowing down and show off, which is a very weak creative choice when her situation has more natural drama built into it than half the plot the show keeps prioritizing instead. https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/19/uS3AqT.png [Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew) https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/19/uS3MTM.png [Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew) I feel the same frustration I used to feel watching other shows when they just stretching the context and keep teasing you almost like you lost, the flashbacks were working just great but I guess at some point in time writers thought it was just too much and now its the present days that dont hold up the same weight, and Requiem has that exact problem, I end up wanting more of that good old context where they keep taking about their past because the present is boring. The show keeps pulling you backward into meaningful moments and then yanking you out before those moments finish, and this episode is probably the clearest demonstration of that becoming a real structural issue rather than an occasional writting style choice. Kentaro finding Sota is bar refurbished under completely new management is the kind of detail that could have sat there and done serious work as a visual metaphor for how completely his world has been rearranged since he left Tokyo, but the episode is already moving toward Isabel and the Apex angle before you even finish noticing all the changes they have done to the place. Amber Midthunder walks into this show as Isabel, daughter of Walter Simmons, and she has a presence so immediately charged that you know she matters, but the episode make her presence looks vague she almost feels fake int he sense that she doesnt matter at all and all you walk away knowing for certain is that she has her sights on Kentaro at a moment when he is emotionally weak as any guy who just lost his father can be. https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png

> https://i.imgur.com/r0yj9oi.png The ending is where Requiem earns back a chunk of what the dream sequence stole from it, because Suzuki gets his machine running and Lee Shaw, the older version sitting right there in that room, hears his own voice coming back through the signal from across time, specifically the younger Major Leland Lafayette Shaw III calling for extraction through decades of distance, its weird how times work on this series and that is the kind of science fiction gut punch that makes you forget about everything that annoyed you for about fifteen minutes because it opens up territory this show has not been anywhere near before, that full on time machine / phone sci fi aspect. The idea that these two versions of the same man might now be able to reach each other across timelines, played in real life by a father and son in Kurt and Wyatt Russell is the most exciting idea this season taken since Titan X first appeared with this presence of Kraken like that everyone was waiting because honestly thats what this season sold everyone, THE KRAKEN and then came up with stupid Titan X name. I am giving Requiem a 7 out of 10 and that rating leans harder on the ending and the performances than on the episode as a whole, specially after them teasing that fight in Tokyo, because the grief work from really good and the Suzuki reveal is a great addition that gives this twist basically taking the Randals from the whole they were in after Hiroshi death, but the dream sequence trick and the way the show keeps rushing past its own best emotional moments before they can fully land keeps this from being something even bigger and this series still has episodes left to either fully commit to the Russell timeline madness or fumble it the way it fumbled Godzilla standing over Tokyo while someone slept, yeah Im holding that grudge till the end. https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png https://i.imgur.com/AbuDA6i.png

body.title: Shadows Crossing a Small Bridge (Parte 3). [EN/ES] Entry for the Shadow Hunters SMASh Contest-Round 422.
body.body:
Hello, friends of the #ShadowHunters community, thanks to our friend @melinda010100 for inviting us to this initiative in her Shadow Hunters SMASh Contest – Round 422.

  
### Shadows Crossing the Small Bridge (Part 3)

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWJhUCLXYyzgXmiwFWYTtN3FCD8sXmpuiups8fVMMkW8K/screenshot_20260417_025606_01.jpg)

---

After an exhausting day, I finally found myself walking again across the small bridge that connects the hotel areas. This time, the shadows were different. They were mine.

---

The journey to get here was not simple. Waiting under the sun at the bus stop, then getting off near the old Varadero airport to take another bus while they refueled. It makes you wonder if after so many days without activity there was no time to prepare, or if, as usual, it was just a lack of planning. No one seems to care about hundreds of workers standing there, carrying their bags, waiting under the heat.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWGArqtQ4CshrxosTqpNPLWCF4dxgRY34gbtdSvefTUnj/screenshot_20260417_025601_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd6poZjPRcL64v1by5RDxjwKj9vjP8gzwT1fq6UHpbK8u/screenshot_20260417_025555_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXc2CwZfoRbPVeW55nndy16kbS2Ywn7c4FfLxcsQrpnpG/screenshot_20260417_025611_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaU4Dh6QmS4mS2VqpY59X8KuAV9z5QvYfwTMVmVkftuGp/screenshot_20260417_025627_01.jpg)

---

By the time I finally arrived and crossed the bridge, carrying my belongings, the sun was already lower. My shadow stretched over the structure, marking each step toward the building where I am staying — or rather, where I am “lodged,” because that word feels more accurate than “guest.” A guest has rights, can complain, can demand certain conditions. Here, things are different.

---

Even simple things become complicated. You cannot cross through the lobby, even when the hotel has no guests. Instead, you have to walk around through the parking area, under the sun, taking the longer way. Standing there, watching my own shadow move along the bridge, I realized that sometimes these images say more than words.

---

The photos were taken with my mobile phone, and for the English version I used Google Translate.

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

---

📢 If you want to see my full process in real time inside Hive and Web3, I’m documenting it here:

👉 Daily Hive Journal 🚀  
https://t.me/diariohive  

There I share progress, mistakes, and results with no filter.

---

***Spanish Version***
- - -

---

Hola, amigos de la comunidad #ShadowHunters, gracias a la amiga @melinda010100 por convocarnos a esta iniciativa en su Shadow Hunters SMASh Contest – Round 422.

### Sombras cruzando el pequeño puente (Parte 3)

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWJhUCLXYyzgXmiwFWYTtN3FCD8sXmpuiups8fVMMkW8K/screenshot_20260417_025606_01.jpg)

---

Después de una jornada agotadora, finalmente me encontré otra vez cruzando el pequeño puente que conecta las áreas del hotel. Esta vez, las sombras eran diferentes. Eran las mías.

---

El camino hasta aquí no fue sencillo. Esperar bajo el sol en la parada, luego bajarme por el antiguo aeropuerto de Varadero para tomar otro ómnibus mientras le echaban combustible. Uno se pregunta si después de tantos días sin trabajar no hubo tiempo para prepararse o si, como casi siempre, faltó previsión. A nadie parece importarle que cientos de trabajadores estén ahí, con sus maletines, esperando bajo el sol.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWGArqtQ4CshrxosTqpNPLWCF4dxgRY34gbtdSvefTUnj/screenshot_20260417_025601_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd6poZjPRcL64v1by5RDxjwKj9vjP8gzwT1fq6UHpbK8u/screenshot_20260417_025555_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXc2CwZfoRbPVeW55nndy16kbS2Ywn7c4FfLxcsQrpnpG/screenshot_20260417_025611_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaU4Dh6QmS4mS2VqpY59X8KuAV9z5QvYfwTMVmVkftuGp/screenshot_20260417_025627_01.jpg)

---

Cuando por fin llegué y crucé el puente con mis pertenencias, el sol ya estaba más bajo. Mi sombra se alargaba sobre la estructura, marcando cada paso hacia el bloque de habitaciones donde estoy albergado. Porque esa es la palabra correcta. No puedo decir hospedado. Un huésped tiene derechos, puede reclamar. Aquí la realidad es otra.

---

Incluso lo más simple se complica. No se permite atravesar el lobby, aunque el hotel no tenga clientes. Hay que dar la vuelta por el parqueo, bajo el sol, por el camino más largo. Y ahí, viendo mi propia sombra avanzar sobre el puente, pensé que a veces estas imágenes dicen más que cualquier explicación.

---

Las fotos fueron tomadas con el móvil y para la versión en inglés utilicé el traductor de Google.

body.title: A new adventure: The Peñon Beach (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> The beach in El Peñon welcomed us this Saturday for another family outing. At dawn, the day looked a bit cloudy, but then the weather cleared up and we enjoyed some lovely moments with the sun, sand, and the refreshing sea breeze. When you put these elements together, fun is guaranteed—especially with little Alma, who loves swimming at the beach and playing in the sand, building castles and making sand cakes.
![1000109828.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpXJ2AwdHPmPewMysuWCUJkWSZ72fmoEgovj6Pj9HjrWnYA2AnpBnnjdp8LdAiywceS.jpg)
![1000110091.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/2423yignWKWcyuKTBHh7RWudd6bqVMyaX8NDcSKSW3gYWhNH2fNumpiLDowbzyN4NnbAQ.jpg)
This time, we weren’t alone on the beach; a few swimmers, likely local residents, were also there for a family gathering. You could hear the children’s laughter and the sound of them running about. We settled into a concrete hut to take in the view, which is lovely.
![1000109837.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpT3dBXnVnQgMxt1X116aZ2a78d7tHSy9ngLyCRSXcQUgCbei6nDFjMf6Xdf1gnXJqF.jpg)
This beach is ideal for children because it isn’t deep; you can walk out about 50 meters from the shore without much risk. Little Alma had a great time because she could go out onto the beach freely, though always under constant parental supervision.
![1000109839.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpXJaArgVHe6VnBYkmoPGuLN5NcBaR4i95yqg38rxmA5ZmPepk9UwVSLu8h8CBqZRV2.jpg)
![1000109835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpLd8FeJXyGyv8T3pmpjrUbg7wSUz6NcFYkvEfsnaoJTDLDMoxXjCXKnJZLdkpK956t.jpg)
The beach is part of the community and getting there is easy; in fact, it’s faster than going to San Luis, which is why it’s usually the first choice for Cumanenses looking to enjoy the sea. You can also buy fresh fish right on the shore—I saw cojinoas, lamparosas, and herring.
![1000109962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpQwM3Zw9oNPb8jAqdFijMZopN1L7x2NXnxPPRLmJxshyfDikThMuh5ou954tiQd4gq.jpg)
![1000109958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpVBX5deaWNMzSfNEgZ8wzCcG2d6faqgF8FoRCpKgfzLrCAJtteXvQpAfYGVVb7V6xG.jpg)
The most popular area on weekends is the one surrounding the Brisas de Oriente bar, which at that time serves as a beer hall and a place for horse racing betting. Right across the street is a cockfighting arena and a few kiosks. Several families were gathered there, enjoying pepitonas, sancocho, fried fish, and liquor—along with soft drinks for the kids—near the beach, while music played in the background.
![1000110094.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eq119rcifULPrL3x5wJs9cemDL9tSEKctX94UQEQCXYNXA6E1zrZmJYGeqPa17XHeFu.jpg)
But we prefer peace and quiet; we take the opportunity to spend time together, have lunch as a family, and enjoy nature without any major disturbances. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> La playa ubicada en El Peñón nos recibió este sábado para un nuevo paseo familiar. Al amanecer el día lucía un poco nublado, pero luego el panorama cambió y disfrutamos de gratos momentos acompañados de sol, arena y la refrescante brisa marina. Cuando juntamos estos elementos, la diversión está garantizada, sobre todo, junto a la pequeña Alma, a quien le encanta bañarse en la playa y jugar con la arena construyendo castillos y preparando tortas.
![1000109828.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpXJ2AwdHPmPewMysuWCUJkWSZ72fmoEgovj6Pj9HjrWnYA2AnpBnnjdp8LdAiywceS.jpg)
![1000110091.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/2423yignWKWcyuKTBHh7RWudd6bqVMyaX8NDcSKSW3gYWhNH2fNumpiLDowbzyN4NnbAQ.jpg)
Esta vez la playa no estaba sola, algunos bañistas, seguramente residentes de la comunidad, estaban también en una reunión familiar. Se dejaba sentir la algarabía de los niños al reír y correr. Nos instalamos en una cabaña de cemento para apreciar la vista, la cual es agradable.
![1000109837.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpT3dBXnVnQgMxt1X116aZ2a78d7tHSy9ngLyCRSXcQUgCbei6nDFjMf6Xdf1gnXJqF.jpg)
Esta playa es ideal para los niños porque no es honda, se puede caminar hasta unos 50 metros de la orilla sin mayores riesgos, la pequeña Alma disfrutó bastante porque podía ingresar a la playa con total libertad, aunque siempre bajo permanente supervisión familiar.
![1000109839.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpXJaArgVHe6VnBYkmoPGuLN5NcBaR4i95yqg38rxmA5ZmPepk9UwVSLu8h8CBqZRV2.jpg)
![1000109835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpLd8FeJXyGyv8T3pmpjrUbg7wSUz6NcFYkvEfsnaoJTDLDMoxXjCXKnJZLdkpK956t.jpg)
La playa forma parte de la comunidad y el traslado es sencillo, en tal sentido es más rápido que acudir a San Luis, por ello suele ser la primera opción de los cumaneses para disfrutar del mar. En la orilla también se puede comprar pescado fresco, pude ver cojinoas, lamparosas y arenques.
![1000109962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpQwM3Zw9oNPb8jAqdFijMZopN1L7x2NXnxPPRLmJxshyfDikThMuh5ou954tiQd4gq.jpg)
![1000109958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpVBX5deaWNMzSfNEgZ8wzCcG2d6faqgF8FoRCpKgfzLrCAJtteXvQpAfYGVVb7V6xG.jpg)
La zona más visitada los fines de semana es la que rodea al bar Brisas de Oriente, que a esa hora es una cervecería y sitio de apuestas hípicas. Justo en frente está ubicada una gallera y algunos quioscos. Varias familias estaban allí reunidas disfrutando, cerca de la orilla de la playa, de pepitonas, sancocho, pescado frito y licores, refresco para los niños, mientras la música se dejaba sentir.
![1000110094.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eq119rcifULPrL3x5wJs9cemDL9tSEKctX94UQEQCXYNXA6E1zrZmJYGeqPa17XHeFu.jpg)
Pero nosotros nos inclinamos por la tranquilidad, aprovechamos para compartir, almorzar en familia y observar la naturaleza sin mayores perturbaciones. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![xUXDZup0qyOVJG14_1001864969.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/queasuluz/images/xUXDZup0qyOVJG14_1001864969/xUXDZup0qyOVJG14_1001864969.webp)
![NdNGx6xDBDWoRN1o_1001864970.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/queasuluz/images/NdNGx6xDBDWoRN1o_1001864970/NdNGx6xDBDWoRN1o_1001864970.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

“Va a llegar un sábado donde el corazón esté en paz, donde a lo mejor al fin entendemos el porqué de muchas cosas, o tal vez nunca llegue esa respuesta pero van a pasar los sábados y la vida me ha enseñado que el tiempo siempre ayudar a dejar de ser tan tercos, sanar, soltar y avanzar. Y a lo mejor lo único que nos falta es entender que si damos mucho entonces merecemos ese mucho de vuelta, ya sabes, en amigos, en parejas, en todo; y que no siempre regresa lo que damos, pero te juro que eso también es la vida avisando que ahí no es. Va a llegar un sábado donde no extrañes a nadie, donde estés con un amor bonito, donde la vida duela menos y donde todo lo que dolía, aunque costó, también sanó”.


English 

“There will come a Saturday when my heart is at peace, when maybe we’ll finally understand the reason behind so many things—or maybe that answer will never come, but the Saturdays will pass, and life has taught me that time always helps us stop being so stubborn, heal, let go, and move forward. And maybe the only thing we need to realize is that if we give a lot, then we deserve just as much in return—you know, in friends, in partners, in everything; and that what we give doesn’t always come back, but I swear that’s also life letting us know that’s not where it’s at. There will come a Saturday when you don’t miss anyone, when you’re with a beautiful love, when life hurts less, and when everything that hurt—even though it was hard—has also healed.”



---

Estoy muy motivada instaurando los cambios que creo necesarios en mi vida.

I’m really motivated to make the changes I believe are necessary in my life.

As the years go by, I realize how important it is to invest in myself—especially in my health and in everything that promotes my well-being.

I won’t deny that the subtle thought also crosses my mind of how wonderful it **would have been** to have had the awareness I have now much earlier; but in the blink of an eye, I dismiss that “**would have**” from my mind and am grateful to be here today, eager to be better.

No es nada complicado, se basa en: Comer saludable, hacer ejercicio a diario, beber al menos 2,5 litros de agua, leer 10 páginas de cualquier libro, preferiblemente de desarrollo personal y tomar una foto de progreso diaria.

Para cumplir con mi lectura de hoy, estuve leyendo el resumen del libro: \
, de Brian Tracy. Al principio pensé: ¡Vaya, que nombre tan feo!, pero luego lo amé.

> I just started a gentle 75-day challenge designed to build healthy habits in a sustainable way. It’s nothing complicated; it’s based on: eating healthy, exercising daily, drinking at least 2.5 liters of water, reading 10 pages of any book (preferably a self-help book), and taking a daily progress photo. To meet my reading goal for today, I read the summary of the book *Eat That Frog!* by Brian Tracy. At first I thought, “Wow, what an ugly title!” but then I loved it. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmT8Maupcyv2Yh9jPNX3YYvMknWhiQcQjHn3kZ5FwiAj4C/20260410_184256.jpg
***

> El sapo es tu tarea más grande e importante del día, que probablemente acostumbras postergar y te genera frustración. Para evitar esto, lo mejor es, en primer lugar, identificar esa tarea que tiene consecuencias negativas si no la haces (tu sapo) y luego, vas definiendo en orden de importancia las tareas que deberías hacer. El truco es: Si tienes que comerte dos sapos, cómete primero el más feo. Empieza tu día con la tarea más difícil para ti. De esta manera no te pesará y podrás hacer el resto con la cabeza más tranquila, porque ya has resuelto lo más valioso del día. En el libro, Brian Tracy, describe algunas estrategias para dejar de mirar el sapo en la mesa y tragarlo de una vez. Si eres una persona que tiende a procrastinar, te lo recomiendo. A mí me pareció tan útil, que ahora leeré la versión completa.

is your biggest and most important task of the day—the one you probably tend to put off and that causes you frustration.\n\nTo avoid this, the best approach is, first, to identify the task that will have negative consequences if you don’t do it (your \

), and then rank the tasks you need to do in order of importance. The trick is: If you have to swallow two toads, swallow the ugliest one first. Start your day with the task that’s hardest for you. That way, it won’t weigh on you, and you’ll be able to tackle the rest with a clearer head, because you’ve already taken care of the most important part of the day. In the book, Brian Tracy describes some strategies for stopping yourself from staring at the toad on the table and swallowing it whole. If you’re someone who tends to procrastinate, I recommend it. > Por fortuna, leerlo fue lo primero que hice al levantarme y me motivó a atacar el sapo de la organización, que me estaba mirando feo desde hace algún tiempo. I enjoyed the experience of finally tackling the task I’d been dreading the most today, so I hope to stay consistent and make this a regular part of my daily routine. ***

> ## Cuéntame ¿Hubo algo que hoy te hiciera pensar en algo más que la rutina? Normalmente estamos tan ocupados o cansados que hacemos las cosas de forma automática y ni siquiera nos detenemos a pensar en cuáles son nuestras prioridades del día. Pero a veces, pasa algo que nos cambia la perspectiva, nos hace reflexionar y entonces decidimos hacer algo diferente. Piensa un poco en tu día y en qué momento tuviste ese momento de luz que te hizo ver todo más claro. También puedes compartir si lograste identificar tu sapo y si pudiste con él. body.title: Puso Village: Lechon, Tuslob Buwa, and More—All in One Place!
body.body: > ![1776565983704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/23wCBnQdkexLxk4o9MUZqGYQoQ3464NHwTuVLVg37SzVuKCkPdesR1NVhiSGeeXQaTZ6Q.jpg) There are many food places in Cebu, and almost all of them are really delicious. It just depends on your budget. But I keep coming back to Puso Village, which is located near Sto. Niño Cebu. Honestly, most of their food is really tasty and also budget-friendly. ![1776566150598.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/23uQxSnvxUWH5yeWyb1GCGu62PfSKTX7jpxAnfyrMiErfmHAB5du1P3Rx3F7sXvTzKogu.jpg) Their lechon is especially amazing—really delicious and worth the price. They even offer unlimited options, depending on what you choose. If lechon is your favorite, it’s better to go for the unlimited option because it’s definitely worth it. It’s crispy and the flavor is just perfect—you’ll keep craving it. ![1776566073625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/242rwdNwKSeo7EL33suDGbMJJBBUoDTjvReyqk3UXRCX94vJR1Q9apBmRrpn3yPrsJVnj.jpg) They also have tuslob buwa. It only costs 200 pesos, and it’s good for sharing with unlimited buwa and comes with 10 pieces of puso. If you run out of puso, you can buy more for 10 pesos each. It’s very student-budget friendly, especially if you’re eating with a group. This is actually our favorite at Puso Village because it’s affordable and very satisfying. ![1776566118712.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/23wqpweTJjaATbRAsxR58E3fSc5pLCz8bxbspeTzojhQh3sqNPyiscZXPQZFMaCwhk62L.jpg) They also have a seafood stall, and it tastes really good too. Every time my cousin and I hang out there, tuslob buwa is a must, but we also never skip the seafood because their seasoning is just so flavorful. ![1776566084916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/23wqkJE2u4baTobyooW7og7CHwHugB9bUn14Vt24ihXcU8ZiH2hE5njFv9LSC8CCX6i3s.jpg) There’s also a bagoong stall that sells mangoes. The mangoes are crispy, and their bagoong is really well-seasoned. ![1776566101869.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/23xp8veFvKZTT8Vd3NWcZJ5Ma99xPPEyfFpKNqQQa16zMkXwYUMdJgBbVH9dny8a39ZzC.jpg) Of course, you’ll need drinks after eating. They have fruit shakes available. We don’t usually go for soda, so we prefer shakes instead. They’re affordable, delicious and come in many flavors you’ll surely enjoy. You’ll definitely have fun bonding with your friends or family when you eat at places that are both enjoyable and budget-friendly. ![1776566061535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsmejustine/23rz2LMh8N27Nu6GS2QdxoRXV3p54V2ZkkM1pFSvn6L2qdXrPtuo6u1DvJKs41VrhxRr2.jpg)

body.title: Time should never be wasted.
body.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/8327551/pexels-photo-8327551.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/person-holding-white-analog-clock-8327551/ ) When we are young, we feel like we have our whole life ahead of us, that is, there is a lot of time in our lives, so many times we waste time carelessly. And this happens in most cases in childhood that we keep putting off work for later, thinking that it does not feel good now and we will do it later. However, we forget or maybe do not want to understand at that time that later time will pass by but our work will not be done. If we think about the old days in each of our lives, that is, the past days, we will understand or see that each of us has wasted many important days in such negligence. The days that we could have enjoyed in a very beautiful way or learned a lot, that is, used the important times of that day to gain knowledge. When people grow up, they regret thinking about the wasted time of those old days at different times. But once time passes, it does not come back, so there is no point in regretting it now. If we can use our every day and important time in life properly by learning and gaining knowledge, then we will not regret wasting our time in any way. We actually make a lot of mistakes in our thinking because we think that we have a lot of time and everything will be done right. But we forget that time never stops for anyone, time keeps moving like time, so we will not be able to use the time that we waste due to negligence in our life. If we do not waste time and do every work at the right time, our life will be able to run properly. And with that, all the work will be done at the right time. But if we leave work and waste time, do one work at another time, then our work will not be done on time and the balance of work and time will be lost. If we can do all our work at the right time, then the balance of our life will be maintained. If we can do the right work at the right time in our life and do all the work at the right time, we will be able to enjoy the right happiness at the right time in our life. Our life will not be wasted in any way and we will not regret that we have wasted our life. If we have to improve in life, earn a lot of money and consider ourselves as an established person in the society, then we must do our work on time. If we do not study properly during our childhood, then that study will not happen later. If we do not earn money when it is time to earn money, then we will not be able to live well. To live well in life, it is definitely necessary to do certain things at a certain age. If we can do certain things at a certain age and at a certain time, we will be able to manage our life well. As a result, we will not have to face any kind of difficulty in our life and we will be able to live well. Every moment of our life is very important, so we should use that time with a very calm mind. We should spend good time with our family and use it to acquire various skills to improve in life. If we use our time to acquire different skills and gain knowledge in different ways, then our time will be used very well and as a result, we will be able to improve and achieve success in our life very easily and quickly. So instead of always sitting and wasting time in negligence, we should think about how to use the important times of every day for good and use them for good. Only then will we be able to achieve everything we need and want in our life. If we waste time, no plan will accompany us, that is, none of our plans will be implemented. Therefore, to implement every plan in our life, to meet all the needs and wants, it is very necessary to make time for ourselves. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/one-should-never-be-friends-with-an-enemy-kw)

body.title: La vida como una ola creciente | Life as a Rising Wave 🌊 [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
## La vida como una ola creciente 


![1000172494.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vi6J2ECrnxL1aV5RkMqGA96Nf2vXix6viChMEU2XgaVeVy8k9z3UF9zfVhtR8EdCfPv.png)


<center><sub>Imagen creada con Gemini.</sub></center>

Hola amigos de Empowertalent, nuevamente me encuentro escribiendo para esta comunidad que me ha brindado momentos hermosos y también llenos de reflexiones. La pregunta de la semana es acerca de ver la vida como una ola en medio del mar, en estos momentos veo mi vida como una gran ola que va en subida llena de mucho movimiento. Hace poco recibí la noticia de que fui aceptada en la universidad donde quería empezar la carrera que desde joven no pude terminar. Fue una sorpresa y una emoción indescriptible aunque se que va a haber mucho por hacer durante todo el trayecto de ese gran mar de conocimientos y oportunidades que se acercan. 

El equilibrio es primordial para no perder el enfoque en la meta que quiero realizar, por eso me tomo muy en serio los momentos de descanso y también de priorizar las cosas que vienen con cada día. Una forma de mantener la calma es recordar que hay que vivir un día a la vez, un paso a la vez. Todas las cosas que hice en los últimos años me trajeron hasta este momento, tal vez en algunas sentí que estaba retrocediendo e incluso dude de que pudiera lograr un cupo en la universidad. Pero fue posible, le doy gracias a Dios que así fue y también gracias a mi por no perder la esperanza de que había una pequeña posibilidad de lograrlo y así fue. 

Ahora me toca enfrentar todo como una persona nueva, nuevas personas, nuevos conocimientos, nuevas aventuras y nuevas olas que conllevan ser paciente, ser perseverante y también recordar que el tiempo de los demás no es igual al mío. Realmente lo único que pensé cuando decidí hacer el proceso para lograr el cupo fue tomar la única posibilidad de subir en esa ola de incertidumbre y tratar de hacer lo mejor que podía con las herramientas que tenía. Me siento afortunada porque no es algo que se conseguí tan sencillamente, pero supongo que como dicen los tiempos de Dios son perfectos y no era antes que tenía que suceder, sino ahora. 

Ahora tengo que enfrentar nuevos y viejos miedos, la exposición frente a nuevas personas me llena de ansiedad pero también de curiosidad y de muchas ganas de ponerle empeño a este sueño. Soy de signo Tauro y dicen que somos muy tercos al tomar decisiones para nuestra vida, creo que es algo cierto porque a pesar de que pasaron muchos años desde la última vez que estudié. Siempre pensé que la carrera que escogí era la indicada para mí, siempre sentí que debía seguir esa ola, que aunque parecía muy grande, seguía invitandome a dar lo mejor de mi y a confiar en mis capacidades, a pesar de que el tiempo pasaba y parecía casi imposible. 

El miedo por supuesto siempre va a estar, sobre todo cuando estamos ante algo que es nuevo pero que también nos desafía a mejorar como personas y también en este caso como estudiante. Cómo dije al principio, creo que enfocarse demasiado en el pasado o en el futuro genera más estrés y ansiedad, además que hace parecer que el tiempo por momentos pasa volando y en otras ocasiones pasa muy lento. Quiero hacer lo mejor que pueda para que todo me salga bien y pueda pensar más allá del final, en las olas durante el trayecto que es donde más conocimientos y aprendizajes valiosos se obtienen. 

Sería maravilloso que el proceso fuese rápido, que todo se diera de la mejor manera, que no existieran olas demasiado grandes que me llenen de miedos. Pero aunque existan, quiero seguir creyendo que este es el camino que quiero para mi vida. Esta es la prueba de que sin importar todas las olas en las que caí muy en el fondo del mar, pude volver a la orilla y seguir nadando sin importar cuántas veces me caí. Esa creo que es la más grande lección de vida que he tenido conmigo misma, en otro momento las olas me hubieran dejado tirada en la arena, pero ahora soy más consciente de que tengo un objetivo preciso que deseo alcanzar y que se que así será. 


![1000172496.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/2432cdqn3FUgup5tWPZnuYGZtvxoMaSeyAKvdz3jQtRnnhtmfyYJZgUmDPRM7kzEUUhDN.png)


## Life as a Rising Wave

![1000172494.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vi6J2ECrnxL1aV5RkMqGA96Nf2vXix6viChMEU2XgaVeVy8k9z3UF9zfVhtR8EdCfPv.png)

<center><sub>Image created using Gemini.</sub></center>

Hello friends of **Empowertalent**, once again I find myself writing for this community that has given me such beautiful moments and deep reflections. This week’s question is about seeing life as a wave in the middle of the sea; right now, I see my life as a **great rising wave** full of movement.
I recently received the news that I was accepted into the university where I wanted to start the degree I couldn’t finish when I was younger. It was a surprise and an indescribable thrill, even though I know there will be much to do throughout the journey across this vast sea of knowledge and opportunities ahead.


Balance is essential to stay focused on the goal I want to achieve, which is why I take my moments of rest and prioritizing daily tasks very seriously. One way to stay calm is remembering to live **one day at a time, one step at a time.**
Everything I’ve done in recent years brought me to this moment. At times, I felt I was moving backward and even doubted I’d ever get a spot at the university. But it was possible. I thank God it happened this way, and I also thank myself for not losing hope—for believing there was a small chance of making it happen. And so it was.


Now I must face everything as a \

person: new people, new knowledge, new adventures, and new waves that require patience, perseverance, and the reminder that **other people’s timing isn't the same as mine.** Honestly, when I decided to apply, all I thought was to take that single chance to climb onto that wave of uncertainty and do my best with the tools I had. I feel lucky because it wasn't easy to achieve, but as they say: **God’s timing is perfect.** It wasn't meant to happen before; it was meant to happen now.

Of course, I have to face both old and new fears. The prospect of being around new people fills me with anxiety, but also with curiosity and a strong desire to put my all into this dream. I’m a **Taurus**, and they say we are very stubborn when making decisions for our lives. I think that’s true because, despite the many years since I last studied, I always felt this career was the right one for me. I always felt I should follow that wave; although it seemed massive, it kept inviting me to give my best and trust my abilities, even when it seemed almost impossible.

Fear will always be there, especially when we face something new that challenges us to grow as people and as students. As I mentioned, focusing too much on the past or the future only creates stress; it makes time feel like it’s either flying by or moving too slowly. I want to do my best so I can look beyond the finish line and appreciate the waves during the journey, which is where the most valuable lessons are found.

It would be wonderful if the process were fast and there were no waves large enough to scare me. But even if they exist, I want to keep believing this is the path I want for my life. This is proof that no matter how many waves pulled me to the bottom of the sea, **I could return to the shore and keep swimming.** That is the greatest life lesson I’ve learned: in the past, the waves might have left me stranded on the sand, but now I am conscious of my goal, and I know I will reach it.

body.body: Lo primero que me resulta genial en su reseña es su extraordinaria aseveración de que tal como están los tiempos afirmar que ahora no vamos a sufrir sino que vamos a tener esperanza y, es que me sigiere que Ridley Scott se propuso desarmar por completo la caja de Pandora contemporánea y para nadie es un secreto lo que queda allí bien en el fondo de ella, peyo es fascinante que apostemos por ella, que seamos las voces subversivas ante tanto pesimismo a la usanza.\nPrecisamente he estado pensando en escribir un post acerca de cómo la barbarie de la época de la II Guerra Mundial que si seguimos tal como vamos y con los representantes del mal contemporáneo y su arrogancia creo que dejaran muy por debajo a aquel holocausto, jamás pensé que la realidad superara a todo mundo distópico ficcionado pero en mi opinión y en mis diálogos con muchísimos amigos, creemos que lo están logrando. No he visto la película pero por lo que nos cuentas en tu reseña creo que Scott nos da aliento de que nuevos 'Sartres' no se vean forzados a escribir nuevas 'Náuseas' si tal como dices aquí se nos presenta un mundo fílmico un mundo que no de asco mirar, tal como dices. \nPor cierto no me parece gratuito que el perro se llame Jasper. Me parece un homenaje al gran Karl Jaspers ese gran existencislista, por cierto también médico y psiquiatra y a quien considero uno de mis grandes maestros espirituales, por sostener que el ser humano ha de perseguir incluso en las circunstancias más adversas, la libertad, la responsabilidad social y el bien común; sólo así tengo la inmensa certeza de que la humanidad tal como genialmente nos dices en tu admirable reseña \
y la esperanza más que una aspiración conseguirá un 'pasaje al acto'.

body.body:

<center>
![M94isk7DKfF2xt8Q_b5618917b0d1f1fb82437398d8e8be.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/M94isk7DKfF2xt8Q_b5618917b0d1f1fb82437398d8e8be/M94isk7DKfF2xt8Q_b5618917b0d1f1fb82437398d8e8be.webp)

</center>
</liketuimages>



我和一个朋友聊天几次后，发现她特别热衷于聊各种八卦，有些即使是她不认识，只是从别人口中听到的新闻，她也会到处传播，至于这些传闻，到底是真是假，根本不得而知。

比如说到他们那个圈子里的男女问题，她说哪个单位里有两位男士，为了一名有夫之妇争风吃醋，闹到当众大打出手，荒唐又离谱，又说某单位哪位美女领导，曾酒后放话，只有某局长能送她回家，非常高调，诸如此类乌七八糟的桃色八卦。

我刚开始听到时，先是震惊，失去了辨别真假的能力，后来又难免涌上一股悲观情绪，觉得自己人到中年，见过太多人情冷暖，世事纷扰，就不自觉生出一种“早已看穿”的倦怠感，仿佛我周遭的人与事也不过如此，浮躁与不堪，人心复杂。

后来，和另一位朋友谈心，她的一句话点醒了我，这个世界或许充斥着潜规则，被权力、欲望裹挟，但外界再乱，只要你的心不乱，一切就都不重要。

确实，静下心来细想，我们总热衷于谈论这些负面八卦，一遍遍给自己灌输各种不痛快，却忽略了，这世间从不是只有乱象丛生。依旧有人，活得踏实又淳朴，守着本分经营婚姻，过着平淡安稳的日子，那些混乱不堪的私生活，从来都只是极少数人的选择，从来不能代表一个行业。


我的一些焦虑情绪瞬间归于平静。

说到底，那些无关自身的八卦闲聊，不过是庸人自扰，对自己的生活毫无益处，又消耗情绪扰乱心境，何必花费时间去关注去议论。不如少听是非，少聊八卦，去做点真正有意义的事，何必浪费人生呢！


---

body.title: Philosopher Pindar:  The Complete Odes #17/71
body.body: >If it is right for my tongue to speak this communal prayer,
>I would wish that the now dead Chiron,*son of Philyra
>and wide-ruling scion of Cronus son of Uranus, were still alive,
>and that he were still lord in Pelion’s valleys,
>a wild untamed creature but with a heart that loved men—
>just as he was when long ago
>he reared that gentle deviser of limb-healing relief from pain,
>Asclepius, the hero who protects men against every kind of disease.
>Before the time had come for her to give birth to him
>with the help of Eleithyia, attendant of mothers,
>the daughter of Phlegyas*the horseman was brought low
>in her bedchamber by the golden arrows of Artemis,
>and went down to Hades’ house by Apollo’s devising.
>The anger of Zeus’ children is no slight thing.
>Yet she in her mind’s folly had rebuffed him,
>and had agreed without her father’s knowledge to another marriage,
>though she had already lain with Phoebus of the unshorn hair
>and was carrying the pure seed of the god.
>She would not wait for the wedding feast to come,
>nor the sound of the many-voiced bridal hymn
>which a girl’s unwedded companions chant in affectionate evening songs;*
>but she was infatuated with far-off things—
>a craving which many others have suffered.
>There is among mankind a very foolish breed, who disdain familiar things
>and look with longing at what is out of reach,
>seeking the impossible with hopes that will never be fulfilled.
>Such was the strong delusion which seized the mind of Coronis,
>she of the lovely robes. She lay in the bed of an Arcadian stranger,
>but she did not escape the one who watched her,
>for though he was then in sheep-receiving Pytho
>Loxias*lord of his temple was aware of her,
>trusting in his omniscient mind, his unerring companion;
>he has no truck with lies, and no mortal or god
>can outwit him either in words or in deeds.
>And so now, when he realized her impious duplicity,
>that she was bedded with the stranger Ischys son of Elatus,
>he sent his sister, wild with resistless anger, to Lacereia
>beside the steep shores of Boebias,*where the girl lived.
>A contrary doom struck her down and hurled her into disaster,
>and many of her neighbours suffered and died with her;
>a fire that starts from one spark can destroy a great forest.
>But when her relatives had laid the girl inside a wall of wood
>and the ravening brightness of Hephaestus had enveloped her,
>‘I can no longer bear in my heart to destroy my own offspring
>in a most pitiful death, together with his mother’s hard suffering.’
>So he spoke, and in one stride reached the pyre
>and caught up the child from the corpse;
>and the burning flames opened a way for him.
>He took the child and gave him to the centaur of Magnesia
>to teach him how to cure men of their painful infirmities.
>And so if any came to him with chronic sores as constant companions,
>or with limbs wounded by the grey bronze or a far-flung stone,
>or whose body was wasted by summer fever or winter cold,
>he relieved them of their several pains and so restored them to health.
>Some he treated with emollient incantations, others with potions,
>and for others he applied salves all over their bodies,
>while others he set back on their feet by surgery.
>But even skill can become the prisoner of gain.
>Gold displayed in the hand was a princely inducement
>for even him to recall from death a man already in its grip.
>The son of Cronus tore the breath from both in a moment,
>and with his hands’ heave the blazing thunderbolt dealt them death.
>Men should seek from the gods only what is consistent with mortal minds,
>knowing what lies before our feet, and the nature of our destiny.
>Do not, my soul,*long for an immortal life,
>but make the most of what you can realistically achieve.
>If sagacious Chiron were still living in his cave,
>and my sweet songs could somehow thrust a charm into his heart,
>then I would surely have persuaded him
>to grant us a healer of feverish diseases for mortals,
>one named as a son of Leto’s child or of his father.*
>And I would have come by ship, slicing through the Ionian sea,
>to the spring of Arethusa*to see my guest-friend of Aetna,
>who governs the Syracusans as king; one gentle to his fellow citizens,
>open-handed to the good, and a remarkable father to strangers.
